author: Veronica
headline: LOVE
comment: This is very lightweight coverage and looks great on my mature skin. It feels more like skincare than foundation, it's very hydrating. May not be good for oily skin but feels great on my dry skin.

author: Susan
headline: Winner winner
comment: I used It when they first launched way back when and loved it. Years and many new brands later I'm back. The formula is smooth, buildable and blurring. Shades are a bit lighter than they look. I ordered a darker shade by mistake but it's actually perfect

author: Danielle
headline: No
comment: This product just left my face greasy and didn't really provide any coverage whatsoever.

author: Anna
headline: Love!
comment:
This stuff is wonderful! As dry as my skin is now in my 50's, I dont always want something that feels heavy on my skin. This is perfect- it's very light but has amazing coverage. I have some redness due to dryness and the weather, and this basically erases it with very little product. It will be great in the summer when you want  coverage without the heaviness. 

I went with the lightest color they have as I have had issues in the past with IT Cosmetics foundations oxidizing and turning orange on me, but I have not had any issues.

author: Ten424
headline: Go try this in person
comment: I was surprised at how much I liked this! You will need to go in person to find a perfect color match. The tester swatch on my arm is very warm compared to the application on my face. I was very, very surprised at how soft and beautifully this melted into my skin and the fact that it has skincare attributes with it?? Yes please.  It's very smooth and comfortable to apply, it does not feel sticky or heavy. And when you wash it off, your skin feels softer.I'm a big fan. I received this product in exchange for my honest review and there you have it :)

author: Kay
headline: Great for day to day use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this tint- especially in my postpartum era! It's super convenient and provides light/just enough coverage for the day to day! Definitely would recommend trying out!

author: Momma4Boyz
headline: Thought I would love, but disappointed
comment: At first i thought i would love this. It feels great on the skin when applying, but its lacking in so many areas. The product doesnt last for more than an hour, no matter what setting spray or primer is used. Its so finicky with any other products underneath that pilling happens so easily. I have tried several ways to make it work over a months time and its just a big NO for me.

author: Shreya
headline: Superb product 👌
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Superb product 👌
Product used : it|Do IT ALL 
Sheer Tint Face Balm 
92% Skincare Serum, Light Warm 215 

I don't usually wear much makeup, but this Sheer Tint Face Balm has now become my go-to product- it really does it all for me.
I am very happy with the results (checkout pics)

After applying it, my skin feels soft and hydrated, without any dryness.
I used a brush to apply it on my face and the process quick and easy.

It's definitely value for money💰 
I would highly recommend this product for daily office wear or even party makeup, especially for those who want quick and great results.

author: Danielle
headline: Lightweight, glowy, and super easy to use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you love that your skin but better look, this is it. This has been my go to for effortless, everyday makeup. It gives the best glow without feeling heavy or cakey. The coverage is sheer but buildable, perfect for those no-makeup makeup days or when you just want something quick and easy. It blends effortlessly and never looks dry or patchy.

author: Phelicia
headline: Sheer to Buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Right now my face is red from cooking and tanning in the tanning bed. I love how light weight it feels. Literally feels like nothing is on my face and it blends so easily and effortlessly . This is definitely going to be a summer staple! The packaging is nice I love that it's glass and not plastic . I love reusing glass packaging. If you were unsure if you should try it I hope this helps you say yes.  My cheeks turn red frequently and I hate it I've been using this just for a natural skin look

author: Lyesa
headline: Great for my tweens skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had my almost 13 year old try this as she's in her makeup era right now. She said she loves that it isn't full coverage foundation and that it just slightly tints her face. She don't like heavy makeup and this is perfect for her. It gives the appearance of smooth skin, without the heavy coverage. It's not super expensive, and something I can buy for her on a regular basis. She wears it almost everyday! She gives it a 4.6/5. So I think we have a winner!

author: Anum
headline: Sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product goes on smoothly and blends well. It is like the name suggests; very sheer. I find that it doesn't cover any blemishes. There's no fragrance so that's good for sensitive skin. The shade I got online was a little too dark/warm for me.

author: BG
headline: Light and airy on mature skin
comment: I love this product. I'm at IT Cosmetics fan and love their CC+ products with sunscreen. This face balm/serum provides tinted moisturizer coverage but with a more natural look and feel. Even on immature skin it does not settle into wrinkles, especially when applied with a #110 puffing foundation airbrush.

author: Msmk
headline: Love this
comment: Most skin tints break out my skin. This does not. I keep finding myself reaching for this for daily use over my foundation. It applies so quickly with a brush, gives an even coverage, isn't resting in lines or patchy. I love the texture and overall finish. And the packaging is travel friendly.

author: Jessie
headline: I would buy this product again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised with this balm. I wasn't sure about the shade, but it worked out pretty well. I like that it's a balm because I can apply with my fingers or a brush. It's good on mature skin. And I like that it doesn't make my face look dry. Its the perfect thing to use if you don't want to use foundation. It's definitely something that I would purchase again.

author: Mallory
headline: Great All over face tint!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'll start with the things I really loved about this product. It's very lightweight it doesn't feel heavy on my skin. It's blend able it goes on like butter!  And provides a decent amount of coverage without going on cakey or breaking up on my skin. It stays on well I didn't notice creasing if you over apply though it can settle into those fine line areas throughout the day. That all being said it's a tad to yellow / dark for my skin tone but I am able to use it currently in my normal contour areas to give just a small contour amount nothing heavy nothing super noticeable it's just enough. I think in the summer I will be able to utilize this product much more as my skin tans more. I will
Be purchasing in my shade though because I really do like the all over feel of this product and the ease in which you can apply.

author: Susan
headline: I would buy again
comment: My skin feels softer and is starting to look better

author: Sky
headline: Not the best
comment: I have dry skin and this clung to dry patches I didn't even know I had and separated throughout the day even after I tried powdering. I liked the shade though but overall disappointed with how it looked on my skin.

author: Em
headline: Not for fair skin unless you like orange
comment: So wish this worked for my fair skin. I love a skin tint where it just smooths out any redness. However, I'm too pale. It was too orange for me. I have very very light skin with a pinky undertone. Tried all the fair ones in store and the best was fair neutral. Took it home and didnt care for how orange it made my face when I tried it on.  I did notice it also caked on and dried funny on any dry skin patches or acne I had. But that could be corrected prior to applying. Either way not for me considering the price and the effort.

author: Chris
headline: Love
comment: It's all I use now. Not heavy and feels great and good for ur skin. My daughter just started using it too. I'm 64 and she's 36

author: Rach
headline: Waste of money! Don't buy it
comment: Barry Matt looking, looks nothing like skin… No blow or hydration makes your face look dull. Not worth the price.

author: Cheryl
headline: Love the product
comment: Ali was my sales associate who helped me . Once I decided on the right shade she went above and beyond to find it.. but there wasn't one to be found, so I opted to have her order it for me.

author: Vicki
headline: I love it!
comment: I was so surprised when it covered age spots.  The color is perfect

author: MARSHA
headline: I like this product
comment: I like the foundation.  It goes on very smoothly, feels almost like skin care.  I feel, though, that it doesn't last quite as long as my Estee Lauder Double Wear foundation.  But this is good for a change, also much cheaper

author: Lily
headline: A must for my beauty routine!!
comment: I absolutely adore this product! I've been on a quest to find a foundation that suits my oily and dry skin. Most foundations look patchy and fade during the day with my oily skin. However, this one is a game-changer! It's incredibly lightweight, has a beautiful finish, and lasts all day long, even during my long 10+ hour work shifts.

author: Clarisse
headline: I love thiss
comment: This is exactly what I was looking for. This is great on my skin and I am looking flawless effortlessly. I get so many compliments. The formula is buttery silky and the shade matches perfectly with my skintone. I love this product. It gives me a perfect skin tone balance and finish i love.

author: mom68
headline: Really Easy and Beautiful
comment: I bought this on sale, and it's fantastic. I'm almost 60, and this doesn't settle into fine lines at all, and when set it lasts all day. I do believe in setting my makeup with both setting spray and powder. I just like a polished look. I have dry skin and some wrinkles, as well as redness from rosacea and this covers everything nicely. I did have a little blemish and this was barely buildable and didn't cover it, so I used some concealer. Not a big deal, but something to note. This stuff lasts all day. It wore off around the mouth, which is to be expected. I can even use it as under eye concealer. And shockingly it doesn't crease there! I was genuinely surprised. Whatever they've done with this little pot of product, I love it. I'm considering wearing it for my daughter's wedding later this year instead of the Dior stick foundation. This has made my top two foundations spot, and I love it. Highly recommend.

author: D
headline: An unexpected love
comment: I was intrigued by similar products promoted on social media, so I bought this during the 21 Days of Beauty sale to try. I have used it 4 times and I love it, especially now during colder months. The formula is hydrating and gives my skin a flow without looking oily. The coverage is very sheer, which I enjoy, but it blends seamlessly with my concealer. My only complaint is the packaging- I just dab my foundation brush right into the pot of product, which is easy but I know it's not the most hygienic way to use and apply.

author: Julie
headline: Just meh
comment:
I really wanted to love this, but it just didn't work for my skin. I have mature skin, and while the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tinted Face Balm felt nice going on—lightweight, smooth, and comfortable—it didn't wear well at all.
Within about an hour, my wrinkles looked more pronounced than before I even applied it. Instead of blurring or softening lines like I expected, it seemed to settle into them and highlight texture in a way that wasn't flattering.
I will say, the initial feel is great and it gives a nice, natural look at first. But the wear time just isn't there if you're concerned about fine lines or deeper wrinkles.
If you have very smooth or younger skin, this might work better for you. But for mature skin, this was unfortunately a pass for me.

author: Shelbbbb
headline: beautiful balm!
comment: this has been the first foundation that has wow'd me in a long time! This product sits so beautiful on the skin, its dewy and glass looking. Upon first application it does feel a little sticky or tacky but it does go away within a few minutes. I do the underpainting method with my other products and then apply this foundation, it blends together seemlessly for a very natural soft glow look. If you expect full coverage look elsewhere. It is buildable but I wouldnt say it goes over medium.

author: Rie
headline: I would buy this product again.
comment: This product is sheer, that gives me a natural look.

author: Cindy
headline: Love it!
comment: It is just the right amount of coverage and it is good for my skin!

author: MJ
headline: New faborite for every day quick looks
comment: so happy I went out on a limb and got this. Balms are usually not my friend but I really love this so far. It has a natural finish, totally buildable so if I need a little extra that day I can smooth some more on. I tend to lean dry in a lot of spots so just be sure you prep your skin!

author: Amanda
headline: Great option for quick makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At almost 40 I'm really enjoying this  face balm. I have dry skin so I gravitate towards lightweight complexion products that add hydration without emphasizing my texture as much as possible and this one feels really comfortable on the skin. I received the shade Light Neutral 120 which was a little yellow, but once i finished my face it all looked good. The balm textures melts in easily and blends in perfectly with a brush. This is a sheer coverage meant to even skin tone so if you're looking for more coverage this isn't for you. I appreciate the added benefit of skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid and peptides. All things that help my dry skin stay hydrated. I got about 6 hours before I noticed any settling but it wasn't too bad. The first time I used it I didn't set it and it still looked good at the end of the day. As long as you skin prep I think you'll love this especially on mature skin.

author: MDRAU
headline: I love this tint balm
comment: If you like sheer light coverage, give this one a try.

author: Elise
headline: Blends beautifully
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a nice balm. I'm really impressed at how well it blends, it is light and easy to apply. I love the packaging as it is easy to carry and not too bulky.

author: Michelle
headline: Wonderful
comment: Lite weight and does not crease or fall in the line of aging skin.

author: Jeleen
headline: Beautiful formula
comment: This product is smooth and buildable. Is that a word? Lol but during the summer time it might be my all-over product. Right now its a beautiful bronzer for a no foundation day. It is pretty pigmented for it to be sheer. I did get this product for free

author: Natalie
headline: Absolutely Fabulous and Radiant!
comment: The most beautiful and truly perfect product! Transformers skin instantly! Glowing and nourished..perfect texture! Highly recommend!!!

author: Dena
headline: I love it!!
comment: I've been using the IT CC cream for 8 years and I just switched to this. It is amazing! So light, but great coverage. I love how it feels and looks. I highly recommend it. They have a 'try on' function to match your shade.

author: Kitty
headline: Lightweight and Blurring
comment: This foundation felt lightweight and blended well. It builds up to medium coverage. It blurred my pores wonderfully but could have covered redness better. It lasted most of the day with no touchups but I could see a bit of the blurring effect wearing off. It can be easily transported. Applying with a brush works best.

author: Yukon
headline: I'm a huge fan
comment: This works so well on my dry skin. I spray the Milani setting spray and it will last all day.

author: Nicole p
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My newest obsession! I was semi looking for a new foundation and this one surpassed my expectations. Feels lovely on the skin, not cakey, good color match. Already bought another one!

author: Catherine
headline: Blends really well!
comment: This is a new favorite.  Very creamy, but sheer.  I especially like using it under my eye.  It doesn't crease at all.

author: Lindsey
headline: My new favorite
comment: I never leave reivews but I really really love this product! It very nicely evens out my skin tone, minimizes discolorations and fills in my pores. It is sheer so don't expect a lot of coverage, but it can be built up a little bit. Also I find using this plus a powder foundation does give a really nice medium coverage for when I'm wanting a more full face look. So in that sense this works for me no matter what look I'm going for. My favorite thing about this is how natural it looks. Seriously can pass as me wearing nothing. This is definitely not for everyone, but if your'e a simple makeup girlie who's looking for your skin but better I highly highly recommend this. Definitely my new go to!

author: Baseball Mom
headline: It face balm
comment:
Pros: Great packaging, light coverage with build ability. 
Cons: Goes on hydrating but drys out quickly and settles in fine lines and dry patches.

author: FC
headline: Super dewy
comment: I didn't think I would love this. The coverage is exactly what I want. Light, but can build to almost medium. I love the way it feels on my skin. Like a good moisturizer. You can powder where you need less shine. I personally don't mind being shiny, I use this as is. Products layer over it well. A little goes a long way. Worth the price point, IMO.

author: Kim
headline: Love it!
comment: Goes on smooth, does not make my lines more noticeable. Looks great and feels light, not heavy and cakey.

author: Sierra
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This blended into my skin so well with and I love that it isn't just a makeup product but also has skincare benefits! The only thing I wish it did have is SPF coverage because I'm not sure how beneficial the skincare is with SPF under it!

author: Cassie
headline: Awesome for every day!
comment: I love the texture of this balm! It's hydrating, and blends really well. It looks very natural by just giving light coverage. I would buy this again for sure! Hopefully they expand this product line.

author: Valerina
headline: Highly moisturizing, serum packed balm with light coverage!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is an amazing product! I expected more of a cream foundation feel, but it is more like a serum with coverage. Very smooth consistency and application that goes on and stays dewy, as it's highly moisturizing. 

I think a lot of people expect a more matte appearance, but considering my face leans towards dry, I really liked it. Plus, I was able to apply some loose powder afterwards and combat the shininess that comes from the included serums. Additionally, I loved that it's light coverage, more like a tinted moisturizer - see the before and after pics. 

I highly recommend this product and feel a little goes a long way, increasing it's value. I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Laura
headline: Nope. Not it. Greasy & Very Little Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a weird product. It didn't feel great on the skin (kind of greasy) and offered little to no coverage. I typically wear a light weight skin tint—but this don't offer anything as far as color coverage, it looked like I rubbed my face in sheer lip balm & gave off such a weird texture. If I applied several layers, I could get subtle coverage of any redness, but it wasn't a great feeling product & smells a little strange.

author: Jackie
headline: My favorite lightweight foundation
comment: I'm 39 with mild rosacea and I absolutely love this tint face balm. It gives good coverage despite it's lightweight formula.

author: Angie c
headline: Great product, but container could use work
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics has always been my go to brand for foundation when I need something new but I don't know what to try. This face balm is great for every day, it's light weight and provides just enough coverage to feel confident to face whatever the day throws at you. I wish they would change the container so you don't dip back in each time you use it but that's my only negative feeling about it.

author: Taylor
headline: Highly recommend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is very easy to blend and transfer, last long, no greasy, natural finish. It comes with many colors that you can one that perfectly match your skin tone. The packaging is small and compact, easy to bring with you when travelling. Highly recommend!

author: Olzhena
headline: The best tinted skin serum
comment: If you are on a quick run to buy something or as myself to pick up my kids from school but I don't want to go for full glam I would say that this tinted serum is it. That's enough to cover my redness or some light imperfections like rosacea or post acne marks, or my little blue veins under my eyes and it doesn't emphasise my dry spot on the skin. It's just melting into my skin and gives me healthy glow. I'm 48 years old busy mama of two young kids who's always on the run!

author: CJ
headline: Found the perfect skin tint
comment: I've been searching for the perfect skin tint and I think I found it! I bought it in store so I was able to color match perfectly. It goes on so smoothly and plays well on top of other skincare. It isn't too shiny, but I did use setting powder when I was finished applying. It didn't crease or breakdown throughout the day. And it feels like nothing is on my face which is wonderful. I might have to stock up! Highly recommend.

author: Peggy
headline: Love this product and its feel on my skin
comment: Beautiful coverage for day to day when I don't have to be all made up but still looks like I am!

author: Erika95
headline: Really good!
comment: Im 48 and this makes my skin look so good. It looks healthy and plump. its beautiful and the coverage is nice.

author: BarbMC
headline: Not Great With Oily Skin
comment: Thought I'd give this a shot, I've been using the same foundation for forever.... I really wanted to love it but not so much.  The color match is great.  This just slid right off my face after about an hour.  I've been using it under my regular foundation for a dewier look and it's ok.

author: Dawn
headline: Natural finish
comment: This foundation is lightweight and my skin doesn't feel like I have on makeup the match was perfect it looks like my skin

author: Sally
headline: Wonderful
comment: This make up is wonderful. It goes on so smooth. It feels good. I'm impressed.

author: PNW
headline: Not Terrible
comment:
After going back and reading the description of this product I felt like I understood how this is supposed to work, its a tinted moisturizer.
The first time I used it with a brush, as I would with a foundation or skin tint, and the product caked up so fast and did not look good at all. It settled into undereye lines I didnt even realize I had and the product got so shiney by the end of the day, it looked mask-like and very similar to other It Cosmetics products (CC cream comes to mind).
I tried it again with my fingers and worked it into my skin like I would a moisturizer and it worked SO much better. The product instantly soaked in and looked like my skin, it was great. I was not able to build the coverage all that much, but honestly if I want coverage I will just use a foundation.
Overall I think the product is worth purchasing if you and looking for a tinted moisturizer , but its not going to provide too much coverage without looking heavy and shiney.

author: Nam
headline: Nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this compact face balm. It gives my skin that glow and a perfect light coverage that I like. It definitely doesn't feel greasy and stays the whole day.  Loved everything about this product.

author: Nina
headline: Worth to try it
comment: Was expecting for it to be on the oily side but to my surprise, it's more hydrating then anything. It feels cool when it touched my skin. The way it blends out is different, you don't even have to try, it naturaly just spreads and glides on your face. It didn't flare up my rosacea and didn't cling to dry skin and it didn't separate or melted off my face. Also, dont belive all the reviews you see, just try it and decide for your self. Most reviews come from people that dont know how to apply makeup or prep skin or don't even know their own skin type and what works for them specifically. Anywho, I did a wear test with a more full coverage glam and it held up longer then expected since it's so sheer. IT cosmetics did something very unique with this formula.

author: Jessica T
headline: Love at first, then not so much…
comment: I would recommend this priduct ONLY if you understand that coverage will look good for a few hours only.

author: Erika
headline: Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The color is pretty good, close to my tone. It looks slightly darker but when its rubbed into my skin it fits. Unfortunately, I have dry skin so when I tried it on my under eye area and upper cheek the dryness started creeping through the product and settled into some pores. I never used something like this before so im not sure the best way to use it but i will keep trying with trial and error and maybe some good moisturizer and hope it'll work well on me. The jar is cute and petite too. Easy screw on/off lid. I used makeup sponge instead of my finger to get the balm out.

author: Kerry
headline: Glowing skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love products that simplify my routine, and this one really lives up to its name. If you like a natural, low-maintenance makeup look, this balm is definitely worth trying.

The texture is really unique — it feels lightweight, creamy, and almost skincare-like when applied. It melts into the skin easily and blends out effortlessly with fingers, which makes it perfect for quick morning routines. The coverage is very sheer, but it evens out my skin tone just enough to make my skin look healthier and more polished.

What I love most is the finish. It gives a natural, slightly radiant glow without looking greasy. My skin still looks like skin, just smoother and more balanced. It's perfect for "no-makeup makeup" days or when I don't want to wear a full foundation.

Another plus is how comfortable it feels throughout the day. It doesn't feel heavy or cakey, and it layers nicely with concealer and a little powder if I want to build up my look.

The only thing to keep in mind is that the coverage is minimal, so if you're looking to cover blemishes or redness, you'll still need a concealer. But for light, everyday complexion enhancement, it works beautifully.

Overall, the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is a great option for anyone who wants a quick, easy product that gives the skin a healthy, natural-looking tint.

author: Stacy
headline: Balm whaaat
comment: This is one of my favorite products now. Smooth coverage not overly oily.  Keeps your skin moisturized. Melts right into the skins.I would highly recommend it has definitely part of my daily routine. Check it out! It might just be one of your favorites too

author: Stacy
headline: Balm whaat
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review Love love love this stuff. I used it once and now I am obsessed. Goes on nicely not oily. Highly moisturized.nice coverage I would highly recommend! A new addition to my daily routine. Love it!

author: Harley7
headline: Dry skin saver
comment: I really enjoyed this a lot more than i thought i would. I am typically a full coverage girl, but as ive had skin changes (im 31) most complexion products were not looking good on my skin. Ive been battling dry, textured, irritated skin for weeks. This gave me a wonderful cooling calming sensation and sat very nicely on texture bumps. It also lasted through a 6 hour restaurant shift. It is sheer-light coverage. Hydrating. But enough to even out complexion. Its also lightweight on the skin. Did not settle into lines or dry patches. Worked well with my other products too. Imagine putting aloe on a sunburn for immediate relief, that is this balm on irritated inflamed skin.

author: Megan
headline: Surprisingly oily-friendly when set. Lightweight.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by this! At first swatch, I thought it was going to be greasy, but it sinks in and virtually disappears, save for a light coverage and dewy effect. I daresay it wears better than other tinted moisturizers and sticks I have in my "vault." I have super-oily mature skin (age 44) and I prefer to powder it and wear a light layer of setting spray. In my photos I also have diffused concealer on under my eyes and around the edges of my nose. The last photo is after about 6.5 hrs wear. You can see it has broken up some around my nose (I wear glasses) but it's still hanging in there for the most part. The shade was slightly yellow for me, but when buffing it out with a dense brush, the difference isn't noticeable. Overall, I would recommend this. It does what it's supposed to, which is even out the skin with a nourishing, seamless finish. I want to disclose that I got this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. That said, I'm a freelance artist and value my reputation, so I'm not going to mince words.

author: Jan
headline: Great for mature skin
comment: I was hesitant to buy this balm foundation because of the weight of balms and the color selection. I am very fair, cool toned and the lightest shade looked too dark for me. It goes on much lighter than it looks in the pot and matched my skin perfectly. Very light but buildable. Lasted all day without creasing in fine lines.

author: Krenare
headline: All in one makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this it cosmetics tint face balm because it's do it all in one or you can say it's 4-in-1 . This is a tinted face balm, face moisturizer, face serum that transforms the skin instantly and over time. It minimizes fine lines and large pores, it makes your skin tone more even and more firm. Once I used it, my skin changed completely. It made my skin look firmer, it gave me an even skin tone and it also hydrated and moisturized my skin. Basically this is all in one facial moisturizer. The shade I have is a little darker for my skin tone but it still worked.

author: Eliana
headline: I love this product!
comment: I dont normally leave reviews but this tint is SO GOOD! It goes on so soft and it blends beautifully and makes my skin look perfect! And i love that its nourishing my skin while its at it! 10/10

author: PG
headline: Mature Skin Friendly!
comment: I don't review beauty products since all skin is different, but with my mature skin, this deserves a review! To me, it's lightweight, buildable, breathable, it doesn't sink into my lines and wrinkles, it lasts throughout the day and is not cakey at all! I recommend at least trying it! Hopefully it will work for you too!

author: Tamara
headline: Feels great on my skin without being heavy!

Im happy to actually use this for quick morning routine, as I give myself 7 mins to get the face together after throwing on scrubs.

author: Kerri

comment: I have used this every day since receiving it and I absolutely love it! My skin feels amazing, I like that it's a buildable product for a full face or just to put on for the gym .

author: Rahila
headline: Great skin tint option for dry skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm has natural glowy coverage that makes your skin looks glowy and healthy. It's comfortable, not heavy, easy to blend and make my skin feel moisturized. I highly recommend this to those busy ladies with dry skin.

author: Johannah

author: Tara

author: Michele

author: Jacqueline
headline: Smooth and easy application!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lightweight and smooth application. I chose the wrong shade,  but fell in love with the ease of application. I tried this product several days with a brush, sponge and my fingers. My favorite application method, surprisingly were my fingers. It felt like I was applying moisturizer on to my skin. Of course, I went in with a sponge/brush at the end to get an even coverage, but even with your fingers the application goes on smoothly. 

My skin felt very hydrated and I was pleased with the coverage it provided me. I have a dark mark on my cheek and I like how it lighten it up just a bit. 

The residue on my fingers came off easily and when it was time to cleanse my face, the tint balm came off very easily. I will definitely be purchasing this tint balm in my shade. Its perfect for those busy mornings when you need to get a little bit of coverage and go out the door. I will definitely be recommending this to my friends and family.

author: Kathy
headline: Perfect tinted balm
comment: It goes on smoothly it covers perfectly if you want more you can easily add more. Highly recommend

author: Mary

comment: Seriously, this stuff is amazing. Its so lightweight and didnt transfer- I was blowing my nose due to an illness and it held up through that and office air. I did set it with setting powder since I am combo skin, but this will be my go to

author: Erica
headline: LOVE LOVE LOVE! This is my new jam!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oh my gosh, I'm so glad I got to try this product. It is soooo awesome. I don't even know where to start. It goes on so light and moisturizing and glowy.  I took some extra time to order the brush that they recommended using with it a No.7 (I got it off Groupon for $20 with shipping. It's super duper soft and works great with this product).. It is perfect. You could also use this tint with a sponge. That would be good too, for light application techniques. It comes out of the pot really easily and quickly. So you're gonna want to use a light touch. Lasted nicely through a warm day without cracking, Super excited about finding this and picked the right shade for myself too! Yay to moisturizing, breathable foundation!   Ps. I have a birthmark and I don't feel the need to cover it 100% but this is a really nice layer to put over it and half conceal.

author: Violetta
headline: Amazing
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Amazed wow I've never tried this brand before I'm definitely making a switch.
 The finish on this is flawless, easy applying it blends so well and smell feels so fresh omg I'm so obsessed with is brand. Five stars.

author: Carla
headline: AMAZING!…but…
comment:
As a 43 year old perimenopausal woman who also suffers from type 2 rosacea, I've been on the hunt for a lightweight tint for everyday that wouldnt accentuate any dryness I have on my (normal/dry) face while also not accentuating wrinkles and covering sunspots. This is it! It wears beautifully! I have never seen my skin look so amazing! HOWEVER. The shade range is for the birds. I have a medium skin tone that runs more cool, however my neck runs more warm. I purchased the shade medium cool (which I tried on in store and was able to see in various light) and wore it for 2 days. It didnt match my neck and ultimately bought out the pink in my skin. 
I went back to ulta today to see if the shade medium neutral would work. I was again shade matched, and while it that shade matched my neck perfectly, it ran too warm on my face. 

I'm hoping to make these work—maybe mixing them?—since the formula is amazing. Hopefully they will come out with more shades in the future!

author: Gail
headline: All sheer tint
comment: I wanted a product for sheer coverage and moisturizer.  This product did both.

author: Christina
headline: If you like sheer coverage and your skin but better, this is
comment: This is perfect for my tastes: sheer, but buildable, looks like skin (hours later, not RIGHT after putting it on), gives a nice glow without looking greasy, stays on all day and plays well with skincare and makeup. My only complaint is you only get a small jar and the price ain't right in that case. But the actual product is incredible.

author: Karina
headline: A new staple in my routine.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this several times and I absolutely love this product. I love that I can apply it and it is weightless but also feels refreshing. It actually feels good to put on your skin. I wonder how they do it because I have nothing else like this in my makeup bag like this at all. I use this on the days that I want to do no-makeup makeup, this has earned a spot and is now a staple in my bag. It wears so good and for quite a long time. I highly recommend to anyone looking for something new and refreshing!

author: Jennifer

author: Patti
headline: Love this foundation!

author: Sarah
headline: A must try!!
comment: I received this product gratis from Infl*enster and It Cosmetics in exchange for my honest review. This is the "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm. This product is a 4-in-1, 92% skincare-infused solid serum that provides light, radiant, and hydrating coverage. Designed for a natural "no-makeup" look, it features hyaluronic acid, vitamin E, and collagen peptides to firm and smooth skin. It comes in 15 flexible, sheer shades and has a lightweight, solid-serum texture that blends easily with the ability to build up to your desired coverage level. It firms skin, minimizes the appearance of lines, and offers 24-hour hydration. Suitable for all skin types, especially those seeking a natural, hydrated look. It makes my skin dewy, with a luminous glow that blurs imperfections and doesn't settle into fine or any lines. Ideal for daily wear, providing a lightweight feel without looking cakey. I've been using my fingers for application and it goes on so smoothly! It feels INCREDIBLE on my skin and definitely doesn't settle into fine lines! My skin now naturally looks more hydrated and smoother! Totally, definitely recommended!!

author: Shay
headline: very skin-like
comment: This product is a must! its very skin like, doesn't settle into pores or imperfections. It feels cool going on and last all day, not heavy at all. It's not cakey and not full coverage. as a mid 40s woman I LOVE it

I tried to use my tart shaped tape for a little extra coverage and it makes a huge mess, the products don't blend well. I compare the ingredients lists and they should be compatible. This also does not seem to blend well with my skin care, which is it cosmetics confidence in a cream. Product does not dry down and I know its supposed to be dewy but this will smudge and wipe off at the slightest touch. I don't see how you could wear this without setting it. These five star reviews have to be incentivized because this product is not it. I had high hopes and I was very disappointed.

I'm also an oily skin girlie and it doesn't make me oily. So definitely recommend!

comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This tint balm is a dream! I love this so much! Its sheer and gives my skin a flawless light finishing. I love lighter and more natural looking foundation and tints and this one didnt disappoint. It applies beautifully with my beauty sponge and give the skin a natural glow that i really love. Its lightweight and the packaging makes it great for on the go. I love usuing this for travel. I keep it on me in my carry on. I will one thousand percent be getting another once i run out! If you love a product that combines beauty with skincare then you need to try this out. My skin looks better and better with each use!

author: Autumn

author: cc

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

comment: This tint balm hides all your flaws on your face while leaving your face soft and looking clean.[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Danielle
headline: Love this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm so glad I got to try this product! I recently had been feeling like my normal medium coverage foundation is leaving my skin looking dry and dull. This is so easy to apply, is non greasy and doesn't make me feel like dry spots are being made more visible

author: Monique
headline: Creamy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation seems thick, but creamy. It went on smooth and felt hydrating. The coverage is not bad and it's buildable. This shade seems to be a decent match for me.

author: Misty
headline: I love this so much and will buy again and again!!
comment: I was absolutely thrilled to try this new product from It Cosmetics! First, full disclosure- I have been a longtime user of the brand. In fact, I have been using products since they first launched years ago. Especially their skin products. I used their CC and powder foundations for years. So all this to say I'm not new to the line. And this is a phenomenal new addition to the brand line up! Its claim is that it's 92% skincare infused. That alone is huge! The coverage tho- is what impressive. It's natural and yet covers flawlessly and get this- it's not at all heavy feeling!! It feels amazing- like a lightweight skin serum. Yet it covers so well and doesn't look cakey, so long as you apply it decently. You can see the coverage and texture in my pics. It's thick in the jar but sheets and melts into the skin almost instantaneously.  I use a dense stippling brush to apply and it's been beautiful in application without needing anything additional. I've tried it with and without primer and same with powder and it still looks great. I'd say my very favorite attribute is the feel. It's slightly cooling but it breathes.  I love the jar delivery- my brush picks it up perfectly and it hasn't dried out yet after weeks of consistent use! It's small but mighty and the glass jar feels sturdy. It doesn't feel heavy or thick. A very little goes a long way and tho it's not a huge jar, you don't need a lot to get it done. It plays well with my sunscreen and doesn't pill. It holds my blush nicely as well. The only thing I keep playing with is its setting factor. Some days it seems to stay slightly damp and takes about an hour til it fully feels set. I am experimenting with ways to increase staying power because I love it that much! I hope to continue on with it and find the perfect combination of products to make it my everyday go to- especially with summer and warmer days heading close. The skincare aspects are impressive and I love that it never looks dry or cakey. I love this and will continue purchasing it!!

comment: This goes on easy, but at the end of my day I had two pimples on my face.  This is going in the trash.

author: Dee

comment: This is literally your skin but better it's so beautiful on the finish is amazing. You don't feel like you have heavy cakey makeup on. This is definitely not for people that like a heavy coverage it's definitely more natural and I have to say I got compliments from so many people on my skin when I started using it.

The first time I used it, wow skin felt so soft!

author: Angie

comment: I love this product sooo much! Its sooo good. Its light on the skin but manages to even out my skin. Its radiant. I dont look cakey! This is the product for that "no makeup makeup look".

comment: It starts as a balm but melts into your skin. It feels luxurious and seals everything in. I notice it leaving my skin soft and silky. It doesn't feel heavy and it looks nice when applied. The finish is very natural.

author: Donna
headline: I absolutely love this product!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OK! So, I absolutely LOVE this this product!!! I was searching for a tinted moisturizer. This is so much more!! It comes in a cute little container. Do not let the size fool you!! A little goes a long way. This has a rich creamy texture similar to a mouse. It goes in so very smooth. It also adds the perfect amount of pigment to give a slight bronze while still blending to my skin tone. It gives a natural look perfect for lite makeup days or even for full makeup. It blended in smooth without a cakey or unnatural look. It also is a skin care. It left my skin soft and moisturized. This is the most perfect all in one skin care, primer, foundation, and tinted moisturizer. It removes easily with just water and soap or cleanser.

author: Garine
headline: So light weight and easy to use
comment: You can see the coverage and the tint on the left side where I am holding the products so silk smooth to apply and drys Matt and I love it feels good on my skin matches my color and helps cover some of my dark under eyes package g is easy to use and store and a lil goes a long way

author: Denise
headline: LOVE THIS
comment: I am 60 years old and have searched and searched for a foundation that covers but doesn't crease. This is it. Coverage that looks absolutely natural while hiding minor skin issues - in my case redness. I am so happy I found this!

author: zenny
headline: Kosas
comment: I received this product free. This face balm has light medium coverage and light weight. It's got a good finish. I like it a lot! Thanks!

author: Loren

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the balm that other balms wanna be when they grow up. Very easy to apply, nice little jar. I used a foundation brush and it applied flawlessly. I'm coming up on 40 and have been looking for a product like this. Covers my redness without being cakey. Feels lightweight, like good skincare. I love it.

headline: Ridiculously expensive

author: Miu
headline: I would buy it again
comment: I love it. The creamy texture and smooth consistency melt into my skin for a natural, sheer coverage. It is super easy to remove with just a gentle wash. The compact glass packaging is sturdy and perfect for my daily makeup bag.

author: Julisa P.
headline: Will Purchase Again!!
comment:
I recently attended a It Cosmetic Event at my local Ulta Store and this was introduced to me. I was hesitate but caved in and bought it. I'm so glad I did. It's a game changer!! I apply it under my It Cosmetic CC Nude Glow Cream. It's such a beautiful combo!! I've also applied it under the original CC Cream since I have very dry skin the tint balm helps give my skin a more dewy/smooth finish when using the Orignal. 

If you have dry skin you will definitely love this product!

author: Kate
headline: Sheer buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've really like using this skin tint. It's goes on really sheer but leaves my skin looking natural and even. I travel a lot so having a solid option instead of liquid is really useful when packing my bags.

author: Christina
headline: Perfect light coverage balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This balm offers light coverage that is buildable. It's really good for everyday wear when you don't need a lot of coverage. It's good for dry skin.

author: Kristin
headline: Nice!

author: Karen

author: Annalise

author: Lu
headline: Good!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is great. When I saw the color I received I was concerned it would be too dark, but it was the right shade. It is lightweight and buildable! It blends so well! I like it!

author: Hira
headline: Very creamy and blends smoothly
comment: This sheer face balm feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin. The formula feels hydrating and smooth, and it's easy to apply quickly with fingers or a brush. It's a nice option for days when you want something simple that still gives your skin a healthy, fresh appearance.

author: Donna
headline: Easiest make up ever
comment: This is just the best idea… make up in a pot and it goes on like like it's supposed to.. easy and flawless!

author: Millie
headline: Where My No Makeup Girlies, You Need This!!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The best sheer tint face balm I have tried, I prefer a low maintenance clean natural makeup look and this product delivers to the T. Buildable coverage without caking, super easy to apply, I used a makeup brush and it glided across my face effortlessly. Feels weightless on skin. You Need This!!! Great for no makeup looks.

author: Carla
headline: My daughter likes it as a concealer!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The finish is sheer just as it says only thing is no matter how much I prepped my face it would cake around the nose and between the eyebrows. But my daughter likes it! She uses it as a concealer since it covers just enough just how she likes it. It easy to take off at the end of the day.

author: Susan
headline: A new holy grail
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This applies beautifully with a brush and gives me a radiant smooth, your skin but better finish. I especially love that it is 92% skincare based and it's so quick and effortless to apply and my skin stays and looks hydrated. With liquid foundation or tinted moisturizers it's always a multi-step process where I pump it onto the back of my hand then use my finger to dot it all over my face before blending it with my fingers or a brush, then I need to wash my hands. With this balm it's dab, blend and I'm done, no mess! The color Light Neutral 210 was the perfect shade for me.

author: Kendall
headline: IT Cosmetics Skin Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked the smooth texture and ease of using this product. Cute packaging. Product was easy to blend. The color I received was a little too dark for my skin tone. I will definitely be purchasing this product in the right shade for me.

author: Sarah
headline: RUN DONTWALK TO GET THIS
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely obsessed with this product. I've tried so many luxury foundations and this one is the one I keep coming back to. Easy to apply, great weightless coverage, covers redness/darkness, and buildable! I barely use my Natasha Denona foundation now and am constantly reaching for this. Bonus points for the skincare keeping my dry skin hydrated and glowy.

author: LA
headline: Love this stuff, but no SPF!
comment: This would be my go too if it had SPF!!

author: Liz

comment: Great color match, so light- tinted moisturizer- I love this for every day.

comment: First thing I noticed was how little product you actually need. One pump gave me amazing coverage without feeling heavy or cakey. It smoothed out my skin tone, covered redness, and still somehow looked really natural — like my skin, just better.

author: Marissa
headline: Absolutely wonderful skin tint!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This face tint is beautifully done, and I especially love it on days where I want to look polished but want to let my skin breathe. It is sheer but buildable, and feels absolutely lovely on my skin. Also, just a small amount of product goes a long way. I'll always have this in my makeup bag!

comment: This is a great tint! The package the came was a lot bigger than I thought it would be. It offers just enough coverage without all the gunk. I'm not much of a foundation fan so tints are the way to go for me. It gives me just enough glow and the formula is smooth. Blends very easily. I always moisturize before to apply easily. Would recommend!

author: Elle
headline: Amazing!
comment: Not my shade but it glides on like lotion so amazing. Not my shade but I will be buying in my shade it's a must have

author: Stacy
headline: Loved this formula!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is completely worth the Hype. I love this formula! It's smooth and creamy, goes on so easy, made my skin so soft and supple. The shade was perfect for my fair skin and it didn't smell like chemicals. I really liked the sheer coverage,  it made things look more natural for me,  which is sometimes a challenge. The only drawback to this product is that it does not come with a sponge applicator,  so you have to figure that out on your own.

Maybe with its next launch, they'll find a way to add a sponge inside the lid or something. All in all though, this stood up to the Brands name and didn't let me down.

author: Siddy
headline: This product melts into my skin, leaving it,smooth & radiant
comment: IT cosmetics Do IT All sheer tint balm it's a lightweight skin care infused serum.  This product melts into my skin leaving it smooth and radiant! I'm obsessed, definitely adding it to my skin routine.

author: Ingrid
headline: Pleasantly surprised
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all the coverage is on point. I am mean, it hides those pesky imperfections like nobody's business. Dark spots, fine lines, you name it this balm's got you covered. It's like magic in a jar. I swear! It's like a filter but not like being covered in foundation. Easy to removed! If  you've wanted to try out a foundation balm but don't want to spend a ton of money, this is a good choice. Highly recommend 10/10.

author: Niki
headline: No coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is so soft and silky. I love that it's easy to blend and very light. It seems to get a bit oily throughout the day though. I wouldn't even say this is like a skin tint because it is provides absolutely no coverage whatsoever. Doesn't even do anything for my undereyes or red spots. I received it to review and I wouldn't purchase on my own bc of the lack of coverage. I don't expect much coverage from a skin tint but this has none. The only plus is it nice and silky and made with skincare ingredients

author: Deni
headline: Love this!!! Perfect for a lady in her 50's!
comment: I would definitely buy this product again. It goes on so silky and smooth and does not settle into my wrinkles. It's very lightweight so it feels like I'm wearing nothing but it gives me enough coverage to even out my skin tone. It's definitely a lightweight foundation so if you need more coverage, this is not the choice for you. I am a minimalist and it evens my skin tone and adds a nice glow!

author: Dawn
headline: Shade 125
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   I received the shade 125, the swatch on my arm is built up 3x, it's the perfect color for my face. The coverage is light to medium (with a sponge) and lasted perfectly thru my 10 hour day. It settled between my furrow lines in between my eyebrows but kept out of my fine lines. I lightly set with powder and finishing spray. Liquid and powder blush applied perfectly over the foundation. I love this foundation. I have normal/dry skin as well as fine lines/wrinkles.

author: Meg665
headline: Gorgeous
comment: This product looks beautiful on the skin without the dry feel. I am 41 and this is exactly what I have been looking for!

author: Deborah
headline: I will buy  this product again
comment: this  is so creamy and glides on

author: Jennifer
headline: Best everyday foundation-hydrating
comment: Love this foundation. Reminds me of how the Maybelin mouse foundation use to leave my skin but better. I have very dry skin and with this foundation my skin feels hydrated. And it still looks great end of day. Feels like I'm wearing nothing. Buy it!

author: Erin
headline: Love this!
comment:
I am very happy with this product.  I got shade 125.  What appealed to me about it is that it is skin care. I am very busy in the morning with little time to do my make up. I generally go for a less is more, tinted moisturizer kind of look because I am almost 43 and find that heavier foundation settles into my fine lines and wrinkles.  

I am very happy with the ease of application and the coverage of this product.  I use a foundation brush for application.  

It is very light, velvety, and balmy.  I was concerned it might wear a little greasy or shiney but it actually dries down but in a moisturing kind of way, if that makes sense.  It leaves a dewey to skin like finish.  I did set my tzone with powder but it doesn't really need it.  I haven't noticed much oxidation either.  

I have worn it for three days now and like it very much. I immediately put it on to try it out when I got home with it from Ulta. I then cooked dinner for my family, including boiling pasta.  Before checking in the mirror, I figured it would have melted off or smudged all over my face due the steam. I was very pleasantly surprised that it was not only fully intact, but almost mattifying considering the amount of heat and steam it had endured. I think it will be great for summertime.

I also played tennis in it the next day and was very impressed that it lasted through two hours of tennis.  My cheeks usually turn very red with exercise and this product not only lasted but completely concealed the redness.

It gives a beautiful "no make up" make up look and lasts through anything.  And delivers skincare at the same time.  Great product!

author: Michelle
headline: Works great to cover my rosacea!!
comment: I bought this in hopes to cover my rosacea and not cause further irritation. Not only does it cover my rosacea it looks like I'm not wearing any makeup, very natural looking and it doesn't irritate my skin. I'm so happy I tried it and will continue to buy it and use it.

author: Kini
headline: Not for me
comment: I do not like this at all. The sales associate was very helpful and picked the closest match, which is a little dark. The next lighter shade was too light. I bought a brush to apply it with and I don't like that either. It is very drying and goes on cakey. It did not work for me.

author: Dana
headline: Sheer Tint Face Balm is the Best
comment: I love this sheer tint face balm. It goes on so smoothly and blends easily. It covers my imperfections without being heavy. It stayed on all day, and it didn't get cakey. It didn't settle into any fine lines.

author: Melissa
headline: Finally a foundation for mature skin
comment: I have spent a lot of time and money buying every "mature" foundation on the market. This is the ONLY foundation that truly never creases or accentuates my imperfections such as wrinkles or blemishes. I was afraid the makeup would be too sheer and flat but instead it's luminous and matches perfectly! The price is a bonus! The most inexpensive foundation in my collection and looks the best- makes my skin flawless, soft and radiant. I haven't had skin look like this since I was in my 20's

author: SaraF

comment: I really wanted to love this but its not for my mature 52yr skin. It sat in my inlarged pores badly. It felt greasy all day. So probably work wonders for younger skin. Since I threw away the box, I will continue to try it in different ways to see if I can make it work. But it doesn't seem likely.

author: Judy
headline: Gorgeous skin like finish
comment: I received this product in change exchange for my honest review.  this is a beautiful glow skin like finish bomb. It leaves very natural look. It's especially good for anyone who has mature skin. The only downside is the color match was off, but it is sure enough to not really be able to tell a difference. I definitely recommend!

author: dellafavorite
headline: Less coverage than CC Cream
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Balm took some getting used to as I'm used to more coverage and a product with SPF. It is light coverage, but can be buildable to a medium coverage. I would recommend setting this with a setting spray or it will wear off fairly quickly. I do need to set my under eyes to prevent raccoon eyes. For reference, I wear fair light in the CC Illumination and the shade fair cool 125 was a perfect color match for my fair light skin. I'm not sure I would buy it over the CC cream, but I would definitely recommend it if you want light coverage or a balm.

author: Teresa
headline: Sheer creamy coverage that's skincare too
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm gives me a subtle put-together appearance that still looks like me. Easy to apply and blend, it's also a hydrating skin care product!  I did not experience any cakiness or settling.

author: Ambrina

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is a great one and done. It's blend able without being cakey. The coverage is smooth and doesn't sink into fine lines. It isn't dry leaves the perfect amount of moisture.

author: Stephanie

author: Chris

author: Betsy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It cosmetics has always been a staple in my makeup routine.  This stuff feels lightweight and doesn't sink into the wrinkles.  It leaves your skin feeling hydrated.  It lasts all day on my skin.

author: Amanda
headline: It didn't settle into fine lines & you see my freckles.
comment: I found my new everyday sheer tint face balm. The new It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a game changer and I love this product. I really love that I was able to use a brush or my fingers to apply this face balm and it gave me great coverage and left no streaks at all. This face balm looks like my skin and it matches my skin tone  perfectly. I really love that the coverage is buildable but still sheer enough to let my freckles still show. This face balm is very creamy it didn't settle into fine lines at all. Since  the face balm didn't settle into my fine lines I was able to get ready quicker and not have to keep messing with the face balm on my skin to make it look perfect. I double layered the face balm on my face it gave me great coverage and my skin looks flawless. I now carry this in my purse and use it daily. It doesn't feel heavy or like you even have anything in your skin. I even used it around my eyes and you cannot see anything settling into my fine lines or wrinkles.  I am 45 and this product didn't age me like other products. I absolutely love this face balm and I highly recommend it I received this complementary gift in exchange for my honest review.

author: Liz

comment: I absolutely love the sheer face balm by it cosmetics. It is moistutizing but does not stay tacky on your skin. comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this IT Cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm in the shade light neutral in exchange for my honest review. Zero greasy feeling like other tinted balms. It's 98% skincare and it's obvious. Makes my skin glow when I wear it alone or with the rest of my makeup like in this picture. This is after a full day of wear. Absolutely love it!

author: Rachel
headline: Great for a fresh no makeup look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the IT  Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, and overall I really like it. It gives beautiful natural finish that evens out my skin without looking cakey or heavy. It is perfect for days when I want a fresh minimal makeup look. 

On application, it does feel slightly tacky at first, but once I set it with a light powder, it wears really well. After setting, it looks smooth and natural and stays comfortable throughout the day. The coverage is sheer but effective, giving skin a healthy appearance. 

This is a great option if you're looking for something easy and lightweight that enhances your skin rather than covering it up. As long as you're okay with setting it, it's a really nice everyday product that delivers a clean effortless look.

author: Kelly
headline: Love it
comment: Love this product my skin looked and felt amazing will be great for summer or no makeup makeup days will buy again [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tara

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product. It is light yet buildable. The shade blends flawlessly into my skin and covers my redness. A little goes a long way and I will continue to use this in my daily make up routine!

author: Jenn

author: Delia

author: Haptic
headline: Definitely sheer and buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this product. I don't think I've really had experiences with IT cosmetics before so this tiny face balm was great. author: Chrystal

comment: Can I say a huge yes !!! I'm 43 and my skin to me is starting to show it. Very buildable, light weight, and gorgeous. Wore it all day and still looked like it did when I first applied it.. would completely recommend

author: Sadah

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow I really like this product. I find both the texture and the color to be very forgiving. It blends so well. Light and easy to wear. It's my go to work bag tint to use whenever I need a pick me up (or forget my main makeup).

author: Maria
headline: It cosmetics
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Gives full coverage and it's long lasting. I usually work out every day and I feel comfortable leaving my makeup on during the work outs. Even if I sweat. If I pat my makeup with tissue, it looks just as good. Easy to apply and remove. I love !

author: Dede
headline: Full coverage but not heavy!
comment: This stuff is amazing 🤩 I am a fan of it cosmetics for a long time. They have some great products for every skin type and especially aging skin. This is so creamy and my skin loves it. I am a dry skin girl all year around. This has great buildable coverage without being heavy or cakey. It has a long wear time. A little goes a long way. It looks like skin!  I have really been loving it. If you want the coverage but not the heaviness of a full coverage foundation than this is for you!! Highly recommend.

author: cass
headline: love this
comment: I love make up.  I try every foundation and skin tint.  this is my most favorite I have ever used. I just wish the ingredients were clean.  I don't like knowing it can affect your liver, and hormones.  but it's absolutely beautiful.  I feel younger wearing it.

author: Tana
headline: A Sheer Buildable Tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When I opened this and saw how yellow tomorrow it was it made me very nervous, however once I put it on it was a sheer tint and seemed to match my skin color well. It had a thin silky feel that was buildable, and did not feel heavy on my face. I did have to add a blusher to my cheeks though just to add a bit more color to my face as it really washed me out. I also think it settled into my fine lines and wrinkles making them more noticeable.

author: Carolyn
headline: A strange matte balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very strange product.  It's a balm, but it's also matte. The do it all sheer tint face balm is no different than any other foundation I have ever tried with my main issue being the IT Cosmetics does not make a neutral fair enough shade for my complexion. It also settles into my pores which is normally not an issue.

author: Sara
headline: Nice, Sheer Skin Tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this product a few times before I wrote this review to give my honest opinion.
The product has a very nice, smooth texture and glides on really well. It absorbs into the skin easily , leaving a nice glow. This would be a great skin tint if you want to leave the house with a no makeup look but just have a little more than nothing.
As a middle-aged woman, it just didn't have quite enough coverage for me. It left a glow, but didn't help hide any unevenness and settled into my fine lines around my eyes.

author: Emily
headline: My new go to
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I loved this product so much that it's now my go-to. If I want something simple to wear over my moisturizer without putting in a lot of effort, this is it. It looks so natural and doesn't cake up. It's long-lasting and gives your skin a beautiful, natural glow.

author: Jane
headline: Nice Texture but didn't work for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product in exchange for my honest review. 

The idea of of a hydrating face tint, that looks like natural skin only better is something that really appeals to me so I really wanted to love this product. I'm also pretty lazy so cosmetics that do more than one job is also a plus. I adore the IT Cosmetics brand but the Do It All Sheer Tint does not work for me. 
 
The packaging is lovely & easily slips into a purse or even a pocket without the risk of spillage, so great for a trip or for touch ups on a night out. I travel a lot & have a 'ready for trips' slimmed down make-up bag & in theory this would have been perfect for that. 

I tried prepping my skin in various ways before using the product but the result was always the same. When I blend it in I look like my skin is peeling in places or I still had the residue of a face mask. At first I thought it was because I had sun block on, but it did the same thing when I was only wearing barrier cream. I tried applying it with a brush but that was too thick & didn't blend into my skin at all. It just sat on top of my skin making my pores look more obvious. I googled how to apply it thinking I was using it wrong but that didn't help either. Applying it with a damp sponge had a better result but still not what I was hoping for. 

If your skin is already perfect then this could be a good addition to your lazy girl make-up routine.

The texture & coldness of the product is really nice. I just couldn't get it to blend properly.

author: Uc
headline: Pretty good Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a different face tint than I have used ever. It is definitely sheer and light weight but still able to perform for a whole work shift. Packaging is cute and allows for easy access plus I can tell when I am running low. The color match was impressive and it blended easily. I recommend.

author: Alejandra
headline: I loved it
comment: I received this product free, I loved it, Its texture is unique, high quality, long-lasting and has excellent pigmentation. Thank you #influester #product #free #itcosmetic

author: LeAnne
headline: My new favorite. It Cosmetics does it again!
comment: This product blends effortlessly for a seamless, glowy buildable look. My skin always looks good when I use this. Great for no makeup look days. Have been using consistently and I love it! I would recommend. It is a very creamy texture and it sits well on the skin with or without makeup on top. Love!

author: Amy
headline: Natural look but better!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product provides light, buildable coverage that evens out my skin tone while still looking natural. The texture is lightweight, blends easily while leaving a soft, healthy glow without feeling greasy. It is an easy low maintenance staple for everyday wear.

author: Christina
headline: Feels great and lightweight!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like how this feels on my skin. Its very lightweight and has buildable qualities. It blends very easy into my skin. My feels conditioned after washing it off as well.

author: nikileigh
headline: Felt nice on skin and blended well.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really loved the feel and application of this product. However I think the color was a little too warm for my skin tone. I'd love to try the cool tone. Coverage was pretty good, product blended well.

author: Kay
headline: Love this so much!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a unique and perfect product. I love the cool feel and just enough coverage that leaves my skin feeling moisturized dewy and even toned. It goes on so easily and blends well with anything. I use my it cosmetics brush and I love it. I use this on light coverage days or times when i want to be active but look put together. I will definitely be purchasing this when I run out but a little goes a long way so it will last a good long time.

author: Alaina
headline: Nice sheer tint in a travel friendly form!
comment: I haven't used an It Cosmetics foundation product in years but knew this was going to be a big hit. It's truly amazing and feels light on the skin but provides a nice light to medium coverage without looking cakey. It plays well with both liquid and powder products too. I love that it has a small form factor which makes it easy for travel as well.

author: Jacqueline
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved this tint face balm. My face looks and feels so different when I use it. I like when the products that I use makes me to see so natural and safe.

author: Sandy
headline: Will never buy anthing else!!!
comment: Tried this for the first time after seeing it on T.V. and Tik Tok.  Blends and mathces perfectly for me. Does not set into fine lines.  I have tried so many different products.  I have thrown them out.  This will be my go to.

author: Ana
headline: Not for combination skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted face balm may work great for normal to oily skin, and while I like the wash of color that evens out my skin tone, my combination skin was not the best fit. I found that even with a moisturizer underneath the color would still emphasize my dry patches. I did not notice any visible wear throughout the day, however, so that is a plus!

author: Yesi
headline: Absolutely love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It was my first time trying this face balm and I absolutely loved it. It feels soooo good on my skin, like it's actually benefiting it. It gives me a nice medium coverage while still letting my skin breath. It feels like a second skin. It lasts most of my work day and I don't get as oily as I usually do.

author: Karina
headline: It cosmetics do it all face tint
comment: I received this product free from influencer  and it cosmetics in exchange for my honest opinion. The packaging is very light weight. Fits well in your purse. This is a tiny with sheer buildable coverage.  Blends well over skincare. Very recommended.

author: Barbara
headline: Pleasantly Surprised
comment: I have tried several different It Foundations yet have not really loved any of them. First of all they have had a tendency to oxidize throughout the day. I do not find that to be the case with this version at all. Personally I prefer a light coverage so I don't use a huge amount and went into things assuming I would end up trying and returning. That did not happen and I'm happy to rank this #2 in my choice of favorite foundations. It's nice to have a version like this (non liquid) for travel. I was pleasantly surprised.

author: Nicole
headline: Blends like butter
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was worried this color would be too dark but it was perfect. It blended well and gave a smooth, moisturizing finish without making my face look greasy. A little goes a long way and it lasted all day with some makeup spray.

author: Maria
headline: Great light weight coverage.
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I am an avid user of It Cosmetics products. I love their moisturizers and tinted cc creams. I was expecting something similar in this product, however this is very very light, it feels like you don't have anything on your skin. It's good, but if your looking for more coverage this is not it. Because it's so light I like to use it on my no make up days!

author: Vidhya
headline: Effortless Sheer Glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheet tint face balm glides on so easily and blends flawlessly into the skin. It gives a natural, fresh finish that looks smooth and effortless- perfect for everyday wear.

author: Amy
headline: Not for me
comment: This product is not for those with oily skin. Even after using setting powder it was a greasy mess. I ended us returning it.

author: Indianame
headline: 210 Light Neutral - comfortable, light coverage
comment: I've worn this for several days now and feel like I can leave an informed review. I can't stand foundation but needed something to even out my skin after a laser treatment. 201 Light Neutral was just about perfect for my winter skin. It feels nourishing and silky and looks quite natural. Despite it being mainly skincare It looks better if I've moisturized prior to application. I don't see any radiance, just a nice, natural finish. I went back hoping to purchase another color for summer skin but nothing really worked. The image I attached shows it with a lot of peach tone but on the skin it's perfection.

author: Lindsay
headline: Great for dry skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  The IT Cosmetics sheer tint face balm is very lightweight but still provides some pigmentation / coverage and can be built up a little bit. The formula sinks into your skin, giving it a lightweight and glowy but still natural finish. It's also very hydrating, which helps minimize creasing. It blended out well with my other makeup and I didn't experience any pilling. I love the glass packaging, which feels very well made. I am also impressed with the shade range. I would recommend this to a friend. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Tara
headline: My skin but better!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is the type of makeup product I have been dreaming of! The infusion of mostly skincare with tint is my ideal everyday makeup. It's quick and easy to apply but still makes me look polished and my skin feel hydrated. It doesn't crease or settle into fine lines and looks great all day. Other products layer beautifully on top as well.

author: Sharon
headline: Definitely Impressed
comment: I bought this face balm yesterday after alot of deliberating I decided to get it.  I have combination skin and I am 66 yrs old.  My face feels great.
