I have been using the cheek balm and love it...It is priced at a good price and I will definitely get again.  My skin looks smooth and actually pretty.  Even my husband noticed the difference.  If you are this thinking about it, just get it.  you will not be disappointed.

author: Samantha
headline: Okay product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't a huge fan of this product. It's a good shade match for me and the texture is nice. It applies a little bit streaky on the skin, doesn't really sink in. I also thought that it clung to my dry areas. Might be better suited for summer when my skin is less dry.

author: Kathleen
headline: Not for me
comment: Doesn't cover at all & too oily.

author: Liz
headline: Radiant and glowing skin
comment: IT Cosmetics really hit a homerun with this product! I mean it gives my complexion the evenness and glow and radiancy that i have a hard time getting from other products. Its easy to apply on my face, its not messy like a pump bottle or any other type of bottle. Its compact and easy to put in your purse. It blends perfectly with my skincare routine no pilling or anything like that. I actually dont even need to use a face primer before putting this on… it has great staying power for me all day long.

author: Amanda
headline: Good!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Coverage was good! I enjoyed the color match and the texture of the product. I thought it creased up a bit under my eyes after long wear but overall it was good

author: Christine
headline: Solid Serum Formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the perfect lightweight coverage. It is easy to apply and goes on smoothly. I also like the Innovative Solid Serum Formula, it is 92% skincare serum.

author: Jenn
headline: Perfect for everyday!
comment:
The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is perfect for everyday wear! It feels lightweight while providing a natural sheer coverage that evens out my complexion. Easy to apply and blends well. 

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is perfect for everyday wear! It feels lightweight while providing a natural sheer coverage that evens out my complexion. Easy to apply and blends well.

author: Falon
headline: Beautiful finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm gives such a moisturized finish. I think this formula would be great for aged skin as it gives a very natural, hydrated finish. As someone with oily skin, I add a little setting powder to my T-zone and it stays put all day. It's really beautiful and the color blend works well for me.

author: Jules
headline: Greasy feel
comment: I wanted to like this, I really did. It felt nice when applying but separated quickly and just felt greasy. For reference, I have average skin that is sometimes dry. I'm over 50 and didn't want full coverage. It should have been perfect for me. Also, is yellow-leaning.

author: Anastasia
headline: My new favorite skin care that covers imperfections!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has to be my favorite all-time tint.   My skin is usually so rough looking anymore that I have to use full coverage foundation, yet somehow with this tint, not only does my skin feel amazing after using it, but it makes my skin glow with a sheer buildable coverage! The tint is made with collagen peptide, vitamin E and hyaluronic acid to really help deliver those amazing skin care results.  I find that the "Do It All" sheer tint face balm is really enough to help smooth out any discoloration and blemishes while also delivering moisture and plumpness to the skin. I can't say enough great things about it!

author: Mary
headline: So easy!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This goes on smooth and sheer. Easy and quick to apply and great for no makeup makeup days! Super lightweight and feels like nothing on your skin.    Great product!

author: Mag
headline: Easy to glow with this on
comment: This balm covered up my redness effortlessly and doesn't settle into my fine-lines. I also enjoy the all-over glow I get from it. This product is buildable however when it comes to some of my darker acne spots I did have to use a separate concealer that blended well with the balm.It also wore well throughout the day and even when I started to get a little oily I still just looked like I had a natural glow. I've applied it with a brush and buffed it out with a beauty blender. If you have mature skin and want something that not only makes you look like yourself but better with a bunch of skin loving ingredients I'd definitely pick this up!

author: G
headline: I hope they never discontinue this balm!
comment: Beautiful, lightweight balm. Better than any tinted moisturizer I have ever used.

author: Kyndall
headline: New Favorite Product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok I think I found my new favorite product! I've said that recently but I mean it this time. 
This goes on so smooth and even. I like how it feels like a second skin but covers all my imperfections. I would recommend it to everyone

author: Farrah
headline: Great for the "no makeup" look!!
comment:
I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm and I was honestly a little skeptical about whether or not I was going to like it because let's face it, I'm in my late 40's and I have a slew of skin issues and problems. I also don't care to wear heavy foundations or skin tints simply because it feels too heavy and it likes to settle into all of my fine lines, wrinkles, and imperfections. This is a balm that contains 92% of serum-based products so it literally looks and feels like skincare. It went on so easily and blends like a dream but the best part is that it looks like my skin but better! It's perfect for women like myself that prefer a lighter weight, no-makeup look because it gives that beautiful dewy, moisturized, hydrated, healthy skin glow and I love that. I included a photo with half of my face completely free of any of the skin balm and the other side I have done my makeup with the IT Cosmetics skin balm, setting powder, and a little bit of blush and the difference is insane. It didn't look cakey or dry it just looks like my skin but better. The coverage is very buildable and it looks very natural all while leaving a dewy, radiant finish. It took very minimal effort to blend it out with a brush and you can even use your fingers too. A little bit definitely goes a long way. 
I think this would be perfect for women with normal to dry skin however you can add a little setting powder if you're oily. I adore all of the products from the IT Cosmetics brand but this one is definitely going to stay in my makeup bag. I loved this skin-tint balm and I highly recommend it.

author: Elizabeth
headline: Great peoduct
comment: It is so easy to apply so it shortens the time getting ready

author: Just a little vain!!
headline: My first review I missed a star!!!
comment: I reviewed this amazing tinted moisturizer but somehow missed the 5th STAR!!! I'd be remiss if I did not correct my mistake because this product is the best tinted moisturizer I have ever used and easy to blend colors to make your perfect color. IT cosmetics created a masterpiece with this product!

author: LovingLife13!!
headline: Literally MAGIC in a jar
comment: Best product yet from ULTA. Bought it on a whim. Purchased 2 colors to blend but was still a bit light, and I am fair, so went back and purchased a third. Now this magical face balm blends seemlessly into my skin and doesn't look line makeup.  It is literally the best product I have ever used.

author: Staleanna
headline: I would buy this product again and again.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you're into lightweight, skin enhancing make-up that feels like skincare, this balm is definitely worth trying. It is basically a tinted moisturiser plus foundation in one. This tint blends effortlessly and gives a natural skin like finish rather than a heavy make-up finish. The texture starts out solid in the container but melts into like a serum like cushion  that is easy to apply with a finger or brush. I absolutely love that it  provides sheer buildable coverage, leaves a natural not matte finish, while leaving the skin hydrated.

author: Penny
headline: I will Definitely keep this in my makeup routine everyday!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is now my go to skin tint for everyday! The texture is super creamy and blends great into my skin. I love how lightweight it feels while covering my blemishes and even my dark circles around my eyes. Definitely true to the name it really Does it All and the fact that it has skincare in it is a game changer for those days I just need my skin to have a natural glow while giving me a light tint of color. Works well with all my makeup without any scent at all. This is My new go to for everyday!

author: Vanessa
headline: Love 125 cool!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product. I have it in cool 125 and it matches my skin so well. The fact that it's skincare is such a bonus because it blurs my pores and is nice and light. This is a staple in my winter makeup.

author: Debra
headline: Very nice
comment: Love it Like wearing no makeup but great coverage

author: Jen
headline: Absolutely recommend!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free in return for an honest review. I love this company and was very excited to have the opportunity to test this beutiful face balm. I think when I get a little sun it will match better.  I tried this product during winter and I'm very pale.  I think it does enhance a pretty glow.  It matches and is a good quality product. The texture is smooth. It feels light and comfy.

author: Katman28
headline: Amazing
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. First time owning IT cosmetics product and I am impressed. I prefer light weight coverage and this sheer tint balm is perfection. Easy application with finger tips and evens out skin tone. Does not give up a caked overage. I have combination skin and fine this product effective.  I think this will work wonderfully during summer months as well. My skin tone is fair cool tone.

author: Kelly
headline: Amazing skin tint!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is perfect for mature skin! Moisturizing and does not settle into fine lines. It helps to minimize redness however it feels light, like second skin. I even think it improves my skin from just wearing this product.

author: Jade
headline: I would buy this product again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is a good one! The coverage is full the consistency is amazing. Blendability is great. It's not streaky or too think that it's hard to blend. I will definitely be buying again.

author: Tracey
headline: Wow game changer.  Very surprised
comment: I highly recommend this product.  I am in my fifties and dealing with makeup settling in my lines and making me look older.  I have tried Clinique's foundation and primer with no success.  This foundation is great.  Lightweight yet provides great coverage and a bit of a moisturized dewy glow.  You should give it a try.

author: Samantha
headline: The Pefect "it"
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   I love "it"! It glides on, easy blendability! Wearable all day without having to reapply or touch up. Its just perfect

author: Kristen
headline: Oh…okay, yes!
comment: I was pleasantly surprised by this product! I would say it is on the higher end of low coverage. Very dewy. Probably great for mature skin. I'm usually a bb/cc cream girl so this really wasn't my thing. BUT I could see it being my thing in the future! Also I love that it is mostly skincare. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Rosa
headline: Great for everyday
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has become my go to for everyday day. It applies with a cooling effect and goes on so lightweight. It has very light coverage and feels and makes your skin look like skin. Other products layer over top beautifully. I wear it everyday for my 8hr work shift and the to my hour long high intensity gym class and it does not budge. The fact that it is 92% skincare makes it even better. I truly love this product and will be purchasing it once I am out..

author: Terri
headline: yes to the Bomb (Balm) !
comment: I really like this serum its moist with the perfect amount of coverage. Especially if I don't want to do all the base coverage and full face deal. I have enjoyed this and have used it every day since I purchased it.

author: Kim
headline: Tinted Skincare with Lovely Finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the perfect solution for a no make-up look. I have oily skin, so I was concerned that it wouldn't work for me, but it blends so well into my skin. It feels very hydrating and although it's super sheer, it gives my skin a polished look. I've been applying it with my fingers, and it doesn't streak or settle in to my fine lines and wrinkles. I love the fact that it's more skin care than makeup. Highly recommend!

author: Jenny
headline: Smooth seamless sheer tint face balm.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is honestly some of the smoothest, easy gliding face balm I have ever tried. It is less of a balm in my opinion and has more of that serum texture but is smooth to apply and doesn't cake up or crack or crease. I personally love using it as a primer for my eyeshadow shadow and it seems to work great! Definitely a fan!

author: Dana
headline: It really does Do It All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had mixed feelings about this product, but in the end I believe it redeemed itself to me. The first time I used it, it looked great when first applied, but it didn't wear well at all. It ended up being blotchy after a couple of hours and it settled into my creases and lines. I had used it in conjunction with my regular skincare routine, so I decided to try again by only using a hyaluronic serum underneath and it worked much better. It's a very sheer product, so it's not going to have much coverage, but it does even the completion out. In the photo, I applied it to the right side of the back of my hand. You can see that it has a seamless blend and blurs the imperfections. I have a lot of redness and I like using this balm on days when I don't want to get made up, but still want to look my best. It's hydrating, easy to apply and blend, and it leaves a somewhat glowy, matte finish that gives me a healthy skin look and feel. All in all, it's a good product, just be careful what other products you use it with.

author: Holly
headline: Smooth and moisturizing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint goes on so smooth and is beautiful. The shade will definitely suit me better in the summer when I have more of tan. The coverage is light but slightly buildable. We'll see how it holds up in the AZ heat!

author: Michels
headline: Very light weight
comment:
I was a little nervous at first when I opened this as the color looks much darker than expected. But I trusted the process and it actually blended in to an almost sheer very light coverage. I was hoping for a little more but would say it's perfect for day-day if you don't need a lot of concealing. It feels light which is always nice. 
I used color- light neutral 210

author: Joan
headline: Very sheer skin tint with a glowy finish
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This sheer skin tint is indeed sheer! I had to apply two layers to get a bit of coverage. It would be something I could wear when I'm just out running errands instead of a full coverage foundation. It applied smoothly over my skin after my skincare. However, it felt quite drying on my skin and seemed like it soaked up all of my skincare. I would definitely have to use a hydrating mist/setting spray after use. It does provide a bit of a glow to the skin as well. I'm not a fan of the packaging as I applied the product with my fingertips and you have to keep dipping your fingers in to the jar. I could use a brush but I'm not sure how this would apply with a makeup sponge as I feel I would need a new clean sponge each time.

author: Audrina
headline: Great coverage, smooth and long lasting!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula is very smooth and light but long lasting.  I love the coverage it's enough to cover my freckles and redness around my nose.  The package is great for traveling and quick touch ups.  Definitely worth purchasing again.

author: Nicole
headline: Nice Product!!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This face balm is hydrating provides a nice sheer coverage. It blends well (I used my fingers) and it's buildable but I didn't need to apply much. It looks very natural and it doesn't feel heavy or look weird and cakey on the skin. It's lightweight and lasts a while. Would be nice if SPF was added to this, though.

author: Heather
headline: Best option if you don't want full coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As I get older and have more fine lines, I've gone away from full-coverage foundation in favor of tints and balms. This one is beautiful and such a great everyday choice. It has enough coverage to solve for blemishes and discoloration without it looking cakey or emphasizing my fine lines. A little goes a long way, and I love it.

author: SUZANNE
headline: Try this if you are looking for a sheer product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had to use this a handful of times bc i couldn't figure out my thoughts.  I have determined that I do I like it.  This for me took some time to enjoy but I do.  I do use my fingers to apply and it looks great.   I found that while I had a blemish I needed more to cover but everywhere else looked fantastic.  It worked under all of my other stages of makeup.  I didn't notice any smells or and application wasn't sticky. I will continue to use and purchase.

author: Amanda
headline: Great all around product
comment: This lasts all day and makes my skin feel so hydrated.  i wore it with moisturizer and i think you could actually skip it.  The coverage is a light tint that looks like my skin but a little better.

author: Nicole
headline: Light coverage with multiple uses
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While I prefer full coverage, sometimes I just like to throw on something light that just evens out my skin tone and makes me look awake. This product does just that. I'm finding this product very pleasant on the skin, it's light and hydrating. Used alone, it is too light for everyday (see the swatches on my skin). I feel it's quite silicone-y and slides on the skin, so I'd need to set it with powder. However - this stuff BLURRS! The consistency reminds me more of a primer and I use it as such. It's also great for touch ups throughout the day. While I'm not using it as intended, it lives in my purse.

author: Pamela
headline: Sincare serum color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted cream is amazing if you don't like wearing makeup and just want a quick touch-up, First, it leaves your skin luminous and with an enviable natural glow, this cream is a serum that provides benefits for you face, and besides being  makeup it is also great for skincare. It's fantastic! Highly recommended

author: Beth
headline: I would absolutely recommend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not going to lie, never been a huge fan or impressed by  IT Comestics….but this changed my mind. It's magic. The perfect color match and how I look makeup free with makeup on! It's so light weight and does not look caked, stays on all day and night! Huge pot for a great cost!

author: Shannon
headline: Smooth and buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in the shade Light Warm 215. I found the consistency very appealing. It's smooth and balmy, which makes blending easy. It has a very sheer coverage, but it is buildable and works well with ither products.  I like that it's is also a skincare serum, so your skin gets a treat while looking great.  It has a very light scent like most cosmetics do. It's not strong and won't linger. Overall,  this is a great product on its own for a fresh dewy look, or used with other products to create new looks.

author: Maria
headline: I love this product
comment: My skin looks and feels younger and younger every time I use this , I absolutely love it, I will be 72 in March and this product makes me feel and look young again

author: April
headline: REALLY DOES IT ALL!!
comment: Saw this IT product and was intrigued...bought it...and was IMPRESSED!! Very lightweight, not heavy at all. Covers minor imperfections and leaves my skin looking naturally healthy (but better 😉)! Applied with a brush, application is flawlessly easy!! Washes off easily too!!

author: Laura
headline: Too dark of shade but nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately, the shade I received to review is way too dark right now. In summer it will be perfect but for now I'm just using it for a little bit of contouring. The consistency is smooth and creamy and blends into skin very beautifully.

author: LaLa
headline: My Freckle Face Holy Grail!
comment: This is it!!! Finally found a product that evens my skin tone, but doesn't cover up my freckles. I have dry skin, and it is great for that too. My skin looks amazing with this product!

author: Felicity
headline: It's pretty good - but better for younger skin.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall, I like this product - solid light/medium coverage, lightweight, good texture, and overall it feel hydrating. I don't like that it's so pigmented because you really can see where it sits on the skin if you have any imperfections. The color was pretty good but it leaned a little yellow for being called a neutral.

author: Katie
headline: Not for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like how this product applied. Very smooth and buttery. I was worried about the finish as it seemed very shiny at first, but it dried down very naturally. The shade is a bit too warm for my skin tone, but that was probably a selection error on my part. The place where this fails is that it highlights texture in my skin. I wouldn't incorporate this into my daily routine for that reason. It would probably be great on younger, clearer skin however.

author: Lanette
headline: Lightweight
comment: I love the way this product felt on my skin. It was very hydrating and lightweight. I also like that it is 92% skincare. It is very blendable and had no scent.

author: Becky
headline: It cosmetics does it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can definitely feel the skin serum aspect and quality of this sheer tint face balm. It feels soft and bouncy to the touch, absorbs flawlessly, and dries quickly, without leaving my skin dry. I used alone, so I'm not sure about pilling. I love the glass jar packaging.

author: Daisy
headline: A new must have
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   This face Balm Melts into my skin and blends beautifully into a soft natural finish. It blurs pores, reduces redness and smoothes fine lines. Love that it has a buildable coverage that doesn't make my face cakey. It keeps my skin hydrated all day, has no artifical sent and lasts all day.
Love the luxe glass packing, this will now be a new everyday favorite.

author: Khanh
headline: For no makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The coverage is not high but it it does feel hydrating. It has a slight tint of shade to cover ur skin but doesn't fully cover. It isn't sticky and smell normal

author: Steph
headline: Finally a skin tint that fits!
comment: I've been looking for a good face tint that fits fair skin and doesn't not leave me looking orange.  This is the one.  It blends in smoothly and gives me a soft glass like glow.  It smells wonderful and little bit goes a long way!

author: Chanon
headline: Score!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is the absolute best coverage! It does not feel heavy or cakey. So light weight and very clean scent. It lasts all day and removes easily with my face wash.

author: Zumaya
headline: Hydratation and color in one product!.
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. It is a very light cream with color, with a medium coverage, it gives a beautiful hue to my skin and its tone is perfect. I use it as my daily makeup. It leaves me with a luminous, youthful skin effect and has no smell. Its packaging is practical to carry on my cosmetic holder.

author: Christine
headline: light coverage and quick application.
comment:
I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for free for my honest review.
It has a smooth texture and applies fairly easily with your fingers. The Light Neutral shade was slightly darker than I expected it to be, but because of its sheer nature it worked fine with my complexion. I tried it over 2 different tinted moisturizers and it worked well with both. I usually set my liquid skin tint with powder, but found I didn't need to set this with anything. It wears off naturally throughout the day, (picture after about 8 hours) but didn't empho or creases. This is a nice option if you ke light coverage and quick application.

author: Ena
headline: Love it for everyday buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So this do it all sheer tinted moisturizer face balm from it cosmetics is skin care and makeup coverage in one. Though it is lightweight it is buildable. Great for everyday make up free make up look that's good for your skin. It's silly smooth. Leaves a radiant light glow as a skin finish.

author: Venalda
headline: Great skin tint balm with very nice coverage
comment: I received this product free from It cosmetics in exchange for my honest review. I really like this product. It goes on smoothly and blends in well with a brush and I don't feel like it's heavy or cakey after it sets (it takes a few minutes), The package is small enough that it's easy to travel with but contains a generous amount of product. I feel like the pigmentation is very good…I get good coverage without it looking orange. I also did not feel like it was oily afterwards and the finish was fairly matte in my opinion. I will use this again and I feel like it doesn't really settle into fine lines and wrinkles.  Highly recommend it for everyone, but especially anyone over 50.

author: BS
headline: Great product!
comment: It feels so smooth and goes on very sheer. Only negative would be the small amount of product, but I'll still buy it again.

author: Ardijana
headline: Beautiful finish but wrong color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] the product is very light weight but dried really fast. The color is not my winter match but it would be perfect for the summer for me.

author: Mindy
headline: A new staple in my daily cosmetic routine.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product! It's so light and creamy yet covers every little line and blemish! It's so easy to wear comfortably all day I didn't even remember that I put it on. The packaging is very simple and the size is great to throw in a small purse. This will be a staple in my makeup bag!

author: Kara
headline: Will go back to the CC Glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first thing I noticed is that the shade I chose is darker than it appears in the site. I chose Light Warm because I'm fair but not quite porcelain, however this shade is a bit too dark for me. It looks more like the Light Medium shade on the site. I definitely recommend going to a store to see the product before choosing a shade. I applied the balm using a brush, but it didn't blend as easily as I expected it to. I had to apply some extra moisturizer to get it to blend evenly. Once blended, it does look pretty natural but can look a bit cakey if your skin is not hydrated enough. The coverage seems to be minimal, although it's buildable. It doesn't seem to feel quite as hydrating as the makeup I normally use, and it leaves a matte finish. (I've been using the IT CC Glow for the past few years and absolutely love it. It's the perfect shade, blends with ease, looks super natural, feels hydrating, and contains SPF.)  I had high hopes for this balm since I love the brand, but I prefer my usual makeup much more and will continue using that one daily.

author: Michelle
headline: My holy grail!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT do it all face balm has quickly become my go-to for my foundation. I was honestly pleasantly surprised at how great the coverage is. I love that it starts out as a more solid balm but once applied to my face softens and truly feels like my skincare products. I ordered the color fair warm 120 and it matches my skin perfectly without having orange or yellow undertones. I appreciate that it doesn't settle into my fine lines like most foundations and balms it's truly just looks like my skin with a beautiful glow. The staying power is great as well I've fallen asleep with it on and still had the same coverage the next morning. After I run out of this jar I will be buying more it really is that good!

author: Jellybean
headline: That's IT
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great packaging and product texture and feel on skin. Highly recommend and IT cosmetics is a trusted brand for women. Love it and goes on like butter and good coverage for day to day!

author: SHERRIE
headline: It products are great
comment: Love the product, think I might try a lighter color.

author: Sheri
headline: Great for a quick coverage
comment:
This is a great product with a brush applicator.  I put on a light oil or moisturizer first and this just glides on.  Doesn't feel cakey or like I'm wearing it at all.

Advertisements and social media recommendations are absolutely correct.

I love this product and just wish that it would come in a larger size so that I won't run out so fast,

author: Crystal
headline: Very easy to apply
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was easy to apply with my powder brush and a nice consistency and feel. It had a very light scent which I liked. I could have chosen a lighter shade but it's a great alternative to just powder or foundation.

author: Daria
headline: Love!
comment: I have been looking for an item just like this, tried Ilia, Merit, and other high end brands looking for light coverage in make up that had skincare components. This is it! My skin looks amazing at the end of the day too, wears well with nothing on top of it, no setting spray or powders needed. Coverage can be light but you can keep adding more for fuller coverage.

author: Ash
headline: Very nice
comment: This is a lovely tinted face balm. It goes on incredibly smoothly and is buildable to an extent. It provides a sheer, natural looking finish that is definitely "my skin but better". Be cautious when using it though for two reasons! First, make sure that it works with your base! This will definitely pill if you're using moisturizers/primers that are water based as this is a silicone based product. Secondly, a little goes a looooong way. Don't over apply or you'll spend your whole day blending lol

author: Jamie
headline: Absolutely LOVE this stuff!
comment: I recieved this complimentary for my honest opinion. I am absolutely loving this It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer tiny face balm! It is so moisturizing and lasts all day!

author: Kate
headline: VERY light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When they say light coverage, they mean it! As you can see in my picture it barely covers the veins in my hand. I would like this for no makeup makeup light coverage days but it does not have any SPF in it which is a bummer.

author: Cheryl
headline: Lightweight
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is very lightweight and I love that. I don't like a heavy or cakey foundation. This is sheer and it gives light coverage. It has a nice finish too. It's not greasy at all. 
I have several breakouts on my face right now and I do still need to use concealer to cover those. The face balm doesn't cover them.

author: LaTisha
headline: Fast flawless finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by the texture and coverage of this balm. It is light but covers just enough, would be perfect for the hot summer months. Makes my skin look glowy, I used a brush to apply which made it super easy but applying with fingers would work too. Doesn't feel heavy or look cakey. It is a little on the expensive side so will be interested to see how long it lasts.

author: Amy
headline: Great for everyday youthful glow
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

 I enjoyed the texture, it didnt feel heavy at all. The fact that its so thin but gives great "my skin but better" look as well as being buildable and the scent wasn't overpowering. Great product.

author: Missy
headline: Great lightweight foundation for on the run
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great lightweight foundation with medium but buildable coverage. Super hydrating and did a good job of hiding my redness and uneven skin tone. It was easy to apply and lasted all day outside of blowing my nose!

author: Shannon
headline: Great light coverage
comment: Loved this product that I received to sample in exchange for my honest review and feedback. I only wish it came with suggested instructions on application. I chose to use my fingers. It is soft and not cakey. It applied smoothly to my face and lasted well. I felt like it gave me an enhanced finish without looking like I was wearing makeup. I've used it multiple times now and would certainly go purchase this on my own when I run out. I did not experience any breakouts to speak to how coverage is for that during this review period.

author: Dani
headline: It's decent
comment: From my skincare standpoint, this leaves a nice moisturized do we finish, but if you're looking for it as like a skin tint, I would probably go somewhere else because it doesn't really leave much color deposit on the skin and the entirety of your skin texture and color shows through. I really do stand to think that the formulation could use a little color correction

author: Jan
headline: Nice finish on your skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using It Do It All clear tint face serum in my morning routine.  It applies very easily and feels smooth on my skin, which is important to me. I use the shade Fair Cool 125 which blends nicely with my skin tone. There is no sticky feeling after applying, and It stays on throughout my workday. I gave it a 4 star review vs 5 because I have sun spots which need a thicker cover-up to conceal them, and although you can apply layers of this face balm, Other than that, this face serum is fantastic and gives my skin a nice, smooth look.

author: Melissa
headline: Great sheer & smooth finish
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review of ]Sheer perfection! I received a free jar of It Do It All sheet tint face balm in exchange for an honest review and I am in love! It goes on smooth, sheer, and I love the smooth finish I get. It blends nicely. It's light weight and easy to apply and remove. I use it daily to help with my dark circles.

author: Alyssa
headline: Blendable sheet balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is pretty great - it's really easy to blend and has surprisingly good coverage for a balm with a natural glow finish. I apply it with a buffing brush and blend into my skin. Works well with other products like concealer and blush. I will say it does really cling to dry spots and you will need to use concealer on any blemishes or dark spots you want covered.

author: Deidra88
headline: Tint blam
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review it's feels good and creamy to the skin the texture is soft and leaves a glossy glow. I've never try a product like this before. Also will be in my makeup routine after trying it out

author: Fathima
headline: Magic balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics do it all sheer is like a magic balm . I have a dry skin with uneven skin tone and dark spots . This magic help hide and remove dark spots that gives a flawless look without looking casket . Since it's a balm with skincare benefits my skin lobes the feel and it blends in to makeup making it very comfortable and easy to use . Definitely recommend it to anyone like me with fry uneven skin tone.

author: Amanda
headline: Perfect sheer coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics Do It All Sheer Balm  has such a nice creamy texture, and glides in beautifully. It can be blended with a beauty blender, brush or even your fingers . It is sheer, so there's not much in the way of coverage for blemishes (prep the red spot under my lips) but for normal face redness is evens out the tone nicely. I tested to see if it's buildable or not and don't really think it is, but it dos go in in a nice even layer without caking and lasts through the day.

author: Katie
headline: Great coverage
comment: I love that it goes on smooth without feeling cakey. It has great coverage. The lack of sun currently has it a little too dark for my face but once winter is over, it will be perfect! It gives a great bronzer tint.  It doesnt smear easily and will definitely be a staple in my make up routine

author: Johana
headline: I would buy this product again and again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm extremely happy and surprised with this product! I have been looking for something that feels less heavy on my skin but also that provides good coverage and this product has it all! The finis look on my skin is smooth and I don't even have to use a sponge to blend it. I'm super glad I got it and it's a great product for the price! I can go to work for 8 hours and still have it intact, it's durability is amazing.

author: hippiecowgirl
headline: NAILED IT
comment: Without hesitation,  this the best foundation I have used. The shade fair cool literally disappears. After I applied this I seriously thought it became part of my skin.  I am turning 60 next month. I swear it has taken 10 years off.

author: Jen
headline: Nice, lightweight balm.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try out this sheer face balm, as I'm not one to wear heavy or full-coverage foundation. I would definitely describe the texture of this to be balm-like. It is very creamy, and it's easily blended onto the face. I used a brush with tapping motions, and this worked out nicely. This balm looks very luminous on the skin upon application, although I do feel like that goes away somewhat as it dries. Interestingly, it also feels cooling on the skin at first, which feels nice. This product didn't dry down all the way for me and remained a bit tacky, and it also settled into my fine lines. The coverage is very light. It definitely doesn't cover imperfections, but it camouflages them a bit. Overall, I like this product, and I will continue using what I have. I'm not sure if I will purchase this in the future or not, as I already use a lightweight foundation that I love more. Definitely give this a try if you're looking for a very light coverage, luminous face balm.

author: Lisa
headline: Best yet for lightweight radiant sheer finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this It Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm in shade light medium in exchange fkr my honest opinion. 
I love it cosmetics only issue is it oxidized a d turns a little orange. Didnt oxidize using this. Its very lightweight , and gives off a radiant glow. It feels like im wearing just skincare, I love that i feel my skin can breathe while giving off a slight tint to even skin tone. This blends in easily and doesnt settle into fine lines and wrinkles. I like that the packaging is in a flat round container, making it easy to pack and apply on the go .

author: Aisha
headline: Your skin but better
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] They really said your skin but better. When I opened the container the color looked too dark and I got worried that it looked heavy. The second I put it on my face it blended in perfectly. It covered up all the redness in my face. Felt like I was wearing nothing.

author: Nosheen
headline: Yes.
comment:
It is sheer, just as described. It has no strong scent, which is good. The texture is very velvety and goes on smoothly. The color was slightly dark for me; however, it is buildable. It comes in a glass bottle, which looks nice and elegant. You don't need any special cleanser to remove it, it washes off easily, even with a gentle cleanser.

I liked it a lot because I normally use matte powder over my CC cream, but this sheer one didn't need any powder to achieve a matte look. It has a matte finish on its own. I would highly recommend it to those without large pores.

author: Elizabeth
headline: Nice Sheer Coverage for a Daily Look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It provides just enough coverage but not too heavy. Great for smoothing out skin on an everyday look. Has a mouse like consistency and is not super thick. Feels light weight when applied and doesn't feel heavy or tight once on skin. The color blends in well, giving an even look. It did seem to last throughout my day and I've tested twice.

author: Kate
headline: Beautiful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is  beautiful shimmering face bronzer. It goes on pretty light surpurisingly -- blends well with a basic makeup brush or pad. I use this to illuminate under my eyes and cheeks.

author: Robin
headline: 4 Stars
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] To start off, I clearly selected the wrong color for my skin— that's on me. The balm went on very smooth and blended and softened very nicely. It seemed to blend right into my skin. 

My only complaint was the balm seemed a bit heavy for the coverage it provided. I know it's buildable for more coverage, but I did not want to add more weight to my face. 

Did I like this balm? Yes.
Did I love it? No.
Will I purchase it in the future? Maybe, but probably not.

author: N
headline: Try it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Provides amazing coverage, but I think I choose a color off from my regular. Goes on to the skin smoothly and easy to blend out as well. The texture is thick and balmy, would definitely try it out if I saw it in store.

author: Missmisti
headline: Could be nice, but...
comment: I generally love IT Cosmetics products, and I don't know that I'd be disappointed this time. My issue was that there color range has shifted as such that I was sent my "normal" winter shade, only to find that it was at least three shades too dark for my skin tone. The product was balmy, and felt like a light, creamy coverage perfect for women 35+ who don't want to set their makeup. I sure wish this were  even remotely close to the right shade for the reference point.

author: Monique
headline: Very light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I applied a small amount of the sheer tint face balm to my skin. I would say it's great for a very light coverage on the skin. The shade blended really well.

author: Niria
headline: Excellent blend-ability
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

 I loved thhs product so much.

The foundation has a thick balm like consistency, however applies like butter on your skin. It melts immediately and does not sit on your skin. 
Loved how versatile it can be. I applied it with my fingers for a light coverage as shown in pictures, however, if using a flat brush you will get more coverage.

This foundation leaves a mild dewy finish. But it did not look oily on my combination skin after a couple of hours.

author: Joy
headline: Perfection
comment: This is literally a do-it-all product! I love the sheer dewy coverage. I got the shade Tan Neutral and it's perfect! I don't even realize it's on my face.  Super moisturizing as well. I'm super excited to use this in summer months. I did recieve this product in exchange for my honest review.  And I'm super grateful bc iT Cosmetics is a game changer in my life!

author: Johanna
headline: Small but handy
comment: Small but packs a punch. Creamy formula gives great coverage. A small amount goes a long way. Long lasting. Packaging is small enough to carry anywhere. I would recommend it. I received this product for my honest review.

author: Gypsy G
headline: Really happy with the results!
comment:
I was excited to try this product. I have used other "it" products and for the most part, I have been really happy. 

This did NOT disappoint! I have worn it a few times now. It is buildable but I bought it because it was a a sheer tint. Wears light and feels like skin. I prepped even though it claims to not need it. The real test is when I wear it in our Palm Springs or Southern California heat.😉✌🏽

author: Jess
headline: Smooth and great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I REALLY love the coverage this provides! It matched my skin tone really well, didn't smell bad like others do and had a nice smooth texture to it once I rubbed it in. Highly recommend!

author: Indianame
headline: Fantastic product, moisturizing and natural looking
comment: It has been a few days since I had a laser treatment and my face is still a bit mottled and irritated. I can't stand foundation but needed something that would provide a little more coverage than a tinted moisturizer. I'm so happy I found this - it's a dream product for me. Light enough to look natural but buildable to smooth out the areas on my face that needed it. It claims a radiant finish but don't mistake that for a sheen or an unnatural glow. I don't see anything like that, just a nourished, natural, healthy look. I purchased the Light Neutral #210 with pink undertones and it's a perfect neutral - not dead looking like some can be. I'm actually looking forward to wearing this because I think it's going to make me feel good about how I look. Highly recommend!

author: Constance
headline: Feels great blends well
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love how this feels on my skin! Easy to apply, not heavy or cakey, blended well. However, I am currently too pale for the light shade. Going to hang onto this until summer and see how it matches when I'm not a ghost.

author: Kerri
headline: Love it!!!! It's soft in the skin!!
comment: Love this Do It All because it literally does it all!!! It's so soft and Buttery on the skin and lasts all day without having to touch it up. I like that it's buildable as well, great color selection to choose from as well!

author: Gigi
comment:
I like to test products for at least a full month before sharing a review, and after using this consistently, I can honestly say it's phenomenal. If you're looking for something lightweight that doesn't feel heavy on the skin but still gives you that flawless, natural-skin finish, this is it.

The sheer tint is absolutely the star , it feels like you're wearing nothing, yet somehow your skin looks smoother, glowy, and effortlessly polished. It gives that "your skin but better" look without feeling cakey or overdone.

This is easily a 10/10 for me and a product I'd genuinely recommend to anyone who loves natural, breathable makeup with a glow. I'm genuinely so happy I tried this , it's officially a staple in my routine.

author: primadina
headline: why so good?
comment: my mature skin loves this balm!  looks great and doesn't settle into my fine lines... seems to blur my pores, too... even my doctor said I looked great at an appt!

author: Lu
headline: Nice consistency, light feel
comment: Giving it 4 stars because I don't like so much coverage without benefits. Wish it had SPF or something other than "95% serum" looked at the ingredients and didn't recognize anything mentioned so idk. Will say it feels great, nice consistency, but will never purchase. But again for anyone who uses face tint/foundation, it's a really light feel. In the picture, that's two coats over my tattoo.

author: Samantha
headline: I would use this when I'm in a rush
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product as a quick on the go look. 
It isn't as full coverage as i typically wear but it's enough to make me presentable to go out in public lol 
This is my running errands makeup so i don't look full glam but im ok if i run into someone i know.

author: Stephanie
headline: Absolutely love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product! It matches my facial complexion perfectly. It blends really well into the skin and doesn't settle in the creases. It has a sheet cover but I love how natural it makes me look! It doesn't have a strong scent of anything.

author: Lizzie
headline: My new daily go-to
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is super lightweight, blends beautifully, and feels amazing on my skin! Great for a no makeup look, or as a base for a more glam look. It helps even my skin tone, as it's a little more yellow than my normal tone, it balances out my redness perfectly! I've included a swatch pic that's before blending it out. There's no scent that i can detect which makes it awesome for folks sensitive to smell. And the ingredients really do make you feel like you're applying a serum! It's not overly dewy, it gives a mostly natural finish, and I highly recommend it!

author: Erin
headline: Great balm!
comment: This a great lightweight tinted balm. It provides sheer to light coverage with a satin matte finish. It made my skin look smooth and didn't crack on my skin like some solid cream/balms do. I used both a wet sponge and brush to apply this. Great for those days were your in a rush to run out the door or just want something to even out your skin tone. Never greasy. Blends wonderfully. I received this for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

author: Amy
headline: Yes! Yes! Yes!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oh man do I love this tinted serum!!  I was skeptical at first but it leaves my face looking polished without feeling caked with makeup!! It doesn't leave my skin greasy at all!! And the color match is on point!! We love IT cosmetics over here 🫶🏼

author: Jp
headline: Ehh It's a no for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Texture is like greasy and wet. I feel like it just smears and doesn't stick. Smell is light, not a strong chemical scent. Doesn't last long, but feels light weight. I wouldn't purchase with my own money for this quality.

author: Christine
headline: Just ok
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am not the biggest fan of this product. I don't like that it comes in the pot form. I think a tube or bottle might be better. I had some issues with it blending into my skin too. The color match was good but it showed lines on my face too much for me to continue using.

author: Johanna
headline: Sheer, no coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Face Balm is a great concept: sheer coverage with serum incorporated. 
It applies easily and does feel nice on the skin, but I found it felt "slippery" wishing a couple hours of application. 
As a mature woman with uneven, textured skin with wrinkles, I prefer a product with stronger coverage. It just doesn't give me the "made up" look I prefer. 
The concept of the Do It All face balm is clever, it's just not for those of us with less than perfect complexions.

author: HOLLY
headline: I would buy this product again
comment: Works great it's easy to use and the moisture lasts all day I would recommend this to my coworkers and friends and family who likes simple that works for them. I like it's not harsh on the skin and contains that moisture and tint and it doesn't have a heavy feel.

author: Xochitl
headline: Great product
comment:
Easy to apply and good coverage love the silk feeling and not heavy or easy to blend and build on as necessary to freshen up 
I only wish it also has SPF in it to be a true Do it All

author: Jessica
headline: Wrong color for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's safe to say that this is not my color. So aside from the fact that the light warm is too dark for me, it seems to work as advertised. It goes on smooth. The balm stays pretty solid but melts when your fingers touch it. It didn't seem very sheer to me but that could be because the color was too dark. It didn't run when water got on it and even repelled it. Though, I was able to wipe it right off with a towel. So as long as you wear it and don't get wet or try to wipe it away or rub it, it should stay. I probably wouldn't get this even in a lighter color but that's mostly because it wipes off too easily. If you just want to use it for a short period, this would probably work for you.

author: Deborah
headline: I would recommend this product to everyone
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review.I received this product from in fluenster and IT Cosmetics for free for my complete and honest review. I think this product is amazing it is so smooth to put on it feels like silk. This product gave me a nice glow and blended in with my skin so well. The scent wasn't strong nor did it have a bad odor it was a pleasant smell. The product stayed on my face all day and it felt great like I didn't have makeup on it was a nice and lite feeling. The packaging was nice. I would definitely recommend this product

author: Jessica
headline: Great product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little leery to try this balm, but was pleasantly surprised. It is such a good consistency, blended very well to my skin, and lasts forever. I didn't notice any scent, which is nice, and it washed off very easily with my normal face wash. I was really happy with this product!

author: Season
headline: Great skin tint
comment: This is a nice skin tint. I do find that it is buildable. It doesn't settle into my fine lines which I appreciate. I like that is has skincare incorporated. Overall a great product!

author: MzGoldi
headline: Good product, needs varying shades for brown complexions
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am extremely disappointed. I got it in the shade "deep cool" to match my complexion. I'm usually a dep in It Cosmetics, but this is way too dark. I have used it as contour and it seems ok. I cannot speak on its moisturizing feature or benefit, as I cannot use it as my main moisturizer. I did use it for review purposes only, though.  It's lightweight and doesn't feel sticky or thick.  It goes on smooth and blends well if you add water to your allpicator. I didn't feel any irritation and my sk8n is sensitive.  There's no scent or fragrance. If they could find a shade between this and light, I'd try it again. 
Not sure if I'd recommend this particular product from ItCosmetics due to the degree of discrepancy in the shade matching.

author: Amber
headline: Good face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is easy to apply and has a light but effective coverage.  It feels great on my skin and I like the way it makes my skin feel.  It is light on the skin but provides an enough coverage for me. Overall I think it works great.

author: KR
headline: A quality tinted balm with good results
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review].  I chose the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in the shade Fair Cool (125). Initially I was a bit worried when I opened the jar and saw the color of the balm. It appeared to be a darker shade than I needed, but once applied it thinned out to a lighter shade that worked for me. I used my fingers for application and the texture of the balm is quite nice. It's smooth and has a wet feel to it. It glides onto the skin and spreads easily and evenly. It's a very simple and quick balm to apply. It has the coverage level of a typical tinted moisturizer. It evens out your skin tone, but it isn't going to hide any major imperfections. The one issue I had was that even though the balm felt hydrating, it accentuated a dry area I had so I'd make sure your skin is exfoliated before applying. Other than that I really like this product and I look forward to seeing the skin benefits it promises with continued use.

author: Candace
headline: Great for quick no makeup days!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm free to try for my honest opinion. I really like how lightweight and easy this was to use. It gives a sheer tint that evens everything out without feeling like I'm wearing heavy foundation. My skin looked like skin, just smoother and more put together. It feels comfortable throughout the day and gives a nice natural glow. This is perfect for those no makeup days where you just want something quick and effortless!

author: Page
headline: It sheer tiny face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this makeup!! It's a creamy texture that glides on your skin making your skin look flawless. It's in a perfect buildable  shade. It's la serum foundation that gives you instant hydration. It's easy to use and lasts all day. It's also easy to remove. I'm not a fan of the packaging as far as using my fingers to dip into it but I still love the actual product. It's a very durable foundation. I am really enjoying the look and feel of it. I highly recommend this product.

author: Schy
headline: Very light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade matches my skin really well. It's easy to apply and feels good on. Coverage on the other hand is very light and sheer. It doesn't look like you have anything on. That could be good for some people but I need a little more coverage for my foundation. It also can get streaky if you apply more. Overall, it's a pass for me after this jar.

author: April
headline: Perfect for summer days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice for the days that you don't want a full face of makeup but want that dewey finish. Helps hydrate your skin, wears easily and lasts all day. Perfect for the warmer weather coming!

author: Kate
headline: Too dark for me but loved consistency
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was sent a color that is too dark for my skin tone.  I am hoping this will work this summer.  I loved how lightweight and sheer but with coverage the product appeared.  The texture is smooth and very easy to apply.  This would be a fantastic product if the color matched better.

author: Cherry
headline: Sheer coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this sheer balm for awhile and like how it feels on my face. This is definitely good for a hot summer day, when you don't want to put on a lot of makeup. It has very light coverage, and I use cream or liquid type blushes and bronzer with it.

author: Katie
headline: Ok
comment: This is great to moisturize your skin but did not provide much coverage to imperfections on my face

author: Terra
headline: Love this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is now one of my all time favorite foundations.  It feels great on my face, covers nicely, and has buildable coverage.  It's now a staple in my routine.

author: Lindsey
headline: Balm
comment: The it cosmetic do it all sheer tint face balm is wonderful.  The shade match is perfect. It feels so light on my skin without making texture on my face more noticeable. It is easy to layer on top of too.  It is easy to remove too, with just washing my face.

author: Alicia
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product for someone with dry skin. It's a lightweight moisturizer with a nice tint to it. It's buildable. I will be saving mine for the summer.

author: Jenny
headline: I love this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It helped my face redness and skin issues covered up. It was lightweight and easy to use after not wearing makeup for so long. I loved the feel of it and how easy it was to put on and remove

author: Tracy
headline: Perfect foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product helped to eliminate the redness in my skin with just this product alone. Goes on very consistently and smooth to help enhance my appearance. I picked the perfect shade for myself and love it.

author: Stephanie
headline: Good coveragr
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this light, buildable coverage. It doesn't feel like a foundation on the skin. It feels light and breathable. It covers my imperfections and doesn't clog pores. The finish looks like skin and is beautiful.

author: Sunshine
headline: Perfect for the no makeup look!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is more like skincare than makeup. It can be buildable if you need it to be. It is extremely comfortable to wear, it feels weightless. It doesn't settle into fine lines and smoothies out your complexion. It doesn't have any heavy scents or perfumes.  The jar could be a little larger, but I would definitely buy and use as part of my daily routine.

author: Susana
headline: Like your skin but better
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time trying a sheer tint face balm and I absolutely love it! This formula literally melts into your skin and leaves behind this amazing glow that looks like it's coming from within. This is perfect for anyone who wants just a little bit of coverage but wants to look radiant at the same time.

author: Julie
headline: Love
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love that its light weight. Perfect for the days I dont want to do a full face of make up. I will use this mascara and lip gloss and I will be good to go.

author: Erin
headline: Sheer, hydrating coverage…a new favorite!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have always been a fan of It Cosmetics and this sheer tint face balm is no exception!  It's so lightweight, feels super hydrating and is buildable for those needing more coverage.  I use this and just some mascara on days I like a more natural look and look forward to using this on summer days as opposed to makeup that's too thick. It's easily become my favorite every day product for light coverage and I would highly recommend!  I received this product to try in exchange for my honest review.

author: Jill
headline: Thin like a veil but texture shows
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like it, and I like the idea of it being good for your skin, and it looks lovely with my makeup, however I don't like it closeup. I felt it accentuated texture and fine lines.  I have used a product just like this in a jar for years by L'Oreal Age Perfect line which for me had more of a coverage. Both products I use a makeup brush to apply. I really wanted to love this product but I just don't love the closeup of how my skin looked with it. You do need to let it set before applying anything else. It does transfer a little as well but washes off so easily and does not irritate sensitive skin. I prefer the IT department cosmetics CC 
cream, the glow one for anyone 45 and over.

author: Ali
headline: Good product wrong shade
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was a very thin type of product that got very liquidy fast when rubbing finger on it. I could see a little going a long way. More of a sheer product. I had gotten the wrong shade and was way too orange for me. The packaging would be great for traveling. Sturdy and easy to open. It had a slight glowy sheen to the foundation that would make you look refreshed

author: Jill
headline: Thin veil, light coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like it, and I like the idea of it being good for your skin, and it looks lovely with my makeup, however I don't like it closeup. I felt it accentuated texture and fine lines.  I have used a product just like this in a jar for years by L'Oreal Age Perfect line which for me had more of a coverage. Both products I use a makeup brush to apply. I really wanted to love this product but I just don't love the closeup of how my skin looked with it. You do need to let it set before applying anything else. It does transfer a little as well but washes off so easily and does not irritate sensitive skin. I prefer the IT department cosmetics CC 
cream, the glow one for anyone 45 and over.

author: Rach
headline: Do IT All serum tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT COSMETICS Do IT All Sheer Tint Face Balm is different than any other foundation I have tried. It has a whipped/airy texture and it's in a glass jar. The coverage is very light. I think it would be a good option for summer. I tried to pair it with another foundation and it pilled. I don't think the finish is very dewy or radiant. I don't think it's very buildable either. The container is convenient though and easy to travel with.

author: Kathrine
headline: Makeup that's more me!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This do-it-all balm is incredible! My skin looks more even without looking TOO perfect. The natural finish is satisfying, and knowing that the balm is skincare infused with pigment makes me feel good about wearing it!

author: Amanda
headline: Great skin tint!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed the lightweight feel of the It cosmetics do it all face balm. It has a perfect lightweight consistency and blended easily for a seamless finish. It looked great even after a day of wear. It was very easy to remove with makeup wipes and facial cleanser. Definitely recommend giving it a try!

author: Christina
headline: Like butter
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review,  I liked this product its the consistency of butter then melts while you smear a little on your face which adds a tiny bit of coverage and color to the skin especially during these winter months

author: Dani
headline: Love this!
comment: I love this product. It's thin, almost transparent and doesn't settle into fine lines. I use it as a base or alone on more natural days. Beauty boost!

author: Julie
headline: Definitely would buy this product again!
comment: IT Do IT ALL Sheer Tint Balm Face Balm was a game changer for me. It went smoothly and last all day. The color was perfect for my skin tone and I didn't need any touch up. I will definitely be buying this product again.

author: Laura
headline: I love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't really like heavy foundation type product. So this is perfect for me. The it doing all face tint feels like you're putting on your skincare routine with the benefits of hiding your blemishes and imperfections.

author: Deborath
headline: Perfect to skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   The FOUNDATION is creamy texture that melt on contact with a brush or sponge. If feel refreshing on The skin and blend easy helping to mininize The appareance of pores and visible reduce texture in The skin. If giving The skin a very flattering natural glow. I wore for six hour and It stayed put. I really like The fórmula, It excellent for daily use beacuse It containt many ingredient that help hidrates The skin.

author: Jay
headline: Lightweight tinted cream
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product really surprised me in a good way. It applies like cream, feels like a moisturizer and looks like a light coverage makeup. It feels great on, very breathable. Blends beautifully adding a bit of color and tons of moisture. The finish isn't too dewy, it's more of a satin. Very lightweight. I love it and would definitely repurchase and recommend. Applies beautifully with fingertips of a brush. It covers minor imperfections and evens tone. The texture is amazing too, it's a soft solid at first and just melts to a serum consistency as soon as it hits the brush or fingertips.

author: Mechlia
headline: Sheer perfection
comment: I got this for a review from influencer. the product was kinda hard to apply but other then that everything was smooth operation my foundation went on smooth made a huge difference in my appearance I would be using it more often

author: Lily
headline: Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For days when I don't feel like wearing any foundation, this is a good alternative. Despite it being labeled as a sheer tint face balm. I find this gives me enough coverage to cover up and slight imperfections. It has a nice balmy texture that makes it easy to use my fingers to apply with.

author: Taylor
headline: Simple & Fast ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this balm! It goes in so easily and provides a light, natural coverage. It does not feel heavy or greasy. I love using this for a nice travel day or casual look. After wearing it all day, it does not crease or dull. It keeps the dewy look all day long. It's also super easy to take off at the end of the day. 
If you are looking for an easy application, look no further than this amazing balm. It will quickly become a staple in your makeup routine.

author: Danni
headline: Really good balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The It balm is really nice.  It feels good on the skin, has no scent which is great, and blends in easily. It's super easy to get the hang of application. Applies best with either just your fingertips or a nice foundation brush. Personally I prefer the fingers for a perfect even application with no worries of streaking. It does oxidize one shade darker after applying so keep that in mind when selecting a shade. Overall this is a wonderful light coverage foundation balm

author: Merinda
headline: The best for mature skin
comment: I love this new cream formula. This buildable and moist.  It's easy to apply. It works well with blurring powder.

author: Katherine
headline: Meh
comment: I regularly use several IT cosmetics products, and my only complaint is that they are so matte. I was excited to try this 4 in 1 balm because I was led to believe that it would be dewy since it's a tinted moisturizer.  However, it is also matte. Also, it has no SPF, so you cannot skip that step. It is sheer— I expected that— but even building doesn't do much. I still had to use concealer. So what's the point? The jar is small, and considering the need to reapply, I don't feel it's good value.

author: Stacy
headline: New must have!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok…I wasn't crazy about this until I WAS!!  I learned I was trying too hard to use it as a foundation, because it is EXACTLY what it says it is…IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm!  Product provides a great sheer coverage, no makeup look, and is so easy I was making it difficult.  It wears beautifully and lightly, and has become my favorite "just a little" product.  I get compliments on the lit from within glow, and it plays well with my rosacea, and provides coverage on my rosacea prone mature skin.  I'm so glad I played around with using this.  I received this product from @Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

author: Nicki
headline: Feels like only skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First off I love the texture of this foundation, it feels like skincare on my skin and not makeup. It gives a nice light coverage for the no makeup makeup looks, it really helps to just even out the tone. The neutral does look a bit warm when you first put it on but once blended out it was a great match for me. Absolutely gorgeous dewy finish. My new go to for when I don't want a full beat

author: Ray
headline: My Skin but Better
comment:
I really like this! And I'm super picky with foundation. I like foundations to feel like nothing or like skincare, and when I look in the mirror I look like myself. I don't need a ton of coverage, just even out my skin tone.

With other foundations I've tried, it's super common for me to look in the mirror and not really recognize myself. Those foundations are pretty, I look pretty, I just don't look like myself, it's like uncanny valley.

This Balm foundation makes me look like myself, my skin, just more polished. Honestly, I can't ask for more than that.

I have dry skin, I'm fair and cool toned, and I thought 125C was going to be too deep, but it was perfect.

author: Lyndsay
headline: Light buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very nice  buildable coverage! This balm gives a natural look with a light creamy texture and blends well into the skin. The product is easy to apply and the color match was very close to my skintone. It lasted all day and didn't cake as the hours went on. The price is higher end than some foundations but worth it.

author: Tolonda
headline: Natural Fresh Coverage
comment: Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm gives me great coverage with or without makeup. It also doesn't have my face looking shiny and wears well all day long. I also love that it easily comes off with makeup wipes or makeup removal products. I would buy and recommend it for sure.

author: Ashley
headline: Not sure it's for me.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am 50/50 on this. Some days I have used this and it was absolutely horrible. Sat on my skin weird and just wasn't good. But then two times it melded into my skin beautifully and was great. (Nothing on my skin prep changed). I don't know. I think this has great potential, I'm just not sure it's 100% the product for me. The inconsistency of the product on my skin is a no go for daily use.

author: Lisa
headline: Wonderful!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love love love this product!!!!! It is so creamy and smooth to apply! It is very buildable and it feels so light!! I will definitely be purchasing this in the future! I highly recommend it!

author: Tolonda
headline: Natural and Fresh Coverage
comment: Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is amazing! It gave that naturally fresh coverage look that I love and didn't have my face looking greasy. I love the coverage it gave me with or without makeup. I also love its texture and staying power and that I can easily remove it with makeup wipes or makeup removal products. It is definitely worth buying and I would recommend it to anyone.

author: Elizabeth
headline: You need this sheer tint face balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really liked the soft creamy texture and perfect color on my skin. I have used  this product  in all sorts of weather and it really holds up, it has not caked up or anything. It is very lightweight but you can build up, i didn't need much product because it had good coverage, it does do it all with a little. I will be purchasing IT Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm in the future and suggest you try it too.

author: Monika
headline: Not for my skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Goes on smoothly, but left my face dry and cracked after several hours of wear. Felt light, shade was perfect. If too much was put on it felt cakey, initially it felt hydrating but then drying.

author: Sara
headline: Lightweight makeup for no makeup days
comment: This is a lightweight balm that provides very sheer to little coverage. This would be nice for a no make up day where you still are looking for some skin care ingredients.

author: Juhnay
headline: An awesome skin perfecting base!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oooh I was so excited to try this formula. I really enjoy a luminous base for my makeup but sometimes I want to be able to at least have the option for a more natural matte finish instead of a glow. The texture of this is so nice almost melts like a balm? But offers a lovely even skin tone perfecting quality. I really like this, I have only worn it with powder foundation on top, but I really think it would be good for a no makeup-makeup day as well because it's so sheer.

author: THJewett
headline: Great skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I chose the Do It All in shade Medium Tan Warm 320. It is darker than my face color however it works well with my body. It is hydrating and helps my dry skin stay hydrated. It gives a dewy glow, which I love. It is not sticky where your hair is sticking to your face. It has a slight tackiness like freshly applied moisturizer. It looks great after 8 hours.

author: Sara
headline: Love!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I ended up really liking this formula. It goes on creamy and then kind of finishes like feeling slightly like a powder.
