It's not dry on your face at all, my face still feels hydrated after applying and the coverage was actually really great for a sheer tint.

author: Maggie
headline: Formula allowing precision and ease of application
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is probably going to be my forever favorite and must have. 
The coverage is minimal yet the melting balm consistency is beautiful and hydrating. 
 I love how it corrects any redness and formula is nourishing  non irritant fir ly sensitive skin.
I honestly que impressed.

author: Kiyana
headline: IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm - Tan Warm 405
comment:
I have some hyperpigmentation on my face, so I was curious to see how well the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm would work for me. I received the shade Tan Warm 405. The coverage is light because it is a sheer tint, so it doesn't fully conceal blemishes or dark spots. However, it's perfect if you're looking for a natural look with a bit of coverage for running errands or for a quick, easy makeup routine. 
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: T
headline: Great skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this skin tint. It is super light weight and feels like nothing on the skin. It blends so nicely and is buildable. This is a definite buy again. I also love the container, you can literally use every single bit of it.

author: Nikki
headline: Patchy, hard to blend, and pills with everything — it just d
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this because I have dry skin and at first it feels very hydrating and comfortable. Unfortunately, thats where the positives ended for me. The formula doesnt blend into the skin well and tends to sit on top rather then melt in. It takes quite a bit of effort to work it in, and even then it never truly looks seamless. 

In the photo of me I submitted, you can clearly see it emphasizing texture and creating a patchy uneven finish. The longer it wears the more noticeable it becomes. It pills with almost every makeup and every sink care item I've tried layering it with, which made it very difficult to incorporate it into a routine. I tested it multiple ways and couldnt find a combination that worked. 

For me this just didnt perform the way I expected especially at this price point and for the usual great products this company puts out.

author: Denise
headline: Would probably be good in the right shade
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this product because I typically use a tinted moisturizer instead of foundation. This seemed like it would be good to even out the skin and it had skincare benefits which is a plus. It goes on my skin fine and feels good. Only problem i have is this isn't the color for me. It's straight orange. Even with it being on the sheer side it still shows up orange on me which is unfortunate.

author: Kristin
headline: Sheer coverage but feels nice on.
comment: I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I love IT products so I was excited to try this balm. It really is sheer but as you can see from the photo it does give a no makeup makeup light blurring coverage on my skin. I was afraid it wasn't my color or too orange. It seems ok once rubbed in. If they had a lighter more neutral shade I think it would have looked better on me. It is really lightweight and doesn't feel sticky. My skin actually felt soft with it on. I would definitely give it a try in a better color shade for my skin. If you don't like heavy makeup but want a little coverage to make your skin look even, you would probably like this balm.

author: Brittany
headline: Great tint!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how this product is in its own container with the lid and it doesn't have a strong smell to it. I prefer something with a little more coverage but as a tint, it's a good product.

author: Candace
headline: Beautiful, good for you foundation!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All sheer tint face balm by IT Cosmetics has become my new favorite foundation. I love how lightweight and natural looking this is. It has great light to medium coverage. It blends well and can be easily built up. I also love that this is 92% skincare and is actually good for your skin. It has ingredients like collagen peptides, vitamin E, and Hyaluronic acid. I dont notice any scent. Everything lays nicely on top of it. I was worried about it being too oily being a balm but it dries down really well and just feels hydrating. I love how this looks, and would definitely recommend giving this a try.

author: Hannah
headline: Very natural feeling
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great face base product when you truly want to go for a no makeup look. It's doesn't seem to transfer much and really looks like your skin. It does fade throughout the day, so you won't have the same coverage that you had at initial application but it feels great on your skin, truly feels more like skincare than makeup.

author: Steph
headline: Pretty good just wrong color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how this balm feels on my face. It's easy to apply but honestly it's just too dark for my skin. It blends in a bit and gets a little lighter but it's still too dark for me.

author: Kristy
headline: Do It All!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It is a tinted moisturizer and skincare serum all in one! It is sheer and applies so smoothly, it is buildable and blends beautifully. It can be applied with your finger or a makeup brush, I prefer to use my finger. It looks best starting in the center of your face and blending out to the edges. It has a light scent. I have seen improvements with my skin since using this face balm, my skin has been dry due to the cold weather but this has helped hydrate my skin and makes it feel softer and smoother! I recommend this product!

author: Samantha
headline: Absolutely OBSESSED!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I am literally OBSESSED with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I already repurchased it in a lighter shade because Midwest winter has me paler than usual 😅 and I needed a better match.
This product is seriously unlike anything else I've used. It's incredibly hydrating and smoothing, and it gives the most natural-looking finish of any complexion product I've ever tried. The consistency is honestly hard to describe — it looks thick, almost like the consistency of a stick foundation in the pan, but once you apply it, it feels unbelievably silky, smooth, and lightweight on the skin.
It blends beautifully, looks gorgeous all day, and — this is huge for me — it's the ONLY product that doesn't crack around my nose. That alone makes it a winner. Plus, it hasn't caused any irritation or skin issues at all.
If you want something natural, smoothing, and comfortable that still makes your skin look amazing… this is it.

author: Julie
headline: Cooking on skin
comment:
Has a cooling feel when it goes on, feels really nice.  Goes on pretty smooth.  Its hydrating and not heavy feeling. It doesnt feel slightly greasy so you will need a powder over it.  Mine didnt last all day and my face became shiny after a while 
Received as a gift for my honest review

author: Syl
headline: Feel great and no cakey feeling
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Pros: easy to put on, feels good on the skin, and a great sheer alternative to tinted moisturizers. Wears great all day. 

Cons: I wear the luminous CC cream and it doesn't quite match up to this serum. The serum has a slight orangish peach tone, even though it says medium. I have to add a glowy tinted moisturizer to even it out.

In the end, I do like it but it's not my go to daily makeup. Maybe I can occasionally wear it when I'm running errands. At least it doesn't feel heavy, just wish the color was more like their CC cream.

author: Corna
headline: Acne
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately i recently started getting acne by using this product. For some weird reason i always break out with IT cosmetics. The packaging is pretty and the product is very creamy and highly pigmented

author: 606jenny
headline: Love! My new favorite foundation
comment: I absolutely loved this foundation.Yes this is sheer but it makes your skin look healthy and glowy which is what I want as I have dry skin. I did receive product for free  from but this review is solely my own. Fantastic product.

author: Rachael
headline: Smooth application and good coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth and easy to apply. Enough coverage to hide my rosacea redness and scars, but sheer enough that it doesn't look cakey. Very build able. Love this!

author: Joanne
headline: True holy grail!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the BOMB alright.   First of all, the shade match is unbelievable!  My skin is in that jar!  It's textured like a cold press serum that's firm to the touch but blendable and buildable!  It feels so good going on just like a high end skincare item.  It's very lightweight and breathable, I feel as though I'm wearing NOTHING!  I keep this amazing sturdy glass jar in my purse at all times.  In the photo you can see I applied it to one side of my face and it is obvious which side it was!  I got this product for free in exchange for my honest review.  TRUE HOLY GRAIL STATUS!

author: Jolo
headline: Everyday must
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used a different brand for everyday makeup because the complexion and mixed type of skin i have , I like natural finish but at the same time matte and not heavy. I also like  smooth blending albeit great coverage and this  it cosmetics tint has it all with plus because it makes my skin feel very hydrated. I Love it so definitely a product that I can use in a normal basis and the best is that small amount goes long !! So it will save me some money

author: Suzi
headline: I would not buy this product again.
comment: Made my face feel very oily and heavy.

author: Ashley
headline: Light smooth look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I didn't pick the shade correctly but I still like it and will use it lightly. I'm not a makeup user for anything other then eye a lip products mostly but I love this stuff. It felt great going on and it weightless. It blended well and a little goes a long way.

author: Angela
headline: Lasts all day!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Timt Face Balm for free for my honest review.   This product goes on smoothly and gives good coverage. Unfortunately it was a bit too dark for me so only using a little worked well for me.

author: Nicole
headline: Love live live It!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is gorgeous! It leaves the skin with a healthy glow and provides the best coverage! It is a consistent application making your make up routine a synch! It lasts all day and leaves no residue. There is a clean texture and has no scent. It comes of easy and leaves the skin healthy and happy! Love it! 10 out of 10!

author: Leslie
headline: It's okay for back up foundation
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. After applying this , It looked a bit too orange for me. Blending it a few time, kind of absorbed into my skin tone.  I did use it without any moisturizer or primer, so I recommend, getting your face ready first. 
Oily at first. 
Absorbs to skin. 
Covers redness.
Not good for hot days.

author: Nicole
headline: Live love love It!
comment: This is my new favorite face balm! It goes on smooth and consistent! The skin has a healthy glow and looks so natural! It has no scent and my skin has had no reactions! It lasts all day and provides excellent coverage! 10 out of 10!

author: Diane
headline: Summer glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This goes on smooth and would be perfect during summer time. It's a bit too dark for current season (winter). It gives good coverage and finish nicely !

author: Alica
headline: I'm impressed!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow this sheer little balm really works to even out redness I've been experiencing in my skin! I like that I can apply it with a sponge and quickly go about my routine to even skin tone and texture without a heavier product on my face. I was apprehensive about the balm texture (umm remember dream matte mousse) but this product is light and bendable. The packaging is heavy and luxurious feeling while there is no scent!  Great product!!

author: Stephanie
headline: Love this product!
comment: I am absolutely obsessed with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! It feels so lightweight on my skin like I'm not wearing makeup at all, but it still gives such great coverage and evens everything out beautifully. It melts right in and leaves my skin looking smooth, fresh, and naturally radiant. The best part is it never looks cakey or feels drying throughout the day. My skin stays comfortable and hydrated.

author: Jamie
headline: Wanted to love it.
comment: I wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it caused me to break out in hives on my cheeks and severely irritated my eyes. Even if that had not happened, it oxidized terribly. It was orange on my skin within a few hours.

author: Cyndilee
headline: I would buy this product again!
comment: It's great! Very hydrating… sheer, but just enough color & coverage to blur out imperfections! Super easy to apply, can do it with fingers if you like. Bought some for my sister as well. She loves it too! I don't think it has sunscreen. Didn't list.

author: Sarah
headline: Truly looks just like your skin but better
comment:
I ADORE this product! So many products claim that they look like skin, but this one genuinely does! You cannot see anything sitting on my skin, but my skin just looks better! It truly does look and feel like there is nothing there! It's super easy to apply. You can use fingers for a brush… both are easy to do and create a gorgeous finish! 

I'm not gonna use this on days when I'm doing full makeup, but it is going to be my go to for every day! 

Love love love!!

author: Bea
headline: Luv this 5 stars !
comment: I'm always looking for a good skin tint instead of full face foundation , my new fave !

author: Emily
headline: An easy light tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this better than I thought I would. I expected it to be a bit drying so I used a lot of moisturizer before applying but it went on surprisingly easily. The coverage is definitely buildable and it's really easy to customize coverage on each area. It wasn't a perfect color match for me and the coverage didn't last long. I could see myself keeping this in my purse for last minute makeup on the go or after Pilates or something. It didn't pill with my moisturizer, and was easy to blend into creases. Natural finish.

author: Tara
headline: Lightweight, buildable, hydrating
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has decent coverage. It is very lightweight and buildable. It's hydrating. I like the packaging.  It is mess free and extremely easy to apply. I use a sponge style applicator but have also used my fingers to blend. The one thing I was not pleased with is right around the eyes it never seemed to blend well in that area. Maybe less product in that area would be best. The shade I received was light neutral. I have fair skin and cool undertones and wanted a shade I didn't have to fuss with or layer and this was perfect. It also covered slight imperfections and had a nice matte finish. It did not leave any shine. I recommend giving this a try. It's a great product and the price online seems fair and provides a good value for the price.

author: Valentina
headline: Perfect for a low key, clean look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is very light coverage, for the days you don't want to wear makeup but want to still look put together. It is light, and dewy. Beautiful finish. Truly the best combination of makeup and skin care I've tried this far. A breeze to remove, compact packaging. It worked beautifully for me.

author: Jen
headline: Natural coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics sheer tint face balm is a great light coverage. Because it is sheer the color range is flexible. It is easy to apply and spreads out easily and evenly. I have some redness on my skin and this was able to cover it without well. It wares well all day and does not fade. I had no issues using any of my other cream or powder makeup with it. This provides great light coverage and looks very natural on my skin.

author: T
headline: Silky and buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is super silky. It blends in quickly and evenly. It is buoldable and showed it on a sun spots I have to show it is sort of sheer on the first application but doesnt look patchy if you apply more. I didn't notice any particular scent to it. It almost reminds me of a bb cream. It comes in a glass jar and it may not seem like a lot of product but a little goes a long way.

author: Kye
headline: Love!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love skincare infused products and this is a perfect foundation that infuses lightweight coverage and a skin like finish. The shade I was sent is a great match and you only need to warm up a bit to cover the entire face. It wears well and is perfect for summer.

author: Ashley
headline: Lightweight and helps blur imperfections
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very light formula which I love! It doesn't feel like anything is on my face. Very sheer , helps sheer out small imperfections on my skin. Love that this formula is 92 percent skincare ingredients

author: Jennifer
headline: Nice light coverage
comment:
This is a nice light balm with light coverage. It feels like the shade will work for a larger range of people too because of how light it goes on. It leaves a nice dewey finish.
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Alycia
headline: Really nice product, is warm leaning in tone
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I overall really like this product. The packaging is glass, and heavy. Doesn't feel like it could easily break. The balm itself goes on smoothly and feels really light on the skin. Felt more like a thin moisturizer or serum, but had enough coverage to cover some of the redness in my cheeks. My only issue is the shade I received was fair cool toned, but on my skin it still looked more warm leaning. I'd definitely recommend this product but I'd try to shade match it in store if possible.

author: Kay
headline: Smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very happy with this balm! I will say I had no idea what to expect from the look of the product. It applied smoothly , offers a fair amount of coverage and is long lasting. The picture I took was taken hours after application and it still covers the uneven skin tones. I am very happy with this product and will definitely repurchase.

author: Asands
headline: Love
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends in really well even with your fingers. I say that it matches well in color to the one in the pump bottle. It is very light in coverage for sure. It is not sticky at all and feels like you have nothing on. If you don't have fine lines you won't even need to powder it. Love it 10/10

author: Marissa
headline: Meh
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice sheer balm. It feels nice and hydrating on the skin. I don't love the packaging though because it feels unhygienic and I don't like to stick my hands in a jar.

author: April
headline: Loved it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lightweight, coverage was great to be a sheer product, loved the texture and feel. Will definitely be buying again. Overall a great product! Love it

author: Nikki
headline: Pretty good skincare makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall, I think this is a pretty good option for skincare with coverage. The texture feels like a creme with just a hint of a jelly texture. It applies fairly easily. I like that the coverage is buildable. It evened out my postpartum skin tone and somewhat toned down the dark circles under my eyes. It didn't feel heavy on my skin at all. Through the day it wears well and doesn't transfer. I don't know that it improved my skin, but it definitely didn't cause irritation or breakouts. I wish the ingredient list was just a touch more natural, but overall this is a good product!

author: Renae
headline: Blendable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Sheer Face Tint Balm gives a light coverage. It helped balance the color of my face. It dries down to a matte finish and blends well. It glides on smoothly. My only complaint is that the color is a bit more yellow than I would normally wear.

author: Alison
headline: Love!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this tinted balm. It feels and looks beautiful on the skin. I swiped some on the back of my had here and the blended it just above. It blends great and leaves the lightest coverage while remaining dewy.

author: Veronica
headline: Nice skin care/tint face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the texture of this do it all sheer tint fall balm by #it . The coverage is pretty decent for a face balm. I used it to cover a tattoo dot aka: party dot and it does cover it better than most sheer balms. I guess my only complaint was even with setting spray it still kind of rubbed off some. It also feels more like skin care than makeup.  It was not on my cloth but it did wipe off a bit on a tissue. The second picture of my hand is after I blended it in. You can find this product #ulta I got mine free from #influenster

author: Dawn
headline: Best ever!!! [I received this product in exchange for my hon
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review I absolutely love this tinted face balm. It blends in well and you literally cannot tell you have something on. I was amazed at how well it matched my skin tone. Now I have loaded 2 pictures first one is half face done. The second one is fully done. I'm very impressed. Everyone needs to buy this

author: Sarah
headline: Good for light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this as a light face tint. It feels light and moisturizing on the skin but it's not quite enough coverage for me due to my rosacea. I think if you have a pretty even tone, it'd be perfect. It is buildable but I feel like I'd need a lot to completely camouflage my redness. The tone was correct and didn't have a noticeable smell.

author: Alyssa
headline: Very trusted brand
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I already use all IT cosmetics for my face (full coverage matte foundation and the concealer + serum). I didn't find it as easy to incorporate this product. You could use it if you forget or don't have time to add a serum to your routine. This acts as more of a serum than the concealer. It goes on very smoothly, but it also appears very light. So you will still need your concealer. You can use your finger or makeup sponge.

author: Lori
headline: Great When My Skin is not Flaking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade 120w works so well for me when I don't have any dry patches. This winter has been harsh on my skin but I use this sheer tint on days when I want a no makeup look or need something to cover just a little bit in a flash. By the name of course coverage is not expected but this tint doesn't feel heavy or cake-like. In the pot it melts so effortlessly, that I apply to my face with my fingers as well. This looks so much better where my skin isn't patchy so I will definitely be using this when it gets warmer. It does feel very nourishing and moisturizing my skin is has just been changing with being over 40 and the harsh winter weather. I really do enjoy using this product, just need to use with the right exfoliator, moisturizer and/or primer for my flaking skin.

author: Megan
headline: Love this product!
comment:
LOVE the sheer coverage, that just makes me look more luminous and put together. This stuff isn't cakey, it goes on beautifully and stays put. I only took a star away because it made my eyelids feel greasy, even when I purposely avoided my eye area. It's uncomfortable with contacts in, but if I wear my glasses, it's a 10/10.
I got this free for my honest opinion.

author: Rachael
headline: Airy and light
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how light and airy this felt! It is buildable but just kept it under 2 layers. Sheer was better for me. It does state that it can make wrinkles look less, help hydrate, and improve skin. My 1st pick i took weeks ago disappeared from my phone but I see no difference in that. It doesn't last on my nose and chin after an 8 hour shift working at a hardware store. It did last a little more on my days off. But still wore fast on my nose and chin. If not blended well you can see that so make sure you blend it well! Over all I got a nice dewy look in basically a matte finish.

author: Kimberly
headline: Light and easy skin tint that blends well.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice and light smooth coverage.  It blends well on the face and reduces redness.  I do see some settling in my skin as the day progresses but I like it as a light layer to help even skin tone.  It is also silky smooth upon application and helps moisturize my skin.  I would definitely continue to wear this as a base for my other makeup or on an easy day where minimal makeup is needed

author: Reatha
headline: Moisturizing and cooling!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like how cooling this balm is as it's being applied. This shade fair cool is great for me in the winter months, especially with setting powder. Lasts a long time when set on me and I love how small the packaging is, as it's great for travel! Love that is a glass screw on lid for travel as well, as that seems to be the most durable packaging, and should aid in keeping it fresh for as long as possible. If you like a skin-like finish, you'll love this! Much less coverage than the CC cream, but a beautiful finish.

author: Melody
headline: Light coverage and feels great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to receive the IT cosmetics tinted face balm! I LOVE how it goes into my skin. It literally melts right in my skin and applies flawlessly with just my fingertips. The coverage is light, but does help even out my complexion. My skin feels really good when I have this on. Overall, I would highly recommend if you are looking for light coverage that feels great on your skin!

author: Kelsie
headline: Light and Smooth!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Goes on so smoothly and blends so nicely! Very lightweight and doesn't feel like I have anything on. The pigment blends in smoothly so there is no harsh lines. Last all day too. And didn't irritate my skin or break it out. Highly recommend and will order again.

author: Heather
headline: I love It do it all tint face balm skin care serum.
comment: I love the value and suitability of the product.The wear and scent are great. The comfort of it on my skin was great. I loved the color match for my skin. I would definitely recommend it to others and would be buying again when I run out of this product. I received this product for my honest review and I love the product.

author: EJ
headline: Nice!
comment: This is a great product - I think I need a lighter shade but it blends beautifully and helps to keep even out your skin. I like using this under my eyes and to help cover up my rosacea. The packaging is so nice too, really easy to use! Definitely recommend.

author: Melissa
headline: New Fave
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really was amazed by the seamless application of this product. It just blends into the skin perfectly almost so perfectly it is hard to tell you ate wearing any makeup. Yet you skin looks more perfect, luminous and yputhful in apperance. It can be layered for more coverage but if you use a concealor, spot conceal then apply this you have a beautiful base. I have underpainted and applied this on top. I have used this and powdered and then went in with powder products. It works great both ways. Used with other creams or liquids or used with all powdwr products after setting.  So I really love the versatility of this product. Plus it is 92% skincare serum. I think that is what makes it soak in and look so much seamless. So I use this sometimes without using any skincare or primer underneath and it still looks great. I am just in love with this product. Skincare plus makeup amd it looks this good. I consider it a huge win, and one of my new favorite products.

author: Nicole
headline: Super lightweight and convenient
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   It cosmetics do it all sheer tint baseball is a great tinted bomb. What even is a bomb? Texturally, it's like a cross between a BB cream and a face serum. That sounded weird to me, but I love it. It is super easy to apply, going lightly on the skin as thin or thick as you want, and it wears all day without taking or creasing. It has a light skin like finish and feels like you're barely wearing anything. I didn't think I would like the packaging either, but it is conveniently sized and, because it is so lightweight and barely leaves any residue on your fingers, it works well as something you can toss in your purse and apply on the go. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a lightweight, low maintenance skin tint.

author: Amanda
headline: Feels so nice!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free in exchange for a fair review. This reminds me of Salt's Sneaky Balm a lot. 

I LOVE the way it made my skin feel. It felt moisturized and soft. The coverage was what I expect from a tint, natural but still has an inner demon glow ( thanks, rosacea!!)

author: Sheenq
headline: Yes
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a beautiful product unfortunately the shade didn't quite work for me.  However, it's super lightweight and bendable and it applies nicely.  It left a nice lightweight tint to the skins

author: Jennifer
headline: Beautiful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very nice product.   It covers smoothly and evenly.  It is scent free and wears nicely all day long.  I had a more olive colored skin tone and it looks amazing.

author: Anissa
headline: Skincare makeup for your face!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I looooove this tinted face balm by IT Cosmetics. I couldn't even figure out how to properly describe how soft and amazing this feels on the skin. It almost cools down the skin, and you can build the product without it feeling cakey or too thick. It feels like skin care instead of make up. The shade was a little darker for me, but it still worked to give me a bit more color. So it was perfect.

author: Marla
headline: Buying another one ASAP
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this. The texture is unique and light weight. Color was a good match for my skin. Packaging is perfect for travel and everyday use. I will be purchasing again!

author: Hayley
headline: Game changer for no-makeup makeup days!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product really surprised me. I'm someone who likes to put a full face on on the weekend when I'm going out but during the week or for errands, I rarely wear makeup because it's too much work. However, this might change the game. The color 210 light neutral matched my winter skin tone perfectly. I wasn't sure how I wanted to apply it at first. I used my fingers but then used a foundation brush which I enjoyed more. The formula was surprisingly not dry and pretty easy to work with. This is advertised as a sheer tint balm and I think that accurately describes it. This gave me a little bit of coverage to even out my skin tone, but almost looks like I don't have anything on. This would be perfect for those days that I don't want to spend time doing my make up but want to look put together. After hours of running errands, where I kept forgetting, I had makeup on and touching my face, it still looked good. Can't wait to wear this on my no-makeup makeup days!

author: Alisha
headline: I was on the fence, but I think I actually like it
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Seen here I am not wearing any skin makeup outside of this foundation.  The swatch shows you how far it is from my coloring.  It's passable, but not enough of a match for me to give 5 stars.  The other shades were not closer. 
The texture is great and it blends super easily.  I like the subtle glow and the versatility that offers.  It did feel moisturizing.  While I do like this and will use it to pan— I keep going back and forth on if it is something I would repurchase.

author: Stacy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok…I wasn't crazy about this until I WAS!!  I learned I was trying too hard to use it as a foundation, because it is EXACTLY what it says it is…IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm!  Product provides a great sheer coverage, no makeup look, and is so easy I was making it difficult.  It wears beautifully and lightly, and has become my favorite "just a little" product.  I get compliments on the lit from within glow, and it plays well with my rosacea, and provides coverage on my rosacea prone mature skin.  I'm so glad I played around with using this.  I received this product from @Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

author: Melody
headline: Incredible Sheer Face balm
comment: I received this complimentary for my honest review.  The Do It All Sheer Tint face balm is amazing.  It spreads easily across the face and absorbs in quickly.  Skin is left soft and natural looking.

author: Allison
headline: Hooked on this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had never used a face balm before so was very intrigued to try.  I'm hooked to this product now.  It glides on seamlessly, is lightweight and adds a light tint/glow - perfect for every day use.  I also love that it has collagen/hyaluronic acid so it's a skincare and makeup combo.  The little pot with the twist on cap makes it easy to use and mess-free.

author: Mouse
headline: Holy Grail product for life!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I cannot tell you how much I love this product! I didn't really think it would make that big of a difference for my skin, but boy was I wrong! The fact that it's a sheer tint made me feel like it wouldn't even be noticeable, but it actually is in the very best way possible. The texture is very thin & light, so it just melts into your skin right away. The color is a perfect match for me & as soon as I rub it in, I am left worth nothing but natural, bright, nourished-looking skin. No cakiness, no settling, no pilling. Just incredibly fresh, glowy skin. It really is just like a serum; you can't even feel it. I'm receiving sooooooo many compliments on my skin, it's unbelievable. I will keep using this FOREVER!

author: Christen
headline: This truly is IT!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am obsessed with this face balm! It's moisturizing, but helps create a great no-makeup look when I can't be bothered and works wonderfully under other makeup. It's subtle, but it smooths your skin and make it look more flawless. It doesn't cake up either. The best thing for me is that it is the perfect shade for me, which is so hard! It also feels like it's helping to moisture & take care of my skin. I love this product, I'm going to have to buy it once I use this one.

author: Yoana
headline: Perfect
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved this product .It's has a very creamy texture that feel ligthand smooth in the skin .Even though the Shade turned out  a bit darker than expected.i'm still going to keep using it because the formula is so comfortable and easy to blend.It's a fantastic serum tint for days when you don't want to wear much makeup.

author: Dawn
headline: Great texture
comment:
Light weight, light coverage, natural look. 
I do pair it with the all in one concealer from IT for my under eye circles.

author: Estrella
headline: Amazing! Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love it!! IT Cosmetics is one of my favorite makeup brands! This tint face balm is amazing, I don't use heavy makeup in my everyday routine but I do use a face tint with my day cream and this is a great complement to cover my under eye. Super light weight and sheer but it does have some coverage. This is a must! I received this product complementary

author: blue
headline: nice lightweight base
comment:
I've tried applying this product a few different ways (brush, fingers, blending sponge) and they're all pretty equal in how the product lays but I feel like I get the best results using a brush to lay the product down and then coming back over it with my fingers or sponge. But if you try to apply it with your fingers or sponge directly I feel like you didn't get as good coverage. 

other than that I love how lightweight it is, almost like tinted moisturizer but thicker....but not as thick as a regular foundation. it's somewhere in between and I love that for light makeup days or when I just want to feel a little oomph on a day in working from home. It also stays really well and sets really well, and doesn't seem to move or get patchy. 

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Dayana
headline: Nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Hydrating, cheer and perfect for my dry skin. I love everything about this product. It has medium coverage, didn't oxidate after applied and has skincare on it! I just wish the size was bigger.

author: Hannah
headline: Flawless!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As with everything from IT, this is another home run! Absolutely flawless! It's creamy and applies beautifully - and the added skin care benefits are the icing on the cake!

author: Megan
headline: Lightweight coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This balm is a game changer for my maturing skin. I have searched everywhere for a foundation to cover my redness without looking caked. This balm has become my new foundation replacement! It has a light, buildable, coverage with the benefits of skincare. I use a foundation brush to apply. It's just enough to cover my redness, but doesn't amplify my texture and fine lines. Put it on after moisturizer, give it a few minutes, and you're ready to go! It does look a little shiny at first, but as it absorbs it gives the best, natural coverage.

author: Pigs
headline: quick makeup
comment: I wasn't sure about this at first because it's very sheer.  But that's kind of a good thing.  I've been using it for a week and so far I would recommend.

author: Leslie
headline: Lightweight Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Feels like I'm wearing nothing yet the coverage is lovely. I suffer rosacea so I have quite a bit of red around my cheeks but I try not to use full coverage foundation. This was perfect for my sensitive skin to give a nice put together look without cake feeling.

author: Kira
headline: Beautiful coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
 I love how easily it glides on my skin. It lasts all day and is lightweight. It doesn't look heavy and it doesn not settle into fine lines.  It washes off easily.

author: Jasmine
headline: Perfect and so Creamy!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Fave Balm is great is you need light coverage. I love how smooth and creamy it is, which makes applying so easy. The packaging is simple and modern and the value is great! So far, I find it durable and lasting all day. Whenever I need something quick and don't have time to do all my makeup, this tint face balm is great!

author: Nola
headline: Perfect for light coverage and mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Fair Warm 120 free for my honest review. Although, I do wish I had a lighter shade I still love it and so does my daughter. Neither one of us like a full coverage foundation so this is perfect. I love the texture, it's blendability and how sheer and light it is. As you get older and develop wrinkles you don't want anything that's going to settle into those lines. This tiny/balm does not do that. It's extremely comfortable on the skin and gives enough coverage to leave the skin glowly and  smooth. I also enjoy the fact that it's fragrance free or if it has any fragrance it's barely noticeable. I will purchase this product in the future.

author: Tina
headline: Light and Airy
comment: I love how light and creamy the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm is. It being 92% skincare serum makes it a luxurious consistency that feels good to put on my skin and makes it feel really buildable and blendable. The color matched my face well after blending and I was as able to cover up redness easily. I do have dry skin and was hopeful this wouldn't look powdery after applying but alas it did (even moisturized etc) but it did seem to sink into my skin and look more natural over the hours I wore it so I dont hate it. It survived and lasted throughout all my Valentine's Day activities and was easy to remove after. I would get this again for sure and want to try more products in the line but maybe in one shade lighter. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Shannon
headline: Absolute love
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so happy to get this as I love it comestics. It was easily blenable and didn't feel to heavy on my face. It was so smooth and made my Facebook look fabulous.

author: Stacey
headline: Nice face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this it's nice and light weight I looks great the color worked well I did like the texture it. I just wish it would have felt like it lasted all day and into the night.  It was easy to remove and did make my skin look nice while it was on its sheer so if you want full coverage this is not the one.  I like this for a summer day so not as heavy of make up on. I for this free to review

author: Deanna
headline: Very nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]    I really like this face balm. The color is a perfect match. My only issue is that I goes on wet and doesn't give.that Matte appearance like I'm used to.

author: maritza
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This feels lightweight and moisturizing. It's not greasy and it lets my skin breathe. It covers up redness and evens out my skin tone.  I like that it also fits in my daily bag so I can take it anywhere

author: Becka
headline: Love the product just the wrong shade!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I do like the Benefits Do It All Face Balm overall. It goes on smooth and it blends easy, and it leaves a natural finish. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy.  My skin felt soft and looked even All over my face.  The only downside that I have is that I chose the wrong color. It just doesn't match my skin tone right, as you can tell by the pics. That's disappointing for me for real, because if it did I would be OBSESSED because I really liked how it performed. Other than the shade it's a great product, especially paired with the concealer.  So I will be ordering a new shade that will hopefully be perfect this time. Wish me luck!!! Thanks #Influenster for the introduction to this!!

author: Lynn
headline: Won't set on top of SPF
comment: I really like the texture of this balm. It's probably one of the most accurately named products I've ever tried. I apply it with my fingers and go over it with a brush. It sits so close on my skin, almost like it sinks in and is undetectable. The only downside is I cannot get it to set on top of my SPF. Even with powder, it ends up looking greasy.  I do really enjoy using it so I've been trying it different ways but, unless I skip SPF completely it kinda slides around my face. Without SPF it's super pretty and natural and makes my skin feel nourished, but the formula is not buildable.

author: Aubreeanna
headline: Good Product Bad Shade Match
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review I really enjoyed the melty hydrating texture of this product as someone with extremely dry skin! It melts in beautifully and leaves a lovely hydrated plump finish to the skin! When applied with a brush it pretty much sat on top of the skin and i was not a fan so the warmth of your fingertips is the way to apply for a seamless result. The shade Fair warm is unfortunately substantially too dark and saturated for my super fair skin and is giving "she needs to get her liver function checked" which is definitely NOT what i am going for. It reminds me of a sheer version of the since discontinued confidence in a compact foundation which was one of my personal favorites. So If you can find a good shade match i would say it is worth a try if you enjoy sheer coverage dewy products!

author: Aubreeanna
headline: Good Product Bad Shade Match
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review

I really enjoyed the melty hydrating texture of this product as someone with extremely dry skin! It melts in beautifully and leaves a lovely hydrated plump finish to the skin! When applied with a brush it pretty much sat on top of the skin and i was not a fan so the warmth of your fingertips is the way to apply for a seamless result.
