author: Claudia
headline: Loved it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this product. It goes on very smoothly. The coverage is buildable and it let's your skin breathe. A little product goes a long way the packaging is cute and heavy so it feels elegant.

author: Gretchen
headline: This would be great to travel with!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is a versatile balm that blends into your skin. I got the shade Fair Cool 125 as I am actually more of a neutral but I think it was a better fit for my skin than the warm shades. Either way, because it melts into your skin and it's overall pretty sheer I think it's pretty forgiving. It does tend to have a natural finish so I used powder on top to matte it out. It's a great product and I will be taking it on vacations and trips as it's easier to pack than liquid foundation.

author: Stevi
headline: Great for textured skin and wrinkles
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Where are my older makeup lovers? Textured faces rejoice! This sheer tint face balm is incredible, don't let the name fool you because it's very buildable. This really does do it all! I love that I can apply it with a sponge, brush or fingers and no matter what, it's smooth and hydrating. I have been struggling to find a base makeup that doesn't make me look older and this is IT!

author: Xiomara
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade was perfect for my skin tone. This feels refreshing when applying. It gives like a cooling sensation on the face. This is perfect for a makeup, no makeup look. It's not heave on the skin.

author: Tracy
headline: Didn't work well with my mature skin.
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I wanted to share the different aspects of this on my arm. By the wrist is a swatch of the actual color. Next to that I blended it out. It does have decent coverage and can be built up depending on your likes. It does dry down after a bit without setting it. Up top of my arm I used translucent power to set it. It did settle into the cracks and fine lines leaving my mature skin and facial wrinkles very highlighted and pronounced. It really does not work great with my mature skin. Overall I don't see myself using this again.

author: Nadea
headline: Smooth and comfortable on the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth and silky formula, it provides light coverage without a greasy feel on the skin. It has a balm feel and is comfortable to wear. It didn't settle into my fine lines and it looked good on my skin after 8 hours of wear. It's a unique product good for those with dry-combo skin.

author: Julia
headline: Light Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Super excited to try out the new IT Cosmetics face balm! The shade was a shade too dark, but I think it still blended in nicely! It is very light coverage, and is not very long lasting. The texture was interesting-I applied with both a brush and sponge, but preferred the brush. I did go in a couple of times to get more coverage-it's build able. The balm didn't irritate my skin, and really feels like nothing is on. There's no scent either which is my preference!

author: Nicole
headline: New favorite.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product! I'm almost 40 and have dry skin with redness. A full coverage foundation does not sit well on my skin anymore. It clings to dry spots and looks cakey. I also don't need anything full coverage. This is light and blends out so nicely. It covers my redness but does not look like I'm wearing a foundation.  I will buy this again and again. I can't say enough great things. Light and sheer.

author: Evie
headline: An incredible face balm with skincare benefits
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am absolutely in love with this tinted balm from IT Cosmetics. I have very dry skin, and find this balm to not only provide foundation coverage but also nourishment and hydration to my skin. I love that this product feels like skincare but looks like foundation.

author: Zara
headline: Do not recommend for oily skin but great for normal or dry.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the idea behind this product and the light- weight, skincare- infused formula. It blends beautifully and gives a very sheer, natural finish perfect for "no- makeup makeup" look. 
However, for my oily skin it didn't perform as well. 
Through the day I noticed increased shine and excess oil production, leaving my skin looking greasy rather than fresh. 
Coverage is extremely light, so it works best for someone with clear, even skin who wants a natural glow rather than coverage. 
Overall, a great option for normal to dry skin types or anyone who loves a barely there complexion look.

author: Leslie
headline: Perfect for weekends
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I finally tried this tint face balm and this is my real talk after a few weeks. The texture honestly its the best part looking like a solid balm, but the second you toch melt like a butter in your face.It fells  like your are applying a moisturizer.its incredible lightweight. I noticed it fades after 5-6 hours fine for weekends or when you want look decent with a little makeup

author: Amy
headline: Light and buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint applies in a light and creamy way. You can build it up as needed for a little more coverage. I didn't choose the correct color, so color match isn't part of this review, but I'm having a current active acne breakout and I feel like this did an ok job of covering it a bit without looking cakey. I like a little more coverage in the winter, but I feel like this could be a great product in the warmer months. As I was washing off the swatch on my arm it was a little resistant to just a water wash, which makes me think it would stay put on the face pretty well in the more hot and humid months. I will definitely try to get the correct shade and give it a go then!

author: Lovelygullz
headline: A great skin tint for all!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

A beautiful lightweight Skin tint that looks and applies effortlessly on the skin. It can be worn sheer for a natural look or built up for more coverage without feeling heavy. It wears nicely throughout the day, giving a true "your skin but better" finish. The shade Light Warm 215 blends nicely with my Light-medium neutral complexion. Definitely recommend!

author: Amber
headline: Skin tint done so right!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm with 92% Skincare Serum is more than a mouthfull but the product itself is very light, simple & breathable. This has light coverage that evens out the skintone & still allows freckles & your natural skin peak through while also giving a healthy sheen to the face. It has a very light, silky & thin texture that glides like butter onto the skin. Super blendable! It doesn't slip & slide around like you'd think with this type of product which is great! It soaks right into the skin, making it feel soft & moisturized with zero tackiness & zero scent. This is going to come in clutch this summer! Very unique product with built in skin serums!

author: Michelle
headline: Fell inlove instantly 😍
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am absolutely inlove with the Sheer Tint Face Balm 😍 I have extremely dry skin and this lays perfectly on my dry almost 40 year old skin. The balm is so thin yet buildable, it doesn't feel heavy on the skin, actually it feels like nothing is there at all, except your left with beautiful almost perfect skin. The consistency almost feels like serum or very thin lotion. The other amazing thing about this balm is you can use a sponge for application, a brush, or even your fingers and you will still get the same beautiful results! I am highly impressed and believe I found my new every day "foundation"!! I highly recommend giving it a try especially if you have dry skin or mature skin!

author: Elizabeth
headline: Amazing
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow this is so great for the skin. Really blends in and feels so smooth. Highly recommend to all my girlies 
Removal is easy peasy. Performance is wonderful

author: Sarah
headline: Obsessed with this tinted face balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. When I first applied this tinted balm, I was sure it was way too dark for my skin, but the more I blended, the more it covered all my skins imperfections and matched my skin perfectly. It's so light and buildable and I 100% will continue to use this.

author: Uyanga
headline: Skincare serum+foundation but blending is hard
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Girl likes her full coverage foundation. But lately I've been wanting sthing light and moisturizing to put on while running errands or at home when u need just enough coverage to feel beautiful. So, as this product promised both I applied it hours after my moisturizer has settled in and put it to test. Dabbing my finger into it made it melt softly and become blendable, although it looked hard. It has a silky texture as if I'm applying light oil onto my skin. I have acne so it did cover 80% of it which I was pleasantly surprised with given how light it is. But the only thing I'm having trouble is blendability, it just wont sit on my skin, making my skin look grainy and enhances my skin flaws for some reason. But it blends decently if skin is flawless, smooth and moisturized already. Otherwise I like that it's a skincare serum+foundation in 1. Please keep perfecting these products, and I'll be the 1st to buy them!

author: Ana
headline: Nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   The texture of this product is very smooth and nice. I applied it with my fingers and it does not look splotchy nor does it show flaws and imperfections in my skin like makeup normally does. It is also hydrating. The only thing is that it does not match my complexion so I will have to wait until the summer to use it. It's Not too matte either.

author: A
headline: A skin tint lovers dream
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a skin tint girlie. I am not a fan of heavy foundations or powders. This is a skin tint lovers dream! It's so creamy and blends like a dream. The coverage is buildable too. It leaves a beautiful slightly glowy finish but nothing too shiny. I set my face lightly with powder and it stays looking flawless all day!

author: Amanda
headline: Skincare and skin tint in one!
comment:
I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Facebalm is a skincare and tint balm that gives you nice coverage while providing skincare benefits. 
It felt nice on my skin and left my skin supple, it didn't settle in to my fine lines and wrinkles. 
I did have some things I didn't care for though, you really have to work this product into the skin to sheer it out. Sometimes it looked a bit cakey and thick and I didn't feel like I was using too much product as I prefer lighter coverage. 
I did like the balm consistency and the coverage was more medium. 
It left my skin dewy which I quite liked and I believe that was because it is 92% skincare.

author: Anna
headline: Blends well
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This blends really well. It looked a little too dark but it blended right in and left a clean finish. It doesn't have a strong scent which is very nice.

author: Emily
headline: Do IT All Does it All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do it all sheer tint face balm feels so luxurious and creamy! Goes on easily and smooth. 92% skincare serum. The color/ shade is nice and blends in well. Easy removal with soap and water or a makeup wipe. Great product!

author: Laurel
headline: Light coverage and weight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is so smooth and light on my skin. It doesn't sit heavy and is light coverage that helps to bour imperfections without looking like paint. It takes a bit to blend in because it sits on the skin if you don't rub it in. It also easily rubs off so be careful.

author: Adriana
headline: The Balm is the Bomb!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a product I've wanted for a long time.  It feels so nice on the skin, more like skincare than makeup.  Plays really well with mature skin, blends like a dream, and doesn't settle into lines.  If you think your current foundation is making you look older than you are, try this instead!  My shade is Light Warm (215).

author: Siuzanna
headline: Natural glow and very comfortable on skin
comment:
Lightweight balm that gives a soft healthy glow without looking heavy. It blends easily, smooths texture and does not dry my skin. Perfect for everyday makeup when you want fresh natural looking coverage. I would definitely repurchase.
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Alicia
headline: It's sheer but it's wonderful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This formula dries down quickly but doesn't feel drying. It doesn't make any of my skin dry spots stand out or look cakey at all. It's so sheer I might suggest putting it on with a dense brush. The touch of my skin feels soft and velvety. The coverage is sheer but it does look great. It truly looks like your skin but better. I know a lot of things say that but this truly is. Your skin dan breath and look good at the same time.

author: Aymara
headline: Perfect for every day wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do it All Sheet Tint Face Balm in Light Warm 215. It gives me that "your skin but better" look with lightweight, buildable coverage. The shade matches my warm undertone really well and blends seamlessly. Feels more like skin care. Very creamy, no smell. Super comfortable and not cakey. Perfect for every day wear.

author: Siuzanna
headline: Natural glow and very comfortable on skin
comment: Lightweight balm that gives a soft healthy glow without looking heavy. It blends easily, smooths texture and does not dry my skin. Perfect for everyday makeup when you want fresh natural looking coverage. I would definitely repurchase.

author: Mia
headline: Great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Texture feels like a solid serum that melts into your skin, it gives sheer coverage with a soft, healthy glow and without looking like an obvious makeup. It evens out the tone, while letting your real skin show. Great for the "no makeup" days.

author: Alisa
headline: Natural breathable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive combo- dry and oily skin that's prone to breakouts…I know great combo. Anyway I don't like heavy mask feeling foundation and tend to usually stick either tinted moisturizer or bb cream for everyday. I like that this has built in skincare and the packaging in comes in is easy to dab and apply with foundation brush, this is also super easy to remove. What I don't love is that you need a brush to apply this I almost wish this came in a stuck form for easier travel and application. I travel a lot and prefer something they I can throw in my bag and go. The coverage itself is good and it looks natural very easy to blend in for a fresh look. The value is good because you have 2 in 1 skin care and coverage which is always a win in my book just wish it was different packaging or came with an applicator.

author: Kristin
headline: Nice foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice blending, shade is a touch yellow. Removal is super easy. Its a nice coverage. Seems to last well in sweat as its a super light coverage. Its really nice.

author: Heather
headline: Nice Tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoy this tint face balm. It provides a light coverage and doesn't feel heavy in the skin. I use a brush to apply and had zero problems with application. This will definitely be a product I reach more during the summer when I don't want a lot of coverage and want something lightweight. The only thing that I would keep in mind is that the shades run dark. I usually wear light neutral shades and this was a tad too dark for my winter shade. The packaging is nice!

author: Camilla
headline: Very impressive! Super glowy and hydrated skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Do it All Sheer Tint Face Balm from It Cosmetics it's exactly what the name says, it really do it all for my skin! The packaging is very generous with the amount of product on it, the texture is super smooth on the skin, it blends very easily and i have the sensation of hydration at the moment that i apply on my skin! The skin become very glowing and looks totally natural! It's very nice for mature skin! I'm very impressed and I'll keeping using! My shade is Light Warm 215! I highly recommend it!

author: Samantha
headline: Love love love
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is so nice to wear. It applies really easily and blends in effortlessly. I was weary it would feel heavy on The face but it's weightless. It had ok longevity. Didn't really last all day but I've been using it mostly for running errands since it's a face tint I don't really expect all day wear.

author: Kimberly
headline: Nice lightweight coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great tinted face balm! It feels great on my skin and blurs out my uneven skin tones. It's so light I don't even feel it on my face. It wears nice and better if you use setting powder and spray.

author: Amber
headline: Really good
comment: I really like this product. I have a fair olive complexion and it works for me without turning me orange or pink. The finish is really nice too and doesnt make me feel like my skin looks older. The packaging is small and easy to carry around which is also something I appreciate.

author: Olga
headline: Looks natural and lasts throughout the day
comment:
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. 
I really like this tint. It makes my pores look less visible and gives my skin a smoother, more even appearance. The balm melts nicely into the skin and blends easily.

author: Jillian
headline: My new go-to daily product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint face balm is my new favorite product. It feels so light and almost cooling. The coverage is light and blends easily. I do touch up later in the day because it doesn't last but I love the natural look it gives me and it's so quick to reapply that I don't mind. The shade range is a bit lacking, I did get a shade too warm for me, but it'll be perfect for my summer shade. In fact, I like it so much I went back and bought my winter shade too. It doesn't feel like wearing makeup and I love that for an everyday look. It gives my skin a healthy glow without looking shimmery or oily like some other products. I highly recommend trying it out.

author: BethB
headline: Comfortable wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have the IT Cosmetics do it all sheer tint on the right side of my face.  It covers up any hyperpigmentation or freckles on my face so good coverage. The texture is like a wet balm.  I like to apply it with my fingers.  It comes packaged in a nice glass jar like container.  It last all day.  I have combo skin though so I prefer to wear it with a powder.  Overall I think it's great for maturing skin.  It doesn't emphasize any wrinkles and it feels good on the skin.

author: Sarah
headline: Great for no-makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm applies and blend smoothly with fingers for an easy application or a brush for more precise placement. I do apply it after my regular moisturizer, and it absorbs well into my skin with no oily feel. While the shade sent to me is too warm for my skin tone, it blends wonderfully and adds a bit of color correction. I have not noticed any changes to my fine lines with this product, but I do love it for no makeup days when I don't need sunscreen.

author: Sarah W
headline: Great for no-makeup days!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm applies and blend smoothly with fingers for an easy application or a brush for more precise placement. I do apply it after my regular moisturizer, and it absorbs well into my skin with no oily feel. While the shade sent to me is too warm for my skin tone, it blends wonderfully and adds a bit of color correction. I have not noticed any changes to my fine lines with this product, but I do love it for no makeup days when I don't need sunscreen.

author: Janelle
headline: Too Dark
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately this was not a good shade for my complexion so I didn't like using it and was unable to really enjoy any positive attributes it might have offered. It blends out so I'm hoping I can use it in the summer when my complexion might be a few shades deeper. I would love if I was able to try a lighter shade as I normally like this brand.

author: Becca
headline: Light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is light and spreads smoothly. It's got a nice creamy texture. The coverage is super light and I prefer something with a little more coverage. Doesn't crease that much which is nice as well. I love that it's got good skincare ingredients.

author: Holly
headline: Natural barely there tint
comment: This is a sheer barely there skin tint. It's basically a dupe for an older L'Oréal skin tint. It is glowy and doesn't offer enough coverage for me, it's hardly any coverage at all. If you spot conceal over top you'll get a more polished look. Def set with powder or I don't think it will last very long. I appreciate getting to try the product but wouldn't recommend it for the price. The wet n wild skin tint is so much better for $5.

author: Heather
headline: I love this skin balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great skin tint! It has great, skincare ingredients which I always welcome! It applies evenly and blends out nicely and looks like skin but better! Perfect for no-makeup days. The finish is great, not too matte or too dewy. It also takes very little for my whole face so one jar will likely last me ages! Definitely recommend this!

author: Whitney
headline: Smooth and dewy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been enjoying IT Comestics Tint Face Balm. It applies smoothly and blende effortlessly, leaving a nice dewy finish. I love how it evens out my skin tone without leaving it looking heavy or cakey. The coverage is light to medium, perfect for smoothing and evening things out but not enough to fully covet blemishes. It's a great every day option when you want a radiant, natural finish rather than full glam coverage.

author: Heather
headline: If you buy any makeup this year, let it be this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics did not disappoint with this one! I absolutely love this! The face balm is sheer but glowy and beautiful! Allowing your natural skin to show through. It's easy to blend and makes me feel like there is nothing on my skin. I did try this with powders on top and I felt like those dried out the balm. So I did try it with very little powder on and under my eyes over the concealer that I used, little dusting around my nose and a blush on my cheeks. I also used a setting spray. This did very well! After several hours, I feel like it looks even better than when I first applied it. It definitely makes my skin look and feel healthy. When I washed this off, my skin felt smooth and soft. Not dried out like others tend to do. I honestly want to throw away all my other foundations and just use this from now on haha! I cannot wait to see how this performs during the summer! If you buy any makeup this year.. let it be this! Thank y'all for sending this to me! This has been truly been my favorite!

author: Marilyn
headline: Very pretty!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by this product. I didn't know what to expect. But being 92 percent skincare…my interest was piqued.  It is balmy but not greasy. It's a light coverage but it gives my face a lovely veil of color. Wears pretty decently. I really like this light coverage days.

author: Rebecca
headline: Easy every day coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm really impressed with the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. This product is such an easy reach especially for casual days or running errands. It glides on easily with a brush, has a satin finish, makes my pores appear less visible, and evens out my skin tone. It wears well on me and lasts without the need for touch up. It does not transfer easily. Worth a purchase!

author: Rosalba zupo
headline: Great coverage and hydrates !!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am using this. It is a sheer Tint face Balm 92% skincare serum. I love that the consistency is creamy and light. I feel I don't need to moisturize before mackup. it is super hydrating and lightweight with a beautiful tint .Amazing for on the go, very pretty .I love the natural tone of my skin after aplicación.

author: Megan
headline: A shortcut to healthy looking skin!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love this product. It goes on so smoothly and just lightly covers and blurs redness. It is also an exact color match for my complexion, which is nearly impossible to find. My only complaint is that it doesn't last very long - reapplication throughout the day is necessary. However, it glides on so easily, touch ups are not a problem. 

I have been using this balm on weekends when I don't feel the need to do a full face - it has taken the place of my eye cream, under eye concealer and foundation stick!

author: Sarah
headline: A pretty balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm feels very creamy. It applies very smoothly and gives a very light amount of coverage. It does not feel heavy at all. I use my fingers to directly apply but you can use your preferred beauty tool. I got the shade fair cool 125 but I would say it leans more warm. Otherwise very lovely and I love the skincare benefits.

author: Tracy
headline: Clean & Smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This blends in very nicely and leaves a smooth feel. The shade and light coverage is perfect for me right now. It lasted me all day with no touch up. I love that it doesn't leave my skin feeling dirty.

author: Katherine B
headline: Good tinted moisturizer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For the past few years I've been mostly doing no/light makeup looks, so I pretty much stopped buying full coverage foundations. I am always exploring new tinted moisturizers so that I can compare the results but I have never tried a balm version, so I was very curious to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. What's amazing about it is that it's not just a balm, it's essentially a serum that transitions into a lightweight but buildable tinted moisturizer. It is packed with great ingredients such as hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides, and vitamin E - all the stuff that makes your skin hydrated, younger and smoother. I don't use the product with anything else - I use it as solo foundation on my skin and it works great for me. My skin is on a dry side, but this balm doesn't emphasize that and actually helps cover some of my fine lines. It's cold season right now so I can't really tell how well it'll perform in the humid NY weather in the summer, but so far it lasts a decent amount of time during the day for me. The packaging is okay but I'm not too keen on sticking fingers in jars, so a brush/sponge combination is a must for me. The only thing I kind of wished it had is SPF, but it's no big deal - I apply my spf separately anyway. Overall, I've been using it almost daily now and I like it.

author: Geshica
headline: Natural glow looking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is amazing and pretty natural looking. I feel my face so hydrated with a healthy glow. This product has a lightweight formula that gives an instant blur. Also the coverage is buildable and the skincare ingredients are great.

author: Tina
headline: Beautiful Glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After testing the It Do It All sheer tint face balm I can tell you that it is something I could see myself purchasing again.  I gave it 4 stars only because I wish there was more coverage, but for light days to run errands or go to Pilates class this works perfect.  The skincare serum in it gives your face a slight sheen, love that glow!  And the color blends beautifully.  It lasted most the day (and through Pilates class) so that's also a huge benefit!

author: Missy
headline: Really good product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used and loved it Cosmetics products for years now, so I was excited to be able to receive this product to test. First of all, I love that it has skin care properties and is helping my skin as I wear it. I like the light wash of color that I get as I prefer lightweight products now that I am older. overall, I really like this product and I will purchase in the future.

author: Sharon
headline: I love this product!
comment: This face tint is lightweight but buildable for more coverage if needed. It leaves my face smooth and glowing. I am so happy with it!

author: Lori
headline: Impressed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this face balm it blends nicely with  wonderful application and great consistency. I wore it for 8 hours with no creasing or reapplying. Suitable for all skin types and I absolutely recommend it.

author: Kate
headline: Lightweight tint with great coverage.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been leaning towards tinted lotions as I age because they don't settle as much on my face. This is no exception. 

I love how easily it applies to my skin with a foundation brush. It takes very little to cover my redness and give me a more even skin tone. I powder over it and have no trouble with it lasting all day or melting my other products. Removal is also very easy. I just use a warm wash cloth and face wash. Zero breakouts from using it either. 

The packaging is sturdy and quality. It's easy to remove product but I also don't worry about it breaking while traveling. 

Overall all I'm super impressed, and will add it to my rotation.

author: Kelly
headline: I love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am so happy I got to try this face balm. I have been able to eliminate a lot of products from my routine and this makes it so quick and easy to get ready now. I apply it with a brush for a full coverage look. I wasn't crazy about the color match so I added some blue for a color correct and now I'm even happier with the product. Definitely a must try!

author: Rachel
headline: Perfect for low maintenance routines
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is so light, soft, and creamy, it's like wearing nothing at all, but better. There's so many days where I throw on nothing but my skincare and mascara, so this balm does double duty on those days. The finish is super transparent although it's buildable, I would save this for days you want a natural, radiant glow. As a new mom I'm loving my low effort routine using this balm!

author: Nicky
headline: So gentle
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone who with mature rosacea prone and hormonal acne finding a product that doesn't irritate and break me out are very hard to come by. This did not disappoint and felt amazing on my skin. It was very gentle for my under eyes too and really brightened up my dark circles

author: Angie
headline: Best tinted face serum
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  It went on effortlessly. It feels like a luxurious serum. It hydrated my skin and evened out my skin tone. It looked and felt like I had nothing on.  This has become a new favorite and daily product I use!

author: Valerie
headline: Beautiful finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from IT Cosmetics is really a perfect fit for those "no makeup" days. It doesn't offer much coverage but it evens out my skin tone and redness nicely. It's easy to apply with my fingertips and feels silky and very lightweight. I love that it's packed with skin loving ingredients. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and cared for whole simultaneously giving me a fresh, radiant face. The little glass tub is a nice size, and a little seems to go a long way, so I will get lots of use from this. This product works well with other makeup too. This is a fantastic skin tint!

author: Melisa
headline: Absolutely love it!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do It All All Sheer Tint Face balm goes on really easily.  I used a brush to apply .  Coverage is great.  It covered my sun spots.  The foundation is very light and goes along way but smooths out very well.  I would highly recommend this product.  It is definitely worth the price.  Out come of the finished product on my face made me very pleased.

author: rach1
headline: love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Cosmetics Do it All sheer tint face balm is so easy to apply. i use my finger to swipe out a little product and apply it like skincare, which it Is a 92% skincare serum. a little bit goes a long way and it has a light radiance and very long lasting. sometimes I add it over or under another foundation for an extra flawless base. overall it would continue to use this daily because it has good results each time.

author: kkelly040
headline: My new Favorite 🩷
comment:
*For reference, I am 44 yrs old and have combo, leaning dry, skin. I have occasional breakouts on my chin area and most of my texture is on my cheeks and nose area. Most of my bases tend to break apart in between my eyebrows & on my upper lip, especially when I sweat*

I have been on the hunt for the perfect skin tint, which for me, is light to medium coverage and something that is barely detectable. Ofc others can tell I wear makeup because I wear a full beat daily but I was looking for something that didn't start to fall apart in places throughout the day. Being a home health aide for a 96 yr old woman is somewhat similar to chasing a toddler around. Therefore, I sweat. ALOT lol. I had recently purchased ((and returned)) Natasha Hi-Glam foundation, Hourglass Illusion foundation, Bobbie Brown's Weightless foundation, and Laura Mercier Skin Tint-because they ALL wore off in a really noticeable way....and then I saw this. I have always been a fan of It Cosmetics, from skincare to their face products so I had high hopes, which was right! This has became my fave skin tint within a week. It wears SO pretty, literally showcases by best face regardless of what kind of skin day I'm having, is dewy and gives me such a youthful glow, keeps my face hydrated throughout the day with long wear, smoothes and blurs all my texture, didn't cling to or emphasize my dry areas, and didn't wear funky in my T-Zone!! I tan, so I can be a different shade daily, but this matches them all lol. If I could make my own perfect skin base, this would be it! Cannot recommend enough for anyone looking for your skin but better in a bottle. Get it!!

author: Mel
headline: Nope, definitely not.
comment: I don't know what the purpose of this is—even being too dark for my current pasty white skin right now, it blends out unrecognizable. So why would a person wear it? Its not a light skin tint with a hint of coverage and it's definitely not covering more… so if i want to be bare faced—i would use my skincare and sunscreen. Even tinted sunscreen covers more?! I tried layering this product with other things (primer, concealer) for a no makeup- makeup look—and it made everything pill or slide. This is a no for me. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Patti
headline: It works
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't hate this product but I didn't totally love it either. Good coverage no scent a bit shiny when I applied it. Didn't feel greasy or heavy. I did like the blending of skincare in with it.

author: LoHo
headline: Good to try
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got this product 2 weeks ago. It's lightweight texture and looks natural. My skin is hydration. It is long last for the end of the day. Good to try, hope everyone love it like me

author: Kristtiee
headline: It feels great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow! This product is so buttery smooth and light weight. It feels wonderful on my skin not greasy and creates a subtle blur. My skin age is mature and I don't feel comfortable wearing foundation anymore. So this sheer tint skincare is perfect for everyday wear. No bad scent or breakouts.

author: Jessica
headline: Sheer Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics "Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm" is amazing. It has been my go-to ever since I received it. It's light weight with just enough coverage for everyday makeup. You can actually build this up if you have a spot that needs more coverage. There is no scent. The texture is soft, silky, and blends right down. Looks amazing under other makeup.

author: Courtney
headline: Very light weight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am not one to really wear foundation anymore. I prefer bb creams or cc creams. This was a perfect product for me. It gave me the light coverage I prefer. It helped hide my redness without making my face feel weighed down. It was easy to apply and blend out with a beauty blender. I will say i noticed it could get a little patchy around my nose where I can be a little more oily and have bigger pores. There was no scent that I really noticed. I will absolutely keep using this product.

author: Melyssa
headline: Works great with oily skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this face balm, as someone who has oily skin, I did not think this would work for me but this is surprisingly one of the best sheer tints I've used. I apply this with the IT Cosmetics Heavenly Luxe Complexion brush and I only need 3 dabs to cover my entire face, I honestly feel like this has more of a light coverage because it definitely covers all my redness or any imperfections. I love to use this under my eyes like a concealer for that fresh, clean look and it does not get cakey at all. This works great under makeup and I've had no issues with my face becoming oilier or breaking down and it lasts all day. This has become my new everyday skin product and I will continue to use!

author: JJ
headline: Not So Dry Skin Friendly
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. As much as I love It Cosmetics, I can't quite figure out how to make the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm best work for me at this time. 

This balm claims to be a "your skin but better", easy breezy coverage product. It is a blendable, light texture. I found the coverage quite light yet the color pigment quite dark. As I tried to build coverage up ever so slightly, I found the serum/balm color built up darker & the tone mismatch became more apparent. (I did attempt to apply with both a Beauty Blender and a foundation brush.) The product seemed to sit on my skin with either application method. It didn't really give the skin-like look I had hoped for. As a person with under eye dark circles, concealer with this was a must. Ultimately, I ended up applying more makeup than I intended on putting on in the first place. 

All this to say, I will re-visit this product in the summer when I have more of a tan and my skin isn't as dry. I really want to like this one, so I won't give up hope just yet! I do love the compact, it is very makeup bag-friendly packaging. For now, it isn't the best choice for me day to day and I cannot say I would repurchase.

author: Kim
headline: Feels light
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product goes on smooth and is not sticky at all. It feels light.  The color I got was a the wrong shade for my skin tone as I got warm, but have more of a neutral skin tone, It is sheer enough that I could still wear it if I blend well.

author: Wendy
headline: Great product!
comment: Light to medium coverage and great to know it's mostly skin care!

author: Eleonora
headline: IT cosmetics does it again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this sheer tint face balm from influencer for my review. I was so excited to get it because I love IT cosmetic products in general and specifically have been into light coverage, BB cream or foundations so this was right up my alley! First off the color match is perfect. The finish is beautiful. It's not matte . It's not shiny. It's perfect. You can build it up and it lasts a long time on your skin as well. A huge bonus for me always is not breaking out and I did not break out from using this product,  so far I love it and definitely will be purchasing some after. I'm done with this one!

author: Leah
headline: Natural finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely blown away by this face balm. A little bit goes a long way and it provides great coverage. I'd say it's like light to medium coverage, keeping your skin looking real and like your skin, just helps to even skin tone and blur imperfections. It's a creamy formula that blends in nicely and dries matte but without giving your face a dry look or feel. 10/10 recommend!

author: Toni
headline: Great skin tint balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really enjoying this product.  It feels incredibly light on the skin and has a creamy texture that makes the application effortless.   It gives just the right amount of sheer color for thoses days when you want a more natural look.

The glass container is portable and I love how versatile the formula is.  I tried applying it with my fingers, a brush and a sponge and it blended perfectly every time.  It also well on its own or when paired with powder.  

It wears comfortably throughout the day.  Overall this tint balm is a great addition to my routine and makeup bag.

author: Renee
headline: Moisturizing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loving this IT Cosmetics Do It All Face Balm! I should have gone one shade lighter, but even being too dark for me it blends in pretty well. I have dry skin so I love how moisturizing it feels, it gives a beautiful glow without looking greasy. Works well with a powder over too for anyone who doesn't want any shine. Has no fragrances which I love, I just don't see the need to have fragrance in make up, seems pointless. Washes off easily, but almost too easily which is why I took a star off, doesn't necessarily last all day in its own.

author: Bobbi
headline: It's Great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this foundation/balm/serum from IT Cosmetics. In the picture it looks like the foundation doesn't match my skin but it blended out perfectly and matched great! The container that it comes in is glass and the top is plastic. It doesn't have a fragrance. It's very blendable and a little goes a long way. I have oily skin and I thought this balm would make me look oilier because of its texture but it didn't. It held up all day (12 hours).

author: N
headline: Love this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product for every day light coverage. It is so easy to use, and it feels great on my skin. As an added bonus, sometimes I even use it as a spot corrector

author: Judy
headline: Great balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very nice balm.  leaves a skin like finish and is very lightweight.  Great for mature skin.  I would prefer it to be in a tube versus a jar for sanitary reasons, otherwise this is a great product.

author: Stephanie
headline: Skincare like makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics sheer tint face balm is a game changer! It is a light weight tinted balm that acts like skincare. The wearability is good, the coverage is surprisingly good for a skin tint. I have sensitive skin and can wear this all day with no irritation or clogged pores. The product goes on seamlessly and does not settle in fine lines and wrinkles making this a great option for both younger and mature skin. I have mature skin with a few age/sun spots and it covers them beautifully. The only somewhat downside is as the day goes on you can get a little shiny, but that is an easy fix with a blotting cloth or a little lasting powder. Overall a great everyday product.

author: Brittany
headline: Like the coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of this product reminds me a bit of the dream mousse from when I was in high school. It is difficult to apply with a brush, so I needed a sponge. It's breathable and provides lighter coverage. I'm not sure I got the right shade for my skin tone, but that's my fault!

author: Melissa
headline: Nice face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this IT Cosmetics sheer tint face balm. It's very creamy, which makes it easy to apply with a brush or a blender.  The coverage is light but that's what I'd expect from a tint product. My only complaint is the color is slightly too dark for me, even though I typically wear medium. It might be good for once summer comes and I have a tan.

author: Gina
headline: Love this hybrid makeup/skincare balm!!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little skeptical at first when looking up reviews of this product. Some people claimed great coverage some sheer (as the name implies)
I have come to love using this in my routine. The consistency is a little weird at first and looks and feels grainy until you warm it up then it just melts like butter into the skin. I like to use this on days when I want a no makeup makeup look or as a glowy base under foundation. I took a pic of it on half my face. It does a great job of evening out redness and the finish is really pretty. I am impressed. The shade I chose is perfect. I know there aren't a ton of colors (15) but it seems like they somewhat self adjust and melt beautifully into the skin.  I actually like this product better than their cc cream. Definitely worth trying out

author: Jennifer
headline: Just ok for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked how well this blended out. It went on a little dark but as I rubbed it in it definitely made my skin look great. It has a little scent to it similar to foundation but not overpowering. If you don't like a dewy look this product may not be for you.

author: Mary
headline: Good ingredients
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall, the IT Coametics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is good. 

I tried it alone and with several different primers along with applying with fingers, brush, and sponge. I found it worked best alone, over moisturizer/sunscreen, or with Jane Iredale primer using a sponge. I also found that it needed to be set with Laura Mercier Blurring setting powder for my mature skin. 

It does "smooth out" my skin making my pores appear smaller and lessened any redness. I had to make sure my skin wasn't dry or it kinda form little patches. Maybe using over time would help with that since it does have good-for-your skin ingredients. 

I picked the wrong shade to try for the winter months but will probably buy the correct one in store. I feel the lightness of this product with be great for the warmer months.

author: Ashley
headline: Love It!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this for free in exchange for my honest review.  Wow, I absolutely love this product!  I just so happened to be on the hunt for a new skin tint and this one delivers. I'm early 40s so my skin is showing visible signs of aging and uneven coloring so I prefer a foundation that smooths and evens rather than over covering and caking. This one definitely delivers.  It's a creamy texture and you can easily build layers to get light or slightly heavier coverage.  It looks completely natural on my skin which is what I love and the color matches perfectly.  I also love that it contains skincare ingredients, thus eliminating steps from my morning routine.  The only thing that would make this product beyond perfection is if it also includes sunscreen.  Regardless, I will very likely be purchasing for my future foundation.

author: Dawne
headline: Lightweight and easy to blend
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First I like to say that I love the packaging of this.It is easy to travel with and carry in my purse.The balm itself is so pretty.I love the shade that blends in my skin.It is very lightweight texture and not greasy plus it is smooth to apply.This is very impressive I love how it adds radiance in my skin and it is all around purpose for me.I can use it as a highlighter or plain clear balm that is just like my own skin.I surely love using this daily and I would definitely wear this anytime and anywhere!

author: Christina

comment: Wow! At my age foundation is a no no. But this The fact that it 's serum based is a game changer! It goes on so smooth, feels super light like I literally put serum on yet covers imperfections nicely and I don't need moisturizer. I recommend this if foundation makes vour pores show too much and you still want the look. Perfect for dry skin. I woulc not recommend for oily skin. No smell. Easy to apply.

author: Jennifer
headline: Beautiful… more coverage than expected!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a beautiful foundation! I used to brush and got more coverage than I expected! Creamy, blendable. No noticeable scent and wore great! It's a win!

author: Stefany
headline: Skin care with coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm free in exchange for my honest review and I am loving this Face Balm. 
This blends so easily with no effort. Has no scent. This has a radiant finish amd its hydrating. It reduces the look of pores, smooths skin and hydrates.  Thos is 92% skincare serum is love that.  Its not full coverage but it does really good covering redness abd I have quiet a bit of it. I absoloutkey 100% reccomend to anyone. My skin is combination.

author: Karen
headline: I'd Do IT Again and Again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face is a versatile beauty essential. It's as smooth as butter! It wears well without turning ashy. It holds up well too. It survives a little sweat and humidity without running into your collars. Easy to apply, with or without a brush; for girls like me that use their fingers and or sponges. This shade was a little too light as a skin tint but it's perfect for an under eye concealer and a skin perfected when my hormonal hyperpigmentation shows out. My only recommendation is to add more color options for darker skin that capture our unique undertones.

author: Amber
headline: Dewy, Unscented Sheer Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been wanting to try It Cosmetics for a while now because I've only ever been able to sample it at Ulta, though I have always been impressed with the results when I have tried this brand. I was able to try the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade Light Warm 215. At first glance, the balm appears harder. When I actually tried it, the Sheer Tint Face Balm melted faster than butter beneath my fingertips, providing a smooth application. It reminded me of coconut oil because it readily thinned from my body heat (smooth texture, not clumpy). Even though it looks thin, it dries into a satin-smooth finish rather than feeling oily or greasy. I think it would be a great balm for a sheer, natural-looking appearance. It clearly added color to my hands overall, but didn't really change the color of my skin other than deepening the tan, or make the veins on my hands look any less noticeable. Just gave them a more even tone and slightly blurred pores. It would be great for clear skin, but I might pair it with a concealer and maybe even foundation; otherwise, use it as a moisturizing base if a fuller coverage is necessary.
I see it being useful for time spent outside and places where minimal makeup might feel more acceptable or preferred. The color itself is a bit darker than I would normally choose, but that means it'll make a better summer color for me and a better contour hue. I also like this tone because most of my current facial powders are too light and make my skin look washed out, so I can use my lighter powders for brightening and highlighting when setting, and rely on the It Cosmetics tan shade (Light Warm 215) balm for a warmer glow on my lighter nude skin. Since it has a sheer feel, even though I don't normally do this because I have sensitive skin, I'd likely also be able to spread It Cosmetics Face Balm to my neck without it causing any redness or irritation on my acne-prone skin. I don't notice any scent when I sniff it or look at the ingredients, aside from the typical smell of makeup. The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm with 92% Skincare Serum offers a hydrating, dewy finish while creating a subtle glow and light coverage. I think this formula would be great for normal to dry skin, especially mature skin, due to its easily maneuverable, hard-to-creamy-to-dry consistency. It's priced well, considering the balm works fine without a primer or moisturizer underneath and doesn't get cakey. It readily blends without accentuating pores, fine lines, or creases. So, I think it's worth the price. It would also be a great travel/work companion, eliminating the need for extra products and saving time on the go.

author: Kinder
headline: It's. Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Honestly it's a pretty good product overall, but if your face is dry and you have any kind of patchiness it sticks to it like glue! It does go on kind of like a moisturizer I just used my fingers, has a decent amount of coverage but nothing like a foundation.

author: Chelsea
headline: Light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very light coverage. This tinted balm is moisturizing and softens my face. It's very light so it looks like I'm not wearing make up. It's easy to add another product on top for more coverage. I have fine lines and sensitive skin and think serum infused light balms work better for my skin. Heavy makeup sits in the wrinkles and ages me so I prefer this over other products

author: Tobi
headline: Perfect for a Natural, Radiant Look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm has honestly become a new holy grail product for me. It melts into the skin effortlessly and gives a beautiful, natural finish that looks like real skin, just smoother and more even. It covers my redness well while still feeling lightweight and breathable, and I've even received a few compliments on how my skin looks while wearing it.

The shade Fair Cool 125 matched me perfectly, which really impressed me. I have combination skin, and I find it very hydrating, especially during dry winter weather. It's long-wearing, comfortable, and a little goes a long way.

author: Katie
headline: Silky and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm is so soft and silky. Putting it on felt luxurious. It has great, lightweight coverage. But my favorite part is that it still feels like a nourishing skincare product.

author: Kelly
headline: My skin, airbrushed - a light-as-air natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As an IT Cosmetics fan, who has been using the CC+ Cream for some time, I was excited to try the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review. It's a unique product in that it comes in a small pot, and is firm yet turns into a gel-feeling serum texture. The directions suggest you can apply with fingers or a brush. I tried both, and highly recommend going the brush route! This product requires blending, so applying with a foundation brush was much more efficient, and used less product. A little goes a long way. What I love about this product: it gives a natural look with minimal effort. It's my skin with a slight filter. You can still see my skin, with the imperfections toned down and "air brushed". What I like: the formula is light as air, glides on, and blends easily.  What could use improvement: I don't find it to be buildable. It becomes very wet and transfers badly when I try to build coverage. One "coat" is perfect- stop there. If you're looking for flawless full coverage, this isn't the one. Also, one layer of product gives the glowy airbrushed look. Building it seems to settle into and accentuate my pores and fine lines -no thank you!  Making sure my skin is well moisturized and primer helps. All in all, I like this for an easy, quick, everyday natural look, but prefer a different product when I want a full coverage look.

author: Jennifer
headline: Sheer coverage and leaves skin natural looking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I thought this product was great for lightweight and sheer coverage. It didn't feel heavy. My skin still looked natural and not cakey. It wasn't full coverage but I did notice that it slightly blurred. I was a little worried at first that it would be darker than my skin tone but it blended in really well. The part I loved the most is that it's a 92% skincare base with collagen peptides, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E. It left my skin feeling soft and non greasy.

author: Angel
headline: Beautiful buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Sheet Tint Facial Balm has been a welcomed addition to my makeup routine. I apply it with a stippling brush and it has a beautiful soft sheer coverage which is also buildable if you desire more coverage. It comes off easily during removal and doesn't leave any residue. I love that it is packed with collagen peptide, vitamin E and hyaluronic acid for a skincare serum!

author: Katherine G
headline: Daily Tinted Balm perfection!
comment: I love an easy to use tinted balm that takes minimal effort but leaves me looking even and fresh! This tinted balm does just that! It's lightweight but even coverage helps even out my skin tone and brighten my face up! Highly recommend! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tina
headline: I would try again with a better color match.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Tint Face Balm in light warm 215 was a little too warm for my skin leaving a yellowish tint. I am fair complected & can usually do a light with a little warmth, but I did not choose well. The face balm had great coverage especially with a blending brush or sponge. It was a little thicker (kind of like a mousse) than expected & a bit oily. I will say that it left my skin feeling smooth. I would definitely try again with a lighter shade for my color match.

author: Tina

author: Brandy
headline: A great tint!
comment: I received this product free from Influen_ster and IT for my honest opinion. It's creamy and feels very smooth. It blends wonderfully and feels very lightweight. It has a nice medium coverage to  it. It's also buildable. It lasts all day. It comes of easily with soap and water.

author: Bee
headline: Great for light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product feels very nice on the skin and is perfect for days where I want light coverage. I also really like the packaging; it has a nice weight to it and does not feel cheap.

author: Jennifer
headline: Your skin but better!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has honestly become my favorite skin tint ever, and I reach for it every single day. It's super lightweight, gives sheer but really nice coverage, and just melts into my skin so easily. It blends out beautifully and leaves my face looking smooth, soft, and natural. I love how well it hides my pores, redness, fine wrinkles, and acne without ever creasing or looking cakey. Plus, the skincare ingredients make my skin feel hydrated and healthier all day long. You can apply it with your fingers or a brush—I like using a dense foundation brush when I want a bit more coverage. The shade match surprised me in the best way because it blends perfectly with my skin tone. The packaging is gorgeous and feels really luxe thanks to the heavy glass jar. It's definitely staying in my everyday makeup routine, and I'll for sure repurchase it. Totally worth it!

author: Jasmine
headline: Would def buy again for medium coverage 🙌🏽
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So I was skeptical about this since I've never use a tinted balm before but I actually quite like this. First pic is before and 2nd pic is after I put two layers on, It's light weight and layers easily. The packaging is simple and easy to open and close and using the product was hassle free. I love how a little goes a long way and you can either use your fingers to extract it, a brush, or a sponge with ease. While it doesn't necessarily give full coverage it gives enough to hide any bothersome dark spots or minor acne scars with some layering. It's great to use in the winter months, but I'm unsure how it will hold up during summer time. Lastly I was happy that it never caused any break outs for me compared to other products I've used on my face

author: Yaritza
headline: Radiant Dewy Balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. On one side of the face I have the balm applied. On the other side I left it bare. I went 1 shade darker than my natural color because I prefer my balms to look dewy and provide a glow. With Spring around the corner this is perfect. It is easy to apply and slightly buildable but don't expect full coverage as it is sheer. I would have given this a 5 star if it was as smooth as it says. It does not crease under my my eyes and it is hydrating however without added steps such as prep, primer etc it does not reduce the look of pores or make my face appear as clear as other competitors. My pores are more noticeable with this product and cannot be used alone. I do like the color and the way it feels but I don't think I would purchase this from the brand. They have a few other face products I would rather use in place of this.

author: Ashley
headline: Awesome Product!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
I'm so glad I got to try this! I really like this brand and was curious about this face product. I found it to be really easy to use, it gave good coverage, it was comfortable on the skin, and I was pleased with the lasting power. The color worked pretty well for me too. I am going to continue using this product.

author: Denise
headline: Great for summer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved how lightweight this product is, so it's great for hot summer days. It goes on shiny but dries down to a matte. I have redness in my skin and dark circles, so it didn't provide the coverage that I needed, even when building it up. I also found myself having to reapply throughout the day because it didn't not last long on my skin.

author: Samantha
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little worried when I got my balm because the color seemed darker than my skin tone but it matched perfectly. I was amazed at how perfect the match was. The product felt light, not like foundation at all. It didn't feel or leave me looks greasy. I applied it with a brush and it worked nicely. It lasted all day too, so huge plus there. I'd highly recommend giving it a try if you are looking for a new foundation!

author: Laura
headline: Awesome Face Balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. At first, I was worried about the color but once I put it on, it looked amazing! I love the way it feels when you put it on and how soft my skin is even after I remove it. I highly recommend it!

author: Kelley
headline: I will always have this product in my makeup bag!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Now that I am 50 years old I have been looking for a product like this! I have tried several other brands, mostly cheaper ones & they were ok but none of them matched my skin the greatest. I love It Cosmetics so was excited to try! Do It All Sheer Tint is absolutely amazing & will always be in my makeup arsenal. I have a lot of dark spots due to years of no sunscreen when I was a child & I love that I can control how little or how much I want to apply & it melts into my skin. I applied it with a brush then used a blender over to smooth it. Amazing Beautiful wear for all day long. I received Fair Cool 125.

author: Kelley

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Now that I am 50 years old I have been looking for a product like this! author: Sarah
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the texture of this product and how easily it glides onto the skin. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy and it looks natural, not flaky or cracking

author: Jen k
headline: Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All tint face balm is just okay for me. The application of the product is smooth and the finish is very natural looking. Mid day I have noticed myself looking a tad greasier then normal. I do have fine lines around my eyes and the product does not settle into them so that's a plus! Overall I feel like the product evens out my skin so I'll be using it on days I'm not wearing a fill face of make-up.

author: Jamie
headline: Perfect for a no-makeup makeup look
comment:
Here's your review in first person, under 400 characters, and in your preferred style:

I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm and love how effortless it makes my routine. The tint gives light, natural coverage that evens out my skin tone without feeling heavy. It blends easily and leaves my skin looking fresh and healthy. It's hydrating enough for everyday wear and perfect for a no-makeup makeup look.

author: Megan
headline: Your skin but WAY better!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Every time I try a new product from IT Cosmetics I'm always left wondering why their products aren't more hyped! This formula is no exception. It feels light on the skin and blends like a dream but the coverage is also great! Leaves your skin looking glowy, healthy and even. I will definitely repurchase as I will be using this all the time…especially in the summertime!

author: Wendy Bethy
headline: It Cosmetics Do It  All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint is very beautiful. It has a medium coverage that look super beautiful on my dry skin. I have the medium cool 315 tone which is perfect for my skin tone.

author: Anikola
headline: Butter and creamy texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It goes on as a balm, it is very velvet and soft! Goes on to fair skin. I place it under my make up like a primer too! Can build up too. Good for different skin types and can blend.

author: Wanda
headline: I liked it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really enjoyed wearing IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It goes on smoothly whether you use a brush, sponge or finger to apply it. I found using my finger was the best way for me to get it right. It's good for makeup when you don't really want to wear it. It goes on sheer and can be buildable, although don't expect it to go to a medium coverage. It feels like you aren't wearing any makeup because it's so lightweight and doesn't get cakey. It's easy to take off at night with makeup wipes or wash clothes. The design of the balm is nicely made and its glass and holds up in my makeup bag.

author: Gigi
headline: Skin-like finish...I love it!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is skincare disguised as makeup!  The texture is buttery and blends like a dream.  It is very sheer...I.applied it with a fluffy but firm foundation brush dipped straight into the product and swirled it into my skin.  I applied it twice, and still.had my skin showing through (which I love).  Super natural finish...and I applied over a grippy primer.  It lasts all day over that primer (use a water based primer so it doesn't pill.  This product will be perfect for the summer or days when you want your skin to look its best without covering it up! 

PS.- I have mature, combination skin with enlarged pores and some redness.

author: Gretchen
headline: Like a lot
comment: Easy to blend and apply.  It also was very easy to remove with facial cleanser and water.  It blends very nicely and offers a nice coverage.

author: Jacquelyn
headline: Smooth like butta!
comment:
Smooth, glowing, and radiant are the best words to describe the texture and feel of this face balm. It is lightweight and blends like a dream. The ingredients feel top quality and the way it wears all days proves its value. I love that it doesn't clump or crinkle in the grooves of my skin after a long day.
Removal is a breeze too. Easy to remove with a gentle face wash and cloth. Love it!

author: Kathleen
headline: Love love  this product!
comment: My skin is dewy & hydrated, my wrinkles are less noticeable. Gives good coverage. This is the best serum/ foundation ever on the market! Love it!

author: Amx
headline: Good coverage
comment: The new IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm kind of blew my mind! I had to kind of select the color randomly but it worked well for me and melted into my skin quite well. It feels nice, not too heavy, which is important because I'm in Florida, and the finish was nice. I liked the coverage, not too much, but enough to take out on the town.

author: Malinda
headline: Overall good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]    Goes on smooth and blends wonderfully. The texture is smooth and lightweight it almost disappears. The only downside is it leaves my skin feeling a bit dry so I really recommend a good moisturizer. Overall a good product.

author: Kaylene
headline: Perfect tinted balm for light makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall I really like this tinted balm! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated without being too heavy. It does give a decent glow, but I would say sets down to more of a natural to satin finish. It's been perfect for light makeup days. Easily blends in with just my fingertips. It works well with all my other products—no pilling or separating. I have normal/sensitive skin  and mild rosacea, and this hung on through a full 8 hours without leaving my skin feeling irritated or dry. It never feels too heavy, even after a full day of wear. Removed easily with cleanser ir micellar water. I'll definitely be keeping this in my rotation!

author: Stephanie
headline: My skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I've really been loving the IT Cosmetics Tint Balm for days when I want my skin to look like skin, but better. I've found the best way to apply it is with my IT Cosmetics foundation brush and I think it makes a big difference in how it blends.  It does feel a little wet when you first apply it, which surprised me at first, but it blends out beautifully. The finish is very natural and lightweight with sheer coverage. It's enough to even out my skin tone and help cover minor blemishes and redness, but it won't fully conceal my dark undereye circles, so I still reach concealer.  Overall my skin looks more even toned and it feels like skincare not makeup!

author: Michelle
headline: It really does it all!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is fantastic!!! I love how it is a very sheer but is buildable coverage. I also really like it is 92 percent skincare. I thought the shade I selected was a little dark for my complexion but it blended nicely.

author: Curlywavycassie
headline: Color matching?
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very nice face tint. It goes on beautifully smooth and melt into the skin like skincare, leaving a very natural, skin like texture. It is light weight anf buildable which is a huge plus. My only issue is the color match isn't great.

author: Paige
headline: great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a really nice tinted balm! I was able to dip my brush in and pick up enough product for a large section of my face. It blended out very nicely and feels light on the skin. Last picture is after setting with powder, other two are bare skin on one half and the unset balm on the other. My face had a really nice glow right after applying. Took off a star because I don't love the packaging- not sure how to make it better though. Haven't worn it for over a couple hours at a time, but I really like it so far!

author: Karolyn
headline: Looks like my skin, but better!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to try IT Cosmetics new Do It All sheer tiny face balm! This balm is 92% skincare serum. It has Vitamin E, Collagen Peptides, and Hyaluronic acid in it. It made my skin feel hydrated all day. It also made my skin look glowy and healthy. This is more of a sheer coverage. When I wear this it looks like my skin, but better!

author: Erica
headline: Thee coolest thing in makeup!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am so shocked by this product and how it feels and functions on my face! At first I was weirded out by it, but the more I used it the more I fell in love with it. It's cooling sensation is so relaxing and refreshing to the face. It covers enough for a no makeup look and if layered it gives a full coverage look, but not cakey!

author: Linda
headline: Lightweight and natural looking!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how smooth it goes on. It blends into your skin and looks super natural. It's light and finishes with the perfect middle between glow and matte. Ideal for everyday and every season. It's lightweight enough for the summer! 
First picture is before application and the second two it's only applied on my right side. You really can't tell it's on but my skin looks amazing!

author: Deborah
headline: Hydrating, natural coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The shade Fair Cool 125 matches my skin really well, and the balm formula feels hydrating on my skin. It gives light, natural coverage with a soft glow. My skin looks more even and fresh without feeling heavy.

author: Nicole
headline: Light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product, it's creamy and smooth and glides on easily. This provides a nice light coverage and is especially good for under eyes and touch ups. The packaging is great, easy to take on the go. I received this free in exchange for my review.

author: Jenn
headline: Gorgeous!
comment: Creamy, blendable. More coverage than I expected! Wore nicely other than getting a bit dewy (but I am oily so I expected that). No noticible scent and washed off easily. I like it!

author: Shannon
headline: Beautiful
comment: I absolutely love this skin tint. It's beautiful and very natural. It doesn't settle into fine lines and wrinkles and has decent longevity for a skin tint but wears off naturally. Great everyday foundation.

author: Helene
headline: Obsessed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am obsessed with this sheer tint face balm. First of all, you can easily build on the intensity of the color on your face. The moment I put it on my skin, it immediately meta and blends in perfectly. It also lasts all day and does not show creases or cracks like some other products do.  It is a great alternative to foundation if you are looking for something that provides light coverage.

author: Karen
headline: A great product from a trusted brand
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product.  It goes on very smoothly,  leaves a light tint. I do have combination skin, so it was a bit oily for me, but not horrible in the Florida heat. This is great if you are looking for some coverage and want to use a very trusted brand.

author: Kelly
headline: Everyone Needs This
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the best tinted skincare product I have ever used. It is super creamy yet lightweight on my skin.
