It is so easy to apply either with my fingers or a brush. It delivers a beautiful Tint that is actually a bit buildable and hydrates and moisturizes my skin all day. It never creases into my lines nor does it ever look patchy. My skin looks absolutely amazing, plus it is completely scent less.

author: Taryn
headline: Perfect for evening out skin tone
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my new favorite skin product! The shade matches my skin so perfectly while evening out the tone to cover my redness. I love how it's just a touch of coverage, but still feels like my skin and not a layer of makeup. The finish is so smooth and it's just what I'm looking for. I'm looking forward to wearing this in warmer months especially when I don't want a full face of makeup.

author: Dani
headline: Stock piling this stuff!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Where has this been all my life?! Haha this balm is so good! I was nervous when initially applied this to my face. It feels like melted butter on the first swipe it just glides across the skin. This balm gives a nice skin like look that's not heavy and looks like your skin but better. My pores are blurred and my redness is hidden but I don't look like I'm wearing any foundation so I love it. I am very oily so I do set this with a translucent powder. I'm sure those with dry skin could skip the powder. So ready to stock up on this! This was better than the pricey skincare foundation I recently got.

author: ashley
headline: Light Weight every day Wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face balm is exactly that, sheer. I love the coverage as I don't like a heavy foundation and want it to look like my skin but better. It is super easy to apply and it doesn't feel greasy on my skin. It is good for every day wear as its light weight and has a thin consistency.

author: Claudia
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT do it all sheet tint face balm free in return for my honest review. This face balm went in my face nicely and felt very nice. I did not notice any scent which I like because sometimes scents on the face are overwhelming. I do not feel like this did much for me at all. It blended in my skin nicely but did not provide any kind of coverage. It also did not really help my makeup look nicer. I really don't think this is something I would purchase. It did however apply nicely and feel smooth on the skin.

author: Khalisey
headline: Tinted Skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got shade light neutral 210 and honestly as long as you're close I don't think the shade will matter too given the sheer tint. The finish is dewy and hydrating. I really enjoy the way this balm feels like a mix between a serum and moisturizer. It soaks in and doesn't sit on your skin. The tint is a nice touch and gives me very sheer coverage. It does make a difference with the redness and dark circles around my eyes but doesn't cover acne spots or age spots. I've been using a little spatula to get the product out and that's worked well. It's hard to get enough product using your fingers. I think this will be perfect for the summer!

author: Stephnhart1
headline: Blends so well
comment: I love this face balm foundation. It gives excellent coverage. It blends like a dream. It works well with my other makeuo and skincare products. It lasts throughout the day. Doesn't look cakey. Has a good shade range and this shade wad goid for me. Definitely recommend. I received this product free in exchange for ny honest review.

author: Stefani
headline: Don't love the coverage/creasing
comment: I gave this product 3 stars because I don't feel it has the best coverage. I also feel that it creases easily. The color I have does not completely match my skin tone (too dark), so that may be the reason for the lack of coverage, so I'll give it that. But I don't like how it creases. I would try this product again in a lighter shade or use this shade when I get a tan!

author: Nicole
headline: Lightweight!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product, it's very lightweight on the skin and it's not heavy or weighed down. It's also not greasy. It's a lightweight coverage but also buildable. It washes off very easily and holds up nice with a concealer and applied with a beauty sponge. There's a huge variety in the color options also which is nice because my skin does fluctuate throughout the seasons. I did think it was going to give a little more coverage than it does but overall I'm happy with it.

author: Holly
headline: No foundation needed, helps hydrate skin
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a 4 in 1 tinted moisturizer.  It provides a buildable coverage while also helping in hydrating your skin, as well as firming skin.  

I decided to use this tint face balm on a date night.  I was impressed by how lightweight this product felt on my skin.  It was easy to apply with not only my fingers, but with a makeup blender as well.  I was happy to find I did not need any foundation after apply this product. It definitely lasted all night and did not cake up on my skin.  It also helps in hydrating my skin, which I currently need right now.  The shade also matched my skin tone well and was not too dark for me at all.

I recommend this product

author: Katrina
headline: I love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face balm comes in many nice shades that are all very blendable and lasts most of the day.  The end result is always sheer perfection and great for dry, mature skin.  I really like the packaging, it's small and compact and comes in a glass container.  I would definitely recommend this product to anyone who wants to make their skin feel more hydrated and just naturally glowing.  Go on and give it a try, IT Cosmetics, Do it all Sheer Tint Face Balm, you dropped the BALM on me Baby...you dropped the BALM on me!

author: Karla
headline: My go-to daily tint.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great, sheer coverage without feeling heavy, soft glow, and tons of hydration. It feels more like skincare than makeup. I love it for daily wear!

author: Tammy
headline: Great base product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect type of base product for my makeup style. I like to even out my skin tone and cover any blemishes, while still allowing my natural freckles to show through. I really enjoy  this product. It's easy to blend out and it works well with all of my cream blush and contour products. I use a metal spatula to scoop it and I blend it out with my fingers or a beauty sponge. The consistency is a light whipped/mousse texture, and I don't recall any fragrance whatsoever, which is my preference. I have used it several times for all-day makeup wear and I have not noticed any issues with it.

author: Brianna
headline: This product made me a believer in skin tints again!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can't believe I'm actually saying this but I absolutely love this product! I normally go for more matte, fuller coverage foundations, but this balm has changed my view on tinted face products. They actually can work out! It's a skin tinted balm that is 92% skincare so it does more than just give you amazing skin-like coverage. I chose the shade 405 Tan Warm. This balm evened out my skin tone and made my skin look fresh and glowy. It gives your skin but better. I was shocked by how good the coverage was. 

For a tinted balm, this product makes your skin look amazing! I was blown away by this!

author: Kelley
headline: Lightweight coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I LOVE THIS PRODUCT. Coverage is next to nothing but it makes my skin look fresh and even and as if I'm not wearing anything. I don't like anything heavy feeling. I like very light coverage. On days where I needed a bit more I used this first and then just added a tiny bit of foundation on top.

author: Yasselin
headline: Perfect for no makeup - makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like it. It gives a natural look. In this photo I have a complete makeup and it's blended well with other make up products. It have good coverage and feel light. I think it's perfect for no makeup - makeup day.

author: Caryn
headline: It's The Balm
comment:
This 4-in-1 formula packs a serious punch. It applies easily and builds beautifully while delivering a radiant finish that left my skin looking fresh and feeling hydrated. The texture is lightweight and comfortable.
It blends seamlessly without any patchiness to reveal smooth glowing skin. I found it easy to remove with a double cleanser routine. It's the ultimate stable for a
"no-makeup" makeup look that actually enhances your complexion over time.

author: Bee
headline: Disappointed :(
comment: I wanted to like this so badly as it would have been a great quick and easy thing to grab for some coverage. Unfortunately, it creates a weird texture with my skin when applying, almost as if my skin looks dry and flakey afterward. It also has a slight greasy texture to it which doesn't help when applying it. It also doesn't provide enough coverage and has almost an oily and see through after effect.

author: Katrina
headline: I would buy again.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sheer tint face balm is perfect if you want a light cover up.   Only a small amount is needed. It goes on smoothly and lasts most of the day. If you are older than 40 or have really dry skin, make sure to moisturize your skin first. It does occasionally settle around the eyes, but you can smooth it right back out.

author: Alyssa
headline: Light Coverage, Hydrating Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! It has such a light creamy texture that gives skin care but coverage of makeup. My skin looks hydrated and this balm doesn't settle in my fine lines or cling to dry patches. It wears well alone or over my sunscreen as well as under concealer without pilling. I'm a huge fan!

author: Kim
headline: Love it!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really loved how silky smooth this face balm left my skin looking.   Its very light, not greasy at all.  It has no scent and is easy to apply with fingers, brushes, or sponges!  It works as a moisturizer, light foundation to give a beautiful finish.

author: Mimi
headline: Moisturizing and long lasting
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a good, moisturizing foundation. I think the shade that I picked was a little too dark, but used sparingly with lots of blending, it looked fine. The foundation lasts all day with setting powder and setting spray. It has a really smooth texture that works on all skin types.

author: Rebecca
headline: Love it So Much
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics has really done a wonderful job with this form of sheer face tint.  The Smooth and Dewy feel as this balm goes on your face is like an experience at the spa day!
The blending with your fingertips or brush is quite easy either way and lasts for hours and let's your skin feel nourished.

author: Ava
headline: Good Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the idea of this product.  Makeup and skincare all in one product. I am very pale, and the lightest shade is unfortunately not light enough to match. Only 3 color choices of light, medium, and deep. It is moisturizing.  Upon applying I did find it to be very shiny, which is not the look I want, or feel is attractive. It gives good coverage, which is buildable, but again, too shiny for my preferences.  My search for a better color match continues.

author: Shari
headline: Makes skin look plump and moisturized.
comment: [I received this item for my honest review]  This foundation has good coverage and smoothes onto the skin smoothly.  It is a thicker consistency and makes my face look moisturized and plump.  I usually prefer pumps for foundation packaging but this formula is much richer and thicker and can't be in a pump.

author: Cat
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im really liking this for no or low makeup days. Its really silky feeling on my skin. The color gives just enough tint to cover imperfections without looking like im wearing foundation. I love that it is good for my skin. I have found that it doesn't pair very well with my foundation though.

author: STEPHANIE
headline: Quick wash of color for on the go!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin: Dry/Textured. Blendability: Easy. Texture: Balmy. Feel: Light and skin feels soft. Hair doesn't stick to your face. Packaging: Travel Friendly. Finish: Natural.

author: Tessy
headline: Perfect tinted balm
comment: Love this new balm!! It feels great on my skin. The coverage is very natural. Being retired I wasn't using foundation all the time but  I use this on a regular basis because it feels so wonderful on my skin.

author: Becca
headline: So impressed!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in love with this formula. It is so lightweight and smooth on the skin. Blends literally like a serum. I have never experienced such a nice skin tint! It has just enough coverage to even your skin tone out without covering up freckles. My imprecations do peak through but I wanted to showcase that. A little concealer in those spots will easily cover. I am so impressed. The shade is a bit warm for me at the moment- but I am at my palest winter skin tone. A little bit of sun and this will be stunning. I cannot express enough how nice this feels. 10/10!!!

author: Kate
headline: Really nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this so far - it goes so well you hardly know you are using it. It's very minimal coverage and very light weight. Glides so smooth over your skin without clumping or settling into fine lines. I've wanted to try this ever since I saw the Jennie Garth commercial. It really works as she says it does!

author: Coco Dior
headline: My new fav
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my go to foundation, it's lightweight, sheer and yet buildable. Sometimes you just might a makeup, no makeup look and this is the perfect candidate. It's amazing. There's nothing but great things about this. I highly suggest you check it out.

author: RS
headline: Natural Glow
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am using shade 125 and it's a really good match for my fair/cool skin. I love how this feels on, it's basically weightless and feels like nothing on your face. The finish is very natural/glowy/dewy. There's no artificial glow or mica, it's just your skin but enhanced. The formula is mostly all skin care so I think that's why it's so comfortable on. Great for no makeup days. 

I have tried it with both fingers and a dense brush. I prefer the brush for more coverage. With fingers, it takes more time and you get less from it. I think it also settles more into your lives using your fingers. I use a brush that was more intended for cream bronzers but fits perfectly in the little pot. Overall, super happy with this and glad to have it for quick and easy face base.

author: Laury
headline: Very nice product.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really liking how well this It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm goes on my skin, it not heavy feeling and it does a nice job of making my skin look more even.
I like the texture of this product is feels nice and smooth and melt into my skin.

author: Mandie
headline: Lightweight, sheer, more skincare than pigment
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I took 2 diff pics with it in my face. And one in the jar.  It looks a lot darker in the container.  As u can see, it isn't as dark as it looks, the color changes a bit when u swatch.  It is very lightweight.  Very sheer.  Feels like a serum really.  I like a no makeup look and this does that.

author: Natasha
headline: Light and smooth coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is great for when you want makeup coverage that's not too heavy or caked-on. It evens out my skin tone and feels good on my skin. The texture is different than I'm used to but it's easy to apply and blends really nicely.

author: trisaratops
headline: Great skin tint option
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
This has become my new favorite skin tint. It gives just enough coverage to even out your complexion, but feels so lightweight and leaves your skin feeling nourished for the day.

author: Jennifer
headline: Nice sheer product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm is pretty thick but it spreads easily across the face. It is definitely a sheer product. It added a small amount of color to my face. The serum seemed to make the product more moisturizing. It didn't bring out my dry patches like some products do. I have on the Fair Warm.

author: Nicole
headline: Creamy Dewy Texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really enjoying the this face tint, I received the shade light warm 215.  It's a great creamy texture that's dewy but not too greasy looking. This evens out my skin tone on days when I don't wear a lot of makeup. Also been using it as a base under other foundations on days I want more coverage and it layers well.

author: Mindy
headline: I will continue to buy this product for daily use.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product! It's so light and creamy yet covers every little line and blemish! It's so easy to wear comfortably all day I didn't even remember that I put it on. The packaging is very simple and the size is great to throw in a small purse. This will be a staple in my makeup bag!

author: CS
headline: Great sheer tint- light texture & coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This photo is after applying the It sheer tint but before other makeup. I like the texture of this slot, it's like a thick balm but goes on sort of silky smooth but sheer. It doesn't bunch of pill or settle weird. It is definitely a sheer tnt like it says, so this is not for folks who want a lot of coverage. It's good to soften redness and even out your tone a bit. I like it a lot, it's great for lighter makeup days and I have g had issues with it irritating my skin or causing breakouts. It is also not drying on my aging skin.

author: Katy
headline: Very moisturizing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a great multitasking face balm that has skincare benefits as well.  I got Fair Warm 120 and is perfect for me. It's lightweight, very moisturizing and doesn't feel heavy on the skin at all. This is a great product to have if you don't wear heavy makeup but want some coverage for everyday use.

author: Thao
headline: Perfect lightweight tint for a natural, healthy glow every d
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the sheer coverage and natural finish of this balm. It feels incredibly lightweight on the skin, making it perfect for daily application . The ingredients feel nourishing, and the compact packaging is so convenient for travel or touch-ups on any occasion. Highly recommend!

author: MuppetMama
headline: User friendly balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Do It All Sheer Balm has been fun to play with and compare to the other IT foundations I have. The balm comes in an easy open but secure screw on lid pot. The balm is buildable and bendable but will never provide medium or full coverage even with lots of layers. Going too heavy does not yield best results. I have a photo to try to show the difference between full coverage and balm. I have found it works best just after moisturizing and being sure to stay on top of my exfoliating routine. I have used it as an under eye concealer, redness blender, spot blender, and all over color. I have found it to wear well over the day and prefer it to other brands of similar type balms. I found the color to be consistent across the brand and recommend this for a flexible use product for those who want to show their skin just blend imperfections. I have used it many times and barely made a dent in the tub so I expect to get a lot of uses. I would like to see a teeny tiny tub of this for portability.

author: Maggie
headline: Good coverage for a sheer product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For how sheer this product is it is also surprisingly good at covering blemishes and redness. It was lightweight and comfortable. It applied quickly and blended easily. I am looking forward to incorporating this into my makeup routine

author: Kally
headline: Perfect foundation for aging skin
comment: I have been makeup hoping for years.  I am 42 and starting to see fine lines.  Makeup settles bad in these lines.  This foundation is light and smooth.  The perfect coverage I have been looking for.  I recommend this to any aging women.

author: Carrie
headline: Silky application and nice coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this face balm more than I thought I would! It matches my skin tone really well, and provides a small amount of coverage for days when I don't want to apply heavy makeup. It feels cool and silky upon application, and hides redness fairly well. I like how it mattifies my oily skin, and it has good staying power. I think it's a great product.

author: Karley
headline: Feels great on your face
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this product!  It blends very well. Has great coverage without feeling to thick. The shade matches perfectly to my face. Last all day. Definitely recommend!

author: Misty
headline: Good For Lightweight Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is super lightweight and thin. I have been using my fingers to apply. I want to try thr brush technique. I don't ever build up enough for more coverage. It does help to lightly even skin tone. Time will tell if it helps everything. Before photo is with towel on head, other two are right after applying it without other makeup. My skin doesn't feel heavy. It doesn't look dewy on me, maybe not enough applied. I like that it is skincare products, I don't wear a foundation anymore at 47 because it looks cakey and settles, so this is a nice alternative. It wears nice under blush etc.  The color Fair Cool matched my skin perfectly.

author: Jodi
headline: Free for review!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Used the balm foundation its really different al.ost like an oil moisture to it. I liked it for work days. It has a very natural glow. Id use again!

author: Stephanie
headline: Foundation alternative
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Light weight, smooth, appearance is nice when first applied but seems to dry out after a few minutes. Does seem to last but I've been using it with another light coverage foundation due to the color not being the best match for me. Have applied with both my fingered and a sponge applicator.

author: Heather
headline: Great light weight color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product feels very light weight and improves skin due to it being a serum. It wears nicely as long as it's set with powder. I chose the incorrect shade but was able to make it work. It smooths out the appearance of skin imperfections while being very comfortable to wear!

author: Sharline
headline: Everyday skin, transformed!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
It's your skin but better! This sheer tint balm applies seamlessly and blends into your skin leaving no streaks or harsh lines. I ended up picking the darkest shade which I use as a bronzer. A little goes a long way! The best part? It is packed with skin loving ingredients to improve the look of your skin, which is so on brand for ItCosmetics.

author: Brittany
headline: Would buy in the future
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great for those days you're riding around and don't have time for a long makeup routine. It is very lightweight and sheer. Not a full coverage or heavy. Good pigmentation to cover any reddish spots. Convenient packaging.

author: Jenilee
headline: Natural glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the IT Cosmetics face balm! The formula feels lightweight and silky going on, and it blends effortlessly into my skin. It gives just the right amount of sheer coverage to even everything out while still letting my natural skin show through. It is very hydrating and lasts all day without feeling cakey.

author: Melissa
headline: natural looking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an interesting face tint. It's perfect for winter so my skin doesn't get too dry. It goes on light enough to look natural yet it still covers imperfections.  I stippled it on with a foundation brush.

author: Angela
headline: Will keep using
comment: This product feels amazing on the skin and dries pretty much immediately. Very very sheer so don't expect a lot of coverage.

author: Christina
headline: Perfect for dry skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow! At my age foundation is a no no. But this! The fact that it 's serum based is a game changer! It goes on so smooth, feels super light like I literally put serum on yet covers imperfections nicely and I don't need moisturizer. I recommend this if foundation makes your pores show too much and you still want the look. Perfect for dry skin.  I would not recommend for oily skin. No smell. Easy to apply

author: Ashley
headline: Great For Every Day Light Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This It Cosmetics Do It Sheer Tint Face Balm is a great everyday light coverage tint. I got the shade light warm 215 and it literally is a perfect match. It goes on so smoothly and softly and finishes with the perfect matte finish. I highly recommend setting this otherwise it does transfer a bit or will crease. Therefore can really show your age. But it has a very light scent that's almost unnoticeable.

author: Kate
headline: I still use a powder at the end
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the texture and how easy was to apply it, I used sponge and another tie - finger, the effect is almost the same. And my choice is sponge, the process is better. I applied it on primer and without it, the result almost the same. Once I didn't use powder and I don't like how it feels and looks (like this balm was washed/wiped away), so I used powder at the end.

author: Mimi
headline: Perfect
comment: I LOVE this foundation!! I wouldn't really call it a balm, but I guess the texture isn't consistent with a liquid or powder foundation. Its consistency is really great, blends easily, coverage is perfect (if you have redness, tap really lightly to blend a couple layers). My sponge blender actually fits perfectly into this container, which I find very cute. Would 100% recommend!

author: Anne
headline: Good for "no makeup" makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by this tint. It is super sheer, but can build to a medium finish. It managed to even out my redness and cover some sun spots. As a balm, it adds a lot of moisture, and felt like it went from a solid in the packaging to melting immediately on my fingertips. I wouldn't recommend this for oily skin, but it was good for my dry skin. It held up pretty well through a cardio dance class. Removal was easy with an oil-based cleanser.

author: Azure
headline: Give it a try if you like skin tints
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this. It is light on the face. So for people who don't like foundations that you can feel will love it. My issues came with the shade match and getting it to look good. In the first picture (white shirt) I used my tried and true primer. I was an oil slick pretty much a few hours after wear. No matter how many times I powdered. I tried another primer and it wore better (red hair). Didn't love it but it was decent. As for the shade, it was off.  I am a 420 Fenty shade and the 510 was off for me. I made it work with concealer and powder.

author: Monique
headline: Radiant finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very radiant face balm. The finish is reminiscent of my skin after getting a hydrating facial. The skin care ingredients give you a nice plump also. It is very easy to blend and has just enough coverage for being sheer. My shade match is very close to my skin tone but runs the slightest bit red. My only concern is it lifts easily if you don't set with a little powder.

author: Pamela
headline: Has potential but zero coverage
comment: This tint balm was interesting. Cute packaging, creamy texture and felt more like skincare than makeup. The biggest issue is the zero coverage. It wasn't blendable. It highlighted my redness. It's very sheer but not sure if it's makeup or skincare.

author: Lyfewithstyle
headline: lightweight, blends easily, and gives a natural glow
comment: IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is such a nice everyday product. It feels super lightweight, blends easily, and gives a natural glow without looking heavy. Love that it has 92% skincare serum my skin feels hydrated and fresh while still looking even.

author: Rebecca
headline: Very Good Very Good!!
comment:
I am so glad I decided to try this. It works very good! It blends well and nicely. It's really great product with aging skin. I am not sure of the "firming, etc" claims, but it is so light and it doesn't settle into fine lines and wrinkles. 
I like it so much!!

author: Dao
headline: Must try!
comment:
I've been using this IT cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm and love it. Its so Lightweight, hydrating, melts into skin effortlessly. The coverage is perfect, sheer but buildable and keep my skin glow. My skin  feels comfortable all day long. Perfect for natural, "My skin but better" looks
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Jennifer
headline: This was perfection;)
comment: So pleasantly surprised by how beautiful this was.  It blended into my skin like butter.   Wasn't super glowy or matte it was like in between and to me the perfect formula.  The shade match was perfection as well and I never pick the right shade.  HA!   Packaging is so small and cute and easy for traveling.   This is all around perfection in my book.   [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Donna
headline: Good coverage
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review.  I like its presentation, I like its texture, it doesn't have an unpleasant aroma. It feels soft to the skin. The color is a little darker than my shade, but I like its coverage. It feels soft to the skin.

author: Amanda
headline: This will be a staple in my spring summer routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a creamy formula I got the shade light natural 210 base on what the color looked like on my screen. This shade is darker than anticipated. With it being winter and it being darker than what I was expecting this is more of my late Spring early summer tan on my skin. With that said I did a swatch test for this review and I did do a wear test for a full day around my house. Applying this as 9am with a makeup brush and doing a full routine of home chores, walking the dog and then having some time to relax before washing my face at 8 pm I can say it was a good foundation. It is advertised as shear but I found it to be a medium to build full coverage foundation. I also found a little bit goes a long way so I feel like that will make it worth the money. Now for the longevity, when I used it around my house it lasted all day, I felt it didn't move much if at all. I didn't experience any creasing or settling in to my finer lines around my eyes. I had a breakout that it easily covered. I definitely looked forward to getting to use this regularly when I get some color to my skin when the sun returns.

author: LB
headline: A truly revolutionary product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow, this is really a special product! It goes on so thin and melts right into the skin. The texture is unique in that it's like a gel-solid. It dries down completely and feels weightless on the skin. It's so easy to spread when applied with a brush and it has a lovely satin/natural finish. I wear it as sheer coverage but it can be built up to medium. I got the shade light warm which is a little too dark, unfortunately but I'll probably go back to buy a better shade match since I like it so much!

author: LB
headline: A truly revolutionary product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow, this is really a special product! It goes on so thin and melts right into the skin. The texture is unique in that it's like a gel-solid. It dries down completely and feels weightless on the skin. It's so easy to spread when applied with a brush and it has a lovely satin/natural finish. I wear it as sheer coverage but it can be built up to medium. It lasts all day when I wear it to work at the office. I got the shade light warm which is a little too dark, unfortunately but I'll probably go back to buy a better shade match since I like it so much!

author: Abby
headline: Sheer but buildable not cakey
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This isn't a product I would normally try because it's not cruelty free but since I was sent this I tried it and actually liked it. It's sheer but buildable. Glides on and leaves your skin real but polished. I did feel like I had to use a good amount but i like a little more buildable foundations.

author: Bri
headline: So soft!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics, Do it all Sheet Tint Face Balm is so soft and breathable. It feels like you are applying moisturizer but provides beautiful coverage that you can layer if needed. Blends nicely. This will easily become a staple.

author: Amanda
headline: Buildable and lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This formula is not what I am use to but I did enjoy the end result. It was very buildable and felt lightweight. I like the compact packaging so it's easy to take with me without taking too much space.

author: Ivy
headline: Natural-looking coverage.
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This foundation truly does it all, just like the brand promises. It has lightweight, creamy texture with a sheer tint and no fragrance, making it feel incredibly soft and smooth on the skin. It provides excellent coverage without any heaviness and cakey feeling. 
The Fair Warm 120 matches my skin tone perfectly. When I apply it, my complexion looks even, my pores appear minimized, and my skin looks smooth and flawless. 
Although the price is higher than similar products, it absolutely worth it. 'it' brand really delivers-giving me long-lasting, natural-looking coverage and the confidence that comes with a pure, beautiful finish.

author: Endia
headline: Lightweight but pigmented
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lightweight but pigmented. The finish depends on how much you apply. I have combo oily skin and it was not as dewy on my skin. Keep in mind I picked up a color too dark for. I appreciate that a deep skin tone woman. I don't crease too much but if you apply it as a foundation it will. Soft matte finish.

author: Katy88
headline: Your skin but better
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this sheer tint face balm from it cosmetics! It's creamy but not cakey AT ALL on my skin which is rare for most every foundation type product I try. It's easy to layer if you want more coverage and looks fantastic and soooo natural when applied with your fingers. I goes on over my sunscreen with no issues. I wore it today for a full 12 hours and it still looked amazing. I can't get over how natural it looks. It's not going to cover acne but that's not what this product claims to do so just keep that in mind. Overall love it

author: Mel
headline: Looks beautiful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this as an incentive for an honest review. I really love this. It blends right into the skin like skin care. It doesn't enhance my texture. It has light coverage. Just enough to even out the skin tone. It's great as an everyday. The pigmentation is definitely a skin tint. It looks beautiful on the skin. I definitely recommend this product.

author: Leah
headline: Glides on smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First off the packaging is in a glass jar with a twist off lid which makes accessing the product easy. The shade is a little dark for me in winter but right now I can use it more as contour or like bronzer till I'm tanner. It feels super lightweight and feels like I'm not wearing anything at all. Reapplying is easy to do throughout the day without looking cakey or patchy.

author: Sandra
headline: Dewy light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ive been using this face balm and overall I really like it. It blends smoothly and has a dewy finish that's perfect for every day wear. The hydration is nice, and doesn't settle in to fine lines. The shade I picked is a little too dark for me right now, but it will actually be perfect for the summer when I have more color. If you're looking for a sheer, skin enhancing tint instead of full coverage, this balm definitely does the job.

author: Kaitlyn
headline: Natural and Effortless!
comment:
I received a complimentary pot of the IT Cosmetics Do It All sheer tint face balm in exchange for my honest review, and it has been a beautiful addition to my everyday routine. I have loved IT Cosmetics for a few years now and regularly use several of their products, so I was curious to see how this one would compare. The balm has a smooth, almost velvety texture that melts in easily and feels genuinely comfortable on my skin.

What stands out most is how natural it looks. It does not mask my skin, but instead softens redness and creates a more even, rested appearance. My complexion looks clearer, more youthful and balanced, and quietly radiant, like I'm just having an especially good skin day.

It also feels hydrating throughout the day. It gives me exactly the kind of effortless, refined finish that I gravitate toward. I highly recommend it for those who enjoy light coverage that doesn't drown you out.

author: Vanessa
headline: Definitely buying again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The it Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm Skincare Serum is actually kinda unbelievable. I had never tried a similar product before. I assumed the skin tone would be off or too orangey, but it's surprisingly buildable and blendable. To the point I couldn't even feel it on my skin. It's almost as if you are wearing nothing. Make sure to match your shade and you honestly will see how it blends so nicely to the point you really don't need any other face product. It's very breathable and doesn't leave your skin greasy or oily.

author: Ashley
headline: Great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love love love this product! It goes on smooth and the coverage is flawless. It was a great match for my skin tone, I would highly recommend this for your daily routine!

author: De
headline: This is It!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love this product on my perimenopausal skin!  A little goes a long way for a light coverage. The container is perfect size opening to dab any brush. Its a smooth thick cream texture that I mix with my spf  and it does not settle in wrinkles not does it leave face greasy.

author: Sally
headline: Natural look and feel
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised with the feel of this product. It's ultra lightweight and has the most amazing feel…feels like a cool gel.   It blends in very easily and leaves your skin looking very natural and just smoothed out a little. The shade seems very forgiving as it does not heavily coat your skin. Perfect product if you are looking for a natural look.

author: Leahi
headline: Interesting
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this product multiple times and im still undecided on it. Sometimes it goes on smooth and other times its clumpy and shows my pores. I will keeping trying.

author: Shannon
headline: Meh
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I'm not sure what I expected from this product but it wasn't this. To me, "sheer tint" should mean the slightest hint of tinted coverage. I expect something subtle. This? This may as well be a medium coverage foundation. Smells like it, feels like it, and definitely looks like it. And as far as moisturizing, I didn't even remotely notice anything hydrating about this.

author: Tiffany
headline: Great coverage for a sheer product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was far better than I expected. It goes on very smooth and has a great amount of coverage for a sheer balm. I was able to use it after a laser procedure and it covered a lot of the redness without irritating my skin!

author: Jill L
headline: Weightless
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the way this face balm feels.  For me the color isn't correct I need a shade or two lighter than light warm 215.  It doesn't feel like I'm wearing it at all. I wish it was the correct color and maybe it will be this summer when I'm tanned.  A little of the product goes a long way.

author: DeaItaliana
headline: Light and effortless flawless look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm for over two weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed. My skin can be picky, but this balm hasn't irritated my skin or caused a single breakout. It feels soft, light, effortless every time I apply it. 

The texture melts in beautifully, giving me that sheer, natural tint without looking heavy or cakey. It's that kind of product you can throw on quickly and still look put together. Perfect for everyday wear. If you want something to even out you complexion while still feeling like real skin, this one delivers.

author: Elizabeth
headline: Love this product I will continue buying
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love love love!! This IT All Sheer Tint is the best. The finish is perfect color on my skin and it lasts me all day and my skin feel so good. Easy to handle container is perfect to carry with you. I highly recommend.

author: Juanita
headline: The perfect tint balm
comment: Im in love with this balm! I love the feel of it. It glides on so smoothly. I love how I don't have to apply foundation anymore. I use this as a sheer foundation and apply a bit of translucent powder above and love how my skin looks so natural. You can still see some of my imperfections but not that clearly and ! like that because it makes it look so much more natural. The pigmentation of the tint in this balm is perfect for me. The price is on point as well. I will definitely be buying this again.

author: Karen
headline: IT Do it All Does It All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face is a versatile beauty essential. It's as smooth as butter! It wears well without turning ashy. It holds up well too. It survives a little sweat and humidity without running into your collars. My dilemma was that this shade is a tad too light but it's creamy texture made it perfect as an under eye concealer and a primer for days when my hyper pigmentation wants to show off. Easy to apply, with or without a brush; for girls like me that use their fingers and or sponges. My only recommendation is to add more color options for darker skin that capture our unique undertones.

author: Samantha
headline: It's okay
comment: light coverage but buildable to medium without feeling heavy on the skin. Skin look a little hydrated not ans I'd like it to be. Packaging not my cup of tea. I guess convenient maybe to have in your makeup bag or on the go. For the price it's ok. Easy to apply with fingers and also with makeup's brush. The color match is alright to my skin. Look nice after 4 hours without retouching. With the flash the photo looks fairly okay. It is a skin tint so do not expect wowing results

author: nikkm4509
headline: The perfect tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was impressed with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, which came in a compact case similar to blush. The product features a smooth, balmy texture, making it easy to apply with the finger. Personally, I prefer to use it under my eyes, as it helps reduce the appearance of dark circles. I appreciate that it hydrates the skin while blending in seamlessly. When paired with my IT Cosmetics foundation, it provides excellent coverage, conceals imperfections, and adds a touch of color to my pale winter skin. I plan on continuing to incorporate this product into my makeup routine.

author: Cassidy
headline: Feel great on skin, natural looking coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm feels great on the skin and is easy to apply. It definitely covers up blemishes and some of my redness in a way that still looks natural. It is slightly buildable, but since it's sheer it doesn't build up to full coverage. I think this is a perfect product to use going into the warmer months where you want coverage, but something that feels light.

author: Jennivibez
headline: MY NEW FAVE!
comment: I have used Clinique, Ilia Youthforia, Maybelline, and so much more for the perfect skin tint because I'm very active on the gym, outdoors, and just as equally on camera. When I saw a skin tint balm, it already sounded perfect, but when I tell you... when I stuck my brush in and it just glided onto my face better than butter... I INSTANTLY KNEW this was going to be my #1 go to! The coverages, the feel, the stay.. This is the first time I've found a PERFECT skin tint- foundation for me. I'M IN LOVE!

author: Alena
headline: Smooth skin
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like consistency, but I need more light shade. For my combination skin it's too oily structure. I think I can mixed with something else to get right shade. Quick absorption. I didn't like the smell

author: Lisa
headline: Blends in with a slight tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends in well leaving just the slightest tint of color. The 1st line is just placing it on the skin. The 2nd is after rubbing it in. Thin texture that is easy to apply and absorbs. Lightweight and dulls the redness of my skin. Overall good coverage and gives a nice clean look. Great for quick coverage and daily wear.

author: Donnamarie
headline: New fav product. Sheer & hydrating
comment:
I love IT cosmetics and this was one product I have not tried and now after using several weeks it's my Top product . This sheer tint balm is amazing . I got color medium cool and even though it looks dark it doesn't go on that dark and blends effortlesy and so smooth . It's light on the skin as not a thick coverage looking and gives you a flawless look on skin 

It's a like a tinted moisturizer but in a balm    It does hydrate the skin which is also a bonus.  I'll be buying this product over and over as replacement from my other liquid tinted moisturizers

author: Tysha
headline: Good for short time wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this. It's very light and perfect for those who don't like to where foundation all the time. This is also perfect for those who like to where makeup for a short period of time I say maximum about 5 hrs. It does feel comfortable and doesn't feel heavy on face.

author: Margaret
headline: I will definitely buy this again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I finally have a makeup for a lady in her 50s. It is so hard for me because I have fine lines and still have an oily T-Zone. I found it best to apply with the full round brush from It cosmetics. Then use a sponge to apply more where needed. For me I used a setting powder in the T-Zone. It wore well on most days except for the hot days where nothing will stay on. It was a perfect match for my skin tone. The only thing you have to be careful of is how much primer and what kind of primer you use.  I find it best to treat it like skin care. This for me is a must have especially if you are over 50.

author: Janesa
headline: Natural Glow, Effortless Coverage!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review; I've been really impressed with this sheer tint balm.
The texture is smooth and lightweight, blending effortlessly into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It gives a natural, healthy glow while subtly evening out my complexion, making it perfect for no-makeup makeup days. I love that it feels more like skincare than foundation, and it doesn't emphasize pores or fine lines. The finish is breathable, comfortable for all-day wear, and ideal for quick routines. Overall, a great multitasking product if you want light coverage with a radiant, skin-like look.

author: Saki
headline: Very cool!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is actually really cool!  It acts as a moisturizing foundation that can hydrate, firm, reduce fine lines and be a base for buildable coverage! It's very smooth and is fairly easy to blend with just your finger (as you can see on my skin). I really like this concept but my biggest issue is, it's a darker shade than my skin so can't really use it. I just needed like a shade lighter but that's okay cuz this comes in 15 shades, so I can get a color best suited for my skin and give this to a friend of mine! The finish is pretty matte, which I think is great especially if you're going to build on it.

author: Niki
headline: Natural Skin Finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was expecting this to be way more balmy and moisturizing than it was. It's a thinner consistency and worked on my normal skin type. You can build the coverage and I felt the finish was natural. I did set my t zone with powder and it lasted all day.

author: Tammy
headline: I will buy this product again!
comment: I love IT cosmetics, but this is the best by far! This is a great product for mature skin. It does not settle in to fine lines and makes my face look youthful again.

author: Sam
headline: Creamy and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this sheer tint face balm. It is so creamy and smooth but makes my face look so balanced and refreshed! I love the texture and it blends nicely.

author: Hannah
headline: Your skin but better!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you are looking for a new skin tint, look no further! I have naturally red cheeks, and this skin tint covered the redness effortlessly. I applied it with a brush, but you can definitely use your fingers for a more sheer look. It is a lightweight feeling formula, and doesn't feel cakey at all. It feels like you are just wearing a nice moisturizer. Overall, I highly recommend this product!

author: Celia
headline: Good for no make up days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very easy to apply. Lightweight and non-irritating. It is very sheer, feels comfortable on the skin. Perfect for everyday wear or your non-make up days. No strong scents. Feels like skincare. No settling in fine lines. No cakey feeling. The shade i choose was a little dark for me but it gave me a nice tanned look. You might want to use a little powder after if you dont like a little glow. But i loved it as is.

author: Amanda
headline: It's nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone who really enjoys IT Cosmetics products I was very excited to test out the new Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I found the product to be sheer just as the name implies - this is certainly geared toward the no makeup makeup look. I like that it is packed with skincare ingredients but at the same time I'm not sure how I feel about its consistency. I don't find that it absorbed into my skin and instead sort of slipped around on top - maybe I need to use less. Definitely going to use this to even out my skin tone when I need to run a quick errand but don't have time to put on my face.

author: Katie
headline: Great, light color
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My first photo is without the product, and the next two are with the face balm.  
I really love this balm. It evens out my skin tone and gives me a nice finish without being heavy or sinking into fine lines.  
You can layer it to build up more coverage. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone who wants a natural finish.

author: Kara
headline: Perfection!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE this product. It is perfect for the transition of the color of my skin tone from summer and on into winter. Glides on beautifully and is so moisturizing. The finish is matte but with a touch of shine… not much at all. I would buy and recommend this product over and over!

author: Lorrie
headline: Will buy again
comment: Used to use L'Oreal for dull mature skin Rosie tone with SPF 30. Great product but was discontinued have been searching a while. Saw this advertised on TV and decided to give it a try so far so good. I just wish it had some sun protection.

author: Liz
headline: Good for minimal makeup looks
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I was really excited to try this product, and it didn't disappoint. It is sheer as the name implies, which is great for a no makeup look. I did find that it didn't absorb well into my skin and it was tough to get it to spread consistently, but maybe I just need more practice with it.

author: Kerri
headline: Love it ! Definitely would buy it again
comment: Loved how smoothly it goes on, it's buildable and can also be used for contouring and mixed with my regular foundation.

author: Rachael
headline: My new go to
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a mom of 2 under 2, makeup has been a thing of the past lately. I absolutely love this skin tint skin care! It is super easy to apply both with your hands or a brush. It doesn't feel heavy like a foundation, but adds a tiny bit of coverage for my redness and blemishes. It doesn't look like I'm wearing makeup, but it feels like I am. I also have fairly sensitive skin and this balm didn't bother me at all. Highly recommend.

author: Lisa
headline: It's a no for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review and honesty is what you'll get] I really wanted to love this, but no matter which application method I tried, the product emphasized my pores, texture, and clung to every bit of peach fuzz. While the shade match was on point, that is about the only thing that went right with this. 
For reference, I'm 40 with combo skin.

author: monica
headline: Absolutely YES !!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

This is just absolutely amazing !! Just absolutely yes !! The consistency is very light ,like a gel !! And the color match was spot on !! It's so light weight and it looks like my skin,like I'm not wearing anything at all !! I used the IT cosmetics foundation brush to apply and then went over it with a wet beauty blender and it looked SO good !! It doesn't have a strong scent more like a light make up scent in my opinion,but this is by far my new go to foundation !! I'm definitely going to repurchase this !! One of my favorite items I received for sure !!!

author: Cristina
headline: Feels more like skincare
comment: Very very sheer, which I like. At first I thought I had gotten the wrong color, but it lightens as you blend it in. Feels very nice and smooth to apply. I don't notice any kind of fragrance.  I didn't try layering too much, so I don't know if it could be built up or not.

author: Casondra
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Balm is a really good product.  I like it's very lightweight. It goes on smooth and doesn't clog my pores. It doesn't make my face look cakey. Its a buildable coverage, which I love. My skin looks more evened out. I love this is a vegan product.  I like the ingredients. Collagen peptide which helps to promote smoother, firmer younger looking skin. Hyaluronic acid which is known to plump and hydrate. Vitamin E antioxidants known to moisturize skin.

author: Barbie
headline: Great , would purchase myself again
comment: I was so excited to try this as I LOVE their concealer with the same name. And this foundation did not disappoint. A little went a long way for me and the coverage was amazing! It lasted all day and I have to run after a toddler so that says alot lol I found this to be a great formula on my dry skin.

author: Mel
headline: Love love love
comment: Not only would I recommend this to a friend, I will be buying it forever. Love the texture, finish and coverage is buildable. It's rare that I like a foundation type product this much. Highly encourage all to try it!

author: Julie
headline: Comfortable application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of the formula is really smooth and easy to apply. The formula is hydrating and gives a mild coverage. The package is durable and easy to handle.

author: Kim
headline: Great skin tint!
comment: This skin tint worked great for me!  Very light and blendable.  Great color shade for me.  This was light neutral 210.   I typically wear "light neutral" shades in all of my foundations, so this was perfect!  I would definitely purchase again!   I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Lidia
headline: Great tint! Will buy again in a better shade!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this balm tint! It a light weight and light coverage tint. To me it has a balm texture that has a natural look which is my preference. I have medium cool which is a bit dark for me, but with it being a lighter coverage I can make it work. Nice heavy glass packaging and this would be great for travel. This lasts well on my skin and also easy to remove with a cleansing balm. I will definitely be purchasing a different color. This has become my new go-to foundation tint.

author: Sarah
headline: Very sheer!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It! Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is exactly as the name states. It is very sheer, so this is not for anyone looking for full-coverage. You can still see blemishes after applying, so this product is not for me since I struggle with acne. The balm is very light and airy, and applied smoothly with my foundation brush. The shade was a great match for my skin tone, and there are a few you can choose from. I didn't notice a scent, so this would be good for anyone that is sensitive to smells.

author: Cathy
headline: Nice "light" foundation
comment: I was looking for a less heavy foundation for my y "older" skin. This balm is light, yet covers and is buildable. I'm really happy with it.

author: Sierra
headline: Lightweight, skin loving coverage that makes skin glow!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone with combination skin, I'm always looking for products that balance hydration without feeling greasy, and this one delivers. The texture is creamy and lightweight, blends, effortlessly with fingers, and gives a natural, skin like finish.

It evens out tone while still letting my natural skin show through, making it perfect for everyday wear or "no-make up" make up days. It feels breathable, doesn't clog pores, and sits comfortably all day without emphasizing dry areas or getting shiny in the T-Zone. 

This is a great option for anyone who wants low-maintenance makeup that feels more like skincare. I'll absolutely keep this in my daily rotation.

author: Rebecca
headline: Light, Natural feeling
comment:
I am so glad I decided to try this. It works very good! It blends well and nicely. It's really great product with aging skin. I am not sure of the "firming, etc" claims, but it is so light and it doesn't settle into fine lines and wrinkles. 
I like it so much!!

author: Daniela
headline: I will buy this product a thousand times!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Perfect natural looking skin all day long!!
I'm in love with the sheer tint face balm from It cosmetics, it's the best of both worlds: makeup and skincare in one product!
It has a high coverage but a super natural finish. It evens out skin tone, conceals imperfections ans leaves skin luminous without feeling heavy. What I love most it's not greasy and doesn't dry out of my skin; on the contrary, it feels hydrating and comfortable all day.
It stays flawless for hours, doesn't crease and doesn't clog pores, my skin breathes and looks healty

author: Mary
headline: Loveeeeee
comment: This has such an amazing coverage. Feels so soft and smooth on the skin as if I have nothing on. Blends in very well, no creases or dryness. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tiffany
headline: Excellent natural texture when buffed
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really enjoyed the light balm-like texture of this product. Unfortunately I was a terrible color match for my very pale and neutral skin. Too dark and too warm to wear (especially this winter). However, I applied it thicker on my top swatch and really blended it into my skin on the bottom swatch and I am so so I pressed by the natural finish and undetectable texture it has when it's buffed in. I wish they had a color match for me. As a dry skin girly, I like that this didn't cling to my skin. I would recommend this for those that have a good color match.

author: Michelle
headline: Conceals Without Camouflaging
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received a complimentary gift of IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest opinion. As I get older my makeup routine has changed and I am no longer using the same foundation that I used in my twenties and thirties. This sheer tinted face balm did a beautiful job at hiding my imperfections without completely concealing my skin. The color blended in nicely and did not look cakey. I did have to apply concealer to a few blemishes, but I would feel just as comfortable only wearing this tinted face balm. I loved how my face was able to breathe and this product did not clog my pores. I feel like this product is very fairly priced for its better quality ingredients so I would purchase this product in the future.

author: Yadaris
headline: Beautiful healthy glow. My new favorite serum foundation
comment: I. received this product in exchange for my honest review. This serum has light coverage but buildable to medium without feeling heavy the skin. Skin look healthy and with a beautiful glow. Packaging is perfect to have in your makeup bag and messy proof. For the price is a great choice. Easy to apply with fingers and also with makeup's brush. The color match perfectly to my skin. Look nice after 8 hours without retouching. With the flash the photo look great. Definitely a beautiful foundation.

author: Caitlyn
headline: Sheer coverage to even out skintone
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm has such a unique texture. It feels very lightweight on the skin, more like a moisturizer. The coverage is quite sheer though. It is good for when I'm having good skin days and just need something to even me out, but not enough for when I need more coverage. Occasionally I get dry skin patches and it clings to those, so I feel like I have to exfoliate first. It seems a little finicky and like it needs perfect conditions, but looks nice when my skin looks nice if that makes sense.

author: Lisa
headline: Nice coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so creamy and lightweight.  Easy to use and nice coverage.  There wasn't any smell and I like that. It covered my dark spots on my cheeks and blended nice.  I like that it's lightweight too.

author: Lani
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends very well. Feels light and airy. Goes on smooth and absorbs well. Skin feels moisturized.  You can apply more to build coverage if needed.   Works well with fingers or brush application.

author: Casey
headline: Great
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this creamy tinted face balm. I've been looking for one to wear on days I don't want full makeup and 
this is perfect. The shade is a little dark for me at the moment but by summer when I have a tan it will be great!

author: Attaya
headline: It's easy to used and blend well as a base
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The balm was nice. It goes on smooth and easy to apply. I used my fingers to blend on the spot I need to covered. It goes from light cream to skin matching color. I think it helps with foundation blending. After awhile of used it, my face was a bit oily.

author: Christal
headline: Product is exactly what it says!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm is exactly what it says it is. It goes on my face so smooth and feels like a moisturizer to me. It provides full coverage and is also buildable. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because it's almost too moisturizing for me as I prefer a more matte finish.

author: Kristen
headline: Great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm is great. It's very light and gives a great buildable coverage. It applies easily and stays all day.

author: Tishy
headline: As a pale, red faced ghost, I HIGHLY recommend this.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm obsessed with this IT Cosmetics tinted face balm. It's truly magic in a bottle. As a pale ghost with a red face, I've tried every product to get that "I'm a human who doesnt haunt houses" look and this product delivers. A little goes a long way. I'm talking a pea-sized amount covers most my face. My wallets as obsessed as I am. But what really puts this product over the top are the results. Redness gone, without looking cakey. Hydration that lasts all day with no oily residue and soft skin once wiped away. Smoothing looking skin that had a natural-looking glow. This is currently my #1 face product, hands down! If you're a fellow pale ghost like me or just want amazing looking skin, try this yourself. Highly recommend.

author: Teresa
headline: Very impressed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow! I was presently surprised by how much I loved this. The coverage was amazing . I thought it wouldn't work for my oily skin but boy was I wrong. It looked amazing, and want heavy on the skin. Gave me a beautiful no makeup look. Sat on my skin beautifully. Loved it more than I was expecting game my skin a beautiful dewy finish.

author: Mindy
headline: The new staple in my makeup bag.
comment: [I received this product free in exchange for my honest review] I love this product! It's so light and creamy yet covers every little line and blemish! It's so easy to wear comfortably all day I didn't even remember that I put it on. The packaging is very simple and the size is great to throw in a small purse. This will be a staple in my makeup bag!

author: Merissa
headline: Love love love this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Applies to the skin perfectly. Very easy to remove if wanted but also lasts through the day. Packaging was secure and easy to come off. There was no scent to it. Very soft and natural tint. Makes skin look healthy and fresh.

author: Alexx
headline: IT works!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Just like every IT product I've ever tried, this face balm is absolute perfection! It's so light, non-greasy, hydrating, and looks so natural when applied. It's great for every day use, but it's also buildable in case you want to go full glam. It's such an interesting product because it's not quite a skincare product but it's also not quite a makeup product either. It's kind of…both, which I think is really cool. I will definitely be buying this again because it's so versatile and checks so many different boxes!

author: KIMBRE
headline: It does it all!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I applied the IT Cosmetics face balm to my skin with a damp sponge. It felt really light and silky and absorbed into the skin leaving a nice, semi-matte finish. It wasn't really scented, which I appreciate in a makeup. The one thing that bummed me out though, is that it wasn't full coverage.  It still covered the dark circles under my eyes and the dark spots from the sun, though. I also love that it contains skin care so I know every time I wear it it's working for my skin!! Unless you're looking for something that's super full coverage, I would recommend this! It's got everything in one, it literally does it all!

author: Ginny
headline: Fresh, clean summer look with a twist!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It cosmetics has made a winner here. If you're young and only need sheer coverage, it's great! If you're older like me with fine lines and pores, it's also great! It is only a sheer coverage, so don't expect a full coverage product. It went on really light. It felt oily to touch, but once on, it gives you this beautiful hydrating finish that gives a sheer coverage so it doesn't go into pores or wrinkles. Think of skin care with a twist of color to give you that fresh, hydrating look. It didn't fade or pill. You can always add more if you want more color. I'm 50 years old with dry skin. Wrinkles and fine lines. This hide it well without emphasizing them. I give it 5 stars all the way. Especially if you're going for a fresh, clean, esthetic look.

author: Brandy
headline: It does what it says it does :)
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I got this product and I honestly really like it so far. Granted it's not close to a full coverage product so if that's what you're looking for you may want to choose another product. However, if you're looking for a product that will hydrate your skin, create a nice matte finish and  provide the benefits it offers then you must give this a try. I'm glad I decided to and will be trying out their other products because I really like what they stand for.

author: Angel
headline: Beautiful skin, seamless to apply
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am blown away by IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! So glad I took before/after pictures to compare. A little goes a long way, I've never used a face balm with this texture so it was a little trial and error. It's so silky smooth and glides on with a brush (I used my fingers to help blend). My skin looks and feels so healthy with this feather light balm! I'm normally a "matte" girl, but I'm loving how natural this looks. Application is virtually mess free and coverage is buildable without any cakey-ness. I love that it's so good for skin, I can't wait to see long term effects. Perfect for throwing on some quick, healthy color, and something I feel good about wearing!I'm

author: NJ
headline: Smooth texture
comment: This balm blends beautifully into the skin and provides smooth, even coverage without feeling heavy. It does a great job of brightening under the eyes and covering imperfections while still looking natural. The texture is creamy and easy to work with, and it layers well without creasing or settling into fine lines. It lasts for hours and gives a fresh, polished finish. Definitely a reliable addition to any makeup routine.

author: Melissa
headline: Goes on smooth, blends easily, and sheer
comment: Sheer perfection! I received a free jar of It Do It All sheet tint face balm in exchange for an honest review and I am in love! It goes on smooth, sheer, and I love the smooth finish I get. It blends nicely. It's light weight and easy to apply and remove. I use it daily to help with my dark circles.

author: Sarah
headline: Good coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I find this face tint to be very good with coverage. It goes on like butter and feels very light on the face. It is easy to use and easy to remove. I applied it with a brush but I think a beauty blender might be better. It reminds me of Dream Mousse from back in the day with the container style. Overall, it is great.

author: Diana
headline: Nice smooth application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never tried any type of foundation before that's in a jar. This was a little new to me,  but so easy to use! I put it on with a brush. It was very easy and quick to put on. I love the coverage, it is buildable. The color matched me perfectly. The photos honestly don't do it justice, I feel like it looks better in person. This has become my regular foundation!

author: Brittany
headline: Feels like you're wearing nothing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product and will be purchasing. I'm constantly looking for a light everyday coverage that evens out redness but looks natural and feels like you're wearing nothing. This is that product! Normally it cosmetics colors don't work for me skin tone but this is sheer enough to blend perfectly. I used fair cool 125 and thought the shade was warmer and pulled more neutral.

author: April
headline: Great formula and nice blending
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I chose to try the IT Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Tint face balm in the Neutral color and I love it. It looks a little lighter on the hand when you're applying it but honestly blend right into your skin and wears so nicely not greasy or clumpy.. It leaves your skin looking smoothly. 
I like the soft texture of the product and how it does glide easily across your face to blend in smoothly. Great have balm that protects your skin as well.

author: Leslye
headline: Easy to Apply and Blend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Sheer Tint Face Balm, is lightweight, blends out beautifully. I love the idea that it's is 92% Skincare serum. It buttery soft when applying, giving me a beautiful even look. Highly recommend

author: Iga
headline: My go-to for weekday makeup!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm leaves a soft, radiant finish that looks just like my skin, but smoother and more even! It feels so lightweight and easy application, which I love for everyday wear when I want something quick and natural. I usually build it up slightly in areas where I want a bit more smoothing and coverage. My skin stays so nicely hydrated throughout the day and looks healthy and glowy. This has become my go-to for weekday makeup!

author: Jillian
headline: Creamy buildable face balm in a beautiful glass packaging!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT COSMETICS: DO IT ALL SHEER TINT FACE BALM 💕🙌🏻

I really loved this Face Balm! It's creamy and moisturizing, which I appreciate having mature and dry skin combo. 

The packaging is nice as it comes in a thick glass container that won't break easily if dropped, plus looks high end at a low-budget price! 

I enjoyed the fact that this product is buildable and as you can see from my final photo- it really did an excellent job covering up my redness! Especially for this just being a "balm" and not even a foundation! If you're looking for a quick, easy product in beautiful packaging- this one is for you! No weird or icky smells like some other makeup brands/products.

I would 100% repurchase this and am excited to use on our upcoming trip to Jamaica because of how light it feels on the skin.

author: Nikki
headline: I will absolutely be purchasing the IT Do It All Balm again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the IT - Do It All sheer tint face balm in the shade 120 fair warm, for almost 2 weeks and I love IT! I have very sensitive skin and it's given me no skin issue at all.  I love that it's sheer but also buildable.  It goes on smooth with a brush and has a dewy finish, not shiny and greasy looking.  I recommend this solid serum to everyone. It will be a permanent staple in my routine.

author: Joe
headline: Applies smoothly and evenly
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It gives your skin a healthy glow and goes on smooth. It's long lasting and doesn't break out my skin. The jar is nice and feels substantial to protect the product inside.

author: Amber
headline: A no makeup, makeup look!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love this product but unfortunately I was a shade off from my actual shade.
