So when I wore this it wore very well it gave my skin a hydrated, dewy finish. It felt like I was almost not wearing any makeup at all I would definitely wear this everyday. It stayed pretty good on my skin all day. Really good product!

author: Renee
headline: I would buy this product again and again
comment:
Very creamy, like wearing a moisturizer 
I love it ❤️ and I'm 55 my skin is always dry

author: Jazmin
headline: Light and Airy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was not expecting this product to look and feel like a lip balm when I opened it. It is a skin tint so don't expect full coverage but it covered light redness and lighter dark marks. It did not feel heavy on the skin and lasted for a full day, even on my oily skin. I did use my finger to apply and I felt like it blended the best that way. (I did receive this product free but the review is on my own.)

author: Emily
headline: truly buildable and natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've seen very mixed reviews of this tint balm, and I think it ultimately comes down to the finish you're aiming for. I have dry, over 50 skin with fairly even tone and texture and very small pores. I like a natural finish, and something that is moisturizing. With a serum base and buildable coverage, I can build up areas that need more concealer and lightly brush over others. The makeup trend toward products with "skincare ingredients" is overplayed, IMO, and honestly makeup with ingredients that are healthy for the skin are simply my standard, although I'm unconvinced that the quantity of these ingredients are enough to really promote long-term skin improvements like firming or a reduction in the appearance of fine lines. I did, however, find that the formula doesn't settle into my lines and make them more pronounced. Because I received this for review, I didn't receive the shade I might have chosen, but the sheerness lets my skin stay natural-looking. I haven't experienced any oily residue even after a day of wear, and haven't had any breakouts.

author: LaToya
headline: Great product!  Good coverage with no weight
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really like this Do It All Sheer Face Balm. It gives me great coverage, without any weight. Initially it looked a little dark, but it blends with my skin tone nicely. It feels like wearing no makeup, and makes my skin look fresh and even. I can use this with a puff or a brush. It blends beautifully.

author: Terry
headline: Nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've used IT Cosmetics for years, although I had never used this particular product. This is a trusted brand that produces quality products. The coverage was very sheer, which was a little too sheer for my personal needs. The color was a good match. I have oily skin, and I did notice it wore off rather quickly. Overall, a nice product.

author: Shelly
headline: Absolutely love
comment: This is so great especially on 65 year old skin

author: J
headline: Unhealthy ingredients
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to like this, but my main concern is the ingredients and they market it is free from unclean ingredients but it contains silicone (not medical grade), phenoxyethanol, ethylhexlglycerin, and aluminum hydroxide. It does not cover so much as it's a sheer color like tint so although it feels pleasant applying, I would not recommend using this product because of the ingredients.

author: Justine
headline: Comfy on the skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love the texture of this balm, it's super soft and lightweight. It glides onto the skin so easily and feels like im wearing nothing. The coverage is buildable which I love in a product. The color isn't a perfect match for my skin tone but i think it'll be great for summer. It comes in a cute glass pot too!

author: Mayra
headline: Product is great
comment: This product is easily appliable and highly recomended for a light serum base foundation.feels really smooth and was easy to put on only takes u like 1 minute to apply  to the whole face i highly recomend getting this product for beginners who are looking for light base

author: Melissa
headline: Wouldn't buy this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I gave this a 3 star review because it went on really cakey, but i also have really dry skin so not sure if that is why.  I also clearly picked the wrong color for my skin.

author: Dana
headline: I really like this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product. It comes in a glass pot container which makes it easier to apply with a brush. It gives a light to medium coverage. In my photo, the swatch nearest my hand was done with my finger and not blended in. The one below it was applied with a brush and blended into my skin. It definitely works better applying it with a brush. I find that it feels very light on my skin. It has a very creamy texture which works good on my dry skin. My only negative is that it doesn't have sunscreen in it according to the label.

author: Gaby
headline: Light weight with coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really really love this product. I love makeup but am picky about foundations because I don't want anything I wear all over my face to feel heavy. This was SO light weight but still manages to even out my skin tone. There were a few areas with darker scarring that I needed to use cover up as well but this was perfect for an everyday type of makeup. The fact that it was also skin care was the cherry on top. The color I got was darker than my current skin tone but I think it'll be perfect in the summer. Overall love this product and will be purchasing the correct skin match to use now

author: Jane
headline: Love this formula
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I was familiar with It Cosmetics' CC creams and liked them, but this is the first time I'd heard of their tint face balm. I love it! The texture is smooth, doesn't cling to dry patches and provides enough coverage to even things out. The best part is that it still looks like skin and isn't cakey. I like to use a squishy makeup sponge to pat it on, and it lets me build coverage in certain areas if needed. It isn't super long wearing, but because it's emollient and balmy, it can be touched up without it looking bad. I would definitely repurchase this. It looks a little too dark on my arm swatch, but it matches my face perfectly. I think the fact that it's a little sheer helps, so this is a pretty forgiving formula.

author: Deep
headline: Glowy Skin in a Balm – Makeup That Feels Like Skincare
comment:
I've been using the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm (92% skincare serum), and I'm honestly impressed with how lightweight and skin-loving it feels.

First, the texture is beautiful — it melts into the skin like a balm but blends out into a sheer, natural tint. It doesn't feel heavy, cakey, or greasy. Instead, it gives a soft, healthy glow that makes your skin look like your skin, but better. Perfect for everyday wear when you don't want full foundation.

What I love most is how comfortable it feels throughout the day. My skin doesn't feel dry or tight, and it doesn't settle into fine lines. It gives a hydrated, smooth finish without emphasizing texture. The coverage is light, so it evens out redness and minor imperfections while still looking very natural.

This is ideal if you prefer minimal makeup and want something that bridges skincare and makeup. If you're expecting full coverage, this isn't it — but for a fresh, dewy, effortless look, it's a win.

Overall: great for no-makeup makeup days, quick routines, and skin-first beauty lovers.

author: Edna
headline: Hydrated skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a lightweight foundation. My skin looks better, more hydrated and smooth.
It's easy to apply and blend, making it easy to use. It has a small package that fits into my purse.

author: Tiiii
headline: Fab
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the coverage that it gives but does not feel like a heavy foundation. I can wear it both during winter and summer months. It is easy to remove too.

author: Sam
headline: Nice Formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure what to expect from this product but it's been a pleasant surprise! The formula is creamy and the shade match is pretty close. I have a bit of rosacea on my face and it covers it nicely

author: Katherine
headline: Not the right shade
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review This was the wrong shade, the product was very easy to apply, i believe that it will be useful maybe for a light contouring but definitely not a color i could use all over, feels very hydrating and because of the formula lasts a good amount of time

author: Violet
headline: Nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a new level of skincare/foundation. It's so convenient and it's perfect for busy moms like me. And the ones who don't want to spend too much time putting skincare then makeup on. It's all in one. The shade i got is little darker than my skin tone. But because it's 92% skincare serum, so I'm still happy with it.

author: Michaela
headline: Surprisingly good coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the IT Cosmetics CC cream so I was excited to try this tint face balm. I would not use it as a replacement for my regular skincare but more looking at it as a bonus that will take care of my skin throughout the day instead of only covering it with a makeup. I applied the balm with the IT Cosmetics makeup brush and I was impressed that the coverage was actually that good. I expected "sheer" and got light-medium (see for yourself on my photo where I applied the balm only on half of my face). What's even more impressive is how long it lasted if I applied a powder and a setting spray. For a daily wear this is absolutely perfect. I have combination/oily skin and it works for me well in the winter but I am a little worried it might make my skin a little too oily in the summer.

author: Janet
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I really did like this skin tint. It's not very heavy or full coverage , but it gives just enough to my skin to even out the tone and texture. There are days when I'm just running a quick errand and want a little something to even my skin tone without putting on a full face of makeup. The texture is very nice and smooth and easy to apply. I love that it comes in a small pot so that you can use every last bit of the product. Ive used similar products that come in tubes and bottles that are very hard to get everything out. The one thing that I feel is lacking is that there is no s p f in it.. Other than that , it's a product i'm really enjoying using

author: Tori
headline: Nice product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't able to get a picture of this swatched after I opened it, it made me really itchy and I didn't want to risk it! I usually never have skin sensitivity. It did go on nicely, but I wasn't able to get a feel of how well it would stay on since I took it off immediately once I got itchy. Seems like it blended well!

author: Kelley
headline: Enhanced natural balanced look!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint is ninety two percent serum, very light and doesn't cake at all, I applied it with my fingers. It gives minimal coverage and leaves your skin with a dewy glow! This is perfect for a more natural, no makeup look- it blurs minimal imperfections and gives your face a more perfect balanced look. Very hydrating and will get you thru an average eight hour work shift! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Jan0769
headline: I'm in love!!
comment: Dry, mature skin with some fine lines. I've tried almost every sheer tint foundation or balm or tint out there, and they either don't even come close to matching my fair cool skin or just dry me out. This one is perfect!! I picked out Fair Cool and when I out some on my skin, it's almost non detectable. It looks dark in the pot but is truly fair on the skin. Softly apply using my fingers, even on my lids and undereyes. It just evens everything out and leaves a gorgeous finish. The best part? It doesnt oxidize and my skin still looks great at the end of the day. I purchsed this with my own money and highly recommend.

author: Kk
headline: Natural look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a lightweight tinted balm that feels smooth and hydrating on the skin. It gives sheer, natural coverage that makes your skin look more even and fresh. The balm melts easily when you apply it and blends well with fingers or a brush.
It has a radiant finish, so it leaves the skin looking healthy and slightly glowy. It works especially well for dry or normal skin. If you have oily skin, you may need a little powder to reduce shine.
Overall, it's a good choice if you want light coverage and a natural "nude" look instead of a heavy foundation.

author: Julie
headline: Amazing product for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is amazing! It gives your skin the most beautiful coverage, but still leaves you looking glowy and healthy. A small amount goes a long way!

author: Jacqueline
headline: Blends beautifully
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The color is a tad dark on my hand but it matches my face better! It blends like a dream with a beauty blender and stays put all day. I love the spf in it too!

author: Kennetra
headline: Beaut!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great everyday complexion balm for people who want their skin to look fresh and even without heavy makeup. If you love lightweight, effortless products,it's a winner. If you prefer full coverage or long wear, you may want something more traditional. Leaves a nice fresh finish and it comes of easily.

author: Kriorska
headline: Finally! A mature skin savior!!
comment: This balm foundation is worth every penny. At nearly 60 years old, I have wrinkles, fine lines, and crepey areas that no other foundation has been able to blur or smooth. This one really does it all. It blends, covers, and wears beautifully! Bravo!

author: Lauren
headline: Pretty gel texture, light coverage, hydrating
comment:
I was gifted this product for my honest review. This product has a beautiful gel like texture and it feels light on the skin. I think you can see from the photo this is not much coverage , kind of like a skin tint. I think it has a pretty texture and tones down my redness though. I tend to range from fair to light and right now I'm more fair and this is a little dark for me so I'd say true to color on depth but it's a little warm for a neutral shade (Light Neutral). What I love about it is it blends quickly, doesn't look dry on my dry skin, and I can reapply it over makeup without removing anything and it looks good. All of that is a bit of a miracle because everything looks dry on my winter skin right now. I do think my skin looks better after removal which is probably the extra hydration. I've worn it every day for a few weeks which says a lot with my large makeup collection. I find it looks good through my work day but I'd have to reapply after that, which is good for a skin tint texture.
It is a bit messy in the jar, so if that bothers you skip it. I'd skip it for oily skin for sure. I'll definitely buy this when I run out, but color match in person to see if I can find something more neutral.

author: Mahima
headline: Perfect for light coverage
comment:
I have honestly never seen a tint balm that works like skincare too. When I first read "balm," I thought it would feel oily or heavy, but it's actually very lightweight and comfortable. My combination skin feels fresh and breathable after applying it. It covers my pigmentation and redness really well while still looking natural. My dry patches stay hydrated all day, and it layers nicely under sunscreen or powder.
It's so creamy — I used my fingers to apply it, and it glided perfectly on my skin. It blends effortlessly without any patchiness and feels super smooth while applying. It's not full coverage, so if I need extra coverage on spots, I either use concealer or dab on a little more product. Overall, it gives a fresh, healthy glow that makes me feel put together without makeup. I think it's perfect for no-makeup days or when I want a soft, natural look.

author: Christine
headline: Spot on natch for color, love the serum base, easy to apply/
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I actually really liked this product.  The color was a spot on match for my sk8n tone, and the serum in the balm left my face feeling like I wasn't wearing anything.  I used it both on it's own, as a basic way to even out my skin tone, and under my powder foundation.  Removing the foundation was the regular routine, but on it's own, I was able to just sweep it away with my regular (non-makeup removing cleanser) and it didn't leave any bumps or dry skin.  If you're looking for a light coverage product to even out your skin, this is the one for you.

author: Stacey
headline: Sheer blending
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy a good coverage for my face. I love that it doesnt feel caked on your face and really is a sheer coverage. It blends well and doesn't give a darker complexion to me. I don't notice this having an all day lasting balm. The more I use this and get used to it, I'm sure i will love it even more.

author: Stacey
headline: An IT concealer I can use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never found an IT concealer I can use with my older skin type.  They usually falls into the wrinkles and always creases. But this is a game changer. It glides right on providing sheer to light coverage that really lasts until you take it off.  A little goes a really long way.  It matched my skin tone quite well and worked well on my dark circles under my eyes. It's very moisturizing and does not have any strong scents.

author: Katniss
headline: Not my shade
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade I received from IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm was definitely not my shade. My daughter decided to try it on and it's perfect for her skin tone. 

The product is easy to apply with your fingers, but needs more than one swipe to coat evenly.

author: Anna
headline: Too sheer
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'll start with this: I don't like sheer tinted foundations  or similar products. I honestly don't see the point, but clearly they exist because some people enjoy them. It's just not for me.
If I want a slight tint, I'd rather use a self-tanning drops for my face. This balm doesn't smooth the skin at all, it only gives a hint of color, and that's it. The texture is nice, I'll give it that. But the coverage is basically zero. 
Also, the shade I received (215), was too warm for me, but because it's so sheer it was easy to spread it across my face without looking overly orange.

author: Michelle
headline: Not for Oily Skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It feels nice on the skin. I don't recommend applying with a makeup sponge. I prefer to apply using a brush for a more even application. I have combination skin that leans more oily. This product looks super dewy, which will probably be nice for people with normal or dry skin. It made my skin look shinier as the day wore on. I tried applying some powder to cut the shine, but that didn't last long. I wish this product had spf. This one is a pass for me.

author: Xochi
headline: Your skin but better!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have to say I was skeptical about this, with the term balm in it I expected a greasy product with no lasting power but I was wrong! Absorbs nicely into the skin, hydrating without the oily feeling. The shade was almost a perfect match and the coverage was buildable even with my dark spots and acne scars. It lasted longer than I thought and didn't settle into fine lines and wrinkles and at the end of the day it looked beautiful!

author: Iryna
headline: Lightweight and perfect for everyday wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this balm for about a week now and I really like it. It feels lightweight but still gives enough coverage to even out my skin and make it look fresh. It blends easily and doesn't feel heavy or cakey. I prefer applying it with a brush because it looks smoother and more natural. It gives a soft glow without looking shiny and is perfect for everyday wear.

author: Alice
headline: Super natural finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Super natural finish, as if not wearing makeup. Coverage is low, but does make your skin look better. I would say use this on a normal working day. Add concealer if going out on a date!

author: Amy
headline: Not bad
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not quite a match for my skin tone but that's hard to guess online. I like the formula, it goes on really smoothly and gives light coverage all day. If you have oilier skin you might need some setting powder on top, though.

author: Lindsay
headline: Obsessed!
comment: This balm really is magic! I love the lightweight coverage, but it covers and smooths over the skin so well! It leaves your skin covered and also not weighed down or cakey. Such a great hydrating finish, as well. Love it!

author: BFF
headline: LOVEEE
comment: I have finally met my bff in foundation! I wanted light coverage for a more natural look… its buildable too tho! I have dry skin, some blemishes, freckles… I am 35 years old, so I want to look refreshed/healthy/alive! I can't recommend this enough! Love her! Nee bff!

author: Colleen
headline: Excellent product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is amazing. I thought it was going to be a tad too dark but once blended it looked great. It is a more sheer coverage than the original but is definitely build able so the works out great. I tend to mostly use tinted moisturizers, bb's and cc creams exclusively. The spf protection is so important and as o have gotten older I realized less is more. There is not really a scent to it which is fine. The jar packaging is not necessary my favorite but it is practical for the kind of product, it would not be the same if it came out of a tube, it is more of a balm type consistency. Overall it is great, goes on nice holds up well over the day and can be washed off with my regular facial cleanser.

author: Puddles
headline: I think I'm in the minority
comment: This is so iver hyped and i bought into it.  Uts really just tinted moisturizer.  Its so sheer and there's no coverage.

author: Rkuhn
headline: Better in tube
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this smoothing , hydrating face balm. I do wish it came in a tube instead. It matches my skin color perfectly and has a pleasant smell. It provides the most perfect tint

author: Brandi
headline: I love this buildable product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This share tint bam from IT cosmetics has a very light texture. That is very smooth going on. It has a buildable formula where you can add a little or add more. The color that I have was a perfect match for my skin. I love this product, especially on days where I don't want to take a lot of time with my makeup. It's a great addition to my morning routine. I have sent sensitivity so I did not notice an overwhelming fragrance from the product. Which is always a plus in my book.

author: Isabel
headline: Very light weight!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is exactly as it says, sheer. When you apply it, it feels like you have nothing on. It's a good size to take with you anywhere. It gives good coverage but not full coverage.

author: Mandi
headline: Lovely, subtle coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't typically wear foundation, usually I prefer a tinted moisturizer or BB cream, so I was very excited to give this a try. It did not disappoint! I really enjoyed the lightweight feel and sheer (but buildable) coverage. The slight dewy glow was just an added bonus. I do wish it was more of a squeeze/pump application vs the potted balm just from an ease of application standpoint, but thats the most minimal of issues. I will most definitely be hitting pan on this one, and likely repurchase as well.

author: Sandy
headline: Sheer Beautiful Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Fave Balm. What really makes me feel good about using it is that it's 92% skincare serum, so I don't feel like I'm just putting makeup on, it actually feels like I'm doing something beneficial for my skin.

The coverage is perfectly sheer, which is exactly what I prefer. I'm not a fan of heavy makeup, and this gives me just enough to even out my skin while still looking natural and not cakey. My skin looks glowy, fresh, and healthy. 

It doesn't cause any dryness at all. My skin feels hydrated. I apply it with a foundation brush, and it blends beautifully and evenly.

author: Kellie
headline: Great tinted moisturizer
comment: Great serum like tinted moisturizer that kept me moisturized and lasted for hours. Easy to apply and remove.

author: Kellie
headline: Provides good coverage!
comment: I really like this product obviously for the coverage but also how velvety it feels and light. It also gives just enough coverage without looking too caked on and doesn't clog pores. Do wish it had a better scent but it's not bad.

author: Kristen
headline: Lovely Natural Base
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a huge fan of skincare, so having it joined with my makeup is a match made in heaven in my opinion. This balm is a lightweight, skincare forward base perfect for those who want their skin to be the feature of their look. This balm offers lightweight coverage perfect for a no makeup makeup look or clean aesthetic. I was surprised by how much I loved the cooling sensation when applying it. It isn't intense and immediately dissipates, but it feels refreshing as you apply. I cannot wait to use this in the summer. 

Because the coverage is so light, the shades are quite flexible. The shade I use is a little too warm for me right now but during the summer it'll be perfect. Despite the slight mismatch during the winter, because it's so sheer I can still make it work with some contour and blush. 

Because this is so soft, it doesn't have a ton of staying power. It'll last through the day with a primer and setting spray, but for longer than about 8 - 9 hours you will have to reapply. It's not a long wear base, but for a natural look, it's great. 

If you like clean, skin that looks like skin bases, I would highly recommend this balm. It feels lovely, looks natural and is quite unique. I'm a big fan.

author: Michelle
headline: I would buy again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Tint Face Balm is giving me that fresh, hydrated, "I woke up like this" finish with zero effort. It evens, softens, and brightens without ever looking like makeup — just healthy, rested skin in a tube.  Using my primer this light weight tint stays on for at least eight hours.  It has a slight fragrance but not overpowering.  It spreads very easy and blends quite efficiently!

author: Beth
headline: Great Product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this for a no makeup look.  It feels so nice and hydrating.  It blends into my skin well and hides any redness I have.   I have been using on foundation free days.

author: Andrea
headline: Definitely not worth the money
comment: I would like to return this product. First of all, I do not see a, "buildable coverage." Second of all, there is no SPF. Third of all, For buildable coverage, I would need to use the whole jar. I've never been this disappointed in this company's products.

author: Ilene
headline: I highly recommend this foundation/face balm!!

author: Elizabeth
headline: Cool Shades Have Yellow Undertones
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] (I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.)

As I have gotten older I have switched to a more minimal makeup look. As such, I have spent the last few years trying to find the best sheer foundation. I have tried over a dozen, and this is for sure in my top five. I am super picky with products, and I was pleasantly surprised with this one.

I received this in the shade "Fair Cool 125". It comes in a nice glass container with a twist off lid.

The coverage is sheer but buildable. One layer gives skin a radiant glow but no coverage. Two layers starts to be more noticeable and tame redness. Three layers evens skin tone on a similar level to a medium coverage foundation. I don't recommend more than 3 layers because then it starts to look cakey.

The texture of this is unique. It almost seems whipped, but it is slightly more stiff and has a break when you dip into it. It feels cold when applying, almost gel-like. It is a somewhat odd sensation that makes my face feel wet, but it would be refreshing in hot weather. It is creamy but slightly oily once applied to skin, and blends in easily. It washes off easily with a gentle cleanser.

It has no added fragrance, and no natural scent either. It smells like nothing.

I have combination skin with occasional oily and  dry patches, and this didn't highlight the dryness. It is slightly oily and doesn't completely dry down, so it leaves skin somewhat tacky. I prefer to set it with powder or setting spray for this reason. 

I have tried this on bare skin, with primer, with and without setting g products, and every combination thereof. It stays on for 8+ hours used alone, no primers or setting sprays necessary. However, because it doesn't fully dry down, it can rub off, so I recommend setting it for extra assurance.

I tried applying this various ways, and found it blended the best with a dense brush. I lightly dip the brush directly into the pot, then blend into skin using small circular motions. 

My biggest complaint with this is the shade range. The FC 125 "cool" shade I received is not cool. It has an obvious yellow undertone that intensifies as it dries. I have very cool toned skin with pink undertones. When I apply one layer of product it isn't too noticeable, but 2 or more layers you can really see the yellow come through.

I used this for several weeks and did not see any improvements in my skin, so I am skeptical of the skincare claims. 

I would recommend this to anyone with neutral to warm skin tone who is looking for a light coverage tint. It gives a healthy glow, and is an excellent product overall. I would continue to purchase this product if the cool tones were true.

headline: your skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face tint balm is perfect for those who prefer very little coverage and want a skin-like finish! This balm essentially gives you a more polished version of your own skin and who wouldn't want that?

I personally prefer a bit more coverage and found that there's no real way to build up coverage with this. I also don't love the little jar packaging, strictly for hygienic reasons, since aesthetically is does look nice and it feels heavy, so I wouldn't worry about dropping it and it breaking.

I think this product would be great for those with mature and/or dry skin, and of course those who don't want to look like they're wearing makeup. I can see myself wearing this on travel days, to the gym/pilates and on days where I'm running around doing errands.

I can't see myself buying this in the future, as my the skin tint I typically wear can be built up to provide almost medium coverage and I like my foundation products to have some versatility.

author: Maica
headline: Lightweight base and hydrating cream in 1!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is a fantastic choice if you want a beautiful easy to wear base that feels more like skin care than heavy make up. It has a natural radiant finish that gives skin a youthful sheen without shimmer or greasy shine, perfect for everyday wear of minimalist look. Bery hydrating with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E that keeps skin feeling plum and comfortable all day. This is my favorite buildable hydrating base now. It is also very easy to apply, it blends smoothly with fingertips or brush and rarely cakes.

author: Nikita
headline: Natural finish!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm felt amazing on my face. It felt both hydrated and moisturized. My face had a flawless natural look. This balm did not look cakey on my skin. It was easy to use and it performed as promised. This face balm lasted throughout the day and I received tons of compliments.

author: Nikita
headline: Natural finish!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm felt amazing on my face. It felt both hydrated and moisturized. My face had a flawless natural look. This balm did not look cakey on my skin. It was easy to use and it performed as promised. This face balm lasted throughout the day and I received tons of compliments.

author: Kiran
headline: Overall, a good foundation
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using IT Cosmetics CC+ cream in Medium Tan for few years and I love it. So I got this face balm in the same shade. And I used it with and without serum and moisturizer. 
1. For the face balm, I will get one or two shades lighter because this was not like the liquid cream shade I used. It feels that this formula gets oxidized very fast.
2. I've combination skin, it blends easily on the parts that are oily. But for the dry part like forehead, you need to use a moisturizer in addition. It will not work for dry skin.
3. It lasted 2-3 hours for me, then I had to reapply. Provides medium coverage.
Overall, a good foundation but I would prefer the liquid formula.

author: Sabrina
headline: New staple!
comment: I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It gives the prettiest natural glow while evening out my skin tone without feeling heavy or cakey. The texture is creamy and melts into the skin like skincare, leaving a smooth, hydrated finish that still looks like real skin. Since I've gotten this product, as you can see in the photo, I've used it every single day. Definitely a great staple in my routine.

author: Katana Miami
headline: Soft Tint, Buildable Glow
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been really enjoying the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from IT Cosmetics. The application was smooth and effortless — it blended evenly across my skin and left a flattering hint of tint while still feeling lightweight and breathable.

What stood out most was the buildability. Even though it's labeled sheer, you can easily layer it to customize your coverage without it looking heavy or cakey. I was able to build it up to get the finish I wanted, and it still looked natural.

It also held up well throughout the day — long-lasting without leaving residue or feeling greasy. Overall, it's a great option if you want something flexible, comfortable, and easy to work into your routine.

author: Meg
headline: Don't judge a balm by it's color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have to be honest, when I received this sheer face balm, I was actually concerned about the darkness of the product, considering I got a tint for fair skin. But the moment I applied it on my face, I actually wished it was darker! The tint is so mild and so natural looking, sometimes I'm not sure if there's actually a tint. I am truly pale, so you'd think it would be more noticeable. With that said, the balm really is smoothing on the face and I love the way it feels. I do find in order to truly see the tint, I need to layer it on a bit, but then it starts to sit in my creases and it ain't cute. So I'm trying to find a happy medium. All in all the product is nice, the packaging is nice, I will keep on using it.

author: Felicitas
headline: Sheer Face Cream
comment: Definitely gives your skin a wonderful glow! The sheer is beautiful and the product is not heavy on your skin. Gives a great shine to your face as well.

author: Amanda
headline: One of the best sheer tinted face balms
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great sheer tint face balm.  It's soft and  creamy, very light weight and has a great light coverage. The color is a good match for my skin tone.

author: Allison
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I won't lie..I was nervous of the color but very surprised by the way it blended. The color I received was darker than expected for me in the winter but I think it will be perfect for summertime tint. It goes on smooth and blends well. Lightweight and no gross smell. I can't wait to try when I'm a bit tanner.

author: Dung
headline: Matte finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am pleasantly surprised at how much I enjoy using this sheer tint balm. It is very light and goes on very smooth. I like that when I use this it just looks natural but if I wanted more coverage I just add on more. Another great thing is this doesn't leave a tacky residue and it's a matte finish. So far so good on my sensitive skin.

author: Jennifer
headline: Good coverage, falls into fine lines
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While this provided pretty good coverage for being a sheet tint face balm the formula is a little too thick. I applied with a brush, a little goes a long way with this stuff. After application I found it getting caked up in my fine lines and cracking in my eye crease. It is lightweight and may work better in the summer weather when my skin tends to be less dry.

author: Ashley
headline: Surprised in a good way
comment: I like this serum and was actually surprised how well the color blended with my skin. I gave it four and not five stars because I have dry skin an my 11s were a little flaky later in the day. Add that it was also winter.

author: Leslie
headline: Sheer and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Perfect match in shade. I can barely tell I'm wearing the face balm. Sheer tint is accurate.  It's light weight and blends in perfectly. I'm wearing Rich Deep Neutral. The texture is soft, and a little goes a long way!

author: Brit
headline: Superpowers in a Balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have loved using this balm! It sort of melts a you rub the pot & is easy to apply! It isn't messy or greasy like i anticipated.  It has great coverage and is buildable. Blends well and looks great! It covers any spots, pigmentation,pores and lines & makes my skin look pretty flawless!

author: DeLayna
headline: Everyday holy grail
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. It's an incredible everyday product that gives a beautiful natural look. I have redness that this product effectively covered. It's long-wearing without any patchiness and very buildable. The texture is smooth and scent-free, making it suitable for sensitive skin. I'll definitely be repurchasing!

author: Victoria
headline: Good product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 92% Skincare Serum by IT Cosmetics** in the shade Light Warm 215 
It's a lightweight tint with 92% skincare serum, so it feels super hydrating and gives a natural "your skin but better" finish.
Coverage is light to medium — perfect for everyday wear. Personally, I prefer fuller coverage and longer wear, and this one doesn't last all day on me.
If you're looking for something fresh, comfy, and natural, this is a great option

author: Alisa
headline: Moisture and decent coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a really good product overall. In the photo, you can see how it evens my skin tone and covers redness (only used on one side of my face to see the difference). This was a perfect winter product due to its moisturizing quality and the shade match was on the lighter side for me. The texture is nice but i didn't find it too buildable given the emollient quality. A setting powder was essential for me but I also have slightly oily skin especially in the T zone. As such it wasn't as long wear as I would've liked but was good for a workday. Felt good, not heavy, and no significant scent which I prefer.

author: Morgan
headline: Clean Girl
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been a longtime fan of IT Cosmetics and have used their CC+ foundations on and off over the years. I like the coverage but the original CC+ formula can feel a bit heavy depending on the look I'm going for. Do It All Face Balm is a completely different experience. It feels more like skincare than traditional foundation or CC creams and it blended beautifully on my skin, giving me more of a clean girl look. 

The product is buildable with a subtle glowy finish. When it first arrived, I was worried that I'd ordered the wrong shade because it looked so dark in the container. The color lightened quite a bit as I blended it and was closer to my natural skin color.

author: Ashley
headline: Lightweight, and skin loving!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cometics is so good! Here you see me applying shade 110- Fairest Neutral. 
This is great for low key days when you don't want a full face, but it also layers so well under my makeup!
It's light weight, and sheer. It leaves my skin feeling supple with 92 percent serum! 
It's worth mentioning that I have sensitive skin, and this hasn't burned, or bothered my skin in the least for the several days I've been testing it. I think it's definitely worth a try!

author: Crystal
headline: Love it!
comment:
I absolutely love how this looked on me. It was super smooth when putting on and definitely easy to use. It did not feel greasy at all.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Jessica
headline: Flawless!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is amazing! A little bit goes a long way and it isn't cakey or heavy on my skin at all! I love how flawless it makes my skin look - I will be purchasing more for sure

author: MMtrynew
headline: Natural finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
This tint face balm has a creamy and lightweight texture. It is easy to blend in. It is scent free. It provides light coverage and evens my skin tones. The shade for this one is light neutral 210. The finish looks natural. I like that it has a lot of skincare serum which makes my face look better. But it does oxidize a bit after a few hours.

author: Amie
headline: Nice, natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm is easy to apply and provides nice, even coverage. I use a primer then apply with a kabuki brush, then complete with a setting powder. I like the nice, natural look it gives. The balm evens out my skin tone nicely. With the setting powder, the look stays all day. I'm very impressed with this product and have made it part of my daily routine. Will definitely purchase in the future.

author: Jessi
headline: Glow on girl
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow. I remember when we wanted our skin so matte. As an oily girl I've now loved that glow skin is in and this balm is perfect. It glides on effortless and makes my skin radiant and hydrated. It does oxidize just the tiniest bit so I need it just a hair lighter but over all I love it!

author: Larissa
headline: A great minimalist product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] (I selected a shade that's a little bit too dark for me in the winter (now), but it will a good match in the summer.) I love how easily this product applies and how it still covers spots without looking like a whole fake layer of skin. It applies just enough tint to even things out. It also holds up really well. When you go to take some product from the jar, it almost just like melts into a liquid, but is solid enough prior that it wouldn't be messy for travel, I think.

author: Amber
headline: Lightweight and buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The do it all tint face balm is really creamy and light. It blends into the skin smoothly and offers a sheer coverage that covered most of my redness with just one layer. The lightweight formula was really comfortable to wear on the skin all day and never felt dry or cakey. I'm impressed!

author: Erica
headline: Perfect product for my not as young as it once was skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was my first experiencing using a face balm and I loved it. The consistency reminded me of a putty primer but a tad thinner. I was able to apply my preferred amount and blend it perfectly. I do like my make up to be minimal so this was the perfect product for that. After applying it with a brush I was able to put my normal foundation powder on top and achieved a very smooth hydrated look. My skin also appeared so much better and brighter. Since I used a small amount I had no problems with the wear, it stayed put all day. I turned 40 this year so keeping my skin looking its best with products made for it is important to me. This product definitely met the mark for that!!

author: Kathy
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When they say sheer they meant it. This is so sheer it blends perfectly with my skin tone. You cant even see that it's on. This is amazing. You cant even feel like you have anything on.

author: Anna
headline: If only it didn't smell
comment: I want to give this 5 stars, but it does have a strong odor. That being said, it is delightful! You can build it or use it sheer. I really like the texture and the skin care ingredients.  But the smell.

author: CB
headline: Meh
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't feel like I got any coverage with this product. It like disappeared after applying. It seemed oily and almost sticky. Packaging is fine, with a modern design and is easy to open. It did seem light on my face. Maybe I need to try again but didn't seem to blend great for me.

author: Victoria
headline: Lightweight and Buildable
comment:
I've been using the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Medium Neutral, and I'm really impressed. It goes on super smooth and blends easily into the skin. It gives light, buildable coverage that evens everything out without looking heavy or cakey.

What I love most is how lightweight it feels. Some cream products can feel thick or sit on top of the skin, but this one doesn't at all. My skin actually feels moisturized and comfortable throughout the day.

It's packed with collagen peptides, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E, so it feels like skincare and makeup in one. The Medium Neutral shade works really well with my skin tone and looks very natural.

There's no scent (which I appreciate), and I love the little glass container it comes in — it feels clean and elevated.

It leaves my skin looking fresh, healthy, and glowy. I would definitely purchase this again!

author: Amanda
headline: Would buy in a better suited color
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately the color was a little but off for me, but the formula itself is *chefs kiss*. It's creamy, smooth and glides on. Important, too, it absorbs well and feels very nice on your skin. I will definitely be grabbing this in a color more suited for me.

author: Daisy
headline: New Favorite!
comment: I purchased two colors because I was unsure which one would suit me best.  I am 62 with light to medium complexion-Rosy undertones. This balm feels wonderful on the skin, imperfect skin as well.  I have some larger pores and a bit of redness on my cheeks.  This will cover sunspots with a few applications. Makeup is about adding beauty, not covering it up like a mask.  This product is amazing and you shouldn't heasitate to try.  I am hoping it keeps its promises in the future - it feels like skin care!

author: Alyson
headline: Nice, sheer coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really liked this tinted face balm.  It is sheer, but just enough coverage to even out my skin tone and it's nice and hydrating, not at all cakey. 
I haven't been using it long enough to notice any sort of skin care results yet, but am curious to see if it will provide anything noticeable. 
I would typically try to find a product with an SPF included, so this is my only complaint- if it's going to have skincare included, I'd love to have SPF, as well, so it's all in one!

author: Danielle
headline: Sheer but sleek coverage
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
I recently received this product in exchange for my honest review, and I'm pleasantly surprised by how well it worked for me. I wasn't sure which tint would suit me best, but the one I received turned out to be perfect for my fair complexion, which has a mix of red and yellow undertones. 

In the image I provided, I applied the product only to the right side of my face (left side in the photo) to show the difference. The tint balm blends smoothly and balances my skin tones beautifully. It's so sheer that it feels like I'm not wearing anything at all, which I love. 

The only downside is that it leaves a slightly greasy residue when first applied, but it washes off easily with makeup remover. Overall, I would recommend this product and plan to purchase it in the future!

author: Bern
headline: In love!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow, this is absolutely my new favorite now! The balm is not sticky at all but very lightweight, melts on contact plus application is very smooth, it leaves a radiant finish and delivers a beautiful sheer coverage that is not greasy and cakey.

author: Desiree
headline: I love this balm! It does do it all!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Creamiest skin tint I have tried! Having dry skin can be so frustrating when it comes to complexion products because I usually end up looking dryer due to the patchiness. This balm is super blend able, light weight and the sheer coverage gives me the ability to build up more if I'm looking for a heavier layer. I'm loving that this balm can multitask and is infused with skincare. I need all the help I can get hahaha. 
I didn't notice any scent and removed easy! 
The color match was was pretty incredible on my cool peach complexion. 
If you're looking for a Do It All kind of product this is affordable and I definitely recommend for those with dry skin.

author: Stephanie
headline: Love this tint balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love using it do it all sheer tint face balm! I got the shade fair warm and it matches well with my skin tone. The texture is a creamy balm. I like using my finger or a beauty blender to blend it in. I also like putting it underneath my eyes since I have dark circles a lot & this seems to help cover it for the most part so it looks so much better. This sheer tint balm helps give my face a dewy/shiny, moisturizing/hydrated look. I like that it seems to lasts throughout my day.

author: Shannon
headline: A must have
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this feel of this, it literally feels like you're not wearing anything on your face. Its nice when you're wanting a minimal look. Its wears well and is easy to remove. Ill have to wait until summer to wear it again. The shade is just a tad to dark for my winter skin

author: Rachel
headline: So very wet
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this so much but I cannot figure out how to use it. I know it's also a serum but it's SO wet if that makes sense. The coverage is pretty light, you can barely see it on my arm - and when I try to build it up it breaks apart all patchy and wet. I have more combo skin so maybe this just wasn't for me?

author: Maria
headline: Hydrating and a Great, Natural Finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very pleasantly suprised by the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! Since I've been rotating a couple of foundations in my routine, I hadn't been on the hunt for a new one but I was happy to try it out when I had the chance and I'm so very glad I did. 

The packaging is very plain and I probably wouldn't have given it a second glance in the store. Upon opening this product, I couldn't smell any discernible fragrance, which is a plus for many people when we're talking about face makeup. 

The texture of the balm is very soft and almost slippery but it does not fall apart. Once I applied the balm on my skin, I realized I had very much misjudged it - it sank quickly and felt very hydrating to my dry skin. The coverage was almost perfect - it covered most of my dark spots but looked very natural, which I prefer and appreciate. 

I would absolutely repurchase this balm, especially for the winter months.

author: Jennifer
headline: Light weight, no scent, love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love this tinted balm. It's light weight, no scent, and has a matte finish. It goes on smoothly and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin nor does it settle in my wrinkles. It's just enough coverage to look refreshed.

author: Judy
headline: Improving but still a ways to go
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics has come a long way with their shade range and how it does not pull grey on me, however, the color is still a bit off for my skin tone. The packaging is nice and it very breathable. I may need a different color.

author: Danielle
headline: Sheer yet sleek coverage
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. 
I wasn't quite sure which tint would be best for me, and the one I received worked out perfectly! I have a fair complexion that has hints of red undertone in places and yellow in others. In the image, I only used the product on the right side (left side of face) to show the difference. This tint balm balanced the tones easily and smoothly. It's so sheer that it's like I'm not wearing anything at all. The only downside is that it has a greasy residue when first using the product. It does clean easily with makeup remover. I would recommend this product and purchase in the future!

author: Kimberly
headline: Natural Look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a creamy face tint that gives a nice smooth look too your face. It doesn't feel heavy on your face. It doesn't make your face look cracked. It does take a minute to smooth out over your face. You have a more natural look to your face.

author: Nikki
headline: Great for everyday wear if you find a good undertone!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is great for everyday wear! The color has a bit too yellow for my skin tone but I can make it work with concealer and liquid bronzer! The texture is really comfortable and looks very natural and moisturized.

author: Lee
headline: Definitely reccomend!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Do It All sheer tint medium cool 315.  I hate that i like this so much cause it's pricey and the container is only 0.63 Oz.  I have cool, olive, light medium skin tone.  It is so HUGE to have a COOL medium foundation.  It's a little dark for me, but really pretty good match! (Finding light medium is difficult, esp in cool). This is not as dark as alot of medium foundations - but maybe cause it's sheer. I'm older and anything cakey highlights my wrinkles, so more sheer is ideal for me.  Very buildable.  It's not super moisturizing, but I can go w/o moisturizer underneath.  Goes on thickest and best with brush- sponge and fingers are good too.  Sometimes I just dab a little on my problem areas with finger and leave other areas bare and it just blends nicely.  Does not last all day for me outdoors, wears off easily.  Love I can put the cute glass jar in my purse and touch up.

author: Yanira
headline: It sheer tint balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product applies very smoothly like butter. I would recommend having a clean face before applying to make sure it doesn't stay in the pores. At first I didn't see any difference but after I did the whole face I could see a more even tone and my skin looked very soft and healthy.

author: Alexandria
headline: Good tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked the way this looked on my skin. It was very light coverage but not a product I would typically use as a balm. It lasted all day and didn't flake.

author: Stephanie
headline: My favorite!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this face balm sooo much, it is my new favorite! Perfect for dry skin, especially mature skin. Goes on smooth and doesn't accentuate fine lines. It's light coverage, but that's perfect for me, especially in summer when you don't want a heavy foundation. The color matches my skin perfectly and doesn't oxidize. It's made in USA, which I appreciate. With a setting spray this lasts all day! Love it so much..

author: BRENDA
headline: i will buy again
comment: Light weight and doesn;t set into wrinkles yet improves the look of the skins radiance and texture

author: Leah
headline: Better than foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm feels like a healthier version of a light coverage foundation. It had better coverage than I expected and blended well. My face felt fresh and light after application and looked more hydrated. The container makes it easy to use every bit of product.

author: Ann
headline: Absolute sheer coverage
comment: I love the amazing sheer coverage. It's texture is lightweight and creamy. Doesn't feel heavy on my skin. Blends smoothly with buildable coverage. My skin generally has dry patches. But using this product makes my skin feel like it's being nourished and hydrated. It creates a blurring effect,minimizes the look of fine lines and pores. This is a sheer tint face balm. My color match is Fair Cool 125. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: ceooftheglow
headline: A beautifully natural face balm
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is a beautiful face balm. It's very natural looking and leaves a dewy finish. There is a good amount of product in the pot and I love the fact that it's made with clean ingredients. I ended up removing one star because this product does have some caveats. One issue was this is a very light shade (Fair Warm) and as you can see, it's got quite an orange undertone. I was able to make it work, but very fair skin likely won't. Although it is hydrating, it can cling to very dry patches, so skin prep is a must if you have this issue. The coverage is definitely buildable, but I recommend letting each coat dry fully down and then set fully with powder, otherwise it WILL transfer. The staying power is average, you'll need a primer if you want 8+ hours out 
of this. If you're looking for a natural product for daytime, this is for you. As someone who enjoys lighter coverage and a natural look, this fits the bill.

author: Stacy
headline: Skin Care But Makeup!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has transformed my makeup regimen! I love that the balm can be used as a bronzer or tented moisturizer. It is so lightweight and  blendable. It looks so good, it doesnt even look like I am wearing makeup when its on because it is 92% skincare based! It is packed with Vitamin E, collagen peptide and Hyaluronic acid! My face not only looks more youthful but more moisturized, brighter and firmer! I love all the shade options, this one fits me perfectly.

author: Stacey
headline: Applies Beautifully
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Some days I go full on make up. Some days I just moisturize and relax. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the perfect in between for all the other days. It provides all the benefits of a self care day with just enough coverage to face the world. This tinted serum is soft and applies beautifully. I love it so much.

author: Larissa
headline: I would repurchase
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have rosacea so my face is very red and textured. This balm is sheer but it adds quite a bit of coverage to my redness. It doesnt hide my blemishes completely but does give a bit of coverage that they dont stand out as much. I applied this with a brush and it applied easily and blended easily and a little goes a long way. It doesnt seem to hug all my dry patches of skin either. The scent isnt very strong and the packaging is easy to open and use.

author: Daisy
headline: Nice moisturizing face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this sheer tint face balm. A little goes a long way and you definitely get a lot for your money. It's easy to use and doesn't dry out my already dry face. The color wasn't quite right for me, but I liked it so much I plan to try other shades.

author: Terri
headline: Give this a try, it's great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the sheer feel to this highlighter that can be used as a foundation as well. It doesn't settle in to fine lines (for those of that have them). It's in a nice little container that is easy to open. I'm looking forward to using this most days or just when I want to brighten my face. And I love it's packed with lots of vitamins. Give it a try.

author: Kelsey
headline: Its a no from me..
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First things first- this stuff STINKS. As in, you can smell it for an hour after it's on your face- it was so distracting. It made the most subtle, SUBTLE difference in my skin pigmentation but settled so nicely into every crevice and flake of skin.

author: Steph
headline: Sheer face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I included a before and after photo. The coverage provided by this product is indeed sheer, but it does help with my redness. I like that the product is lightweight and it doesn't feel like I have makeup on. I can understand why this is considered a skin care product and not makeup. I like that the product does not settle into my pores and it just glosses over them. As you can see in the photo, there is a little bit of caking on my dry skin, but that's not the product's fault. I used a peeling product last night. I have abnormally sensitive skin and this does not bother my skin. It is also fragrance free, and just a very light product. I just smoothed it on with my fingertips and then I was ready to go. I only took one star off because it doesn't appear that this product includes SPF. I truly believe that's probably the only way you can make this better.

author: Hannah
headline: Glowy, moisturizing tint
comment: I enjoyed getting to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Face Tint. It has a glowy, non-sticky forumula that is great for dry skin. It is moisturizing, doesn't settle into fine lines, and can be applied with fingers or a brush. It gives decent coverage and helped cover my redness, which is impressive for a tint. My only issues were that it separated a bit throughout the day and the shade I tried wasn't the best match, plus the shade range is limited. Overall, a solid option if you want a hydrated, natural looking glow.

author: Jena
headline: Light face balm
comment: Beautiful blending face balm creates a light finish for any makeup routine. It give a more natural tone after applying the foundation so you don't have a ghost like makeup effect. It not too thick creating a more natural glow before you apply your blush.

author: Christine
headline: Simply the best!!!
comment: I am a mature woman in my 70s and I have never found a makeup that glides on doesn't crease at all and is so natural. Of course you must get the right shade and when you do, you won't use anything else!!

author: Lisa
headline: Great Product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great all day wearability. No odor or sticky feeling left on face after application. Gives you an all over tint with the sheer look and feel. Love that it contains the facial serum to give me the extra benefits throughout the day.

author: Christy
headline: Will be added to my daily routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This melted onto my skin and blended perfectly and quickly. It gives very light coverage and you can't even feel that it is there! If you are going for the no-makeup makeup look, you need this in your routine. Loving this as a tired mom who doesn't have a lot of time but wants to look put together.

author: Lora
headline: So Light and Yet Covers Great
comment: Love this product.  It is my new go to.  Light coverage but lasts.  Great for the summer.

author: Alex
headline: Lovely Match, Beautiful Finish
comment: I received IT Cosmetics Do It All Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review and I have really enjoyed using it. The finish when applied with hands is light and dewy. My skin feels light and clean. This product makes my skin feel more supple and moist. I like that coverage can be built up in layers or left like a sheen on the skin to even out skin tone. It matches my skin beautifully. The glass jar this product is in makes it easy to access and apply. After wearing this for a few days I can say that the even tone of my skin lasts all day and my skin breathes and feels very good when it is on. It does not dry my skin or make it feel tight. I highly recommend if you like a no makeup look.

author: Lace
headline: So creamy soft
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free for my honest opinion this IT face tent is so creamy soft feels amazing when applying and blends in effortlessly it looks amazing on my skin last longer with a setting spray, but I was given love the brand and this will definitely be added to my collection.

author: SDG1
headline: Glowy finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The new Do It All Tint Face Balm is an all-in-one multitasker best suited for dry/mature skin. I love that it contains SPF however I'm not very keen on the hard clay like texture. The shade wasn't a match either (that's on me), however upon application the product further oxidizes leaving an orange hue behind. 

The finish is glowy and it doesn't settle in fine lines and wrinkles too much. Loaded with skin caring ingredients, I think I'll need to try the absolute fairest shade because I like the product but after oxidization it's too dark and muddied on my face. 

Removes easily with an oil cleanser, foaming cleanser or regular wipes if I'm feeling lazy. Because of the SPF content, it's suited for daytime wear. I could get a good 7 hour wear out of it before it started to fade.

author: Michelle
headline: Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Similar to a cc cream or tinted moisturizer. I use my foundation brush for application and although it is a solid, once I dip my brush it changes and glides on real easily. I thought the product was very small at first but a little covers a lot. I have the medium warm but because its winter it's a bit darker on me right now. I'm sure it's going to bien well in the warmer months. My face felt hydrated throughout the day, I didn't see any separation or dry patches and it lasted quite a few hours, specially if you're bit touching your face constantly. Enjoyed trying this product!

author: Amanda
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this foundation product. I don't think I can go back to my old skin tint definitely even though everything as well as giving you a healthy glow

author: Kendall
headline: HOLY GRAIL!
comment: THIS is the product the market has been missing. A truly skin-like finish that blends seamlessly. I have two shades to use as all over complexion and bronzer. It is the only foundation I reach for anymore. The formula layers beautifully with other cream products and powders. I find that I am able to build up the coverage for full glam makeup, too!

author: Krystal
headline: My New Everyday Product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I am so extraordinarily surprised with this tinted face balm. I wasn't able to get it in the fairest shade but instead got it in light warm shade and I am so surprised with it and how amazing it looks on me. Normally I am a casper white being a natural red head. However, this light warm shade gives me a sweet natural sun kissed glow that I have never got from any other product. This sheer tint is just that, super sheer and light weight, but even outs your skin tone, helps to reduce redness, which I am always, and gives your skin this beautiful glow that doesn't look like you have any kind of makeup on at all.
It Cosmetics has really out did themselves with this versatile product that I find myself wearing every single day. I don't wear as much makeup as I used to but this is something I can put on after my moisturizer and feel like I am put together without much effort.
I am very happy with this sheer face tint and will be getting it in other shades too.

comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I am so extraordinarily surprised with this tinted face balm. I wasn't able to get it in the fairest shade but instead got it in light warm shade and I am so surprised with it and how amazing it looks on me.
