I am very happy with this sheer face tint and will be getting it in other shades too.

author: Heather
headline: Lightweight and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lightweight and feels like there isn't anything on your skin. It has a great light coverage that covered my redness and just smoothed out my skin without the appearance of heavy makeup.

author: Bea
headline: Free for review
comment: I received this free for review. This is a 4in1 tinted moisturizer that is supposed to improve your skin over time. It has sheer buildable coverage to firm, hydrate, and minimize fine lines. It has many moisturizing ingredients and leaves a light dewy finish. You can apply this with a brush or your fingers.  The product feels cold when you first apply it. Almost like cool water. It set on my dry to combo skin without having to use powder. It does have light coverage. Even though it is hydrating, it still clung to dry patches and would not cover my pores. I get better results with applying with fingers. I have an olive skin tone and the shade, while being light warm, still blended well and was workable. It does not blend over silicones very well so avoid those types of primers.

author: Stefanie
headline: New favorite face tint! Obsessed
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Look at this fabulous sheer finish! Blends so easily; I used a beauty blender but honestly could have used my fingers. I love that it is firm in the pot so you don't risk scooping way too much out at a time. I have worn it for a week with no breakouts, and it lasts all day but washes off easily. I'm a convert!

author: Chantelle
headline: ​The perfect "no-makeup" look (if you don't over-apply).
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I'm honestly impressed by how natural it looks. If you look at my side-by-side photos, the one where I'm wearing it (the closer shot!) just looks like my skin but a lot more hydrated and "awake". It doesn't heavy-handedly cover everything up; it just blurs the redness and gives me a nice, healthy dewiness.
My biggest takeaway? Put the brushes away. I found it applies way better when I just use my fingers—the warmth makes it sink right in instead of just sitting on top of my skin.
One word of caution: It is super easy to overdo it! I included a photo of what "too much" looks like on my fingers. That amount was way more than I actually needed for my whole face. A tiny bit goes a long way, so start small and build it up if you want more coverage.
Overall, if you're into the "no-makeup" look, this is definitely worth a try. Just remember: less is definitely more!

author: Nadya
headline: Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This time face balm leaves my skin feeling smooth and fresh. I love the ease of application and texture of it. It is also long lasting and a little goes a long way.

author: Tiffany
headline: Lightweight but Light Coverage
comment: This product is very lightweight and nourishing to the skin and I anticipate that there would be positive results with extended use. However, I was disappointed in the coverage. I expected that the product would be light coverage, but ultimately, I felt like it didn't blend in well and left a streaky finish. I also felt like it sat on top of pores instead of providing any coverage for them. This may work better for someone who is seeking a more natural makeup look that also has skincare benefits.

author: TCGR
headline: Surprisingly Pleased
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
 I really really like this face tint. I'm usually a full coverage girl due to having a scar from a cancer spot removed. The only reason I took off 1 star is because I chose a shade a little to light. But that's okay I just used this tint either as a primer for my foundation or if I'm in a hurry I throw this on and a little powder that's slightly darker and I'm out the door. 
I tried 3 different methods to apply this,  1. Beauty Blender, 2. Brush & 3. My fingers. My favorite way to apply this is by using my fingers because I feel like I get a smoother application, then I would say the brush and lastly the blender.
I plan on buying this tint when I can go into a store and get my proper shade match.

author: Sindy v
headline: Tinte
comment: This tinted moisturizing balm has a lightweight, easy-to-blend formula that feels like a second skin. Its multiple hydrating ingredients leave skin soft and radiant, perfect for everyday use. It contains peptides that help keep skin perfectly hydrated, addressing signs of aging while maintaining a flawless complexion. The packaging is practical and easy to take anywhere.

author: Ashley
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great coverage, I woke up with this big red spot under my eye and this tint face balm covered it right ups very buildable, great feel and very light weight. There is no scent to this product

author: Luv2shop
headline: Love ❤️
comment: I really like this balm. Its not heavy at all and blends into your skin like a dream. I don't like liquid makeup ar all and don't wear it, but, this is a game changer

author: Alex
headline: Love this!!
comment: Lightweight and doesn't make me oily after hours of wearing.

author: Sabrina
headline: Perfect skin tint, feels like skincare!
comment: I received this skin tint in exchange for my honest review and I really enjoy this product. It feels so lightweight almost like skincare. No scent at all, and is not harsh on my sensitive skin. No breakouts or irritation to the skin. It is easy to apply with a brush or sponge and blends really nicely. It is light coverage, that is buildable to almost medium coverage, and helps with redness and evening out your skin tone. It has a nice shade range and this color was perfect for me. The packaging could be improved, the pot makes it a little easier to contaminate, I prefer the ability to dispense only a little product at a time, but still a great addition to my routine! Especially those days where you don't want a full face of heavy makeup. I would repurchase this and recommend to friends, it is a great go-to skin tint.

author: Bridget
headline: Not just makeup... it's skincare too!!!
comment: I'm loving this tinted balm. It's not just a good tinted face balm it's good for my skin. It's like a 2nd skin. Just use a good primer & this goes on nice like a serum also u can build it up. It's a good find n def a keeper in my routine. Recommend

author: Katie
headline: Light, Buildable, Natural Color!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics products are always a good blend of skincare and makeup. The Sheer Tint Face Balm is exactly this. The glass container is heavy enough that you don't have to worry about it breaking but isn't so heavy that it is a pain to carry. The balm itself is so soft and smooth. It feels airy even. I like the formula better than most tinted moisturizers I've tried. It lasts all day without any touch ups. It gave great, even coverage, especially to my redness on my cheeks. The only reason I left a star off is because - and this is the case for almost all IT Cosmetics skin product- it didn't come out quite as cool as I need it too for a full face. My mom's skin tone is more of a blend of both cool & warm (neutral maybe?) and her veins are a little "greener" than my blue ones. Other thsn that, I would definitely recommend this!

author: Lindsey
headline: Good option for light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Has a nice creamy texture. I would say it has a sheer to light but slightly buildable coverage. A little bit goes a long way. Would be a good option if looking for skin tint or something to balance overall color while still looking natural.

author: Chrisi
headline: I would not buy again.
comment: It doesn't feel right on my skin and I wish I could return it.

author: Dawn
headline: IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 92% Skincare Serum
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really love this IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 92% Skincare Serum. It's light, goes on smooth and blends easily into your skin.  Washes off easily. It can be used before makeup application to make your skin look more natural and smooth. I used Light Warm 215. My skin is glowing.

author: Pegah
headline: New addition to my holy grail collection.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT Cosmetics, and this is was exception! As I'm getting older, I'm transitioning to lighter weight make up. I'll still do the full glam, but I don't want to FEEL like I'm wearing a lot of make up.  This balm melts into the skin without looking cakey. It's sheer but gives enough coverage to even out the skin tone. I can go in and spot conceal afterwards, and it plays well with other makeup brands! A little bit goes a long way, so it'll last you a decent amount of time. I'm not a fan of sticking my hands or fingers into something that'll go on to my face, so I used a small spatula to scoop some out. Product design aside, this was a win and one I'll be repurchasing time and time again.

author: Cj Joy
headline: The quality we've come to expect from IT Cosmetics
comment:
As you can see in the photo, it goes on a lot darker than it is. You can't tell but I have a second patch underneath that's fully blended out. It feels very light on the skin, almost more like a tinted serum. I'm definitely going to use this in the summer.

(I received this product free to try but my opinions are my own)

author: Jain
headline: Made my day
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from IT Cosmetics, and it truly lives up to its name. The texture is lightweight and melts into the skin effortlessly, giving a natural, radiant finish without feeling heavy. It offers sheer, buildable coverage—perfect for days when I want my skin to look fresh, even, and healthy without a full‑foundation look. I love that it's packed with skincare ingredients (92% skincare, according to the brand) designed to hydrate, smooth, and improve the skin's appearance over time A B C.  What stood out most is how comfortable it feels throughout the day—no dryness, no patchiness, and it keeps the skin looking glowy in a very natural way. If you enjoy skin tints that enhance your complexion rather than cover it, this one is a beautiful everyday option.

author: Tetiana
headline: Fresh, smooth, and comfortable all day
comment:
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I really enjoy using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It feels very lightweight while still helping even out my skin tone. The creamy texture blends effortlessly into the skin and gives a smooth, healthy, natural glow.

I love how quick and easy it is to apply, making it perfect for everyday makeup when I want a fresh, minimal look. It feels comfortable throughout the day and never looks heavy or cakey. The compact packaging is also very convenient for travel or touch-ups.

I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for natural, lightweight coverage with a radiant finish.

author: Cecelia
headline: Lightweight glue in a balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has such a soft, creamy texture that truly melts into the skin. It applies smoothly and feels incredibly lightweight — nothing like a heavy foundation. The coverage is buildable, but I found I didn't need much to achieve a radiant, moisturized look.

It's formulated with hyaluronic acid for hydration and plumping, collagen peptide, and vitamin E for antioxidant benefits, which makes it feel more like skincare than makeup. While it didn't really minimize my fine lines or fully cover blemishes, it did leave my skin looking smooth, fresh, and healthy.

If you're looking for sheer, natural coverage with a hydrated glow, this is a beautiful everyday option

author: Tetiana
headline: Natural lightweight coverage that looks fresh and effortless
comment: I really enjoy this face balm because it feels very lightweight while still evening out my skin tone. The texture blends easily and gives my skin a smooth healthy glow. It is quick to apply and perfect for everyday makeup when I want a natural fresh look. It stays comfortable on my skin throughout the day and does not feel heavy or cakey. I would definitely purchase it again.

author: AmBeR
headline: Not For Me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that this has so many skin care ingredients in it, but I count on my actual skin care to get the job done. This balm foundation was just ok. I have combo/oily skin and this was just too hydrating for me. I totally recommend for someone with normal to dry skin.

author: Maisie
headline: Skin like appearance
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is so fantastic every day serum bomb foundation that is a combination of makeup and skin care. It feels thin and easy on the skin. It doesn't feel heavy and it doesn't look heavy. It has a skin like finish and wears beautifully throughout the day. I have mature skin as a mom of six. This foundation is become one of my most used for every day use.

author: Ashley
headline: Skincare and Makeup in One!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the consistency of this product. It's super lightweight on the skin with a nice sheer coverage. It really brightens the skin while concealing any unwanted pigmentation. Matched with your favorite makeup setting spray this lasts all day!

author: Lauren
headline: Flawless finish
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review - When I initially saw the color in the pot I was worried it would be too dark but it was perfect. I applied with my fingers and blended with a beauty blender. The finish is natural, it covers redness well and feels weightless on my skin. I do not feel that it looks heavy and there was no creasing.

author: Nichole
headline: Not my fave
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This isn't my favorite, it takes a long time to apply as you can't scoop it out. It is a very very sheer look and does add some hydration but a pumpable serum is much more efficient.

author: Trisha
headline: Amazing for fine lines and wrinkles
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really torn about giving this product 4 or 5 stars, so let's get into it.
What I loved: The formula is amazing, it blends so nicely and doesn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles. HUGE WIN! It's a light coverage that was strong enough to even out my rosacea without fully covering my freckles and leaving my skin looking plump and healthy. I loved that it really didn't look like I was wearing makeup, that's a big win for me. It really was a clean look and if you weren't inspecting my face close up you would just think I had great skin. I was worried about the neutral shade, because IT Cosmetics can lean warm tone in my opinion, but I didn't have this issue at all. As a true cool skin tone I didn't get any orange or yellow tones showing through. 
What I didn't love: the amount of product you get. With only 0.63 oz this is around 25% less product than you get with most foundations. I have been using this for about a month and I'm going through it faster than I would like.
Overall if you are good with the price point for the amount of product you get, then I would highly recommend. It really is an amazing product, especially if you have any fine lines or skin texture. I was blown away at how well this product preformed. I will likely buy it again for this reason, but I would use it for more special times that I wanted to look nice.

author: Becky
headline: I was Quite Impressed!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Definitely feel like the "IT Do It All sheet tint face balm has improved the lines in my face and firmed the skin up a bit. It seems to hydrate the skin well and doesn't leave a cakey feeling once applied. It is light weight and doesn't leave not feel heavy on the face. The shade matched my skin tone well and the tint blended nicely.

author: Rochelle
headline: Super Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the fact that this is mostly made of skincare ingredients that are good for your skin. It glides on so easy with fingertips or a brush and the product just melts into your skin. My skin actually felt softer when I washed it off at the end of the day which surprised me. This is perfect when you want something light on your skin but has decent coverage. It feels very moisturizing so it's probably better for dry skin.

author: Erika
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. At first I was a little skeptical about using this product, because it's my first time using it in this form of balm. To my surprise when applying it on my face it applied smoothly onto my skin. Covers up my imperfections, doesn't feel heavy, lasts all day.

author: Julie
headline: Skin care meets, sheer, natural coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone in my 50s, my makeup philosophy has shifted. I want products that feel like on my skin, blur, imperfections, naturally, and actually helped my skin look and feel better overtime. That's exactly what I love about it cosmetics do it all sheer tint face bomb. This isn't just makeup, it's a hybrid of skin care and make up in one! What really stands out to me is how light it feels. It melts into skin with a breathable finish that never feels heavy, greasy, or cakey. The coverage is sheer, but buildable, offering a natural, radiant look that enhances your complexion without masking it. 

Make up benefits with coverage that blurs texture – perfect for the "no make up makeup" days, but I want a polish look, but look natural.

author: Shana
headline: Smooth easy coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Goes on smoothly, great coverage, great color match. Texture smooths out pores but doesn't sit in wrinkles. Miracle stuff! Love the size of the container and consistency of the product.

author: Gwendolyn
headline: Do it all!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I would have given it a 5 if it had sunscreen included. Daily sunscreen is a must for me. The two that I'm currently using on my face have a slight tinting effect so it changes the undertone of the sheet face tint balm. So I'll have to invest in a none tinted sunscreen while wearing this. Other than that, I love it! My bare skin does look better that I've been using it every day, so it does have skincare elements. It's easy to work with and gives you the no makeup makeup look.

author: Jessica
headline: Very lightweight coverage.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is very light coverage. The shade was not exact for me but due to the light coverage, i made it work. For me, it was not build able coverage because it looked a bit cakey with two coats. My main complaint is that the finish is more matte and I prefer a glow.

author: Stephanie
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Can you even tell it's on my face? I don't think so, it is so natural and easy to put it. I wasn't sure how I would like this product, but I am super impressed. I love that it's small and easy to travel with, all you need is a brush. I wasn't sure how much I would need each application, but WOW, a little goes a long day! I am a true fan, I would definitely buy this product. I would be curious to see the other colors and shades they offer, because while I think this matches, I would love to see if I could get more of a neutral color. But, I would buy this exact product again and again!

author: Angela
headline: Did not oxidize on me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin care and foundation combo is interesting. It moisturizes my skin and blends well with my skin color despite being a darker shade than I like. It is very soft and easily dentable using fingers.

author: Ashley
headline: Lightweight but covers!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have a tendency to have red blotches on my face. This do it all face balm was amazing for lightly evening my face tone without being heave foundation. It's sheer and left my face feeling moisturized. I put a light setting spray and it lasted all day. Something that will definitely come in handy for my skin.

author: Chantelle
headline: The Ultimate "Your Skin But Better" Glow (Just Watch the Do
comment:
I've been trying out this tinted serum lately, and I'm honestly impressed by how natural it looks. If you look at my side-by-side photos, the one where I'm wearing it (the closer shot!) just looks like my skin but a lot more hydrated and "awake". It doesn't heavy-handedly cover everything up; it just blurs the redness and gives me a nice, healthy dewiness.

​Overall, if you're into the "no-makeup" look, this is definitely worth a try. Just remember: less is definitely more!

author: Maggie
headline: Filter effect
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  This tinted face balm is a real life filter, I got so much compliments when wearing it, your face will look glowy, dewy and healthy, and it's buildable so you can make it cover even more. All that and you won't even feel like you are wearing anything, it's very lightweight, and very easy to remove. 100% better than foundation.

author: Maggie
headline: Filter effect!
comment: This tinted face balm is a real life filter, I got so much compliments when wearing it, your face will look glowy, dewy and healthy, and it's buildable so you can make it cover even more. All that and you won't even feel like you are wearing anything, it's very lightweight, and very easy to remove. 100% better than foundation.

author: Marybel
headline: Best tinted foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm impressed! I'm not a fan of tinted anything. The color is never right, nor does it do anything for me. When I tell you I tried it on, it was perfect the first application. I gasped! Color matched. Feels wet/cool applying. You can build it to make it more makeup vs natural. You can apply with a brush or sponge. It's perfect! I do get oily after 4 hours, but it's perfect for mature skin. I received this product for free to review, and I have bought a backup just in case. It's so good. Having been using it every day instead of my Lancôme foundation

author: Sally
headline: X to the Pot
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the product itself. It gives a glowy, natural finish. Blends really easy and it feels light. It has decent coverage. The only thing I don't like is that it's in a pot. I like using brushes and I feel like it will harbor bacteria. Even if I were to use fingers, I'm just not a fan of potted foundation/tinted creams. If it was in a squeeze tube or pump, it would be amazing!

author: Amy
headline: Sheer
comment: This product does what it says. It's a sheer balm that does slightly tint my face. It looks like such the wrong color upon application but after some blending it mellows out. It does smell like sunblock which I don't really enjoy, and it is fairly hard to wash off at the end of the day. I've noticed it makes my skin a bit greasy. It's not for me but I'm sure it's dewy look and light coverage would be great for some. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm truly surprised me on many levels! It felt like a balm, very light and soothing. It was buildable and I was able to get the needed coverage for my hyperpigmentation. As you can see it did not fully cover it but gave my skin a lightly filtered look. I did use a light finishing powder and was pleased with how well it set. I also used it under my eyes instead of concealer. After 5 hours, it looked just as it did when I first applied it. I am finding myself reaching for this product instead of my high end holy grail foundation! For reference, I am wearing the color Fair Cool 125.

author: Emma

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the lightness of this and how it blends, however it's not quiet my color, but it still covers redness and is easy to remove. Its a sheer texture.

comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

headline: Gives a lovely glowy finish
comment: I have really been enjoying using this skin balm!   I like to apply it with my fingers.  When I rub the product onto my finger in the jar it has a melting fluid-like consistency. It does not have a balmy sticky texture. It gives me such a nice glow without being over the top.  The glow and the finish hold up well throughout the day.  It layers nicely with skincare, sunscreen and other makeup.  It never looks cakey and it does not settle into lines or pores.  I love this product and highly recommend!  I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Jaclyn
headline: Minimalistic makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you're into a no-makeup look, this is a good bet. This has a nice texture and applies easily with fingers. It has a satin finish and seems to minimize the look of pores. It adds a little bit of coverage but not enough to cover a breakout, just enough to even it out a little.

author: Cynthia
headline: Silky smooth for a natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy using this balm. It's very silky and smooth as I apply it. You don't need a ton of it. I apply it old school and use my fingers but if they would include a specific type of brush to apply it, I'd probably use the brush. I apply it like I would my face cream. It's a light coverage  that gives your skin a natural no make up look. It isn't long lasting but perhaps if you apply a setting spray it can last all day. I'd say about half a day and then you'd need to reapply it. I do think its skincare as it tones down some of my discoloration and redness. It also helps maintain moisture throughout the day. I tend to reach for it for when I'm in a hurry and don't want a full coverage look. I'd recommend for mature skin too as I don't find it settled into my wrinkles or fine lines.

This product is so far from that!  I used a small flat brush and a little product went SO far!  It really felt like I was just brushing a serum into my skin.  Extremely lightweight, and gave a hydrated dewy finish.  I found that I could tap and build over any problem areas without it looking cakey! This product is perfect for those 'bare skin days'

author: Jamie

author: Rebecca

author: Kirstyn

This blends quickly and is buildable so you will get your desired coverage.  This is not cakey and does not leave any creases on your skin, feels like you are wearing nothing, that is how lightweight this balm is.  Makes my skin look great, glowing and hydrated all day long.  Another product from IT Cosmetics that I will continue to use.

author: Linde
headline: Wow! Beautiful finish and everyday staple!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was skeptical at first, but wow! The sheer face balm looks great in person and makes my skin still look like skin, but also look so polished and even. It looks so nice that I don't want fuller coverage, I'm great with the ease of application and the effortless effect it gives. This has become an every day staple in my makeup routine!

author: Emily
headline: A great, natural-looking sheer tint face balm
comment:
This has quickly become one of my favorite everyday complexion products. I have very dry, sensitive skin, and I'm always looking for something that gives a little coverage without emphasizing dryness, texture, or fine lines. This face balm is exactly that.

The texture is creamy, balmy, and incredibly comfortable on the skin. It melts in easily and feels more like skincare than makeup. It lightly covers my redness and hyperpigmentation without completely obscuring them. My skin looks more even and healthy, but still very natural — it doesn't look like I'm wearing foundation. It's perfect for days when I want to look more put together without doing a full face.

What I really love is how hydrating it feels. My skin stays comfortable and doesn't get tight or flaky throughout the day, which is huge for me. I would say that the look is more natural skin to slightly matte, that makes my skin look smoother and more refreshed, and it doesn't settle into fine lines or cling to dry patches. This is definitely not a radiant or dewy look though. 

The sheer tint is very forgiving and easy to blend, making it great for quick application with fingers. It also layers beautifully with concealer where needed without looking cakey.

Overall, this is a great option if you have dry or sensitive skin and want light coverage that smooths and evens out your complexion while still feeling like skincare. It's easy, flattering, and makes my skin look healthier with minimal effort.

author: Marycel
headline: Light weight and perfect match
comment: The texture on this balm is silky like. It blends beautifully and matches my skin tone perfectly as I am on the yellow side. It has a sheer affect and makes a nice dewy look. However, it has minimal coverage even if you build on it so keep in mind if you want full coverage this isn't it. I really enjoy using this as it has some serum in it.

author: Heather
headline: Good skin day
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how this feels on my skin. It has a very wet texture when you apply it, but it sinks into the skin nicely. You will not get much coverage out of this. You could try to build it up, but I prefer to just spot conceal where needed to keep the lightweight feel, and it just looks like I'm having a good skin day. I usually have very oily skin, but over the winter it is more normal, and I prefer something a little more hydrating than my usual matte foundations. This has been perfect for the drier months. It feels and looks like skin, and wears well throughout my day. I will definitely repurchase this.

author: Ilene

It's lightweight sheer it could cover up a little bit of pores, but you just have to find the right shade. I like that it doesn't rub off your fingers if you touch it. It just absorbs in the skin, but I would prefer a tube instead of a jar.

I have oily skin so I need to set with powder but the finish of the product on its own its pretty. It its lightweight and creamy and my skin feels nice. Easy to remover with just cleanser.

author: Heather

author: Ramya

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of this balm is smooth and readily melts into the skin. It gives a sheer finish and blurs texture. This serum skin tint is great for busy mornings.

author: Katie
headline: Airy & Light!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics products are always a good blend of skincare and makeup. The Sheer Tint Face Balm is exactly this. The glass container is heavy enough that you don't have to worry about it breaking but isn't so heavy that it is a pain to carry. The balm itself is so soft and smooth. It feels airy even. I like the formula better than most tinted moisturizers I've tried. It lasts all day without any touch ups. It gave great, even coverage especially to my redness on my cheeks. The only reason I left a star off is because - and this is the case for almost all IT Cosmetics skin product- it didn't come out as cool as I need it too for a full face. The second "hand" picture is actually my mom's. Her skin tone is more of a blend of both cool & warm (neutral maybe?) and her veins are a little more "greener" than my blue ones. It goes perfectly with her skin and she could definitely use it for a full face! I would definitely recommend this!

author: Disha

But when I applied it to my face, it was actually a pretty good match. Easy to apply and smooth onto my skin. Lasted for the whole day, and blurred my pores fairly well also.

author: Aida
headline: Mrs. Do it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] We are entering a new skincare meets makeup era, and this is a great example. It has the texture of a balm but it feels wet on the skin, dries out with a balanced sensation of matteness but it still looks glowy on the high point of the face, wow! TBH, It took me one or two trial-and-error tests to figure out I had to simplify my skin care routine to get the benefits of this product, and to balance out my powder placement on my combination skin. I think this simple, minimalist routine with just a few steps could be perfect for someone who likes to keep things quick and easy, especially when they're in a hurry or on the go, rushed mornings, traveling or quick makeup in the car. The balm format works great for all this type of situations, no worries about spills or wondering how many ounces on the plane, again? The color match worked really well too, since it doesn't try to be full coverage shades are flexible and easy to work with. Its so hydrating that I even tried it under my dry under eye as concealer. I got to admit it wasn't the best concealer work I had seen but it worked great for the morning hours and it would save me time and products to use in a real life rush situation. It's an overall great product with numerous and versatile uses. It's easy to work with and carry around, so give it a try.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Hey I'm sorry. I wanted to love this product but I just don't. It's oily and sticky. It made me get a bump on my cheek. It feels very uncomfortable on my skin. The shade was correct but the formula is just a nope for me.

author: Ruby
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this face tint balm since I recently turned 37 and have had some skin changes, especially in winter time. A little goes a long way. This pot is small enough to take with you or just store wherever. This is not thick at all. My preferred method of application was with my It Cosmetics foundation brush. You really don't need to pick up much at all. It swipes on the skin easily and blends out pretty good.  It's also scent free. The whole application process was pretty easy.  For wear tests, the color pay of was great expect for when you have the wrong tone. The color I got was medium cool. I tend to run cool/ neutral. This was very cool and made me look somewhat grey. I did fix this by bronzing. This did make my skin look pretty and dewy initially but by the end of the day, some of the product was broken up around my mouth and nose. I also did have some clinging on dry spots that did enhance them. This is one of those products that you have to play with more and be cautious setting too heavily with powder or it will ruin your make up and make it look cakey as well. On a positive note, this works well as an under eye concealer but again, doesn't play well with setting powders.

author: Tai
