author: Nicky
headline: Decent coverage sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately the color I chose wasn't a match so l wasn't able to wear this out but I did wear it in my house to see if I would love it. I have to start by saying that I have dry sensitive skin so my face tends to dislike a lot of products. This product seemed like it would be a great match for me but unfortunately I didn't love it. I didn't have any reaction to it so that's a good thing, like it didn't irritate my skin so that's a plus. Although it is advertised as having skincare ingredients and more like a tinted moisturizer I still had to use a moisturizer before hand because the time I didn't, it emphasized my dry patches and held on for dear life as the day progressed. But it also transferred quite a lot even tho I set it the usual way I do. But it didn't last very long in places especially my chin and nose. Would I pick this as my go to, unfortunately no. But everyone is different and it might work better on normal skin types just didn't work for me.

author: Regina
headline: lightweight, dewy and perfect for mature skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm really pleased with this product. I don't normally wear foundation because as a woman in my 50s I find most foundations tend to age me. This tinted face balm is completely different.
I was unsure at first because it looks like a traditional foundation, but it absolutely isn't! It didn't clog my pores, didn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles, and I didn't have to worry about it transferring onto my clothes. It gave my skin a beautiful dewy finish, which I love!
You could apply it with your fingers or a brush, I used to brush for more even application and it worked perfectly. The only thing worth noting is that the shade I chose is a little dark for me right now, but that's just my winter skin versus summer skin.
Overall, this is something I'll definitely be adding to my make up routine on the days. I will just want light and natural coverage.

author: Christina
headline: In love with the serum feel and light coverage!
comment: I am IN LOVE with this balm.  I received this product in exchange for my honest review.  Feels nice and light like a serum when applied.  I use my fingers and then buff it out with a brush.  It is so light and provides the perfect amount of light coverage.  This also lasts all through my work shifts at my restaurant.  I love the glass jar and feel this will last me a long time as it takes just a bit of product to achieve the results I'm wanting.  This will also be great for the hot Florida summers as it doesn't sit heavy on the skin.

author: Bb
headline: So good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got the IT Cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm to try and I really like it. I love how smooth it goes on and lasts all day. The coverage is light which I like. It doesn't have a heavy or greasy feeling either. Definitely my new favorite.

author: Kim
headline: Check in store for your shade!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm so glad I selected the right color, because I feel like if I had went one shade off, this wouldn't have matched. I'd recommend going into a Ulta to make sure you choose the right shade! Once I lose my tan, I don't think this one is gonna work for me anymore. As for the application, it is slightly tacky at first but eventually smooth in for a pretty light coverage. I think I could've went heavier. Had I wanted that effect but I liked how light it was on my face and it stayed on most of the day without budging!

author: Magi
headline: Amazing face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is absolutely annoying amazing face tint. I l9ved the the formula the blendability it has. It applies  effortless it has a natural finish.

author: Kecia
headline: Almost 5 Stars!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cosmetics. The formula is  lightweight, hydrating, and gives my skin a beautiful glow without being too heavy. It evens out my complexion so my skin looks like skin. It's perfect for no-makeup makeup days or when I want something quick and effortless. My only downside is the glass jar. While it looks luxe, it's not the most convenient or hygienic option, especially for traveling. I'd love to see it in a pump or tub one day.

Overall, if you're looking for a sheer tint that hydrates, smooths, and enhances your natural glow, this one is worth trying!

author: Chelsea
headline: Sheer tint do it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It all sheer tint face balm appears darker than my skin color but it blends right in and matches. You need to use the right moisturizer or the balm will make your skin look flaky and cakey. It looks natural and is a sheer coverage. Product will last a while as you don't need a lot of it.

author: Heather
headline: Creamy, soft, perfection
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetic's new Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has gone directly into my 'use everyday' makeup kicking out several other products. It gives just enough color to help blend everything together without being heavy or a true 'foundation'. It is defiantly one of those products for the days you don't want to put a lot on but still want to even out your skin tone. The color is flawless, blending in so perfectly and the texture is absolutely perfection. It is so cream, soft, and lightweight, your face will feel softer without feeling like you have anything on. Compared to other tinted liquid serums, this creamy Do It All is easier to apply without wasting or using excess product. I'm getting a second just to keep in my purse.

author: Fabienne
headline: Winter Holy Grail
comment: I bought this on a whim because I walked into Ulta and it was right there. It had me at "Do It All" and balm. This winter has been BRUTAL. And my normally oily skin has been dry. So I wanted something protective. First of all I tried the tester and it was such a perfect match that when I asked my kid "Does this match? " she answered "Does what match?" Because it was INVISIBLE on my skin. The texture is silky and not at all greasy. It's lightweight and offers buildable coverage. Looks like my skin. It's so natural and flawless looking that I have to remind myself to wash it off. It doesn't clog my pores and it's protective. No discernible scent. What are you waiting for?? Run don't walk!!!!

author: Winona
headline: Definitely a holy grail foundation for me! :)
comment: I have purchased so many different types of foundations.  I have very dry skin (like it flakes off even with a lot of lotion/oil on it daily). WOW it is fabulous!  I can even use it without lotion all over my face before applying. A 10 for me!

author: Cassie
headline: Easy and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am always impressed with the quality of it cosmetics. The Do It All sheer tint face balm is no exception to this! I found it very easy to apply and the coverage is very good. Thie face balm leaves your skin feeling moisturized. I like to use a powder after to achieve a more matte finish.

author: Andrea
headline: I used so little and it went so far!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oh wow. Full disclosure when I first touched this is thought "No way is this covering anything". Im really lucky and have never had to many skin issues but as im getting older I have had problems with dryness and the occasional pimple or 2 with my cycle. I barely even disturbed the surface and did half my face. It such a perfect color and blends so smoothly I only had to use it in some problem aresa. Like my red nose. You can see the difference in the pics from the half I did and didnt do. It finished like satin and stayed for a full day of out and about.

author: Ness
headline: Easy and beautiful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very serum like product. Lightweight but buildable. Very nice feeling to put on and easy application. Found using immediately after a moisturizer worked best. Seems to stay and not transfer to clothing. Does have a dewy or shiny appearance, setting powder/matter finish spray would work great if it's not a look you love.

author: A
headline: Good for no makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried  the IT cosmeticss Do It All Sheer Tint Face balm. It definitely a product I could use on  a no makeup days. I like how it evenly blended in and felt like I had no makeup on.It  felt lightweight and appeared  to be buildable but you may have to use more product because of its consistency. I feel  it will last a long time unless you are  sweating . It does appear hydrating at first but after wear it settled into fine lines. I wish it had spf which would have been great.

author: Sarah
headline: Looks and feels good on my skin
comment: I love this balm. It evens out my skin just the right amount and feels so great. It is now my go to.

author: Vanessa
headline: Lightweight creamy foundation
comment: This lightweight creamy foundation comes in excellent packaging to ensure that nobody else contested. It's secured and wrapped which ensures sanitization.. I do not enjoy worrying foundation much because it feels like a suffocate my face however, with this foundation, it has light to medium coverage and leaves my face filling like it can breathe, does the lightweight creamy moose like filling. It lasts about 10 hours and it's easy to remove with facial soap or any makeup removal product.. it's definitely high-quality foundation and perfect for any time of year leaving your skin feeling moisturized.

author: Juwayriya
headline: Makes my skin look great!!
comment: Love how this makes my skin look and feel! Only issue with it is I wish it would last a little longer. Other than that it is an amazing product!

author: Midori
headline: Easy to apply and great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT products, they are high quality and work well, this sheer tint lives up to that same standard, does not disappoint. I like the ease of applying the product. Applies easily with a sponge. Gives good coverage and evens skin tone. Very much like and will add this IT sheer tint to my regular makeup routine.

author: Jessica
headline: Do it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint balm looks really natural. Your skin but better. It evens out the skin tone and leaves a dewy finish. I love that it has skin loving ingredients like peptide, vitamin E and hyaluronic acid. These ingredients help not to dry the skin out over time while wearing. I found that I got more coverage when I used a brush to apply and a more sheer coverage when I used a damp beauty sponge. I works well with my cream blush and my powder bronzer. I did use a setting powder to set it so I wouldn't accidentally bump it or rub my face and mess it up. Even after powder, there was still a very healthy, natural dewy look to my face. I wish the container was just a little bigger around to accommodate a brush or a beauty sponge better. I also wish it had SPF, that would have me reaching for this product daily!

author: Cindee
headline: Buildable
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product free for my honest review.

OMG in my old age, my skin has become more dry. I haven't used foundation or powder because it would flake up. This product actually moisturizes and covers any dry spots. It's buildable so I can apply as little or as much as I need.

author: Erin
headline: Lasts all day, even when working out!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how easy this is to put on in the morning, just a minute or two with a sponge to dab it on and blend it in, and my face looks even without any red spots, but without looking "made up" It lasts all day, even when I was moving furniture, cleaning all day, and sweating!  My eyeshadow blends better when I have this on. That said I find that my mascara seems to smear into the foundation if I barely touch my eye.

author: Renee
headline: Great alone or as base
comment:
Finally! I really like this and look forward to using it this summer.  It is light and doesn't get patchy or dry into places on skin.  
It gives me some moisture and evens my skin tone.
If I need extra coverage for stubborn dark marks I brush a little bit of my bare minerals powder and works perfext together. 
I also love that I can brush some light bronzer/blush over and it also pairs well and doesnt settle or cake. 
For reference I'm in lower 40's and have very dry skin( sometimes flaky from our well water) and some lovely lady wrinkles and this has been very soothing.

author: Em
headline: Beautiful formula
comment: I've had super dry skin this winter and this foundation is amazing. I think it would work for oily skin too. It's so lightweight but still covers imperfections. I had high hopes for this and it exceeded my expectations. I applied this product with a foundation brush, and it went on super even. It were well throughout the day.

author: Michelle
headline: So easy to use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is one of the best facial items I've tried. The balm is so smooth and literally melts on your fingers making it so easy to rub into your skin. It hydrates and really improves the look of my skin. It gives that minimal tint coverage for an effortless look. A little goes a long way which is amazing. I absolutely love using this do it all sheer tint face balm daily!

author: GabrielleB
headline: 5 stars excellent
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm so impressed by this product. I don't regularly wear skin tints or concealer but this is the perfect product for days where your under eyes need a little extra oomph (especially after a late night). 
This product is cool to the touch, solid yet and melts like a liquid on your skin. Super easy to blend, buildable.
I do not notice any creasing after a long day.

I can't speak to long term benefits (re: the serum aspect of the product) but the short term and daily use are fantastic.

author: Jessie
headline: I like ITs face balm but…
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this face balm. IT cosmetics is usually a brand I love. The finish is beautiful, the coverage is buildable and it stays throughout the day as long as you do not sweat too much. I like the packaging as it seems sturdy enough to take with me. However, i noticed it does settle into fine lines as you go about your day. Which is a bummer hence why i left 4 stars instead of 5.

author: vltpg
headline: Amazing!
comment: I saw this advertised and decided to give it a try!  I could not believe the luminous look, the feeling as I put it on, and the finished look that I got, without all the coverage from foundation that I haven't used for years because I never liked the look and feel on my skin.  I got one shade, suggested by an Ulta employee, and it was perfect.  But I might just try a shade darker for the summer months.  The feel is so comfortable and the look is WOW!

author: Kris
headline: I love this way more than I expected!
comment: I have combo to oily sensitive skin, and I assumed it would break me out like most cream foundation products I've tried. Not the case! This balm is light and sheer with buildable coverage- it feels silky and not cakey at all on my skin! Helps conceal some of the redness and shadowing I constantly battle! Love love love and I think everyone should try it at least once!!! Amazing line!!!

author: Patty
headline: Great Product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is great. It matches my skin perfectly. Especially for someone like me that dont wear alot of makeup. This is great to cover imperfections ive been using it instead of foundation but you can also apply foundation over it. You can use 1 layer or build a thicker coverage with it. It dont have a strong nasty odor like alot of products do. It also dont dry my skin out like other products do. It dont irritate my super sensitive skin and make me break out like other products have.

author: Tatiana
headline: I would buy it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how natural and lightweight the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Gace Balm feels on my skin. The sheer, buildable coverage evens my face, blends easily, feels hydrating, and removes quickly, though wear time is moderate.

author: WolfinFun
headline: A little goes a long way!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried Fair Warm 120 and it was a perfect match to my skin tone. This is by no means full or even medium coverage even though it states it's buildable, it isn't.  I learned the hard way that you pat or tap this on your face, do not rub or glide your fingers over your face until this has set up otherwise roll up your sleeves and prepare to wash your face, the rolling mess not to mention the way it makes your pores look. I have learned to use this in the evening after I take all my makeup off as the balm seems to help my skin care routine or rather I feel like I'm benefiting from having this balm over it. I like this product,  not crazy about the price point but I like and will buy it. No break outs but I could see if you attempted to "build" coverage becoming oily thus break outs. A little goes a long way.

author: Cosima
headline: Barely there even complexion
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This balm is exactly what it promises - a lightly tinted, sheer balm. The texture melts into the skin immediately and spreads easily with your fingers. Overall, on its own this does not have any noticeable coverage. However, paired with a concealer and a light powder, the effect is a more even complexion without looking heavy. It does need to be said that it does not have buildable coverage. Applying too much actually results in the shade looking off while applied in a single layer it appears as a perfect match. Unfortunately my biggest issue is that the balm texture does not play well with my combo oily skin type. It is perfect for a day when I don't wear my makeup all day but it does not have longevity. But if you have dry skin or don't need 12 hour lasting power, this could be perfect.

author: Lindsay
headline: Good but not my top pick
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade is Fair Cool 125 and it was a good match for my skin tone. I was suprised by that because I'm usually in the "light" shade range and not fair. It is very sheer coverage which I like because I want makeup to look natural. However I wish it was more of a dewy or radiant finish. I wouldn't call it matte. More of a satin. Unfortunately it didn't stand up to the test of time. Within just a few hours it looked like most of my makeup was worn off. Good for a Quick Look for errands for younger skin. Not meant for mature skin or to last all day.

author: Tina
headline: Love IT cosmetics
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This tint was exactly that. A tint, do not expect any coverage. As a tint though it was great, moisturizing for the winter months but as an oily skin girly not sure I could wear this in the Florida humidity of the summers.

author: Taylor J.
headline: Perfectly glowy natural finish!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is awesome for everyday! It's super Light weight and glowy.  It feels super silky on and has the perfect amount of coverage for everyday to elevate your makeup. It didn't feel heavy or make my skin feel cakey at all. It blended perfectly natural. I definitely recommend!

author: Amanda
headline: Oh, how I love a good Skin Tint! ✨
comment:
As I've gotten older, finding the right makeup is a struggle. It's not just about the shade—it's finding a formula that doesn't crease, cake, settle, or flake.
​I have some sensory issues with heavy products, so I always prefer something light and sheer. I just want an even skin tone without feeling the makeup on my face. This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm absolutely hits the mark! 🙌
​It feels weightless. I love that I can forget it's even there, but then I do a random mirror check and think... "Oh, lovely!" 🤩 It evens everything out, doesn't clog my pores, and lasts all day.
​If you want that "your skin but better" look, this is a good one to try!
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] ​

author: Tara
headline: Hydrating!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product! It is fairly sheer yet does provide some coverage. It feels super hydrating! I haven't noticed a scent but I can't say if it's actually unscented. The only thing that would make this better would be spf! It lasted throughout the day and came off easily when I washed my face.

author: Ashley
headline: Meh
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had high hopes for this product because I really love the IT Cosmetics CC Foundation, but this one just didn't quite win me over. The brand claims that with continued use, this balm can help improve the overall appearance of your skin; however, I didn't use it consistently enough to see any long-term results.

Although it's marketed as a balm, the texture feels much lighter than I expected, more like a serum than a traditional balm. I was also not a fan of the packaging, as the container didn't feel very hygienic. Texture-wise, the best way I can describe it is… very wet.

The coverage is extremely sheer. Even after applying multiple layers with my fingers, a brush, and a sponge, it remained very light. As you can see in my photos, it didn't cover my freckles at all. Once applied, the product didn't sink into my skin the way I anticipated; instead, I could feel it sitting on top, which I personally don't prefer. I also felt the need to set it with powder.

That said, while the coverage is minimal, it did help even out my skin tone slightly and gave a nice luminous finish. I can see this working better for someone with drier skin who prefers very light coverage. Overall, though, there weren't enough benefits for me to repurchase this product.

author: Tonia
headline: Giving Face
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Giving skin! Just a hint A just a tint - I have freckles and aging . I am 51 . And look flawless. This product is perfect for a fresh face. Love it . A little goes a long way.

author: MaryKate
headline: Unbelievable! The best I have ever used
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the ONLY foundation I will wear on my skin!! It's lightweight and also has collagen and an absolute beautiful finish! It doesn't smear or smudge!

author: Lacey
headline: Home Run Sheer Tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The texture is incredibly smooth and it glides onto the skin so easily-super quick and effortless to apply, which I really appreciate on busy days. It gives me a natural, fresh finish that looks like skin but better.

The only downside for me is the container itself. I'm not totally in love with a packaging. That said, the product inside is such a home run that it doesn't take away from how much I enjoy using it. Overall, this is a great everyday staple and one I'll definitely keep reaching for.

author: Dana
headline: Great lightweight dewy coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to try this product created by IT Cosmetics with Jennie Garth (hello 90210 days!) since it's formulated for more mature skin I was even more excited. At 38 my skin has its fine line, plus I still suffer from acne and rosacea. The texture was different than any product I've used before. It's cool feeling on the skin to apply and blended in with my skin tone without turning orange by the end of the day. It felt lightweight and dewy, definitely moisturizing without settling into my lines and pores. I did feel like I needed to set with some sort of setting powder for it to stay. I tried one day without and it seemed to disappear rather quickly, versus putting my setting powder over top it stayed on a lot longer. I did find it covered my redness but wasn't a full coverage foundation. More of a sheer finish Ike my skin but better. I also love that it's a serum and makeup combined.. I love all in one type of products. Lower stars for longevity, or lack thereof. Great if I want a minimal luck to run errands without doing a full face.

author: Ren1
headline: Sheer tint balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice product to use on everyday basis. It's light weight but gives nice coverage makes skin looks hydrated and sheer. If you don't want heavy foundation or heavy make up then this would be an ideal balm to use!! It's blends in nicely giving good coverage.

author: Holly
headline: Works wonders ⭐️
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really loving this product it says sheer tint balm, but I really does so well even as a concealer. The texture blends so nice, it is easy to use. It lasts throughout the day, definitely a great product!

author: Dana
headline: Easy to apply and gentle on skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately this product missed the mark in  my opinion. The hues carry an orange tint. It does blend well, however I found that th product is sticky without a powder over it, which then made it feel heavier than most tinted creams. Also, didn't last for a long time without wearing off. Easy to remove and there is no scent so that is nice and gental on the skin.

author: Tammy
headline: Great for sheer coverage,  and portable!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am pleased to report that this did NOT break me out or cause any bad reactions! I have that problem with so many products - especially foundation. Definitely sheer coverage and possibly not for those with oily skin. Easy to carry in your bag for touchups throughout the day. I will definitely purchase this again.

author: Tuesday
headline: This was nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm in the shade fair cool 125 in exchange for my honest review. I liked this balm it went on well and laid a light to medium coverage. To me this will be perfect for summer time looks when I wear less makeup. The coverage was buildable and it was a nice shade match for me. It's in a little glass jar that makes easy to carry it with me. I really did like this product. There wasn't a scent to it at all.

author: Ambee
headline: Great foundation balm
comment: I have several high-end foundations and have consistently reached for this one since I received it. It's like skincare meets coverage. It's moisturizing while providing a great makeup base.

author: Jeanne
headline: Eh not so good sorry
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Hey I'm sorry. I wanted to love this product but I just don't. It's oily and sticky. It made me get a bump on my cheek. It feels very uncomfortable on my skin. The shade was correct but the formula is just a nope for me.

author: Winnie
headline: Foundation balm
comment:
I received this product for free Thank you for giving me this opportunity to try this amazing product.  It cosmetic Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a lightweight, radiant-finish tinted moisturizer and foundation balm in one. Powered by a 92% skincare base with collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E, IT delivers sheer, buildable coverage. Visibly smoother, firmer, more hydrated, and subtly blurred. Its ultra-blendable solid-serum texture melts on contact for effortless application, making it as easy to use as it is beautiful on the skin. Makeup and skincare routine all in one!

I got the color of this foundation balm at light warm 215 shade. It has a floral scent! Be honest! This color is too dark for my skin tone! The texture is very lightweight! This foundation balm with medium coverage by using it alone! I tried two methods, I use my finger to put on the  foundation. Second method, I use the foundation brush to put it on & use a blender to blendable even. I like the first method better. Looks more natural! Looks flawless! Skin look! So natural on skin! Dewy finish! I love how it feels on the skin, not greasy, lines looks minimize. Not feel dry! Feels hydrating all day long! On the second day, based on the color too dark when I tested before, I put a  lighter tone loose power on top, it fit perfectly!

author: Amanda
headline: My New Favorite Face Product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has got to be my new favorite face product! The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has completely replaced my foundation step and keeps my skin looking dewy and fresh throughout the day. I love to apply it with a blending sponge that is slightly damp - it is so easy and works great with my combination oily slash dry skin. I also love that it doesn't settle into my wrinkles or make my pores look larger. Can not wait to continue using this into the summer!

author: Christine
headline: A really nice skin tint!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice light coverage skin tint! It feels very cooling when applying it, which I definitely enjoyed. I feel like it looks very skin like. The longevity was nice. It lasted a good portion of the day, definitely through my work day. I would buy this again!!

author: Jessica
headline: Buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is light weight on the skin. Feelis like you're not even wearing makeup at all. It's sheer to medium coverage. It's  easy to build up to the coverage that you desire. My favorite way to apply was with a brush. It spread the product out evenly and blended easily . Last all day

author: CHRISTINA
headline: Fantastic
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It cosmetics do it all shear tint face balm is a fantastic product that outperforms any other I have tried so far. It lasts all day into the evening. It is a buildable coverage and it leaves my skin feeling renewed.

author: Michelle
headline: Sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's a cream sheer tint, it goes on nice and easy and blends well. I wasn't sure how I was going to like it as a cream base and I don't always like the feel of those. This one feels nice and light.

author: New York
headline: Good for the gym
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a longtime it cosmetics fan and have used the cc cream for years. In the photo, face balm on the left and cc cream swatched on the right. This balm is much sheerer than the cc cream which is great for no makeup days, though it is more matte than I prefer. It's cooling when initially applied. I needed to used a rich moisturizer before applying (dry winter skin right now) and used a foundation brush that wasn't too dense.

author: Mindy M
headline: Really is like skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sheer face balm was a pleasant surprise. The color was a good match, which is normally a struggle for me. It has a nice sheerness with enough color to even out your tone. It is easy to apply, I used a brush. It sits nicely on the skin and didn't enhance wrinkles or texture like some products do. I appreciate that it doesn't feel heavy on my skin. It truly feels like skincare and it lasted for 7 hours before I noticed any loss of color.

author: LeeLee
headline: Fabulous Face
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm has a mousse-like texture and is very light on the skin. It covers my redness nicely, as well as any bumps, all while looking natural. It does not pill when put on over my moisturizer or SPF. I used a dense bristle foundation brush and it worked well. It was not bad using a makeup sponge application either, but I preferred using a brush. The skin balm lasted pretty well on me, (8 hours) but did break up in my oily spots later in the day. This did not settle into fine lines for me like some other skin tints do. The skin balm also did not make my dryer areas look flaky or dry at all! I'd say it's a complete winner for me! I will just add powder to my oily areas as usual. I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea. There's no scent, and it feels good on my face and looks good in photos and in real life as well. I'd recommend it highly for an everyday natural look.

author: Tiffany
headline: Grab and go makeup that makes your skin healthy.
comment: No time for makeup? This is my go to. Easily applies just like skin care. Because it is skincare. The packaging is durable,and easy to fit in any bag. The value is amazing. It looks like a solid,with the simple touch of your finger melts into a serum. The scent is non existent. Removal os easier then all other tinted balms I have tried. Simple makeup remover or soap and water with a gentle cloth.

author: Kate
headline: A no go for me!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is not my favorite face tint. The texture seems to highlight even the most minimal bit of dryness anywhere on my face. I live in the Midwest, it's very cold, dryness is a battle! The shade I received is much too dark and orangey in person. It is very lightweight with an almost sheer coverage. Unscented. Overall I would not purchase this for myself.

author: Lisa
headline: One stop shop!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The container packs a small miracle in it. The sheer tint is smooth, creamy, and goes on easy. The opening is wide enough to get the right amount of product out. The color is a perfect match to my skin tone and melted on my skin. I applied it after I cleansed my face, and it wasn't heavy. It covered my dark spots, wrinkles, and fine lines. There was no need for foundation or powder. This is a one-stop shop. It was easy to remove as well but gave me great coverage for hours. I applied the product to half of my face to show the difference, see photos. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

author: Patrice
headline: Extremely Hydrating and Natural!!! I love IT!!
comment: I really enjoy this face balm for everyday wear. The texture is smooth, lightweight, and very hydrating without feeling greasy. Coverage is sheer but evens out my skin tone nicely and gives a healthy, natural glow. It blends easily with fingers and feels comfortable all day. There's no strong scent, which I appreciate, and it doesn't settle into fine lines. Perfect for no-makeup makeup days or when you want quick, effortless coverage with skincare benefits.

author: Victoria
headline: Buildable but Amplifies Texture
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I had really high hopes for this face balm, as I love skincare products and light facial color so a light, buildable color that firms and minimizes lines sounded like a winner. 

I did like the amount of moisture in the balm, and found that it was truly light and buildable while being hydrating. I could spot correct and blend without using a ton of product, and the balm melted into my skin.

However, I did not find that the balm minimized lines or texture on my face. You can see in the photo - the top is my regular skin, and the bottom is the balm in action and the lines and bumps on my skin are actually emphasized.

I will be mixing this into my regular SPF for a bit of color, but as-is this balm didn't work for me and my textured skin.

author: Danielle
headline: Works well
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As you can see in the photo this product blended flawlessly into my hand which I was worried about when I saw the color.  It provides good coverage without feeling heavy. My complaint is the container it's in, I wish it wasn't in a jar as I think that's kind of messy especially once it's been using and starts to get low.  Other than that I think the texture and the product itself are very nice but I wouldn't expect less from this brand.

author: Rosa
headline: I would recommend this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok now I have to said this I love this tint face balm I been using it everyday for work and I love how natural it looks on me like I have no makeup on it last all day And my face looks glowing

author: Jerah
headline: You may never need foundation again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!!! I can't say enough good things about it. The shade match was perfect!!! The packaging is compact and cute. The consistency is not too think or heavy feeling. It blends beautifully, and often days I use it in place of foundation. It gives great coverage and lasts all day. I would recommend this over and over again!

author: Angela
headline: I will definitely buy this product again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love all things IT so I was super excited to try this IT Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm. As expected it was awesome!  Easy to apply and the finish was nice not heavy. Definitely recommend!

author: Eliza Ann
headline: Better than expected
comment:
I was upset because IT discontinued their "Your Skin but Better" serum liquid foundation. And then "BOOM"
out they came with this little treasure! The minute I started to apply it I knew I was hooked! it went on as light as air, and it instantly hydrated my face! normally I apply my foundation with my fingers, but I used a foundation brush for this. You need very little product to cover your face, and it's buildable if you need some extra coverage! since wearing it, I have gotten so many compliments on my complexion and my skin! it does not settle in your lines or in your wrinkles! and I just turned 60! I hope they never stop making this product! I'm hooked!

author: Penny
headline: Would recommend this for friends and family
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sheer tint face balm has good coverage enough to cover uneven spots and light enough for skin to feel breathable and not cakey. It helps my skin with the glowy effect but also feels very light. Can also be easily removed by gentle makeup removers. Just wish that they come in more different shades/colors.

author: Gabriela
headline: Okay
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited for this product. Unfortunately it is too dark for me. Maybe it will be a good shade come summer time. Not a fan of the packaging. The product itself feels very lightweight as it is a skin tint balm. It does last as it took 2 cleansers to remove from the swatch on my cheek and arm.

author: Cheryl
headline: Great glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was fortunate enough to be able to try Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review. I found the packaging to be quite small with very little product,especially for the price point but after applying my first application of it I realized a little goes a long way. It left my skin feeling smooth but a tad bit greasy. I think this would be a good tint to use during the summer months when I am not wearing makeup but I would need to incorporate my sunscreen since unfortunately this doesn't contain any. The color does give your skin a perfect glow that I do love though.

author: Kathy
headline: Nice sheer coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have grown quite fond of using this product! It goes on great with my makeup sponge. It is definitely sheer coverage but it feels so nice on my skin! It stays put for most of the day. It pairs well with my IT concealer. It leaves a dewy finish which is better for my mature skin.

author: Sommer
headline: This rocks.
comment: Unlike any product I've tried, smooth finish and barely there look. I love a product that looks like I'm not wearing anything, but suddenly my skin looks more even, and more refreshed. Would recommend for those who love that natural glowy look, without the weight. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Ashley
headline: Thoroughly Impressed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was worried the shade would be a little orangy but it actually blended really well with my skin tone. I have dark freckles and highly pigmented spots and it did a wonderful job of making my skin look more youthful and even. I love this skin tint!

author: Laura
headline: Perfect for a natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this in shade fairest neutral. It pulls a little warm on my skin but I also have very cool undertones. It is a sheer product but it feels like bare skin once blended out.  It has the perfect level of moisturisation for my dry/normal combo skin but it might not work well for those with oily skin.

author: Ekaterina
headline: Would buy again.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As of now been using this about three weeks now. My skin has not reacted negatively to tis product. Love the skin care aspect of this balm especially with my extra dry skin during winter months. Skin feels plump and hydrated and the product doesn't catch on extremely dry spots which is wonderful. Blends very easily with the brush or fingers.  Would definitely recommend for us dry skin girlies.

author: Sarah
headline: Great for those no makeup, makeup looks
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I love this formula, skincare is important to me and now it's in makeup is a bonus. It doesn't look cakey, you can't tell that you have any makeup on.

author: Pam
headline: Love it!
comment:
Since Clinique quit making my favorite foundation I have been trying others.  Love this Sheer Tint Face Balm.
Not greasy or oily and is perfect for what I wanted.  Not heavy and feels really nice on your face!

author: Nicole
headline: Impressed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was actually really impressed by this balm.  I was quite sure how to apply at first but found using a rounded face brush to apply and then a blending sponge to do a final blend worked well.  The product looked dark in the pot, but gave my skin a nice glow without looking like I was wearing the wrong color.  The weight of the formula reminds me of a skin tint, but it's much cleaner to use than a tint.  I fortunately didn't notice any caking or bad settling into my lines after a few hours of wear.

author: Kimberly
headline: Long lasting and beautiful color
comment: This product was given to me in exchange from my review. It is beautiful, long lasting color perfect for every day wear

author: Karla
headline: Moisturizer and makeup? Yes please!
comment: When I opened the light neutral color I felt like it looked orange in the package, but applied it blends in perfectly and made my skin look smooth. It is not transfer proof, so I feel like I have to be careful not to get it on my clothes. But that is usually fine. My skin has a healthy look with it on and it blurs blemishes without looking like I have a lot of makeup. The fact that it is also skincare is great. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Heidi
headline: A Great Sheer Tint Balm
comment: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.  This tint balm is very light and feels light on face. It's perfect for those days when you dont feel like wearing a full face of makeup. Slightly blurs some imperfections.

author: Jess
headline: Great for mature skin and lightweight
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review]As I get older I don't use base/foundation as often. This feels just like it is labeled, like a serum on the skin. I like that it cancels out the redness and looks luminous. It did not have a scent that I could smell and was easy to apply. If felt lightweight and stayed on a decent amount of time.

author: Jennifer
headline: Beautiful skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sheer balmy face tint. The texture is very creamy,  it applies smoothly, and gives a sheer, glowy coverage. The color match is perfect for my skin tone. Since it is a jar packaging, the product is easiest used with a brush since I found it difficult to get the product out with my fingers. Not a deal breaker since the product works so wonderfully.

author: Tina
headline: Perfect tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sheer tinted face balm! The shade I tried is light warm 215.  The product goes on so smoothly-has a creamy texture- it literally melts into the skin as you apply it,  I started using my fingers for application but then used a foundation brush. It really goes on flawless and is so moisturizing. It leaves a dewy finish look. It goes on light but you can build this for heavier coverage. It really evened out my skin tone. There is a minor product scent but nothing over powering. I would 100% purchase this product and would recommend it.

author: BridgetP
headline: Great Tinted Skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is truly the ultimate "tinted skincare". This product comes in a solid plastic container with a simple twist off lid. This smooth and creamy formula has a "whipped" consistency. It is easy to apply and melts effortlessly into the skin. It is easy to apply with clean fingertip or with a brush- both have worked well for me. I love that this contains all of my favorite skincare ingredients including hyaluronic acid, vitamin E, and collagen peptides. This product provides perfect sheer/light coverage that masks imperfections while still looking natural. It provides a radiant hydrated finish without looking greasy or shiny. Over time, I have noticed improvements in the health, texture, feel, and appearance of my skin from regular use of this product. There is no noticeable scent. It this product is easy to remove. I have received so many compliments since I started to use this product.

author: Amanda
headline: Not for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited to try this foundation, but unfortunately it just didn't work for my skin. It clung to dry patches and noticeably emphasized texture. From a distance and in photos it looks fine, but up close it didn't sit well on the skin. It also requires setting, as it tends to smear and transfer if left unset. Overall, I wouldn't recommend this for mature, combination skin.

author: Joey
headline: Product blends easily and doesn't feel heavy on skin.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice product. It gives you a good amount and is easy to open and take with you on the go. The product itself goes on nicely and is smooth with a nice texture that blends easily and doesn't feel cakey or heavy. I don't really wear foundation but you could definitely use this as a light more sheer one and it's a good cover up to blend in small areas. I like this product and would recommend it.

author: Mónica
headline: A must!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review
The IT cosmetics  Do it all sheer tint face balm
Is an excellent light product 
Soft and easy to apply on my skin 
Looks amazing on the tone of my skin 
The pigmentation  looks natural without breakouts

author: Luciana
headline: This product is exactly what the name says.
comment: Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is your 4-in-1 skin-transforming tinted balm that delivers instant radiance and visible skin improvements over time. Powered by a 92% skincare base—featuring collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E—IT gives you sheer, buildable coverage that looks like your skin but is visibly smoother, more hydrated, and firmer. Available in 15 flexible shades. This product is exactly what the name says. It goes on very sheer and provides a light tint in a balm formula. The texture of this balm is silky and sheer with a little going a long way on application. My skin definitely looked smoother and plumper which seemed to hide some of my finer wrinkles, also, healthy look when the product is applied. The coverage lasted all day for me and my skin never felt dry. I was very impressed with the product and will continue to use it. I definitely recommend this product. I received a free product for the purpose of my review. Opinions are 100% my own.

author: Katmac
headline: Magic balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Liquid magic. That sums up this product. I have very red dry skin. This product laid beautifully over my skin. Don't be deceived it being a balm. It's not heavy or oily. Beautifully glowy on the skin but also a nice natural feel. The product layers nice for some more coverage where you need it. But overall it is a tint so you won't find full coverage. I work this in the city for 14 hours. I had no creasing. Product really hydrated and melted into my skin. Overall o did have some wear around my nose and mouth from eating and drinking by the end of the day. But was surprised it was still very little. I felt in my case a beauty blender applied the product perfectly. You could use your fingers. But I do not like putting my hands in my skin products. The jar container feels the perfect way to package the product and use.

author: P
headline: Not for me
comment: I really wanted to like this product.  The soft feel and cooling sensation were great.  However, it broke me out all over.  Also, it was not long wearing at all.  In no way would this stay put throughout the day.  I immediately went back to their CC cream and my skin cleared up almost immediately.

author: Beagle Mom
headline: Great Product
comment: I took a chance when I saw this product by IT. Paid full price and I'm not disappointed. Goes on smooth and with my old super sensitive skin it makes my face feel very hydrated. I've used IT for years because of the hydration. Definitely recommend

author: Laura
headline: Fantastic new favorite
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Listen to me I must have a minimum of 20 foundation underneath my sink. None of them look good. They all turn out cakey or too dry or settle in my pores while this is not a high coverage foundation for my oily mature skin I have never and I repeat never worn a better foundation. There was some days I would just leave the house because I said screw it. I'm not putting something on. I have to fix in an hour. I never now leave the house without this cause it's just so simple and fantastic to use.

author: MeoMotMui
headline: Lightweight, it doesn't dry my skin out
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   
 Unlike CC+ cream or foundation, which tend to feel heavier (to cover an uneven skin tone), this one is really lightweight compared to anything else I have used. I love how sheer it is on the skin, and it doesn't make me look like I am wearing heavy makeup at all.

   I love light makeup, so this works perfectly for me. Of course, this is not full coverage like a foundation (my dark freckles area need stronger option but the rest of the skin love this tint balm), because it's a tint. For a tint, the result is actually way better than I expected.

   I have dry skin, and this doesn't dry my skin out. When I check the ingredients, it contains peptides, hyaluronic acid, etc, so this is more like makeup with skincare benefit. And I enjoy it because it helps me save a lot of steps in my morning routine.

   The finish is radiant btw.

    In short, I'm definitely adding this to my make up list. This is a new happy discovery for me, so thank you so much for the opportunity to try it.

author: Michelle
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint feels so hydrating and refreshing. Made with skincare for those lines we all can't stand. It's a great coverage for adding daily wear to your skin. It blends nicely with fingers or tool. The packaging is great for traveling or daily use. The scent is nonexistent for me I like it. I will be bringing with me everywhere.

author: Monique
headline: Clocking tea
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

This tinted face balm is a total game-changer for tinted moisturizer. It pops the second you put it on and just gets better as you wear it. It hydrates your skin all day, and it's super easy to apply—though you might need a bit more product than you expect. My favorite part? It firms instantly and softens fine lines. The glow is natural and fresh—just that perfect everyday vibe. For the quality, the price is crazy good—I'd pay double and still feel like I won. You need to try this!

author: Kara
headline: I will be adding this to my makeup routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can say I was shocked by the performance of this face balm. It's very lightweight, blends in very well with my skin tone. Didn't leave my skin feeling dry, or greasy. And the overall look was great. I will definitely add this tinted face balm into my makeup routine again.

author: Nik
headline: Sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sheer Tint Face Balm is surprisingly easy to match to many skin tones. Goes on smooth with medium coverage. Apply with a foundation brush for best coverage.

author: Debbie
headline: Great for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm in love with this base product! I have mature, combination skin. I have so much trouble finding something that looks and feels good but lasts. I hate the feel of heavy products and most settle into wrinkles and look awful by mid day. I used my finger to apply and it melted into my skin beautifully. I have a very fair neutral skin tone but my freckles are very warm. This blended into just the right shade. I'm willing to spend a little more if it's worth it, and It is for sure! There doesn't seem to be any scent and blends I to a satin finish.

author: Jessica
headline: Natural looking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very natural looking balm.  I think the light warm 215 shade I was sent to review might be a little off for me. I think I need something more neutral and less warm.  However, this formula blends so easily into the skin that it didn't deter me from wearing it.  It's lightweight, has no strong smell , and doesn't settle into the lines of my face and evens out skin tone.  I found it was not drying or too matte either.  A real winner for those of us with uneven skin tone and aging skin!

author: Kathy
headline: Feels like putting butter on the dry skin
comment: It cosmetics did it again. Super moisturising, without looking cakey or settling in to fine lines. It will give you "no makeup look" makeup look. Super hydrating and melts as soon as it touching the skin.

author: LC
headline: May As Well Use Nothing
comment: All if that being said...we are in the middle of a brutal winter so...there 's that. This is notnwhat my skin needs right now.

author: Bizzybee
headline: A great touch up yes I would buy again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this face balm! It does exactly as described. It blends directly with my skin giving it a radiant glow. It's so smooth and glides over the skin. I start applying from the dark circle around my eyes and it blends with my face. A great touch up and go!

author: Lucy
headline: Great tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed this tinted face balm! The texture felt good on my skin, and I experienced a good amount of long wear. I enjoyed that I could apply it with my fingers and my face brush both.

author: Karen
headline: Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm - This is "iT"...
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was lucky enough to be gifted "iT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm" for my honest review.  Upon opening the glass jar, I immediately swatched the "Light Warm - 215" balm on my arm and it was a perfect match for me!  Next came the fragrance check...  No fragrance!  We were off to a great start!  Then it was time to try the balm on my face...  I applied half of my face with my fingers and the other half with a brush.  Both techniques worked well and the balm blended into my skin nicely.  I really like that it has a sheer, yet buildable formula.  It allowed me to put a little extra on my melasma while allowing it to peek through a bit so it doesn't look like I'm wearing anything.  I love that the balm provides a natural looking radiance...  I don't want anything on my skin that makes it look drier cakey. Most of all it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! I've been using this for several weeks now and I have to say that I am pleasantly pleased with "iT Cosmetics lDo It All Sheer Tint Face Balm"!  When I run out I will definitely get another jar!

author: Coco
headline: A Luxe Skincare Foundation- looks and feels amazing on!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am loving the ItCosmetics Serum Skin Tint. It feels so nice on the skin. It's cooling and super smooth when applying. I used a foundation brush to dip into the jar, it is a convenient and economical shape, nice for conserving product and not wasting. It Melts right into the skin and adds a sheer to medium coverage with a dewy glow. You can build it up depending on the coverage you prefer. It has a very nice soft light scent. Literally feels like a luxury skincare serum with some coverage. I would definitely get this again and recommend it for any skin type.

author: Abby
headline: Love ❤️
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how lightweight and natural this face balm feels on my skin while still evening out my complexion. It blends effortlessly and gives a healthy dewy finish without looking greasy or heavy. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day almost like I'm wearing skincare instead of makeup. It's perfect for every day wear when I want quick polish coverage with minimal effort.

author: Amanda
headline: Love this so much
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love everything about this. I have combination skin that's oily in the t-zones. This is so smooth almost like a lotion and I set it at first application and don't have to touch it the rest of the day. It's wonderful.

author: Chris
headline: Part of my daily makeup routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product comes packaged very well. The container is very sturdy. I placed the product on my hand first to see how it matched my skin tone. I have a fair to neutral complexion. It matched great, I was surprised. The product is creamy and spread well on my skin. It lasted all day. It has become part of my daily makeup routine.

author: Chris
headline: This is part of my daily makeup routine!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product comes packaged very well. The container is very sturdy. I placed the product on my hand first to see how it matched my skin tone. I have a fair to neutral complexion. It matched great, I was surprised. The product is creamy and spread well on my skin. It lasted all day. It has become part of my daily makeup routine.

author: Amanda
headline: Sheer and Moisturizing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because it is great for sheer coverage plus moisture without a heavy feel. I apply it with my fingers on the go and it melts right into my skin while providing sheer coverage. Easy to wash off with soap and water or my regular face cleanser. Definitely recommend for those wanting "less is more".

author: Devan
headline: Skin Loving Makeup
comment: The consistency of this face balm is stunning. During the dry winter months this is the type of product I need. There's enough coverage that blends out beautifully and hides some imperfections. I personally preferred using my fingers for application. I love the skincare serum benefits and makeup in one product.  I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Christi
headline: Great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very excited to try this since I don't wear much makeup anymore. Because it comes in a pot I had to use a brush to apply which is fine for me. It went on really well and I like how it was somewhat buildable. I like that you can still see me freckles. The only reason why this isn't 5 stars is because it isn't transfer proof.

author: Dawn
headline: Sheer tinted face balm- great for travel
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't notice any scent when applying the product.  It went on sheer and smooth.  I love the size of the face balm package which allows for ease in travel or taking it in your purse.  It doesn't seem to use much product when applying so it should last for quite a while.  My only negative was that I like a little more coverage.  I will definitely continue to use it though especially in the spring and summer.

author: Laura
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I do have to say that the color was not right for me, and that might have affected how I feel about the product. It felt ok texture-wise, but once it was on and dried, it was still really heavy-looking, even though it didn't cover like a heavy base. It was also a bit greasy, but not moisturizing—it never felt like it blended well or sank into the skin. Not a win for me, which is sucky because it seemed like it would be awesome.

author: Amanda
headline: Lightweight skin tint that still covers my blemishes
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint covered all my imperfections but didn't dry my face out. I have combo skin so sometimes it will peel but this done great. Products blended over it very well. It looks like skin not heavy or cakey. I do wish they had more shade options.

author: Bridget
headline: Great base
comment: This product worked out very well for me. It had a light powdery smell. The smell did not bother me, but it might bother other people. It lasted very long. It gave me a really great look and I got lots of compliments on my overall look. I feel a great base is a key to a perfect overall look.

author: Cat
headline: Nice lil balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this balm for no makeup days. It looks just like my skin but better. It does apply and blend well once it's thoroughly warmed up but is a little patchy until then. It is definitely very sheer coverage but the ingredients make it feel more like skincare anyway

author: Michelle
headline: Fantastic coverage!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is impressive. It smoothly covers my skin, evening out the tones and lines. 

I don't often wear foundation, however I do like tinted moisturizer. This does it all!  It did not cause any irritation or breakouts on my sensitive combination skin. I'm not sure I would wear this everyday. I will wear it when I want to look my best. Highly recommend!!

author: Elizabeth
headline: Effortlessly Fabulous
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This lightweight, radiant-finish tinted moisturizer and foundation balm in one is absolutely amazing. With buildable coverage to reveal a gorgeous and natural look. Ingredients to nourish you skin and reveal a smoother, firmer, more hydrated, and subtly blurred look. It went on effortlessly.

author: Erin
headline: Good coverage, very dewy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a good product. I typically like liquid foundations, but was pleasantly surprised at how good the coverage was. author: Jessie

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked how smooth the product went on. It felt very good and silky on my skin. author: Rachel
headline: Lightweight and buildable!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Tint Balm is a truly standout product. Infused with hyaluronic acid, it keeps my skin feeling hydrated throughout the day without settling into fine lines or creasing.

The packaging is thoughtfully designed, making it easy to pick up the right amount of product with a brush. It blends effortlessly and evenly, leaving no streaks. While the addition of SPF would make this product even better, it remains an excellent choice overall. I will definitely continue reaching for this face tint regularly.

author: Amf111

Removes very easily with a mild cleanser. Go buy this Face Balm. You will love it because it is so different from anything else out there.

author: Princess

author: A

The texture is very smooth and balmy, almost like a skincare product. If you have dry skin, this is an excellent product to give a natural finish.

My skin feels hydrated while wearing it, and it layers well with blush and bronzer for a simple everyday look. This is a great option if you love lightweight, natural-looking coverage.

I loved also how it didn't settle into lines or pores & instantly smoothed out my skin! My skin feels hydrated while wearing it, and it also blends perfectly with bronzer and blush for an everyday look!
This is absolutely the perfect option for anyone who loves a simple everyday look or a full beauty moment!

It gave me a well hydrated look. Excellent for days that ! don't want to wear a heavy full coverage foundation but it still want to look put together!
The removal was a cinch, and I love that it honestly feels like you just put on moisturizer, not make up! It's looks so natural, I love it!

author: Tina
headline: No Breakouts!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Been using this serum for the past few weeks, and I'm very surprised by this product. I'm 52, with normal, acne-sensitive skin. I usually wear tinted sunscreens or CC creams for my foundation, and this worked just like them. I got the perfect tone, and it absorbed into my skin effortlessly . I didn't use a moisturizer while trying this serum, and my face doesn't seem dry. We even got rare cold weather with low humidity the past couple of weeks, and I don't have any dryness around my nose like I often get in this weather. I can't speak for dry peeps, but this kept my normal (formerly oily) skin hydrated during winter. It did NOT cause any breakout. It's not expensive. It played well with my other serums. The only reason I don't see myself purchasing this in the future is that it doesn't have SPF in it. A lot of SPFs break me out, so I prefer to continue using a moisturizer with my tinted SPF. That is the only negative I found with this item. I can definitely recommend this serum, though.
