comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I cannot tell you how long I've waited for a product like this one! It's incredible. It's super blendable & the texture is soft almost lotion like but thicker. I love how it makes my skin glow & still has a light coverage!

author: Charmi
headline: A great everyday tint!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never used a skin tint balm before and I wasn't sure if I would like it. But to my surprise I have been wearing this a lot lately. It is blends in so effortlessly and feels like second skin. I love how I got a perfect shape match. Absolutely love how it makes my skin feels and gives me that natural finish without too much effort. Sometimes I just use it under my eyes and I am good to go.

author: Carissa
headline: Light and creamy
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
 I was pleasantly surprised by this product, it is so light and creamy. Feels wonderful on my skin. The face balm is so light but still offers a nice clean coverage. I would recommend this for easy wear and a no make up, make up look.

author: Terra
headline: I'm thrilled with this product!
comment: Oh my gosh, I'm in love with this tinted balm. I'm almost 44 and my skin has felt like it's turning into crepe paper no matter how much I seem to moisturize and keep humidifiers on all day this winter. All my expensive foundations that used to look nice just kept looking dried out on my face and it was aging me even more! I watched some video reviews of this product on various social media sites and decided to give it a try. I originally got 125 because reviewers said the 120 was really too warm and one review looked so yellow. The closest makeup match I've found for me is Ilia skin tint 2.5 Sombrio for reference, but I wish it was even fairer. I should have ordered the 120 originally. The 125 looked pretty good still, but just too pink for me especially as the day went on. What's in my photo is 120 fair warm. LOVE IT! It feels so nice on my skin. My skin looks so hydrated all day and I feel like I'm myself again. The pic is with no makeup on in the left and after 10 hours of wearing the IT Do It All balm on the right and it still looks great.

author: Denise
headline: Perfectly fit face balm and lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First time trying IT Cosmetics-Do it all sheer tint face balm, it easy to blend on my face. Perfect tint makes my skin feels light and the finish feels smooth and light.

author: L
headline: Sheer coverage. More skincare than makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is more skincare than foundation, so I think buyers should be cognizant that the coverage will be sheer. I like that the packaging is easy to open and the product seems easy to reach. I used my fingertips to apply the product since I was worried that the current packaging would cause bacteria growth if applied directly by brush. I will say that the product feels firm upon touch but then gets liquidy/creamy as you swirl it. Applying to my face requires to layers because the coverage is very sheer. If you're looking for lighter coverage and not the full weight of a foundation or bb cream, then I think this is a great product. I think if you're looking do the product to cover up blemishes, you'll be disappointed. It's not going to cover a freckle no matter how many layers. I do enjoy it and I could see me wearing it to the gym where I don't want to look fully dolled up!

author: Angie
headline: I would definitely buy this product again
comment: a nice creamy mixture easy to apply

author: Melissa
headline: Wow I like it
comment: Creamy and blendable. Feels good on my skin. Is a good value for your money.

author: Yennys
headline: Must have in my makeup routine…
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the IT DO IT ALL Sheer Tint  Face Balm for a while now, and I really enjoy how it feels on my skin. It literally melts like a butter when you apply it and once it's on, you barely feel it. It's super lightweight and comfortable, almost like you're just wearing skincare. The coverage is sheer but enough to even out my skin tone and make me look more put together without looking like makeup. What I like most is knowing it's actually nourishing my skin, that's a big plus for me because I don't worry about it drying my skin out or damaging it with long-term use. I reach for it a lot on casual days or when I want something quick, fresh and natural. It's simple, easy and does exactly what I expect it to do. It's fragrance free.

author: Julie
headline: 92% serum based
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love that this skin tint is good for your skin! It's 92% nourishing skincare based. Perfect for a light coverage on no makeup days. Covers redness and is so creamy.

author: Sara
headline: Must have!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been loving this Sheer Tint Face Balm way more than I expected. It gives just enough coverage to even out my skin tone without looking or feeling heavy. It honestly feels more like skincare than makeup, which I really appreciate.
The texture is super smooth and melts into my skin easily with my fingers. No streaks, no cakey look, and it doesn't settle into fine lines. It leaves my skin looking fresh, glowy, and healthy.

I also like that it has skincare benefits built in. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day, and I haven't noticed any irritation or breakouts.
Perfect for everyday wear when I want a natural "your skin but better" look. Definitely a new staple in my routine.

author: Anna
headline: Blends Perfectly
comment:
I absolutely love this tinted face balm! It melts right into my skin, and I love that it can be applied with my fingers or a makeup applicator. It has very buildable coverage and the texture is super creamy and smooth. 

I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles

author: Traci
headline: Do It All Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mixed feelings about this face balm. It seems to have the potential to be a great product - lightweight buildable sheer coverage, blends easily, skincare benefits. However, it's not compatible with my oily skin so it never fully sets and just enhances my shine. I tried it with a setting powder but since it stays so wet the powder just tends to soak into the product instead of setting it. Based on the other reviews, it seems to be a good product for people with normal/dry skin but I personally wouldn't recommend it for combo/oily skin types. I would prefer this type of product for daily wear but it's so hard to find anything that's compatible with oily skin. I would love to see some brands come out with a mattifying version!

author: Molly
headline: Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this face balm! I love how it goes on and the finish is really nice! The shade matched well especially in the winter and it wore really well!

author: April
headline: Must have for beauty lovers
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. At first, I was a little nervous about how dark the tint looked in the container, but after spending more time in the sun, it actually matched perfectly and gave my skin a really natural, healthy look.

I'm looking forward to using it more to see how well it helps with wrinkles and the other skincare benefits it claims. One thing I really love is how compact the container is — it's perfect for travel or tossing in a makeup bag without taking up much space.

When applying, it goes on super smooth and blends effortlessly into the skin, which is a huge plus for quick, everyday use.

author: AlexG
headline: Just buy it!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely adore this product. It's the first time I try a tint face balm and I'm hooked!!! It is perfect on the days I do not want to wear full makeup, but yet still have a little glam. The texture blends perfectly. It is light coverage and is more on the matte side. It is not sticky and the shade that I picked match my skin perfectly. This is definitely a product that I would buy again and again and again.

author: Vyasaveda
headline: Perfect coverage and match
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loveeee this so much it matched my skin tone perfectly, it was easy to apply, it gave me the perfect amount of coverage, it feels like butter it's so smooth and blends in so well, it's totally worth the price, I will definitely add this to my makeup bag from now on, when i was ready to remove it i used a makeup wipe and it came off without having to rub too hard.

author: Jennifer
headline: Perfect, lightweight moisturizing light coverage.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
 
I love the consistency of this product. It is very creamy and moisturizing. It does not stick to any of my dry spots and provides a lightweight light coverage base for my make up. The only minus I would say is I did request one of their neutral tones and it is warmer than I feel a neutral tone should be, but seeing that it's lightweight once it is blended in it does not appear to be as warm as it looks when you swatch it. I did receive this item free to test however I would absolutely purchase this on my own. As someone who is going to be turning 43 very shortly this is the perfect type of coverage for me. It is buildable. It works well with powders. It doesn't look cakey and keeps my aging skin looking youthful.

author: Larissa
headline: Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm by it cosmetics is super amazing. It feels like nothing on your skin but gives you that nice "your skin but better look". It blends in beautifully and I love that it comes in a glass potted jar. The formula is super comfortable and it feels like you aren't even wearing it.

author: Lindsey
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love the coverage and application this product, it is extremely smooth, and his color matching to your skin. It is extremely lightweight and easy to apply. The packaging makes it easy to travel with.

author: Natia
headline: I would buy this product again and again
comment:
I tried the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm and I'm honestly impressed! The texture is very lightweight and balm-like, making it easy to blend into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. The tint looks very natural and gives my skin a healthy, radiant glow.
I love that this is a 4-in-1 product - it works as skincare, a sheer tint, and a moisturizer all in one. It evens out my skin tone while still looking like skin, which makes it perfect for everyday wear and "no-makeup makeup" days.
My skin stayed hydrated throughout the day, and it didn't settle into fine lines. Definitely a go-to for anyone who prefers a natural, effortless look!

author: Kristina
headline: IT face balm does it all!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics Do It Sheer Tint Face Balm is lightweight, feels great on the skin, is very effective and long lasting throughout the day. I like to apply it after I've put on my concealer and I love to use a damp sponge. This isn't super heavy duty coverage, which I appreciate. I highly recommend that you check this product out.

author: Kels
headline: Like it a lot
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this tinted face balm. It has a very lightweight feel to it. It blends out nice and has a nice light coverage for me. It is like a your skin but better look. I like it.

author: Nicole
headline: Smooth and lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately I was sent the wrong color. The texture is smooth and creamy. No smells. Easy to slide on. But unfortunately I can't use because it's 3 shades to dark.

author: Taylor
headline: Instant GLO
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cosmetics! It's so creamy and smooth when applying. Your skin gets an instant glow! It buildable if u like a fuller coverage with caking up your face.

author: Kim
headline: Good option
comment: This lightly scented foundation is best used after exfoliating for those of us with dry skin. Otherwise it does cling to dry patches. It's light coverage but is buildable. I can't get full coverage out of this product but I don't think it's meant to be.

author: Jill
headline: Blends well!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Balm is a nice product! It liquifies when warmed by your hand, which allows it to spread easily. It gives good coverage and does not dry out my skin.  It is light-weight and blends well!

author: Blythe
headline: Great formula with an imperfect shade range!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation balm really is quite sheer and flattering. Excellent for those of us who want a healthy, natural looking finish. The texture definitely fits the term "balm" almost to the point of being mousse-like. It blends out very well, but manages to even out my complexion and cover any pigment discrepancies. Fortunately, it isn't heavy or cakey the way a lot of solid foundations are! It doesn't cling to my dry patches. 

That said, finding a shade match may prove to be a challenge. IT Cosmetics undertones are not the best. They lean a bit too yellow or peach. Since this product is so sheer, it's easy to get away with it, but it definitely isn't ideal.

author: Angela
headline: Simply amazing product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is amazing! It's supposedly a sheer but covers your face blemishes like no other face coverup that's this lightweight ever could or has that I've tried before. Smooth, matte finish that makes my face feel fresh and nearly makeup free. For the price point and the quality and not feeling the heavy cake like feeling that full coverage face makeup gives you. This is a big win for me.

author: Jessica
headline: Amazing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok I was skeptical at first. I guess a foundation brush and just went straight in to the pot and go on my face. It glides on like a skincare item and felt immediately a cooling sensation and hydration. Then the foundation just blends right in. It kept my dry face sooooo nice all day and after along day you can see in the pic that my face is still so flawless!!

author: Beatriz
headline: Full cover with natural finish
comment: It cosmetics, Do it all is a tint with great full coverage but with natural finish. You can apply with fingers o basically with anything, feel natural skin and soft. You love it! You can use on all your face or in the area you need including dark spots .

author: Caroline
headline: Obsessed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My new go to for concealer! It blends so well, and lasts for hours. It feels greats, lightweight and still provides coverage. My skin feels hydrated and plump, and not cakey. Highly recommend, won't regret it!

author: Deidra
headline: I would buy this again
comment: I got a shade too dark, but that's fine in the summertime. This will be the perfect shade for me because I do tan. I love the fact that it is sheer but there's a little tint of foundation in there and it's not something that's noticeable like my freckles still come through and it wears nice all day. It doesn't settle into the fine lines that I'm starting to get as a 40 year-old and I love the fact that it has skin care serum in it.

author: Monica
headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OK, where can I start? first of all the pigmentation is very sheer but still has enough coverage that it looks like you're barely wearing makeup. It's so lightweight that I had it on well over 12 hours and did not fill the need to wipe it off. This foundation is perfect for those no makeup makeup looks. I love it.

author: Amanda
headline: Love!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this. It's simple to apply, blends easily, isn't too heavy and keeps my skin looking blurred but not caky. At first I thought the shade would be too dark, but it blended into my skin effortlessly. I tried applying with fingers, brush, and sponge, and all options work well. It is a light coverage but is buildable. This works really well on aging skin, and I'll be purchasing this again once I run out.

author: Sushi reddy
headline: Great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The face balm is nice and the shade I have is little light but I was able to manage it,And the skin felt so well and the product has lasted for a good time and the texture looked smooth and glides great in to the skin and feels great..

author: Christine
headline: Easy to apply
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was a different product for me but glad I got to try it. It's a skin tint in balm form. I used a brush to apply and it gives you light to medium buildable coverage. It applied nicely and covered redness well. If you have darker spots or blemishes you'll need to use a bit more.

author: Ginger
headline: Skin care based
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm in love with how the IT Sheer Face Tint Balm makes my skin look and feel.  I've never used any type of tint or foundation that moisturizerized my skin like this balm does. The hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides and vitamin E base melts instantly when  applying. The color is sheer, buildable and blends beautifully.  My skin looks natural and radiant. I will never go back to using a regular foundation.

author: IAROSLAVA
headline: Creamy texture, good solution for a quick makeup.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Super nice creamy velvet texture. Very easy to apply and blend onto skin. Medium coverage. Stays all day, has a mate finish. Super convenient product for a quick makeup.

author: Marcelli
headline: Very lightweight
comment: It's a very lightweight and very light coverage product to use in your no makeup makeup days. I loved specifically to go to work. It build good with other products and I use makeup brush to apply. It doesn't have any scent.

author: Caroline
headline: Excellent product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Was very surprised by this product! I have combo/oily skin and was concerned about too much shine. When I applied it went on so easily and blended great. I was able to layer a little for additional coverage. It was my skin but better and didn't feel greasy. Love the skincare in this product and it feels like a two-for-one; skincare and a great coverage product for easy makeup days. I did set mine with a little powder and it lasted all day! Would recommend and buy again!!

author: Tommi
headline: Not my favorite
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted face balm is supposed to be neutral however it is a little bit on the warmer side. This is a cream based tint that glides on smoothly. I will use this on a casual day but not something long lasting

author: Kathy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have grown quite fond of using this product! It goes on great with my makeup sponge. It is definitely sheer coverage but it feels so nice on my skin! It stays put for most of the day. It pairs well with my IT concealer. It leaves a dewy finish which is better for my mature skin.

author: Janet

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It, do it all sheer tint face balm has a very light feel. I used a contour blender and a concealer brush to apply to see which one I preferred.  I liked the contour blender better for application.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A little intimidating to use at first. It most definitely leaves a tiny to the skin. On me this shade gives me like a peachy color. Not sure that I like it. I am super fair so it's hard to find light enough shades that don't turn me white or some sort of orange tint. I do like the small packaging of the product.

author: K
headline: Great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is great!  It's very easy to apply and it doesn't leave behind any residue! It doesn't get all cakey like some stuff does it literally feels like you don't have anything on your skin!

author: Devin
headline: I would by this product again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to trying this product, and it did NOT disappoint! It has a smooth formula that blends into your skin effortlessly! It's a nice light buildable coverage for everyday wear. It last all day long without melting off your skin. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a daily light weight foundation!

author: Kim
headline: A true "do-it-all" product
comment:
I honestly haven't tried anything quite like this. The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Balm truly lives up to its name—and then some. From the first application, it melts into the skin and delivers the most natural, healthy glow without feeling heavy, greasy, or overly shiny.

I've tried several IT Cosmetics products before and while they've been good, this one really stands out. The formula is sheer yet smoothing, evens out my complexion just enough, and somehow makes my skin look better the longer I wear it. It's effortless in the best way.

What really sold me is the versatility. I can wear it alone for a fresh, no-makeup look or layer it under makeup and it still plays beautifully—no pilling, no texture issues, just skin-but-better.

This balm has quickly become a go-to and a definite repeat purchase. If you love easy, flattering products that actually do what they promise, this one is absolutely worth trying.

author: Trisha
headline: Blends beautifully and wears well
comment: I was happy to receive this tinted balm free in exchange for my honest review. The color I received was classified as light neutral and seemed a little bit too warm in the jar, however, the color was a good color match to my skin after applied. I tested it out using a brush to apply and used my fingers at separate times and found both methods distributed the color evenly. The balm melted well into the skin and is very comfortable to wear. In fact, the makeup looked better after a few hours of wear then  when I first applied it. It's creamy and when applied to your face has a nice cooling effect. Make up layered fairly well on top of it. It dried down to a semi matte finish, but had a hint of moisturized glow. No fragrance. It is a great foundation to wear for daily, on the go use. I would purchase this product.

author: Dianna
headline: Perfect for the no make up feeling
comment: I received this to test from a website and I have to say I am hooked it's incredible. It feels so light on your skin. You only need a small amount you can build up the coverage a little bit I chose not to, but it's just really nice for women my age I'm 51 and it didn't settle in my lines. It just kind of blurred them.

author: Alison
headline: Great sheer long lasting coverage without weighing down skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has a smooth texture and glides on so silky. I love the dewy look of my skin when applied. It gives a hint of freshness with the sheer coverage.
Definitely doesn't weigh down the skin. It is also long wearing without making your skin feel tired or in need of refreshing. Extremely impressed.

author: Kara

comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is absolutely amazing lol, but seriously!!! Def recommend!! #influenster #itcosmetics #voxbox

author: Jenny

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this foundation balm! The coverage is light, which I adore, and the balm feels like a hydrating moisturizer instead of a stiff mask of foundation. The look is natural and lovely. This is the foundation I have been searching for my entire adult life!

author: Maria
headline: Skincare + Sheer ring balm mature skin approved
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a mature skin glamma I absolutely love the finish very hydrating glowy easy to apply lasted the whole day and suited my expectations to be completely honest this was definitely an amazing experience I've used it cosmetic in the past and I think the products is so worth it especially for mature skin but this truly will be added to my everyday definitely loved it pictures below are showing without makeup just one application and then final result

author: zaida

comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. First of all, thank you for allowing me to try this product. I'm always looking for products that help me achieve a fresher, more age-appropriate look. It helps cover those little age spots without feeling heavy, and I love it for everyday use.

author: ag318

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. IT cosmetics usually don't work for me because I have fair skin and the products are usually too dark or orange looking on me even in their "fairest" shade. However, this face balm is amazing. It does look darker in the container than it does when I put it on my face. It covers my redness and my vein in my skin without feeling heavy. The balm blends without much effort. It gives my skin a glowy hydrated look. I also love that it doesn't have any scent. I will be purchasing this when I run out.  Highly recommend.

author: Jackie

comment: I was so excited to try this bc i dont wear foundation but want a little coverage. I went and got color matched in-store and th color is perfection. My color is fair cool. Nice, buildable coverage plus the hyaluronic benefits make this tint a solid winner. Just buy it.

author: Cindihowru
headline: Glides on smoothly
comment: This product is awesome! I love how it matches my skin tone perfectly covering up any imperfections I may have. The product is compact but has a big punch with its coverage. It's light on your face and makes your skin feel and look moisturized throughout the day. I received this product for free for testing purposes

author: Trish
headline: You'll love it
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sheer tint far bam is an overachiever. It melts into the skin, leaving my face feeling hydrated, with a soft healthy glow. It never turns oily or greasy, even as my 36 year old skin gets more oil prone as I age. No scent, no irritation, just great product. 
The packaging makes it effortless to use, apply with a sponge or fingertips. It blends seamlessly and enhances my natural tone so my skin still looks like my skin, just on its best day. Wears all day without feeling heavy and I haven't needed to reapply.

author: Jamie F
headline: Summer glow in a bottle
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This do it all sheer tint face balm is amazing!!! Its packaging is easy to open and apply the product. I added it to my brush and apply to my entire face. It leaves my face feeling hydrate and tinted to take away those winter blues. The product is very lightweight but has decent coverage for being so sheer I have resorted to this instead of my concealer. At night, I use a makeup wipe to remove all makeup and it comes off easily. I have not noticed a difference in my fine lines with using this product but think I need more time to see results. So far I am very happy with this product.

author: Veta
headline: Sheer Face
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is perfect for those "no-makeup makeup" days. I love how quick and simple it makes my routine—just swipe, blend, and go. Great for busy mornings when you still want to look polished but effortless

author: Jessica

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is truly sheer and I think you can see the before and after effects - this doesn't cover my deeper acne scars but it does even out my skin tone and gets rid of my redness - it's a very light formula, almost whipped in texture - very light and airy - super hydrating which I need so desperately for this winter skin! Thank you IT Cosmetics!

author: Cline
headline: Love!!
comment: Im loving this balm. It hydrates my skin as well as provides great buildable coverage. Didnt break me out at all or clog pores. No cakey look either.

author: Steph
headline: I like it!
comment: I received this product complimentary to test. I have dry skin in winter and rosacea and this felt nice on my skin. I applied using a brash to blend it in. It gave me nice coveeand even covered my rosacea and blemishes. It doesn't settle into fine lines and gives a nice, natural finish to the skin

author: Stacey
headline: Loved the formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this tinted balm! It provides more coverage than I was expecting but still sheer. It looks like skin. It cancels out my redness and uneven skin tone. Blends out like a dream and feels like nothing when applied. Lasted about half the day before I had to reapply in areas around my nose. I would say it leaves a luminous matte finish.

author: Nora
headline: Nice lightweight coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Dream matte mousse is this you?? This product reminds me of my youth in a good way. You can see how well it blends and I did not have a line on my neck at all like that other product from ye olde times. This is smooth and perfectly blurs any imperfections. I wish it had SPF and I wish it came with a sponge or a tool to apply it as I hate dipping my finger in a container like this. I am going to experiment with a brush to see if I like that better.

author: Irina
headline: A must have in beauty routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this beauty balm. It has a very soft texture, it has buildable coverage and a little goes a long way. It blends well with skin and normally under the primer, it stays a whole day( u do couples touch ups through a day ). Cannot recall seeing any residue from it on my clothes.

author: Chelsea

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is amazing. I have bought so many different types of foundation tinted moisturizer you name it I have tried it. This has no scent the coverage is amazing perfect texture because it doesn't sit in my pores and lines. The color is great too perfect shade match.

author: Kathia

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Amazing all in one balm!! Goes on super easy and has nice coverage. It lives up to its name. Easy way to have a no makeup makeup look. Perfect for everyday or build it up for more coverage. It's my new go to!

author: Memorie
headline: Buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer skin tint is definitely true to its name - it's very sheer and buildable. It does cling to imperfections and doesn't cover them as well as I'd like, so I'd save this for a good skin day when I didn't necessarily want to apply a full face of makeup. The scent isn't overpowering and the overall consistency is nice and doesn't feel heavy on your skin.

author: Jennifer
headline: So easy to use!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So my photos show: the balm with no powder (no glasses) and then set with powder (with glasses on), and then after an 8 hour work day (no glasses again but you can clearly tell the rest of my makeup is messy lol). I'm 39 for reference and this is my first time trying a balm. I didn't use any primer underneath. I was very pleasantly surprised by the results!! It was so easy to apply and had decent coverage. From the look of the color in the pot, it looked darker than my skin but it blended in perfectly. I was also surprised by how well it lasted throughout the day, considering my office is 85*. I would absolutely buy this again. As I'm getting older, I'm appreciating lighter coverage.

author: Shari
headline: Nice for a light dewy look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] coverage is light but buildable. glides on easy and leaves skin with a dewy look. Too much leaves an oily look.  Too much can settle in fine lines. Overall good if used lightly for a dewy light coverage.

author: Markie
headline: Literally melts into your skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm has a creamy, lightweight, serum-like texture that literally just melts into your skin like butter. For this only being a sheer tint, it's very buildable with excellent coverage. I love the way that this feels on my skin. It applies so smoothly you don't even notice you have anything on your face. It is also so versatile with its 4-in-1 makeup benefits. This face balm visibly firms and minimizes the look of lines for smooth coverage with the help of collagen peptide, Hyularonic acid, and vitamin E. It provides 24 hours of hydration and plumps the skin too. This balm can really "Do It All" and it's so convenient to apply while on the go.

author: Jacquelyn
headline: Perfection! Light and build able
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ever since getting this I cant stop wearing it! It evens out the skin in a light build able formula. It wears so beautifully all day and really feels like nothing in the skin. Its natural and im in love with it.

author: Kristi
headline: Beautiful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a lightweight beautiful product. It's biuldable and long lasting. It's so gorgeous on the skin. It evens my skin out and feels weightless on my skin. Truly a great everyday quick easy face balm.

If u have perfect skin which I dont this might be for you but I have pigmentation and things I want to cover up. I do like the packaging. They usually give u and oz of product for foundation this gave u way less.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT never lets me down. Packaging is easy to open glass jar. Product gone one very well, so easy to apply. Feels very light weight. The coverage is phenomenal! This price is excellent.

author: Meghan
headline: Love This!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm absolutely obsessed with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! The sheer, buildable coverage gives a natural-looking finish that evens out my skin tone without feeling heavy or cakey!! I can't believe it's infused with ingredients like hyaluronic acid, green tea, and chamomile, which help to hydrate and soothe my skin!! I love that it's also SPF 50, giving me an extra layer of protection against the sun. If I'm running errands or just need a quick pick me up, this face balm is perfect for adding a touch of color and moisture to my skin!! It's truly a 'do it all' product that lives up to its name!!!

author: Stephanie
headline: A must
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is amazing especially for my aging skin. The fact that it has hydrating skincare in it is amazing. It blends like a dream and is the perfect match for my skintone. It's nice and light on your face and not heavy or cakey. It lasts too and blurs everything perfectly and now I can't live without it in my routine.

author: Kristen
headline: Comfortable wear, medium coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT DO it all Sheer Tint face Balm product is very comfortable to wear. My skin looks dewy and the redness is definitely reduced. I don't love the packaging as I have to dig into the product which isn't very sanitary. The ingredients are fine as far as they didn't irritate my skin but this product will definitely NOT be replacing my skincare routine.

author: AV
headline: Fantastic everyday product
comment:
I absolutely love this product. It is so sheer and natural and just blends into the skin! 

I've gotten so many compliments on how great my skin looks since using it and I think it's because people just realize that people don't realize that I have makeup on. It's really great.

The only thing to be aware of is this is for dry skin. If you have oily skin, you will probably not like this as it does get quite shin throughout the day (I use light setting powder to keep it in place).  Overall love it! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Kom
headline: Not a fan
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The application is easy, the feel is soft and creamy but thin and slick. After applying one coat, it disappeared with no trace. I tried building it, it seemed to just enlarge my pores and still provided no concealing or coverage. I can not say I enjoyed this, even though I really wanted to. I feel it not good for anything. It's supposed to provide some blurring but it didn't. It has no SPF or coverage. It provided me nothing but enlargement of pores.

author: Dawn
headline: Hydration hydration hydration
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've tried some of It cosmetics products and they've always been good. This tinted face balm is the bomb. It feels weightless on my skin. The balm feels hydrating and cooling. Coverage is good because it covered all my blemishes by applying just a little bit more in problem areas. It lasted all day until I washed it off. I like how my skin looked flawless. I would highly recommend this balm.

author: Keisha
headline: IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm: Skincare Formulation
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a creamy, lightweight consistency which absorbs easily onto the skin. The balmy texture is emollient with a smoothness to apply softly onto the skin which gives a natural, blurred finish which evens out the skin tone. IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm indicated this product has 92% Skincare Serum. Prior to application of IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm, I prepared my skin with cleansing, toning and sealing the skin with hydration. Then I applied the Sheer Tint Face Balm with my fingertips in sections and concentrated in the area instead of applying the product all over the face at once. I noticed that it makes a difference to work in sections to ensure that you are slowly building up the product onto your skin for coverage. This formula reminds me of a hybrid cream to powder. It applies like a cream but smoothies out to almost a powdery soft substance onto the skin. In addition the finish has a similarity of a demi-matte on my skin. There are ingredients which assist with anti-aging, softening and smoothing, hydrating and plumping of the skin with a peptide formulation.

The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sheer to light coverage but it will give an even out appearance on the skin. I really enjoy that it evens out my skin tone and gives a radiant, natural look to my face. This balm enhances my skin with a natural, soft look. During the application, I needed only a small amount for coverage in each section of my face. I pressed the product into my skin in certain places for extra coverage such as areas of my face with dryness. I have normal to dry skin. I do have some dry areas such as T-zone, jaw and chin on my face. If you have any dry skin on certain areas of your face, this balm will attach to those areas of dryness and minimally shows on the skin. It is not as obvious unless you are clearly focusing on the absorbency of the balm of your face. You may need to exfoliate the skin on your face to assist with additional smoothness and reduction of any dry textures on the skin.

The packaging is sustainable and clearly visible for product in glass jar. It has airtight lid which one must make sure to place on fully closed. You will want to be careful with storage of this product especially in a cosmetic bag, pouch or travel, carry on compartments. There is no fragrance detected during application or wear time throughout the day.

Duration of time, I have worn the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm for approximately 10 hours and still looks very nice on my skin. The balm does lightly transfer from the skin onto any facial protective gear such as a mask. I really appreciate a tinted face balm that stays mostly on the skin throughout the day. It means less touch ups and a beautiful finish throughout the day. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is ideal for anyone with normal to dry skin, mature, seeking a smooth, even out skin finish. I think it is a universal face balm for any skin types but the concern for combination, oily may need to reapply this product due to capabilities of transfer. The skin enhancing formulation is great for skincare benefits with anti-aging properties and keeping healthier skin with a beautiful face.

author: Jill
headline: great coverage but feels light!
comment: This product is very creamy and provides good coverage even on a dark spots. it feels light even when building coverage and lasts all day! I use it to even out my skin tone and am thrilled over all with it! I use a make up brush to apply and it works like a charm.

author: Pam
headline: Thinner than I thought
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was surprised at this product because it felt so different than it looked.  When I put on my face it was much thinner than I expected.  I thought it was going to be too dark but it was just right.  I like it ok but rather have my other makeup on my face.  I received this product for my honest review

author: RIShoegirl
headline: Fool me once…
comment: Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me teice, shame on me. I WANTED to love this soooo badly. The first time I wore it over my tried and true sunscreen and with a sponge. It looked terrible. I blamed the sunscreen. The second time I applied with a brush and it completely pilled. The LAST and FINAL time I tried it with my fingers and a pilling mess. I was so disappointed. I love a good glow! This unfortunately is a big fail for me. Will be returning.

author: Sasha
headline: Love!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't think i would love this because the color looks much darker than I am, but I was very wrong. On the face it blends in almost seamlessly and has such a wonderful, creamy texture for my drying skin. I liked it better without a primer and think it works wonderfully without it. It has very buildable coverage, i used both my hands and a brush to apply and both were very easy to do. I would prefer it if they came out with a couple more lighter shades. This is the lightest shade in the lineup and you can see it's actually pretty dark/orange.

headline: No for me

This product looks like nothing I. Your skin if it's the right color as you can see I tried to build just got worse and worse maybe for a teen doing a natural look I had high hopes but coverage, color, formulas all a no go and I love it cosmetics but this was a

author: Lisa
headline: Very dewy and light finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very lightweight face balm with a very light buildable tint. It is a really nice little product that comes in an easy to open glass container. I had to use a darker setting powder on top to finish and set.

author: Michelle
headline: Love the creamy texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Having dry, mature skin, I'm always looking for a lightweight foundation that absorbs without a tacky residue but leaves a glowing look. This foundation hit the nail on the head. It goes on super smooth, it is not heavy or greasy, and it doesn't make me look like I'm wearing a cakey mask. It's very hydrating, almost to the point that I can skin moisturizer. I don't use setting powder or spray, so it does transfer a little as the day goes on, but I imagine if I used one of those it would solve that issue. The color I was sent matched my skin tone perfectly. I have always been a fan of It cosmetics, and this is definitely another win for me. I received this product free in exchange for my honest review.

author: Betty
headline: I would purchase this product again.
comment: Love this product.

author: Nellie
headline: Cool stuff!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you're skincare lazy like I am, this product is the best. It's basically all the face things in one. Lotion serum balm foundation. I see why they named it "Do it all". It doesn't bother my sensitive, dry skin. It's basically a really thick foundation. Has the consistency of a cream blush. Covers redness well.

author: Rashmi
headline: A bit oily
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] ​This balm is a dream for a quick, "no-makeup" glow. It offers a beautiful sheer tint that evens out my complexion effortlessly. However, be warned: it is quite oily. While it's incredibly hydrating for dry skin, those with oily or combo skin will definitely need a setting powder to keep the shine from getting out of hand by midday. Great for a dewy look, but a bit slick!

author: Gloria
headline: Light and airy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all I chose a darker skin color than I am, but that was my fault. I made it work though. It'll be perfect during the summer. It's super light feeling and easy to apply. I dabbed it on over my face and what I like about this texture is that you can easily spread it to the rest of your face with your hands when you're in a pickle. I, however, have been using my sponge which blends it flawlessly. It glides on smooth and it's not super pigmented. Once you spread it, it's more in the lighter side. It's easy to blend. You need primer as well as setting spray though because it's easy to rub off possibly unlike your traditional foundation. I like that it's easy and quick and it doesn't feel heavy. It'll be great for travel.

author: Tatiana
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am impressed by the product, the texture is amazing! It's lightweight, creamy, melts right into skin and doesn't feel heavy or greasy at all.  Perfect for busy mornings

author: Mac
headline: Great for a natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is very sheer and perfect if you want very light coverage for that natural make-up look. I found it to be a slightly greasy but if you skip  moisturizer or wait for it to set in, it's not bad. It's honestly hard to tell how long it lasts because of how sheer it is.

author: Charlotte
headline: Great tint face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this Tint Face Balm and it suits well on my face and with my skin, my face is more brilliant and soft. Easy to apply and absorbs very well. There is a nice scent, not strong that is good for me.

author: Angela
headline: Amazing moisturizing and gorgeous skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula for this balm is genius. It is highly moisturizing, lightweight and feels like you're wearing nothing on the skin. It is pigmented enough to balance the redness in my skin without covering my freckles, but can be applied with a brush for fuller coverage. It is extremely blendable and forgiving, and I'll be wearing it as my main foundation choice all summer.

author: Brandi
headline: Nice and blends well
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. 

I am in love with this product! It do it all sheer tinted face balm is nice and creamy. I apply it with my makeup sponge and goes on nice and sheer with some coverage. It applies nice and smooth and really makes my skin glow and feel pretty without looking heavily done.

I have the Light Neutral 210 and is perfect for my skin tone. I really love how it looks and this jar will last a long time. I would absolutely recommend this product.

author: Hannah
headline: Perfect Formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This didn't end up being a perfect shade match for me right now in the winter, but the formula is 1000/10! It feels so weightless on the skin, but provides a nice sheer coverage. It looks really good on the skin, and it wears well throughout the day. This would be perfection in the summer with a little blush for a natural look.

headline: No coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is extremely sheer. Described as a sheer tint face balm with 92% skin care, serum, keep in mind, this will not provide you with any coverage at all. This is in the shade fair warm 120 which is good for my light, neutral skin tone. I was a bit surprised as I was hoping that it provided a little bit more coverage though again it is described as a sheer tint, which is what it provides personally it doesn't work for me because I do prefer light coverage and this was barely anything.

author: Kendra T
headline: Good but very sheer
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Extra sheer. Heavyvon the sheer. This product give a barely there coverage. It was super light and easy to wear. It lasted a few hours and then I could notice spots. It was easy to remove.

author: Vicky
headline: It cosmetics perfection for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It cosmetics is a favorite brand of mine. This do it all balm looks dark at first. However once applied it smooths out light on the skin. It created dewiness and smoothed over wrinkles and fine lines without settling into those areas. With the magic of skincare this is a new favorite product for many to come. I'm a light to medium neutral beige in most foundations and medium 315 was my shade

author: Nataliia
headline: Natural Glow Made Easy — it DO IT ALL Sheer Tint Face Balm
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review, and it quickly proved to be a wonderful addition to my daily routine.

This sheer tint face balm shows that everyday makeup can be both simple and high-performing. The packaging feels elegant and functional, making application quick and convenient.

The texture is more like a serum than a traditional foundation. With 92% skincare ingredients, it feels nourishing and lightweight on the skin while providing a soft, radiant finish.

Coverage is light but noticeable — perfect for smoothing the skin tone and creating a healthy, fresh appearance. Shade Light Warm 215 blends seamlessly and enhances the complexion with a warm, natural glow.

Considering its performance, design, and skincare-focused formula, this balm offers great value for the price. It's an ideal "do it all" product for daily use when you want comfort, quality, and a natural look in one step.

author: Patti
headline: New add to my daily routine!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth application, nice evening of tone without feeling cakey in the least. I've been using this daily for about 2 weeks now and it has not only held up well in extreme weather conditions (ice storm with wind and southern Florida humidity), but really has improved the hydration to my skin, enough so that colleagues have noticed and complimented. Pigment is light, and smooth, buildable if needed. The before/after shown here is a single application. With an additional application, more coverage is achievable and still feels light. Its little screw cap tub is easy to throw in your bag and take along when winds make you feel like you need some moisture or you might need a touch up while out. It's now going into my daily routine.

author: Claire
headline: Good coverage, silky smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT cosmetics products. It's is a decent coverage, silky smooth, concealer adjacent products. It dries mat and seems hydrating. I chose color fair cool and I should have chosen a lighter shade, this is a little too deep/warm for my fair complexion and reads orangey. If I had the correct shade, I think this could be a go to staple.

author: Liz
headline: Great pre-foundation step.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all, I really like the feel of the product. It has such a great satin finish. It's lightweight, the packaging is really effective and easy to carry on the go. Plus, it's not too heavy so it's great for the use of a good make up remover. The product feels very smooth and not so sticky.

author: Johnna
headline: Nice tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product! The consistency is nice and light and feels weightless on the skin. There's no noticeable scent that I can detect. The shade is a good match for my skin tone also. This product is easy to remove also. The only thing I'm not crazy about is that it has very little coverage, but it is only a tinted balm.

author: Stephanie
headline: Light, comfortable coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I have incredibly sensitive skin. Almost everything irritates my skin or my eyes. This did not! The texture of the balm is smooth and creamy, but light and thin. I don't love the container, but the product is great. It applied easily, and I did not feel like I had anything on my skin. It provided light coverage, so I did two layers to cover my bright red acne. The makeup lasted a 30-minute walk outside, and all day after.

author: Amber
headline: Sheer foundation with added skincare benefits
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Do it all sheer tint face balm has a creamy consistency. It's very easy to apply and is blendable. It does a good job at hiding skin imperfections while feeling light on my face. It has added skincare benefits to minimize the look of fine lines and hydrate skin all day. It also makes my skin look radiant. It's perfect for more mature aging skin.

author: Latasha
headline: I would wear this everyday
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   Do it all sheet tint face balm blended flawlessly into my skin and gave my complexion the most beautiful natural glow the lightweight serum formula makes it perfect to wear alone for a effortless everyday look it it also work beautifully as a base if you want to build coverage it's last all day  moisturizing minimum coverage a little will do the job

author: AprilB
headline: My winter savior!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I finally found my go-to for the dry winter months. I struggle with dry patches that usually make foundation look flaky, but this Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is a game changer. It provides just enough coverage to even out my skin tone while making everything look hydrated and smooth. It's moisturizing without feeling greasy and leaves a beautiful, youthful glow. If you want a 'your skin but better' look that won't cling to dry spots, this is it!

author: Denise
headline: Natural Nude
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I swear this was the perfect match on color. I was able to see the difference of the tint upon application. I wanted to be fair so only put ok the tint and mascara. Very happy with the formula it is almost as a lotion my skin looks hydrated and the pigment is appreciated too, since after application I didn't feel any need to add extra. A Little did go a long way so for the cost it can be stretched but I do have a drug store version that works just as great so for me this would not be a regular buy. However it does hold up to its quality and that is important when the ticket price is higher. As for the application I applied with hands and a sponge, preferred the sponge, it is more like a foundation and the packaging may be a little tricky once I reach the bottom. I like the tube version more than the  bowl.

author: Aura
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These tint is perfect. Your face looks so pretty and so fresh. I like that it still looking good like eight hours or more. It's very light so you cannot feel your face and it's perfect.

author: Elana
headline: Glowing skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm!  It evens and brightens my skin tone and covers issues with looking cakey. My skin feels hydrated and still looks natural.

author: Nikki
headline: Silky smooth skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how silky, smooth this balm is. It's super lightweight. It stays on al day too. The color was a little dark on me. It stayed on the back of my hand while doing dishes and going to work. My coworker tried it out and said she really liked it too. Iight coverage.

author: Alicia
headline: I would by this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This application is just wonderful and I love the texture glides right on. The color is perfect for my skin tone. The pigmentation is amazing. Overall I love this product.

author: Tiera
headline: rich warm 505 it wears beautifully
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very grateful for the opportunity to try out the it cosmetics Do IT ALL skin tint balm. I loved testing it out because it definitely is being loved already. I want to note that it was a perfect shade (rich warm 505 ) match for my complexion and skins under tones which was perfect. The skin tint balm is a sheer to build able coverage without any sents, it's also pretty quick and easy to use and wear. I am truly amazed by the way that it blended into my skin really well. Like a weightless moisturizer in my perfect complexion shade match. It has a great longevity wear time because it's a sheer complexion product that appears to improve the look of your skins appearance overall. I noticed my skins natural radiance while wearing the product. I'm enjoying it 10/10 would definitely purchase it for backup.
I'm in love with this skin tint balm and I'm usually into medium buildable coverage. 
The it cosmetics skin tint balm is like your skins better version of itself. It works great with other products also. Setting it was optional for me.

author: Helen
headline: Aging Skin Approved: Smooth, Natural, All-Night Wear
comment: I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for free in exchange for my honest review, and it quickly became one of those effortless products you keep reaching for. The balm went on incredibly smooth and melted into my skin without tugging or emphasizing texture, which I really appreciate as my skin is aging and has some natural redness. The coverage is sheer but surprisingly effective, it evened out my skin tone and covered redness beautifully, and while it's buildable, I honestly didn't feel like I needed to add more. The finish is natural and healthy, giving that "your skin but better" look, and the skin scent is light and pleasant without being overpowering. Performance-wise, this impressed me the most, it lasted all night without breaking down or settling, and my skin still looked fresh hours later. Overall, it's an easy, flattering face balm that delivers smooth application, great wear, and a natural finish that feels comfortable all day.

author: Christine
headline: weightless coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm feels smooth and comfortable on my skin. It is a perfect match to my skin tone with great coverage. It feels weightless on my skin. I really like the texture and the feel of it on my skin. .

author: Alicia
headline: Finally!!!
comment: I have been trying my hardest to find a suitable tinted moisturizer/foundation that gives me the no make up look while also covering my dark spots, and I believe this is it. The way this lays on my skin while also loving on my skin is just everything I wanted. I'm oily in my tzone and this didn't make me shiny by noon like other products I've tried. It feels very light and lasted all day. I'm in love with this product basically.

author: Jenny
headline: Great premise, but a total miss for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited to try this because I love a good makeup-meets-skincare product, but this one just didn't work for me. The formula felt less like a balm and more like a cream-to-liquid sheer foundation with an odd texture that separated easily. Almost like water was added to it.
It did have a nice cooling effect on the skin, but I didn't notice any real skincare benefits. I used Light Neutral 210, and unfortunately it wasn't an exact match. Regardless, it didn't do much for me.
For reference, I'm 49, and I wouldn't recommend this for well-cared for-mature skin unless you already have very even tone and texture. I love the concept and had high hopes, but this one was a miss for me.

author: Jocelyn
headline: Not it
comment: Was looking for a lighter more moisturizing product so was excited to try this, but it's a big no for me.  It feels like you are applying butter to your skin and stays that way.  I tried using some setting powder but it just never sets, and if you use eye makeup, it melts off after a few hours..  I do however love the CC cream so I'll just stick with that until I can find something with lighter coverage and better staying power.

author: Kat
headline: Great all-day wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product. I applied it with a damp makeup sponge and it goes on nicely. Very buildable. I also tried to apply with my fingers but better and more efficient with beauty sponge. Stayed on all day. I wore this as is (nothing else) during a winter beach vacation. The only time it came off was in heavy heavy wind. Nice finish. I have dry-normal skin and have some skin sensitivity but was good with this. Comfortable on the face.

author: Dawna
headline: Fabulous product - buildable coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I normally don't use products that leave your complexion with a "dewy" finish.

However, I fell in love with the it Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm (Fair Cool 125).

It has such a lovely, soft application.  It is buildable, but with my fine lines, I applied just enough to give some color.  I don't like to wear heavy foundation.  The hydration it gave lasted for hours!  It has a pleasant, light scent.  

I received a lot of compliments on my makeup the days I wore it.

author: Glynis
headline: Not for me but maybe for you
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I included before and after photos using this product, and I don't think this balm does much for me. The finish falls flat, and left my skin looking a little dull rather than luminous. It IS a sheer tint, but I wish it was more buildable for spots where I need a little more coverage. This product might be better for someone with much dryer skin. I also find the color confusing. For a cool shade, the color read as definitively warm on my skin. I also wish it had some modicum of SPF. Just not a fit for me, I will stick to my Korean bb creams.

author: Maggie
headline: Lightweight & hydrating with nice coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm so happy to have found this product. It really perfects my skin and looks very natural.  The formula is super lightweight, hydrating and  non-greasy.  It feels cool when I apply it to my face and definitely blurs imperfections without being cakey. It's very sheer, yet covers everything.  I wore it all day and it looked as fresh as when I applied it.  I got light warm and it's not yellow. My skin glows when I wear this.  My new go-to.  The jar travels well too.

author: Andrea
headline: Versatile
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  this skin tint is amazing. It really does wonders for your skin. It's very versatile. You can definitely use it to contour your nose and face. It has a very variety of options that you can use it for. It's definitely one of the kind it blends easily no scent. The packaging is easy to open, and it will do wonders for your skin texture. Looks flawless on our skin types, even though this is darker than my skin tone I love it

author: Felicita
headline: Love the coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm!! I don't like to wear a lot of make up nevertheless heavy make and this product is just what I wanted and needed. It leaves my face feeling bright and refreshed without covering my freckles etc. It's also moisturizing with is a huge added benefit.

author: Sara
headline: Love!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this tinted face balm! It's very lightweight and blendable. Easy to build coverage in certain areas. Applicable with fingers or a makeup sponge. Very comfortable and long wearing. Love that it has skincare in it as well!

author: Liubov
headline: Love it 🥰
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this tint, it feels much lighter than foundation. If you usual mix your foundation with a toner, this a great alternative. It has pleasant scent, blends beautifully, doesn't go to patchy, and doesn't mattify the skin. Good packaging and dewiness.

author: kay
headline: love!
comment: I absolutely loved this.You barely fill it on your face.And it says sheer, but I think it gives more coverage than just shear. It definitely cancels out some of my red.And I am going to turn to this for my everyday foundation, love it.

author: Kat
headline: Interesting
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint comes in the form of a solid in a glass jar. It's small enough for travel. I found the shade range limited, but was lucky I chose the correct shade. I'm a light medium neutral, right now I would say I'm a light neutral because it is winter. The shade I chose was Fair Cool 125. My skin prep is very simple, I don't use a ton of skincare nor a primer. My skin type is normal at the moment but sometimes can be combination. I used a spatula to apply it onto my face and blended the product in with a brush. It blended beautifully and was a skin like finish. The coverage is sheer to maybe medium. Unfortunately this isn't long wear. After a couple hours (even if set with powder) it looked greasy… especially around my nose. It looked beautiful upon first application but I would not wear this for more than 3 hours.

author: Debbie
headline: I wanted to love this, BUT….
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for my honest feedback.  First off, I wanted to love it as I use other products from IT cosmetics.  
The Good:  I liked the packaging.  Super easy to put in your purse and go.  You can use clean fingers or a brush to apply.  Consistency is nice.  Not heavy.   A mousse like texture.  The product did last the full day.
The bad:  color did not look good on my skin.  A bit too yellow for my liking.  I was hoping that it would be more moisturizing but it made my dry skin patches look terrible.  Winter time is hard on my skin.  I tried a primer but that didn't help.  It did not cover my imperfections.  Kind of made them look more noticeable.  I think this would be fabulous product more moisturizing and provided a little more coverage.  I did not think the color matched my skin.  Also it made me breakout.

I do like the concept but being a bit older I feel I need a bit more coverage.

author: Kimberly
headline: Creamy and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall I really liked this face balm. It's creamy and doesn't sink into your lines and wrinkles. Plus, a little bit goes a long way. The only drawback is that is goes on much lighter than how it looks in the container. Holding the balm up to my skin it looked like it matched perfectly, but was way too light to match my skin tone. However I've been using it as a concealer and it works great.

author: Mandy
headline: Light weight and hydrating
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The face balm is light weight with good coverage. The product has a thin consistency and was easy to apply and blend. I have normal skin and found it to set down and stay on my face well. It left my skin feeling hydrated and not sticky. My only complaint is that the shade I got was a bit too dark.

author: Denise
headline: All-in-1 Game Changer!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I received the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Tint Balm in shade Fair Cool. 125. The color in the jar appeared darker, which made me a bit nervous. But when I applied it, it blended beautifully and matched my skin tone perfectly. As implied in the name, it really is a game changer and does it all - this is a buildable serum face tint. It firms, hydrates and minimizes fine lines. The finish is a glowy, radiant look, without being shiny. And it lasts all day while feeling like there is nothing on your skin at all. I didn't notice any heavy fragrance, which was a plus for me!

author: Annmarie
headline: Glides on
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoy using this bomb it has a lightweight feel to where you're not wearing anything and gives your skin a nice glow  easy to apply just use your fingertips and go shade is perfect for my complexion gives me a glow highly recommend

author: Samantha R.
headline: Will buy this product!
comment:
I recieved this product complimentary for my opinion. 

This product is amazing. Goes on effortlessly and flawless. It is not cakey or greasy. I woudl recommend this producy and will buy it. I love it!

author: Katy21
headline: Balmy Skin Tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is truly as the name suggests, a face balm which has a tint of color to it. The product comes in a thick glass tub and feels elegant. I picked the color light Neutral 210 but it's slightly orangey and is not the perfect shade match. May be a cool toned shade would have worked better for me personally. 
Besides, it blends so easily and is perfect for when you want light coverage in a short amount of time. It doesn't fade out and perfect for mature skin.

author: Dora
headline: Love it!
comment: I love this makeup! It feels light but has great all day coverage!

author: Ann
headline: Creamy, truly sheer face balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Light Neutral 210 blew my mind!! I was super impressed at the look, feel and overall claims of this face balm. The texture is like creamy butter that literally and I mean Literally melts into your skin -so good. Which in turn makes blending into the skin a dream.  The shade and pigment are pretty spot on so this truly makes it a 'sheer tint' as it claims. I can't speak too much to its skincare claims other then its moisturizing enough to leave the skin looking refreshed and not oily or shiny. 
I really like using this face balm for everyday use when you want to just touch up dark circles or to smooth uneven skin texture or shade. It can be worn for a simple look or a full face. My only complaint as with most mainstream makeup is the ingredients. Id love to see this with cleaner more natural ingredients.

author: April
headline: Natural look for the win
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint face balm has improved my daily makeup routine.  It hydrates my face when I apply it and it hides my blemishes.  It leaves a shiny look which I love without the greasy feel.  It gives my look a more natural one.

author: Nicole
headline: Loving this face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this Do it All sheer tint face balm from IT costmetics! It goes on so smooth and easy and looks great. It's not heavy like other products I've used from IT. It feels light and like I'm just putting moisturizer on the skin. I LOVE that it has skincare ingredients and is benefiting my skin when I wear it! Such an amazing concept! Easy to remove, just washes off. Last me all day and gives a healthy pretty glow to the skin. Not greasy or oily, and I have combo skin. I am so happy I got this to try! I will be purchasing it when I'm out!

author: Mystina
headline: Buildable, blendable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Buildable, blendable coverage that lasts. Really fantastic as far as texture and lasts all day! I love how good my skin felt after use, and that I could build up to my desired level of coverage.

author: Jessica
headline: sheer tint face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sheer tint face balm is a nice alternative to the usual liquid options. The shade I received is a bit too orange for me but it does have nice coverage. I am not a huge fan of balms because I like the coverage of a liquid better but that is my personal preference. I personally wouldn't purchase this just due to the application process. If you're a fan of balms though, this would be great for you. It's moisturizing and has more of an oily texture going on but dries perfectly.

author: Amy
headline: Makes skin look like skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.  It's thin and kind of melts into my skin, which is exactly what I want.  Many foundations look terrible on my dry skin.

A little goes a long way and spreads evenly with very little effort.  The coverage is light, like almost not there.  It evens things out and just makes my skin look and feel like… skin.  

It doesn't last all day, but that doesn't really matter to me.  My make up doesn't need to last all day and I'd rather it fade naturally than get weird and patchy.

author: Isabel
headline: So natural!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product complimentary for review, but please know that my opinions are unbiased.
This is my new holy grail base product! I love sheer coverage bases and thus far balm offers a very natural dewy glow. It's easily to apply. I simply use my fingers. It's easy to blend in and is easily buildable, as well. Removal is easy with a cleansing cloth and face wash. Love how the face balm has skincare properties to it. I haven't used it long enough to know if it helps my skin, but it at least  does not break me out. A great product overall!

author: Brittany
headline: Great foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This may be a small container but a little goes a long way. It goes on smooth and not cakey at all. It matched my color perfectly. It also stayed on all day.

author: Fio
headline: Sheer finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm is all I want for the coldest days in the city. I need continuous hydration and nourishment on the skin but I want it to have a nice appearance as well. It's great when I don't want real foundation but still want my skin to look more alive. The coverage is very light, it just softly evens things out instead of hiding everything, which I actually love for a natural look.
It feels also very nourishing, like skincare with a tint. My skin feels comfortable and hydrated all day, not tight or dry. Fine lines look a bit smoother just because my skin looks more plump and fresh. It's perfect for no-makeup makeup days, or when I want my skin to breathe but still look polished.

author: Melissa
headline: Still feels like my skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Interesting texture! First tried to apply with my fingers and found it to be a little difficult to spread. It melted quickly when I touched it but just didn't seem to be able to get enough product to spread. The packaging made it difficult to use a blender initially so switched to a brush and that worked pretty well! Had a few areas that looked a little streaky initially but overall good coverage that still feels like my skin. 
I did receive this product free in exchange for my honest review.

author: Melissa
