comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Interesting texture! First tried to apply with my fingers and found it to be a little difficult to spread. It melted quickly when I touched it but just didn't seem to be able to get enough product to spread. The packaging made it difficult to use a blender initially so switched to a brush and that worked pretty well! Had a few areas that looked a little streaky initially but overall good coverage that still feels like my skin.

author: Jaimie
headline: Buildable coverage! LOVE!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love that I was able to try the IT Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Tint Face Balm. Honestly, I loved the lightweight, build-able coverage. It never felt heavy on my face & wore well with my complexion. It also did not accentuate any wrinkles or imperfections, which is a huge plus! Overall this is a big win in my book!

author: AJ
headline: Perfect no makeup skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this for no makeup days, beach or lake days or a day that you want a little coverage. The tint is sheer but has some build ability to it. It's lightweight and wears great when set with a powder. I have dark  under my eyes, redness and a few blemishes that this helps cover. I have worn it by itself, with concealer to cover any places that were poking through, underneath makeup or even as a concealer on top of light weight foundations. It doesn't break my sensitive skin out. Travel friendly package. Can be applied with a sponge, brush or even your hands. I prefer a brush for a buildable coverage.

author: K
headline: Very nice texture
comment: This product goes on smooth and gives a nice coverage. It does seem to wear off after a few hours. Overall, it's excellent and leaves skin feeling wonderful.

author: Maureen
headline: Great find!
comment: I love this product. I was looking for something for mature skin that looks natural and this is it. I highly recommend.

author: Shellie
headline: Best foundation!!
comment: Love this foundation as I have dry skin! It's like skin and goes on very smooth.  I will definitely buy again.

author: Bobbi
headline: Beautiful
comment: I received this product for free for my honest review! I have mature skin and this look beautiful on my skin! Blends like butter! Wasn't expecting to like this as much as I did! I'm impressed!

author: Michaela
headline: Your skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
Lightweight, hydrating, and super easy to wear. The tint blends seamlessly and gives a natural, skin-like finish without feeling heavy. Shade Deep Neutral 615 is a great true neutral—perfect for a polished "no-makeup" look.

author: Jamie
headline: Really impressed!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my favorite tinted serum! I wasn't sure what to expect but its amazing. It goes on light a breath of fresh air and dries perfectly into your skin. It gives coverage but not enough to make it look overdone.

author: Mariela
headline: Perfect match: Skincare and color correction
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this! The color is perfect for me. It blends in easily. I apply with 2 fingers. All you have to do is rub it and it melts immediately. I love how smooth it makes my face and it cover any imperfections I may have like a light foundation without the feel of make up. I will definitely continue to use this as I'm loving the no make up look.

author: Ashley
headline: The "Wait, Is This Even Foundation?" Skin Tint I Keep Reachi
comment: I went into IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm with high hopes, mostly because I have been burned before. Last summer I bought that viral Milk Makeup product everyone was raving about, and on me it just felt heavy and ended up sitting in a drawer.

author: Lacy
headline: Love IT!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Perfect color match for my skin tone! The silky cream foundation glided on so smoothly to my skin and blended perfectly. My face feels soft and it stayed all day. Still looks like I just applied it.

author: Ashley
headline: Amazing tinted face balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer tint face balm is amazing! I was a little skeptical at first but it went on so smoothly. The texture is really nice and soft and it blends extremely well. I wore it out all night and it still looked great when I got home. It it super easy to remove with makeup remover. I would definitely recommend!

author: Oksana
headline: Good , but not perfect
comment:
The tint face balm is not bad overall, but the effect feels a bit weak. The application is easy and smooth, and the texture is comfortable on the skin. The scent is light and pleasant, which I appreciate.

However, the coverage is quite light — I can still clearly see skin imperfections underneath. In terms of suitability, it works better for those who prefer a very natural look rather than full coverage. The longevity is average; it stays on for a while but doesn't last all day without touch-ups.

Overall, it's a decent product for light use, but not ideal if you're looking to fully hide skin imperfections.

author: Ana
headline: Great coverage, lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow I love this foundation!! It has really nice coverage and the color is perfection. It's a balm so it's nice and hydrating! Wears comfortably and feels weightless! It was easy to remove but stayed in place all day long! It might be a bit expensive but it's so every penny!! I feel like It cosmetics always gets it right!! I love all their formulas!!

author: Lisakk
headline: Light Weight Good Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a wonderful tinted bakm. It feels light. It gives up to a medium coverage. It has skincare which is a plus. It is very easy to blend. It wears very well. I have oily combination skin so it will get some glow after 4 hours. It doesn't break down so it is a winner. The color is perfect. I am enjoying using this. It is great for a quick no makeup makeup day. I recommend it.

author: Alicia
headline: It's a nice skin tint.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Fo It All face balm is nice. It's definitely a creamier texture to it. The skin tint blends out pretty well with either fingers or a brush. Although a brush lays more product on your skin. The color is just a touch dark but this is usually the case for me with It Cosmetics products like this. Overall it's a nice product.

author: Samantha
headline: Not what I hoped
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My first complaint off the bat is that it oxidized quickly. I got shade Light Neutral and it was basically a light orange. I am testing this in the winter months but I did notice that it clinged to my dry patches.

author: Katie
headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula is very lightweight. I prefer applying it with a brush over my fingers. It provides a light coverage - more pores and texture still show through. It does not feel heavy though. I like it for during the day

author: Bobbie
headline: I'm a fan, IT Cosmetics.
comment:
I didn't know what to expect from a tinted balm, but I quickly realized that I love it. Super hydration with a healthy glow or a full look. Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is surprisingly buildable. The formula is really thick and creamy. My contour and blush blends into it so well. This has been really nice in this winter air. It doesn't make me oily just perfectly hydrated. 
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Amanda R
headline: Love this product.
comment: This product is great for mature skin. Does not sit in my fine line's especially around my eyes. Wears great and is my new favorite. I apply with a damp foundation brush. A little goes a long way.

author: Vanessa
headline: Smooth and radiant, but not a true sheer tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
Packaging: weighty glass with a screw top, 0.63 oz/18 g
Formula: solid but is easy to pick up on brush or sponge, or scoop with spatula for finger application. 
Shade: Light Warm LW215
Photos: natural light (mid bright), warm indoor lighting (least bright), cool indoor lighting (brightest
Comparison (top to bottom): IT Cosmetics CC+ in Light (applied and blended), Tinted Balm (applied, blended, and sheered out), Wet n Wild Tinted Hydrator in Fair (applied and blended). Note: the two IT products are too dark for my winter skin, obviously, but would match well with a self-tan.
Review: the solid formula has no discernible scent and is very emollient, almost melting if you rub between fingers and onto your face. I felt it was easiest to apply with a sponge because I prefer a sponge to a brush, but both applications are easy. My skin is dry, but my skincare prep means it's properly moisturized, so I didn't have dry patches to note whether this would stick. The final result is a radiant finish, which is accurate to the product description. The reason I rated it 3 of 5 stars is that it is not truly sheer to my expectation of what a sheer product can be. The coverage is more light (very sheered out) to medium as it completely blocked out the redness from rosacea on my cheeks. Swatches shown in photos compare to the sheerness of the WnW tinted coverage (a popular product to put it in perspective), which is hopefully clear despite the shade differences. The tinted balm shade in Light Warm is nearly identical to the classic IT CC+ in Light (see photos). IT products run yellow in my experience, but to be fair, this shade is called "warm."
It lasted in normal wear for me and didn't lift or break up with toner, serum, and SPF underneath. It is overall good, but I would not consider it sheer, which lowered my rating based on how it's marketed.

author: Ruth
headline: Perfect Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this as a tester from #Influenster and #Ulta, in exchange for an honest review.  The product goes on smoothly for an even coverage.  I wore this for over 5 hours and it did not rub onto my clothes.  It's lightweight and as you see the coverage still appears natural.  When I don't want a full made up face, this will be my go to.

author: Dani
headline: Love!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has actually become one of my favorite go to foundations, it has pretty good coverage. It feels great on the skin and has a natural finish. I've been using a brush to apply it and love it.

author: Eskeila
headline: Perfect for mature skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is game changing for any any but for mature skin is just perfect.
The tint is enough to even your skin color, giving you a hydrated and satin finish. 
Packaging is different, usually skin tint comes in a tube but this container keep it cool and safe. Easy to travel with it. 
The texture is soft and creamy, does not feel heavy or greasy on the skin. 
Has no scent and pack with good ingredients.

author: Samantha
headline: So lightweight!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends in super easy with your fingers; I was able to blend with a brush as well. Light to medium with buildable coverage, melts into the skin like butter. I like that it is also a serum. Packaging is nice, and doesnt really have a strong scent; it is very light and I don't notice when applying. Good for everyday use too! Was able to set it with my powder. Picture shows it as a base with my finished makeup on. It lasted a few hours without touch up too. I used the shade fair warm 120

author: Melissa
headline: A lovely light foundation
comment: I was gifted this product complimentary to test and review. I have never tried a foundation like this. The texture is like a balm. It is light. And a little goes a long way. I applied it over my moisturizer with a foundation brush. It went on smoothly and blended into my skin well. I used powder over it. It lasted all day. I do recommend this foundation.

author: Emily
headline: Love
comment:
I really love this face balm. It feels more like skincare than makeup and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow without looking heavy or fake. The texture is super smooth and melts right into my skin, evening out my tone while still letting my natural skin show through.

It's perfect for everyday wear or "no-makeup" makeup days. My skin feels hydrated all day, and it never settles into lines or looks cakey. I also love how easy it is to apply — fingers or a brush both work great.

If you want light, sheer coverage that makes your skin look fresh, radiant, and still like you, this is definitely worth trying. I reach for this way more than traditional foundation now.

author: Ruby
headline: Feels so nice!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mixed feelings about this so far.  I am 47 going through some hard hormonal changes and my skin is not happy about it.  My skin tends to be oily, sensitive, and acne prone most of the time. Now recently it's fairly dry and a vitamin c cream has left me with a dry red irritation.  
This skin tint goes on pretty wet and I felt like it applied better with my It Cosmetics flat foundation brush than with fingers or beauty blender.  I did not notice much of a scent, feels nice on the skin, causes zero irritation,  and dries down to a nice finish.  Almost feels like it's cooling.  There is little to no real coverage but it definitely evened out my skin tone.  It does though sink into my wrinkles and clings to dry patches (I did not use any concealer or primer underneath) I did powder the wrinkles and my tzone.  This would be nice in summer.  Wear time is average for a skin tint on me 6-8hours.  Love the glass jar and should last me awhile.  I received the shade light neutral

author: Yana
headline: Not sticky at all with natural glow finish
comment:
I really love this product. It moisturizes so well on its own that I don't even need to apply a separate cream. It's not sticky, doesn't pill, and feels very comfortable on the skin.
It gives a light, natural glow - not greasy shine - with a soft, silky finish. The texture is smooth, easy to apply, and looks very natural on the skin. Perfect for everyday, no-makeup makeup.

author: KT
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face balm is interesting.  It is a solid balm in the tub, but melts as soon as you touch it.  It glides across the skin and leaves a sheer tint of color.  It is buildable as well.  Unfortunately it sank into every line on my skin and did not look nice.

author: Tiffany
headline: Great light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is perfect for dry or combo skin like mine. This balm does not irritate my skin or show my dark spots, dry patches, or acne scars. This balm feels super light weight, almost nonexistent. I use a foundation brush to tap the product on my face and blend it out. This balm blends with ease, fingers also do a good job. I use this balm with liquid blush and bronzer and everything layers together nicely. I'm wearing shade Rich Deep Neutral 520 and it matches perfectly. This is another great IT Cosmetics item.

author: Cristen
headline: Good quality wrong shade
comment: I received the Do It All Sheer Face Balm for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately the shade just doesn't work for me. I already have a hard time finding my correct shade, and this one makes my skin look almost bruised. That said, the application is smooth and the product quality itself is great—it feels nice on the skin and blends well. Because the shade isn't right for me, I don't see myself purchasing it, but I do think it could work well for someone with a better shade match.

author: Tracy
headline: It Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the Bomb!
comment:
I received this product for my honest review and Wow!  This isn't really makeup. It's skincare that happens to make your skin look better.
The It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is 92% skincare serum, and you can feel the difference the moment you apply it. It melts into the skin, feels light and nourishing, and doesn't sit on top like traditional foundation.
Coverage is sheer and forgiving, just enough to even things out, soften redness, and give that healthy, rested look. No heaviness. No creasing. No dry patches showing up by lunchtime.
What I appreciate most is how comfortable it is. You can apply it with your fingers, skip primer, skip powder, and your skin still looks natural and hydrated. It's especially great for dry, sensitive, or mature skin that doesn't love full-coverage makeup anymore.
This is a true "your skin but better" product. If you want something quick, breathable, and skin-first, this is an easy yes.

author: Lori
headline: Light Coverage That Feels Like Skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I really love the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because it feels more like skincare than makeup. It's super lightweight, but still gives a bit of coverage, making it perfect for my no-makeup makeup days. The shade Light Neutral 210 matched my skin perfectly. I tried applying it with my fingers and with a brush, and I liked the finish better with a brush. It looked so smooth and natural. Overall, it's an easy fuss-free balm that makes my skin look healthy without feeling heavy.

author: Donila
headline: Nice face tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation / skin tint is a very interesting product by IT cosmetics. I have been using their Glow foundation for years and they are my holy grail foundations. This is similar in the sense that it looks natural and beautiful on the skin. The color is a bit orange on my skin right now but I will try it in the summer as my skin gets tan. 

The packaging is not my favorite because it is hard to use with fingers but easy to pick up with a brush. It blends beautifully and looks great on the skin, without breaking me out. The texture does feel a bit oily at first but dries down into a beautiful satin/matte texture.

author: Danielle
headline: Overall great product
comment: I was given this product for my honest review. I have really enjoyed using this product. The texture and consistency of the product is probably my favorite things about it. it's smooth, easy to apply and blends into the skin beautifully without feeling heavy. I didn't have any issues, layering bronzer, and other makeup on top of it. it did not become patchy or flaky. It was lightly moisturizing on my skin, which is really nice this time of year when the air is so dry and cold. there is a light scent but it is very mild and not overpowering or unpleasant. It was also very easy to remove when I went to wash my face. But it lasted all day too, so it didn't come off throughout the day. Overall, a very nice tinted face balm.

author: Akhi
headline: Omggggg, I love this!!!
comment:
It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer tint Face Balm is such a holy grail for makeup! It's very lightweight, sheer and great coverage. This face balm melts quickly and blends on skin so beautifully. Gives my skin a soft, smooth and natural look. It covers up all the pores and redness on my skin, as well as hides and minimizes the wrinkles and acnes. It doesn't crease or makes my skin feel cakey at all. The skincare ingredients in this product, make my skin feel so healthier and hydrated all day long. You can apply this face balm on your skin easily, using a Brush or fingers. I'm so surprised to see how the shade is so perfectly goes with my skin tone. It doesn't have any artificial scent to it. Also can be removed easily using a makeup wipes or remover. Love the heavy glass packaging, looks very luxurious. I do wish it would have came with an applicator or a sponge with it, which is more hygienic. This is my first time using this brand and I feel extremely happy trying out this product.
This will be a great addition to my everyday go to makeup from now on. Definitely buying more!

author: Grace
headline: Very smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Obviously I selected a color that is too dark but it did blend out nicely. It is lightweight and fairly sheer. My one complaint is that it is too shiny for me and takes a long time to dry down on my face. I used powder and setting spray but it will still dab off on a paper towel.

author: Starla
headline: Silky smooth skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way this feels, it's very silky smooth like butter! Love the way it looks on but I do feel I need a lighter color but it is nice and kinda sheer but still gives a lil coverage and glow

author: Emma
headline: Good coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a solid tinted moisturizer/skin tint. It contains skincare beneficial ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid, peptides and Vitamin E.
It feels comfortable on the skin and is lightweight. It is quite pigmented so it does even skin out well once blended but I found it hard to get a color match and It products tend to look quite orange on me. However if you can work with the color range I think it's a great skincare/makeup hybrid. It's unscented and the packaging is compact.

author: Mary
headline: Found my new go to foundation for my mature, dry skin.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice simple package, which allows for the focus to be on the product itself. I have mature, dry skin and I am highly impressed with the hydrating and moisturizing feel. It is light weight, medium coverage and wears well for hours. I found my new holy grail foundation.

author: Candie
headline: I Loved this for me!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice thick, yet creamy texture.  It melted right into my skin and gives you a dewy natural sheer glow. It is not as dark as it looks in the package  and matched perfectly as i blended more. I had no problems using powder and blush over top. I will purchase again! I have been using it daily when I dont want to wear anything but mascara and it evens my skin so nicely and brings some life back to my face.

author: Inna
headline: Excellent texture, no residue no breakouts, moisture packed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really LOVE the coverage level capabilities of this product. It is quite "buildable" so you can do one layer for a quick morning or daytime "no make-up" look , you can put down a layer as a primer (as it is solid in the jar but once on the skin it melts as skincare should). It's quite a lot of product in the container so I'm sure it'll last a very long time. My only critique is that while it's 98% "skincare" label, the product quality app I use still rated it quote low and the long list of ingredients on the peel through label makes me a bit nervous...Having sad that, it is still an affordable,multi-coverage level product that is easy to apply and easy to store and care for.

author: Victoria
headline: Surprising glow!
comment: I was surprised when I used this product because of the luminous glow it gave while not being too pigmented or heavy. I have purchased from IT brand and find ther formulas to be heavy and always full coverage. This is a different product type for them and I think they honestly nailed it. It gave great lightweight coverage without being greasy. I love this formula for a quick natural looking face.

author: Brandy
headline: I love it
comment: This has been an amazing product I got this from influencer on a campaign for exchange for my honest opinion. I  must say I am obsessed with this my skin looks so good and healthy. I have a little color now I'm very fair skinned. My go to product now

author: Ann
headline: Hydrating, Radiant, Long Wearing Makeup Results.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product complimentary from It Cosmetics and Influencer in exchange for my honest review.
Very nice tinted moisturizer that gives radiant results and is so convenient and easy to apply.
If you are looking for a product that will give your skin a glowing, hydrated appearance with very little effort this is for you.
I easily applied it just like I would my regular moisturizer (with my fingers) and followed with my regular makeup products most of which are powder based (cream concealer being the only exception). I do not wear any foundation, I normally use my sunscreen as my base.
This balm gave me a really nice hint of base color (Fair Cool 125) and worked beautifully with the rest of my makeup products.
My results were long lasting, stay in place makeup wear with hydrated glowing skin.
The texture of this balm feels very lightweight and there is no notable scent.
Highly Recommended!

author: Mstattooed  aka breyona
headline: Get it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is legit! I usually have an issue finding the right shade for me but this was a perfect or close to perfect match. It blends out evenly and offers great coverage

author: Tracy
headline: New favorite
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love the IT cosmetics Do it all sheer tint Face Balm. I have very dry skin in the winter time. This product did not dry my skin at all once applied and made my skin look fantastic. It even felt more moisturized. I am absolutely switching to this product as my new foundation. The coverage is fantastic. I am in my 50's, this did not settle in my fine lines

author: Sarah
headline: Nope
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The good. It's light weight sheer coverage that feels great on the skin. 
The bad. I'm a dry skin girly and this just puts a spot light on my dry patches. It also amplifies every baby hair on my face. It also leans so yellow.

author: Summer
headline: My new go-to face balm! Must try!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am obsessed with this face balm, it's going to be my new go-to foundation. The pigmentation is pretty good coverage considering it's mostly skincare. It definitely makes my skin feel smoother. I tried doing a half face image so you can see how it cleared up my redness. The color I selected may be a shade too dark for me but will be perfect for the summer months. Packaging is pretty standard but makes it easy to use with a brush. I received this product for my honest review.

author: Rebekah
headline: Glowy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice glowy skin tint. It's a thicker texture but blends out nicely. I picked 210 light n. It's a bit dark for me so watch the shade you choose. It dosnt settle in lines or pores. I like the glass packaging.

author: 40s club
headline: Awesome product!
comment: Lovely lightweight hydrating cream that applies effortlessly with just a fingertip. Buildable and just the right amount of coverage without feeling like you're wearing makeup. Will purchase again! I would recommend since it is a lightweight coverage to go a shade darker than you normally would though.

author: TerriC
headline: Really love the light texture and coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really lioving this product.  It goes on like butter.  Smooth and so creamy without feeling heavy. At first it felt damp but settled nicely to a nice finish.  The little pot is easy to use with a makeup brush. The product also lasted all day without any issues

author: Christina C
headline: Amazing tinted face cream
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved the feel of this tinted balm. It wasn't heavy like some products are. You only need a little bit of this to cover imperfections, as a little goes a long ways. Removal is fairly easy with this product which I appreciated a lot! I highly recommend to any makeup lovers that is looking for a product that will cover up dark circles, pimples etc, this product will do that!

author: SunnyBunny1177
headline: Winter Skin Savior
comment: I was intrigued by this product when I saw it in-store but was unsure due to the crazy amount of paid-reviews here. I decided to swatch it (found the perfect shade match it's insane) and buy it anyway. Despite being in CA, my skin was already on the leaning-dry side but winter is truly here because my skin has been more dry. It's hard to deal with makeup when it wants to cling to dry patches or feels like all the moisture is sucked out no matter the skincare underneath. However, this product looks soo good. Can build (slightly, still sheer) the coverage more than an actual skintint without feeling like you have a mask. It feels lightweight and my husband even commented on my skin lol. So you can wear this on low-effort, no makeup-makeup days or add in some fuller coverage concealer to small areas and amp up the coverage without sacrificing your skin. I think i will also love this for summer. Also, feels like this product will last a long time and not run out quick like others.

author: Lulala
headline: Light coverage plus convenient
comment: I received this tinted face balm from IT cosmetics for free in exchange for this review. I received number 210, which matched my skin color. The face balm is perfect for no makeup makeup. 92% serum plus light coverage are perfect for casual hangouts. It came in a glass jar which is a huge plus.

author: Amal
headline: I love this sheer tint face balm on my face .
comment: I recommend this product to everyone to try it. It's really simple to use and coming in very nice packaging for the price. Also the shade is very good too. It is covering up all my face more than I need it is very amazing all my friends saw the difference.

author: Brooke
headline: Love!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been looooving this! Super easy to use. I have been using a brush and it glides on the skin so nice and melts in beautifully. A little bit goes a long way and, in my opinion, has great coverage. Evens my skin out and doesn't feel heavy. It comes in a nice sturdy glass jar. Overall will continue to use and probably purchase once I'm out!

author: Tammy
headline: A new must-have in my skincare routine…
comment: OMG, I love this product. There are days I want to just hang out at home but still want to be put together. This tinted balm is perfect for just that. I use it right after doing my morning skin care. It glides on leaving my face looking smooth & glowing. It's not a heavy product at all. And the color is perfect for me. I'm definitely adding this to my morning routine. It's the perfect base when wearing mineral powder foundation. And a little goes a long way. The jar is sturdy & you get a very generous amount. So glad for this! I definitely will be getting this in the future. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tammy
headline: An absolute must for good skin care!
comment: OMG, I love this product. There are days I want to just hang out at home but still want to be put together. This tinted balm is perfect for just that. I use it right after doing my morning skin care. It glides on leaving my face looking smooth & glowing. It's not a heavy product at all. And the color is perfect for me. I'm definitely adding this to my morning routine. It's the perfect base when wearing mineral powder foundation. And a little goes a long way. The jar is sturdy & you get a very generous amount. So glad for this! I definitely will be getting this again in the future. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tiffany
headline: The best tinted face balm!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face tint balm is awesome! I needed a super quick no-makeup makeup look to run a few errands, so I used this balm. It goes on super smoothly - I love the texture! It is a light coverage balm, but it has just enough tint to even out my skin tone. I got the Light Neutral shade. And no strong smell! Love it!

author: Brittany
headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had my daughter test this out for me. The color matched her better. She only put it on one side of her face for the photo. The balm is pretty sheer and applies really smooth. It blurred her pores. She said it feels very lightweight, like she has nothing on her skin. She applied it with her fingers and said it takes no time to blend. The biggest complaint about it is that it leaves the skin feeling wet if you don't set it with powder. It would be perfect to have in your purse for emergencies and on the go.

author: Shawna
headline: Love using this as under eye concealer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Obsessed. I never really cared for this brand before but once I received this product and felt the texture, I knew it would be perfect to use for my "no makeup makeup" days as my under eye concealer! It's so lightweight and skin like, super hydrating, so it works so nicely under my eyes for light, natural coverage that doesn't settle into any fine lines.

author: RB
headline: Buildable tinted face balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I tried this product by applying it with my fingers and with a brush. I prefer the brush application as it helps create an airbrush effect. This product is buildable or can be applied lightly and still have great results. This doesn't feel heavy on your face and leaves a nice finish on my face. Part of me wishes the jar was a bit wider so I could swirl the brush a bit more in the product. The rim of the glass container tends to get some product on it with it being its current size. There really isn't a scent to this product, if I had to say there was a scent, the only thing I can think of is a slight undertone of clay. I like this product and would recommend.

author: Mai
headline: Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This goes on flawlessly and does not remain oily. It is perfect for skin for women this goes on flawlessly and does not remain oily. I love this...

author: LaTasha
headline: Loved it, just need a lighter shade.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this face balm. It goes on smoothly, feels lightweight, and gives a nice sheer, natural look. The only downside for me was that the shade I received was a little too dark for my complexion, but the formula itself is great. I'd definitely buy it again in a lighter shade.

author: Megan
headline: Beautiful finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It feels lightweight and comfortable on my skin and gives such a beautiful, healthy glow… perfect for a natural, everyday look. The coverage is very light, which is great for evening things out, but I personally wish it offered just a bit more coverage to blur imperfections. Overall, it's a great product for a fresh, glowy finish, especially on days when you want something quick and easy.

author: Shawna
headline: PERFECTION!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is sheer perfection!! Its super lightweight but has great coverage while not looking cakey.  I received it just in time for my husbands birthday dinner and it lasted all night long. I have sensitive skin but I had no issues with the ingredients in this face balm at all! Simply wonderful!!

author: Casey
headline: It's ok
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Happy I was able to try the product but definitely not something I needed or will use again. I have oily skin and this product just seemed to slide around on my skin, it didn't set or absorb.

author: DT
headline: Reduce redness
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. The balm literally melts under your fingertips, and applies beautifully on your skin. It is pretty sheer, but tinted enough to reduce redness. It does not replace concealer or foundation, but if you have overall redness this will help. This shade matches my skin perfectly. The only con is that it does slip around, so you have to set it with some powder.

author: Taylor
headline: Best no-makeup makeup
comment: Ive been searchibg foe a lightweiht tint that also evens my complextion. Thus is EXACTLY what i needed. Super hydrating and gives natural look. I like to add a litle setting powder over it and il good to go

author: Stephanee
headline: Creamy and Moisturizing balm!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
First time trying a face balm. This is a serum-based tinted moisturizer that melts into skin and blends easily. 
It's soft, creamy, hydrating, doesn't sit in creases and gives a healthy glow. 
I love how it firms and minimizes fine lines. Buildable for more coverage or less for a natural glow. 
Powered by a 92% skincare ingredients-
Hyaluronic Acid
Vitamin E
Glycerin all work together leaving your skin more dewy, plump and radiant.  
Worth giving a try to see less of those fine facial lines!

author: Erin
headline: A beautiful, blendable face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The tinted face balm is so light and blends into my skin beautifully. It gives me a nicer "no makeup" look while protecting my face. It's also easy to build on and remove! I would definitely get this again.

author: Alaska
headline: This is my all time fav!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm lately, and it's become one of those easy, throw-it-on-and-go products. The texture is super lightweight and melts into the skin really nicely, no heavy or greasy feeling at all. The finish is what I love most, very natural, like your skin but a little more even and fresh. It doesn't look like makeup sitting on top of your face, just a soft, healthy glow. Coverage is sheer but enough to blur redness and even things out, making it perfect for no-makeup makeup days. Overall, it's low-effort, comfortable, and great if you want something that looks natural without trying too hard.

author: Liz
headline: Just like skin face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is by far my new favorite product! I have very dry skin and a lot of foundations/face balms do not sit well on my skin. They make my face look drier than it normally does. This product sits so well on my skin, blends so easily, and I love the skincare that is incorporated in this product. I feel like I'm treating my skin great and looking great as well! I will forever purchase this product from now on.

author: Lisa
headline: This is a good product
comment: I have used this product about a week now .I don't love it but I like it. It's a really light coverage and I like more. It feels good on my face and lasts ok. I does come off easily. I probably wouldn't purchase for myself but if you're younger with good skin it's probably perfect.

author: Vicki
headline: Glowy skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A tinted face balm/tinted moisturizer that feels lightweight, hydrating, and glowy — kind of a hybrid between skincare and makeup. It's meant to blur minor imperfections and give your skin a your skin but better look with very sheer coverage.  ￼
Packaging is great and compact.

author: Elle
headline: Blends into skin.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow! Super blendable on skin, the tone match's my skin. Texture is creamy and silky. Doesn't have a scent which is good since I can be allergic. Easy to swipe off and clean off face.

author: Nicole
headline: Smooth Application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] There were a couple learning curves with this product. I received shade 405 tan warm, which is a bit too dark for my winter skin, but it will definitely match in the summertime, as I spend a lot of time in the sun and tan quite easily. Also I had never used a balm before, so had to play around with application. A brush applied way too much and fingers too little. I found the perfect balance using a beauty blender, then doing a couple swipes with my fingers to melt it into the skin. It is sheer, which I like, but definitely buildable in the areas you want a little extra coverage, and other products, such as blush, contour, etc, applied smoothly on top.

author: Valerie
headline: Not a diverse enough color range
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way this product feels. It's moisturizing, nourishing, and evens out my skin tone while giving an extra glow.  I picked out the palest + cool undertone shade, which is my typically strategy for makeup. The color is still super orangey on my skin.  I'm hoping it will work out in the summer when I get a bit more color, but the lack of color range is the only thing keeping this from being a 5/5 holy grail type product

author: Vonnie
headline: So good!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok this stuff is actually amazing. A tinted moisturizer loaded with skincare benefits. It's great for dry skin. It evened out my skin tone without being heavy and obvious that I have something on my face. It's perfect for those "no makeup" days or when I just want to run to the store real quick and don't want to look a hot mess. Just natural, glowing skin.

author: Hollyh
headline: Skin Like Finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you are looking for a product that will make people think, "is she even wearing makeup?" This is it. It's easily blendable with you fingertips or a fluffy brush. This is the light medium shade (swatched on jaw). It's bendable and doesn't cause breakouts. Super natural, sheer finish. If you are looking to completely cover dark circles or acne, this product likely isn't it, but if you want something sheer, natural, and subtle, I recommend giving this a go.

author: Elizabeth
headline: Not for all skin types
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is not a product for everyone. It is a very sheer balm. I tried putting it on a few different ways. Finger, beauty blender and finally just dipping a brush in. It isn't as hydrating when wearing as you think a balm would be but it wore nicely and washed off easily. In the summer I think this would be a good lightweight option. Not really for my winter skin right now. But still a good product.

author: Nelly
headline: Love the balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this sheer tint face balm in medium tan warm 320. It feels like nothing on the skin and its buildable. The balm covers perfectly. Perfect for a simple natural look.

author: Danielle
headline: Light and Moisturizing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love many of the products from IT Cosmetics, so I was excited to try this out. It was super light and smooth. My skin felt moisturized and the slight tint blended with my skin perfectly. There was no sticky or cakiness, which was nice. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because it did cause a slight breakout on my 50+ skin.

author: Lori
headline: Not for me
comment: I'm returning this today.  It felt dry and the color oxidized badly.  My daughter took one look at me and said it looked like I was wearing funeral makeup.

author: Marie
headline: Not for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT products, however this one for me is a failure.  The color is very very orangey and the second you touch it it melts.  In my experience there is no workability once you apply it on the skin.  
Unfortunate but this product just doesn't ring the bell for me.

author: Mao
headline: Perfect for everyday makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics tint balm has very sheer and lightweight coverage, melts into the skin and blends easily. I do not like foundations for everyday makeup, and this is the great solution for me. The balm does not crease and stays all day long.

author: Jessica
headline: Beautiful skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint is just lovely. At first I thought it was going to be a little too dark for my fair/light skin. I used a beauty blender to dab some product onto my face, it melted in beautifully.  It's very light coverage at first but you can build it. I did have to use a little concealer around my eyes, but that's to be expected with a tint. The product blended away pores and small wrinkles and looked great upon completion. I checked it again at the end of the day and it still looked pretty good. I have combo skin so the more oily areas had some missing makeup as per usual, but my dryer areas still looked perfect! I definitely loved this product and I'll likely repurchase!

author: Carolina
headline: Great for a natural, glowy look, but the texture is quite th
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really like the idea of this product and the natural look it gives to the skin. The coverage is sheer but helps even out the complexion and leaves a healthy, glowy finish. It feels comfortable on the skin once applied and works well for a quick, everyday makeup. However, the texture is very thick and balmy, almost too pasty, which can make it a bit tricky to blend if you use too much product. Using a small amount and warming it up first definitely helps. Overall, it's a good option if you enjoy very natural, skin-like makeup and don't mind a heavier balm texture.

author: Allison
headline: For dry and mature skin !!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product because it's moisturizing, ideal for mature and dry skin, and easy to carry in your bag. The only thing is that the shade isn't the right one for my skin tone, but that was my mistake, It has light to medium coverage. it cosmetic definitely never disappoints me. I recommend it.

author: Rocio
headline: Sheer, radiant finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] [Incentivized] First time trying a tinted face balm and I love how lightweight it feels. It is pretty sheer but covers up enough to make my skin look a little more smooth. I have very dry skin, especially during the dry winter days so this balm is perfect because it keeps my skin hydrated with a healthy glow. I applied it with a sponge and a brush and it was easy to apply with both. I will definitely be reaching for this when going to appointments or running errands. I am in my late 40's and I love how it didn't accentuate my fines lines. I will need to get a darker color for the summertime. I do wish it had SPF and a little more coverage though.

author: Mara
headline: Skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Is a nice last product for my morning routine  it gives a very light coverage to my skin that's great when I'm not going to wear make up. It feels as if I'm nit wearing nothing and that's amazing for me.

author: Angelina
headline: Easy to use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Good size container with no offensive or overpowering scent. Light warm 215 color seems to match well with my skin tone and I like that it's sheer. I'm not sure what exactly is 92% skincare serum as the literature on the box/container doesn't say much.  Easy to spread by fingers or brush and I like that I don't look overly made-up.

author: Amaris
headline: Going to have to pickup a spare for my purse too!
comment:
I was a bit skeptical when I tried It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. (I used Fair Cool 125)I have very dry skin and foundations tend to look cakey or flaky (or both at the same time.) I have this a shot after thoroughly moisturizing my face in the morning. 

The good? No flakes!! While I originally thought the color wasn't quite a match, after applying, it blended beautifully with my natural skin tone and it filled in my fine lines nicely. It also significantly toned down my rosacea!! Quite a feat for a tinted balm. I am impressed. It felt light while still having good coverage, and feels velvety soft when applying. It didn't take much to get great coverage and lasted all day, which makes this little pot worth the price. 

The bad? I'm really not seeing much bad here. The initial cost could be a factor for some, but the quality if excellent. If you have dry skin I do strongly suggest using a good gel moisturizer first! I also wish it included a SPF. 
This one is a keeper! I'm excited about finally enjoying a smoothed complexion and not having to worry about flakes! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Maggie
headline: Love this tint!!
comment: I love this stuff!!! It's perfect for my "non makeup days" because it looks so natural and covers any redness or uneven spots on my face. I apply with a foundation brush and it looks amazing on my skin. I also love its compact and easy to travel with or put in my purse. Highly recommend!!

author: Jb
headline: Shocked! This is beautiful
comment: I have tried everything in search for the perfect "skin like finish" every product claims to have well still having coverage. Everything I have tried has either been too heavy, too light, too greasy, settled into my fine lines and wrinkles, to matte, etc. I did not expect to like this and I am so happy I was wrong. This is more coverage than I expected while still looking natural. It does not settle into my fine lines and wrinkles. I have mature, dry yet oily, skin with lots of rosacea and sun spots. It covers my rosacea and my sun spots without looking like a mask. Im so thoroughly impressed.

author: Jessica
headline: Felt greasy , is that normal ?
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't have much experience with skin tint . But first impressions .. I love it cosmetics and glad to try this product . Unfortunately this color ( tan warm 405 ) is to dark for me , this will work after a few visits to the tanning bed though. I did apply and wear this product so I could review honestly despite the drastic color mismatch. Product applied easily , soft & light. a little went a good ways. I did feel like it felt and looked greasy though after a few hours of wear. Im not sure if that is normal for a skin tint ? I will try again after i tan a little and it doesn't look so silly.

author: Tinatin
headline: Blurred, Even and Undetectable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a lightweight skin tint that blurs and evens out skin tone while still looking natural. The formula includes skincare focused ingredients like hyaluronic acid, glycerin, vitamin E, and peptides, which help keep the skin comfortable and hydrated throughout the day. The texture feels balmy but not heavy, blends easily with fingertips and sits well on the skin without looking cakey. This is exactly what I was looking for in a skin tint - easy to apply, sheer coverage, and a true "your skin but better" finish.

author: Sara
headline: Lightweight coverage
comment: The IT cosmetics Do It All Sheer balm is a lovely, lightweight balm. Glides on smoothly, and provides a sheer coverage. No scent noted. Did not clog pores.

author: Mary Elizabeth
headline: Love love love
comment: My aging skin is in love with this product. It glides on so smoothly, makes my skin appear dewy and provides ampke everyday coverge for those natural makeup days. Im seriously obsessed!

author: Jolynn
headline: I would definitely buy again
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Its beautiful. Very silky and soft to apply and it glides on very nice.  Its a perfect match in color. I would recommend this to everyone

author: Val
headline: Love it
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok this one is a game changer for me. I loved it. I have dry skin and sometimes I just want something natural. This tint did its job! It's definitely a good product for my dry skin girls! There's no major scent I think it's ok. 
This balm did last me a few hours and I went out at night. 
It's a yeess for me and will definitely buy another once I run out.

author: Kasey
headline: Nice lightweight coverage but no wow factor.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lightweight and sheer coverage, but it does build up a bit.  It covers redness and discoloration but I just didn't love the look of it on my skin. It didn't blend as well as I wanted.  I wore it for about 6 hours and it had great staying power. It didn't crease or bead up at all.

author: Sarah
headline: Foundation and Moisturizer in One
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] They weren't kidding when they named this product; it really does Do It All. 

I'm usually a liquid foundation user, but this balm has me as a convert. It really does moisturize and made my skin softer. It has collagen peptides and hyaluronic acid, which made my skin look better. And these are hot ingredients right now! 

I love that this is a buildable foundation. Sometimes I need more in some areas, so buildable is a big priority.

It was easy to apply, blend, and build. And I love that it lasts all day and doesn't make me break out or my skin feel very oily.

author: Angela
headline: Definitely adding this to my daily routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love all things IT so I was super excited to try this IT Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm. As expected it was awesome!  Easy to apply and the finish was nice not heavy. Definitely recommend!

author: Amber
headline: Big no for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade was great. It was scentless which I can appreciate. When I received it it was just the little pot and no outer packaging. It was nice though. It dried down on my face and made my skin look terrible. I prefer a more dewy finish and this did not have that. That was very disappointing. I could only wear it four hours before I had to wash it off and saturate my face in oil and moisturizer. I received this for free for an honest review.

author: Cori
headline: Smooth and light
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is great. I don't know that I've tried something like this, but it was awesome. It went on super smooth. I put it on with my fingers the next day. I tried it with a brush that was perfect. I wanted to take a picture of it on my face, but it matched my skin tone exactly and honestly, I just kind of guessed it so that was a huge win. You can't even see it on my wrist because again it blends so well little bit Dewey going on did not stay that way it did take a little bit of time to set. I would use this if I was going to the gym or just running errands and having a day that you don't want to put full makeup on, but also want to have some thing semi shearer and just balancing everything out, it was perfect put a little bit under my eyes put it all over my face loved it. I think this is like a upscale BB cream but with good things in it to help your skin love this brand love this product totally recommend again not a super every day make up but great for days that you just wanna run errands and do things without the whole set up on your face.

author: Jen
headline: Great!
comment: I wasn't sure I picked the right shade when I first opened the jar. But I was pleasantly surprised. It's actually a great match. I don't notice that it gets into my little creases like heavy foundation normally does I'm in my early 40s and so I don't like heavy foundation so this is perfect. I definitely will buy again once I'm out and I'm actually going to get a darker shade for a summertime.

author: Callie
headline: Great sheer tint for minimal color addition
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics sheer tinted face balm is easy to apply. Smooth consistency to apply either with your fingers or a makeup sponge. Easy packaging to store or take with when traveling. Did not find however that it covers much with the sheer aspect.

author: Jess
headline: Might be good for a dry skin, but not gray for oil
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It does work, but I feel like it's separates throughout the day on my oily skin. This might be a product that's good for a dry skin, but it doesn't work great for me.

author: Alisha
headline: Sheer Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT sheer face balm is perfect for that no makeup, makeup look. Very thin but nice coverage. Didn't settle into my fine lines. Wore very nice and I can't wait to see how it has up during the summer months.

author: Antonio
headline: Skincare + coverage and glow?!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have combination skin / with texture concerns (larger pores and fine lines / wrinkles. I know it's a sheer and balmy formula but it has pretty good coverage in my opinion. It's pretty undetectable whilst fulfilling the need of helping give a more even skin tone you'd want from a foundation. It comes in a glass jar and applies rather easily.

This is something I wore at the beginning of the day for a 6 hour shift and it lasted till I got home.

author: Jeanette
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a lightweight formula. Blends in nicely with my skin tone. It was a flawless consistency and went on smoothly. It came off easily with just a makeup wipe.

author: Sarah
headline: Good product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really like this product. It goes on smooth and is very easy. Nice color and matches my complexion.  Lasts awhile and does not leave my skin oily or Mae me breakout. Long lasting.

author: Randi
headline: Wow!!! 🤩
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product!! It's perfect for a "no makeup makeup day". It goes on so smooth and blends seamlessly. It's soft and almost feels like a moisturizer. Will definitely keep using and purchasing!

author: Connie
headline: So smooth
comment: I absolutely love this IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, it's not thick and goes on so smooth and the coverage is on point! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Diana
headline: Perfect for whoever does not like to wear makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was impressed with this product from the moment I applied it first. It feels refreshing once you apply it and it has a fresh scent. It blends like a moose in a heavier form. I applied it with my fingers at first and I noticed a more dewy finish that lasted all day. The coverage is sheer to medium. I also tried a brush and the coverage is more sheer. It is definitely a product for people who are looking for a natural look without feeling they have makeup on. It's definitely a must have if you are that type of woman. The color looks darker in the container or once applied but once I blended it, was invisible.

author: Daniella
headline: This face balm is bomb dot com
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this face balm because it applies sheer but it is buildable and literally melts into the skin. Its smooth, silky, and there is no real fragrance. I have recommended to all my friends.

author: Makeuplover
headline: Nice Color Match
comment: Traditionally, I've had difficulty finding my match with other IT Cosmetics foundations & concealer but I will say this is an exception. Fortunately, I got a decent match. The texture & formula felt hydrated and had decent buildable coverage.

author: Kay
headline: Best of both worlds!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really enjoying using this tinted face balm in my everyday makeup routine. I have combination skin and my skin has some fine lines and texture. This balmy evens out my skin tone while still looking natural. It gives a slight sheen that makes my skin look healthy and glowing. The shade is a little bit warm for my skin tone but it blends out so well and actually helps me look bright and sunkissed. For application I take a small amount on my finger, dot it around my face and then blend with a brush. It feels lightweight and lasts all day. I love all the skincare benefits the balm offers. Its quick, easy and looks great!

author: Susan
headline: Love coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love a good face tent. And this brand is one of my favorites
This product did what it said.It went on very smooth. It is not claimed to be a full coverage product.It is a lightweight product for everyday use. I did apply it with my makeup brush. Not a blender, and it went on perfectly. I will say I have very hydrated skin so it did look good on my skin.I have read that others needed to add some moisturizer.First, it all depends on your skin. I did find the packaging very nice and it does come in a glass container, not a plastic one. I have used it for a few days now around the house and quick errands out. It gave me just enough color to my skin to look natural. I would recommend this to anyone.

author: Rennie
headline: Another great IT product
comment: Perfect for a sheer, natural, but finished look. The light, easy to apply formula is able to layered for a bit more coverage, but I preferred the subtle look of one application. As always, IT cosmetics brought exactly what it promised! (I received this product in exchange for my honest review)

author: D
headline: Not quite it
comment: Firstly, I have great difficulty finding a shade match in this company's products, which is frustrating. This seems blendable, but the finish was dull. The consistency was slippery, which was new for me. I did like the packaging. All in all, it seems this isn't the right product for me and I'm unlikely to purchase in the future.

author: Dee
headline: This is a great product!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics are consistently great products and this one is now exception. It applies smoothly and is lightweight. I love how it feels like I am doing something good for my skin when I wear it. This my new favorite skin balm.

author: Paige
headline: Very natural, yet buildable! Love it!!
comment: This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is awesome! This transforms skin instantly and over time. It delivers a radiant look, visibly firms, minimizes the look of lines, and hydrates all day! I have been using this for several weeks and I absolutely love the way it makes my skin look! It's so easy to apply and can be applied with fingers, sponge, brush, etc. It's buildable without getting cakey, and does great with my dry skin. I also have a lot of redness on my face and this covers it so well! If you're looking for a really good tint face balm, this is an excellent one to try, especially for dry skin! It leaves my face with such a beautiful natural glow! Most definitely recommend!!

author: Liane
headline: Great Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics makes the products I love! This Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm provides a light tint while making my skin feel smooth with a 92% serum. I recommend their products!

author: Maryna
headline: Impressive!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow this product feels like butter and barely there at the same time. It's light, blendable, buildable, not drying at all. The finish is not matte but also not too luminous, like a healthy skin. The shade that I got is a bit dark for my skin but I use it to warm it up my complexion, it proves the universality of the product. Obsessed.

author: KAROL
headline: TINTED MOISTURIZER
comment:
Overall this is a nice product to use when you do not want heavy coverage and it is buildable or a good base for further makeup application.
It felt very hydrating and melted well into my skin and had a nice overall sheen.
 l like that it also has benefits to the actual condition of the skin with extended use.
I personally prefer tinted moisturizes in a tube versus a cream jar though, just for application purposes.
I received this product complimentary for my honest opinion.

author: Anna
headline: Lightweight
comment: I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for everyday wear. The texture is lightweight and melts into the skin easily, giving a natural, sheer tint that evens out my complexion without feeling heavy or greasy. It feels comfortable throughout the day and works perfectly when I want a quick, minimal makeup look. I really like how it blends effortlessly and leaves my skin looking fresh and healthy rather than covered. Great option for no-makeup makeup days.

author: Nikkita
headline: Looks great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this, do it all sheer tint face balm it blends into my skin flawlessly and feels so soft.  Leaves the prefect tint to my face and lasts a while also.  Definitely recommended.

author: Kat
headline: Improves skin and looks great while doing it!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
After wearing daily for two weeks, my face feels more hydrated and firmer at the end of the day, kind of like it feels in the morning after having an intensive serum or moisturizer on all night. I love that it works all day in addition to providing a nice-looking, smooth face. It is the best of both worlds, and it saves a few steps on busy days because I can skip the serum and moisturizer step in the morning. I also love that I was able to match my skin tone exactly, which is honestly rare. This leaves me looking very natural but just indescribably better, which I love. I used it on a day I was filming a video, and I was happy with the way it came out.

author: Angela
headline: Light and pretty, hard to work with
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've had a chance to play with this product quite a bit. As you can see in the pot, it has a bit of an oily texture., but once applied it's quite Matt with a little bit of a shimmer. The product absorbed very quickly so you have to work fast.. overall I really like the coverage, but I don't like how quickly you have to work with it before it dries. It feels nice on the skin, very light so you feel like you're hardly wearing foundation. I like it, but I can't say that it would be my first choice of product, once it's time to repurchase.

author: Beth Ann
headline: Skincare Focused Tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the light medium warm shade and it is a bit too dark for me, but I can make it work. It's described as a sheer tint face and that's exactly what it is. It's more skin care than it is make up. It's perfect for days when you just want skincare ingredients that aren't trying to look full glam.

author: Jen
headline: Lightweight and easy to blend to cover redness
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product looked a little dark for me but to my surprise it wasn't. It is sheer and spread nicely by using a brush. You can build it up to cover redness or imperfections. I like that it keeps me looking fresh and natural. I might buy another lighter shade and mix them together. I like the consistency and ease of applying. I hate anything to heavy so this is anything but heavy.

author: Madi
headline: For day time use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love using a skin tint. It makes the skin looking uniform without looking cakey. It is easy to apply, I use my fingers and a dense brush. I would use a gel like moisturizer before to avoid any peeling. The color match is not usually perfect for me but it's spot on for my friend. Perfect for daily use.

author: Tamara
headline: Melts into the skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really love the IT Cosmetics Tinted Face Balm. It goes on beautifully and blends super easily, and the coverage is way better than I expected for a balm. I've had breakouts from some of their products in the past, so I was a little nervous, but this one didn't break me out at all. It evens out my skin without feeling heavy and gives a nice natural finish. Definitely a go to for everyday wear.

author: NattyCupcakez
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Upon first viewing it, I originally thought it was too dark for my skin. I applied it to one half of my face (see pics) and I'm sure you can tell which half I applied it to. I was quite impressed how my skin looked smooth, yet the color blended in with my skin perfectly. It wasn't too dark and it really had a texture that just melted into my skin. I applied it with just a normal sponge and it worked great!

author: F.H
headline: My New Secret for Effortless Skin ✨
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've finally found the perfect "no-makeup" makeup staple! The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a total game-changer for my daily routine.
​I struggle with redness around my cheeks, and as you can see in the before & after, this balm completely neutralized it while leaving a stunning, dewy glow. It's 92% skincare serum, so it feels incredibly hydrating and lightweight—not heavy or cakey at all.
​It blurs, firms, and tints all in one step. If you're looking for that "your skin but better" look, this is definitely the one! 💖

author: Vanessa
headline: Effective and Quick Foundation and/or Concealer Alternative
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

This product's consistency is somewhere between a concealer and a foundation, as if you mixed the two. I love that it's 92% skincare serum (though serum is a misleading label given the thick and creamy consistency). 

I found my typical serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen were still needed prior to application of this for enough moisturizing so it's not really a one and done skincare and makeup product, at least for me. As with concealer or foundation, primer definitely made it look better, though I wonder how many skin care benefits are possible with all those layers and barriers to reach the skin. 

The color match was pretty close, not quite exact for me, but close enough to work if I didn't have time for my typical makeup routine. If you find a perfect match this would be an amazing product. 

I found that application was very quick using fingers to tap and blend, much faster than my typical makeup routine. I also found that simply using this product, setting powder, blush, and light eye, brow and lip makeup looked nearly as good as my typical routine in a third of the time, so this is fantastic if you're limited on time and looks almost as good. I typically swear by my beauty blender for concealer and foundation application but avoided using it with this product given the thick consistency, which I expect would simply lock into the sponge and be impossible to wash out.  Would definitely highly recommend if there's a shade match for you!

author: Buhbine7
headline: I would definitely buy again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love it cosmetics they are very efficient and great products. The color i used is fair warm 120 and im light skin with natural tones. The color match i used a perfect match and you couldn't tell i had makeup on, which is the way it should be. The texture is very creamy and smooth. It blends in your skin nice. Long lasting and doesn't wear off though out the day. I mean it's makeup so smells like makeup and doesn't have a strong odor or anything. I used some makeup remover and can off very easy with no issues.

author: Lupita
headline: Different
comment: So far it's been ok of course the weather has been nice and cold so my makeup doesn't run as much as in the heat but it does have good coverage and not sticky

author: Wala
headline: Color range??
comment: The finish is  stunning on my skin but the color range is horrible. Light foundations with warm undertones is what I usually wear so thats what I got amd my face looks grey. I will try a different color but the range isnt the greatest unfortunatley.

author: Donna
headline: Huge fan!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a huge fan of IT Cosmetics, so I was really excited to try Do It All. I was not disappointed in the slightest! It blends with my skin tone perfectly, goes on smoothly and easily using just my fingers and feels like I'm not wearing anything at all. It's perfect for those days when I don't want to wear makeup, like when I'm off work but still out and about and don't want to look bare-faced in public. It helps my tired skin look refreshed and dewy. I feel so much more confident than when I'm wearing nothing.

author: Nguyen
headline: Healthy glow
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect hybrid for anyone who wants hydration + a hint of coverage.
• The Vibe: Ultra-dewy and effortless. It feels like a high-end serum but looks like your skin on its best day.
• Best For: "No-makeup" makeup days. It blurs redness and pores without feeling heavy or cakey.
• Keep in Mind: It's very sheer; it won't hide major blemishes, and oily skin types might need a light powder to settle the shine.
Final Word: A must-have for a quick, healthy glow

author: Yugauni
headline: It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is interesting. I was a bit hesitant originally because on my first wear I didn't feel that it covered too much and that it clung to my pores and dry patches a bit too much. However as I kept trying different application techniques through my testing period, I found that for me using a brush led to better application than a blending sponge. The color was a decent match for me and I did not really feel it on my skin. It might be nice for travel, but need to test it out in different climates to determine (currently dry, winter air only) because I'm curious how it would wear in humid summer weather.

author: Sarah
headline: I would buy this product again and again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is fantastic! I love iT cosmetics to begin with but this formula is amazing. Better than I expected. I'm very already recommended it to several friends. I was worried about the shade and it looks like it wouldn't match but it's perfect. I glides on smoothly and leaves just the right about to dew to the skin. It's long lasting and doesn't feel greasy. Huge fan!

author: Brandi
headline: I will be purchasing this again and again
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love this face balm. The consistency is no where near as thick as I thought or would be. It goes on very smooth and looks nice on the skin. It blurs the pores, even without a primer. The color choices were decent. You don't need a perfect match for it to work. It is more sheer, so it looks like your skin, just better!

author: TaiTai
headline: Good beauty balm
comment: Pretty good beauty balm. Melts into skin nicely. I took a star away because is not sheer coverage. Its more medium coverage buildable to full coverage.

author: Tricia
headline: IT lasts all day for  a perfectly flawless glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm goes on so smoothly and gives me the natural finish that I desire. I love how it lasts all throughout my day, rain or shine and it's also suitable for sensitive skin like mine. IT has the staying power that you need day in and day out.

author: Tricia
headline: Great coverage and lasts all day
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm goes on so smoothly and gives me the natural finish that I desire. I love how it lasts all throughout my day, rain or shine and it's also suitable for sensitive skin like mine. IT has the staying power that you need day in and day out.

author: Laure
headline: Great color match
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I generally really enjoy It cosmetics products and this one was no exception. The color matching to my skin is great- I tried to show in the pic but it's hard to even see though  loaded it on!  I do feel like 'balm' is sort of misleading though.  It really is more like a solid buildable foundation. My one concern is that it's a little drying so in the winter when my skin is already dry, which makes it not blend as well. I think it'll be a great warmer weather product for me though!

author: Stacy
headline: Not for me
comment: This shade was way too dark for me it seemed to have two different shade tones to it and just didn't work for my skin tone. It's very light weight not a lot of coverage I'd like to try in the right shade I feel like it it could be worth it…..I don't hate

author: Jen
headline: Buildable sheet coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While I am sure I chose a shade a little too dark, I can always use it when I have a tan. 
It's a light texture, very sheer but also seems like it's pretty buildable. I don't want a lot of coverage so I wouldn't use much. It does oxidize a little so be weary of that. It's easy to remove as well. Overall it's a fine product for minimal makeup with minimal coverage.

author: Tracy
headline: Very nice tinted face serum
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very nice sheer tinted face balm with buildable coverage from It Cosmetics. It glides on your skin blending easily as it has the texture of a serum. You can add another layer if you want to without it feeling heavy. I love that it's great for your skin, keeping it moisturized, firm, and helping with fine lines.
