author: Allyson
headline: Beautiful coverage with great skin care
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The It Cosmetics "Do it All" Sheer Tint Face Balm is such a new and unique makeup product! It's high quality facial skincare with a beautiful tint that blends to perfection to give you light, yet buildable coverage, in a shade that is super forgiving.

As you can tell from the pictures, I'm a light to medium shade. I'm 44, so I'm dealing with discoloration, dark spots, redness, uneven tone, large pores in certain areas (hello perimenopause!). I look for base makeup that not only looks good, but it needs to feel good as well!  This product really does it all! A super quick application with clean fingers gave me perfect light coverage in order to look finished and polished to take my daughter to play group. I don't typically have time to apply makeup on playgroup days, but this was so quick and easy to apply! You can layer it with sunscreen, finishing powders, set, but I found it looked beautiful on its own. I paired it with a neutral lip gloss and neutral blush for a fun and quick look.

Unlike most foundation makeup, this is lightweight and you can't even feel it! If you are neurodivergent like me, this may just be the perfect foundation for you. There's no cakey feel, and the finish is absolutely perfect! It's not fully matte, yet not at all shiny like many foundations. I didn't feel like I needed face powder to cover shiny areas.

The only thing I would change is that I wish it had a flip top cap with an applicator. I don't particularly like touching my makeup and an applicator would be an awesome addition. Otherwise, this product is perfect for anyone looking for lightweight makeup coverage that is perfect on its own or paired with your favorite color cosmetics. It's definitely a product I plan to keep on hand because of how great the coverage is for a lightweight foundation and how good it feels on your skin. Nourishing, yet undetectable! This would also be a great product to give a younger person a chance to try a foundation product that looks natural and appropriate for anyone of any age who wants to look a little fancy while taking great care of their skin.

My skin didnt feel heavy or weighed down and I didnt have a breakout after. Our winter is pretty dry right now so my skin is crying out for moisture and this not only helped make it less dry it also covered and make my skin look like I tried. Perfect for a go to quick no make up kind of look while still looking put together and not like you just rolled out of bed, even if you did.

author: Megan
headline: This sheer tinted face balm is perfection in a jar
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tinted face balm is perfection in a jar. It goes on so smoothly and finishes beautifully with no shine or dryness. Lightweight coverage that lasts hours. Easy to remove.

author: Chula
headline: Lágrimas light tint to COVER-FULL, IT CAME THROUGH
comment: Every look needs a strong base , and here it is ! The creamy texture and easy application , to the glowing effect while healing as it's on your face. From touch up to build up this is hands down #1 with 92% skincare ingredients.(complimentary product for my honest review)

author: Nicole
headline: Needs better color range
comment: I have mature combination skin. I am usually a true light neutral. I received the light neutral 210 for free in exchange for my honest review. Right away I noticed the color in the pot was much darker than a normal "light." I applied the product with my fingers, as I plan to use this for quick makeup looks when I want to get out the door. The color pulls very orange on me. I would step down one shade, but the next neutral is fair and their lightest shade. I am ghosty, but not that fair. I do wish Benefit would expand their color range. As for coverage, it was exactly as I expected for a sheer tint. I found it to absorb quickly into my skin with all the skincare ingredients. It's light and buildable to a degree. It does not set right away, and I don't care for that feeling. Setting powder helped some but it still felt like lotion on. All in all, I would most likely recommend another tint instead of the Do-It-All Sheer Tint Face Balm until they extend the color selection.

author: Samantha
headline: Smooth skin tint!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint adds just the right amount of coverage without ever feeling bulky. The shade match was spot on, and it goes on smoothly—plus a little really does go a long way. The only downside I've noticed is occasional light pilling on my skin, but overall it wears beautifully.

author: Hienny
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the blending of the face balm. It's smooth and has the perfect shade, the coverage is impressive and this is how my makeup looks at the end of the day!

author: Marcelle
headline: Perfect thing for the daily makeup!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's really different than everything! It's so lightweight and my skin feels so smooth. It's natural beautiful! I really enjoy the finish. It's the perfect thing for the daily makeup. I truly enjoy and recommend it!

author: Desirae
headline: Best foundation I've used in a long time.
comment: I always have a hard time finding a good foundation for my fair and sensitive skin with rosacea. When I first received the product from influencer I didn't think it would work because of the shade. I was so surprised at how well it blended into my skin. It didn't make me look like a ghost and it wasn't dark. The texture is so smooth and light, it feels like water and so refreshing. I didn't even need powder to set it. I wore it while exposed to water, and although not perfect, it did last a long time. It lasted all day very nicely and didn't flake or clump off, but was so easy to remove with my normal double cleanse routine. I will definitely be purchasing this product again and I do highly recommend this product. After trying numerous foundations and mainly sticking with a skin tint, I've finally found a foundation for my skin!

author: Samantha
headline: Beautiful formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this face balm. It's sheer like skincare but has enough coverage to be a foundation. It also leaves you face hydrated and glowy so you can use powder ontop and get longwear out of it! I truly enjoy these type of foundations because they are natural and not too cakey.

author: Kris
headline: I would buy this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I was pleasantly surprised with this skin tint. This is great for everyday use, especially on days when you don't want to look like you're wearing makeup, but want to even out any redness or cover up blemishes. It's lightweight, comfortable, and not oily. Its sheer coverage gives flexible shade matching, and has a skin-like, satin finish. Its packaging is a nice sized glass jar that allows you to use a brush or sponge. Another plus was that it had no scent. Overall, I would recommend this product.

author: Amber
headline: Love,love,love this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never had a product that actually matched my skin tone and actually provided coverage. You can see i have been fighting redness due to some medical issues and medications im on. I applied this with my finger tips my dabbing the product to the left side of my face, and it was MAGICAL. I didn't have to apply alot for coverage either!   I am so absolutely impressed by this product!  It feels so lightweight and not greasy. I set it with powder and it lasts all day!  This will be my go to makeup from now on and I'll be telling everyone about it!

author: Julie
headline: Light and sheer look
comment: I's very creamy. I got light warm 215. It matches my color skin. It blends well. When you put on, it does show a sheer look. It covers very lightly, I added a few layers for more coverage. Feels light, not heavy. It has a very light scent, which I like. I don't think coverage lasts, however, I didn't use primer or setting spray, I wanted to give an honest review of the the product itself.

author: Shannon
headline: IT looks natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. This is a great everyday skin tint in a balm form that is a sheer with buildable coverage. I have mature dry skin and I don't like the feel of heavy foundations anymore and I tend to like these types of products better. It doesn't leave my skin dry or oily. I've had no reactions with using it so far. It has a good selection of colors to choose from and it looks very natural on the skin. I will definitely be purchasing this again. Another great product from IT cosmetics.

author: Amy
headline: Not for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't usually do sheer face products as I prefer full coverage, but I'm excited to get to sample and review this product. I have been looking into a lighter wear product to help throughout the day, and not into wearing makeup everyday anymore. The product comes out of the container easily, which proves the moisture of it. It isnt really strong smelling, but doesn't smell too great to me, kind of chemical like to me. It is very sheer, once rubbed onto my face I can't even tell it is there. It does blend in rather easily though. I don't really see a difference since beginning to use this product, honestly I probably won't purchase this item. 
In the photo of me, product is on the same side as the product container and the other half has none.

author: Alice
headline: A must have make up product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The lightweight, easy-to-spread cream blends seamlessly with the skin, providing a comfortable, light feel that makes the skin look natural without feeling heavy or clogged, while nourishing ingredients leave the skin feeling soft and smooth, Easy to remove makeup, compact and portable, can be taken anywhere.

author: MissBronte930
headline: Light coverage with skincare
comment:
After testing this sheer tint face balm for a couple of weeks, I can honestly say that I love it! I've tried so many different foundations and had given up on finding one that helped even out my skin tone without looking cakey and settling into my pores. I'm in my 40's and have combination skin. 

The balm is easy to apply with clean fingers and is very buildable. I use a light layer and can add a touch more to areas that need more coverage without any issue. 

I like that there are so many awesome skincare ingredients as well. I have noticed that my skin feels softer and more hydrated even after I've washed my face at the end of the day. 

The packaging is simply and sturdy and easy to use. I will absolutely be purchasing this face balm again. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

author: Stephanie
headline: Low effort makeup
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I stared at this face balm for a solid minute trying to figure out how it wanted to be applied. Fingers? Sponge? Moon ritual? I gave up and used a brush. Turns out, that worked just fine.

It went on smoothly, evened things out, and gave me that "my skin but slightly more put together" look. Not full coverage, not magic — just an easy, sheer tint that doesn't feel heavy or greasy.

Once I stopped overthinking it, I actually liked it. This is a good option if you want low effort makeup that doesn't scream I tried too hard.

author: Bek
headline: Wow impressed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im loving the IT do it all sheer tint gace balm. It compliments my skin hides imperfections with out looking like I have any make up on! It absorbs into my skin no makeup lines! Its powered by collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E! I usually cant wait to wash my face after wearing make up a few hours. Also can be prone to breaking out. Not with this! I will buy again.

author: Stephanie
headline: Love!
comment: I am a huge fan of it cosmetics products. I love that this skin tint feels so light but the coverage is still great as all their other products. I really enjoy the packaging of this product, it is so easy to get the desired amount out and it feels so soft and smooth on my skin.

author: Cindy
headline: Awesome product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is great! You can work it into the skin without over drying. It doesn't build up in creases, which I find to be amazing. That is not a common feat. It does have a bit of a matte finish even though it's a balm.

author: Sitsiya
headline: Sheer tint but gives good coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

A sheer tint that gives a good coverage to my skin! Blend smoothly on to my skin and feels lightweight.  Wear it alone or wear beautifully with makeup. I love how it evens out my skin tone and gives coverage to my skin imperfections and blemishes. Definitely a must-have!

author: Cheyenna
headline: Really "Does It All" !!!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product really does stand by its name "Do It All".  It provides great coverage which is buildable and matches my neutral (warm) skin tone perfectly.   It's in a small jar which I wish was a little larger due to getting the product out but if you use a brush it's easier to apply and blend.  It's perfect for spot coverage as well and my teen daughter loves it for that. It's super light on the skin and doesn't seem to be cakey after applying.   A++++

author: Mindy
headline: So light and smooth that you won't know you are wearing it!
comment:
love this product! It's so light and creamy yet covers every little line and blemish! It's so easy to wear comfortably all day I didn't even remember that | put it on. The packaging is very simple and the size is great to throw in a small purse.
This will be a staple in my makeup bag!

author: Heather
headline: Loved this face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this face tint it's creamy abd goes on smooth and brings color to your face. It's not heavy and gives you great full coverage. And if you are looking for something that is light weight gives this a try.

author: Mindy
headline: So light, smooth and creamy that you won't know its on!
comment: I love this product! It's so light and creamy yet covers every little line and blemish! It's so easy to wear comfortably all day I didn't even remember that | put it on. The packaging is very simple and the size is great to throw in a small purse This will be a staple in my makeup bag!

author: Vanessa
headline: Makeup bag must have for touch ups
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Shade Fair Warm 120: this is a keeper for the cosmetic bag. Although I need something slightly more concealing for my dark under eyes, it delivers hydration with a balm like glow to the skin. Definitely gives the re-hydrate finish after a long shift of work. Perfect for day to night transition, especially for the dry skin areas. If you are oily you may only use this sparingly but if you are dry or mature it even the tone it like a base and gives a hydrated finish. Would also be great for teenage skin and photography for men's skin. Great addition to the IT cosmetic line.

author: Agnes
headline: Light and smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is light and smooth. It is an easy to open jar. The shade is great to my skin and it has light coverage. Washing it off is easy since it is so lightweight. I like the coverage it provides.

author: Rachel
headline: Unique and incredible
comment:
Absolutely love this product, which I received free in exchange for my honest feedback. The sheer skin tint is easy to blend and gives a natural, healthy glow—perfect for everyday wear. It feels lightweight on the skin while still making your complexion look fresh and even.

I also love that it includes skincare-like, anti-aging ingredients and serum benefits that help your skin look healthy and radiant over time. There's no scent, which is a big plus for me.

The formula itself is unique—creamy, rich, and buildable. You can apply it with a brush, sponge, or even your fingers, and it blends beautifully.

The price is reasonable, it's easy to find online and at Ulta, and I would absolutely recommend it.

author: Lisa
headline: Another great IT Cosmetics product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I did enjoy this sheer tint face balm. It did originally get to a medium coverage with the first application and I was able to build it up slightly more. It did feel a bit tacky so I had to use a setting powder to set it down to my liking. It felt light weight, lasting over 8 hours and I was able to remove it with my makeup removal balm. There is quite a bit in the jar, it's deceiving how much you truly need to apply. Start with less and build up.

author: Rachel
headline: Just ok
comment: I found this product to be just ok. It wasn't something that I found myself reaching for a lot. That being said, it is light and creamy and certainly has buildable coverage. I like that it's not a heavy foundation. Maybe be better suited for summer.

author: Lindsay
headline: Nice for light, undetectable coverage and dry winter skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this in the winter as my skin gets a lot dry and peels a little, and I don't need a ton of coverage. This settles in so nicely. I set it with a touch of powder and you can barely tell I have it on. It's pretty much un-fragranced, and it goes on smoothly, but sets well. I like the glass jar instead of plastic packaging as well. Overall I recommend this if you're curious.

author: Lesley
headline: A Love Over Time
comment: I was gifted this balm through Glass Angeles and have come to love this product.  After initial application, I wasn't sure it was for me. Too dewy.  Too sheer.  But after some finessing and changing the tools I used to apply, I really enjoyed it.  It definitely needs to be set down and isn't my favorite right after the powder is applied but it really looks lovely throughout the day as it wore. Not holy grail status, but definitely in my rotation!

author: Jodi
headline: Perfect skin tint!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a perfect sheer tint! I love it! It is a perfect lightweight foundation. The application is a breeze! It blends so beautifully! This will definitely be a staple when I'm wanting just a little bit of coverage! Do yourself a favor and try it! You won't be disappointed!

author: Crista
headline: It Cosmetics Sheer Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive skin type & fair complexion & skin tone red head & this product from It Cosmetics didn't make my skin irritated. The blendability was flawless. It blends like butter. I'm obsessed with this product I am thrilled & will purchase in the future as it didn't make me look valet more like my true skin but covers redness & blemishes well but it is sheer as stated so keep that in mind it is not ment to cover up heavy deep blemishes. This will be my go to easy quick make up look. Highly Recommend this product from It Cosmetics. Thank You @ It Cosmetics for killing it once again!!!!

author: Ashley
headline: Works well
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is darker then I thought it would be but once on it seems to not be as dark. Definitely more of my summer color. It's very light weight and removal is easy. Doesn't make me breakout and I don't notice any smell with it.

author: Lisa
headline: Creamy
comment: I received this complimentary for my honest review. The Do It All sheer tint face balm comes in a glass jar. It's super creamy but have a texture between a mouse and gel. It's super blendable but gives more of a natural sheer finish. Over all if your looking for a sheer natural finish this tint is worth checking out.

author: Jassy
headline: Its lightweight and gives beautiful finish
comment: This sheer tint face balm is absolutely amazing on my skin during this season. Before applying i normally prep my skin and on top of that it goes so easily with brush or fingers .It gives perfect finish which looks glowing. I like it has skincare like ingredients which suits on my skin. If you don't like matte foundations then this is literally for you. Not heavy or greasy totally my kind of tint face balm.

author: KiMack
headline: You Can Do It All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] With the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, you really can do it all. I was a tad skeptical about the coverage and consistency of a balm in a jar. There was no reason to be! The formula applies and blends out so easily. The light coverage is great and even slightly buildable if you want more coverage. I would not call this hydrating like a balm, but it doesn't need to be. My dry combination skin reacted just fine to it with no dry or cakey patches. The face balm gives a nice natural kind of finish with a bit of radiance. I really enjoy how lovely it makes my skin look. I will purchase!

author: Alexandra
headline: Great for light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this product. It's easy to use and it blends into your skin so easily. The coverage is light, but it did even out my skin. It was hydrating and skincare-like. It didn't feel like I was wearing anything!

author: Amanda
headline: a new part of my makeup routine!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The picture doesn't do this justice! I love this product! I love that it has serums in it, so it is hydrating (which is perfect for these extra cold winter days!) It is buildable, but I have been wearing this under my makeup throughout the week and then on days when I'll be home all day or maybe just run an errand or two, I will put this on as my base and then put a little powder on to set it! It says to apply this with your fingers or a brush, I prefer using a brush to apply it.

author: grandma
headline: mature skin with wrinkles
comment: what are the pros and cons of this product for mature skin with wrinkles?

author: Jessica
headline: Good for a sheer balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth and silky texture, applies like butter. Light weight formula and great coverage for a sheer balm. My only issue is it looks cakey around the chin and lip area! Maybe it's just me or my skin but overall I will still use just wished it would blend in a little better in those areas.

author: Marybeth
headline: A great tinted balm for light coverage and skincare benefits
comment:
Here's a polished version in your voice, warm and real, no weird phrasing:

I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The texture honestly feels more like a comforting serum than makeup, super lightweight and hydrating on the skin, while still giving a really flattering light coverage. It's easy to build if you want a bit more coverage, and applies effortlessly with either your fingers or a foundation brush.

I tried the shade Fair Cool 125, and I will say it runs slightly darker than I'd typically expect for a fair cool shade, so I'd recommend going a shade lighter than usual. That said, I still really love this product. The skincare ingredients like peptides, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E make it feel like it's actually doing something good for my skin while I'm wearing it, which is always a win.

author: Lisa
headline: Applies amazingly smooth
comment: I've never used a face bomb before, but this IT cosmetics, sheer tint face balm is amazing. It is lightweight cooling and blends in so smoothly given me a very sheer tent with just a touch of added color for a Dewey glow.

author: Becki J
headline: Lightweight Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so smooth and moisturizing! I'm adding two pictures… One showing it before I wrote it down and another showing in my arm afterwards. It really is a good creamy sheer coverage! I've been wanting to lean into a lighter foundation, and I think this is going to be perfect. It's very easy to get it out of the jar, and the pigment seems like it's going to work for a wide variety of skin tones!

author: Angie
headline: Love the texture and finish!
comment: This foundation has a great slip texture, making blending easy—the perfect amount of coverage to even out average redness and discoloration.  Powders and creams layer well.  The finish has a great dry down to an understated satin glow. Great product!

author: Sara
headline: Good for no makeup-makeup days!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy this for no makeup, makeup days! it's exactly what it says it is- sheer makeup but buildable. it doesn't leave me greasy in my t-zone surprisingly! I didn't notice a smell at all. goes on well with a brush or beauty sponge! blends easily! Packaging is nice!

author: Charmie
headline: Perfect lightweight coverage 👌
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I appreciate the lightweight and smooth texture of this product. It offers commendable coverage despite its light consistency. While I may not use this product daily during the winter, it would be an excellent choice for summer activities such as lakeside outings and general use. I highly recommend this product.

author: Anna
headline: Nice light coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the It Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Face Tint.  I'm usually a full coverage type person rather than a sheer foundation user, but I like to have no makeup makeup days, and I thought I'd give this one a chance.  

The product appeared to be the wrong shade for me, but after applying it blended into my skin fairly nicely with a sponge.  I applied a thin layer and it was almost no coverage, so I did build it up a bit with another layer and had a nice light coverage.  It seemed to blend nicely with my other makeup, and it wore well throughout the day.  It's not an every day type product for me, but I enjoyed using it and is perfect for those no makeup makeup days.

author: Shannon
headline: Applies and blends easily.
comment: I do like this face balm. I like that it has a light coverage to even out my skin. I am not crazy about the packaging. I would prefer it in a squeeze tube. You have to apply alot to be able to blend it out since its in a pod and more of a balm. Overall though I do like it. Gives a light coverage that makes you look more bright and awake.

author: Tiffany
headline: This is great!
comment: I really like this product, it has decent coverage, a slight sheen to it and looks like no make up! I have redness to my skin with some acne and it does a decent job with coverage. I like that this is skincare too! I feel better about putting it on my face. It blends easily, isnt cakey and gives you a fresh looking face! Buy it!

author: Jen
headline: New makeup staple
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is great. I don't wear foundation and usually just use a glow enhancing cream under blush. I added this to my routine and find that it does a great job at evening out my skin tone (I have rosacea and get red blotches quite regularly) and this leaves my skin even with a slight glow. It glides on smoothly and does not look like you have makeup on.

author: Danielle
headline: Smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm has a nice tint a little dark for my complexion. Easy to use container and easy to apply. Blends well. Long lasting coverage. Not cakey like some balms I've used in the past. Would recommend.

author: Joedo
headline: A better version of You
comment: I was skeptical when I first opened the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The color shade looked much too dark for my skin tone. Surprisingly, it worked so well it was hardly noticeable at first. The balm is in a tub so must be applied with your fingers or your own applicator. I used my fingers and spread it over my face. It doesn't smell and goes on smoothly. The appearance is more matte than dewey, which I liked. It's a sheer tint with moisturizers that keep your skin fresh. With use over time, my face did not experience any breakouts. The coverage stays put all day. It's a better version of yourself!  I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Kayla
headline: Just ok
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This compact was easy to use. I prepped my face with my usual moisturizer and primers and used a brush to apply it. The color I chose was a bit too dark so I felt a little self conscious wearing a shade too dark. This gave a dewy glow. I have somewhat oily skin and this mostly sat on top of my skin and came off throughout the day. I would definitely use a setting powder next time.

author: Tiera
headline: The it cosmetics skin tint balm is like your skins better ve
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very grateful for the opportunity to try out the it cosmetics Do IT ALL skin tint balm. I loved testing it out because it definitely is being loved already. I want to note that it was a perfect shade (rich warm 505 ) match for my complexion and skins under tones which was perfect. The skin tint balm is a sheer to build able coverage without any sents, it's also pretty quick and easy to use and wear. I am truly amazed by the way that it blended into my skin really well. Like a weightless moisturizer in my perfect complexion shade match. It has a great longevity wear time because it's a sheer complexion product that appears to improve the look of your skins appearance overall. I noticed my skins natural radiance while wearing the product. I'm enjoying it 10/10 would definitely purchase it for backup.
I'm in love with this skin tint balm and I'm usually into medium buildable coverage. It works great with other products also. Setting it was optional for me.

author: Rachel
headline: Almost perfect
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] One light layer later this is very sheer and lightweight. Doesn't cover much. However, if I warm another small amount between my fingers and apply the second layer, that's where the difference is. Then it covers (still sheer) but in a natural diffused kind of way. 
It's almost perfect-except it can cling to dry patches and lines if not buffed out enough. A little bit goes a long way though-it's unscented and the shades are super flexible. It lasts for about 6-8 hours and kind of melts in my skin. No major irritation or breakouts noticed. Solid 4.5 stars

author: Marie
headline: Not a fan at all!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think tinted moisturizer type products that are very light weight should be in a tube. For me this product was so sheer no matter the amount I added on. Maybe I picked to light of a shade but I don't think I'd try it in any other colors.

author: Veronica
headline: First Time Using A Skin Tint That Was A Balm…
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've never tried a sheer face tint balm that has a 92% skincare serum in it as well. I have used skin tints but in a liquid form. This was buttery soft for the texture and light weight on the skin. I used my fingers to apply it on my face and then used a brush to blend it out (which was quite easy to do). The color was a good match this time (Light Neutral 210) and thankfully I didn't have to use color correction!  It has lasted me throughout the day fairly well (I also used a setting powder).  There isn't a residue to me, plus I love the skincare serum being in it.

author: Martha
headline: Do it all tint face balm
comment: Okay so the Do it all skin face balm by it cosmetics  actually performs pretty good it's like a pomade and the texture is very soft You only need a little bit and a little bit goes a long way it does cover well it dries quickly it wears like a velvet matte and it wears all day however it was just too drying for me and it worked well with blending the rest of my makeup with it I had no problem It has no scent whatsoever My only problem was that the shade oxidized a lot as you can see in the picture it turned very orange and I had the color light medium warm 225 maybe with the right shade it would have been better so all in all it is good but it does oxidize too much. And is very light it weights nothing and it's very compact you can put it in your pocket or in a very small purse it fit's anywhere So that's another plus

author: Handbaglove
headline: Fantastic skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never used a base product like this but I'm honestly pleasantly surprised . It was so easy to dip my brush into the pot and apply it. It spreads easily and seems to sink into the skin. It feels like you are applying a light lotion to the skin. It gives light coverage and leaves a very glowy, skin-like finish. It is too glowy to leave unpowered so I always set it with powder. Other products layer well on top and it wears well throughout the day (not as long lasting a matte foundation for very well for tinted balm). I do get some shine breakout towards the end of the day but it can easily be touched up with blotting paper or some powder. I think this product is perfect for someone who wants light coverage, hydration and a glowy finish.

author: Victoria
headline: Makeup and skincare in one product is a win!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've always wanted to try tinted face balm but they usually have a few shades. It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face balm comes in 15 shades! It's literally a solid balm that transforms into a lightweight tinted moisturizer. It is ultra blendable using it with a brush. The coverage is sheer but buildable. It goes on smoothly. I love the combination of skincare and makeup together making it easier to get ready and go. It gives a radiant healthy glow while keeping my skin hydrated and healthy.

author: Anna
headline: Natural, Flawless, Everyday: IT Cosmetics Tint Face Balm
comment:
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm comes in a sleek and practical round glass compact.
