comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lightweight coverage! My redness is covered and my skin feels so soft without heavy residue. This is easy to wear and easy to remove. I will definitely finish this free product!

author: Lauren
headline: Sheer foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] All and all I think this is a good product. It is very sheer, so I was a little more hopeful that it would cover my redness which it didn't really. But it is a nice foundation to wear when I want to feel a little more put together without having a heavy layer of makeup on. I wish it wasn't in a pot, because you have to use a brush with it, otherwise it's sheer. And dipping a brush or fingers into most of the product just leads to buildup of bacteria which makes my skin breakout.

author: Michelle
headline: Great lightweight product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Just to start off- the shade that I received is NOT the correct shade that matches my complexion. Not sure if it's what I chose or if it was just sent to me. That being said, although I can't use it. I do love that lightness and the smooth texture of the product.. I would def go seek out the correct color match and try it. So that's why I rated it "good" instead of "excellent".

author: Lindsay
headline: Love this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is one of those products I  didn't know I needed and now I don't know what I ever did without it. It goes on so smooth and sheer you can't even tell that you are wearing it. It's absorbs quickly into the skin but it also smoothes out uneven skin tone for a flawless light weight look.

author: Tammie
headline: Great tint
comment: I love how this tint is sheer and buildable. It's so perfect. It doesn't hang in my lines and creases. It's  great alternative to foundation [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Tiffany
headline: Perfect for those "no makeup" makeup days
comment: This is the perfect product for that "no makeup" makeup look or if you need to get out of the house quick, but still want to look put together. I find It Cosmetic complexion products tend to run darker,  so the shade fair cool that I picked  matched me perfectly even though I always wear shades from the light lines. The product is sheer at first, but you can absolutely build the coverage up. It blends out so easily whether you are using a brush, sponge, or your fingers. Even with just one layer, it does a great job at evening my skin tone and minimizing the redness in my cheeks. It leaves me with a gorgeous and hydrated glow. Powders and creams applied beautifully over this and my base held up nicely throughout the day. I love that it is primarily created with skincare ingredients that benefit your skin over time. I will definitely continue to use this product on a regular basis.

author: Gabrielle
headline: Really double up on the hydrating moisturizer first!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This reminds me of the L'Oréal age perfect 4 in 1  tinted balm that's been discontinued but that was more hydrating. I have sensitive skin that is rosacea prone and dry, in saying that I look for products that are geared for sensitive skin that pack a ton of moisture and are fragrance free. I was very excited to try out this new IT cosmetics Do it all sheer tint 4 in 1 face balm, now the claims are true it absolutely is a sheer wash of color which I generally like and it's very lightweight but I felt like it was lacking in the hydrating department even though it's packed with Vitamin E, Hyaluronic acid and Collagen peptides. It blended in with ease but clung to some of my dry spots, which I didn't love. It also really stuck onto my fingers as I rubbed it in ( I lotion them constantly it's just freezing and dry outside ), I found that strange. I appreciate the small jar as I can throw it in my bag when I want a little balance in my complexion but without having to do a full face. All in all I think the product has potential but you have to apply it to a fresh moisture surged skin prepped face, go heavy on the moisturizer first if you have dry skin! I was sent this item complimentary in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion.

author: Beebs
headline: Really comfortable tinted balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm feels light to the touch and blends in seamlessly. As I get older I want less coverage and more skin care: this fits the bill. On my combination skin, it feels soothing without being greasy. It evens out uneven pigmentation but    won't cover dark sports or melasma. I like the wide opening and tried using a sponge and brush but actually prefer using my fingers. This works nicely over both my mineral and chemical sunscreens.

author: Maggie
headline: Great product
comment: I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I had really great results with this face balm. It has a nice texture and is easy to apply and blend in. It is very natural looking. Highly recommend!

author: Frances
headline: It's and IT day
comment: IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer is a lightweight, skin-loving formula that delivers a natural, healthy glow without feeling heavy. It blends effortlessly, evens out the complexion, and adds just the right amount of sheer coverage for everyday wear. Perfect for a no-makeup makeup look, it leaves skin looking fresh, smooth, and hydrated all day.

author: ELL dee
headline: I would buy this product over and over again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face bomb leaves your skin feeling smooth the shade is perfect. You could build on it with other makeup stays on all day Lovett.

author: Anastasia
headline: Makes my tired skin look healthy
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love it cosmetics face cream and have been using it for years, so I was very excited to try their sheer tinted balm. First things first, the packaging, It comes in a glass jar not plastic has nice weight to it. Even though designed is simple, it looks quality unlike plastic does. The jar opening is kinda small though. My foundation brush has no extra wiggle room and it can get a bit of a mess. This by far is my biggest complaint about this product. Next, the application, It was very easy to apply and blend it on my skin. I used a foundation brush as mentioned before, dipped it directly into the pot and then onto my face. Took me like 10 seconds from start to finish. I have not tried it with a beauty blender yet but see no need since the brush works so well. Anyways, the application is very fast and effortless. Love it. It feels hydrating and cooling when applying. This balm looks very skin like, you can't even tell I wear something yet my skin looks evened out. You can see it on the picture, or can you?! ;) It makes my skin looks healthy and glowy as well but never greasy. Just the right amount of glow. I find, it also makes my dull, tired and frankly, aging (sigh!) skin look fresh. And now that we are in winter and all summer sun glow long gone, I especially need it! It is a sheer balm, so it does not cover blemishes but it makes them look less angry less visible anyway and does not cling to the dry patches. And has no scent btw. 
It does not claim to hide dark circles either, yet it makes a significant difference for me without settling into fine lines, awesome!  I think, It is perfect for when you do not want to wear make up but still want to have more even skin tone, perfect to wear on its own and by itself with nothing else. Perfect for mature skin, it smoothes, hydrates the dry texture, does not settle into fine lines and pores and does not add grease to oily areas. Also, I use both powder and cream blushes and bronzers. Powders goes on top of it diffused not clinging in patches. When I used it with creams, the colors blended easy, melted right into the balm,l which did not lift. Since it is sheer and hydrating, it won't give you 24 hour wear, it's just not the type of product that does it. But it still lasted on me pretty much all day. Some did wore off especially around nose/ mouth area but it wasn't noticeable. There was no visible line and somehow still looked good overall. Overall, I am very happy with this tinted balm. It is a perfect effortless easy every day and day time wear which is what I need most of the time. For evenings and special occasions, I will use something with more coverage. But for every day wear, this is IT! Pun intended.

author: Ashley
headline: Smooth and light weight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I would say this foundation is light coverage, and evens out skin tone. It feels very lotion like. I prefer to apply it with a brush. It has a light citrus smell like other it cosmetics products. Initially your face will look wet and I am tempted to set it, but I don't because I'm about 5 mins it's dried down and set. I have combo skin. Oily nose and dry chin. I think overall it lay down well. Blotting needed on nose. My photo is of my chin before and after coverage.

author: Ruby
headline: Mature skin has a new favorite tinted skincare serum
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review and honestly I really like it! As a woman with mature skin I have trouble finding products that won't make my fine lines more noticeable. This sheer tint face balm does just that- gives m seamless cover without making my texture look ugly. It's solid in the container and melts like butter to touch. The warmth from your fingers is enough to change the viscosity to a soft butter balm. It's easy to open, apply and put away. 10/10 for me!

author: Rania
headline: Awesome
comment:
The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a total win for anyone craving that effortless, glowing "no-makeup makeup" look—especially if you like products that double as skincare. I've been using it daily since it launched, and it lives up to the hype as a 4-in-1 hybrid: tinted balm, hydrating serum, subtle firming treatment, and radiant skin perfector.
The texture is genius—it starts as a solid balm but melts into an ultra-lightweight, serum-like feel that blends seamlessly with fingers or a brush (no patches or streaks). It delivers buildable sheer coverage that evens out tone, blurs fine lines, and gives this natural, plump, dewy glow without ever feeling heavy, greasy, or cakey. The 92% skincare base (with hyaluronic acid, biosynthetic collagen peptide, and vitamin E) keeps skin hydrated all day, and over time (after a few weeks), my complexion really does look smoother and more radiant—brand claims check out here.

author: Melissa
headline: Beautiful skin tint option
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a watery, light, barely there face tint. I didn't have high hopes as someone with oily skin and vascular rosacea who lives in a humid climate but I was pleasantly surprised. It feels wet—not greasy—when applied and seems to build well. My shade is a bit too cool (Fair Cool 125) for me to comfortably wear but the more neutral shade would probably be perfect. Unlike the Milani stick, this didn't create or stick to any dry patches and would be perfect for a no-makeup makeup look. I was able to powder it without problems but my face kept eating it within hours. I would absolutely buy this in a more neutral stage once my current skin tint runs out. This would probably be a dream product for dry skin folks who want light coverage.

author: Emily
headline: One and done
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint helps cover my redness and gives me glow without looking cakey. The shade is warm and gives my skin a healthy tint. I didn't even need a concealer!

author: Manjeet
headline: Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a sheer tint face balm. The product is amazing does dissolve in skin instead of giving me an ashy look as I have brown skin tone. The light gives me a glow and it just requires minimal amount for coverage.

author: Alicia W
headline: Just Ok
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. I was looking forward to this product, as I'm a person who prefers a natural makeup look. This certainly is a balm, however the jar makes it difficult to use the product. I ended up dipping my brush in the jar and then applying. I don't like this method. I also didn't get the greatest match color wise.  The product itself is a thin almost greasy formula. It wasn't my favorite product from this brand.

author: Barbie
headline: Just OK
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Let me start by saying that I LOVE this brand.  I really really wanted to like this product but it was just average for me.  It definitely is easy to apply, very silky smooth but I don't see the purpose of it.  It seems like it would be similar to a tinted moisturizer and yes it moisturizer but that's it.  There really is hardly any tint.  There's no coverage at all.  I'd rather continue using my regular moisturizer.

author: Paola123
headline: Yes babe
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product thanks to Influens and It for my honest review! This product is a 10/10! This tint is 4-in-1, as it's a moisturizer and serum that hydrates and nourishes the skin. It also reduces fine lines. And the best part is that it works as a foundation with medium to full coverage. It's like applying butter; it blends incredibly smoothly. It's also vegan. I loved it. Is long lasting, easy to remove! And sheer finish.

author: Julie
headline: Glowy nice finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The finish of this foundation is amazing very creamy easy to blend, nice color match, great for any skin type and has 92% skin care in it, what an amazing product, love the packaging and formula,  it has a nice coverage and love the glowy finish, it doesn't look cakey or heavy on mature skin, and has a great price point for a good product

author: LM
headline: Blends nicely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm tint has a very nice consistency! It is easy to apply and blend in, definitely can tell there is a serum in it. It provides moderate coverage that is perfect for everyday wear. Don't expect a full coverage tint from this!

author: Dee
headline: Awesome
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Most days all I wear if tinted spf so was very excited to try It Cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm. Firstly the application is super simple, the tint face balm blends easily into my skin leaving my skin looking amazing. Highly buildable as well. Another winner from It Cosmetics!

author: Linda
headline: Great skin balm with great skin care ingredients
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This do it all skin balm is everything I was looking for. I have aging skin so wrinkles show with most foundation I use. This balm actually helps it. Doesn't define my fine lines. There's no scent and the coverage sheer. Perfect for everyday no makeup look but just the right amount of coverage. I would highly purchase again.

author: Tomeka
headline: Best face tint Balm!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been looking for a face tint and this is it. Easy to apply with a sponge or brush. Goes on smooth and blends quickly. The shade was a tad bit too
dark for me but I made it work. This product has no smell at all. All day wear till you remove it. Easy to remove with a makeup wipe as well. I will definitely buy this product again.

author: Melissa
headline: Highly recommend
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
IT cosmetics did amazing with this product! I love how it's so lightweight but blends with my skin so well. It matches my melanated skin perfectly without having to add an additional product.

author: Liz
headline: Make your coverage perfect.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is very lightweight on the skin, it blends out effortlessly. Its has light sheer coverage but could be built up depending on what kind of coverage you like. Personally, I liked it a lot.

author: HK
headline: Bursting with hydration
comment: I actually really, really love this stuff. I usually use the cc cream and I think that this honestly feels a little bit lighter and less heavy and more hydrating. In the picture, it looks like it doesn't match my forearm, but it matches my face perfectly once rubbed in I was a little nervous at first, cause it looked a little too dark but once I rubbed it in, it was a perfect match. It's super hydrating and I also love that it's in a little compact jar. It makes it really portable to cart around in your purse for touchups or bring on vacation.

author: Lin
headline: Lightweight and cooling
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has a really interesting texture that feels light, moussey, and cooling. I tapped it on with a dense brush and was able to cover my capillaries from rosacea. It is buildable without becoming heavy. The only complaint I have is the fair cool shade needs to be paler, it's pretty dark. Please make more shades!

author: Rhonda
headline: Feels light and non greasy
comment: I received this product for my honest review. This is a nice silky feeling tinted moisturizer. I love the feel of it on my skin. This is a buildable coverage as well as amazing hydration throughout the day without greasiness. It's very easy to use and goes on very smoothly. Choose as much or as little as you need to get the look that you want. It also firms in minimizes lines right away and over time. This is a great product to add to your makeup selection.

author: Sara
headline: Super effective
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has become a standout favorite in 2026 (yes, already!) because it offers high value for those who prioritize a look that gives that "your skin but better" vibes, without the heavy makeup or the heavy feel of traditional makeup.
The finish of this balm is truly its "superpower". It provides a luminous, sheer veil that makes your skin feel weightless and look hydrated with a healthy glow and kind of a "blur" effect. 
The packaging is travel-friendly which is super important to me because a makeup product with this much value is something I want to take everywhere.

One of the best features is how easy it melts away. Because this formula is sheer, balm-base, it doesn't grip to the skin. Also, this goes hand in hand with the fact that this is a non-comedogenic product so it didn't cause any breakouts in my skin.

author: Renee
headline: Great coverage would recommend !
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wonderful coverage ! As you can see in the photo there was great coverage and it provided moisture as well. I have very dry skin and it helped hydrate it. I would recommend

author: Anna
headline: Lasts all day. Smooths complexion
comment: Complimentary for IT Cosmetics. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how portable this balm is. I can keep it in my purse for touchups and it does not take up much room. I can tuck it into any pocket. I absolutely love this sheer tint face balm serum because it's not heavy. It is a lightweight formula that smooths and evens my skin tone never feels greasy or heavy. It leaves a sheer matte finish and never cracks. My face doesn't dry out and I'm loving the formula. Works well under makeup and is so easy to apply.

author: Lacey
headline: Wow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all, wow.  This  face balm is light weight and really makes my redness disappear without being too heavy on my face. I like how easy it is to apply and the fact that it matches perfectly.

author: ThisRedheadheadReviews
headline: Great for light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ohhh I love this!!! It's sheer coverage that blends in well and feels nice on my skin. It has lasted all day with my regular make up. A little goes a long way and this makes me look naturally flawless. I'm a fan of IT Cosmetics full coverage foundation but this great for a lighter option.

author: Rita
headline: It's ok.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I usually really love It cosmetics products an was so excited about this skin tint balm. I love the packaging. I love the solid glass container that the product shade is visible through. It's definitely small enough for travel but a bit heavy because of the container which I personally like. Doesn't feel flimsy. It's not scented or at least not as strong as many other products. The consistency is beautiful. Very lightweight. However it didn't do much for my skin. I love a skin tint (typically use hourglass or milk or mac) but this one just felt like I definitely had something on but not enough to notice any changes in my skin tone. Meaning it wasn't as pigmented as I'd hoped to even out my skin tone. I know it's not a full coverage - I prefer skin tints over foundation as of late and this just fell flat for me.

author: Han
headline: Great tint face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Tint-Face Balm gives a natural, sheer tint with a subtle glow and comfortable, hydrating feel. Users find it easy to wear daily, blends well, and keeps lips soft, though the color payoff is light.

author: Crystal
headline: 41 year old approved
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm a super fan of It Cosmetics, so when I saw this.. I was super excited & without fail.  The formula feels so nice when applied.. It 100% feels like a luxury skincare serum, but the bonus is the shade! It applies so nicely & makes my skin look youthful and silky. I forsee this becoming my new go-to. It looks like my skin but better & I adore a natural neutral look.

author: Laura-Maria
headline: Blends out so smooth and hydrating!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My face is normally VERY extra red as I have fair skin and a Rudolph red nose :p but this is such an awesome little cover up! I've worn it 3 days now and I'm not feeling cakey or dry— it's actually light and feels hydrating as I use a brush to sweep it across my face. The finish is fresh and dewy —not sweaty. I usually only wear light foundation for spot cover ups so idk how this would make my skin react over long period use but for the days I want a bit more smoothing out of my face, I'll be using it. (I usually breakout or get this weird suffocating feeling when I wear makeup so I like to mix it up!) Packaging wise: I kind of like the little tub but I'm wondering how gross it's going to get with regular use — I understand cleaning tools regularly but I typically go for the products that you pour or squeeze out without touching (any tips there?)

author: Sue
headline: Love this product
comment: I received this product to sample and leave my honest review and I totally loved it!  It worked for my undereye area and my whole face. No need for a second concealer!  It felt smooth and made my skin soft and moisturized.  I totally recommend this product to all

author: Maura
headline: This Product is Sorcery
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review and cannot say enough good things about this product. First, as a 40something, I am highly critical of products settling into fine lines and wrinkles. I want glow too. This is magic..the color blends in seamlessly and is soooo foolproof to apply. It seemed yellow in the jar but somehow looks perfect on my fair skin. It's freezing here and this somehow glides on, doesn't show any dry caking and doesn't look like my lines are accentuated. It has skin care in it too, such a bonus! Truly love this.

author: Coco
headline: Sheer, Beautiful Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I didn't expect to love this new face balm as much as I do. It glides on, providing sheer buildable coverage that evens out tone without masking your skin. It leaves behind a gorgeous, healthy glow that looks like your skin on its best day. It wears evenly for hours, never clinging to dry patches or settling into lines. The texture is so lightweight it feels like nothing at all. It works well with skin care, sunscreen, primers and makeup products. 

What I love most is that it is not in any way sparkly or greasy, just gives that fresh, healthy lit from within appearance to the skin.

author: Megan
headline: Definitely a great fit for certain consumers!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I read the claims on this and it appears to have a lot of skincare benefits, however I haven't used it long enough to see any improvement in my skin. It does give a slight hint of color when you blend it out. It definitely left a dewy finish, which I'm not a huge fan of, but for people who like that look, they will love this. It gave me very light coverage but just enough color to even out my skin a bit. I will definitely continue to use this product but I don't think I would purchase it on my own.

author: Kate
headline: Great product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used it on my face, but the color is way off so I took a picture on my wrist to show. 
I did like the texture. It's very smooth and it goes on so easily. The coverage is light, not caked which is nice for more mature skin. I would definitely buy it in my shade!

author: Krystal
headline: Soft blend smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics always has amazing items! Coverage is great, even with my fair skin you can see it covers the redness and blemishes. I didn't have to heavily apply or blend it into my skin. It went on well, blended out evenly, and looked like my skin had more of a natural glow than before. The container was easy to open even with my arthritis. The do-it-all Sheer Tint Face Balm does exactly as it says! Simple soap and water to remove, no irritation after either.

author: Amanda
headline: Best sheer tint face balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sheer tint face balm by IT Cosmetics.  It is very creamy as it is 92% skincare serum which is perfect for my 40 something skin.  It also has amazing buildable coverage which I was not expecting since it's a sheer tint.  I love the fact you can choose sheer to medium coverage while still being a light weight formula.  It did not settle in my lines or pores and it lasted all day without streaks or wearing off.  The balm worked really well over different types of moisturizers and it did not peal which I applied liquid or powder blush.  The color I chose is a little dark for me in the winter but would be a great match for the summer.  I absolutely recommend this one for any skin tones.

author: Sarah
headline: Great looking foundation
comment: Really natural finish. Feels great in my skin but still covers up most of my redness. I applied it with a brush and went on really easy and blended super well.

author: Denise
headline: Perfect for everyday!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!  This is so silky, moisturizing and light!  Most tints are not the correct color, too heavy, don't cover…but not this!  Do it all does it well.  Feels so good, blurs uneven coloring seamlessly and stays put! With that said - I am not a foundation, contour, full coverage gal.  Just a little something to blend, powder, blush and go.  Perfect for everyday!

author: Angie27
headline: It cosmetics
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. It cosmetics works amazing on my skin. I looked at the tint color and thougbt it wasnt going to work for my skin color. I was surprised when i apllied the sheer tint. Very soft and smooth it blended so well on my skin. It was easy to apply and remove with makeup remover wipes. The product itself felt like a thin layer of lotion applied on my face. I got the light neutral in 210

author: Zena
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this face balm. It feels like I am wearing nothing. I use it with a brush and it gives me a buildable coverage without making my skin feel heavy. It lasts all day

author: Erika
headline: She does "Do it all!"
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This iT Cosmetics "Do it all sheer face balm" is exactly what it claims to be! It is extremely lightweight and creamy. It is completely buildable and can either be applied as sheer or as heavy as you like. It also has the benefit of being 92% skincare containing collagen peptides, hyaluronic acid and vitamin E. As someone who has fair, dry and blotchy skin (ie redness, uneven tone, sun damage) I highly recommend this product! It leaves my skin feeling dewy, hydrated and evenly covered! It was easy to apply using a makeup brush and glides on smoothly. It doesn't feel greasy or appear cakey, making it a win-win for me! It also has lasted throughout the day! Next time I will order a lighter shade, however this will be perfect during the summer months. Will definitely be purchasing again knowing it's easy to apply, contains a nice skincare base and looks great on!

author: Lara
headline: I would repurchase! Hydrating
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really enjoying this Do It All Sheer Face Balm! While the coverage is sheer, I do think its buildable. The consistency is very hydrating but it doesn't look greasy or overly dewy. I prefer matte coverage for my oily skin so I was worried this would not play well, but it was wonderful! I also think it works well as a spot concealer and under eye concealer especially for those of us with more mature skin. I would definitely purchase this in the future.

author: Shannon
headline: Great for everyday wear
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends beautifully and helps even out skin tone. It's nice to wear everyday. It's buildable for better coverage. Light weight and just smooths out your face!

author: Meliaa
headline: So creamy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've not had opportunity to use much IT cosmetics so this was so fun to see. I was super curious about this being a face balm. The texture is super smooth and creamy. The color I received doesn't match too well but it can be blended. Interested in finding a better match.

author: Christels
headline: Love this creme and how it covers
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this creme!! I used a brush to apply it and it was so quick and easy.  It covered great and feels so light on! I also don't see my skin looking dry and flaky after a day of wearing it,  which is huge! Its a little pricey  buy seems like a little goes along way.  Really thinking ill be switching after trying this product.  Very impressed.

author: Jen
headline: Wearable for everyday!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have shade Fair Cool 125 and though I tend to wear more neutral shade, I used this as a natural blush since it left my skin a bit flushed. The tinted balm has a serum finish where my skin feels moisturized and looks hydrated after. My skin feels smooth to the touch after and looks very even. It's light weight and definitely wearable every day.

author: Shasta
headline: Holy Cow! It's amazing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Holy cow what a difference! In the photo I only applied the product to the left side of my face and wow! It really does use more coverage than I would expect, but I should have known to be WOWED from It cosmetics! I'm a long time it cosmetics believer. This is creamy, light and easily blendable. I applied with a sponge and truly, this could be my summer makeup with how light it is! The color is great and I'm just overall really happy!

author: Penni
headline: Great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted face balm is great. It provides good coverage without being heavy. I like how it has skincare ingredients in it. The color matches my face decently. I like how a little goes a long way. Thank you, @influenster and @itcosmetics, for sending me this product #complimentary!

author: Lauren
headline: Perfect match
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When I initially saw the color in the pot I was worried it would be too dark but it was perfect.  I applied with my fingers and blended with a beauty blender. The finish is natural b it covers well and feels weightless on my skin. It doesn't look heavy or crease.

author: Beth
headline: Love it!
comment: It is perfect for the everyday no makeup makeup routine and feels amazing on my normal/dry skin!

author: Jessica
headline: Great formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula is a little odd at first, so I recommend using a brush or makeup sponge to apply. It's really cooling and melts into your skin leaving a really nice and natural appearance. I'd highly recommend this product.

author: Jakie
headline: Excellent coverage!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from It Cosmetics is an amazing product for your makeup arsenal! Has a great coverage for a sheer balm giving you a nice finish after applying concealer, bronzer and blush. I don't experience any breakout or reaction in my sensitive skin. The packaging is very sleek. Their formulation promotes a healthy and glowing complexion, is easy to apply and suitable for any type of skin. I highly recommend!!!

author: Teri
headline: Good Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics face balm is great for when you don't want to deal with putting on makeup. It has a silky texture which glides on and although it is a sheer tint face balm it still has good coverage and feels light on your skin.

author: Anna
headline: Sheer but buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product feels lightweight and the formula is very smooth and easily blendable. Buildable without feeling heavy. I love a good moisturizer with a bit of a tint to cover up bits of imperfections and this did its job. The color in the picture looks a bit off but once you blend it, it matches!

author: Erke
headline: Perfection
comment:
Great product! I have been looking for a product who does it all for a while, and I think I have found it. The coverage is light-medium, which I prefer. It makes my skin look very natural, but a bit more even and matte. It's easy to apply, easy to take in a bag with me wherever I go. The color is perfect for my winter skin tone. 

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: LaToya
headline: Perfect for winter! Creamy yet smooth finish.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this so much and it couldn't have come at a better time! It's perfect for winter! Goes on creamy and gives a beautiful finish without being too heavy. I try to limit full coverage during the winter as it's easy to look dried out so this is my new best friend. I wear it to work and still look finished. No scent but I do wish it came with an applicator. Overall I love it!

author: Jessica
headline: I won't be using again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm not a fan of this. I feel like applying it make my under eyes look black and blue which isn't normally seen, it's like it highlighted flaws that are not typically visible. I won't be using it again :(

author: Jennifer
headline: Really great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little unsure about this product at first as I haven't really liked balm products before but I honestly really liked this product. I put it on and started blending and literally said "what!?!" I was shocked with how it blended so perfectly into my skin and left it looking natural but almost airbrushed. It had an almost cooling effect as well. The color was a perfect match for my skin tone and I found it to be a light coverage but buildable. It also dries to a soft, smooth, almost powder feeling product. Also, a little bit goes a long way so this will probably last a very long time for me. Great product and the packaging is nice too!

author: Sarah
headline: Your skin, but better
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from IT Cosmetics is an absolutely fantastic foundation if you're looking for a very natural, lightweight, your skin, but better look. I've never used a face balm before, but I was really impressed with its natural finish, and even more impressed by the durability of this balm. I wore it when I was snowshoeing during a snowstorm for a couple hours, and my skin looked just as great when I got back as it did when I started my adventure. I am super impressed by this product.

author: Parm
headline: Gives your face very nice and natural look
comment: I'm really liking it so far. It gives a light and  buildable coverage. It is perfect on all skin types. It will keep your skin hydrated. It's very comfortable and lightweight for all day wear. A little goes a long way. You can apply with fingers, brush or beauty blender. It is very easy to use. I absolutely recommend it.

author: Ali
headline: Great except for the staying power
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

I found the sheer tint face balm to be super blendable and a great match for my skin! It is sheer but buildable, which I appreciated as I often want a very natural look for daytime but higher coverage if I'm going out. I applied with a brush and found it went on very smoothly.

The main problem I have with this is that the staying power isn't so great, even when you build it up more. I tried on its own, with a translucent powder over top, and with a setting spray. By end of day, I felt like I had nothing left on my face. Ultimately, the staying power is very important to me on days when I'm out and about.

author: Amy
headline: Super Multi-Use
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This such a great convenience makeup item. It's super compact in size but super multi use. I am impressed at the shade match; its a really beautiful match. The product blends nicely. I plan to carry it in my purse for mid day coverage issues.

author: Loa
headline: I Love IT!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this face balm. My skin feels noticeably more hydrated, and the coverage is surprisingly good for a sheer tint. You can clearly see in my before and after photo how well it helps cover my redness and rosacea, even with a small amount of product. The formula looks very natural and smooth on the skin. I ordered one shade darker than my usual tone, and I'm actually very happy with it because it works perfectly for me year-round. The finish is dewy and creamy, which makes it ideal for cold weather and dry skin. I would like to test it during summer or warmer weather since it does have a luminous finish, but for now it performs beautifully. It's perfect for anyone focused on hydration and skin-friendly makeup. Fragrance free.

author: Jessica
headline: Found my new go to makeup
comment: I'm in love with this I'm not the one who wears stuff like this because it feel heavy on my face I go to powder foundation but this Do It All Sheer Tint Balm will be my everyday use it's easy put your purse go doesn't take much put on your face it's soft and smooth doesn't dry my skin out easy wash off I will be trying find it in my Ulta store or ordering bunch online

author: Courtlandt
headline: Light & hydrating
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm from It Cosmetics is a great product for those who enjoy a lightweight base product with a little coverage but who don't want to wear a lot of makeup. It does build in coverage some if you add a second layer where needed. I find that on my combo skin, this product gets shiny after a few hours on my T-zone (but the product did not break down). I tested it with a sticky primer, and that worked great! It's nice, especially for dry skin or during the cold months to have a product with additional hydration, and my skin responded well to this product. It is unscented, doesn't texturize my skin, and doesn't cause breakouts. I also enjoyed the glass jar packaging. A great product!

author: Brooke
headline: Light/ Minimal Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is a great lightweight balm that glides on effortlessly. While it doesn't compare to its other IT Cosmetics counterparts, it is in a league of its own being lighter in coverage. The shade matched beautifully to my skin and seemed to blend fairly easily. It didn't last as long, but with a balm versus a foundation, I suppose it would wear slightly quicker. 
I could see myself using this more in warmer months when I don't need as much coverage as it does have more of a natural wear.

author: Stephanie
headline: Perfect for a glow without coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a fantastic match for my skin. This is basically tinted skincare. It's not going to provide coverage as it's very sheer. Now that's perfect for someone like me that doesn't want or need coverage.. it also gives a gorgeous glow. The application is easy as you literally just dab it on and blend. I'd wear this on days when you just need a little something. I haven't tried with powder to see if that enhances coverage or wear.

author: Brandi
headline: Amazing natural finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love the texture and spreadability of this product. I used to damp beauty blender, and one amazing thing as it didn't settle into fine lines they gave me a wash of color even out my skin cone without looking Kiki. It didn't separate at the end of the day I'm so seriously impressed with this product.!! My skin looks glowy not too shiny

author: Daniella
headline: Best skin balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so lightweight, bendable, melts into the skin and lasts all day. It's literal skincare and doesn't feel like makeup! Love it. I will be trying a lot more from this brand!

author: Sharon
headline: Great brand
comment: I love this brand it cosmetics it works good . It's goes on smooth i get great finishing using it . It has no scent . It's a great price and I will buy it everytime now . I recommend this brand to everyone .

author: Cici
headline: Do it All~ Face Balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  This is such a new and different concept, sheer tint face balm 92% skin care serum. Comes in a round glass jar this soft serum balm lightly adds coverage to the skin. I received the shade Fairest Neutral. It's seems to easily blend with my skin tone. I'm not a person who wears foundation and I find this to be a nice lightweight sheer tint for  a natural appearance. I applied this with my fingers, it was not a liquid wet feeling but more of a powdery dry. It blended smoothly and lasted through out the day. Some nice facts about this product, it contains Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen Peptide and Vitamin E. 
Appreciate the opportunity to try.

author: Amy
headline: I will buy this for sure !
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Never tried something like this before. I must say it is extremely light weight almost feels like a lotion. The shine it leaves on ur face, silky and refreshed. The color is a perfect match. And the coverage is impeccable.f Very very light scent. I would recommend this product !

author: Cristina
headline: Beautiful coverage and finish but emphasizes texture.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetic Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I like the glass jar container with the white top, which is very easy to open and close. It looks aesthetically pleasing. When I first applied the tint it felt fresh and moisturizing, is very creamy and buttery. It feels lightweight and gives me a natural look. It blends and applies beautifully giving me a very soft sheer coverage. This is so convenient for on the go it's a perfect complexion product for a quick minimal makeup look. It covers my redness and imperfections and it feels like skin. It does have a beautiful radiant finish and stays on for a long time. I love everything about it except that it transfers a little on the clothes if not fully absorbed and emphasizes my pore texture. Other than that it's perfect and affordable. I would still buy it. They need to work on 2 things and it will be the perfect everyday do-it-all skin tint that will fly off the shelves.

author: Suzzett
headline: Amazing product.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow I'm super impressed with the skin tint balm. Amazing product. Easy to apply, it is super buildable and blends well . I test wear it all day and it's amazing. I love it. Great product, I highly recommend it.

author: Kay
headline: Quickly become a staple in my routine
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is a fantastic everyday product. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm gives just the right amount of coverage to even out my skin tone while still looking natural and skin-like.

The formula feels lightweight and hydrating, making it perfect for days when I want a fresh, effortless look. It blends easily with fingers and melts into the skin without settling into fine lines or pores. My complexion looks smoother, healthier, and more radiant after applying it.

I also love how versatile it is. It works well on its own for a no-makeup look or layered with other products when I want a bit more polish. It wears comfortably throughout the day and never feels heavy. This has quickly become a staple in my routine and is a great option for anyone who wants simple, natural-looking coverage.

author: Kimberly
headline: It Cosmetics Tinted Face Balm is a must try, I love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was my first time trying a tinted face balm and I must say I was pleasantly surprised. I really like using it. I use my daily moisturizer first and then I used the tinted face balm after which seemed to help seal in the moisturizer.  My skin is extremely dry in the winter and I really loved this.  It was not oily and it goes on so smooth and just blends right in.

author: Kimberly
headline: It Cosmetics Lip Balm is a must try! Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was my first time trying a tinted face balm and I must say I was pleasantly surprised. I really like using it. I use my daily moisturizer first and then I used the tinted face balm after which seemed to help seal in the moisturizer.  My skin is extremely dry in the winter and I really loved this.  It was not oily and it goes on so smooth and just blends right in.

author: Geri
headline: Sheer and soft
comment: The wear and feel of IT Do it all sheer tint gave balm is wonderful. There is no scent.  It made my skin feel soft.  It matched my fair Irish fair skin perfectly.

author: Kacy
headline: Sheer, even, buildable coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Before and after! A nice light color correcting face balm. It has buildable and even coverage. I am naturally splotchy and dry and this evens me out for everyday moisturizing wear.

author: Liz
headline: Love
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Tested on my hand first and loved! It blended very nicely and was a little dark but will definitely use less. Used mainly under my eyes and really liked the appearance. Definitely buildable with makeup.

author: Vee Marie
headline: Lightweight, hydrating, blends easily, gives natural glow wi
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how lightweight and hydrating this feels on my skin. The sheer tint blends easily, evens things out, and gives me a natural, healthy glow without feeling heavy or cakey perfect for everyday wear.

author: Danielle
headline: Smooth and easy to apply
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It Cosmetics Do-It-All Face Balm lives up to its name with a rich, melt-in texture that hydrates instantly and leaves a natural, dewy glow. It smooths dry areas, layers well under makeup, and works great as a moisturizer or glow booster. Simple, versatile, and perfect for effortless, healthy-looking skin.

author: Tiffini
headline: A beautiful balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The value is great. The coverage is beautiful. It covers wonderful and feels light. It is buildable.  It can be used with fingers, sponge, or brush.  It is a wonderful sheer tint.

author: Garima
headline: Subtle glow to skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm is really amazing, feels like nothing on skin but still gives slight matte finish to the skin. The pigment is absolutely skin like and blends in super smooth. Packaging is chic and portable. Very convenient to carry it for quick touchups.

author: Amanda
headline: Not My Favorite
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not the greatest. It's very sheer. Doesn't go on very smooth and the coverage isn't great. Not my favorite product, that is for sure. It was rather hard to remove, as well.

author: MJ
headline: This is IT!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is exactly what I have been waiting for. It is 92% skin care serum that goes on smooth and doesn't sit on top of fine lines and wrinkles. Love it!

author: Mirzana
headline: I was a bit disappointed
comment: I really wanted to love this because the concept is great—a sheer tint with skincare benefits—but it fell a little short for me. The texture feels nice and lightweight, and it does give a natural look at first, but the coverage is very minimal and I found myself needing to use a lot of product to see any difference. Even then, it applied a bit patchy in some areas and didn't blend as evenly as I expected. It's fine if you want something extremely sheer and skin-like, but if you're looking for more consistency or noticeable coverage, this may not be enough on its own.

author: Kristin
headline: Super unique, glowy complexion product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted face balm is a really unique texture! It's verrrry glowy, but isn't greasy. It's wet-feeling on application, and actually has more coverage than I expected. I'd say it's a bit buildable, barely there to light/medium. It's not super long lasting, but did make it through the day ok, and doesn't seem to gather in pores which is a common issue for me. It's a pretty product and the cool fair shade is a perfect match for me-which means it runs dark and warm. I'd recommend it for dry skin girlies, over 40, or if you love a dewy, glowing finish. I'm 51 and could see this being a complexion product I reach for to do a casual, daily look-especially in winter when skin is dry.

author: Carolina
headline: A lightweight, sheer tint balm that evens skin tone, feels c
comment: I really like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The coverage is light but effective, helping to even out my skin tone and reduce redness for a natural look. It blends easily into the skin and feels very comfortable, almost like skincare rather than makeup. The finish is smooth and radiant, not greasy, and it adapts well to my skin throughout the day. It has little to no noticeable scent, which I appreciate, especially for sensitive skin. Overall, it's perfect for everyday wear when you want a fresh, effortless finish.

author: Meg
headline: Do it all sheer face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't really care for this tinted face balm. For me it wasn't enough for me to feel comfortable walking around with this on my face. I had to put my foundation over it. It did do a good job of minimizing my pores. The fair cool color looks dark in the container, but blended in a lot better than I was expecting. I think I would have gone with a lighter shade if I had known.

author: Heidi
headline: A Great Sheer Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm is super lightweight and feels natural. It does exactly what it says, "a sheer tint" meaning that it is not a full coverage product. This is a great option for those days when you do not want to put on a full face of makeup. It doesn't cover imperfections but,  it does blur some of them making them less noticeable. It feels good on the skin, it is not drying,  and it didn't make my face oily even after several hours of wear. It blends easily because it is so light and sheer. I don't have the best skin and I am somewhat self conscious so, I prefer full coverage but, on days that my skin is clearer and I just need something that looks natural and blurs a bit this will be a great option. The packaging was secure, safe, and practical.

author: Heidi

The packaging was secure, safe, and practical.

author: Jaimee
headline: Great coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! I would not say it is sheer, however. You can definitely see a difference in the way it covers my skin. I applied it using a foundation brush. Personally I prefer a full coverage foundation, which is why I really like this product. But if you are really hoping for a sheer tinted cream/balm, this may be too much for you. With that said, it doesn't feel heavy to me. It does offer a bit of a glow/shine, if that's your thing. It hasn't separated, caked up, or increased in shininess, which are all pluses! I would buy this product again and again! I think it may replace my usual tinted face SPF (I use SPF moisturizer anyway). I just love the coverage of this face balm and the way it feels on my skin!

author: Geldc
headline: Skincare tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Understand that you are using a skin tint and not a foundation and you will love this. Formulated with 92% Skincare serum this is skincare first then makeup. I use this on errand days and it wears decent but it is expected of a tint that is majorly skincare. Blends seamlessly and does nit cling to dry patches. I am one that loves the glass jar packaging. I knocked ine star as the shade I think could have been better because I have Light Neutral but is leaning more medium. But other than that this is a beautiful tint. Gifted by It Cosmetics in exchange of an honest review.

author: Madelyn
headline: Beautiful even after hours
comment: I was very excited to try this face balm and was not disappointed, this one give a very beautiful texture on the skin, looks very natural it is buildable, but still a bit sheer probably will need some concealer for blemishes and then this balm, even after hours skin didn't look cakey at all loved that

author: Lisa
headline: It cosmetics do it all serum
comment:
So I received it cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm 
For my honest review . So I liked the feel
and texture of the product. , liked the soft glow it gives my skin  I realize I'm a bit older so I think I need more coverage.  I also do not like dipping fingers  into product as oils from fingers can cause breakouts. I did have one day which it caused me to breakout but it was quickly resolved when I used a sponge for applicator  so I'm guessing that was user error not product.

author: J
headline: Beautiful light coverage
comment: I loved the beautiful light coverage it gave me. Easily applied and blended into my skin with no annoying makeup lines.  It lasted through my day of activities. I would wear this on any day of the week. This was gifted for my honest review. I recommend this for anyone.

author: Courtney
headline: I really like this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never really used a tinted balm like this, but it really like it. However, I did get shade 125 Fair Cool which is not a great match based on the swatch. The only way I can use this is with a dense brush and it sheers out enough it's wearable. This is great for dry skin women and those of us who need next to no coverage/just evening out a little redness (she has barely any coverage at all). Definitely a "no-makeup" makeup look/natural but satin finish. The texture feels almost like water applying. The longevity is okay; I set with a powder after spot concealing with concealer. I will definitely use this. Hoping they may add to the shade range for a better match.

author: Michael
headline: Great for skin, but no SPF
comment: I received this product free to try for my honest opinion. When I first applied it, I hadn't really paid attention to what benefits it offered, I just assumed it was a light/medium coverage makeup product that I was being asked to try. I like the way it went on, it felt light like I wasn't wearing anything, yet my face felt soft. Even though I'm quite red and I'm getting to the age where I have lines on my face, I still like to have a more natural look with my makeup. I definitely feel like this checked that box. There's still some of my natural redness and lines visible, but it's not as bad. After looking up the benefits of using this makeup, I was pleasantly surprised by all that it's supposed to help with...however, I really wish it also offered some SPF in with all those skin care benefits. It's something very important to me. So, I will continue to use this, but I'll save it for when I'm out at night. My skin is typically very dry so before applying this I did apply my moisturizer, then later in the evening my T-zone will sometimes get oily or shiny, I do think this helped keep that at bay or at least hidden for the day.

author: Cari
headline: Easy and pretty!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product seemed to go on a little orange at first, but then the color calmed to match my medium-tone skin. It goes on smooth and feels moisturizing. I have used it as a primer under other makeup when I wanted fuller coverage, but in the included picture I am only wearing this product as foundation. This would be perfect for travel. I applied it using my clean fingertips and rubbed it on my face 80s-90s girl style, eyelids included. I really like how it ended up, and is great for a minimal makeup day or any other day. My dry sensitive skin is loving this stuff - no bad reactions!!! I didn't notice any smell, which I appreciate. Overall I think this one is a keeper!

author: Jennifer
headline: Great skin tint balm for the days you want to cover up
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this Shear tint face bomb because as it says, it does feel like a serum. I love that. It's very lendable. You can put as little as you want and continue to blend more if you want more of a feeling or look, but it's always going to look like a skin finish. I love the consistency. It's not thick, but it's not loose and I feel like it is durable and I love the glass container.

author: Savannah
headline: A millennial must-have
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this consistency and finish of this do it all skin tint. The color is perfect, and the formula is easy to blend and spread.  It feels lightweight and looks very natural on. After wearing this for a full day it left my skin feeling soft and natural.  I recommend this for aging skin.

author: Tina
headline: Coverage, but natural looking coverage
comment:
I received the IT Do-It-All Tinted Face Balm free of charge in return for my honest and unbiased review. 

This face balm is very moist, creamy, and smooth. It doesn't have an off-putting scent. It did not leave my face feeling greasy. It dried quickly, but my skin did not feel as if it was tight or suffocating. It evened out my skin tone, but it still looked natural.  It gave my skin a more youthful glow. It didn't settle into my fine lines. It also stayed put for the rest of the day. It did not accentuate my pores, which is fantastic. There is no need to scoop it out or go overboard with the amount you use during application, because it does a great job evening out your skin tone. It is buildable where you need it. This container of IT Do-It-All Tinted Face Balm should last a good amount of time, since you do not need a lot to make your skin look great. I definitely recommend this tinted face balm to family, friends, and the public in general.

author: Jennifer
headline: Not what I thought
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This melts literally like butter when you first touch it. It almost feels greasy. I used without normal skincare first since its supposed to be primarily skincare/serum according to the label. It dries super fast on my skin and looked powdery. More coverage than a tint.

author: AJ
headline: Very sheer tinted balm
comment: This is a very sheer tinted moisturizing balm. I like that it is not cakey and doesn't enhance wrinkles like some other creams, however for me I need more coverage for dark spots. The color is perfect and blends in nicely with my skin tone. I also prefer a tube vs a jar.

author: Stephanie
headline: It does it all!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The color matches my skin well. Occasionally, I have issues with skin tints that are to orange or yellow looking. Not this one. It matched my slight olive tone fairly well. The product is extremely moisturizing and easy to apply. It's good if you're looking for a quick one and done (no makeup) look, or you can keep going for a more glamorous look. I like it!.

author: Ashley
headline: Love it. Amazing.
comment: I got to try this for free but the opinions here are based on my own experiences. This stuff is awesome. I love it. I just apply it with my sponge and it looks good. It has a little tint to it but it just makes my face look great. I don't always like wearing full foundation and this gives my face a good look without being so thick. It also has skin care serum in it which is nice. There are a few products I am replacing with this. I love it so much. Highly definitely recommend trying.

author: Veronica
headline: Great product: beautiful skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is nice. The balm wasn't a perfect shade match but I blended it really well and it performed beautifully. The picture says it all . My skin turned out really pretty. It has a slight sheen but nothing outrageous. Highly recommend this product.

author: Michelle
headline: Tinted moisturizer
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Shade: 210 Light Neutral

I should have ordered a slightly darker shade, but overall this works well as a tinted moisturizer for days when I want light, natural coverage. I love that it's infused with skincare ingredients and feels hydrating on the skin.

Pros: Lightweight, comfortable, adds moisture, perfect for minimal makeup days.
Cons: Transfers easily onto clothing and doesn't have all-day wear.

author: Meenakshi

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Jo Anne
headline: Buildable Coverage Makes this a Winner!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've always wanted to try a tinted moisturizer in place of foundation but have been hesitant because my uneven skin tone requires coverage I didn't think I could get from anything but a heavier foundation or concealer. Enter IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 92% Skincare Serum in Medium Tan Warm 320. The ingredient list reads like a combo of products I use daily: Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen Peptide, and Vitamin E among others. The balm comes in a small jar with a screw top lid. It's compact enough to keep in a small bag for touch ups. I used my fingers initially but have since switched to a sponge to keep from adding oils from my fingers. The balm is very lightweight. I felt like I used a lot of product to ensure I got enough coverage but my first day using barely made a dent, and now even weeks in of using this multiple times a day, I still have a full jar. It goes on so light but offers buildable coverage so I am able to get the level of coverage that makes my skin look more even. I still use a moisturizer before applying this balm but my skin is very dry and it's winter so I need all the moisture my skin can get! But in the summer, this tint may be plenty on its own. The only downside to the balm is that I don't feel it is long-lasting so I reapply at least once a day. Otherwise, I'm happy with this tinted moisturizer. It hasn't cause any breakouts or irritation and the buildable coverage is exactly what I needed!

author: Stacy

author: Alyssa

This face balm truly looks so natural to my skin tone! It has lasted all day with very minimal touch-ups needed. My face looks radiant, supple, and has a beautiful glass skin effect. author: Jenny
headline: Great sheer, everyday tint!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been a long time user of IT Cosmetics, and was very excited to try the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.

I'm used to full coverage products from IT Cosmetics, but this one is more sheer. It's a your skin but better tint. I was able to build it up a bit with a foundation brush and it covered most of my redness although I would probably go back over with concealer to cover the stubborn red spots. I have shade Fair Warm 120 and it was a great shade match. 
I find it has a natural finish, and it feels like skincare vs makeup on the skin. With setting spray it lasted all day!

author: Elizabeth

author: Dawn

author: Alexassy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was skeptical of the packaging at first, luckily my brush fit nicely but I can imagine the pot being a nuisance if the brush didn't fit. I put on about two layers and had almost med-full coverage. It made my skin look pretty smooth but not skin like, and noticeable I had makeup on. Just not as natural as my usual foundation. The color matched my skin pretty well, a hint more orange than my usual color. I do like the pot because it's more compact when traveling. The texture of the balm is a bit thick but easily blends. After a whole day of wearing this balm, I noticed my face becoming quite oily and you can see the texture of my skin and the balm looking patchy. I might have to set the balm differently or try another method of application. I do like IT Cosmetics products but this one was not my favorite.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first pic is bare skin, second is with serum applied, and third is with my regular makeup on top. It is a 4 in 1 tinted moisturizer that is supposed to transform skin instantly and over time.  It's a serum that combines a sheer, buildable coverage with 92% skincare ingredients.  It is supposed to firm, hydrate and minimize fine lines.  It did hydrate, but I noticed no firming and no minimizing of fine lines.

It contains hyaluronic acid, a biosynthetic collagen peptide, a collagen peptide, and vitamin E.  It comes in 15 shades, which is great!

I was actually quite impressed with this product.  The top screws on and off and it is the perfect size for picking up directly with a brush from the package.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really impressed with the it Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.
