comment: I recently received It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face balm in Fair Cool. It is the perfect shade for my light skin. It is like a moisturizer,  serum and foundation all in one. It's very lightweight and silky on the skin.  I love using it.

author: Kimmy
headline: Must have Tent Face Balm!
comment: I absolutely love this Sheer Tint Face Balm. It doesn't have a scent to me. Goes on so smooth, feels soft on the skin, and is a perfect match to my skin color!! It lasted me all day without looking oily like usual. I recommend this to all skin types. It's amazing it's not heavy at all, doesn't feel like you even have makeup on. Thank you so much IT Cosmetics, for the free IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tent Face Balm, in exchange for my honest opinion and review.

author: Monica
headline: Very sheer skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is very sheer, serum like face tint. The shade is fine. The container is a little messy. Its very full so a little runs on the side after you use it. Overall its a really nice product and my face feels really smooth after I remove it.

author: Briana
headline: Melts Into skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect on the go skin tint! It's great for the days I don't want to do a full face of makeup but still have some coverage! You can see how great of a match it is to my skin, and it literally melts into the skin. I can see using this a lot in the summer too in place of a tinted moisturizer.

author: Bethany
headline: Yessss
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is pretty neat, I love that it's creamy enough to blend and build easily but melted a bit when I touched it to make it really easy to apply. Normally for a face tint, I think it can be difficult to hide certain imperfections but this is more buildable so it applies nicely and I can cover certain areas more. The color matched my skin tone well, and my skin looks great after applying. Also loving the fact that this has great skincare benefits as well to help hydrate my skin. Great for a day where I want the "no makeup" look. It does make my skin look a little more glowy than I normal would go for, so I might just put a bit of translucent powder over it as a finishing touch.

author: Sherrie
headline: I LOVE IT
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thanks for gifting me this to review for my honest opinion. I think I just found my new 
favorite foundation. I absolutely love it. My skin looks 
so good. Your skin will look radiant and beautiful. This 
doesn't settle in my fine lines. I absolutely love it,

author: Holly
headline: Good coverage and lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is creamy and goes on well. I really like the application of it and how it feels on my skin. It's lightweight and gives medium coverage. It does pill up on my skin in certain places. I always wear moisturizer under it. I tried it with primer and without, but it does it both ways. If I our setting powder over it, it does it worse than without. It lasts most of the day on my oily forehead and all day on the rest of my face. It's very simple to remove. I could probably just use water and a wash rag, but I use makeup remover, and it wipes right off. I would recommend this product and hopefully I'll find a way it doesn't pill up on my skin

author: Altovise
headline: Sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The It Cosmetics Fo It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a good addition to my beauty collection. It really is sheer and moisturizing. In the picture I posted you can see how close in color this product is to my skin. I received this product from It Cosmeticsin exchange for my honest opinion .

author: Selena
headline: Effortless Glow
comment: Okay, let's be real—IT Cosmetics' Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is giving me life right now. If you want something light, glowy, and actually hydrating, this is it. It melts into your skin like a dream—no streaks, no cakey mess. I love that it has hyaluronic acid and collagen peptides, so my skin feels nourished, not just "covered." Coverage? It's sheer and buildable, so don't expect to hide all your blemishes, but your skin will look flawless and natural. Perfect for no-makeup makeup days or when you're rushing out the door. Downsides? Shade range could be better, and there's no SPF, so don't skip sunscreen. Overall, it's a hydrating, effortless glow in a stick.

author: Christina
headline: Dewy perfection
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure at first because I didn't know how to apply it, but I saw some influencers online applying it with a brush and that changed the way it looked on my skin! I have very dry skin and this applies nicely and looks dewy. It covered my redness and is totally buildable. I'm not sure if I have the exact right shade for me, but it's good enough for now and I'll buy another when this runs out!

author: ADRIENNE
headline: I want to love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I want to love this product. It applies and blends like a dream, the color is great, it's so glowy and beautiful. However. I did find that the product does tend to separate by the end of the day. I do love the sheer coverage and the creamy texture though.

author: bk
headline: Wish There Was More Product For the Price
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was hesitant to try the balm in 120 W since I usually lean more neutral, but I tan easily and use self-tanner, so I took the risk. I'm glad I did. The balm melted seamlessly into my skin and ended up being a surprisingly good color match. The texture is smooth, creamy, and genuinely comfortable to wear.

The packaging is sleek and substantial. The glass jar has a nice weight to it, and the compact screw-top design makes it easy to travel with. My main hesitation is the size. At 0.63 oz, you have to hunt a bit to even find that detail on the Ulta site, and I do wish you got more product for the price. That said, the formula won me over enough that I'm already curious about trying additional shades.

Bottom line
Beautiful texture, easy wear, and a flexible shade match, just wish the jar held a bit more

author: Donna
headline: Moisturizing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this face balm for no- make-up days or as a base layer. It is like a tinted serum. Its lightweight, silky smooth and blends easily. I apply it lightly on my face to even out my skin tone, then build up on dark spots and acne scars. It stays on fairly well.

author: jvhazel
headline: Tinted face Balm
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I like that Its lightweight, has a radiant-finish tinted moisturizer and foundation balm in one, designed to make your skin look better. It has 92% skincare base with collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E, IT delivers sheer, buildable coverage leaving  my skin hydrated as well. Perfect for winter weather,
Its ultra-blendable solid-serum texture melts on contact for effortless application, making it as easy to use especially with a brush.

author: KK Quin
headline: Sheer, smooth coverage
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is great for "no-makeup" days. It's very sheer but it effectively evens out redness and gives a dewy glow. I have combination skin and it wears well for 6-7 hours. The tinted balm almost feels more like skincare than foundation! I prefer to apply this with a big, fluffy brush but it's also super easy to apply with fingers when you're in a rush.

author: Casey
headline: Obsessed
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok I'll admit at first I was like what is this stuff but I'm sold for life. Somehow it perfectly matches my tone but it has an element of coverage and moisturizing properties to give your skin the most hydrated look without being cakey

author: Nancy
headline: Lightweight coverage
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I liked that IT Cosmetics face balm had lightweight but, buildable coverage. The finish looked almost dewy. I didn't like that it settled into my dry skin and fine lines a little.

author: Janette
headline: Constant blotting and repowdering
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been giving this a fair try and used it for a full week, but I don't think it works well for my skin type. I have oily skin with large pores and some fine lines, This really emphasizes them especially on my forehead. The neutral shade also pulls warm on me and looks a bit orange. I do like how easily it applies, and right after I set it with powder it looks nice. But within about an hour, my face gets very oily, the product starts sinking into my fine lines, I'm constantly blotting or adding more powder. I think it could be great for someone with dry skin.

author: Ness
headline: Enhances your skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like it! It's a very lightweight coverage but it feels like a lotion. I can hardly feel it sitting on my skin but it makes a notable difference. It gives that soft put together feel without hiding your natural skin.  It enhances your natural beauty rather than hiding it.

author: Nicole
headline: Impressive
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It has the best sheer tint face balm. It glides on the skin so nicely. It's not greasy like others can be. It actually feels like you're not wearing anything at all. It feels amazing on the skin. It matched my natural color really well. I also love that it gives you coverage but it's not heavy like a foundation. It lasted all through my work day as well. I'm very impressed!

author: Stephanie
headline: Fantastic
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely LOVE how this serum melts into my skin leaving a soft flawless finish with no transfer. This will be my go to for spring and summer! Lightweight and gorgeous!

author: Brandi
headline: Great lightweight face balm
comment: This is a great face balm if you are looking for sheer coverage. It melts into the skin beautifully. Covers my redness and evens out the color on my face. Does not have a scent and feels very lightweight. Great for those no makeup, makeup days. Love the little component it comes in. Can easily throw in your purse.

author: Heather
headline: Great lightweight coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great lightweight tint balm that goes on smooth and even. It's easy to apply no matter what you use.  It blends in well and keeps my face from drying out during the day.  The color match is easy to find the right shade for your skin.

author: Gina
headline: I would definitely buy again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This light yet creamy tint is better than expected. It goes on smoothly and blends beautifully into the skin. The coverage is more than I anticipated for a tint, and it's easily buildable. It feels weightless—never heavy—and holds up very well throughout the day.

author: Laura
headline: Surprisingly good!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This surprised me!! When I first felt the balmy texture of this, I thought that it wouldn't work for my combo skin. However, this provides more coverage than I expected without feeling greasy or heavy at all! It isn't full coverage by any means, but it does even out my skin nicely and can be built up a bit in areas where I want it. It sets down nicely without needing a heavy layer of powder which I appreciate. Plus, I appreciate the added layer of spf. If you're looking for something lightweight that provides light coverage, I highly recommend this!

author: Sarah
headline: I probably won't buy this product.
comment: I received this product for free for my honest review. It did not match my skin tone And almost felt like it sat on top so next time I will definitely moisturize. It is definitely buildable.

author: Tanya
headline: Even tone.
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I am pleasantly surprised by this product. When I applied it to my face, the tone became more even and I didn't need much product at all, because it seemed to melt in my hands. The shade also suited me. I will definitely use it.

author: Anna
headline: Skin care plus a skin tint that's amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love any It Cosmetics product but this skin tint is just beautiful!!  So lightweight. It does not feel like I am wearing anything. It really evens out my skin and cover imperfections. It has so many skin benefits so you get benefits to your skin as well. Blends so easy and it lasts all day. An unbelievable product! I received free product for review

author: Heather
headline: Would only look good on very smooth texture free skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to receive my complimentary IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! I unfortunately got the wrong shade but think it will work when I get a spray tan. It feels very light on the skin and it's clear you could make it more buildable to achieve fuller coverage and achieve a lasting all day look.. The downside of the product is it shows every bit of texture on the face. However I think if you had perfectly smooth skin this would be a great addition to your makeup bag.

author: Realz Product Reviews
headline: Healthy natural glow
comment: I received this IT sheer tint face bomb complementary to try for my honest review. The product appeared darker in the container than it went on the face. The color is very subtle once you rub it in. It left my skin looking healthy.But didn't look like it had a foundation. I like the healthy glow it left.

author: Kim
headline: Effortless and fast
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really excited for this product as I have been using something similar from another brand that is more expensive and harder to find. This works very similar to the Danessa Myricks balm, if not a bit more sheer but can be built up pretty well. It has a very emollient consistency at first but once blended it dries down nearly matte without being dry or cakey. I purposely used my fingers to apply it because I want something I can use quickly, and that worked perfectly. I have the fairest shade and it worked for me, but someone super pale might not find a match with this product. It does help cover imperfections a bit but concealer is needed if you want to completely hide them. Can't wait to keep using this for "no makeup" makeup days!

author: Laura
headline: Step out in confidence makeup free
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I'm loving this face balm! The application is super sheer and silky, and it instantly hydrates my skin while giving a subtle, healthy looking tint. I use the shade Light Medium Warm 225, and it blends in beautifully without looking heavy or cakey.

It's perfect on its own for a fresh, makeup free look, but it also works really well as a moisturizing base under foundation. A little goes a long way, which I really appreciate. My skin looks smooth, hydrated, and naturally radiant every time I use it. Definitely a new go to for effortless, everyday wear!

author: Amber
headline: New obsession!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im obsessed with It Cosmetics Do It All Seer Face Balm. It feels like applying a luxurious face cream instead of make up. It feels moisturizing and incredibly lightweight.

author: Jojo
headline: My new fav!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Uhhhhh I love this stuff. My skin looks amazing and feels amazing so hydrating and light like I honestly don't feel I have anything on just skin care and it is so sheer and has a wonderful glowy finish.

author: Sam
headline: This face balm is amazing for winter skin!
comment: This product was provided to me in exchange for my honest review. It Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm by L'Oréal is just what my face needed in this harsh winter weather. I was a little skeptical about the color, but the shade was perfect and blended so smoothly on my face. There was no heavy, caked on feeling, and the texture was creamy and light. I've been wearing this every day for a couple weeks and have received many compliments, that my face looks fresh and youthful. I love this and will be purchasing in the future.

author: Quratul
headline: It Cosmetics
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do-It-All Sheer Tint Face Balm with 92% skincare serum has a smooth, creamy consistency that blends easily into the skin. The finish looks natural and fresh, giving a healthy glow without feeling heavy. The coverage is light but effective, helping to even out my skin tone while still looking like skin. The wearability is comfortable throughout the day, and the durability is impressive for a sheer tint, as it stays put without fading or settling into lines.

author: Yolanda
headline: Hydrating and easy to blend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics sheerr tent face balm is excellent. It is very creamy,hydrating,and easy to blend into the skin without looking cakey. There are plenty of shades to choose from or you can pick two to blend for your custom color. The shade I have is deep but I realize that it is a little too dark as a full face tent.  I have muti-tasked this balm to use as a light contour or a light blush with a little translucent powder and it looks beautiful. Glowing without feeling sticky or without looking greasy. I have also used this as a brow tint with a slight dusting of powder. I am on the search to find my perfect shade or to find two shades to mix for my skin. If you have oily skin this may not be something that is for you. I do believe this is marketed for mature skin and also marketed for individuals with dry skin. An excellent product worth purchasing.

author: Amanda
headline: Blends perfectly into my skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love to fill of this face balm. It has a smooth silky texture. It goes on and blend into my skin perfectly leaving my skin feeling soft. It last all day long and it allows me to build over the top of it with my other skin care products. It's unscented so it doesn't have any fragrances to it, which is good. That means I can do my fragrances without having any contrasting scents absolutely amazing.

author: Jessica
headline: I love my sheer tint
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review I love the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because it melts into the skin like skincare, feels super comfortable and lightweight, gives a natural glowy finish, wears beautifully for everyday.

author: Natalya
headline: Blends so well!
comment:
I was given this product for free in exchange for a review.
I have found a new favorite skin product! It's sheer, lightweight and offers plenty of coverage. The shade is close to my skin tone and gives a nice glow. 
I do wish this had SPF.

author: Jayme
headline: Definitely would buy!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product goes on flawlessly! The texture feels like a very light serum, with very good coverage. Leaves my skin feeling light and silky smooth. Powder applied very nicely over the top. Lasted for quite some time through my day. There is no scent. It really is a great product.

author: Ap
headline: Creamy and nice coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very creamy and nourishing. I was a little alarmed at the color in the pot but once I tried it and rubbed it in, it blended seamlessly. It lasted all day. No breakouts or irritation just a nice healthy glow.

author: Mandy
headline: Glowy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is very creamy. It doesn't have the best coverage but it gave me a beautiful glow! I will continue to use this product as a primer under foundation. It does dry down after a few minutes as well. I would not recommend it as a foundation but definitely would recommend it as a primer or a light under eye concealer

author: Mel
headline: ✨ Skin But Better in a Jar ✨
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face balm is giving your skin but smoother 🤍
Light coverage, super glowy, blends like skincare and feels weightless.
Perfect for no-makeup makeup days ✨
Hydrating, natural, and easy to apply with fingers.

author: Amy
headline: This balm is the balm!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My first impression when I unboxed the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm was that the shade looked too dark for me. However, once I applied it, it matched my skin tone perfectly. It doesn't come with an applicator, so I use either my fingers or a makeup sponge to apply it. Even though it's a solid balm, it feels soft like butter and melts right into my skin. The texture is lightweight and easy to build.

My skin is usually a bit dull, and this product gives me a vibrant, healthy radiance that makes me look less tired and more refreshed. It's also super hydrating. I usually apply moisturizer before I put on any type of makeup, and I don't need to with this product. 

I have fine lines and I love that this product doesn't settle into them. I also have some hyperpigmentation and it covers those areas nicely. 

I love that this balm doesn't have any unnecessary synthetic fragrance. It is very gentle on my skin and didn't irritate it. Some makeup and skinscare products cause me to break out, but I feel that this product actually improves my skin. 

Overall, this product is certainly in my list of top makeup picks! It's a great value because you get a hydrating, skin-improving, natural looking tint, all-in-one!

author: Hermine
headline: I will recommend this product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Give a natural finish it all in one moisturizer, serum and a light foundation. It looks and feel great on my skin not offer 
a light coverage but will not cover all my face dark spots.

author: Mia
headline: Great product! Perfect coverage,
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This beauty balm is amazing. I am in LOVE . Not only is it super affordable, but it also high quality . It matches my skin tone perfectly,  goes on super smooth and blends well. This skin tinted foundation had my skin looking extremely flawless zand natural; the color matched soooo perfectly I got so many compliments!. It looks so natural that it feels like I'm not wearing anything at all.

author: Ivonne
headline: No makeup makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is ideal for makeup-free days. It applies lightly while offering sufficient coverage for an even skin tone. The formula is lightweight and breathable, blending well with your natural skin tone.

author: Yuliia Ju
headline: Weightless and melts on my fingertips for a great blending
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Do-It-All Sheer Tint Face Balm together with the stated 92% Skincare Serum in it, and this combination fits great and layering thin into my everyday skin routine. I chose the shade Fair Warm 120, and it blends into my skin seamlessly, adjusting in a very natural way. Durable enough , but need to test it more with some activity   Weightless. 

What I enjoy most is how the balm reacts to touch. I love applying makeup with my fingertips, and this formula melts instantly from the warmth of my hands. The texture softens right away, spreads easily, and sits on the skin in a very thin, even layer. It's simple to stretch, blend, and build where needed, which gives me full control over coverage without losing that lightweight feel.

The finish looks fresh and hydrated, and the skin feels comfortable throughout the day. For me, this is one of those products that works intuitively — it responds well, layers nicely, and makes the whole application process feel easy, effortless is what I like with foundation

author: Nat
headline: Beautiful but…
comment: It feels so good and applies beautifully Ijust wish the shade range was bigger. I am very fair and cool toned and the lightest cool shade makes me look down right tan. I ended up purchasing the fairest neutral because I just reay wanted try this product which i can make work but now that I have I wish they had a shade that is an actual good match for me.

author: Jennn
headline: LOVE!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 46 with oily skin. I think I need to get one shade lighter. But, I tried it anyway. I'm obsessed! This melts nicely on the skin. It's creamy but also feels powdery soft. So light on the skin. Feels nice on my winter skin. And I can't wait to wear it in summer. It's very sheer but does make the skin look like skin…but better. Dries down nice and soft. It does have the slightest scent. Still looks nice after several hours wear.

author: Mary
headline: Great tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face bomb gives you full face coverage. It feel's lite and smooth as your applying it and has very lite scent that smells good. You can definitely wear this all day and not sweat and your makeup would stay in place. I will definitely buy this product again.

author: Darcy
headline: Holy smooth and blendable soft skin glow Batman!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review.  O! M! G!  I Looove this product! I honestly could have done a shade darker because this blends out so smoothly it's insane! It touts it to be a "tinted moisturizer and foundation balm all in one," and they ain't lying! When they say it's an "ultra-blendable solid-serum texture that melts on contact" the lie detector test determined that was the truth! I can't tell you how smooth and light this goes on. It really makes your skin feel so soft! I can't speak to the long term moisture and skin tightening due to the short testing window, but I definitely plan to purchase this as a staple in my makeup routine for the future, so time will tell. But in terms of application, it couldn't be smoother and more blurring! The only little bit of negative is that it does make my T-zone a little for oily- but I keep in mind that this perimenopause skin of mine has a mind of its own and it's been an uphill battle with oily skin that I've never had to face before.  So I can't attribute that solely to this product.  It seems to do quite well as a primer as well.  The under eye coverage is amazing especially considering how light and melty it is when you apply it! Try it- you won't be disappointed!

author: Rupali
headline: Face Balm
comment: This face balm delivers a lightweight, breathable tint that evens skin tone while feeling hydrating and comfortable all day. It gives a natural, radiant finish—perfect for effortless, no-makeup makeup looks. A great go-to for quick, glowing coverage!

author: Mari
headline: Love a balm foundation!
comment:
The foundation looked much darker on the top layer than what was underneath, which led me to think this may oxidize. I have dry skin so this formula is really nice and feel like silk going on. I usually don't prefer a matte finish but this is such a soft matte that it's nice and blurring.
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Em
headline: Perfect for a no makeup makeup day
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this tinted face balm! It's perfect for a no makeup kind of day. It glides on easily and I find it to be buildable. Mind you it is "sheer" tint, so it is not a thick heavy liquid and it doesn't cover every flaw.  It leaves a glowy/dewy finish which I love. I don't notice any scent which is nice. I've been using my fingers to apply, not sure if there is a better way it but works well. I will definitely purchase this again.

author: Lawden
headline: Perfect no makeup makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very excited to try this skin tint out since I have loved so many products from It Cosmetics! I tried this out for a few days and the first day was without any primer. I loved how it looked when I first applied it and how silky smooth it made my skin look! Unfortunately it didn't last long and wore off after a few hours. The next day I tried it with primer first and then I added setting powder and spray. I still loved how it looked and it lasted much longer! It still wore off  after little by the end of the day but I do touch my face a lot and I do sweat and have combo skin so I am used to that happening with foundations that aren't full coverage and transfer proof. I think this would be a great option for a no makeup makeup look day or a day at the pool or beach or gym for me. I think it will be great anytime for people with dry skin who like light coverage. I am very happy I tried it and will definitely continue to use on those certain days.

author: Thepinkasterandrose
headline: Light Sheer Coverage That You Can Count On
comment:
IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm Shade Light Warm 215 is the perfect shade for me. This sheer tinted balm is easy to apply, blends in nicely, is not greasy and minimized any minor imperfections had.
I applied this face balm over my serum and moisturizer- then applied my face powder over IT face balm. The balm sets really nice with my compact powder, leaving me feeling confident and ready for the day. I did touch my face up before lunch with powder but I was pleasantly surprised to see that my skin still looked fresh.
truly feel that this product does what it is suppose to do.

author: Ashley
headline: Highly recommended
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this sheer tint face balm. It goes on so smooth and covers pretty nice for a "sheer" tint. It's packed with 92% skin care serum which is great for something going all over your face!

author: Tina
headline: Perfect coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Cool Ivory, and it's quickly become a go-to for easy, natural makeup days. The texture is smooth and lightweight, blending effortlessly into the skin and giving just the right amount of sheer coverage to even out my complexion without looking heavy. The Cool Ivory shade matches beautifully and leaves a healthy, fresh finish that looks like real skin. I also love that it feels hydrating and comfortable all day, making it perfect for everyday wear when I want something quick, flattering, and low-maintenance. Very impressed with this, it provides just the right amount of coverage I need.

author: Michelle
headline: Very sheer, very melty
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very sheer product, coverage is not buildable. No fragrance that I noted. The product does not dry down very quickly, leaving a bit of a slip behind. Rubs off on hands/clothing if not very well powdered afterward.

author: Cris
headline: Not for oily skin
comment: I received my sheer tint face balm from IT Cosmetics as a free gift in exchange for my honest review. I received the shade light neutral 210 and it's way too dark. Feel more like a light medium in my opinion. It doesn't show up in pictures, but it's a little "orangey" to me. I thought it would at least even me out since my neck is darker than my face, but it's actually darker than my neck. I applied just sunscreen underneath and on top applied a little concealer to my undereyes, blush, and set it all with powder. It isn't very flattering. It accentuates all my bumps and texture. I will say it was very easy to apply. It's more like a cream and less like a balm. It's very nourishing and dewy. My recommendation is stay away from this if you're very oily like me. Dry skin people will love this, just pick a shade lighter than your usual.

author: Angie
headline: Sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you want a light, hydrating tint that enhances your natural complexion, this balm is a lovely everyday option. It feels more like skincare than heavy makeup, gives a healthy radiant finish, and is easy to use—even on low-effort days. The light coverage and comfortable texture make it ideal for those who want natural beauty with a boost rather than full foundation coverage. The balm is great for the winter months and it's unscented. I recommend if you're looking for moisture and a light weight tinted option.

author: Desiree
headline: Lightweight, blends out so nicely!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very disappointed because the color i received is not the right color for me. I'm sad because this Tint Face Balm is bomb! It feels so light on the skin, it melts into your skin and blends out beautifully! I was able to make this color work with using a lighter tint product over it which just means that you can layer other products nicely over it! It lasts all day without smudging off, it doesn't have a scent (that I can pickup) and it doesn't hug texture (my skin is very dry this time of year). I would definitely recommend this product and will look into finding the right tone for me in the future.

author: Shannon
headline: Flat & Dull
comment: I love IT Cosmetics and I had high hopes for this face balm.  I really don't like the weight or consistency of it.  It's almost like a creamy sand texture and for me, it's too heavy.  When I was younger, I'd have loved everything about it.  It's a dull matte on me and as I'm 52-almost 53, I want something more radiant and luminous.  Just not for me.

author: Sara
headline: Flawless blend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Can you tell I'm wearing anything? Bet you can't! It's actually on my skin and the color blends so flawlessly it's insane. Feels like a light moisturizing cream and gives a very sheer clean girl look. Feels amazing in the cold dry winter

author: Josie
headline: Effortless
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a lightweight, sheer face balm that absorbs easily into the skin and feels very comfortable throughout the day. It blends effortlessly, evens out the complexion, and gives a natural my skin but better appearance without looking heavy or cakey. The finish is fresh and smooth, making it perfect for everyday wear when you want subtle coverage with a healthy glow.

author: Triceyy
headline: Great Balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this balm it is so creamy and melted in my skin so well. My shade was spot on and performed great it was long lasting and didn't have a weird smell at all.

author: Nicole
headline: Such a good skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in love with this Do IT All Sheer Tint Face Balm by It Cosmetics. I chose the color Tan Warm. I was a little nervous when the product arrived as the color looked too dark for my winter skin. However, this product blended so well and looked amazing on my skin. I look like I have nothing on and beautiful glowing skin. I love that it works great with other makeup products. I had no pilling at all. Because I am a skincare junky, I also love that this contains 92% skincare serum as its ingredients. This is a great product and I would recommend to others.

author: Jocelyn
headline: Great coverage for such a light formula
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This formula is light and buildible. It covered my problem areas and evened out my skin. I like the creamy formula and used my fingers to apply. It managed to stay on in the humidity.

author: Tuwanna
headline: Natural tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because it gives my skin a natural, healthy-looking glow. The sheer coverage evens out my complexion without feeling heavy or cakey. It feels very lightweight and hydrating, which makes it comfortable to wear all day. I love that it blends easily and looks like skin rather than makeup. It's perfect for days when I want a quick, effortless makeup look. Overall, it's a great everyday face balm for natural coverage and hydration.

author: Yulia
headline: Melts into the skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm feels like a balm in the jar, but the moment it touches my face it literally melts into my skin and turns into a thin, weightless veil. It doesn't sit on top like a heavy foundation - there's no "mask" feeling -  just a smooth, comfortable finish. The coverage is sheer but surprisingly effective: it evens out my overall tone and softens redness/unevenness while still letting real skin show through. What I love most is how it seems to adjust and blend into my natural skin tone, so it looks very seamless and natural in daylight. This is the kind of product that makes you look more rested and polished without looking like you're wearing much makeup.

author: M amin
headline: Serum like feel
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest opinion. I like that is has a light weight feel. It doesn't have a scent and it's not really pigmented or buildable in my opinion. It feels more like a serum

author: Gabby
headline: Easy, Natural Coverage — With One Packaging Flaw
comment:
I've been really enjoying the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade 315 (medium cool). It gives light, even coverage with a natural, skin-like finish and feels comfortable all day. It's perfect for quick makeup days when I want my skin to look smoother and more balanced without feeling heavy.

The only downside for me is the packaging. Since it comes in a jar, it's not the most hygienic — brushes can contaminate the product if they're not perfectly clean, and using fingers isn't very practical either. I've been using a small spatula to scoop it out, but I really think this would work much better in a stick format for easier, cleaner application.

author: Kidist
headline: IT Do it All face tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do it All Tint face Balm it has 92% skincare Serum. The shade is amazing it is exactly my shade. It makes my fade so soft. I recommend it.

author: Heather
headline: I love this stuff
comment: I absolutely love this stuff! Great for mature skin with aging spots. Absolutely amazed by the cream and how smooth it was and how long it lasted. Covered my freckles and dark spots amazing. Went on smooth and creamy, no odor, oily  or greasy feeling. This stuff was a 1st for me and I will be looking for other product. Easily taking off at the end of night.

author: April
headline: Smooth natural look
comment: I received this product to review. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is pic after a 10 hour workday, a gym workout, including some time sweating in the sauna. I felt like it smoothed out my 60-year-old skin with a light tint and I was happy that it didn't sit in the creases. The shade blended perfectly with my skin, so you couldn't see a heavy cream based on my face.

author: Asianzingg
headline: Light weight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is my new everyday fave! Super lightweight, melts right into the skin, and gives that fresh "your skin but better" glow. The sheer tint evens things out without feeling heavy, plus it keeps my face feeling hydrated all day. Perfect for busy days when you want effortless, natural-looking skin in one swipe 💕

author: Aicha
headline: Incredible product, must have !
comment:
I have received this product in exchange of my
honest review. 
  
I have never been a big foundation fan yet now that my skin is starting to age i feel the need to wear some more often. I have wrinkles, dark spots, uneven skin tone. I however still dislike the tick and caky foundations. And I feel that if I put foundation on it have to go with a full make up face. Which is not what I want everyday. 

This product is amazing and fulfills ALL my needs. 
It is very buildable, soft and airy, yet is efficient in camouflaging my little skin issues while maintaining a natural glow. I loved the texture, how dewy it is, how glowy the skin looks. It literally melts on the skin. And I don't feel I need to go for a full make up face.
More importantly it has skincare properties so I'm both beautifying and taking care of my skin.

author: Sara
headline: Does what it says
comment: I recieved this product for free in exchage for my honest review. I have been enjoying this IT Cosmetics Do It All face tint. The texture is light and creamy with a wet serum like consistency. The coverage is sheer but buildable. I like to wear it on more natural days, where I just want a barely there look. I have also used it as a concealer over my other foundations, which is my favorite way to utilize this product. I have more normal skin leaning a little drier during the winter months. Due to it light coverage and serum consistency it smooth over my pores and give me a very natural look. I would say the only down fall of this product is that it does transfer quite a bit and for that reason doesn't last very long on my skin even setting it with powder. I think it will be really nice though during the summer months and beach days. I have the shade light warm and I tend to lean more light neutral but I can make it work.

author: Chelsie
headline: Skin care omfg
comment: The new skin tint with 92% skincare which care yes!! 10000 thanks you!! I love this product and it has a dewy glow

author: Yolanda
headline: Perfect for no makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So this is definitely sheer, if you're wanting coverage this isn't for you. This is skincare with a tint of color and coverage. It melted into my fingers and was easy to apply and blend out. I had some sheer coverage that was slightly buildable in some areas I needed a bit more. It didn't feel greasy or oily but I did lightly set it with a powder. After about 3 hours my skin has a nice radiant glow. I am not sure this would work for oily skin my but normal to dry skin is happy. I'll definitely use this for no makeup days. It's not transfer-proof so when I wore my glasses it did rub off there. I can't feel it on my skin, very lightweight. Hopefully it does benefit my skin overtime as well.

author: Sallie
headline: I love the way this feels on my skin
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this for about a week and I can see and feel how it has improved my face . The cream goes on really well and blends into my face smoothly. I love the fact that it has 92 percent skincare Serum in it .

author: Tracy
headline: My new go-to for daily routine
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm is exactly what I needed for my daily routine. It provides just enough coverage to even out my skin tone while looking like I'm wearing nothing at all. The balm texture is creamy, hydrating, and feels incredibly lightweight on the skin. It's easy it is to apply too. 
I'm using shade 215. From my picture: the top line is unblended and looks darker than my inner wrist, but it's a perfect match for my face. When I smeared the second and third line out, it blended into my darker skin beautifully!

author: Rya.
headline: Glow, glow, glow.
comment:
Initially I thought the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm would be getting, at best, 2 stars for effort. Before that first application I watched a tutorial to make sure I gave the product the best chance at working how it's supposed to (as I do with all items I'm sent to test) and that wound up being a huge mistake. This tutorial instructed me to use a brush, and while that may work for some people I found the finish it left to be an oily/caked mess, not at all something I would leave the house wearing.

But then I tried using just my fingers, and it's perfect. When applied correctly this balm leaves a gorgeous and natural finish, truly a "your skin, but better" vibe. You can up the glow, but not the coverage (as seen in the included single freckle coverage test.) so less is more.

The only downside I can think of is that, on the areas of my skin that do have some fine lines, the glowy sheen does draw attention to it a bit - so if your skin is textured in a way you'd rather not highlight this may not be for you.

author: chante
headline: great face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that this is a face balm the only things I don't like is that it has no instructions on how to  use had to look it up  love that it's my color and the other thing I don't like be careful cause it comes off very easily  so watch out what color shirt you wear overall light weight and felt like it definitely  moisturized  my face

author: Cary
headline: Very glowy
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At first application, this face balm looks really pretty. It goes on smoothly, evens out the skin tone, and gives that fresh, hydrated glow that feels effortless and skin-friendly. The sheer to light coverage is great if you want a natural look and something quick to apply.

However, after about 30 minutes, the shine really starts to come through. What initially looks like a healthy glow quickly turns into an overly shiny finish, especially in areas prone to oil. I found myself wishing it had more oil control or a more satin finish to keep it looking polished throughout the day.

Overall, it's a nice product for short wear or very dry skin types, but if you tend to get oily or want longer-lasting balance, this may require blotting or setting to maintain the look.

author: Sasha
headline: Nice!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Glowin' to the gods! Feels so nice and hydrating on the skin. Its for sure a balm and doesnt dry down but it doesnt get patchy. Its coverage is light and best for dry or aging skin.

author: Nimra
headline: My Everyday Natural Glow Balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I honestly love this tint face balm. It looks so natural on my skin and literally sinks right in like skincare, not makeup. It feels super lightweight and smooth, and it doesn't sit on top or feel greasy at all.
The finish is beautiful , a healthy, natural glow that makes my skin look fresh and even without looking like I am wearing anything heavy. It blends so easily with fingers and gives that it looks like your skin but better.
I also love how comfortable it feels all day. No cakey feeling, no dryness, just soft, hydrated skin with a nice glow. This is perfect for everyday wear, especially when I want something quick and effortless.
Totally worth it

author: Priscilla
headline: Love!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint is freaking gorgeous!! I typically hate this type of product because of my textured skin and large pores so I stick to liquid foundations. But I'm seriously impressed. This is sheer but buildable and has no scent. It's has a really nice cooling effect when putting on. I used a soft dense brush to put it on and it just melts into my skin. Just for reference I have combo skin with dry cheeks and a very oily t-zone. This skin tint also very glowy but not greasy at all. I set my t-zone with powder and then lightly set the rest of my face so it can last longer on me. Wear time is great. I started to see it wearing off around the 10 hour mark so that's pretty good for this type of product. Also it never settle into my pores! I normally have trouble with that. I think the shade range is also pretty good. The color I got I thought might be a little too yellow but it matched my skin tone perfectly. I think this product is perfect for those cold drier days because it's got skincare in it and is very moisturizing. Very highly recommend.

author: Ashley
headline: It's sheer!
comment: It's definitely sheer! I could tell a very subtle difference. I used a make up brush to apply it. I didn't want to put too much and over do it because it was a little thicker make up than what I like. I usually use very little foundation.

author: Darla
headline: I absolutely loved this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blending was fantastic! Packaging was cute. Felt comfortable on my skin all day! It matches my skin perfectly. And it smells great. I love everything from here.

author: Lauren
headline: Flawless skin and long lasting results!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am so impressed with this tinted face balm!! I got shade Fair Cool 125, and it was a perfect match! It added a nice sun-kissed glow, that made my skin radiant! I think applying with a makeup brush will give the best results. It is very silky, and with the added moisturizer, making sure to get it to spread evenly and in a thin layer, helps prevent it from becoming caked up, or being too heavy. I got a perfect spread, with even coverage, that stayed perfectly moisturized all day! It never felt too heavy, and if anything it just felt natural.  I finally was able to wear it during some warm weather, and even spent time jumping on trampoline. And I am happy to report that it did not sweat off, smear or anything, it just stayed put! All the while allowed my skin to breathe. I applied while my skin was slightly damp, with no other products underneath or added. It really made my skin flawless!!

author: Jamie
headline: Good option if you like a more sheer coverage.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very lightweight and sheer foundation.  If you enjoy more sheer foundations then this is a good one!  The finish is very natural and pretty, it is lightweight and comfortable.  You do need good skincare prep if you have dry skin otherwise it will emphasize dryness.

author: Kelley
headline: Radiant Finish
comment:
I received this product complimentary to test and review.
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall I enjoy this product. The balm comes in a glass pot, preserving the integrity of the ingredients. The consistency is a smooth buttery balm that melts upon contact of skin. I use a foundation brush for majority of the application to cover larger areas. Around my eyes and nose I blend with my finger tips for a stunning result. It's comfortable to wear, it feels like I'm wearing skincare. Which is what 95% of this product is. My skin feels light, radiant, hydrated, and beautiful! No scent whatsoever with this balm! I've noticed reduced appearance of fine lines and a more even skin tone with use of this balm. I also like that it's buildable, it's great coverage for a balm. definitely recommend trying this in your routine.

author: Meg
headline: Sheer coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation is sheer and buildable.  It's very easy to use and easy to blend. It's very forgiving if you get too much. It leaves a sheer cover, just enough to even out your skin tone. It's a perfect every day foundation.

author: Emily
headline: Makeup and skincare in one
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got this IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face bam in shade fair cool 125. It matches my fair skin pretty well, it just gives me a little bit of a tan (which is good). It is really lightweight and slippery. The product just glides on and melts into the skin. It makes your skin look blurred and flawless. The best thing is that it contains skincare ingredients to improve your skin over time.

author: Debra
headline: Great Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product it blends well you can blend it with your finger or brush its comfortable to wear. Easy to work onto the skin i loce that a little goes along way because it blends out. I love that I can use it on places I want coverage whether it's  under my eyes or cheekbones or all over.

author: Patricia
headline: I would buy this product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint applies smooth and blends out nice. There's no scent which is a huge plus. It has a sheer coverage. I have neutral/pink undertones and the light neutral shade was a good match for me. I'm not a big foundation user and this seems like a great replacement for that.

author: Sally
headline: Very sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an interesting product that combines skincare with coverage. Nicely sized for on the go touch ups. Feels cool to the skin once applied. For me the sheer coverage is so sheer it doesn't do anything to cover dark spots, under eyes, blemishes or anything. I didn't find the formula to be buildable. If you are looking for a sheer product then this is for you.

author: Tatiana
headline: Light, natural coverage for daily makeup.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this face balm. It feels light on the skin and blends easily. The coverage is natural and evens out my skin tone without feeling heavy. Perfect for everyday use.

author: Kellie
headline: It's a greater tinted balm and gives skincare too
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Application is simple with your fingers. It's very sheer yet covers imperfections yet is a skincare serum. Shade is easy to pick out and it feels light or like nothing is on. It feels good.

author: Saleen
headline: I give it an A
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I use IT a lot, I enjoy their products in general. This face balm is hydrated and pigmented but so light. I really like it. It glides on and does not seem to settle in my fine lines. I give this an A for a product that offers hydration and light coverage.

author: MARIAN
headline: Really like this product.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I just discovered IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm"92% Skincare Serum and I must confess I think it is amazing .It really is a Four in One product ,a  skin tint, face balm, hydrating and skincare serum. It is so easy to use, The cream almost liquefies and spreads even over my face .It absorbing in to leave a fresh ,matte finish that is buildable if you need more covering. Yet it feel lightweight and will last all day without touchups. No signs of irritation or redness on my sometimes sensitive skin. No fragrance notice ,if that's important to you.  But most important is how my skin feels, more hydrated and me but a definite  better me .Recommend to family and friends.
