author: Brett
headline: Almost there!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like where this product is trying to get but it's not quite there for me. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm made with 92% Skincare Serum is a great idea and it's a bit of a multitasker. It helps reduce uneven skin tone, covers redness and provides a nice light coverage. I feel like it takes a lot of setting product to get it to stay throughout the day however, which is where it needs improvement, it transfers pretty bad without a really good setting product. Don't let the word Balm scare you however, it's not greasy and is really honestly super light feeling on the skin almost unnoticeable even. Application is easy whether using brush, puff, or fingers. Personally I used a brush for application and then hit it with the beauty blender to smooth out brush lines.

author: Angie
headline: Perfect
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm really gives you beautiful coverage that lasts all day. I love how it hydrates the skin and leaves it very hydrated. It is very easy to apply and very light.

author: JEAN
headline: I like!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was able to try out the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.  This moisturizer foundation is easy to apply and does not feel heavy and cakey.

author: MelissaN
headline: Beautiful Balm Formula!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure at first about a balm foundation for my sensitive combination skin. Turns out I really like it! I love the container and how solid and easy to use it is. The formulation has no scent, which I prefer. The coverage is truly almost weightless. I found it to be light, but easy to build in areas where I had more redness. I set it with translucent powder and it looked very natural all day.

author: Shakira
headline: Great tinted balm
comment: I love this brand and this product with infused skincare is genius! It provides just the right amountbof coverage without feeling heavy or cakey. The formula is lightweight and leaves a glowy finish.

author: Tara
headline: Just what I needed for my face it's so glowy!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Let me just say I am in love with this product. The sheer tint is subtle and glowy. I love how it glides on so smooth and soft. I can touch up if I want throughout the day if need be, but it seems to last a long time with my make up on. Very pleased with this sheer tint face balm.

author: Rebecca
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The feel of this was great but I noticed after I put it on it was dull and started to pill around my nose or any dry patches. I would say this would be good for anyone that needs a little coverage and doesn't have dry patches.

author: Rocio
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is a total game changer! The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm gives my skin the perfect natural glow while still feeling lightweight and breathable. It blends effortlessly, evens out my skin tone, and provides just the right amount of sheer coverage for a fresh, no-makeup look. I love that it's made with skincare ingredients—it feels hydrating and comfortable all day long. Perfect for everyday wear when I want my skin to look healthy, smooth, and radiant. Highly recommend!

author: Alina
headline: Natural Radiance and Hydration in One Balm
comment:
I really like IT Cosmetics — their products always impress me. This Sheer Tint Face Balm has a balm-like texture that melts into the skin, feels super lightweight, and is barely noticeable once applied. It's not a foundation and doesn't cover blemishes or unevenness, but it gives the skin an almost sheer, natural glow while providing hydration and skincare benefits thanks to 92% nourishing ingredients like collagen, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E.
It has no scent and doesn't leave any greasiness on the skin. The packaging is a beautiful, high-quality glass jar with a secure lid.
I use it after my serum, like a moisturizer, and set it with a bit of loose powder on top. My skin looks healthy and glowing all day.

author: Alina
headline: Lightweight Glow with Skincare Benefits
comment:
I really like IT Cosmetics — their products always impress me. This Sheer Tint Face Balm has a balm-like texture that melts into the skin, feels super lightweight, and is barely noticeable once applied. It's not a foundation and doesn't cover blemishes or unevenness, but it gives the skin an almost sheer, natural glow while providing hydration and skincare benefits thanks to 92% nourishing ingredients like collagen, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E.
It has no scent and doesn't leave any greasiness on the skin. The packaging is a beautiful, high-quality glass jar with a secure lid.
I use it after my serum, like a moisturizer, and set it with a bit of loose powder on top. My skin looks healthy and glowing all day.

author: Expensive balm
headline: Beautiful balm but pricey
comment: I liked this product. It is a really sheer balm that contains collagen peptides vitamin E and hyaluronic acid. It gives a very sheer tint with luminosity. The picture on the top is with the product. The picture on the bottom is without the product and the whole facial shot shows one side with and one side without the product. It goes on velvety smooth and is easy to blend in. I'm wearing the shade light neutral and it was perfect. The downside is the cost for .63 ounces it's retailing for around $34, I think is too expensive for the amount of product you get.  I did put on two coats as well so if you wanted a little bit more coverage, it is buildable but again you're gonna go through the product quicker and in my opinion, it's overpriced for what you get.

author: Sarah
headline: IT is "the One" for me!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I found my holy grail face tint! I wasn't sure what to expect from something with "balm" in the name, but this melts effortlessly into skin with the touch of your finger. Applied super smooth, feels like I'm applying a moisturizer. Finish is very natural and skin like, which is my preference. Not too shiny, nor too matte. No noticible scent. 

I love how natural this looks, and how it doesn't fully "mute" my actual skin. It just looks like I've been taking better care of my skin. Easy to layer if you need a little more coverage, but definitely a sheer formula.

author: Ruby
headline: More colors
comment: I would love to order but you dont have my color yet: LIGHT COOL,

author: Dragongurly
headline: Great product
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really enjoying this sheer tint face balm by It Cosmetics! It gives light, buildable coverage that evens out my skin without feeling heavy. It feels hydrating & smooth on my skin.

author: Beth
headline: Amazing texture
comment: The product works well and will be replacing my old makeup routine. This is my go to and a staple now. The texture and the way it blends so quickly is amazing color matches almost perfect

author: Samantha
headline: Such a great sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is fantastic if you like a tinted face product which I prefer. It has just enough coverage to even out skin but not look like I'm wearing foundation. The formula is smooth and creamy and feels great on the skin. Easy to apply with your fingers and blends out like a dream.

author: Lela
headline: This face tint really does do it all
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
IT cosmetics has impressed me yet again with this Do it all sheer tint face balm. I am usually a fair neutral color, but the color chart for this product has it looking like the fair warm 120 is a perfect match and guess what? It is! In fact, this blends so beautifully that I use it right under my eyes! It lasts all day long and feels so lightweight like I'm just wearing skin care. Washes right off with regular makeup remover and yet doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. This is perfect for winter and my dry skin by the way!

author: Tracey
headline: Super Blendable
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Gorgeous, ultra lightweight, buildable coverage.

I have a strong preference for tinted moisturizer over foundation, and want sheer coverage only to even out some redness and to soften or hide some spider veins on the sides of my nose. This is perfect for that. It blends easily, and feels like nothing is on my face. In my photo, I've blended out the left side of the swatch. It'll be lend in completely if I keep blending. 

In the container this looked a little dark, but once on it blends nicely. I may go to Ulta to test out a few other shades to be sure this is the best for me, but I'm pretty satisfied with this!

author: Caitlin
headline: Make up free feel !
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice smooth product. Definitely can't wear over lotion it's too smooth but it is more skincare than make up but does have nice buildable coverage as you can see. Removal was easy washed right off. No notable scent.

author: Dashelle
headline: Fresh look, naturally gooey skin
comment: I received the It Coametics Do it All Sheer Fave Balm as part of a complimentary promotion in exchange for an honest review. The product packaging is compact and great for travel. The unscented formula was a great for sensitive skin consumers. The product is lightweight and slick upon first impression. It glides nicely onto the skin and leaves behind a light coverage with a healthy, realistic looking glow. I'd purchase this on my own when I finish this sample.

author: Lucky
headline: Easy to blend
comment: I love that this tint is a skin serum. It's perfect for daily use and does not feel heavy. I will continue to use, even wore it to the gym. It's a good tint minimal cover not a heavy scent.  [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Dashelle
headline: Glowy Skin Natural beauty
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Fave Balm had simple but classy packaging. I appreciate the glass jar it comes in. The size of the packaging is compact and great for travel. The formula is unscented which means a lot to me. Upon first touch it is a smooth and almost oily consistency, but it blends really well onto the skin. The finish is that of a natural glow. I had compliments from co-workers about my glowy skin. The formula lasted most of the day and was not irritating to my skin.

author: Tanya
headline: Great coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product for a quick makeup routine. I typically don't use balms, but this is light and it goes on smoothly. It doesn't make your face look cakey and it has a nice coverage. I have tried without setting powder and it doesn't even make my face oily. If you like more coverage, this balm allows you to build. I don't feel any need to reapply hours later because it lasts all day and doesn't make my face oily.

author: Tre
headline: Comfortable balm with light coverage
comment: I'm loving this so far!! It's a lightweight bam with light coverage. It's described as buildable but I think it can barely get to medium coverage, definitely not full coverage. But it's nice on days where your skin is okay but you still want a little light coverage if you're going out and just in case you see people. It's very comfortable on the skin and feels nourishing too. Love it!

author: Ellen
headline: It works
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Never used a foundation or tint balm before so ghis was new. It was alot more went then I expected but it makes sense. The color was a a bit darker then my tine but nothing I can't work with. I love tbe coverage.  It coved my tattoo and I was not expecting that. I wouldn't say this is something I will reach for daily but I will use it most definitely. 
#itcosmetics #makeup #tintedbalm #foundation #free #match #claim

author: Michelle
headline: Light, buttery, and sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This "Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm" in Fair Warm 120 matched my skin pretty closely. It's only applied to one side for comparison. It's very "sheer" and applies like a balm. Overall, good for a daily application but does not have much coverage.

author: Ann
headline: Blends nicely and has creamy texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Perfect creamy texture that glides onto your skin.  I wore it alone and as a base before applying foundation.  When worn alone it does not last all day.  It seems to moisturize and gives some protection against the dry, cold winter weather.  The tint is not so overwhelming and blends easily.

author: Jennifer
headline: Light and easy to blend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Upon first glance, the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm looks to be thick and heavy. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I found it to be a light, mousse-like cream. It blended right into my skin with my fingers and provided a light coverage. It held up all day, though I did find my fine lines were more apparent by the end of the day, but that could be a result of the cold, dry, winter air.

author: Kim
headline: Very light coverage / blurs imperfections
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Product is very easy to apply with fingers and then even out with a foundation brush. It is very light coverage that blurs skin imperfections. I found that I needed to use a setting spray to extend wear time. Without setting spray, I found that the foundation became chalky on my skin.

author: Darla
headline: Silky
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The consistency of this is beautiful. It is solid in the jar but spreads like silk on application. It is very very light coverage on me. I love the skincare ingredients! This would be perfect for a no makeup day or even as a blurring step under your foundation.

author: Bee
headline: Like a balmy primer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is indeed a balm as described, but the color doesn't translate to much once I applied it to my face. It's basically a serum with extremely mild pigment. I can see myself using this as a primer before applying makeup, but as a standalone product, it doesn't do much.

author: Kristin
headline: Yes and yes
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've had color match issues with IT Cosmetics before, so while still optimistic, I was hesitant on the match. THIS IS THE ONE. even in the container, it didn't look right, but applied, it's **chef's kiss.** The serum is so light and blends well, evens out imperfections without a thick layer of product. I really really like this one.

author: Mom
headline: Love this but 125 was too dark
comment: This tinted serum is very nice. It's light and soft in the skin but provides slight coverage. Nonscented, wears well/long lasting and doesn't feel cakey. The fair cool 125 is too dark for me. Washes off easy and the small glass packaging is great.

author: Sara
headline: So Smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm almost 40 years old and finding make up that keeps my skin moisturized, but not looking too overdone, is next to impossible. I don't have wrinkly skin by any means but I do have skin that is plain thirsty due to my age. When I looked at the packaging and saw the ratio of serum to coverage, I was astonished to see it's mostly serum. As I applied it, my skin felt smoother and softer, and it gave it my complexion an overall nice blur. It's the perfect addition to my winter makeup routine. It washed off easily with my face wash last night and lasted all day. I did set it with a little powder, but I just feel like I look darn good. ;)

author: Britnie
headline: Feels great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This looked a little dark but it went on great. This feels like I'm wearing nothing. My skin feels soft while wearing it. This is not like anything I've ever used, but I love it.  I think even those with dry skin will love.

author: Jenny
headline: Lightweight and natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This makeup actually feels like skincare.  I have super dry skin, especially in the winter.  This tint felt so hydrating going on.  It has a silky texture and almost seemed to absorb into my skin.  The coverage is light but buildable and looks natural with a matte finish.  I found it very easy to blend.  The color at first had me a little worried that it would be too dark but after applying and blending it actually looks perfect.  My complexion looks more even and any small imperfections are hidden.  I've noticed no fragrance to the product and love how it is gentle on my sensitive skin.  I've had no issues with breakouts or redness.  The coverage is also long lasting, even after a 10 hour day my makeup still looked great.

author: Deborah
headline: So nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has really great packaging. It feels lux. I like the way it applies really smooth and easily. It lasts and leaves skin looking nice. I definitely recommend.

author: Tracy
headline: love it
comment: . [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really loving the It cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm. This color is perfect for my skin tone and goes on so effortlessly you don't even realize you're wearing makeup. I find that this face balm blends into my skin so nicely giving me a beautiful finish. I highly recommend this product.

author: KaytS
headline: Looks, feels, and applies beautiful(ly)
comment:
I adore the texture and feel of IT! Cosmetics foundations, and this is completely different but absolutely nails the sheer tint promised- and it feels fantastic on the skin. It's super light, thin, and on first glance I thought the size of the product was small given the price point, but the consistency of it means that a little goes a long way and I can see this lasting me multiple months of applications. I have dryer skin, so I am totally on board with the 92% skincare serum take; it makes my skin look natural, and doesn't leave the obvious dry patches that some similar products do on me. My face feels moisturized while it's on, and it comes right off with my normal cleanser. It smells almost like nothing- just some earthy/light scent that's barely perceptible imo.
It can be applied in layers to cover redness etc if desired. I love this because it covered the red but still let the freckles show.

My only problem, as is with all IT! Cosmetics foundations, it doesn't come quite light enough for my skin- which is an absolute shame because this and their CC creams would be my HG if it did offer pale enough shades.

author: Inna
headline: Great Face Serum
comment: This is a very nice consistency sheer tint face balm that also functions like skincare! It has a very nice feel and it's a beautiful shade. I highly recommend it!

author: Elisa
headline: Easy application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am loving this sheer face tint. It felt so smooth and hydrating when I applied it to my skin and made me feel like I was glowing . I felt that coverage was great and did not dry my normal skin out . The color I picked was a shade to dark for my winter skin but in the summer it will be a perfect match . It blended easily and was easily buildable for more coverage, if that's what you're looking for . It was very lightweight since I didn't apply a lot and I also found it didn't accentuate any fine lines or wrinkles due to not applying many layers . One layer seemed to be enough for me. I noticed very little to no transfer and no scent . It worked as great under eye concealer for me .

author: Lilischarm
headline: Effortless Natural Glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how lightweight and comfortable this sheer tint face balm feels on my skin. It evens out my complexion while keeping a natural, fresh finish. It adds hydration and a healthy glow without feeling heavy or greasy—perfect for everyday wear and quick routines. A great option when I want my skin to look like skin, just better.

author: Christy
headline: Love this!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this tinted moisturizer for couple days now and I love it. My skin feels so good! It blends really well. I love IT cosmetics they have the best stuff. No greasy residue. Stays on all day. Will definitely be buying more.

author: Sarah
headline: Holy grail product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My new favorite one shop spot! This is the holy grail of multipurpose tinted foundation. This tint actually makes my skin look better, it acts as a skincare product, not just a foundation. It doesn't magnifying my pores and it doesn't look caked ok. It melts into my skin and reduces the look of my fine lines. It's the perfect shade. It's so lightweight that I just feel like I'm wearing an extremely light sunscreen. I LOVE this product!!! Because it's similar to a sunscreen or facial cream, it's easy to remove and it actually leaves your skin better than when you applied it.

author: N
headline: Not a Bad Product for What It Is
comment: This product is very sheer, to the point that it is more sheer than some CC creams I use. Shade labeling is a bit misleading; the "light" initially looks a bit too dark for my skin, but blends quite well and doesn't leave noticeable lines. If you are looking for a product that is compact, lightweight, and is barely noticeable, this is the product for you!

author: Amanda
headline: Great all day coverage
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. 

I didn't know what to expect from a tint face balm, but found this product to provide great coverage while also being silky smooth. I liked applying it with a brush vs my fingers.  It blends well and stays on all day. 

It looks like full coverage without feeling thick and caked on.

author: Sarah
headline: Truly all in one
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When I first got this I was like all in one what? This is truly an all in one skincare serum, tinted moisturizer and foundation that is buildable. This is honestly beyond lightweight, after putting it on I forgot I even had anything on. The color is so perfect, I got fair warm. I applied it with my fingers for a quick and easy on the go (running late) application and it washed right off of my hands no problem. It covered my under eye redness and bags pretty well without looking cakey. It has vitamin e, collagen, and hyaluronic acid. I would definitely recommend this.

author: Michelle
headline: Goes on smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth texture, goes on super nice. Nice packaging.  Overall 10/10, def recommend this to everyone! Nice color doesn't make it looked caked on at all.

author: Sara
headline: Light coverage winner
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I do not like the feeling of foundation and so I was curious about this product being called a balm. To my surprise, I really really like it. It is very natural looking. I was worried the color I got was too dark but the formula is very forgiving and it works for me. Coverage is dewy and makes my face look bright. I apply with a foundation brush or my fingers. I will repurchase this.

author: Refaat
headline: Soft dewy look
comment: IT Cosmetics' Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a great pick if you love a natural, radiant look without the feel of heavy makeup. The balm melts into the skin effortlessly, giving sheer, buildable coverage that evens tone while still looking like real skin.  It is delivering a dewy glow that feels fresh and comfortable. The scent is pleasant and size is compact so you can carry it easily everywhere.

author: Casey
headline: Great face tint
comment: This tiny face balm is great if you are trying to achieve a more natural "no makeup" look. It goes on smoothly, I used my fingertips or my blending sponge if I want to build the coverage. It is very light coverage to being with but can be built up to closer to medium. Blends into skin smoothly. Lasts all day.

author: Jackie
headline: Eh...Product is having an identity crisis!
comment:
Eh...To be honest I was really looking forward to testing this product for my honest opinion.

The Good: Nice texture, smooth, silky, not tacky at all. No fragrance. Some skin care ingredients (Vitamin E/HA/Collagen). Did not settle or cake.

The Bad: No longevity. It really is for almost perfect skin to appear fresh for the grocery store/quick outing. It's applied best with clean fingers. My real beef with the product is it's small size and lack of quality skin care ingredients. I pay for less than an ounce for great skincare products all the time. But this isn't great skincare or great makeup. For me it just missed the mark. Either improve the ingredients (sunscreen, vitamin c, ferments, etc) or make it bigger/better coverage like competition.

author: T
headline: Wonderful Texture
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
 I was really excited to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, especially since my mature skin doesn't tolerate heavy makeup very well — it tends to age me fast. I have normal to combination skin, so I'm always looking for lightweight, skin-like products.
First off, I love the packaging. It feels sturdy and luxe, and the balm texture is beautiful. Once warmed up, it melts into the skin easily and blends without much effort. I also appreciate that it's buildable, which is great if you want a little extra coverage in certain areas.
From a distance, my skin looks really nice — smooth with a soft, blurred effect. However, up close, I did notice that it settles and gives a slightly cakey or chalky look, which unfortunately makes my skin look more aged rather than fresh. That part was a bit disappointing for me personally.
Overall, it's a good product at a good price point, and I think it could work well for others, especially if mature skin texture isn't a big concern. For me, it's a bit hit or miss depending on how close you're looking.

This product was received in exchange for my honest review.

#ITCosmetics #DoItAllSheerTint #FaceBalm #MatureSkin #NormalToCombinationSkin #MakeupReview #Influenster #HonestReview

author: Kate
headline: Sheer, Creamy, and Effortlessly Natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Do It All Sheer Face Tint Balm is ultra subtle and creamy. I applied it heavier for the image so you could see the effect, but once blended it looks like hydrated skin. The finish is perfecting, never overdone, and the shade matched my light beige skin perfectly.

author: Jane
headline: Skincare but not?
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok this is INTERESTING. It's like a mousse foundation but it's clearly infused with skincare because it FEELS like you're applying skincare. It feels like you're applying some sort of serum/moisturizer hybrid. The coverage is light. I used my IT cosmetics Love is the Foundation brush and found that it applied best with that. A little goes a long way. I think dry skin gals and mature skin gals will love this.

author: Hayley
headline: Smooth and natural looking skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm!! I prefer a more natural looking makeup. I don't like makeup that is thicker or is full coverage. So this tinted face balm is perfect for me!! It is so lightweight and glides on effortlessly. It blends into my skin really beautifully and gives my skin tone a more polished look. If you prefer a foundation or cream that hides everything, this is not for you. It simply evens things out and makes you look your best but in a more natural way. It lasted throughout the day and didn't have any buildup in places that have more movement. It isn't a very big container, but it will last a long time since you don't need a whole lot. The compactness actually makes it easier to throw in your purse. Overall, loving this IT cosmetics tinted face balm!

author: Cya
headline: Easy to apply
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A lot of product in the container.  Easy to apply with your fingers but I got a better application with a brush. The finish is outstanding and I applied on dry face. Used it for a few hours without it bee itchy or feeling cakey. Finish looks well and you can definitely apply to neck without it feeling heavy. This is outstanding on how hydrating and light it is. Color matching isn't the best on this one for me but I love it.

author: thanh
headline: Uh vậy
comment: I really liked this product. It has a smooth texture that glides easily over the skin and provides an immediate feeling of hydration without being heavy or greasy. It gives a natural glow that makes the skin look healthier and well cared for. I've used it on m

author: Mara
headline: Lightweight coverage with benefits
comment: I am always looking for great skin and makeup products and like to find ones that combine many beneficial qualities. This smooth balm glides on the skin and easily covers redness without a ton of cakey product feeling. I've used tons of foundations and with the dry air and my aging skin this is a real winner!

author: Ethel
headline: Serum-concealer in one
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been an "it" cosmetics fan for quite a while. 
I love the color, texture, natural look, and coverage of this serum/concealer rolled into one, application is a breeze, it is subtle on the face. Loving the size and shape, it is full sized so the value is there, I love that it fits easily in my purse for easy touch up.

author: Rosa
headline: Blendable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Check out the before and after with my sun spot. I was pleasantly surprised with how nicely this product feels and the coverage. Feels so light the texture is light and soft and super blendable.

author: Alexandra
headline: Great for busy moms who don't need a ton of coverage
comment: As a new mom to a relatively clingy baby, this looked to be exactly what I needed - all my skincare in one plus a tint for my tired eyes and acne-prone skin? Sign me up! I chose the lightest color but it was still a little dark for my fair skin, but not in a bad way - just add bronzer to the endless list of things this does! The coverage wasnt much, as expected of a balm like this, but it was decent enough in a pinch (see before vs after). My oily skin absorbed the product really quickly, which was good and bad - good because it means skincare benefits, bad because it took awhile to spread it all - it isn't the most spreadable formula but it's definitely going to last me! It's the perfect size - since it's a balm, it would probably be long expired before I run out of it, so it's compact enough to travel with easily but not so small that it seems like a joke or a "deluxe sample". Overall I like the product, if I could change it I'd make it have more coverage and be a lot more spreadable, but it leaves my skin dewy without feeling greasy and has okay coverage so that I could apply it with my fingers on the go without worrying about streaking. Overall a great product for a busy mom like me, though it does take longer than expected to apply.

author: laura
headline: It REALLY does it all!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got to test this complimentary of a free app and I must say, it's hard for me to tell what my shade is based on a picture, but this matches my skin perfectly! And a little goes a long way. It feels buttery smooth on the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. The finish is matte which is perfect. A MUST to cover blemishes while looking natural. And it doesn't cover freckles

author: Marie
headline: Balmy foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've received this product in exchange for my honest review. The concept is nice that it is all in one skincare balm. Color match is tough since it's not that I tried directly in the store so I can't complain.  But color range could be wider. Texture is definitely balmy, could be a bit more smooth for my skin. Semi matte light coverage finish.

author: Julie
headline: Definitely buying again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this formula I only put it on half my face to show how well its blends and how opaque it truly is. very lightweight and buildable coverage. I could hardly tell if was even wearing foundation and it takes very little to go a long way, will definitely purchase more in the future,  typically i have foundation settle in my fine lines this does not to that, there was no shine and matte which I particularly like in a foundation. I found it to be very lightly scented.

author: Dawn
headline: Very light weight.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Do It All Sheer Tiny Face Balm is a new favorite for me. It looked like it wouldn't match my skin when it was in the bottle but went on and was perfect. It's creamy and not greasy at all. It Dover's a lot of imperfections in my skin.  It really held up all day as well.

author: Nicole
headline: Smooth application
comment: (I received this product for my honest review) I LOVE how smooth this applys to my face!! I used a dry sponge, and its glided on. I felt Fair Cool 125 was a great match for me. This evened out my skintone while providing a sheer coverage. I feel like it made my skin look firmer.

author: Karen
headline: Absolutely love this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] and I must say that I absolutely love this product

author: Jeanie
headline: Great Multitasking everyday make-up
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I chose the shade light neutral and it is just a little too dark for me right now but will be perfect this summer. This face balm is 92% skincare and it's very moisturizing you definitely do not feel like you have any make up on. This is somewhat buildable but it's not meant to be full coverage. It is a little shiny but in a good glowing way but if you prefer a more matte look you can just use powder to tone it down. 
This is perfect for everyday looks and going to the beach/travel (the size is very compact, perfect for travel) although I don't see any sunscreen in it so don't forget that. 
This does stay on all day and did not settle into my wrinkles. I would probably use a setting spray in the summer but you may not need one. Highly recommend.

author: Amie
headline: A surprise hit
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I hadn't heard much about it before, so I wasn't sure what to expect. First off the packaging is simple but cute. The product comes in a wide range of colors so it was easy to pick my perfect match. The product was easy to apply directly to clean skin and left my skin feeling supple, hydrated and with lightweight coverage perfect for a day in the office. The coverage is also buildable when you need a bit more to hide behind. A surprise hit, I'll be adding this to my daily routine.

author: Johanna
headline: for daily use it is TOP.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's truly a game-changer, making basic daily makeup incredibly easy and quick, plus it provides buildable, lightweight coverage and dries super fast.

author: Nancy
headline: I think I love this stuff!
comment: Just what I have been in search of- light sheet coverage and a bit moisturizing! Looks great all over. I add a bit of shimmer on the areas I want a little glow

author: Stephanie
headline: Nice texture
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I'm a fan of lightweight balm style foundations, and overall I like the lightweight texture and skincare benefits of this sheer balm. The coverage is a light satin finish, I found it to be difficult to build but it does blend nicely. It did loose a few stars for me because I found that it oxidizes very quickly and with a fair shade it was pulling too dark for me.

author: Melanie
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was a new product for me.  This smooth and silky tint balm applies easily and with good coverage. Blends evenly. Perfect for a quick makeup day. @influenster @itcosmetics

author: Rachel
headline: Definitely a go to
comment: I RECEIVED THIS PRODUCT TO GIVE A HONEST REVIEW .I really like this IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It feels lightweight and super comfortable on the skin, almost like skincare instead of makeup. The coverage is sheer but enough to even out my skin tone and give me a healthy glow. It blends easily with fingers and doesn't settle into lines, which I appreciate. My skin stays hydrated throughout the day, and it looks fresh and natural, not cakey. This is perfect for everyday wear when you want something quick, simple, and polished without feeling heavy.

author: Susan
headline: A hybrid between skin tint & tinted moisturizer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When I saw the word "balm," I thought this would be a thick, but it performs like a skin tint. At first, I thought it was sheer coverage only, but this balm is buildable and dries to a dewy finish. I requested the fair cool shade because this is typically my go-to, but I think I will try the lighter neutral shade. That said, it's forgiving. The shade blends well without giving that overall appearance that I am wearing makeup slightly darker. I like makeup that is also skin care. The balm is perfect for my aging skin. I saw no texture and for a product that is so lightweight I couldn't believe the coverage especially over red areas on my cheeks. I also experienced no irritation, and my skin was well hydrated. Finally, I believe this would packaging and formula will be great for travel. It comes in this weighty glass jar, and the Product only becomes like serum once you press into it and warm it up on your skin.

author: Huong
headline: I would like to buy it again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint face balm skincare serum when I try it on my face coming out so beautiful the shades so nice they cover all the pots and look so beautiful love it

author: Dawn
headline: Just meh
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. Incentivized. After trying the new face balm from IT cosmetics I have decided that it's just okay. I like that I can use it in place of a moisturizer but it really doesn't provide any coverage. This is a product designed for women who already have good skin so if you are using it to cover acne or scarring you might want to pick something else.

author: Janine
headline: Good face tint
comment: I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I'm not sure how I 100% feel on this product. I have dry skin and added moisturizer to my skin before adding this product but I just felt it almost went on and dried the skin more. The product is more matte texture and I was hoping a little more dewy. I feel this will be great in the summer when my skin isn't as dry during the winter time but until then I'll just keep experimenting by added extra hydration under it. Otherwise it goes on smoothly and blends very easily and is long wearing!

author: Katie
headline: Great face tint!

author: Christie
headline: I had blending issues
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I was eager to try a tint that has collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and Vitamin E. I have been using a tinted moisturizer from a well-known department store brand in a plastic tube, but I like the idea of a more beneficial balm from a glass jar instead. 

First impressions: I chose the best I could, and I had the whole range to choose from. The Light Neutral 210 seemed like a good match via online since I normally like my foundation to be slightly lighter. I thought it was going to blend into my skin, but it did not blend consistently. My hope was just to make my dark spots
less noticeable like my normal tinted moisturizer, which was achieved. 

Initial test (right side of my face): My first test was trying to use it without a moisturizing base since it already has a hydration component. What I noticed was that it blended into my skin in some areas and not in others. When it did not blend in, it was very noticeable, especially my forehead. The picture focusing on my forehead shows the balm not blending into my skin after spending some time blending it in. Notice the pooling on my skin (compared to the left side sans balm). 

Second type of test (left side of my face): So, the next attempt, I added a moisturizer underneath, and the
balm blended better than without the moisturizer. I still spend a good amount of time blending it in. 

Third type of test: I took everything off and put a moisturizer on my entire face. Then, I started from the top of my face, and blended as much into my forehead and then spread the excess elsewhere. This seems to work, but this took some effort. As a person who uses a richer moisturizer twice per day, this shouldn't be an
Issue. 

The Outcome: The balm is lighter than my tinted moisturizer. As soon as I learned how to apply it with a moisturizer first, starting from my forehead down, I am enjoying the result. I don't advise buying this without going into a retail store and having it match to your skin. In fact, the next time I am at a store with a cosmetic representative, I will ask to see which one is actually my shade and then test it in the store to see if
it blends any better. 

Value: This is less expensive than my Department store tinted moisturizer. Even though the jar has only .63
ounces (18 g) of balm, it will last a long time. This has better value if it could blend better.
