author: Straleshia
headline: Nice deep pigment
comment: I love the deep brown pigment. It works great when I'm contouring my face , the color brings out the adult look I'm going for. It wear long as long as you set it with a powder foundation. It has no smell and it does not leave you face feeling funny or irritated.

author: Justine
headline: Amazing!
comment: Love this product so much as it is completely sheer, and I love that it has skin care serum built into it for a healthier overall glow, and it definitely works well for under eyebags and dark circles as well as enhancing the overall complexion of my skin

author: Lilly
headline: Great formula
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.  I love a good sling tint that has a little bit of coverage but also feels like skincare and doesn't transfer and last all day, is that too much to ask? Maybe, that said I think I've found my HG in this skin tint.  
The formula feels like a balm/ rich moisturizer to the touch, it applies and blends very easy either with a brush or with your finger tips. It absorbed fairly well into my skin and worked really well over my current spf. That alone is a plus for me because a lot of foundations, skin tints and such won't sit well with with my spf and spf is a must for me. 
This skin  tint blended very easy and looks beautiful. I say it has a light coverage and makes you look like your skin but better. 
I have dry skin and the skin tint gave my skin a very healthy and natural look, it worked well with my cream blush and concealer. I set my makeup with setting spray and that was about it. 
It last fairly well and doesn't transfer much, just the area around my glasses but I say that's normal since I don't like to set my face with powder I expect a little burofax transfer from any skin product I wear. 
The formula feels rich and emollient all while absorbing into the skin and giving me a healthy and plump look to my face. 
At first I thought it would break up easy or just wouldn't hold as long as my go to bb cream but I was wrong.  I tested it for over a week with my normal daily routine and I have to say I truly love it! Oh one more thing, a little bit goes a long way, no need to swirl the brush into the jar to pick up a lot of product and is also buildable so if you want to have a bit more coverage in a specific area just apply the fiat layer, give it a bit to dry and then lightly pat over it to apply more product to achieve a bit of more coverage.

author: Colleen
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is so good. It goes on sooooo smooth and feels great. It does not get chalky at all. Feels super light and has a nice texture to it. The packaging it great.

author: Jesseca
headline: Breathable Coverage That Actually Performs
comment:
I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential to test and review, and I've really been enjoying it so far. It has that hard-to-find balance of feeling incredibly lightweight on the skin while still delivering solid, even coverage. It wears comfortably throughout the day without feeling heavy, cakey, or like it's clogging my pores — which is exactly what I want in an everyday foundation.

I'm especially drawn to complexion products that incorporate skincare ingredients, and this one definitely checks that box. I love the idea of a true dual-purpose product, and I'm planning to keep using it consistently to see how the serum ingredients perform over time. So far, it's an easy, breathable base that fits seamlessly into my daily routine.

author: Jackie
headline: Unique foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a really interesting product. I am a big fan of It cosmetics foundation products. This is like a foundation balm and really like nothing I've tried before. I was expecting this to be more sheer, and it's not it has pretty good buildable coverage. It lasts like a traditional foundation does and it seems to blend well. My only issue is the packaging. I feel like the pot is going to get really nasty really quickly. Overall though, I do like this foundation and I can see myself using this long-term.

author: Rebecca
headline: Blends nicely, would pick a lighter color next time
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall great coverage! The color might be a little too yellow/dark for me but I would just go with a lighter color. I applied it with a beauty blender. It blends nice, and it wore nicely for 4-6 hours.

author: Kayla
headline: Perfect for everyday light coverage giving a nice glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in light warm by @ItCosmetics complimentary from @Influenster in exchange for an honest review. Let me say. I have never received anything from It Cosmetics that I didn't like. This tinted face balm has a perfect light coverage for everyday use. Its very moisturizing not at all greasy. This gives me a perfect glow and a nice healthy color. It spreads easily with a brush. I will most definitely purchase this product in the future.

author: ChefLisa
headline: Cream to powder
comment: This was not at all what I expected especially since originally I thought it felt. Lot like dream matte mousse. The formula blends out beautifully to a nice sheer coverage and dries down to a powder finish that stays light on the skin and doesn't budge all day. There is a little bit of a smell to thebproduct that isnt great but thats obly if you stick your nose in the jar.

author: Tabitha
headline: lightweight but great face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoyed using this face balm. The tint worked perfectly with my skin; it was such a close match! It was lightweight and not greasy like some face products feel. It also did not make your hands messy to apply. I live in a place with harsh winters, and I felt like this was a great protectant for my skin. I looked forward to applying it before leaving the house. I felt like it kept my face from getting dried out from winter.

author: Ashlee
headline: Beautiful!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tent face bomb is absolutely beautiful. It truly is so easy to blend into the skin.. It truly does look skin like. I like that the component is small and easy for travel. It applies easy with clean fingers or a brush or sponge. I love this for an everyday look it's easy to apply convenient. Doesn't feel heavy on the skin. Doesn't bring out any texture on my skin. It is very hydrating, but doesn't make my skin feel oily . If you want something for easy application, natural or no makeup makeup look, this is great ￼

author: Rad
headline: Love this Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It comes in a glass packaging with a plastic lid. I tried the shade Light warm 215 and it's a perfect match for my skin tone. It's a sheer balmy formula thats easy to apply and gives a smooth skin like finish. The balm sets well and doesn't feel wet after applying. It's a great one to try if you prefer skin tints. No noticeable fragrance. I am testing in winter and didn't experience any shine at the T zones.

author: Natalie
headline: Bendable!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product goes on so smoothly! I was really impressed with how little I needed for my face. I was a little worried about the shade but it blended into my skin perfectly without adding an orange huh. The scent was tolerable and I didn't notice it after application.

author: Damion
headline: The name Do It All, says it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Feels amazing going on, brightens skin as well as covers imperfections. It's extremely light weight, while allowing for buildable coverage that blends into a natural finish. Great value for the benefits and multipurpose ability of this product.

author: Arleen
headline: Creamy and sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is so creamy yet goes on sheer and smooth. The product blends and becomes part of your skin. It's not highly pigmented but that's what I want in a face tint at my age. The formula doesn't sit in my fine lines which I love. I highly recommend this tinted balm.

author: Erika
headline: Very lightweight but nice coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great formula for someone that already loves the brand but is not happy with how full coverage their original cc cream is. This is a light weight formula that still gives optimal coverage and is buildable.

author: Michelle
headline: Great for dry skin girlies!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint melted into my skin. I blended it out for an even coverage and I was able to build it up. My skin is mature with texture and dry and used powder to set it and looks great and feels light. I don't know if I would have bought this if it weren't sent to me as I like typical matte foundation. It does go on dewy but you can calm that die if it's to much for you. I wore it to the gym and it didn't slip or slide off my face.

author: Lina
headline: Easy and great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very sheer and smooth. It will be a great compliment to my makeup. It does not have a sent or leave any residue. Love the glass jar that it comes in. Makes it easy to apply with hand or brush. Blends in very nicely.

author: Audrey
headline: Very moisturizing, nostalgic packaging
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture is definitely wet, making for great blend ability. Incredibly light coverage, and not particularly buildable. It did stay on all day with a tiny bit of powder in the t-zone, and didn't settle heavily into any lines. The packaging is nostalgic for me as a millennial (mousse foundation memories), and it definitely has a light, clean fragrance but did not bother my skin.

Would be great for dry skin, or if you'd just like a tiny bit of evening - I'd wear it skiing or hiking to ensure any photos are great, but it's not quite enough for my every day wear.

author: Samantha
headline: Surprising Coverage, Great Feel
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I picked the wrong shade, I should've gone lighter probably neutral instead of warm. This product goes on well, feels nice on the skin not greasy. I went ahead and did a full "no makeup" look to get the idea. It covers better than I expected more of a medium coverage with a brush.

author: Julie
headline: Great base for light makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product! Skincare and a little tinted color in one. I put it on without moisturizer & with a bit of powder over the top & I really liked it that way.  On its own it's not quite enough for me on a makeup day but it's a great base for a light makeup day.

author: Brittany
headline: For people with very clear skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a really cool product. My first observation is that this is going to be aimed towards anyone with already very clear, nice skin. I have a lot of redness and it definitely does not cover, but as you can see in the photo it does help blur and it feels fantastic! It's so lightweight and easy to apply, I just used my fingers and it blended out just fine. Perfect for no makeup days! It has no smell and the color match is pretty spot on. I am impressed

author: AEB
headline: I love this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this sheer tint face balm! It's thick enough to noticeably cover my hyperpigmentation and even out my skin tone, but it still feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin. It gives a natural, skin-like finish without feeling heavy or greasy—perfect for everyday wear when I want coverage and skincare in one!

author: Naina
headline: Easy everyday tint
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm goes on smoothly with a soft, creamy texture and gives light, natural coverage that evens your skin without looking like makeup. It feels comfortable all day, looks fresh on the face, and wipes off easily with a normal cleanser. The packaging is clean, sturdy, and easy to carry, making it a nice everyday product if you want something quick and natural.

author: heidi
headline: good texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Here is a swatch of the face balm. It has a good texture and i.like the finish. I don't notice product transfer on normal skin either. I would like less tint since I am mostly concerned about skincare.

author: Kait
headline: Silky smooth
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow, this feels so silky smooth going on. It immediately calmed the redness in my face without looking like I'm wearing any makeup. I can tell that this has good products in it for my skin- not just makeup. I'm also so impressed at the color match- I'm a cool skinned woman, and it can be hard to find something not too pale that provides nice coverage that matches.  I have already told bunch of friends about this product and will continue to sing its praises! Great find!

author: Marianna
headline: Easy to apply, great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for Free to test and give my honest opinion. This is my first time trying it cosmetic do it all face bomb and I was really skeptical about it. I was actually very pleasantly surprised, but how well this product goes on your skin and it doesn't feel very oily. It applies smoothly and the coverage is great. The only thing I'm concerned about that. It feels a little heavy on my skin one's applied.It looks natural and you can reapply on areas that need extra coverage. I would definitely recommend this product and will purchase in the future.

author: Kathleen
headline: Evened out my skintone and left silk skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thank you It Cosmetics for sending out this complimentary product for testing and review purposes.
I used this right after my skin routine. It looks thick in the jar. I initially put it on way to thick.  The key is lightly brushing your fingers across without pressure. Only then did I feel the serum. That was complete user error, but after trying it more times I got the right touch and there is no heaviness from using too much product. It feels like I just added another important step to my skin routine. 
I was thrilled to have chosen perfectly. The tint balanced the color on my face. I especially love it for that. I appreciate the versatility. It looks fabulous when you want to go fresh faced, or if you want to glam out.

author: Jillian
headline: Nice coverage, light
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A beautiful share finish that does a decent job of covering my redness. It's not a full coverage, but it still has a nice matte look that leaves me a little luminous. I found it easiest to apply with a makeup sponge rather than a brush

author: Molly
headline: Everyday Flawless
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is an excellent foundation for day to day. The texture is creamy but not oily or greasy. It is buildable, and works well with my combination skin leaving me neither oily or dry and cakey. The color matching was easy and I was able to find the perfect match for my skin.

author: Jeannette
headline: Interesting new find
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Definitely not the what you'd think a serum would be! Excited to try this since it's such a different product from my usual lineup. It appears like a cream, but when you touch it it feels almost watery like what you'd expect from a serum. Very light and thin but with light to medium buildable coverage. Personally I think it's a bit more on the matte side. Once blended in it smooths out quite nicely however there is some slight settling in lines. Would probably use with a primer or on very good skin days for a natural light coverage. A little confused on proper use, however, since see no indication of SPF but probably wouldn't want to apply lotion on top. Not even sure if you want to put on top of primer since serums are usually intended to provide extra skin goodness on cleaned skin.

author: Kaci
headline: Perfect for "no makeup" makeup days.
comment:
This face balm really surprised me in the best way. The texture is super velvety and smooth, and it glides onto the skin so smoothly. Once it's on, it settles into a soft matte finish that feels comfortable, not dry, and helps keep shine under control without looking flat or powdery.
The coverage is light and sheer, just enough to even out my skin tone and blur a bit of redness while still looking like skin. It won't cover everything, but that's not what it's meant to do. What I love most is how it feels lightweight, breathable, and easy to wear all day without feeling heavy or cakey. Even with the matte finish, it doesn't cling to texture or settle into lines.
It lasts well for everyday wear and layers nicely with concealer if I want a little extra coverage in certain spots. Overall, it's a great "throw it on and go" product for when I want my skin to look naturally polished with a velvety, matte feel.
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Agnes
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in love with this balm, the texture is super creamy, it gives beautiful matte finish, goes on very smooth and is buildable, i applied to my wrist on the picture and it is barely different from my skin tone, i like that it comes in the small jar.

author: Asum0423
headline: Face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the tint face balm. It feels great, coverage is good and its multi purpose. You can use it as highlighter, concealer or foundation. Its definitely buildable coverage and melts onto the skin. Unscented formula.

author: Lina
headline: Buildable and Moisturizing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The It Cosmetics- Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is fantastic. I love a good sheer tint face care product that is buildable, if I choose. I love that it has collagen and hyaluronic acid, and my face feels ultra smooth after application. It's a nice, creamy mousse for easy blending, and no scent at all, which I love. Definitely recommend this skin balm!

author: Jessica
headline: If you are too busy for makeup, you need this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This blends like a dream.  The sheer tint is so nice for evening out my complexion and giving my skin a naturally fresh faced appearance.  Perfect for days when I need to drop my kiddo at school and get out the door in no time flat. I can even use this around my eyes and it doesn't get dry and clumpy, it feels more like skincare than makeup.  I also really appreciate that the formula layers nicely over my sunscreen without pilling or separating.  I think the texture of this balm is what really sets it apart because it applies like skincare and it dries down and feels like I'm not even wearing any makeup.

author: Jessi
headline: Great for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very pleasantly surprised using this product. The finish is very forgiving for dry skin. It applies smoothly with a brush even though I usually use a sponge. It does stay on all day, but after about six hours does settle into fine lines/pores. It's not horrible, just slightly noticeable. The finish is more on the dewy side after several hours, but not greasy. As you can see from my color swatch, this shade was too dark for me, but it can be sheared out. If it was lighter I could have built up the coverage to more of a medium. I would repurchase this in my shade.

author: Amber
headline: Smoothing but needs spf
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really want a natural look for daytime, but as I age, my skin doesn't look as nice without a little something to help it out. I have fine lines and large pores, as well as slightly uneven surface, so its a big ask for one product to help all of that! I've been an IT fan for years, and they didn't disappoint with this one! It really does feel like a balm, but goes smoothly on my skin with no excess oil, or dragging. The color I chose is slightly off, but pretty close. The smoothing aspect is what impressed me the most. Once its on my skin, it really smooths the texture and improves the look amazingly.  The fact that it has good skincare ingredients is a huge plus!  It comes in a jar, so i use a little spatula to get it out, rather than my fingers. It would be really great of they supplied a little scoop or something. I also wish there was spf added, so that it could be a one quick step to getting ready for a casual day. I like that theres no obvious scent in this as well.  Ill be replenishing my supply as soon as im done with this jar!

author: Maria
headline: My best friend for the daily very fresh on the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Aroma is very fresh you don't feel the smell, I recommend the product for the daily it is fresh when applied nothing heavy on the skin and very creamy, packaging is plastic lid and glass in container, feeling on the skin very fresh I recommend it is worth investing in it, it is just an ink so it does not have much coverage but it is very noticeable that you have it on

author: Erica
headline: It was ok
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I liked the ease of application, i used a foundation brush and went to town. I liked the buildableI coverage and the silky texture but i also felt like it was a little yellow on me and my t zone came out rough. I hated that the conditioner was glass, cause I almost dropped it a couple times but Overall I thought it felt nice to wear on my face.

author: Laura
headline: Smooth coverage
comment: Omg! I'm totally in love with this tint balm, it's perfect for an everyday look, it gives you a smooth coverage without looking cakey and it doesn't feel greasy on your skin either, and the best thing is that it lasts all day. I think the price is fine for the size or product and the quality as well. I can't recommend this product enough

author: Debbie
headline: Beautiful!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oh I love this brand and now, I love this product!! Great color.  Great texture.  Blendable.  Makes the skin look naturally flawless.  Performance is spot on.

author: April
headline: I will be adding this to my every day makeup routine!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product. I am usually skeptical about trying out new foundations/face tints but this one is a big win. It goes on very smooth and blends nicely into the skin. At first I thought the color was going to be too dark, but it gave me just the right balance of color.

author: Sara
headline: Love this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I prefer face tints. This one goes on so smoothly and it gives me a sheer finish that feels luminous without being shiny. I tend to be a little drier and I mix products and I was able to use this product on its own and felt like it looked great. The packaging is nice and it's easy to use the product.

author: Sophie
headline: Give it a try
comment: Great product for slow build up. I've attached picture of a scar before and after application. I think it's covering it well whiteout being cakky. The text is more like a lip balm so it's not something I'm used to use on my face. Very easy to blend no issues with that at all and didn't even need a brush. I think it could cover a little more especially if acne probed skin but overall great product. Influencer sent me this product to try for free in exchanged of an honest review. It did covered my scar all day.

author: Kate
headline: Wonderful glowy coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so delighted by this product. It provided a super moisturized light coverage which was especially useful on wrinkles. The coverage is very similar to a bb cream but the effect was way better/glowier. Perfect for a "no makeup" look.

author: Lisa
headline: A light tint without using foundation
comment: This product is very lightweight and creamy. It gives you a light tinted glow. For just a little while it's ok. It's not my favorite because it doesn't last as I'd like and comes off easily.

author: Joni
headline: Great light weight foundation
comment:
I have been really impressed with this sheer tint face balm and have been reaching for it almost daily. The texture is smooth and balmy without feeling heavy or greasy, and it melts into the skin beautifully. It blended effortlessly with both my fingers and a sponge, leaving no streaks or patchiness. The coverage is light, which I personally love. It evens out my skin tone and softens redness without looking like makeup, making it perfect for a natural everyday look.

One of the biggest highlights for me is how well it lasted throughout the day. I applied it in the morning and it still looked fresh hours later with no settling into fine lines or breaking apart. My skin stayed comfortable and hydrated, which is impressive for a product that feels so lightweight. It truly feels more like skincare than makeup, and my skin looked healthy and glowy rather than flat.

I was also pleasantly surprised by how much product comes in the container. It is filled to the brim, which makes it feel like a great value for the price. A little goes a long way, so I know this will last me quite a while. Overall, this is a fantastic option for anyone who wants light coverage, easy application, and long lasting wear. It is ideal for no makeup makeup days and for those who want their skin to look like skin, just better.

author: Sarah
headline: Love how easy it is to use and throw in my bag
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great face balm to have with you for on the go. I throw it in my purse to use after the gym when I've showered and want to put something on to look nice and refreshed without a full face of makeup. Love that I can apply with fingers, no tools required. It definitely leans more into skincare than a heavy look but for everyday, that's just what I need. I also use it sometimes as a base layer under more fully made up looks.

author: Kelsey
headline: A staple for your daily routine!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a working mom with one on the way, my makeup routine has become much more simplified and efficient. Let me just say that this is the perfect addition when I feel I need a bit more coverage than a tinted moisturizer and is the perfect, buildable blemish concealer. I love that it's easy to bring on the go and lasts all day. Not to mention it doesn't look cakey.

author: Nadia
headline: Good for every day use
comment: Lightweight, hydrating, and very natural on the skin. It melts in easily, evens out my tone, and gives a healthy glow without feeling heavy or greasy. Perfect for everyday, no-makeup makeup days.

author: kelly
headline: lightweight and buildable
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is great for daily wear because It's lightweight and awakens skin for that fresh look. It's sheer, so I recommend using concealer if you require extra coverage. The serum consistency allows you to blend with ease. IT Cosmetics always blows me away with the luxurious packaging. Thank you for providing a quality product.

author: Elsa
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great tint to use every day. This is perfect for maturing skin. It's really comfortable to apply to your skin and wear all day. This leaves your skin looking flawless.

author: Vanessa
headline: Light not sheer. Great for no makeup look.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's a thin balm with light foundation coverage. I love the coverage, a no makeup makeup must. 

The finish is shiny/dewie to the max. I have mostly oily skin so it was a must to dust with powder after. 

Even tho this is a balm
It clung to my dry patches, which is a bummer. 

Initially I was horrified when it highlighted my pores but after going over it with my fingers, it melted better into my skin. 

Besides it clinging to dry patches, my other bummer was the tone, I selected a neutral under tone and yet it turned out very very orange. I would recommend going down a shade to counteract that. 

Overall I would recommend if you like the no makeup look and to try it out in store for a better shade match.

author: Tracy
headline: So soft
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The DO IT ALL Sheer Tint Face Balm is a fantastic product! It's packed with 92% Skincare Serum, which suggests it's designed to nourish and benefit your skin while providing a sheer tint. It's so soft smooth and feels light.The size is 0.63 oz / 18g, which is a pretty standard size for a face balm. It's a great option if you're looking for a multi-tasking product that offers both coverage and skincare benefits! ✨

author: Amanda C
headline: For A Natural Look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really wanted to love this one 

First off — the packaging is adorable. A thick glass jar, heavy, luxe, and packed with product. Definitely gives "high-end skincare-meets-makeup" vibes.

After trying every application method imaginable, I finally cracked the code finger tapping ONLY. If you rub it in… it literally disappears. Gone. Vanished. 

At this point I'm thinking, okay what's not to love?

Well… here's where it lost me a bit. The product transfers — a lot. Even after letting it sit for 20 minutes, it was still transferable.

I did a full side-by-side test — forehead fine lines, freckles, the whole shabang 
✔️ Coverage was actually really nice if your going for natural definitely not full
✔️No scent
✔️ Didn't make fine lines look worse
❌Transfer Proof

So overall? It's pretty, lightweight, and natural — but the transfer issue keeps it from being a holy grail for me.

author: Wendy
headline: Great for dry skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I liked the coverage more than I expected for a sheer tint it evened out my skin tone and looked very natural, feels a little heavy though. While I prefer liquid formulas, this balm still wore comfortably and blended well. I really like products with the added skincare benefits, it makes the purchase worth it.

author: Erica
headline: You can skip your skincare when applying!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this! It goes on your skin like butter. I love that this has serum in it. If you are ever in a rush, you can skip your skincare and just use this. It's not greasy or heavy on your skin. It glides on smoothly. Very little goes a long way. It blends into my skin perfectly. It covers fine lines, wrinkles, and acne. It doesn't make your skin look cakey. My skin feels smooth, soft, and silky all day long and all night. It lasts all day long. It doesn't have a scent which is nice.

author: Alischa
headline: Nice glow, but two greasy for my skin
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is lightweight and easy to apply, and it does give a nice sheer glow with light coverage. That said, on my skin it felt a bit too greasy, especially as the day went on, and it emphasized texture rather than smoothing it out. While it may work well for very dry or younger skin, I don't think it's the best option for mature skin or anyone who prefers a more natural, less shiny finish.

author: Yuko
headline: Tinted face balm with natural finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted face balm has sheer coverage. Because it's sheer, I need to use concealer, but for my under-eye dark circles only. I love the natural finish, and it's perfect for everyday wear. My skin doesn't feel tired after wearing it all day.

author: Caitlin
headline: Good ingredients- not pore-perfect
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this face balm overall, especially the skin-loving ingredients—it feels nourishing and lightweight at the same time. It's very easy to apply and blends quickly, making it great for a simple, low-effort routine. The sheer tint evens things out nicely without feeling heavy.

That said, I did notice it tends to settle into my pores, especially after it's been on for a bit. It's not a dealbreaker, but it keeps it from being perfect for me. Still a solid option if you're looking for something easy with added skincare benefits.

author: Manda
headline: Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has such a unique texture. I love the feeling of it on my skin. It has good coverage and doesn't feel too heavy. I was sent the wrong shade so I can't use it all over in this season. But I can wear it as a bronzer and this summer.

author: Sophia
headline: Like liquid silk
comment: I really love this skin tint because I don't always feel like going all out with the foundation. This gives me moisture all day, doesn't clog up my doors or cause any breakouts, it's just the right amount of coverage to even out my skin tone, and it gives me a dewy glow. It's weightless and silky smooth.

author: Anhy
headline: The best
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was gifted the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm and I love it — it's become my go‑to for quick, effortless coverage. 
The formula feels incredibly lightweight, almost like a tinted moisturizer but with just enough tint to even my skin tone without looking cakey. It blends like a dream with my fingers and gives a natural, skin‑like finish that still lets my freckles show through. Hydration is noticeable; my skin stayed comfortable all day without needing touch‑ups. It also layers nicely under sunscreen or over a serum.
Packaging is simple and travel‑friendly. If you want light coverage that looks like your skin but better, this is a lovely everyday product.

author: Monica
headline: Incompatible Color
comment: This review was completed in exchange for complimentary products for testing purposes. Unfortunately, the Sheer Tint Face Balm is too dark for my complexion, and therefore, I will not be able to utilize the product.

author: Jodie
headline: Dewy. Feels Like Skincare
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the finish of this tint. It actually has more coverage than I expected with the name being, "sheer tint". It is definitely all balm texture and finish. I'm in my 40s and I prefer a dewy look as I also have dry skin. I like that this gives a light coverage all over but is buildable without looking cakey. I like that it does cover some of my imperfections. I personally like applying with my fingers at first and then adding more with a beauty sponge to certain areas I want more coverage. It feels really nice on the skin-it feels more like skincare than makeup. The shade was a match to my usual It Cosmetics base products.

author: Amber
headline: Smoothing, but no spf
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really want a natural look for daytime, but as I age, my skin doesn't look as nice without a little something to help it out. I have fine lines and large pores, as well as slightly uneven surface, so its a big ask for one product to help all of that! I've been an IT fan for years, and they didn't disappoint with this one! It really does feel like a balm, but goes smoothly on my skin with no excess oil, or dragging. The color I chose is slightly off, but pretty close. The smoothing aspect is what impressed me the most. Once its on my skin, it really smooths the texture and improves the look amazingly.  The fact that it has good skincare ingredients is a huge plus!  It comes in a jar, so i use a little spatula to get it out, rather than my fingers. It would be really great of they supplied a little scoop or something. I also wish there was spf added, so that it could be a one quick step to getting ready for a casual day. I like that theres no obvious scent in this as well.  Ill be replenishing my supply as soon as im done with this jar!

author: TanyaW
headline: Good light coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've had a major shift in my approach to foundation thanks to the DoIt All Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cosmetics. This game-changing product offers light coverage that effectively conceals imperfections, redness, and pores, giving my skin a natural-looking glow that lasts all day. Plus, it's incredibly lightweight and comfortable to wear, making it perfect for everyday use.

author: Buffy
headline: Another IT Hit! This is a keeper!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I swear, if IT Cosmetics' Do It All face balm doesn't go viral, there is something messaged up in this world. It's like… a pigmented, rich, moisturizing airbrushing. It isn't about false perfection, it's about letting your skin shine through with a little help (and a little hydration). Let me tell you, I ordered 210 Light Neutral and when I first saw it I thought, "Nope nope nope, far too dark". But when I actually put it on my skin it soaked in, disguised some red scarring left from nasty acne in years past and make everything, just… better!

author: Amanda
headline: Tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very pleased with this sheer tint face balm. It was very easy to apply. The container is very easy to open as well compact to store. This lasted me an entire 10 hours at a festival, so thats is great !

author: Larrissa
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this tinted balm.  It's a tiny bit dark on some parts of my face but I have an SPF skin tint that is my lightest shade.  Together they are an impeccable duo.  They blend perfectly together and onto my complexion.  At 92% skincare this is something I feel good about wearing all day.  It's as comfortable as the ingredients are comforting.  It removes easily with remover or cleanser but stays on the skin when desired.  But setting spray really is needed to extend its wear. I LOVE that it doesn't clog my pores at ALL!  I've even left it on overnight with no problems.  That's insane to me.  I like the packaging although a dispenser would be convenient and more hygienic.

author: Nicky
headline: Love this foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a big fan of IT cosmetics sheer tint face balm it goes on smooth and is a really nice color match. It keeps my face moisturized while covering my light facial discoloration without looking heavy and cakey.  I am very excited to see how it makes my face look and feel healthier over time. I will definitely purchase again.

author: Cris
headline: Great Tinted Face Balm
comment: I really love IT cosmetics. This Sheer Tiny Face bomb goes on smoothly, it provides a nice coverage to help my uneven skin tone, and it is easy to blend. It feels more like a balm than a foundation and it feels like satin. The color is a good match to my skin as well!

author: Hannah
headline: Lightweight sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a lightweight sheer ish coverage,  just light enough. I wear it under my eyes before I do my whole make up, or on days I dont do anything but need something to hide the circles a little.  I do wish this was a little bit lighter color for my tone but it blends easy.

author: Tammey
headline: Light weight Coverage
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest reviewThe IT Do It All Sheer Tiny Face Balm comes in a small glass container (0.63 oz) and is packed tightly, so a little truly goes a long way. There is no smell at all, which I really appreciate. It applies easily with a brush, fingers, or a sponge, and it blended in effortlessly, almost like a smooth lotion. It provided fair coverage, but what I liked most is that there was no heavy residue and it didn't feel like I was wearing makeup. I actually prefer this skincare serum style formula over tinted moisturizers that tend to feel heavy on my face. With this balm, it genuinely felt like I had nothing on at all. It has a smooth blended in finish and easily removed with soap.  I would recommend and purchase again.

author: Kim
headline: Great product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really impressed with how well this skin tint matches my skin color.  It's a nice creamy formula that's glides on smooth and blends very well and a little goes a long way. It's a great alternative if you don't have the time for a tedious makeup application.

author: aysays
headline: Great product for daily use
comment: If you want a little color on your face and fresh look without all the heavy make up, this is the right product!! Mostly made with skin care ingredients, this balm gently improves the look of your skin with a tint of color and nourishes your skin over time.

author: Britany
headline: Great, Innovative Face Balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really been enjoying using the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I chose the shade Fair Cool 125. I have mature, combination skin. The shade matched my skin perfectly. It applies beautifully and doesn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles. It feels very lightweight yet hides all your imperfections while moisturizing the skin. It's not buildable—layering doesn't add coverage—but it looks very natural. Applying with my fingers worked best as brushes seemed to waste product. I also set it with a small amount of loose powder. I didn't experience any pilling, and it wore well throughout the day. I really appreciate this balm because it acts as skincare and foundation together. Plus, there is little to no scent, so it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and it removes just as easily as it applies. I love the glass packaging; it feels elevated and well-made. The formula contains 92% skincare ingredients, including Hyaluronic Acid, collagen peptides, and Vitamin E. Overall, this is an easy, everyday "no-makeup makeup" option if you don't have much to cover. I would recommend and repurchase this.

author: Sara
headline: Great Tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love a lightweight product that gives some coverage and sits well!  This texture is so smooth and glides right on, but did get a little oily through the day - which I have combo skin. I'd say this is slightly buildable if you want it to be, but is sheer to medium coverage.

author: Marline
headline: My New Favorite
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation or sheer tent is amazing. It is lightweight, but it covers all of my redness. It does not sink in the fine lines or sit on top of the skin. It just it looks like your real skin. And it's hard to describe, it wears really, really well. It dries down quickly, and it wears all day.It's very good for mature, textured skin.And it actually removes quite easily with just your regular makeup remover.

author: Linda
headline: A Whisper in Tint
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review As someone with aging skin, I'm always on the lookout for a face tint that feels light yet gives me a bit of coverage. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm definitely delivers on the sensory experience , applying it feels like tiny droplets of rain landing on your skin.  I didn't really like the skin feeling wet but the texture is refreshing, and the adorable little pot makes it easy to toss into a bag without taking up space. I also love the subtle scent, which adds a nice touch without being overwhelming.  Application is simple, you can use your fingers or a brush. I prefer starting with my fingers and then blending with a cream brush for a more even finish. The formula is very sheer , almost too sheer for my taste. I picked up the shade Warm Natural, which usually matches my skin tone well, but the tint here is extremely light. If you're looking for noticeable coverage or a thicker consistency, this may not be the best match.  While I appreciate the chance to try it, I'm not entirely sure I'd purchase it again. It's lovely in feel and packaging, but I personally prefer a tint with more coverage and a bit more substance.

author: netty
headline: Natural Look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very light weight product that comes in a cute small packaging. I started using my finger to apply then switched to sponge. It is great at blending smoothly. It give a natural smooth look. A great product with no strong scent would definately recommend

author: Brittany
headline: Beautiful skin care balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a beautiful product. It feels so nice on my skin. Very hydrating and smooth texture. It has a really nice light coverage. It's blendable and easy to apply. It covers without covering everything so it's more natural and I like that.

author: Kristina
headline: this is a great multitasking product for a natural
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm and I really love how easy and natural it is. The application is effortless - it glides smoothly over the skin and blends quickly with fingers or a sponge, with no streaks or patchiness. It's perfect for quick, everyday makeup.

The packaging is compact and practical. I like that it's sturdy and travel-friendly, and the product inside feels well protected. It's easy to throw into a bag without worrying about mess.

There is little to no scent, which I really appreciate. It doesn't irritate my skin at all and feels comfortable even on sensitive days.

The effect is exactly what I want from a sheer tint. It evens out my skin tone, softens redness, and gives a healthy, natural-looking finish without feeling heavy or cakey. My skin still looks like skin, just more polished.

In terms of wear, it holds up very well throughout the day. It stays comfortable, doesn't settle into fine lines, and fades evenly without breaking apart. Overall, this is a great multitasking product for a natural, fresh look, and I would definitely repurchase it.

author: Jaime
headline: Very natural
comment: I'm normally a medium neutral is all face products but this one was a bit too dark and way to warm/orange toned but I used a foundation brush and only applied very small amounts, blending was great and since it's sheer, it worked out ok. It leaves a very glowy finish and is comfortable on the skin. It doesn't last long since it is glowy but that's not what this product is meant to do so I wasn't disappointed. It's very natural looking and I'd compare it to a tinted moisturizer.

author: Christina
headline: So nice and light!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint is amazing! It is so lightweight that I don't feel it on my face.  The coverage is just enough to give you a hint of color and it applies very smooth.  There is not real scent which is a plus! Removing it after all day wear is so easy, face cream remover works great.

author: Jamie
headline: Product Test
comment: I received this product to try out. I usually love wearing tinted moisturizer, although it blended well it just sat on top of my skin. I didn't see any coverage at all either while some other brands do have this quality.

author: SLS
headline: Hard Pass
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] —- Applies odd. Does not apply well with a silicone pad but applies better with a brush.  Sits on top of skin and does not soak in. Feels dry and cakey on the skin. Has a white cast to it once applied. Does not cover or even out anything even if your skin is relatively in good shape. I actually hate this product. Day to day I normally use Milk Hydro Tint. The IT tint to me is awful.

author: Autumn
headline: Everything and more
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am obsessed! This sheer tint face balm is beyond amazing. A beautiful color match that was so simple to apply. It leaves a nice silky satin finish. Zero scent or irritation to my dry sensitive skin. From what I understand skincare and makeup with built in skin care is going to take the lead in trends for this end of the 20s. This wears like a dream. Not full coverage but instantly evens out skin tone letting the skin peak through while leaving a natural healthy glow. It removes as easily as it blends revealing healthy skin underneath. I'll be reaching for this for my everyday look. Perfect for dry and/mature skin as it didn't settle into line or crease. Such a cool concept for skin coverage. I highly recommend it. Find your shade and try it out. I literally have nothing but love for this skin tint!

author: Alicia
headline: Long lasting coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Light weight coverage, a little goes a long way. Feels smooth, covers well. Matches perfectly good base. Can build to it easily. Lasts all day, perfect

author: Äní
headline: I will buy this foundation when it runs out.
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
I love foundation but I wanted a foundation that let my skin breath and receive moisture as well. The it DO IT ALL Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade  as rich as warm 505,  gives me glow-up energy. 
 Not another heavy foundation. This sheer tint balm is 92% skincare serum, so it feels like self-care.  I use it when I want that fresh, dewy look without the fuss. It moisturizes and , evens out tone, and gives a soft tint that looks like my real skin, just glowier. Dispensing it is smooth. It's Lightweight, buildable, bendable and its appearance is very natural, glowy and very beautiful.  It's perfect for no-makeup makeup days.
I highly recommend it and will buy it when it runs out.

author: Angel
headline: Love it
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Texture and Finish: Many reviewers commented on the unique texture of the product, describing it as mousse-like but lightweight, melting easily into the skin and providing a dewy, naturally radiant finish. This product does not cake and effectively evens out skin longevity tone .
Coverage: Despite the name "sheer," the coverage is described as light to medium and buildable, sufficient to cover redness from rosacea or other imperfections.
Skincare Benefits: The formula contains 92% skincare ingredients, including Hyaluronic Acid, collagen peptides, and Vitamin E, providing 24-hour hydration, firmer skin, and reduced appearance of wrinkles, according to consumer studies.
Feel on the Skin: when i wear found the durability very lightweight and moisturizing on the skin, feeling like a moisturizer. Some with oily skin noted that the product might not dry completely and could smudge if touched .

author: Christiana
headline: IT Cosmetics Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got to try the IT Cosmetics new face balm and it did not disappoint. It is 92% skincare but applies like a lightweight foundation. The coverage is sheer allowing your skin to breathe. It also lasts all day which is impressive for such a sheer foundation. I like that is provides coverage without feeling heavy. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a more comfortable foundation.

author: Christina
headline: IT Cosmetics Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm acts as skincare and foundation in one. It applies beautifully and doesn't settle in your fine lines and wrinkles. It feels very lightweight yet hides any skin imperfections. It lasts all day and is easy to remove. I like that there is no residue left behind when removing. I would definitely recommend this face balm.

author: Destiny
headline: A Light Balm Foundation
comment: This balm foundation was a very interesting concept. I used the faintest neutral 110 shade. It goes on creamy like a balm that keeps your face nice and moisturized but also works as a light foundation. It is really a light colored balm but it did blend into my skin so some of my imperfections were hidden while moisturizing my face. I don't wear foundation sometimes so this is a nice alternative to give my skin a little extra something without applying heavy makeup. It left my face with a velvet feeling! The picture shows the bottom part of my face using the balm and the top without it. There is definitely a difference. I received this for free for my honest review. I highly recommend!

author: Mari
headline: Very Nice
comment: I like sheer products. And this one seems like it could be buildable if needed. There is no odor and the texture is smooth! I like it - easy application - I used my fingers. I will wear this color Rich Warm in the summer time when I get a tad bit darker.

author: Amy
headline: The best product for every day natural healthy skin look
comment:
The @IT Cosmetics #DoItAllSheerTintFaceBalm was sent to me , in exchange for my honest true review. 
This product was wonderfully created and prepared for us that have been seeking out , that truly healthy lightweight glow , without all the unnecessary and heavy products. That clog and unpureify our pores . It feels so light on the face , goes on so easily with just your fingers and the the healthy skincare ingredients goes in so smoothly and cleanly absorbed.  It leaves a beautiful blurred glow behind. Without the extras just a little touch of tint. It also builds up so nicely and evenly. It doesn't even carry a scent. Perfect for that no makeup looked or if you don't wear foundation. But needing something to create a canvas for your makeup. I found the product works best with no primer at all . Just a little makeup. I am excited to experiment with it. I want to see all the looks I can create. And this also has something I'm loving is it easily cleanse with a face wipe then a quick wash . This is something I have been wanting to be created . And so glad that @IT cosmetics has it now. I myself have not seen something like it before. I definitely recommend the @IT cosmetics #DoItAll Sheer Face Balm . 
Thank you @IT Cosmetics and @Influenster #FaceBalm ##SheerTint

author: Libby
headline: Great coverage
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics CC cream has been a favorite for years so I felt confident and excited to try the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because I trust IT Cosmetics to offer a great buildable coverage that allows me to shift between my everyday no makeup make up look to looking polished and photo ready for special occasions. Once again, IT developed a product that does just that and of course sneaks in some skin care. I applied the balm with a brush and it beautifully melted into my skin. I went for a light look but tested the buildable coverage on my arm and it covered by sun damage easily. I also liked that this balm wore well throughout the day. I had no need to reapply.  I think I may have found a new favorite!

author: Nhi
headline: Fresh faced
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been really enjoying using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm as my everyday base. It really feels like one of the skincare products in here with 92 percent skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid, collagen peptide, and vitamin E, so I get to enjoy the skin benefits of being hydrated and plumped as I go about my day. It comes as a solid serum but turns to liquid in the skin, with just the mere touch of the fingertips.
The coverage is just sheer but buildable, creating a smooth, radiant finish for my skin without making it heavy or greasy. The product balances my skin tone, blurs my fine lines, and ensures my skin stays moisturized throughout the day. Indeed, this is one of the best products to use if I want to go natural when I want my skin to look healthy and glowing, not covered up. Highly recommend!

author: Dharti
headline: Blends really well into the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the balm in Light Medium Warm 225 shade and was impressed with how my skin looked, healthy and even without any additional make up. The balm melts effortlessly into my skin and gives light, sheer coverage that softens uneven tone while still letting my natural skin show through. The shade blends in nicely with my warm undertones and doesn't look heavy or mask-like. The finish is naturally radiant, fresh and glowy rather than greasy and it feels more like skincare than makeup. My skin stayed comfortable and hydrated throughout the day, which makes this a great option when I don't want anything drying or thick on my face.

author: Lazara
headline: I love it!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's exactly my tone!!! What a wonder of Face balm, I am super excited that it has been perfect for me, it is soft, it is not heavy, it has no aroma, it is long-lasting, the packaging is beautiful and its value is excellent! I loved it! Thank you.

author: Genevieve
headline: Amazing texture that blends beautifully
comment: The texture of this skin tint is everything. It goes on like a gel and blends in right away to give natural coverage with zero fuss. As you can see in the photos, the color of the one I tested is a bit too dark for my winter skin but it somehow still blended amazingly well when applied to my face. I will gladly use this in summer as it's such an incredible texture on my finicky 40 something skin.

author: Savanah
headline: I liked this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed trying this unique product. Its not like anything I've ever used before. Its a sheer  creamy balm that delivers a dash of color while still looking natural. It blends well with a foundation brush or fingers. I haven't tried it with a beauty blender. I was very pleased at how natural my skin still looked after application and I like that it's buildable. I would repurchase this product and I do recommend it.

author: Stacy
headline: Nice and Sheer
comment: I thought this was a very thoughtful product as this was nice and light. I appreciated how sheer this was and how it felt on. I could barely tell I had put anything on my face. It was a nice smooth feel and I will absolutely continue using it. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

author: Brandy
headline: Do-it-all skin in one swipe
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This multitasking sheer tint is an instant skin enhancer and a long-term skin booster. It glides on like a lightweight tinted moisturizer, evening out tone while giving the complexion a healthy, luminous finish. What sets it apart is the skincare-infused formula that doesn't just make skin look good right away—it actively works to improve it over time.

With true four-in-one benefits, it helps smooth the appearance of fine lines, supports firmer-looking skin, and keeps moisture locked in from morning to night. The hydration lasts all day without feeling heavy, leaving skin feeling comfortable, refreshed, and naturally radiant. It's the kind of product that simplifies your routine while delivering both makeup and skincare results in one step.

author: Tanya
headline: Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is my go-to for effortless, natural-looking skin. It melts in like skincare, evens out my tone, and leaves a healthy glow without feeling heavy or greasy. Perfect for busy days when I want my skin to look fresh, smooth, and polished with minimal effort.

author: Rachel
headline: Lightweight and long lasting coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a great way to get coverage without the heavy feel of foundation. The balm itself had me a little bit worried about the final shade because it initially looked a little more golden hued than I normally use, and I was worried about oxidation as the day went on. However, the balm blended really well on my skin and felt really light and not greasy at all. The pot that it was in was easy to scoop the product out of, and is going to be great for actually being able to use all of it. It lasted the entire day and didn't oxidize at all on my face. I was very impressed.

author: Erica
headline: Good for days when you want to feel airy
comment:
Love how bouncy and light this product is. Feels great on and blends well, especially under the eye area. 
Love the multiple array of shades to choose from and that the packaging is easy to travel with. Would also be a good product for younger skin as well.

author: J
headline: Feels greasy and looks dry and flaky!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So many negatives with this product. I've had other face products from this brand so I felt confident in my shade selection. This applies much lighter than it appears in the pot. It felt so smooth and hydrating yet clung to every pore and made my skin look flaky and dry. Horrible coverage. Even in the right shade I can't see this looking good. It gave polkadot pores, which is not usually an issue for me. Truly a terrible product that felt greasy and looked dry.

author: Maria
headline: Yes
comment: It provides very natural coverage that evens out the skin tone without feeling heavy. The creamy texture glides on smoothly and leaves the skin feeling soft and comfortable. It feels very pleasant on the skin, and the scent is light and not overpowering.

author: Samantha
headline: Nice sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this. It's easy to use. Blends easily. Packaging is good although i wish it was a little bigger due to my brush size. Finish looks like a satin finish on my skin. Don't think you could wear this if you have oily skin

author: Tylee
headline: Great summer foundation!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It has very light coverage that pretty much just evens out skin tone. It feels sort of soft and liquid like but is a cream. It's a great product for anyone looking for something light and easy to apply with your hands. Definitely a good summer foundation!

author: JB
headline: Nice and natural
comment: Smooth, lightweight tint that feels like skincare not makeup. Love how it adds a fresh, natural glow and evens skin without feeling heavy. Great for everyday, doesnt make me oily by end of day at all!

author: Maria
headline: Yes
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It provides very natural coverage that evens out the skin tone without feeling heavy. The creamy texture glides on smoothly and leaves the skin feeling soft and comfortable. It feels very pleasant on the skin, and the scent is light and not overpowering.

author: Blair
headline: This is the best foundation/serum/balm I've ever used
comment: This is my new favorite product and I will never EVER touch another foundation again. I am blown away at all of the benefits! This is the only product I used, no moisturizer! It has built in serum that makes your skin look and feel amazing. My arm is very light toned compared to my face but the color "Light Neutral 210" matches my face tone perfectly with no lines or weird orange hues. It takes about 15 minutes to feel "settled" but it makes your face have a glowy, natural and put together look all day. The packaging has a luxury feel and the jar fits perfectly in your hand when applying.

author: Jessica
headline: Easy to blend tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Blends on like a dream - it really melts into the skin and has luminosity which I prefer to shimmer. The coverage is light and the consistency thin so it can be buildable. Easy to wear!

author: Hope
headline: Wonderful balm
comment: This is a wonderful face balm. Its the first one Ive ever used. It feels very lightweight. It goes on very smooth. The medium  shade works perfectly for my skin. It actually covers my red spots on my face. Definitely worth a try. I'll continue to buy for sure.

author: Jessica
headline: Beautiful finish!

author: Kristen
headline: Nice lightweight skin tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I do really enjoy this skin tint. For reference, since there are pictures, I got the shade "fair cool." I feel like the color match is great for me. This balm blends easily into the skin and creates a seamless look.
 I'm not someone who usually wears a full coverage foundation, so this is perfect to just even out my skin tone. If I do have any redness or spots that need extra covering, i find it's easy to just get a little extra and cover what needs covering. have used a brush to apply this, and i think that method works great. I hate having stuff on my hands. So, rather than having to go wash my hands after I apply this, i think it's way easier to use a brush. Plus, I found the coverage to be really good and what I wanted with the brush, so there is no need to try another method when the brush works great. 
After you first apply this, you definitely can still feel it on your skin for the first five or so minutes, kind of like a serum/slick feel. But the balm does sink in, and I did not find a need to apply powder. I don't like powering my whole face since my skin is on the dry side powder can make it look/feel dryer. My skin did feel nice throughout the day using this product. I didn't notice any dryness or uncomfortable feeling when I wore the skin tint. 
This does include a lot of skincare ingredients, which is great. I do have a dedicated skincare regimen which includes some of the ingredients in the skin tint (hyaluronic acid, etc.) So I don't imagine this product would make huge improvements in my skin versus what I already do. But if you were someone who didn't use much skincare, I could see it possibly improving your skin.
 Overall, i think this is a nice product. It could even be a one and done on days when you don't feel like doing your skincare. Well, almost, there's no sunscreen in here, so please add that. But this is a great lightweight skin tint, lots of good ingredients, and nice light buildable coverage. I like it a lot.

author: Marium
headline: Balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
This is one of those products I reach for when I want my skin to look healthy without feeling like I'm wearing makeup. The balm texture feels rich at first, but it melts instantly into the skin and becomes lightweight once blended. It doesn't sit on top or feel greasy, which surprised me for a balm formula.

The coverage is very sheer and natural. It doesn't hide imperfections completely, but it softens redness and evens out my skin tone just enough to give that "your skin but better" look. I love this for casual days or when I want a fresh, minimal base that still looks polished.

What really stands out is the finish. It gives a smooth, hydrated glow that makes my skin look plump and comfortable throughout the day. My skin never feels tight or dry while wearing it, and it layers well with concealer and cream products without breaking apart.

This isn't for full coverage lovers, but if you enjoy lightweight, skin-focused makeup that blurs the line between skincare and makeup, this balm does exactly what it promises. It's easy, effortless, and perfect for everyday wear when you want your skin to breathe while still looking put together.

I will say thatI wish it might've had a little bit more coverage as well as as a doings. Overall, I did like it though.

author: Valerie
headline: Great tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a sheer light feeling tinted face balm that actually has pretty great coverage it feels super soft and silky on my skin and melts like butter into it

Does cling a bit to dry patches so you will want to prep skin well before application. I received this item in exchange for my honest review.

author: Beauty fanatic
headline: Wow!
comment: Over 66. Probably one of the best foundations I've ever used, you do get enough coverage, goes on with a nice glow and healthy look.

author: Lil0me

author: freya
headline: No-makeup makeup product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love how lightweight  and effortlessly radiant this face balm feels on my skin. My shde is fair warm 120, and it wears nature. It delivers sheer, buildable coverage that beautifully blurs imperfections while still letting my natural skin shine through — perfect for a fresh, everyday look without the heaviness of a traditional foundation. The formula feels incredibly hydrating thanks to its skincare-rich base with hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides, and vitamin E, leaving my skin feeling soft and plump all day long. Blending is a breeze (just fingertips or a brush), and it melts into the skin seamlessly for a natural glow that doesn't look cakey. It's become my go-to "no-makeup makeup" product!

author: Cari
headline: Sheer Tint Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure at first what to think of the color from how it looked in the container. Once I put it on my skin I really liked it. It is quite a nice tint. It gave me that little bit of extra color I felt I was missing in the winter. It was a bit more sheer than I was expecting, but I just added a bit more to achieve the color I wanted.

author: Audrey
headline: My favorite new product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Easy application, very smooth, hydrating, feels absolutely amazing on my face, helps cover spots and wrinkles. In love with this product. I highly recommend this product and brand.

author: Laurenee
headline: Natural coverage and comfortable on skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used foundation brush for the product and it feels cool to the touch on my face which was pleasant. And it feels weightless. I think I can layer it by applying more on the areas that needed more coverage.  Overall I liked the natural coverage that blends with my skin. My face was comfortable while wearing it, so it wasn't irritating or anything which is  great. Maybe it has balm like moisturizing effect. I just wish it came with a puff or applicator just like k-beauty foundation cushions.

author: Morgan

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Although this product looks dark on my pale hands, it blended into my skin seamlessly. I felt like the buildable coverage was key. There's also no odor to the product. I only gave this 4 stars for 2 reasons - I wish there was an SPF aspect and because it wasn't that hydrating overall.

author: Tracy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product goes on really smooth- it's not full coverage but it worked really well to cover the darkness under my eyes. Doesn't seem to crease either which I feel like a lot of products I try under my eyes end up doing. It feels very light weight and I would say almost hydrating feeling.

author: Ash
headline: Good but I'm not in Love
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product feels so good! The texture is soft and smooth. It feels good on the skin. The coverage is buildable and not heavy. I think this product would work great for all skin types-textured to aging skin. 
Unfortunately the color does not work well with my skin tone.

author: Shelly
headline: Beauty in a bottle
comment: Coverage is unbelievable! Great product. Color matches well.Stayed on all day. Little goes a long way. The package is easy to use and easy to put away.

author: Kathy
