author: Melissa
headline: I will be purchasing and using this
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This doll it all face balm is a game changer for me. I love how lightweight it feels on my face. Cover amazinling well. It blends easily with a brush or makeup sponge. It lasts all day. I like the container it's in. Its very easy to open and apply with a sponge or brush.

author: Adrianne
headline: Light, effortless coverage with skincare benefits!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm is a beautifully natural, everyday tint that blurs imperfections while keeping skin looking fresh and radiant. The sheer coverage smooths tone and brightens without feeling heavy or cakey — perfect for days when you want a polished, minimal makeup look. It applies easily with fingers or a brush, hydrates without sliding, and layers nicely under powder. The formula feels comfortable all day and gives a soft, skin-like finish that's ideal for everyday wear. A great pick for anyone who loves low-effort, luminous skin!

author: Sophia
headline: Good buy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a game-changer! It's a 4-in-1 tinted omoisturizer that transforms skin instantly and over time, providing sheer, buildable coverage with a radiant finish. Made with 92% skincare ingredients, including Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen Peptide, and Vitamin E, it's perfect for those seeking a natural, effortless look.

author: M
headline: Review
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm works well. It applies nicely, blends well and covers well too. It feels good on my skin and wasn't drying after use.

author: Svitlana
headline: I like this product and buy again.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product! The texture is very lightweight, smooth, and creamy, making it easy to apply and blend. It melts beautifully into the skin and gives a natural, sheer coverage without feeling heavy or greasy.
The scent is subtle and pleasant, and it feels very comfortable and nourishing on the skin throughout the day.
It's perfect for evening out the skin tone, adding a healthy glow, and keeping the skin hydrated while looking natural and fresh. Definitely a go-to for everyday use ✨

author: Jen
headline: Unique Tinted Solid Serum To Hydrate & Provide Coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cosmetics  is the perfect balance of being lightweight, hydrating and offering sheer, buildable coverage to match my skin tone. It is very unique in that it comes in a solid serum and melts instantly on contact with my skin so that it spreads out seamlessly and evenly without a greasy or cakey look. I absolutely love that I no longer need to apply a serum or a moisturizer prior to using a skin tint. This product also does a wonderful job of minimizing the look of my fine lines and age spots and leaves my skin looking more radiant and youthful.

author: Nikki
headline: Skincare and makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great make up. I love the fact that it is skin care and make up. It goes. I'm very small does not leave a cakey residue. You can barely tell. I even have a make up. I wish it came with an applicator, but I was able to apply it Easily with a sponge very thin, but you don't need a lot. The shade is perfect.

author: Sarah
headline: Great face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT cosmetics face balm is great. I like the fact that it is sheer yet offers enough coverage to hide imperfections. The texture is light and gives you a glowy look. It is easy to remove. I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Julisa1988
headline: Awesome balm
comment: I'm loving this balm it has just enough coverage, A little goes a long way I really enjoy using it with a brush and looks really nice. It has a super creamy texture, medium coverage, with great skincare ingredients. I received this product in exchange for my honest review

author: Nicole
headline: Great face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice and light and the color is perfect. No scent at all and goes on smoothly. I love how it is not liquid but goes in like a bb cream. I would recommend this 100%

author: Katisa
headline: Your skin, but with a healthier glow
comment: What truly sets this product apart is its practicality and lightweight feel. It instantly revives dull skin, giving it a much more supple and revitalized appearance. Unlike other tinted products that can accentuate dry patches, this balm glides on like a moisturizer, making it the perfect "emergency" product to keep in your bag and reapply without worrying about it looking heavy. It's a fantastic option for those who prioritize skin barrier health, because although its ability to conceal blemishes is minimal, its blurring effect and satin finish make the skin look flawless in a very natural and effortless way.

author: Thuy Ci
headline: It helps your skins more softer, moistures, brighter
comment: I feel I loom younger than my aged after I applied this serum on my face and my hands. My dried skin look way softer, moisture , and brighter. This serum has no sense so it's good for people has a sensitive smell. It's small and easy to carry with you around to use any time for busy people like me.  Quick applied and keep it all day long. Easy to remove with your face cleanser.

author: Nikki
headline: Smooth and creamy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very smooth and creamy formula. A barely there sheer finish that goes on super smooth. Easy to wear and apply. The color match is a little too dark for my skin.

author: Kris
headline: Use a brush!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face balm and it was an interesting consistency. At first, I tried to apply it with my hand, which I did not like once I put it on the brush. It was much easier to distribute. it did leave a glow and not greasy feeling.

author: Trish
headline: Its good, I would buy it again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think this balm is more for dry skin, but any type of skin can use it , is so hydrating, minimize imperfections, when you took pictures looks grate, it transfers easily, if you have a cold or allergy don't recommend, because easy get down with the tissue

author: Jess
headline: I say grab it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics is always a number 1 in my book and this new DO IT ALL sheer tint face balm has not fallen short! I love how it feels on my skin! I can throw it on and not have to add anything else on top. It makes for the perfect product when you don't feel like putting on a ton of makeup or as a base to start your makeup.

author: Rachel
headline: Super easy sheer tint for a natural, fresh "your skin but be
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this sheer tint balm for quick, everyday makeup. It feels lightweight but still gives my skin a smoother, more even look with a natural finish. The texture is creamy and blends easily with fingers, and it doesn't feel heavy or greasy once it sets. The coverage is definitely sheer, but it helps blur and even out my complexion in a way that looks fresh and skin-like. Perfect for days when I want something simple and glowy without doing a full face.

author: Sarai
headline: Feels good on my skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was little skeptical of this product, I was worried that it was going to be to oily and break me out. I have combination skin and this worked perfectly on my skin. It gave me a dewy glow but without leaving my skin oily. The coverage is just like a tinted moisturizer. I would recommend it for anyone looking for light to medium coverage.

author: Jody
headline: Perfect shade
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how smoothly this product goes on my skin. The colour is a great match for my fair skin and it doesn't feel heavy or like it's sitting on top of my skin

author: Misa
headline: Easy to apply, blend in well, amazingly smooth.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The package is compact which is convenient for carrying in my purse. I used my finger and a brush to apply the sheer tint. Fave balm onto my face to see which method is better. I think both are applicable, however, using a brush would give me more of even the distribution. When I first put the sheer tiny face balm on I was very surprised to see how well it blend into my face. After I let it sit for a bit, my face seems very smooth, skin tone is even out. No chalky, for moldy looking face!! I'm loving it!

author: Tanya
headline: Sheer but Evens Out Skintone
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is definitely a sheer product, as the description states. As you can see in the photos, the freckle on my hand is noticeable in both pictures (with and without the product). It did blend in really well on my face and provide a slight evening of my skintone, but it accentuated some dryness around my nose. I experienced no irritation and while I usually prefer more coverage, this is a nice option for days when you don't need a full face.

author: Nancy
headline: Super sheer and lovely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I love this stuff! Just what I have been looking for- just a little coverage and a lot of smoothing. I add a bit of shimmer to it for my cheeks for a little extra

author: Nancy
headline: Super sheer and lovely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I love this stuff! Just what I have been looking for- just a little coverage and a lot of smoothing. I add a bit of shimmer to it for my cheeks for a little extra

author: Nancy
headline: Super sheer and lovely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I love this stuff! Just what I have been looking for- just a little coverage and a lot of smoothing. I add a bit of shimmer to it for my cheeks for a little extra

author: D
headline: Lightweight with a beautiful, natural finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used the IT Cosmetics CC cream for years. It's great, but it can be a little too full-coverage. This balm has just enough coverage to even out skin tone, but it feels like nothing on the skin. It's like a tinted moisturizer with a little more oomph in the color. Since it's a balm, you only need the tiniest amount so it doesn't have the tackiness a moisturizer formula can sometimes have. It's so lightweight, it doesn't build up in pores or fine lines. There's no noticeable scent unless you really put your nose right over the container, then it has kind of a medicinal scent. I prefer unscented foundations, so this is great. 
I applied this with the same IT cosmetics foundation brush I use for the cc cream. I just tapped it in the pot and it blended out flawlessly. You can build it up a little, but it's perfect for light coverage. I had to apply it three times on my hand to build it up enough for a noticeable swatch. I usually get Fair-Light in the CC cream, and I got Fair Cool in the balm. I was concerned it may be too light, but there's a lot of flexibility in the shade since it's more sheer. I was able to apply both a cream contour and a powder blush over the top without pulling up the balm at all. It leaves a beautiful, natural finish.

author: Rainey
headline: Will buy again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little disappointed with the size of the product at first but after using this I realize a little goes a long way. I found it best to apply with a brush and the finish was beautiful. It's lightweight and doesn't feel like I have anything on my face. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and bare. Even though it says it's a sheer face tint, I felt like the coverage was a little more than that. I am very happy with this product and will be using this regularly.

author: Tina
headline: Really good!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I haven't tried very many it cosmetics products in the past. I must say this sheer tint face balm is quite impressive. It has a super soft, creamy texture that blended very easily into my skin. Just smoothed everything out without looking like I tried. I would say a medium coverage for me. Left a nice, subtle glow. Love that it contains skin care ingredients, and bonus, no bad scent . Would definitely repurchase.

author: Gina
headline: Like skin care
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have this in light neutral but I think it's a little too dark for my complexion. I'm usually a light neutral in other brands so I was a little surprised. Looking at the other lighter shades, the pictures online look like it could be too light for me. Besides the shade, I think it applies beautifully on my skin. Didn't feel like it was too sheer though. I applied with a brush. The product literally melts into my skin. I would definitely wear this more in the summer as I'll be sweating and wouldn't want anything too heavy. This would be perfect.

author: Helen
headline: Recommended
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT Cosmetics and this new tinted face balm is perfect for a quick make up routine and on the go for touch ups. It blends really well, coverage is 100%, and non shiny. Long lasting with clean ingredients. I would recommend it.

author: DrKay
headline: Sheer blurring coverage with gorgeous feel AND serum benefit
comment:
I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review. Of note, it is light warm and I am a fair neutral, so slight yellowy look where my skin sags a bit, but with how sheer, still workable, great for my dark circles, and probably for summer!

Overall, I love it. It is VERY sheer, but blurring. It has a tiny amount of glitter in it which I am not a fan of, yet has a very light natural finish/feel. If you have very dry skin, it may stick to patches more, but only an issue if you don't moisturize first or isn't shade matched, and with its serum benefits will likely help resolve them. It did not feel greasy or oxidize through the day, and my sensitive skin has not broken out!

I will be purchasing in a better winter shade as I just love how it feels on my skin, that it offers actual skincare benefits, and gives a no effort no makeup look with gentle tone evening which I need. 

It Cosmetica is also known for using sensitive-friendly ingredients and natural mineral colorants, so I can trust my sensitive skin to the brand. Absolutely recommend.

author: Sue
headline: Very helpful
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was overall a nice to tint! It's very light and subtle! The texture is good and I like how it also has ingredients that are helpful for your skin! Very glowy! I would recommend this product if you need a light tint!

author: Julie
headline: Glides on the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is very creamy and melts into the skin. It's the perfect easy light coverage. It covers redness and evens skin out. Comes in a glass jar. I applied with a flat kabuki brush.

author: Rachel
headline: Love this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product it is light and it blends in well. It also matched my skin so well and covered redness. The packaging is super cute but it is glass so makes me a little worried that the co trainer will break. It also washed off with no issue.

author: Courtney
headline: I love it but is it necessary, eh
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love IT products, they are my to go to products for all my foundation needs. This was my first time using a face balm. I gave it three stars because I don't really think it's necessary in your day to day makeup regimen. The color gives a slight glow as you can see in my picture but I would require a lot of this product to get a full coverage. I read about face balms and they're supposed to be like a moisturizer base but like I said I would need a decent amount of this product to get the coverage I like to see on my face. I don't see myself using this product again in my foundation regime

author: Karina
headline: Great for natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smooth tinted face palm. Product was nice and creamy and easy to apply. This is sheer but tinted. Great for a natural no makeup look. Did leave face looking flawless and did cover some flaws on the face.

author: Tara
headline: Smooth and creamy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how smooth and creamy this product is. It didn't cause me any breakouts or it didn't seem to crease after hours of wear like some makeup does. It also didn't have a strong smell. I just wish it was more my color ! I think I will purchase in my color.

author: Yanka
headline: Perfect everyday skin tint
comment: I really love this sheer tint balm. It feels very light on the skin, blends easily, and gives a natural, healthy glow without looking heavy. It evens out my skin tone and makes my face look fresh and hydrated. Perfect for everyday makeup when I want something quick, comfortable, and natural. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Rebecca
headline: My new favorite product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is amazing for the days I don't want to wear a full face of makeup. It's a rich color and blends perfectly to my skin!! Super lightweight and lasts all day. I have never used face balm before but will totally be using this in the future. Very bendable and such easy application. In love!

author: Lacey
headline: A must try!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the bomb! It is a 4-in-1 tinted moisturizer that looks and feels awesome on your skin while providing the benefits of multiple serums. It combines skincare with buildable coverage and looks great on your skin as it works its magic. Personally, I've struggled with a love/hate relationship with Ilia tinted serum and hoped this would be better. Do It All Sheer Tint Face Bomb wins hands down.  Better coverage, better feel on my skin, no weird smell, no peeling up during application, and it is packed with hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides, and vitamin E. This is my new go-to "foundation".

author: Amanda
headline: Covers nicely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by this face tint.  At first I thought it was going to be too dark and look funny on my, however after I got it to fully cover my face, it evened out at skin tone so nicely.  It toned down the red as well.  It is very light weight and I cannot even tell I applied it.  Honestly I'm not a fan of the round container it comes in because it is hard to get out and gets under your forger nails.  I personally prefer and tube or anything that I don't have to stick my finger in. All in all thought, I'm very happy!

author: Danielle
headline: Good product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this makeup.  The color was a little off for my skin tone but I just added blush after and it was fine. Covered all my imperfections without looking like I had makeup caked to my face. Went on very smooth and even.

author: Michelle
headline: Impressed  but not full coverage.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really excited to try this from it cosmetics! This sheer  tint is basically that, it is a very sheer tint. I was having issues trying to show the color on my phone. I personally love this because I am more into tinted skin tints. This face balm really gives me very very little cover coverage while making my face look even. It's really unnoticeable on my skin. It blended beautifully right in. It does not lay down matte, so you will need to set it.  I really like this. 

If you are looking for full face coverage- this is not it. This is really sheer. I'm using the shade: FAIR COOL 125.

author: Emily
headline: Sheer, buildable coverage
comment: I received this product complimentary for my honest review. When I first opened the package, I was surprised how big the container is. It contains 0.63 ounces which will last quite a long time. This product gives a natural finish. Not only does it provide great sheer and buildable coverage but it also contains ingredients that helo improve your skin long tern. It is very hydrating and I immediately noticed how it minimized my fine lines and wrinkles. It would be great for both younger and older people. I highly recommend this product. Thank you for giving me the opportunity to test and review this product. I am very grateful!

author: Kr
headline: Good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm to review and it's definitely a nice foundation balm. It does pull a little warm, so you will have to work on it if it's too warm for you. It does blend out nicely. It did wear off a little bit around my nose and tea zone where I am most oily. I do like if there is no scent to it.

author: LouAnn
headline: Blends great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this.  Rarely do i wear foundation because it doesn't blend or match my skin tone.  This was perfect! Blends well and you can't tell your wearing it.

author: Amanda
headline: Definitely a staple for me now
comment:
I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Balm for several days now and I'm honestly impressed. It's one of those products that actually lives up to the "multi-use" claim.

The texture is super creamy and melts into the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. I use it mostly on dry areas, cuticles, lips, and even lightly under my eyes when my skin feels tight — especially on trentinoin nights when everything feels extra dry. It gives instant comfort and makes my skin look healthier right away. The coverage is great and it's easy to wash away. 

What I love most is that it doesn't just sit on top of the skin. It actually absorbs and leaves my skin soft and hydrated for hours. A little goes a long way, and it layers well over skincare without pilling.

Perfect to keep in your bag for dry winter skin, post-handwashing dryness, or anytime your skin needs a quick refresh. The packaging is perfect for on the go! Definitely a staple for me now.

author: Cindy
headline: Sheer and weightless
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of this balm is very sheer and melts into your skin easily. It has light coverage that isn't that buildable, so if you need to cover up a blemish you'll have to use a concealer with it. It really does feel like your skin but better and looks natural on. I would say that it does not cake or settle into lines as drastically as a traditional foundation would. I wear it all day and it feels like nothing is on my skin. For those that don't wear much foundation like me, this is the perfect formula. Literally weightless but enough to even out your skin tone a little.

author: sarry
headline: love it
comment: I absolutely love this. It goes on smoothly and honestly, a little bit goes a long way. The texture is amazing and it doesn't feel cakey. It last super long.

author: Brandice
headline: Nice Sheer Coverage, But Prep Is Key
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm gives a really pretty, natural finish and is great for light, everyday coverage. It blends well and evens out my skin without feeling heavy. That said, it is a little drying on its own. I definitely need to moisturize well before applying it, otherwise my skin doesn't feel as hydrated as I'd like. Once my skin is prepped properly, it looks nice and wears well, but it's not something I'd use without a good moisturizer underneath.

author: Jennifer
headline: IT Cosmetics Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try a new face tint but was majorly disappointed with this one. When trying to apply it just felt like it was sliding all over my face and wouldn't stick. I tried dusting in some setting powder and it didn't help. I even tried the baking method with no improvement. The product feels like it sitting on top of my skin and moves around. The coverage is okay but it also settles in the fine lines and makes them more obvious. I've had it on for about 3 hours at this point and it's already getting patchy and looks like it's separating.

author: Danielle
headline: Natural finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade is a little dark for me so I'm not basing my score on the shade match. Formula wise this is gorgeous. A light amount of coverage and a healthy glow. Easy to blend and wears nicely. I can see myself reaching for this a lot for busy days when I just want to even my skin tone a bit.

author: Jennifer
headline: This Sheer Tinted Face Balm really "Does It All"
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The words "Do It All" pretty much sums up the amazing finsh to this soft, silky tinted face balm that leaves my face feeling hydrated, with a full coverage effect. It felt weightless on my skin and felt like silk when applying it to my face. I thought it would be a primer base but instead it ended up being all the coverage I needed!! The packaging is eye catching with the words "Do It All" in the name, and it actually does!!

author: Natalie
headline: Feels nice, but I need a lighter shade
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade is a little dark but easy to sheer out. I really like the feel of it and that it is easily to blend. I wish I had a lighter shade, but this works really well with my other products and looks natural. It hold up without touch up for my whole 12 hour work shift.

author: Christa
headline: Wow wow wow!!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am truly blown away by this product. When I tell you that I have about 40 foundations, I'm not lying. I am a foundation snob. I love trying different foundations. It's my favorite part about makeup. Today I was absolutely floored. This looks like my skin, but perfect. I would say it's a light to medium coverage skin like finish, not settling into any lines or pores. It is literal magic in a jar. I can't stop looking at my skin in the mirror in awe. I did prep my skin with the confidence in a cream moisturizer by it cosmetics and applied the skin balm with my fingertips. I'm hoping this foundation has a good wear time.

author: Laur
headline: Great for your skin and great coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was hesitant at first about this It Cosmetics tinted skin balm because it initially felt a little greasy when I touched it. But it went on super smoothly when applied and almost absorbed into my skin. The coverage was great and I love that it is buildable so in certain spots on my face that need a little more coverage I can do that. I was so impressed with all the skin benefiting ingredients that are in this so you feel good about applying it! There are so many shades too that I can get another for summer when my skin is a little darker.

author: Kim
headline: Natural looking
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I really loved this It cosmetics sheer face balm. It was the perfect match for my skin tone, it gives a natural, sheer glow that evens out my complexion without feeling heavy or greasy. It is also lightweight, which I love. Perfect for everyday wear

author: Kristin
headline: Lovely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is super nice. It's not too much and leaves a light tint and makes you feel flawless and beautiful without having to pack on makeup everyday. I absolutely love that cause I don't wear makeup everyday especially when I work. The packaging is super nice comes in a glass container and it's perfect to carry with you. I love it

author: CC
headline: Would repurchase!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So, you will receive this product and you will notice it is in a glass jar that feels nice and easy to open.  When you first open the lid, some oxidation of color may be apparent, but that disappears after first use.  My first swatch the color seems a bit off, though I suspect it is anyway because I did not go into store to color match which I think is the consumers responsibility, however, the brand should be held accountable to getting the undertones correct!  I have had some from other purchases that were way off.  This is not the case here.  I have light-OLIVE- Neutral skin tone and usually purchase neutral shades because my skin tone is typically impossible to match due to the olive.  I will say this light neutral shade in this sheer tint face balm is pretty close.  Now, outside of the shade, the product feels sooooo silky, but not greasy.  I do not typically use powder over my base because I have pretty dry skin, and so far I have no creases, and it feels amazing on my skin!  I set it with a bit of setting spray, and it has lasted pretty well throughout the day. Again, I do not set with powder, so the lasting power with just setting spray was pretty incredible for my dry skin.  I typically start to get the "dry" feeling on my face mid day, but not so far with this product!  From a coverage perspective, it covered my redness, but did not fully cover my dark spots, which I am not dissatisfied because this is a SKIN TINT.  Furthermore, it did layer well and was buildable to do a better job of covering that up.  I did not smell any fragrance with this product naturally sitting on my skin. Over all I am very very very pleased with this product and the way my skin looks after applying.

author: Felicia
headline: Why
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 41 and have fine lines, wrinkles, large pores and very dry skin. If you have any of those, don't bother. It really didn't even help with my coloring either. It felt like it would be moisturizing of my finger. However it went on matte. I really wanted this to work :/

author: Lisa
headline: Silky soft skin tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect, lightweight skin tint. It goes on very smooth and has a creamy texture. It blended well with my skin tone and my skin felt very soft after applying. This is definitely something I will use when I want to even out my face, but don't want to do a full makeup application.  Overall, I feel the color was a perfect match and the formula was silky soft. 
I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion

author: Amanda
headline: My skin approves!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this stuff. I stopped wearing face makeup because it's usually too heavy and my skin hates it. This is very light and doesn't feel like I have anything on. I'm able to quickly cover up problem area and it disappears into my skin, matching just right. It lasts all day and doesn't come off on my clothes!

author: Peaches985
headline: Great for light makeup days!
comment:
Very sheer but buildable skin tint. The color sent to me matched my skin tone perfectly (fair-light neutral with peachy undertones). It had no noticable scent. The packaging was a little difficult to get the.prodixt out with long fingernails, but it melted nicely once warmed with a few swirls of my fingers and applied nicely with just my hands. Weartime after completing my makeup routine was excellent, with just a tiny bit of separation around the edge of the bottom of my nose (after several hours). Does not feel heavy on the face at all. I would recommend this product for lighter makeup days. 

I was sent this product for free for my honest review.

author: Michele
headline: Take me any where size, Huge Coverage
comment: Great size to slip in a small purse or travel makeup bag. Don't let the size fool you. It provides great coverage with no greasy residue. Many shades to match your skin. No scent. Stays a long time.

author: Bri
headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Highly satisfied with the lightweight feel of this product. Blends easily and translucent enough to feel natural while still providing good coverage.

author: MaanP
headline: I love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this for more than a week, and I really enjoy it. My skin type is mixed, and I have some fine wrinkles and semi-dark circles. I integrate it in after dabbing it on and letting it warm for about a minute. Compared to the hundreds of other foundations I've tried at different price points, this one settles far less, has excellent coverage, and is buildable. A small amount goes a long way! I use the elf setting powder on my T-zone and on top; it works really well!

author: Natalie
headline: Good for natural skin look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade is a little dark but easy to sheer out. I really like the feel of it and that it is easily to blend. I wish I had a lighter shade, but this works really well with my other products and looks natural. It hold up without touch up for my whole 12 hour work shift.

author: Maria
headline: Great product!!!
comment: I love this face balm so much. It feels very light on the skin, hydrates well, and blends easily. The coverage is natural and gives a healthy glow without looking heavy. It is perfect for everyday wear.

author: Ling Ling
headline: Good product!
comment: First time trying the product. Love the shade. It fits very well with my skin tone. It is minimal coverage of natural look. It is good for everyday use. It is not heavy and easy to apply. Long wear! It stays on my face for the whole day. Will buy it next time.

author: Danielle
headline: Very light and sheer, but doesn't last
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I included photos of my skin before I applied, right after, and two hours after. You can see that the coverage is very light and covers some redness. Unfortunately, it settled into my pores and did not stay on my skin for very long. If it didn't settle, I might use it for short grocery store trips, but as is…I wouldn't use it or recommend it. The texture is nice and it does go on smoothly, it didn't dry out my skin or cause it to be oily.

author: Melissa
headline: 5 stars- new go to face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am really pleased with this face balm! It gives nice natural coverage which is not heavy or cakey while still helping to even out skin. I have used it alone when I'm looking for a nice natural look and used mineral powder over to build coverage when I'm looking for more of a high coverage look. I am really picky and have tried many face balms, creams and foundations and generally have always gone back to only using powder. This product has made me a convert! It also has hyaluronic acid and collagen peptide which help to smooth fine lines and wrinkles, which is amazing as not only does it give coverage but helps fight signs of skin aging. It also has vitamin E and left my dry skin feeling moisturized. Definitely recommend and plan to try more products from this line!

author: Sylvia
headline: Subtle
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As you can see in the picture the color was perfect. Needed to be blended but on my face it worked well. The coverage is very minimal but just right for on the go . I am more of a medium coverage lady but I still quite liked it. It blended well into my skin after applying a primer. Gave me zero pores on my nose but didn't cover any redness. Wore beautiful throughout the day without making me greasy.

author: Michelle
headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If never used a skin tint like this before so I wasn't sure what to expect. The shade was perfection. The wear and performance was nice not a heavy feeling like I thought it would be. Lasted all day. Didn't look at the ingredients but it didn't seem to bother my skin.

author: Veronika
headline: My rating 4/5
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product wins you over with its versatility — it can be used as a concealer, a foundation, and I've even seen girls use it as a bronzer. The texture is quite dense and offers good coverage. It wears well for about six hours.

For me, it applies a bit too heavily, but that may be because I don't moisturize my skin enough beforehand. Because of the packaging, I initially thought it wouldn't last long, but the product is actually very economical — you need only a small amount.

The packaging is beautiful and convenient, and the finish is matte.

It feels comfortable on the skin, absorbs well, and doesn't transfer. However, for dry or combination skin it may feel a bit heavy, as it lacks additional moisturizing properties.

author: Marina
headline: Creamy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Feels very creamy. Very light weight on face with minimal coverage. Great for when I don't want any make up but need to tone down my redness. Skin feels soft after use.

author: Susan
headline: A new must have
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im loving it Sheer Tint Face Balm. It's 92% skincare serum. It blends in very well. Leaves your face with a smooth finish. Its very easy to apply and it don't take much. No ugly residue. Easy to remove as well. With a makeup wipe or with warm water and a little soap. Easy

author: Kaida
headline: Too Heavy on Maturing Skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited about this product. I'm almost 40 and it's definitely showing in my skin. This face balm has a surprising amount of coverage. The look of it isn't too bad when I dont put too much on. It can look cakey if you put on too much, as with any product. I received the color fair warm which is slightly on the orange side for my olive skin. I wanted to like this but it looks a little too heavy on my skin.

author: Tara
headline: Decent
comment: I think this is a decent product, I like that the packaging is small and it has decent coverage and since it has skin care in it, it has a more natural appearance. There is a bit of a scent but not bothersome and I'd say it has decent lasting power! It's perfect for running errands or if you're in a hurry!

author: Dawn
headline: Great natural balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice light coverage balm that provides hydration with some pigmentation. It is lightweight on the face and blends easily making applications easy as can be! Great for a natural look. I would purchase! I received free in exchange for my honest review!

author: Kelly
headline: Mild coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Mild coverage went on smoothly but slightly drying. Blends well with your skin and wears well but soaks into your skin so hydrate your skin prior to applying it.

author: Nateesha
headline: Awesome
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like how airy this feels. It blends well and it doesn't feel like I have anything in my face at all. Easy to take off. Hydrating almost. Love

author: DM
headline: Love this stuff
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
Love this stuff! The IT Cosmetics Sheer Face Balm is perfect when you want light coverage and don't have a lot of time. It blends super easily, feels lightweight on the skin, and gives a nice healthy glow without looking heavy. It evens out my skin just enough to look fresh and put together. Definitely a go-to for quick, on-the-go makeup days.

author: Nikki
headline: Gorgeous formula
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's beautiful! I got my perfect shade! It blends nicely. Doesn't settle into lines or pores. It makes my dry skin look hydrated! It looks like skin! It's beautiful!

author: McKenzie
headline: Smooth Application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 39 and have combination skin with occasional acne. I liked the balm, it matched my skin color perfectly. The texture is smooth and silky. The packaging is nice too. It went on pretty smoothly just with my fingers. I did moisturized my skin before applying. It didn't make my skin texture look worse which a lot of these balms do by forming those flaky balls. I would say the coverage is very sheer, maybe a slight noticeable difference when I have it on vs bare skin. It doesn't cover skin texture but has a very slight smoothing effect. It can cover up very slight discoloration under the eyes. Does not cover acne.  I wore it for about 4-5 hours and it still looked good, no pilling and my skin still looked hydrated. It's suppose to visibly firm lines and minimize their look, I don't think I have deep enough ones to say. I would be slightly afraid it might settle in them. It would look really pretty on a 20 something face with minimal texture. But I would still recommend it and I'll will keep using it along with some concealer on days I want more coverage.

author: Stacey
headline: Love this more than I expected to!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I did not expect to love this as much as I do! It goes on so easily and smooth. Matched my neck perfectly. I can't speak on buildability because I wanted a lighter look. I didn't notice any scent which is great. It also didn't cause any irritation.

author: Leticia
headline: So silky and smooth!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Light, sheer tint with skincare benefits—IT Cosmetics Do It All face balm blurs, hydrates, and brightens for a natural, glowing look that's easy to wear daily.

author: Kamini
headline: I recommend this another to buy
comment: This tint conselor is good with soft applications. It has good oil free texture for smooth application with conselor brush. It come in heavy to medium shade for all skin color. It does not clog the pores. Use with finger can also applicable. Love it.

author: Sonia
headline: Not for textured skin or mature skin
comment: It dries very patchy. It highlights every single bit of texture. Surprisingly not hydrating. Will be returning,

author: Abby
headline: A great option!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product surprised me so much. It has medium coverage that is pretty buildable. I love how moisturizing it feels. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because I feel like it could come off really easily and doesn't set the greatest. Otherwise I love it!

author: Stephanie
headline: The best
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] PERFECT this was the best skin tint I have ever tried very buttery and easy to apply to my skin feels very lightweight on my face the application is smooth whether you use a brush, sponge or ur fingers and I love how it has 92 percent skincare serum

author: Stacey
headline: Great for mature skin
comment: I received this in exchange for my honest review. This face balm applies well with both my fingers or a brush.  It seems thick out in the container but quickly sort of melts to become more serum like.  It has light coverage that looks very natural but hides imperfections. It is buildable in the areas that need more coverage.  Not at all cakey. .  It makes you look like you, only better.  It's a slightly radiant finish but without feeling greasy.  It does not settle into fine lines but blurs them to make them less noticeable.  It's more than just makeup- it has collagen and other skincare ingredients that make it hydrating and helps with firming.

author: Kristina
headline: Light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT cosmetics sheer tint balm is so moisturizing. It's light coverage but buildable . The color I received was a perfect match and makes my skin look like a filter . It's great when you want coverage but not a full glam . It's great .

author: Emily
headline: Sheer but effective
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is sheer so if you are looking for medium or full coverage this isn't for you. But this was great for me to throw on for a weekend running errands. It gave me enough coverage to leave the house. It was easy to apply with just my fingers and blended right in. Super lightweight on my face so felt like I wasn't wearing anything!

author: Samantha
headline: Very lightweight coverage and dewy finish
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review Here are my before and after pictures showing the beautiful finish of this tint balm. The coverage is light but flawless and easy to apply. It's very lightweight. I would highly recommend this product and will be purchasing this again.

author: Kris
headline: Nice but not for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I honestly loved the way this felt. It went on super smooth. It felt lightweight in my skin and I could even keep it in my bag and put it on in a pinch which is great. I was disappointed when I looked in the mirror and it seemed to make the lines in my forehead and around my eyes which I don't feel are super noticeable when I didn't have this one. You can see them exaggerated in the picture. I'm still giving it 4 stars, but that is for younger skin. More mature skin I do not think this is a good choice. I don't think I'd purchase it.

author: Ulyana
headline: My new favorite
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been loving this IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for my everyday makeup routine. The texture is so smooth and creamy, and it melts right into my skin with zero effort — I literally apply it with my fingers and I'm done.
It gives the prettiest sheer coverage that evens out my skin tone without looking heavy or cakey. My skin still looks like skin, just healthier and more fresh. I also love that it feels lightweight and hydrating, almost like skincare with a tint, and it never settles into fine lines.
This is perfect for busy mornings when I want to look put together in 2 minutes. Easy, natural, and comfortable to wear all day — I'm officially obsessed

author: Olivia
headline: Not long lasting by pretty!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love how creamy it is and it's really pretty on the face. It's not the longest lasting but that's okay because I don't think it was meant to be very long lasting. I have combo skin and it didn't get too oily.

author: Teri
headline: Perfect coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This "Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm" blends perfectly with my skin tone. It's creamy and goes on smoothly. I apply it once in the morning to my face and the coverage lasts all day. I don't need to reapply it. I appreciate the container that it comes in. It fits nicely into my small travel size makeup bag. This product is a great addition to my daily routine.

author: Nicole
headline: Great
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love IT brand and products. I love this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I love this sheer finish face balm. Great product and quality. Excellent appearance and easy to apply.  No scent.  Lasts all day. Highly recommended.

author: Nadiya
headline: it's a great everyday product for a natural and effortless l
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because it feels very lightweight on my skin. The sheer tint evens out my complexion without looking heavy or cakey. It gives a natural, healthy glow that makes my skin look fresh all day. I appreciate that it hydrates my skin and doesn't settle into fine lines. The balm texture blends easily with fingers and works well for quick makeup days. It's perfect when I want light coverage but still want my skin to look polished.

author: Tre
headline: Excellent coverage!!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 
92% Skincare Serum 

This balm is lightweight with a dewy finish and, surprisingly, hydrating. It applies super smoothly as if it's melting into the skin. It provides buildable coverage, leaving behind a smoother complexion with a natural glowy finish. Excellent product!!

author: Krans
headline: Really natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I thought this would be creamier or thicker and more moisturizing than it is based on the description of it being mostly serum. I am okay with this being a base or foundation rather than skincare, though. You just have to know what you're getting and this will need to be used with moisturizer if you're a dry skin girlie. The coverage is beautiful and buildable, and the finish is super natural and pretty. The fair warm was a perfect match for my NW13 skin.

author: Lauren
headline: Hydrating face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is super hydrating. Love it for my dry 40 year old skin! Probably not a good fit if you're oily at all. I did need to set it with powder, but that's to be expected. Applied super easily and evenly.

author: Mariana
headline: Love this one
comment: I really love this face balm for everyday use. The texture is lightweight, silky, and melts into the skin instantly. It gives a sheer, natural tint that evens out my skin

author: Alicia
headline: Silky and Natural
comment: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. It glides on smoothly and integrates well with my skincare routine. The coverage is lightweight, which I really like. I believe it lasts most of the day on my face and sets nicely. It helps create a smooth, natural look. I also blend this with a full-coverage foundation when I need additional coverage. The shades appear darker but match perfectly once set. There's no residue, and it washes off easily.

author: Andrea
headline: Impressive product that kept my face hydrated
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm pleasantly impressed with this tint face balm. It was easy to use, wasn't heavy and lasted all night. It made my skin feel hydrated and worked well with my other products. I will gladly continue using this product.

author: Trish
headline: I would buy in a correct shade
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary jar from #Influenster@ITCosmetics. I was very excited to try another new IT Cosmetics product. I have used many of their products over the years and have loved them.  The first thing I noticed was how smoothly this glided on. You can use your fingers, brush or sponge. It feels really good on , however I didn't find it had much coverage for me at all.  I'm guessing I most likely needed a darker shade. The shade I received was light/fair.  I will try a darker shade. I think this is a great tool for people who don't like to wear a lot of make up.

author: Angel
headline: Beautiful light coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this tinted face balm, it glides on my skin and blends well with my skin and gives me a beautiful light coverage.  I can use a brush or a sponge to apply it. It is very light but gives you some color. It's easy to remove and doesn't leave your face feeling sticky. I like using it on days where I don't feel like applying much makeup and I noticed that it doesn't dry out my skin.

author: Heidi
headline: Light coverage
comment: I received this item complimentary for my honest review. I used a brush to put in however it did not work well or spread evenly and sponge worked better.

author: Stacey
headline: Skin care/foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mixed feelings with this product. Doesn't cover much but does help with redness of the skin. However you start with decent coverage but since there are skincare products in it you have to rub it in which takes most of said coverage away. Feels nice and refreshing and moisturizing while applying but after about 10 minutes my skin felt very greasy. Not build able either you just rub more skincare into the skin and end up with the same almost not there coverage

author: Gigi
headline: Buy it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the DO IT ALL Sheer Tint Face Balm! It blends effortlessly into my skin and gives such a natural, even finish. The formula is incredibly smooth and lightweight, making it easy to apply without feeling heavy or greasy. It enhances my complexion while still looking like skin. Perfect for everyday wear—I'll definitely be repurchasing!

author: Lisa
headline: Melts like butter
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this sheer tinted balm! It melts under your finger tips and skin.  It's very sheer but can build for more coverage.  Love that it has skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid for moisture and collagen peptides for firmness.  This shade is a tad too warm for me in winter but you can see how it blends and cuts down the redness. (Applied to half my face in light warm).  I love this no makeup-makeup look!

author: Stefanie
headline: Nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product went on really nice and was so easy to blend in.  The shade I got was a good shade match.  I didn't notice any scent with the product.  The packaging is average.  I did have to apply 2 layers to get better coverage.  My other products layered nicely over it.  Doesn't feel like I have anything on my face.

author: Renee
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was not sure that this light crème was going to provide coverage like my liquid. I was pleasantly surprised by the coverage. A little goes a long way. The fair cool was a perfect match. I like that it the light coverage doesn't accentuate my fine lines.

author: Kate
headline: Good
comment: I'm surprised how much  like this. My cheeks flus easily and this covers it in a subtle way. My skin is very sensitive and I can tell this is causing at least some reaction, hence 4 instead of 5 stars. The weight of it is nice and buildable, as advertised. So, so, so many of the reviews are sponsored, and even with sponsorship, they refer to this being better for younger skin. That's not me and my skin has dry spots and this still works. I agree it's likely better on moisturized skin, though. I received this free to review. All opinions are my own.

author: Mtnair
headline: Amazing
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is now one of my favorite base products that I've ever used. I applied it with a brush and it easily melted into the skin and looks extremely natural. I didn't have any streaks and it felt more like skincare than makeup. The color match was basically perfect although it looked much darker in the container. It provides a sheer, buildable coverage that's slightly dewy but not greasy. Essentially undetectable on the skin!

author: Christy
headline: Silky and it blends easily into the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is so silky. It blends very easily and you can just use your fingers to apply it. It has a nice scent and is the perfect compact size to throw in your purse. The coverage is pretty light but it evens out your complexion. I used this today instead of foundation and I feel like it looks like my skin, but better. I don't think I've ever used anything so silky that feels like a luxurious skin care item with the added benefit providing a light coverage to even out my skin tone. I think this is a great tint to have year round. It's especially nice for a low maintenance tint on the go.

author: Kristen
headline: Nice Lightweight face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice product. It blends very easily and it doesn't fee like you are wearing anything. It has a nice creamy texture that makes it easy to blend. I feel like the color was good for my skin tone. It gave me a nice glow. My only concern is that it seemed to make me break out a little bit, but it wasn't terrible. I do think it made me shiny after several hours but my skin is typically more oily.  The color lasted as long as expected- it don't last a full 8 hours but it was reasonable.

author: Melissa
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Definitely not for anyone who has dry skin. I love the concept of it but it just wasn't for me. It is definitely sheer, if you don't really want any coverage this is for you. I don't see how it's hydrating at all, it sticks and makes it extremely noticeable to any dry patches. I could see this being for teenagers that has normal skin that's it.

author: Lindsay
headline: Awesome product
comment: This stuff is awesome. It's hydrating on the face, gives a nice natural coverage and a nice glow to the face. It's not sticky feeling and almost feels like you're not even wearing anything. It covers any imperfections you may have on the face. Loveee

author: JC
headline: Solid balm doesn't leak and is great for travel.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very forgiving way to achieve color on my face. I used color 210 Light Neutral. It was the perfect shade for my skin without a summer tan. Packaged in a small jar, the balm is a solid, but very soft product that melted into my skin. I used my clean fingers and a foundation brush to apply, and found they both were effective. The color was somewhat sheer, but the more I applied, the more coverage I had on dark pigmented areas. It did not settle into my fine lines, and left my skin feeling soft and moisturized. I love that this is a solid balm which I don't have to worry about leaking in my cosmetic bag, and it is perfect for travel. There seems to be a lot of product in the jar.

author: Milian
headline: Love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked the texture; it applies like butter, it's lightweight and has a radiant but very natural finish. The coverage is very light, and the glass bottle feels a bit cheap, but I like it.

author: Shalom
headline: Game changer!
comment: I received this product for a review. Imagine on a rush but still want to look pleasant! So handy, it instantly moisturizes my face and covers my blemishes like I have applied a foundation.

author: Lauren
headline: Perfect for natural, every day wear!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is great for days when I want light coverage with a healthy glow. The texture is creamy but lightweight and blends effortlessly with fingers or a sponge. It evens out redness and smooths the skin without feeling heavy or cakey.

The finish is fresh and dewy, making my skin look hydrated and natural rather than made up. It definitely feels more like skincare than foundation, which I love. Keep in mind the coverage is sheer, so it won't hide blemishes or dark spots on its own, but it layers well with concealer.

Overall, this is a solid choice if you prefer a "your skin but better" look that's comfortable for all day wear.

author: Alicia
headline: Great Dewey thin face tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I first wasn't sure the best way to apply this, it's a very thin texture and tried it with my fingers but that wasn't it, it wasn't even. I read online about it and decided on a good brush, and tried again, this is a great texture and consistency for skin of any kind and even for aging skin. Very thin but buildable. If I repurchase I will probably go down 1 shade but this will be great with some self tan on. It's very moisturizing and leaves your skin glowing!!

author: Jannine
headline: Great product!
comment: I received a sample of Do It it All cosmetic for my honest opinion. I liked that it was very light. It was not greasy. It felt creamy, but was a powder texture. Very good coverage, I really didn't need much.

author: Danielle
headline: Worth the the money
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was sent it cosmeodo it all sheer tint face balm free in exchange for my honest opinion after using it I gave it a 5/5 stars based on texture. The blend ability is amazingly easy, the scent is not strong so it doesn't over take my perfume it's easy to remove. Over all I highly recommend and will continue to use.

author: Amy
headline: Easy to blend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is easy to open. The application is easy and blends nicely. I don't notice a scent. It's not heavy on your face once applied. I would recommend

author: Cassie
headline: Skincare with makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics Do It All balm is unlike any makeup product I've tried before. Just like the name, it is very sheer and weightless on the skin. A little bit goes a long way and it is buildable. I like how this is a skin care product with some color built-in. I tried the shaded light neutral 210. Because this is a balm, the packaging makes it a little challenging to get the product out because you either have to dip your finger into the product or use a brush. I used my finger to warm up the product a bit. I could see myself using this a-lot in the summer to give my skin some life while not feeling weighed down by heavy products.

author: Kristy
headline: Such a great foundation balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love this balm. I've been waiting for It Cosmetics to hit us with something great and this is it! Perfect match shade, it just blends in so easy to the skin and makes your skin look natural! Plus it's 92% skincare!! It's sheer bit it's buildable and plays amazingly with other products on top. Very easy to remove and doesn't stay built up in your pores. Plus it's friendly in fragrance. This is now my favorite light weight foundation that I'm using now! Love it!

author: Naty
headline: My skin is glowing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm does it all! It provides a buildable coverage and contains 92% skincare ingredients. It has the consistency of a balm, but is not sticky and melts right into your skin. It can be applied with a brush or your fingers, and looks great both ways. I love that I can put the container in my handbag without worrying about it spilling. My skin has been dehydrated lately, and this feels so amazing and moisturizing without feeling oily. I have super sensitive skin and this does not irritate it one bit. It's excellent! When you're buying it just remember that it's sheer and buildable; which means it will look darker in the container than on your skin. I was worried when I first saw how dark it looked, but it's not too dark on my face at all.

author: Angela
headline: Loved
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely loved the Do It All Sheer tint face balm. The consistency felt great and it was so easy to apply. It has a buildable coverage and blends very well. It felt great on the skin and didn't sink into wrinkles. Loved it for my aging skin.

author: Cynthia
headline: Sheer face balm
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I received the IT do it all sheer tint face bomb and it is definitely very sheer. The face bomb is very moisturizing and it blends very well with your skin. This would be great to be worn alone or even maybe under foundation I normally like a medium coverage so this will definitely be used when I go to the gym in the morning so my face looks awake. Definitely recommend for those girls that don't need a lot of foundation and want something sheer and natural.

author: Amanda
headline: You'll never go back to anything else!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oh my gosh! This balm is perfect for a natural, fresh look. It blends effortlessly into the skin, evens out tone, and leaves a healthy glow without feeling heavy or greasy! The balm texture feels hydrating and comfortable all day, making it great for everyday wear. Ideal for anyone who wants lightweight coverage with a smooth, radiant finish. I absolutely love this product!

author: Jessica
headline: Beautiful Glowy Everyday Base
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review, [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a beautiful skin like product. It has no fragrance which is a huge plus. I used my fingers to apply which is always my favorite method for any base layer. It truly looks like my skin but better. It applied beautifully over my skinceuticals vitamin C and moisturizer along with my SPF. The coverage is very light but gorgeous and perfect for everyday. It matched my skin color perfectly. It also came off super easy. I am very impressed by this product.

author: Molly
headline: Great for warm weather
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never used a tinted face balm, so I have little to compare it to in that specificity, but overall I would say this is a good product. It does melt into your skin and has just enough tint to somewhat balance skin tone. It is very smooth and goes on smooth. I will say that a little does not go a long way, but just enough. It is very light on the skin and does not look cakey or thick at all. Doesn't seem to be buildable, but this is a perfect product for a quick summer , dewy look.

author: Debbie
headline: Would not purchase
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It has nice coverage but does fell cakey and slightly greasy. It seems to lay in the crevices and large pores. It is easy to apply and was the right shade.

author: Julie
headline: Your skin but fresher!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Omg I love this for low makeup days! It's sheer but has a blurring affect that covers just enough to make me look fresh and a bit glowy. Feels amazing on the skin almost like putting on serum vs makeup. This is a vacation/weekend trip must have! Makes me feel just put together enough where I can throw on liner and feel good walking out the door. There is a good amount of product even when using it liberally. My daily go two is the bye bye foundation cc cream and this doesn't have any real coverage but if your skin just needs a boost and not cover up this is a great option.

author: Aim
headline: Nice creamy formula, great light coverag
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've using IT makeup for years, but I found a new favorite. This ultra-creamy balm looks like foundation in the container but feels like skincare. I applied it directly with my fingers (I usually use brushes) for a no-makeup makeup look. Then I added some under eye concealer, blush, tinted lip balm, and a light dusting of powder. I really like how it feels on my skin. Even when I removed it at night, my towelette wasn't orange all over, so I know it's lighter. For parties or more important events, I'll wear a greater coverage foundation for a more dramatic look, but this will be my go-to for looking fresh and feeling pretty on regular day.

author: Karoline
headline: Lightweight tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do it all sheer tint face balm is a lightweight face balm it great and matches my skin tone. The packaging is small so you can take it on the go to reapply during the day. Love how smooth and light it is and it is not scented which is great for people who are sensitive.

author: Bri

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that it's made with 92% skincare serum, because it feels more like skincare than makeup. It hydrates well and leaves my skin looking fresh and smooth rather than cakey. This is perfect for no-makeup makeup days, quick errands, or when you want something breathable.

author: Sarah
headline: Nice
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics sheer tint face balm really does do it all! The shade matches for my face perfectly and I love the feel that my skin can still breathe.

author: Lizz
headline: Skin care and color …count me in!
comment: For me a tinted moisturizer is the best of both worlds. I especially love it because I don't wear foundation. This sheer tinted face balm states it has 92% skin care ingredients (to include important ones like hyaluronic acid collagen peptides) to keep skin hydrated and fed. The circular glass packaging is small flat and easy to place anywhere. It glides on the face with each finger stroke. Provides minimal coverage but does give a thin layer of glow and warmth. Does not contain any noticeable scent. Very easy to start with this tint add more coverage or straight makeup to keep it simple and natural. Last all day without needing to reapply

author: lilly

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the effect of this IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It basically has the coverage of a tinted moisturizer, which is generally all I use for a base. It looks like it applies quite sheer, but once it's applied all over the face, you can certainly tell the difference in how it subtly evens out tone. It may just be that I'm not used to this specific type of product, but I do always find myself wishing it somehow came out of a tube instead, as I tend to apply it with my fingers and it takes a while to pick up enough of the product from the pot. Overall, I do like this product and the way it wears on my skin.

author: Bz
headline: Definitely recommend
comment: IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm feels lightweight and hydrating, evens out skin tone with a natural sheer finish, and is perfect for everyday wear when you want light coverage with skincare benefits rather than a heavy foundation.

author: Lara
headline: Hard pass
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'll admit this has nice coverage and color match and my skin feels nice after using this several times. The huge disadvantage is the way it lays on my skin, no matter the moisturizer or primer, this makes my skin look worse. Instead of having a natural look and finish, it makes skin look rougher. I was excited about how easily this was to use but I'd pass on this and look at a cushion foundation for better and smoother coverage.

author: Angelica

The packaging is a cute glass casing with a screw on lid. I feel the value of the product is worth the cost. I highly recommend.

author: Mandy

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've tried a LOT of foundation over the years, but this is a really different kind of formula. comment: This product is comfortable to wear. I don't feel greasy with it on. Maybe I needed one shade lighter.  But it blends well, and over an ok product. Personally I have used more affordable face tint with better performance.

author: Pamela

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really impressed at how well this face tint blended falsely with my skin color. It felt smooth and silky and was easy to apply. I liked that it was sheer and still gave me great coverage.

author: Jiaying
headline: Dewy balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so interesting. I love the original tinted moisturizer in a tube with spf50. Although this one doesn't have any spf, it feels amazing on. I applied with my finger first but noticing coverage being too sheer. So I opted for a fine haired face brush and the coverage was light but definitely way better. Upon initial contact to the skin, this balm feels so amazing because it's like water to the face. It's hydrating and perfect for this weather. I'm combo and slightly dry in the winter. I wore this for 3-4 hours without setting with powder and my nose got shiny. So I decided to set with some powder and take down the shine. By the end of the day, my nose and forehead was kind of shiny again but not greasy. It's more of a dewy look. I also love the way how my liquid blush blended seamlessly and effortlessly with the tinted balm. My skin felt good the whole day. The shade I got was light medium and it's a tad too warm for me but not too much that I look orange. It will work better in the summer but then I will really have to set with powder and setting spray. Overall, a very solid product and natural looking with lots of added serum for skincare.

author: Michelle
headline: Skin-first Makeup!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Shade Fair Cool 125 has officially earned a permanent spot in my complexion routine.

As an aesthetic nurse with light skin, colder months are when I really notice makeup settling into fine lines more than I'd like (hello getting older meh). This is exactly why I've been gravitating toward tinted moisturizers and skin-first makeup, and this product is a total gem! The balm texture is buttery, lightweight, and the formula melts right into the skin as it transforms into a literal serum. It gives that fresh, healthy, radiant look and is buildable, without feeling heavy or cakey, it's super comfortable! It instantly evens out my complexion while still letting my skin look like my skin… just better. A more enhanced version of myself… A bonus is that it's unscented! 

What I love most is that it's doing more than just covering. It doesn't cling to dry patches, doesn't emphasize fine lines, and actually makes my combination skin look more youthful and plump with wear. Application with fingertips is suggested, but if you have the coveted Heavenly #7 brush… it blends like a dream! 

This is truly next-generation tinted moisturizer energy… makeup that enhances your skin and supports skin health. Perfect for everyday wear, no-makeup makeup days, or when you want to look polished without a full face.

If you're noticing makeup not sitting the way it used to and want something radiant, hydrating, and flattering, this is absolutely worth trying. Skin-first makeup is where it's at!

author: Shannon

comment: Talk about luxury I love the way this finishes and it doesn't leave u cakey or dry! I definitely recommend this or any of her products because you are gonna get good quality stuff!  And the packaging let me tell you is off the chain it makes me feel so boogie

author: Lala
headline: Good with cautions
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the new it cosmetics Do It all Sheer Tint Balm in Light warm 02 for review.  This is a very lightweight sheer skin tint that acts more like skin care than makeup.  Initially I swatched it on my finger and was immediately concerned with the level of sheerness wondering if it would do anything.  I was amazed as I put it on that it actually went on the skin very dry feeling and covered more than I expected.  I have a lot of redness on my cheek area and the pictures show it evened my skin tone nicely.  It is matte, not dewy as I expected.  In fact it did tend to highlight a few dry patches I had instead of smoothing them, so make sure you are well moisturized. I have oily skin and did not need to apply any powder on top of this product, but did notice oil breaking through about 5 hours later on my T-zone. I was concerned about some quality control issues with the packaging, one was the label on the top was off center and had bubbling under it as if it was hastily applied.  The other was immediately after swiping the top layer off the product, there was a large uneven pocket of product underneath as if it had a large bubble in the actual product.  You can see this in the picture.  I'm concerned this means the product was hastily packaged and worried about quicker spoilage of the product due to air bubbles, so I will monitor this.  Another thing I noticed as with other it cosmetic products is oxidation.  The top layer of the product was a completely different color than the product underneath but it did not seem to oxidize and turn orange on the skin after had a day of wear, likely because the product is so thinly applied. Overall I think this is a good product for skin care with a bit more or everyday makeup looks.  I think dry skin will be an issue for this product.  I received this item in exchange for an honest review.

I also wasn't fond of the ingredients the one being dimethicone
