headline: Light and natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm goes on light and weightless to leave a dewy finish. It doesn't feel heavy or caked but light and natural. The color matches pretty well as well, giving my skin a boost of healthy looking brightness. Love this product and the amount is impressive.

author: Allison
headline: Smooths and hydrates skin for a natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very impressed with the IT Cosmetics Do it all Sheer tint face balm! I normally wear a full coverage foundation but this was great for days I just want a more natural look. It blends so smoothly and is really hydrating. It lasts all day and is very affordable. Great for a quick natural make up look.

author: Britney
headline: Wow!!!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was skeptical at first. I didn't see much of a tint when I put it on my skin. But after a minute, I realized, it made me
Skin look so soft, smooth,& a light glow. I put this under my eye to start & it made a huge difference in appearance. It had minimal coverage but yet it made a full transformation. I can't even explain it but this stuff is amazing. Didn't even feel like I had anything on my skin but it looked so good!

author: Lisa
headline: Amazing coverage and light feel
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Instantly reduced redness and evened out my skin tone. I applied to half of my face in the picture and you can easily see it covered the redness on my forehead on the side it was applied to. It's very light, but still offers amazing coverage. I have normal to oily skin and it left my skin feeling great. The product wore well all day. Small compact package made it easy for me to apply with my complexion brush. Highly recommend this and the fair warm matched my skin tone perfectly. I received the product for an honest review and am very pleased with it.

author: Audrey
headline: Light weight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When I first opened this product I was thinking that the color was going to be very off from my skin. However once I began to blend it, it seems to adjust more and is a pretty close match. It's very light and blend able.  I got the shade light Neutral. I tried both a brush and a sponge to apply it and found that the brush did a decent job. There is a very very light scent to it but nothing that stands out. It is very comfortable to wear because you don't even feel it on your skin. As for durability, I only wore it for a few hours but it seems to hold up.

author: T
headline: Love this product
comment: This is a really good tinted moisturizer, the color blended in to my skin really good . Makes your face feel so soft . Love that it has really good ingredients in it to make your skin look better one time . Quiet few colors to choose from, I would definitely recommend to my friends and family

author: Kelly
headline: Moisturizing Sheet Tint!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have a love hate relationship with this this face balm. I really wanted to give it five stars, but the coverage isn't what I want it to be. As a tinted moisturizer, it's pretty great! It's got a light texture that simply melts into your skin, but the color literally disappears (which is why I added the pic of it first applied). It didn't really do much for my skin tone, but I may be applying too lightly. The hydration seems to last all day! I would definitely buy this again for everyday use, but maybe not when going full glam.

author: cro0427
headline: This balm is so good!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really really like this toned face balm! I'm always looking for easy daily face products that aren't too heavy while I'm at work. But I can also put on quickly. This balm melts right in! Blends so easily. The color is like my skin but better. I really like the potted packaging. It's big enough for me to dip a brush or sponge. It made doing my daily face a whole lot easily! Highly recommend!

author: Fallon
headline: A lightweight, hydrating skin tint for a natural, no-makeup
comment: This sheer tint balm is perfect for everyday wear. It blends effortlessly, feels lightweight, and gives my skin a natural, healthy glow. It evens out my complexion without settling into lines or feeling heavy, and the formula feels hydrating all day. Great option for quick, minimal makeup routines.

author: Coll
headline: Nice feel
comment:
Let me start by saying, I am in my 50's with menopausal skin. I am no a fan of heavy coverage so this was a very nice light weight. I only applied a light amount for wear but this product is billable for for coverage is that suits your need. The look is not matte or dewy in my opinion, just sheer skin with a fresher finish. Covered my pores and imperfections well. Easily removed with micellar
Water. 10/10

author: Amy
headline: Lightweight but effective
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the 210 (light/neutral) color. I'm light skinned with a cool complexion, so when I opened the jar I was afraid it would be too dark. As you can see from the picture, it blended in beautifully. I swatched it on the right side and blended it to the left of the swatch. You can hardly see it. The balm is very moisturizing. It gives light coverage, which I like, since I want to just cover imperfections or discoloration but don't want my foundation to cake or settle into fine lines. I thought it was a good value, too, since so much was included in the pot. I suspect this will last quite a while.

author: Christine
headline: Good coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Light weight, good coverage. I do not usually go for a foundation like this, but I would buy this. Even the color is a pretty good match to my skin tone. Overall I would recommend

author: Nicky
headline: Its a dream, I am in awe of this sheer tint face balm.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Its like butter on my skin. I love the texture and the buildable coverage from this tinted balm, I have never experienced such seamless blendability from a product like this before. Its honestly like applying a nice oil or serum, it feels like nothing is on your face which is nice. I am very much into this, the packaging is compact and in a cute jar so you can take it on the go in your bag for touch ups, I would say perfect for spring/summertime it gives you that sheer beachy natural look but totally buildable. I am in love and it's worth it just for the ease of touch ups at anytime. Dare I say, this is what Maybelline Matte Mousse wanted to be in 2008 but It cosmetics perfected it and made this gorgeous texture.

author: Jen
headline: Great Tinted Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such a unique face product. It's like a creamy serum with a slight tint. It's extremely lightweight. I used a Beauty Blender to apply. It's very sheer but can definitely be built up. It blends in like a dream. I have lines and texture with normal to oily skin. So for me I did need to set with a little powder. It does have a slight scent but nothing overwhelming. For the price I do believe it's a good value because this will last quite awhile. Also love the fact that there is skincare ingredients included. If you don't love heavy full coverage makeup this is a great option.

author: Fran
headline: Blends easily!
comment: I received my Do It All sheer tint face balm for free to try and write my honest review. I like how it blends into my skin easily. It feels lightweight and not heavy or greasy . It is unscented which is perfect for me!

author: Autumn
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Super happy I gave this a try. My face is DRY-dry, and I've been having trouble with a lot of my old products with regard to them not blending well, making dry patches look worse, and wearability in general just being a huge ick. This face balm is creamy and smooth, blended easily with my pinky finger (no sponge or anything else needed!) and didn't call extra attention to the parched Sahara that my face has chosen to take on as its new identity. I'd never heard of this brand until I picked up this jar. Flipped it over and of course, it's L'Oréal! I'm happy with the ingredients, I'm happy with the results, and I love the sturdy glass jar. This one is a win, folks.

author: Michelle
headline: Would buy this more
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] There's no scent thankfully. Definitely the right shade light warm 215. The results are light but very buildable. Will definitely use this more

author: Jo
headline: Great natural coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Tint Face Balm blends beautifully and helped hide my skin redness for a lovely, even skin tone with a natural no makeup look.  It's a bit thick at first, but spreads thin and easily; thanks to the moisturizer in it I didn't deal with any skin dryness that I typically experience with concealers that I typically use.  I will absolutely be buying this balm in the future and I love the way it makes my skin look!

author: Danielle
headline: Nice daily product
comment: This is different than anything else I've ever tried. It's more of a mousse in the packaging but smooths on like a cream to serum. It's evens out skin tone while adding a tint of color. I like that it contains skincare ingredients and my skin feels hydrated when wearing, never dry or patchy. This product wears well all day and I don't apply powder since my skin is normal to dry. I haven't noticed it causing me any breakouts or skin sensitivity. Also wears well with my other makeup. This would be a gray option for someone looking for a buildable yet natural daily look. Applies best with the IT heavenly luxe double ended brush.

author: Audrey
headline: Love it
comment: Wow I am loving this 'do it all' sheer tint face balm! I love a makeup that does it all- especially for travel am this product is very nice! It is easy to use and wear.

author: Sara
headline: Perfect
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint face balm is amazing. I love this balm. I'm over 40 and hate how foundation looks on my skin. I tend to have dryer skin and I have wrinkles also. Foundation sinks in the skin and leave it looking terrible. However, this balm goes on beautifully. It leaves a dewy finish. My skin feel naked even though it isn't. The consistency is nice. Not thick, very sheer and pretty. I will not be waisting money on foundation anymore. This balm is the bomb. I will be switching to this. It last all day on the skin too. Just as beautiful at the end of the day as it is at the beginning. It has a nice, lite, fresh scent. I'd highly recommend this sheer tinted face balm.

author: Amanda
headline: Wonderful for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this, I'm at an age when makeup can actually make me look older then I am, this in place of foundation is amazing. I goes on smoothly like a serum absorbing into the skin giving a nice smooth look not settling into the fine lines and wrinkles. It also doesn't get dry or caked on the skin after a few hours of wear. It doesn't feel heavy like a regular foundation can as well. This is great for a nice clean makeup look.

author: Jackie
headline: Great skincare makeup
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so smooth and goes on like a moisturizer. The color light neutral was a good choice color match. It goes on weightless and has buildable coverage. There is no scent and did not bother my sensitive skin.

author: OleLy
headline: Light warm 215
comment: Nice coverage, radiant look, but for my opinion to greasy, stays on clothes. After about 5-6 hours coverage not so well anymore, but t-zone is not greasy. No scent. To yellow in color. Comfortable on skin. Not sure how it would be on hot summer days.

author: Shannon
headline: Light hydrating coverage that works
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I applied the Do it all sheet tint face balm to the left side of my hand. It feels smooth and hydrated.
The shade blends really well. I really like that there is skincare in this product.

author: Kristin
headline: Perfect cream sheer foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been on the hunt for the perfect cream foundation and this may be it. It offers the perfect coverage easy to apply with little to no scent. The product did not oxidize on my skin or separate as I do have mature skin. Overall loved the look this product helped me achieve. Was sheer and lightweight while still offering coverage. Would suggest a setting spray to help it last longer but isn't a requirement. Product was easy to remove and didn't leave my skin feeling caked with residue. I was concerned it wouldn't offer enough coverage for my acne pron mature skin but I had been on the hunt for a great cream foundation. This product is perfect. It is light weight offers the perfect amount of coverage and is easy to remove.

author: Mshop423
headline: I would buy this again it's perfect for the light coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm not a huge fan of all the it cosmetics stuff but this one is my favorite. I like light coverage and this is perfect! It feels like soft skin care serum but dries after putting it on and not completely matte but doesn't smudge because it's sheer either. Most sheer creams won't dry on fully cause oils in there and then they smudge off, I'm glad this doesn't do that.
Easily bendable and nice texture. 
This is my summer color but blended well on my skin and I can use it as a bronzer without looking orange. 
This is great light coverage to hide minimal blemishes I'm sure you could put more layers in for my coverage as well. 
It's nice because it states it's 92% skincare! I'll need to buy more shades!

author: Hannah
headline: Definitely recommend this product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is amazing! It's so easy to take on and off, you can use a beauty sponge or makeup brush! It leaves your face feeling so refreshed and smooth! You can't even tell you have any on but it does the job and has a full coverage look! Definitely recommending to my makeup girls and buying again! This is definitely for you if you're going for just a simple foundation look or just a simple coverage!

author: Ashley
headline: Great color!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The effectiveness of this sheer balm is so nice it's so soft on your face. The shade matches up and makes you look great and with color. The application is super easy and so smooth! I love this product! I highly recommend it!

author: Sarah
headline: Prep your skin before use and you'll love it
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice creamy skin tint balm. It's presented in a glass jar. It feels silky and creamy and dries down to a powdery finish. I tried it on one side of my face with no prep and then I did prep the other side. On the not prepped side, it was smooth but overall a tad dry feeling for me. On the prepped side, where my skin was super moisturized, it glided so well and looked at lot better. For someone who has very dry skin, especially now in the winter, it wasn't as hydrating as I would've preferred. It's still a nice skin tint balm but for me, I need a lot of hydration. I would recommend it to people. It's great for those who are not super dry and if you are super dry, I would definitely recommend prepping your skin first which is not a deal breaker for me.

author: Annie
headline: Love the creaminess and the color
comment: I received this product for free in exchange for a honest review.  This is a great product. It feels so light on my skin yet gives me the best color. I love the creaminess of this skin tint and how smoothly it glides on my skin. A little really goes a long way. This fade balm is the perfect color for my skin that last an entire day. I would definitely recommend this product.

author: Victoria
headline: Love this serum
comment: At first I thought this serum would be too dark but once you apply it and spread it around it becomes much lighter and more sheer. It blends easily and spreads nicely. Hydrating and liquidy kind of like a serum but dries up and feels nice on the skin, not rich like a moisturizer. I think it's perfect for all skin types.

author: Lauren
headline: Silky balm
comment:
Virginia
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm is very silky. The color matched perfect and i was able to wear it all day long. I would wear a moisturizer under. The packing was cute and eye catching and was able to take it off with a makeup wipe.

author: Renee
headline: I'm sold!!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm genuinely shocked how much I love this product! I didn't think a sheer tint baseball would do much coverage for me but I was extremely wrong. I like how it's very lightweight, super easy to apply, and the range of colors you're bound to find a match. I like how it doesn't feel heavy on my face and it just gives a flawless finish. I will from now on be using this product instead of my usual full coverage foundation. I highly recommend you give this a try, you'll fall in love!

author: Laura
headline: Wonderful face tinted balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had the opportunity to try out this product and I am so pleased with it and its performance. This balm does a great job with coverage and also hydrates while being very light on the skin. It has a creamy texture and blends beautifully and gives a radiant look. Not only this tint covers my blemishes but it also reduces fine lines with consistent use of it. The jar is glass and I do like it a lot, it's small but I only need a little to cover my whole face so the size is perfect.

author: Yamaris
headline: Perfect no makeup, makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm tint is the perfect no makeup, makeup look. It glides on and looks just like skin. It's long lasting and blends right in perfectly. It's not drying and no need to reapply. It's a cute little glass container that fits in any bag. The perfect size.

author: Hilliebee
headline: Unbelievably silky smooth!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product! It feels super smooth to the touch and feels completely invisible on my skin, which is very important to me.

author: Sadia
headline: I love most is how hydrating it feels. Highly recommended.
comment:
I just start using the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for a few days now, and it's become my go-to for everyday wear. The texture is very lightweight and smooth.
What I love most is how hydrating it feels. My skin stays comfortable throughout the day without drying out or settling into fine lines. It gives a soft, natural glow that makes my skin look well-rested. It also layers nicely with concealer if you want a bit more coverage in certain areas.

author: HL
headline: Found my new product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula sinks into the skin easily and has a lightweight, glowy finish with very sheer coverage that softly blurs discoloration and imperfections.This is a great everyday go to! Im so grateful for giving me the opportunity to test this product.Found My New Complexion Product

author: Krystal
headline: Love this stuff!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Who loves a skin tint?! I know I do! Doing some errands but dont feel like putting on a full face but want to cover up those pesky blemishes?! It cosmetics do it all skin tint is the perfect way to do so! Blends beautifully into my skin with little effort from my brush! Literally melts right in and covers blemishes and the dark circles around my eyes. Doesn't crease or make my other makeup look cakey.

author: Dana
headline: Great skin tone serum
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is done very well. The product is very easy to applicate on my face. There is more than enough product. The shade fits perfectly with my skin tone. There is a good consistency using this product. I would highly recommend this product.

author: Melissa
headline: Sheer but good
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sheer coverage but surprisingly provides decent coverage. I have a lot is hyperpigmentation and uneven skin so I was pleasantly surprised when it evened out my skin. Doesn't cover imperfections up but wouldn't expect it to. I'm 45 years old with severely dry skin so the formula is perfect as it is hydrating. I lightly powdered with elf halo loose powder. First pic is right after and second pic is 5-6 hours later. It's a balm so it's hydrating and slick to touch. Has skin care ingredients in it. No scent or very low scent. Don't smell anything after applied. Sheer coverage so doesn't have to be a perfect match to skin. Will continue to use. Will say since it's sheer that I put two layers on with a brush so it buildable. I tried using my fingers but I liked the brush better. Didn't attempt with a sponge. I think a sponge would eat up the product.

author: BB
headline: Perfection
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited to try this face balm and it did NOT disappoint!!! As you can see the color match is perfect and really blends with the color of my skin. It feels sooo lightweight, like there is nothing even there which is a huge win! It covers very well for a tinted face balm, I usually use tinted moisturizers and Id say it's about the same coverage. A little goes a long way so this little container should last even for everyday wear!

author: Jessica
headline: Sun kissed winter.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Its winter here in MI and I miss the sun. Luckily this IT Cosmetics Sheer tint face balm is super easy to apply, it's creamy at first and upon application gets a light weight powdery texture with a sheer tinted finish. Reccomend applying with a complection brush or sponge. Easy twist open, sturdy packaging, can fit in your bag or even your pocket. It's a four in one, tints, moisturizes, firms, and minimizes fine lines! Around thirty eight dollars for that sun kissed tint I've been longing for!

author: Daria
headline: Love
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed using this sheer tint face balm. The texture is lightweight, creamy, and very easy to apply — it melts into the skin effortlessly. The coverage is light but perfect for evening out my skin tone and giving a natural, healthy-looking glow.

I love that it feels more like skincare than makeup. My skin feels hydrated and comfortable throughout the day, with no heaviness or dryness. It looks especially beautiful for a no-makeup makeup look and works great for everyday wear.

After application, my skin looks smooth, fresh, and radiant. This is a great option if you want something quick, natural, and effortless while still improving the overall appearance of your skin. I would definitely recommend it, especially for those who prefer sheer coverage with a skincare feel.

author: Jenny
headline: Very nice - wish I had chosen a lighter shade!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a new mom I was really excited for this product for a low maintenance day. I do think it is easy to apply (I just just a makeup brush) and blends seamlessly with the skin. I do wish it was more of my shade, I think it may be a bit too dark. It does feel like butter on the skin and leaves a very pretty tint. I didn't notice any scent which is also a plus!

author: Britt
headline: Definitely recommend
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love it cosmetic products there all amazing and work great. The value is definitely there. I like the packaging as well. The shade is perfect I chose. The texture is smooth. I definitely recommend it. It is more of a full coverage foundation

author: Lili
headline: This is amazing!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I honestly have to say that this do it all sheer tint face is absolutely amazing! I did not expect this to look so good on my skin! I'm surprised at how my whole skin looks like. It's all one even tone and it literally looks like I have a real life filter on my face! I'm insanely impressed at how lightweight this is because normally that has this much coverage is very heavy and feels heavy on the skin! This one feels so light and so good! I even felt that it hydrated my face a little bit and it's really easy to blend with other products after I started doing my make up on top of it, but I can even use it for a daily bomb instead of using any other makeup product

The shade match was amazing! I absolutely think that this product is worth every dollar and I will continue to purchase this and I will buy some for my daughters too because this product is something that every woman should have in their make up bag

author: Jaclyn
headline: Barely-There Tint That Effortlessly Evens Skin Tone
comment: I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for free in exchange for my honest review. This is a very sheer tint, but it does a nice job of subtly evening out the skin tone without feeling heavy or cakey. It feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin, making it great for no-makeup or low-effort makeup days. While it doesn't provide much coverage, it gives just enough of a blur to smooth things out and leave skin looking fresh and natural. I'd recommend it if you're looking for a barely-there tint rather than true coverage.

author: Val
headline: Covers my dark circles
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Honestly, I haven't bought IT Cosmetics before. It was just never on my radar. That has now changed. I decided to try this face balm around my eyes with no other products on, and the results are great! I thought the color would be too dark, but it is perfect. The dark spots under my eye are hidden, and it doesn't feel dry or cakey like some concealers. There is no creasing and it is light. I don't feel like I am wearing any makeup around my eyes. As I get older, I'm having trouble sleeping, which means dark circles are a battle, but this helps.

author: Whitney
headline: All in One
comment: This product blends beautifully and is very comfy to wear. The packaging is sleek and simple. Pigmentation is clean and has no fragrance at all. The finish is clean and great to wear for every day.

author: Edita
headline: Beautiful face product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wish the pan was bigger to have a more comfortable access to the product no matter what way I apply it (brush, sponge, fingers). The texture is balmy, but not too slippery. I find the shade runs a bit on the darker side, but since it's a lighter product, it adjusts to the skin. It starts as a sheer coverage, but it can be easily built up. It applies smoothly and evenly, and blends easily. The finish is beautiful and gives a natural radiant effect.

author: Veronica
headline: Good tinted moisturizer for that natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a good tinted moisturizer if you're going for the natural look and just want a little color. It's not meant to be a full coverage foundation. I like that it gives me just enough tint to hide those subtle blemishes. It doesn't settle into my fine lines and creases. It's very creamy and absorbs into the skin well. It's is thin light weight texture. It blends in good and doesn't leave look cakey on the face. Definitely good if you want a natural look with some hydration. Plus, it has added skincare benefits.

author: Renee
headline: I've already bought again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I just found my favorite tinted face balm. It's absolutely amazing and the color matches perfectly with my skin. It goes on smooth and light and very blendable. It's very creamy and smooth.

author: Keri
headline: Color matches my skin perfectly and leaves skin feeling soft
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am stunned by this product! It looked to dark for my skin at first but it was a perfect match! It's silky smooth and makes my skin feel soft and nourished. I don't get that heavy make up foundation feel and it's great! Removal of the product was very easy with my make up melting balm. Highly recommend for someone that wants to wear make up with not only tint to it but skin care benefits as well!

author: Pamela
headline: Tint Face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This do it all tint face balm is very easy to apply, it doesn't have a strong smell and but I feel like it doesn't cover as much as other brands that I've tried.

author: Larrisa
headline: Not my shade but will be great for summer.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is definitely a nice skin care balm as it feels light and clean. While this isn't a perfect match for my skin, I am surprised at the ability to build on it, so this will be great for my summer skin.  If you are just looking for a simple balm to deal with dryness, particularly the current winter dryness, this balm will be great for it. Very moisturizing.  There's no scent that I can pick up from it which is nice, I prefer non-scented skincare products.

author: Judy
headline: Yes, I will buy this product again
comment: This product I really good for your face. I really love it went on smooth it made my face hydrated feels really great. It's liability very well on the face make your face very appearance. I would recommend this product to my friends and family. I really loved it. If you don't believe me you need to try it yourself because you really would like it very hydration for your face make your face look glowing

author: Jamie
headline: Super comfortable.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this! The texture is weirdly satisfying, it feels like a thick, silky moisturizer rather than a heavy cream. It's definitely a sheer tint, so don't expect it to hide everything, but it just blurs and evens things out enough to look "done." ​I was worried it might be sticky, but it's actually super comfortable and just feels like I'm wearing a serum all day. Plus, it has that clean, slightly citrusy scent that IT Cosmetics usually has, which is a nice touch. Definitely my new go-to for coffee runs or gym days.

author: Nicole
headline: Exactly what I was looking for
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been searching for a light cream tinted moisturizer and this does not disappoint! It did a great job covering redness without caking on. I don't mind some redness showing through but this does help even it. It feel light and it's not sticky or clumpy after application. I would absolutely buy this and recommend this!

author: Boise Tiffers
headline: Great for mature skin!
comment:
I never write reviews, however this product is worth the time! IT face balm surpaces the others as it is light and moisturizing without feeling greasy. I can build coverage and I have added the balm bronzer for a healthy glow!
If you have mature skin and had given up on foundation coverage- try this for sure.

author: Rachel
headline: Melts and blends into skin flawlessly!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a face makeup product like nothing I've ever tried! The balm texture blends out seamlessly & melts into my skin. I use this at the beginning of the day, but it is also very easy to use for touch up makeup throughout the day!

author: Judy

author: Laura
headline: Innovative, unique, essential!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is my first time using a balm foundation, so I had no expectations. I chose shade 120 Fair Warm, which matches my skin flawlessly. 

The balm is wet and thick, but blends into my skin so easily. Just a little bit is all you need, and I just used my fingers to apply. It even covers my acne from "that time of the month." I appreciate that the balm doesn't settle in fine lines, it just kind of sits on top and hides them seamlessly.

From the looks of it in the jar, I expected the finish of the balm to be dewy…and it turned out to be quite the opposite. While it's not a matte or even a dewy finish, it's kind of somewhere in between. I absolutely love it, and for the first time didn't have the urge to set foundation with powder, which is a big deal.

It lasts ALL day (and into the night!), yet comes off easily with micellar water and a cotton ball. 

The 4-in-1 skincare aspect is especially awesome in the winter, you can essentially skip your moisturizer. This could save you a decent amount of money, as you technically don't need to apply your serum or moisturizer on the days you wear the balm.

This balm's consistency is so innovative, the finish is beautiful, and my skin feels light and looks flawless yet natural. I'm a new super-fan.

Highly recommend!

author: Michelle
headline: Amazing product for even tone, healthy skin!
comment:
I was gifted this product and was able to test this before launching through Gloss Angeles Confidential. This is my first impression and introduction into the IT Cosmetics brand, and I must say I am impressed! This product is marketed as a sheer tint face balm that enhances your skin to provide a naturally flawless look. In terms of delivering on their claims, this definitely does deliver and gives a moisturized, bouncy, fresh look to the skin. It is a sheer complexion product, but does layer well with concealer to deliver fuller coverage. The finish is a radiant and glowy which is perfect for drier to normal skin types. I have extremely oily skin and the finish is a bit to glowy for my skin type. Throughout wearing this product, the finish turned into a shiny, oily look if I did not properly set it with powder which is why I deducted one star. Despite this I think this is a great product to use in winter time to combat the dry look. Due to the climate I live in, I don't think I would recommend wearing this in the summer as it would not last and feel like too much on my skin. In terms of shade range, I do think that IT Cosmetics did a great job in catering to all skin tones and undertones. The great thing about this product is that it is sheer and flexible so the product adapts to you for a perfect match. 

Details worth mentioning...I have an oily skin type, medium skin tone with neutral undertones. My perfect match of this product is 320 Medium Tan Warm

author: Sally
headline: Just what I was looking for!
comment:
I was invited to use IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review.

I've been searching for a while for a product like this! Something that truly enhances my aging skin, with its fine lines and uneven tone. I strive for a very natural look with a healthy glow and truly dislike a face that looks like it might crack when you smile! I chose a shade to review that matches my natural coloring.

I applied IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm to half of my face to really compare the results. This luxurious product is a solid, but as soon as I  applied it, it almost melted into my skin, because it's SUPER blended and gives an ultra-smooth appearance. I was amazed how quickly and easily it went on and immediately gave me a balanced look, with a nice glow. Some areas of my face required a little more than others, because of my aging skin, which is understandable. 

I have very high cheekbones and almost instantly I could see a big difference on the half of my face with the balm, as compared to the other half. My high cheekbone was so noticeably and beautifully enhanced and my treated face looked smooth, hydrated and had a balanced look compared to the other side. Fine lines were still there, but much less noticeable. My eye area looked brighter, more awake and more healthy . . . And this was BEFORE applying any other make-up. 

I like the small container it comes in, because I travel extensively and it will easily pop into my cosmetic bag. The downside is that I'll need to buy it more often - does it come by the case? 😊

Overall, I'm very pleased with the results of this product and I'm so happy I had the opportunity to try it - it was a real find for me!

author: Amelia
headline: Sheer but nice texture
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm by it cosmetics is nice, it applies really well to dehydrated middle aged skin. It has the feeling of a thicker cream when in the jar but once on your fingers, becomes somewhat oily and much thinner. This allows it to go on super smooth and doesn't cake up in the creases. Buildable coverage, the light neutral color was a bit yellow hued against my skin but otherwise love it.

author: Alita7
headline: Easy Tinted Balm for Everyday Natural Skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The tint is light but evens out my skin tone nicely without feeling heavy or cakey. It blends easily with fingers and gives a soft, skin‑like finish.
It's perfect for days when I don't want full foundation — just something that smooths and brightens my complexion while still looking like skin. I also like that it feels hydrating and comfortable on my face all day. Simple, easy, and great for everyday wear.

author: Marie
headline: Good coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT cosmetics do it all sheer tint face bomb I believe is a great face bomb. It's extremely lightweight and has a really nice coverage. I use the light medium warm number 225 and I think it had nice coverage.

author: Teria
headline: Simple easy to use one step face tinted balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The container is compact and light. The cream melts and blends well on the skin. The face tint balm has a light shimmery glow look and feels smooth on the skin. I have combination skin and it blends well. The coverage isn't heavy but it seems to build well if you would wanna apply more layers or apply another foundation with it. I got this as a free product. I applied to my wrist in the photo

author: Rachel
headline: IT cosmetics delivers again!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sheer tint face balm is lightweight, buildable, and perfectly matches my summer skin tone. I'll definitely be buying my winter color as well.

author: Carlirose
headline: It was okay
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is sleek and covers nicely. A little off in the color but it doesn't stain but you need setting powder or something because it doesn't really stay either

author: Pamela m
headline: Amazing product
comment: I absolutely love this product. The packaging is sleek and handy. The way the product applies is like butter! I absolutely love using it when I want a no makeup look day

author: Mary
headline: Very natural look!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love how creamy and nice the texture is. It covers well and leaves natural look. It doesn't have any scent. It's very light and lasts long. I use it in the morning after toner and sunscreen and my face looks really natural.

author: Mi
headline: A great face balm tint for a natural look!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time trying the it cosmetics 'do it all' sheer tint face balm. I have the shade 'fair warm 120' which is a good match for my nc25 Swinton. This face balm is derived from 92% of skincare ingredients and feels like a lightweight serum with some color. It is a liquid like cooling face tint that comes in a pot container so you can use your fingers or go in with a brush and sponge to spot cover. It is also a good product for a no makeup makeup look as your skin will look very natural with a light coverage to make skin look more even. As a person with combo-oily skin I think this product will be great for those days running errands to give that fresh face look. It is definitely not meant for full coverage.

author: Cay
headline: Beautiful hydrating finish sheer balm❤️
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have this It cosmetics sheer tint face balm in 120 fair warm,this is a balm based product,it's smooth but thin and breathable,you can wear it very sheer or build it up.m,it isn't greasy at all,if you have tried RMS concealer in a pot the texture is similar but this one is non sticky and feels very hydrating,I find that I can wear it alone without setting powder it held up just fine,I applied it with a brush,it gives my skin a very healthy glow but not shiny,the longevity is ok,if you have a long day and need to wear a base makeup for over 8-9 hours I recommend you to use a regular foundation product,this face balm is beautiful and make your skin glow!the shade is leaning very warm ,it says fair warm but it's not fair at all I would say it's leaning towards little deeper end of fair shade with warm undertones.I recommend this product if you have dry skin or normal skin type,you may need to set it if your skin is on oilier side.
Ps:I received this free product in return for my honest review.

author: Milana
headline: Sheer and gorgeous!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in love with this sheer tint face balm from IT Cosmetics. It is so lightweight yet gives you a good amount of coverage. It goes on like butter and doesn't pile up at all. I used it from morning to evening and it stayed on so well. I removed it with a wipe and then washed my face as always and it came right off. I also love that it comes in a glass container and is so compact.

author: D
headline: Good for a teen maybe
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm isn't very hydrating and in fact dries down to a powder. Very light coverage so best for someone who wants very minimal makeup look. Best for oily young not textured skin. Maybe good for a teen.  In the photo I have it on the right side.

author: Sofia
headline: SO hydrating
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am actually IN LOVE!! Most skin tints claim to feel like skincare, but they stick to dry patches and feel like rubbing oil pastel on my skin. This one does not! It genuinely feels like butter and it was a perfect shade match! This is the best skin tint I've ever used!

author: Cindy
headline: This is a great face tint. Definitely would buy again.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never tried a face tint before and was completely surprised and impressed with the coverage. This will be a staple for me when I don't want to be full glam makeup. Just the right amount and it feels lightweight.

author: Shina
headline: Great coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Glides on smoothly. Blends in nicely. It has light weight coverage which I love. I think it lasts awhile on my face and it set in good. Does help with making my skin look more natural and more smooth.

author: Christina
headline: LOVE IT!!
comment: I am in love with this sheer, beautiful face tint. It applies smoothly and makes my skin glowy. I love that it hydrates my skin at the same time. It lasts all day. The packing makes it easy to apply to a brush or sponge. It's a balmy silky texture and applies evenly. This product is definitely worth the price.  I received this product from influencer and IT Cosmetics for testing and reviewing purposes.

author: Whitney
headline: Very sheer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very sheer coverage. I gave it three stars just because it takes multiple uses to be noticeable. I do really like the creamy, smooth texture and it is very easy finally.

author: Ayisha
headline: For vibrant looking skin a great balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OMG so much fun to use it its texture is like a butter and weight less it's suites for every skin type and light pigment makes skin look more natural and more vibrant

author: Yvonne
headline: Beautiful light weight tint for everyday use ✨
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! It feels super lightweight, blends easily, and gives my skin a natural, healthy glow and my skin feels so hydrated and I don't feel that I'm wearing anything on my skin. Perfect for everyday wear when I want coverage without feeling heavy 💕✨no scent and the texture is very light and creamy.

Love it 💕

author: Maria
headline: Sheer matte finish
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very light face balm. It's solid in container but glides on skin smooth and without streaks or unevenness. Blends flawlessly. Or leaves more a matte feel than what I expected and I like that.

author: Brittany
headline: Natural ready
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I never wore foundation in my teens and twenties. In my late thirties I was forced and by 40 I wear it daily now. I don't like thick and candy but my dark spots and aging needs it. This product is amazing! I could totally use this over my foundation. It's light. It's not greasy! It matched up color wise even when I thought it would be too dark but it wasn't. It was perfect. My under eye circled and dark spots were instantly reduced. This is great for a natural look!

author: Jenn
headline: Nice hydrating tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm gives a natural, skin like finish with light coverage that evens out tone without looking heavy. It feels hydrating, lasts throughout the day and comfortable for everyday wear, and the warm light shade matched my skin nicely. I did have to add a setting powder on some areas because it looked a little too dewy. Overall, good for a no makeup look with a subtle glow.

author: Kelly
headline: Your skin, but better
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OK, when I first tried this, I hated it. Turns out I was just using it wrong and at the wrong times. This reminds me very much of my Jones Road balm. It's very sheer and lightweight and gives you a " your skin, but better" feeling. I love using it for my day-to-day morning activities, like dropping off the kids at school stopping by the grocery store and gym. It does not feel or look like I'm wearing makeup, but slightly even things out and gives me a little bit of a glow. Also, when putting it on, I thought that it would for sure make me feel greasy and oily all day, but it settles in really really nicely. Doesn't make me feel dry and doesn't make me feel oily. It's honestly perfect.

author: Brittany
headline: Perfect for winter!
comment: This is my new go-to for winter. It kept my skin glowing and moisturized all day. The coverage is pretty sheer but thats perfect for me. I'd have to test this out in warmer weather to see how it wears. I have combo skin so I feel like it might be a little too dewy. I definitely recommend this for anyone in a cold climate that has combination skin. This was gifted to me as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential to test out.

author: Wren
headline: Love this!
comment: I had been looking for a sheer tinted moisturizer type product to replace my old favorite that had been discontinued, and this is finally one that works for me. Tge product is sheer, but blurring, and looks like my own skin just bumped up a notch. I received this product for free as a part of Gloss Angeles Confidential, but i have not been compensated for my review.

author: Paloma
headline: I liked this… but I didn't love it.
comment:
The coverage is actually really nice for something sheer, it evens things out without feeling heavy at all, and it feels super lightweight on the skin. Once it's on, it gives that natural, skin-like glow that looks effortless if everything underneath is cooperating.

That said, prep matters a lot with this one. If your skin isn't well hydrated, it will cling to dry patches sooo much. On days when I used good hydrators and moisturizer beforehand, it looked great. On days I didn't, it definitely emphasized texture and dryness.

I wouldn't rely on this as a true one-and-done tinted moisturizer, despite the claims. It works best when your skin is already in a good place and you don't mind putting in a little effort with prep.

Overall, it's good, but not something I would grab before their CC cream. 

This product was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential (thank you for the opportunity to try it).

author: Wildelise
headline: Lovely product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As you can see, I'm pretty pale and unfortunately I couldn't grab my perfect shade in time, but this still works perfectly fine, over my spf that's too cool toned for me. It's very sheer and luminous, but not too greasy (at least during winter) I will keep using it and update my review, to let you guys know what i really think of it. But so far, I love it just as much as the rest of their products!

author: Marcela
headline: Good for everyday
comment: I tried this product through Gloss Angeles confidential. Color choices are great. I thought this was great for when you're not looking for tons of coverage but looking to look put together. I'm not sure that I saw any skincare benefits, though.

author: Nicole
headline: Great summer product
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is just as described in the bottle.  It is a sheer face tint with a lot of benefits packed in.   It's very sheer so I think this would be great in the summer and goes on smooth and light.   There is not really a smell which I like and so far it's left my skin feeling soft and clear.

author: Brigid
headline: Love this balm!
comment: I really enjoy using this product that I received as part of the Gloss Angeles Confidential program! I love the creamy but light texture. I feels great in my skin and gives just enough coverage to even out my skin (light coverage headed toward medium). I'm not sure if the blam improve the appearance of my skin but I like knowing the ingredients are at least complimentary to my skin rather than irritating it. I would definitely repurchase.

author: Matija
headline: Lovely balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm is simply amazing. It blends effortlessly covering minor imperfections. It is an all day wear balm and i dont have to reapply it throughout the day. Washes off effortlessly at the end of the day. Highly recommend it.

author: Amber
headline: Great for a no makeup makeup look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed using this sheer tint face balm. I tested it on moisturized skin with no face primer so I could see how it performed on its own, and it gives a very natural, healthy looking finish. It feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin and blends easily when pressed in, more like skincare than makeup.

The coverage is sheer but it does help even things out while still letting natural skin show through, which I really like for everyday wear. It doesn't feel heavy or sticky and wears comfortably throughout the day without settling into fine lines. My skin looks fresh and hydrated rather than fully made up.

This is a great option for anyone who prefers a minimal, no makeup makeup look and wants something quick and easy that still makes skin look nice.

author: Jessica
headline: Your skin but better!
comment:
I received this product to test through Gloss Angeles, and overall I've really enjoyed using it. The texture is lightweight and smooth, and perfect for quick, everyday makeup.

I don't love heavy foundation products and tend to prioritize skincare, so this felt ideal for me. It keeps my skin feeling like my skin, just a bit more glowy and hydrated. The coverage is very sheer, which I personally love, though while the product claims to be buildable, I didn't find that I could achieve much additional coverage with layering.

The product also claims to "transform skin instantly and over time." While I appreciate the instant hydrated, healthy look it gives, I haven't noticed a visible long-term change in my skin after about a month of use—though it may be something that takes more time. That said, this fits perfectly into my routine, and I would absolutely repurchase it.

author: Kylie
headline: Great!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is so good! I was so worried it was not going to blend into my skin and would be way too light. But! It blends like a dream and wears comfortably. The shade was actually perfect too.

author: Sophia
headline: Gifted from Gloss Angeles
comment: Thought this was such a nice base product. A true tinted moisturizer. It felt as if I was applying my regular lotion to my face but gave a nice tint and hydration.

author: Kaitlyn
headline: Blendable
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Really excited for this face balm from IT cosmetics for my honest review. The texture was nice, like a combination of balm and a moisturizer but it was a little odd to apply. The feel is silky smooth and it blends and builds nicely.

author: Candace
headline: Love it!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint is lightweight and has great coverage. The texture is very soft with an all day long lasting wear. It looks very natural as I love. Definitely will continue with this brand!

author: Alicia
headline: Perfect coverage and finish for no makeup-makeup
comment: The texture of this product is so unique, like if Glossier Stretch Concealer had a baby with a water cream.  I applied with my fingers and it went on smoothly and easily, and really evened out my skin without looking or feeling like makeup.  I did notice that when my picture was taken with a polaroid camera at my office's holiday party, my face looked flat and white (think Queen Elizabeth I), but how often do we take pictures on an old polaroid camera these days?  Overall I loved the face balm, it is now my go-to complexion product.  Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for sending me this product as part of your seeding program!

author: Marina J
headline: Love it!
comment: I received this from Gloss Angeles Confidential to try. I'm a huge fan of skin tints and this one doesn't disappoint. It's super easy to blend and is very sheer. It looks very nice on my combo skin - just makes me look more pulled together while running errands. It does get a little shiny around the tzone but nothing powder can't fix. The pot takes getting used to. Having the right size brush helps.

author: Maranatha
headline: Sheer & Buildable
comment: This was unexpected! I was able to try this product via Gloss Angeles Confidential and when they said skin tint, I had a certain type of packaging in mind but this was in a little jar that is a bit larger than a concealer pot. So it is set apart in that way. In terms of application, using a brush was less effective than getting it warmed up with clean fingers and swiping on face and then smoothing with a brush. It provides nice light coverage and it buildable and plays well with skincare products. Did not seem to cause any breakout issues or reactions while using. I love because I prefer a light coverage anything on my face.

author: Andrea
headline: I would recommend
comment: I was able to test this product through Gloss Angeles. It is a sheer product, just like they advertise. I tried with a beauty sponge and my fingers and it blended nicely into my skin with either one. I don't have flawless skin, I would have to put concealer over my red areas to achieve the coverage i wanted. The concealer went over flawlessly though with no issues mixing the product. It evened out my skin tone and felt like a moisturizer at the same time. It was a very comfortable product that you could leave or layer as needed. I would recommend this to anyone for a day to day look or someone who just wants to even out their skin tone.

author: Kristen
headline: Feels luxurious!
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. This was my first time trying IT Cosmetics and a foundation/tint balm, so I wasn't sure what to expect, but it ended up being one of the best products I've tried in a while. I have sensitive, combo-to-oily skin with rosacea and usually struggle to find shades and formulas that work, but this one really checked a lot of boxes for me. The shades are surprisingly flexible! I used 110 Fairest Neutral and 125 Fair Cool, and both blended into my skin beautifully. It felt super lightweight, gave natural-looking coverage, and didn't cause any irritation at all. I wear a luminous sunscreen underneath, which worked well texture-wise but did make me look oilier faster. Setting powder helps, but the shine does come through as the day goes on and the balm can shift a bit. I think this would work even better on drier skin or with a light sunscreen or primer. I applied well using both my fingers and a brush, though the brush gave a little more coverage. Even with daily use, I can tell these balms will last me a while, and I'm excited to see the skincare benefits as time goes on.

author: elisa
headline: Pleasantly Surprised
comment: I am in my 50's and have been struggling with melasma for the last 2 years.  This product does not cover my brown spots but it does give my skin a nice boost and evens out my skin tone. Perfect for minimal makeup days.  This item was gifted*

author: Idalys
headline: Feels like skin
comment: I was gifted this balm by Gloss Angeles. This balm has significantly improved my skin's hydration, making it feel much less dry and more like normal skin. It has a lightweight texture that doesn't clog my pores, ensuring my skin remains breathable. Additionally, I can layer the balm to build up more coverage if desired, it provides the versatility for my combination skin.

author: A Must Have
headline: A Great Foundation/ Tint
comment: I received this product from Gloss Angeles in exchange for my honest review. I am genuinely surprised and amazed with this product. It has become a staple in my makeup routine. It feels like i have nothing on my face but covers all my acne scars and pigmentation. I love how its buildable too so if you want more coverage you put more product on. Its also pretty easy to apply, i swirl a brush into the pot and then put it on my face. I have senstive + acne prone skin and it has not broken me out either. I love it!!

author: Sammy B
headline: Beautiful glowy finish
comment: I enjoyed using this balm. It was both lightweight and glowy. My only critique is that it is not super long lasting. However, I still use it becaue the finish is so nice! It definitely has a plumping effect. I received this product for testing from Gloss Angeles confidential.

author: Mariah
headline: Natural, lightweight finish but still provides coverage
comment: I received this product to test from Gloss Angeles Confidential. I received two shades and both actually worked well for me.  It is a really nice, lightweight consistency and did not crease or look cakey, but still provided enough coverage.

author: Sofia
headline: A great do-it-all product for those with a minimal routine
comment:
I was very excited to test out the new IT cosmetics do it all balm with Gloss Angeles Confidential but unfortunately found it to not work for me. The balm itself is a super hydrating, serum-y consistency (almost mousse-like) and actually gave more coverage than expected (light to low-medium). It took some trial and error to find an application method that I liked but found that it applied best with a brush/sponge combo. Coverage was good, finish was beautiful!

The issue I kept running into is that it never fully absorbed into my skin (normal-dry) and continued to move around throughout the day. I found that the product worked best when I used minimal to no skincare in the mornings, allowing the balm to act as both skincare and makeup! Since that's the case, i do wish they had found a way to incorporate spf into the formula. I really did like the product but just wasn't a fit for me - however I passed it off to my (much lower-maintenance) mother and she loves it! While it didn't work for me, I'd still recommend for someone with a minimal routine looking for a do-it-all product.

author: Jamie
headline: Nice face tint!
comment: This face tint texture reminded me of an elevated dream mousse by maybelline. Easy to apply and provided a nice dewy light coverage. I do think I needed a shade lighter. I had the opportunity to test this product through gloss Angeles

author: Carinne
headline: New holy grail
comment:
I was gifted this product through gloss Angeles confidential and it did not disappoint. I work as an esthetician and don't like to wear a lot of makeup during the day (note: I can be acne prone and have some mild rosacea so I do like a little bit of coverage). This balm gave a nice sheer coverage for just a tiny bit of blurring and felt like all I had on my skin was some moisturizer. I also liked that it was buildable so in the event that I wanted a little more coverage, I had that option. I didn't notice anything substantial in terms of improvement in fine lines in my skin but I have been getting compliments from friends that my skin looks great!

If you're looking for something lightweight that keeps you feeling hydrated/dewy throughout the day, this is it. Will continue to purchase!

author: Angela
headline: Didn't work on my skin
comment: really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it didn't work well for my skin. After a few uses, I noticed minor breakouts, which isn't typical for me. I also found that the wear time didn't live up to expectations—it faded and broke down well before the end of the day. While it may work for others, this one just wasn't a good fit for me.

author: Madison
headline: Nice lightweight coverage but not great with dry patches
comment:
Overall: I like the texture, finish and color match. I would give it a 3.5/5 since I personally needed to ensure I do enough extra-hydrating skin prep ahead of time. I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for my honest review.

On first try, this balm noticeably clung to dry patches (though it did not highlight fine lines). Once I prepped my skin with extra hydration, I did like how the product blends without highlighting dryness. The color match is a perfect fit that really does seem to blend and adapt into my natural skin while still evening out redness. I typically applied with (clean!) fingers from the center of my face and worked outward.

While this balm does not moisturize enough on its own for me, I didn't notice my face feeling dry or tight throughout the day. I needed an occasional touch up just because I have a bad subconscious habit of touching my face, but touch ups blended smoothly with product applied earlier in the day. Basically, it stays "flexible" on my face but isn't sliding around, which is great!

author: Katlyn
headline: Beautiful...while it lasts
comment: I received this product to test via Gloss Angeles to test and was very excited to start using it as I usually use a different brand's skincare-containing complexion product.  Fair Neutral was a perfect match for my hard-to-match skin (so many brands miss us neutral toned super fair skinned folks) which I definitely appreciate.  I applied it with a BK beauty foundation brush and fell in love with the slight cooling sensation, your-skin-but-better light coverage, and natural finish.  Unfortunately, my love for the product was short lived as I could not get it to stay put or "set" for the life of me even with trying different primers, powder, and setting spray, product movement and transfer started happening after about 2 hours of wear. I tend to run oily but don't often run into this problem anymore.  It's really a shame because I loved everything else about it.  If a longer-lasting vetsion was released I would buy it in a heartbeat.

author: Amanda
headline: New holy grail
comment: I received this to test through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I love this product! I tend to prefer light coverage and this gives me the perfect amount of coverage while still looking natural. The texture is so unique and fun. I love how flexible the shades are. I'm terrible at shade matching myself but that's not a problem with how flexible these shades are. Both 110 and 125 worked for me. My face always looked so good whenever I wore this. I didn't see any noticeable difference from the skincare ingredients included in this product but that isn't important to me in a complexion product so that's fine. I'll definitely be repurchasing this when I run out.

author: Katie
headline: Light coverage
comment:
I recently had a laser treatment done and it helped clear up a lot of my dark spots that I was using a medium or full foundation to cover.  I was looking for something that would be lighter and just help with overall color evening.  I was so happy when I was able to try Do it all sheer tint face balm from It Cosmetics.  I already use a lot of It cosmetics products and love the CC cream.  This balm was a perfect transition for a sheet coverage product.  It helps for my fine lines to be minimized and to smooth out my skin tone.  I also really like that it has skin care ingredients as well, so my skin is also hydrated while improving my overall look.  It was easy to apply with a brush and was buildable if I need more coverage in areas.  I would use more of a flat brush to apply onto my face and get the amount over coverage I wanted.  Then I would blend out with a larger lighter brush, and my final look was very natural.  If I was particularly red in an area or had a pimple, I would apply a bit of concealer just in that area but overall, I think it gives good coverage for a uniform look.  I have combination skin and I am in my 40s. 
 
I was gifted this product from gloss angels confidential.

author: Kellyn
headline: Pleasantly surprised!
comment: To preface, I received this product as a gift from Gloss Angeles Confidential. It's not something I would typically purchase on my own, but I was genuinely blown away by it. The balm offers impressive coverage and is highly buildable—much more so than the average tinted moisturizer. I received so many compliments on my skin, with people telling me it looked smooth, flawless, and perfected. What really surprised me was that I didn't notice a dramatic difference myself at first, yet the compliments kept coming. Because of that alone, I absolutely recommend giving this product a try.

author: Lorena
headline: Great for everyday wear
comment: I was gifted this product from GlossAngeles Confidential for review purposes. This review is 100% my opinion. This face balm has helped me looked great for everyday wear. The formula is very lightweight and feels great on the skin. It covers my minor in perfections like large pores and some redness. This balm makes it seem like your skin but better. My face isnt flawless but it looks real. I use it during the week for school drop-offs and it makes me feel confident. This is my latest obsession and i will definitely be recommending it to freiwnds and family. I have combination skin and this product works well with my skin. Im in my mid 30's and have some fine lines and wrinklea but this product doesnt enhance them. I love that my skin looks healthy using this face balm.

author: Andrea S
headline: Love how natural it looks
comment: I've been wearing this foundation nonstop since i received it. I was lucky enough to be gifted this foundation in the shade light warm 215. I have light medium neutral skin and this shade was such a great match. I have dry skin and i love how smooth and natural this wears. I wore it to work and for holiday celebrations. It stays on so well and is also very buildable.

author: Amanda
headline: My new favorite go to
comment: I have been using this for almost 1 month, courtesy of Gloss Angeles. I'm new to trying balms and my 40 year old, oily skin loved it! I was gifted 2 shades and both worked with my medium, olive/neutral skin tone. I set it with powder for extra longevity but don't need to. It plays well with other creams and powders. It looks beautiful sheer, for a no makeup makeup look and is buildable for when I want more coverage. I work from home and it looks good on camera and IRL. What I love most about it is, it is so lightweight, it feels like nothing on my skin. My skin has been looking more hydrated without makeup since I've been using this. For cold, windy, December it's amazing.

author: Kay
headline: Actually love it
comment: Balm foundations aren't typically my go to for my combo skin, but I do enjoy a skincare meshed, sheer product, so I was happy to give it a try. Turns out, I actually love it! I used the fair neutral shade (mont blanc is my perfect match) and it blended into my skin tone nicely. I do have redness, and that showed through so on days when I wanted less, I used a color corrector and the balm worked perfectly with it. I think the radiant finish is accurate, if it were more dewy, I wouldn't use it. Not sure if I noticed any help with fine lines, but it certainly was hydrating and felt really nice on the skin even after a long day. Overall great product, I'll keep using it and purchase when the time comes! Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for sending and allowing me to try.

author: Jenny
headline: great tinted balm for dehydrated skin
comment:
**Nonspon review purchased with my own money** 

In my early 40s with oily but dehydrated skin, very minimal lines, mild hyperpigmentation. Let me tell you - if you're after a sheer wash of coverage that provides hydration and glow (and/or have more mature skin) this is the base for you.

I use my danessa blurring balm (universal) directly underneath. then this balm, then VERY lightly set, then blush/bronzer, then a dusting of finishing powder. I get a solid 6-8 hours of good wear time assuming I blot around the 4 hr mark. If you'e dry skinned obviously you will prep/set differently. My advice is for how oily skinned people can use this product despite it being a balm.

Since this is a balm, it looks considerably darker in the pot than on your face. So even though im a light-med tone, i went with med-cool which is a good match to my deeper body & neck. It has no spf so oxidation is little to none.

I wfh and this is perfect for my minimal makeup looks while being good for my skin. Would recommend you try!

author: Rachel
headline: Love! Perfect face tint/balm
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles for review (lucky me)! I have never used IT cosmetics, but was always curious. I received a cool tone and a neutral tone. Cool is perfect for my face, blends so well, can't tell I am wearing anything! LOVE!

author: Megm
headline: luminous foundation with a luxurious feel✨
comment: The new IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a beautiful, skincare-infused tint that delivers a natural, radiant glow with ease. Its lightweight, balm-like texture feels silky and smooth upon application, melting seamlessly into the skin without any greasy residue. The formula is incredibly buildable, allowing you to customize your coverage from sheer to medium. It has a soft, thin, balmy consistency that transforms effortlessly as you blend, whether you use your fingers, brush, or sponge. I typically like to warm the product up on the back of my hand and apply with a sponge for everyday. If I want to achieve a more glam look, I'll typically start out the same but I'll blend it out with a brush instead. Honestly, any way you use it, it comes out flawless. This balm is excellent at smoothing, by softly blurring imperfections without settling into fine lines or pores. It feels comfortable-hydrating, evens the skin, smooths, and blurs, thanks to its soft-focus properties. It has a natural-luminous finish. The glow is subtle, it just enhances your complexion without emphasizing texture or imperfections. I got a good 5-7 hours of wear each time I used it. The days it lasted 7 hours I did apply powder. I did not on the 5 hour days, but it still held up nicely without settling, (FYI I do have combo skin that's more dry leaning in the winter). Overall, the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sophisticated choice for those seeking a nourishing, luminous foundation with a luxurious feel and impeccable blendability. It's perfect for achieving a natural, radiant look with added skin benefits.

author: Dailey
headline: 5 star sheer coverage product
comment: I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. I am very much a sheer coverage girl - I love a skin tint or a very light weight foundation. This product definitely fell into this category, but is so unique from other skin tints I've tried. The formula was so smooth and melted into my skin with minimal blending. It looked great if I put it all over, and it also looked great if I just do spot coverage on redness. You can build if you want more coverage, and it still blends well. I also loved that it didn't separate in my oily spots as the day went on, and it didnt settle into fine lines. It really did melt all the way in. It felt light weight on, like I was wearing no makeup, which is a must for me. On a personal note, I found this easier to apply with my fingers as opposed to a brush. If you like sheer coverage products, I really don't think there is anything better or more comfortable out there. I will repurchase when I run out.

author: Michelle
headline: This is a must have!
comment: I am definitely an It Cosmetics girl and have lots of favorites from their line. Now I've found my ultimate favorite with this face balm. Its an innovative makeup and skincare product in one with the most unique texture that starts as a balm and proceeds to melt into skin flawlessly. This tinted moisturizer has 92% skincare ingredients to nourish and hydrate skin as it provides buildable, sheer coverage with a radiant finish. Let me tell you, my skin has never looked better! Its as if I put a filter on as my fine lines are blurred, imperfections covered and my skin looks so supple and healthy. Once again, It Cosmetics has created a winner and this one just might be one of the top products of the year. Do not hesitate to try it. Gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential

author: J
headline: Nice light skin tint
comment: I really liked this skin tint. It is very light coverage but worked great for no-makeup days and I can see using it a lot in summer when I want an even skin tone but dont want to feel like im wearing makeup. It layered well over serum, moisturizer and suncreen on my normal but mature skin. There were a few spots where it clung to dry patches from my retinol but no more than the other skin tints I use. It will be great for travel since its not a liquid! I also liked the cooling sensation I got when applying it.

author: Renee
headline: Does exactly as the name says
comment: This do it all sheer tint face balm really is just that. Provides just enough coverage for running errands or a zoom meeting and gives a gorgeous dewy glow.  Not cakey at all and really helps you look put together, but still natural looking. Thanks Gloss Angeles for the opportunity to test this product, I will definitely purchase with my own money ☺️

author: Allie Wilson
headline: Wanted to love this, but it's a bit finicky!
comment: I have mixed feelings about this product! I loved the idea of a serum foundation that was sheer and easy to apply. I do agree that it's very easy to apply, which is great as I have a toddler and not a ton of time to get ready! I use a brush. I did find it to be a bit finicky depending on my skincare routine. For example, I noticed the product would break up depending on which sunscreen I used. I also noticed it clung to dry patches, which seems to go against some of their claims about it being hydrating. The product claims to "visibly firm" but I can't say I noticed any difference in my skin related to that. Overall, I think this product would work for you if you use minimal skincare underneath and don't have any skin issues. I received this product as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Kalynn
headline: No makeup makeup
comment: I have to admit at first I was very flummoxed by this product.  Is it skincare?  Is it makeup?  As someone that does not have flawless skin, I cannot use this as my everyday complexion product.  However, on days when my skin is feeling good, I do reach for it.  Sometimes all add some concealer to round it out or if I'm looming for a little extra coverage.  I find that even though it doesnt cover much, it does have a blurring effect.  Because of the sheerness, the shades are forgiving.  Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential, for the opportunity to try this product.  I look forward to continuing to experiement with it!

author: Bethany
headline: Low effort, high impact
comment: This tint truly lived up to its name. I was genuinely surprised by how much coverage it provided—so much so that I didn't even need a separate primer for it to last all day. It applies incredibly smoothly, and the texture feels lightweight yet nourishing on the skin. The shade match was spot-on for my skin tone, and I also loved the sleek, practical packaging. Overall, this is a versatile, easy-to-wear product that delivers far more than I expected.

author: M
headline: Juicy radiant skin
comment:
I had really no expecations trying this my first impression was the shades run a littlt yellow but its nothing bronzer cant fix. I love the packaging and how its in a tub, I like using it with a dense brush for more coverage, but its a lightweight, airy texture… I persoanlly love the feel of it and finish, like I ssid this product kind of surprised me!!

*** I was gifted this from Gloss Angeles Confidetial ***

author: Melaney
headline: Amazing skin tint for a glowing appearance
comment: I have used this product for about a month and will purchase again! I received as part of Gloss Angeles confidential. I preferred using a brush to apply and found the coverage adequate and slightly buildable to cover unevenness (I still needed concealer for covering red spots).
