The color blends well into your skin and looks natural. The finish feels hydrating and provides a illuminating finish and wears well through the day. I had no reaction with my skin and even traveled with the product to wear on vacation! I had never using any products from it before or a balm for complexion and this was a great introduction to the brand.

author: Cat Kim
headline: Just what I've been looking for!
comment: I've been searching for a product that has the light coverage, but also has great skin care benefits. A tinted moisturizer never had the coverage that I was looking for, however, this product is beautifully formulated and gives just the right amount of coverage so that I don't have to wear a foundation, but I feel confident enough to be out in the world And it evens out my complexion so beautifully. The skin care benefits are definitely a huge plus. I would still purchase this product even if the benefits weren't included just because it sits so beautifully on my skin. I use a foundation brush to apply the bomb and it drives pretty quickly and I can put my whole contour blush highlighter situation, and lightly powder my tea zone and I'm set for the day. I am so shocked at how long the product stayed on my face throughout the day, this would be a perfect my skin, but better found foundation for the summer when you just wanna have a light layer of coverage. Huge fan! I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential but will purchase once I'm finished with this jar.

author: Giovi
headline: Smooth as butter
comment: I got to test this face balm through the Gloss Angeles Confidential program, and it's one of the best products I've ever tested. Smooth as butter, SUPER easy to apply, and perfect for someone like me who wears light makeup but still wants to cover up some spots and texture here and there. This has become a staple in my beauty routine!

author: KK
headline: Feels wonderful
comment: This product has be ome my every day face makeup.  It feels so good on the skin.  It is so weightless and comfortable and really makes your skin look great.  It does not give a ton of coverage and i have some age spots that i like to cover when i go out for something special, so i use another product for that.  It does say that it is buildable but I didn't have much luck with that.  Im not sure about long term benefits as it's only been a few weeks of use.  I have been given this product from It and Gloss Angeles Confidential for my honest review.

author: Leah
headline: The perfect non-foundation foundation
comment: I usually don't wear foundation, but I'm always on the hunt for skin tints that give light-to-medium coverage while still looking like skin. This one honestly exceeded my expectations. The finish was so nice and natural, and it truly didn't feel like I was wearing makeup at all, which is exactly what I look for. The coverage was surprisingly great and very buildable. I was impressed with how well it covered acne redness, which is my main concern. I applied it with my hands and mixed it with bronzing drops, and the result was a glowy skin look. Definitely adding this into my makeup routine. Thank you Gloss Angleles, for introducing me to this amazing product.

author: Ashley
headline: This is perfect product for a low maintenance gal
comment: I don't like face products & can barely tolerate a skin tint. This product surprised me. It pairs beautifully with all my other products. I have dry, sensitive skin & this doesn't irritate it. I will repurchase & I was gifted this.

author: laurynm
headline: Light and buildable tint!
comment: Thanks to Gloss Angeles Confidential, I was able to review this product. I am a big fan of tint products because they are light and get the job done. This was my first time trying IT Cosmetics and I loved it. This product is light and can build coverage. Its not full coverage since its a tint, but it covered my hyperpigmentation spots nicely! I like how small and compact of a product it is so it can travel with me in my purse if I need a touch up. I do wish it came with a small spatula or something (kind of like how the Danessa Myricks balm product comes with a small spatula) so you can easily pick up the product and not have to use fingers. But you can just dip you brush directly into the container. Overall, I highly recommend this product! (very beginner friendly for all makeup newbies)

author: SS
headline: Impressed
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles in exchange for an honest review. I am 35 and have combo acne prone skin, it can be quite reactive at times too. This is such a convenient and nice product. A little goes a long way and it blends so seamlessly into the skin. I use a stiff slighty tapered brush to add to areas where I am red or have some uneven skin. I get lots of compliments on how glowy my skin looks when I use this, I am impressed!

author: Nurseeejo
headline: PCOS hormonal acne game changer !!!!
comment: I got the opportunity to try this tint face balm through my bestie gloss angeles confidential and let me tellll you besties my skin was LOVING IT !!! Im a pcos hormonoal acne prone girly and my face had no breakouts or bad reactions. I love that i was able to build up to it , i could do an effortless glowy look or build up to a full glam ! I also was able to use my beauty blender and brush and had no issues applying the product ! A little goes a long way besties so definitely worth the price ! Skin care and face balm you cant go wrong with that !! My new go to product and cant wait to continue to incorporate to my skin care routine !! I love how it also incorporated skin care ingredients collagen , peptides , vitamin c , hyaloronic acid ! 10/10 recommend besties !

author: Yuki
headline: Not my favorite
comment: I wish the shade selection was better for fair to light skintones. This didnt work out for me unfortunately. I received this product through Gloss Angelos Confidential.

author: Katie
headline: Wow
comment: I was gifted this product from gloss angles! I am a no makeup, makeup lover and this fits that bill perfectly! Gives just the perfect coverage and still looks like my skin! It wears really well for me, and plays well with my other products! Very impressed!

author: Fawn
headline: I would purchase this!
comment:
I received this product via Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for an honest review. I'm in my early 40s with combination skin and minimal fine lines. I received the shades Fair Cool and Light Warm, and Fair Cool ended up being the best match for my skin, which surprised me since I usually consider myself light with neutral undertones. I plan to try Light Neutral as well, as that may be an even better match.

The formula sinks into the skin easily and has a lightweight, glowy finish with very sheer coverage that softly blurs discoloration and imperfections. It's not buildable—layering doesn't add coverage—but it looks very natural. Applying with my fingers worked best; brushes seemed to waste product, though I lightly tapped with one at the end and set with a small amount of loose powder.

There's a subtle cooling effect on application (not menthol-like). I didn't experience any pilling, and it wore well throughout the day. I noticed minor caking around my nose once due to dryness, which improved with light exfoliation and less product in that area.

I love the glass packaging, it feels elevated and well-made. Overall, this is an easy, everyday "no-makeup makeup" option if you don't have much to cover. I would recommend and purchase this.

author: Maleah
headline: Loved It
comment: This product left a very nice finsihed on my skin and I didnt feel like it weight ny skin down like most face balms. This also hVe a very buildable coverage if you wanted a fuller coverage.

author: Julianne
headline: This is a good one
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles for review. I enjoyed the texture and the way it builds when applied. I love how sheer it is but while still giving a great level of coverage! After I apply it I put on powder and it's perfect. Given the reasonable price point and the way it makes my skin feel, I will definitely re-purchase!

author: CeCe
headline: My new go-to!
comment: I am so grateful I had the opportunity to try the Do It All balm as part of the Gloss Angeles Confidential program! It is a beautiful product - goes on smoothly & lasts all day. It has just enough coverage to even my skin tone but still looks natural. My skin looked glowy but not 'wet'. My dry, mature skin loved this product & I will buy again!

author: Laura H.
headline: Great for Gym, Little to No Makeup Needs
comment:
I was gifted this product to try by Gloss Angeles.

Love that this is skin care and the easy way it applies and feels on! For young skin, this could be perfect for everyday, but alas, I'm 40 and basically dead, haha, so I need something a bit more. I loved wearing this to my fancy bootcamp, though!

author: Allison
headline: Absolutely incredible!
comment: I've finally found my perfect daily foundation. The texture feels amazing and it provides a super natural, skin-like finish that lasts all day. It's officially a staple in my routine. Thank you so much to Gloss Angeles for the opportunity to test this!

author: Emma
headline: super soft on the skin
comment: It blends very easily, it's not heavy, and it leaves a perfect finish, very light and natural.

author: Maddie L.
headline: Great hydrating sheer coverage balm!
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential for review. I have been testing this product for the past few weeks, and have really enjoyed it! This product is a lightweight, sheer, hydrating balm foundation. As someone with dry skin, even more so in the winter, I was pleasantly surprised by how well this foundation hydrated my skin. One day my skin felt a bit tight, even after applying my moisturizer, so I tried the balm without any additional hydrating products to really test how well it hydrated. I was pleasantly surprised to find that after application my skin no longer felt tight and it appeared plump and hydrated as well. Because of the products lightweight texture and hydrating formula I found that it helped to minimize the appearance of fine lines I have on my forehead, where drier foundations can sink into and exaggerate them. The coverage on the product is relatively low. I think it can be built up to somewhere in the light (maybe verging on a light medium coverage) range, but I believe its intent is to be a sheer layer of color and coverage, which it achieves. I did notice that the hydrating nature of this product meant that it never fully set and could potentially transfer if I touched my face with my hands or had foundation on my neck that got onto my shirt. That being said, a layer of powder will help midigate the transfer (albeit taking away the hydrated appearance on the skin). My only other critique comes for the shade range. The range is described as flexible (likely due to how sheer it is) and while I could absolutely wear the light warm shade without it appearing completely off it did look a bit warm on my light olive skintone. Overall, I think you'll really enjoy this product if you're looking for something sheer and hydrating!

author: Brittany
headline: A new staple in my routine
comment: I tested this product as part of Gloss Angeles and am obsessed with it! It is so easy to use, i applt it with my mario f4 brush and it gives me just the right amount of coverage for day to day, but i find i can also build it up if i wanted to. I will be absolutely purchasing this!

author: LC
headline: Great skin tint
comment:
I wasnt sure about this skin tint balm from seeing it in the packaging and was sure how to apply. I forst tried using my fingers but did not like that method. I also wasnt sure on the shades as they seemed too dark. I then used a brush and found I liked this application better. The shades adjusted to my skin. I liked the buildable coverage and how it made my skin look smooth. It also feels weightless. I did find woth my oily skin that I did have control that throughout the day but overall happy with the coverage and wear. One down side is i feel like my blush doesnt apply and look as pigmented as it should. While I do like the coverage not sure if I'll repurchase due to the oilyness of my skin. 

Thanks Gloss Angeles Confidential and IT cosmetics for the opportunity to try this product out.

author: Shawen
headline: Sheer and comfortable
comment: This was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential for my honest review. The coverage is sheer and slightly buildable to a light coverage, not medium. The cooling sensation of the product (presumably due to the water content/serum texture) is really lovely. I found this really enjoyable but would not expect medium or high coverage from it. it is a really nice base layer to a light makeup day, and I like it best when I add a little concealer after using it.

author: Juliana
headline: Don't judge a balm by its cover
comment: I was lucky enough to try this early through Gloss Angeles Confidential, and it has completely changed my view on balm foundations. When I first opened the jar, I was definitely skeptical about the color match, but once it touches your skin, it adapts beautifully and looks incredibly natural. It has become my favorite portable option for travel because it's a solid—no leaks in the bag and perfect for quick touch-ups.

author: Kim
headline: Amazing, my new favorite product!
comment: I got to test out this product through Gloss Angeles and I am absolutely blown away. I have used several other skin tints before but this product is next level. It blends in seamlessly, doesn't dry out my skin, and was the perfect shade match. It left my skin looking glowy and radiant. Would highly recommend

author: Catherine
headline: Amazing, no notes !
comment: I was fortunate enough to try this product ahead of launch through Gloss Angeles confidential and wow am i impressed. I have used it cosmetics since I was in high school and I'll be 30 this year. This product is super moisturizing, I was even able to wear it post micro needling with dry,flaky skin and it still looked really great hours after application. The shade range and cosistency makes the producy very forgiving. My skin looked great with two different shades. Throughout the entire testing time, multiple people commented on my skin and asked me what I was has done differently because they couldn't believe I had nothing but just a little bit of coverage. They all thought I wasn't wearing any makeup so it truly is the perfect natural everyday product. Having used it every day since I received it with touchups throughout the day, there is still a ton of product left. I think this is a product everybody would benefit from especially for the price. It'll last you a very long time. I would highly recommend trying if you've tried other cosmetic products of them or if you've never tried the product line at all. Cant wait tobtry the othwr products in the line and will be repurchasing

author: Cynthia
headline: So good!
comment: I enjoyed using this tinted face balm as i have enjoyed suing something light and breathable on my skin! The color was so nice on my skin and really did look lik my own skin but better! Gifted from gloss angeles

author: Rida
headline: Sooo smooth
comment: This one is a must have for me. I literally love this product not only is it so smooth, but it gives me such amazing coverage. This product is incredibly smooth. It goes onto the skin and beautifully and it layers very well on other makeup products. It lasts so long throughout the day and I don't have any creasing or separating.

author: CamCoo
headline: Balm with a Beautiful Finish
comment:
I was sent the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Balm for my honest review as an esthetician. I swapped my usual skin tint out for this product, and kept my skincare routine the same otherwise.

From a skin professional's standpoint, this is a complexion product designed to enhance—not mask—your natural skin. The coverage is buildable from sheer to semi-sheer, making it ideal for clients who want a "your skin but better" finish rather than full coverage. Even when layered, your natural skin still shines through, which I personally appreciate for a more realistic, healthy-looking complexion.

The texture is especially noteworthy. It starts as a semi-solid, almost butter-like consistency, and melts effortlessly into the skin upon application. It's very user-friendly and can be applied with fingers, a brush, or a sponge; however, I achieved the most seamless finish using a sponge.

In terms of wear, it performs reasonably well throughout the day. I did notice some breakdown by midday in my oilier areas—around the nose and between the brows. For reference, my skin is combination, leaning normal to dry with a few oil-prone zones. Because of its dewy finish, I don't think this formula will be a good choice for very oily or oil-dominant combination skin types.

While I appreciate the inclusion of skincare benefits, I didn't notice any significant improvement in my skin over time. That said, as someone with rosacea and eczema-prone skin, the formula was gentle. I experienced no irritation, sensitivities, or flare-ups, which speaks highly to its formulation.

Overall, this is a beautiful option for normal to dry skin types or anyone seeking a radiant, skin-first complexion product that prioritizes skin health and a natural glow over heavy coverage.

author: Rocelia
headline: My new daily skin tint
comment: First off thanks to It cosmetics and Gloss Angeles Confidential for giving me the opportunity to test this product. While i was gifted this product this us my honest review. First thing, this applied beautifully for me. It has a cooling effect which i love! Next I found the product easy to blend and provide a nice light natural looking coverage. I also found that it lasted throughout the day. Finally i found this product to blend and match my skin tone perfectly. This will continue to be in my rotation. Definitely recommend this product.

author: KJ
headline: Easy to apply, great for dry skin
comment: I have extremely dry skin so this was a great product for the winter months. It was easy to apply with a brush/sponge combo method. It made my skin feel hydrated with enough coverage to hid any imperfections.

author: Hil
headline: Using This Non-stop
comment: I got to try this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential and I love it. Like I LOVE it. I got the neutral light and light warm colors, and the light neutral blends like a dream. this product is hydrating and so lightweight, I often forget that I even have it on! The coverage is light, but it's also more than I expected. If you're a fan of skin tints, I say go for it. If you like something with a little more coverage, you may not enjoy this. I found that it looked best when blended with my fingers or a sponge, but I'm sure that's dependent per person. I've been using this nonstop, and I will definitely repurchase in my shade. The other shade sent was flexible enough to where it could work in a pinch, but light neutral was just really where it was at for me.

author: Mere927
headline: Dewy and soft
comment: I really enoyed this product for a quick foundation application! It evened ny redness and felt like skincare.

author: Ally
headline: Obsessed!
comment: This is the perfect looks-like-your-skin sheer tint w/ light buildable coverage! The texture is AMAZING. It feels like a soft cloud going on. Definitely more skincare feeling than makeup feeling. When on, I can't feel it at all and the coverage is gorg!

author: Metalflower71
headline: Looks great on skin!
comment:
This product was a gift from Gloss Angeles.

This is a great balm. As promised, its sheer and flexible to skin tone. So many products fail at this. At first, looking at it in the jar, I thought it would be too dark. After applying moisturizer I used a good amount of balm. It needs a minute to blend into your skin. The coverage is definitely sheer and it looks more natural than any other product I have used. I would prefer not to use any complexion makeup, but I have melasma that needs to be softened out. This face balm isn't trying to hide anything. Nice and natural. I don't believe it has changed my skin in any way. It does contain hydrating ingredients which makes it a great choice for my dry skin. The balm did feel good at the end of the day and didn't look or feel cakey even after applying sunscreen multiple times a day. That's amazing! I have a few tinted moisturizers that I will no longer use as this balm is so much better.

author: Sara
headline: A wonderful "glass skin" natural look
comment: I received this product from Gloss Angels to test—loved it! I'm 40 and I think I would like this product even better in the summer when I have a little color on my face. It's very sheer and I tend to need more coverage, but this is absolutely perfect for days where you don't want to do a full face. Work from home, running errands, etc. IT Cosmetics does a great job of making products that make your face look natural and flowing. I use the CC cream for move coverage if that gives you an idea of the sheerness of this product.

author: Adrianne
headline: Smooth texture and Hydration
comment: This is a super versatile tint balm — great for everyday wear, travel days, or whenever you want to look like you woke up glowing. Would definitely repurchase if you're into that effortless, skin-first makeup style.

author: Laura
headline: My new favorite makeup product
comment: I'm so happy to have had the chance to test out this tinted face balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I've used and loved IT Cosmetics's CC cream in the past, but lately I've been gravitating towards lower coverage complexion products. It's been years since I've consistently used an all-over product like foundation, opting instead for spot coverage with concealer, but sometimes I still want a little something more. This balm checks off all the boxes for me! It's lightweight with sheer, yet buildable, coverage. It doesn't oxidize on my skin or get flaky, nor does it wear off quickly like some products of this nature do. The shades are also quite flexible. I tried fairest neutral and fair warm. Both work on my skin tone, and they are perfect when blended together. I don't know that I tested the product for long enough to comment on the skincare claims, but I'm optimistic. Cannot recommend this highly enough if you're looking for sheer, natural coverage!

author: Lindsay
headline: Miracle in a Jar!
comment:
I trialed this product for 4 weeks as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential. 

I was happy to see the packaging was a jar for ease of use and I don't feel I am leaving any product behind. I will be honest at first I found it challenging to use and get the right coverage. But patience is a virtue and I quickly learned that letting it settle on your skin before applying more is the best route. The lightweight formula goes on with ease and don't feel heavy. About week 3.5 I started to notice my skin look and feel firmer. I was happy with the buildable coverage and the finish was very natural.

author: Shay
headline: Amazing everyday balm
comment:
I got the opportunity to try this beautiful balm recently. I took it with me during my holiday travels as a replacement for my moisturizer and foundation. It looked great all day and night, both in person and in photos, every single day. 
The texture of this balm is silky and sheer with a little going a long way on application. It evens skin tone while beautifully masking texture, pores and slight imperfections. The skin loving addition of Hyaluronic acid, collagen and vitamin E keep it from settling in fine lines-regardless of if it's set or not- while also hydrating and plumping them. It blends perfectly with both cream and powder products without becoming cakey, separating or pilling. I absolutely loved this product and formula on my skin in the winter months and I'm excited to see how well it does during the summer!

author: Loved the feeling!
headline: Refreshed
comment: At first i wasnt sure how to use the product but aftwr seeing someone apply it with a flat brush, theb i let it warm up to my skins temperature a out 30 seconds it quickly melted in! I loved the feel of this! I do feel like i went theough half the jar in 1 month but maybei used too much lol. On days that i wanted more coverage i was able to apply a concealor and had no issues mising the two! I was gifted this in exchange for my honest review from Gloss Angeles

author: Michelle
headline: This product has become a new favorite!
comment: I have been REALLY enjoying the texture of this face balm. It has nice coverage to disguise redness/uneven skin tone but not too much that my freckles get covered up. It has a cooling and soothing effect on my sensitive skin and can be built up for more coverage in areas that I need it. I have been applying this product with the dual ended complexion perfection brush but also love blending it with my fingers. Thank you It Cosmetics & Gloss Angeles Confidential for gifting me this product!

author: Marlene
headline: New favorite skin tint!
comment: I have to say I wasn't sure how I would like this but I have completed fallen in love with it! It has quickly become my go to skin tint! It so easy to apply and blends out like a dream. I love the texture of it and how buildable it is. I'm impressed with the staying power it has as well! I was gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Kaelyn
headline: The perfect skin tint!!
comment:
I've been searching for the perfect skin tint for years and this is it. My first reaction was that I did not like the jar but I very quickly got over that because I have good control over how much I use. It applies beautifully and is buildable. It feels great on my skin and still usually looks good by the end of my workday. 

I'm not sure that I've seen any long term skin care benefits, aside from it feeling hydrating as I wear it, but this doesn't matter to me because the rest of the product is great. I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Hayley
headline: Beautiful glowy coverage
comment: I was gifted this product to try by Gloss Angeles Confidential. I've used their CC cream in the past and found it a bit too thick but this had very beautiful and buildable coverage! It was easy to do a sheer wash or add more product where needed but still looked like skin! The only issue I had was that it stayed a bit slick feeling on my skin (I can get oily in t zone) and would need some extra powder. If you are on the dryer side I could see this product being perfect for you!

author: sara (no h)
headline: Obsessed!
comment: I was fortunate enough to test this product ahead of launch through Gloss Angeles Confidential and wow, I'm in love! As a oily combo girlie, this doesnt feel heavy on my skin at all, and it has skin care benefits. I found that I liked it best when applied with a damp beauty blender, and I set very very lightly with a translucent powder just along my t-zone. This may be slightly too creamy for me for the really hot summer months, but for the fall and winter, its perfect. I don't tend to wear complexion products during the week when I work from home but this has been a great no-makeup-makeup skin enhancer for me that I can wear every day.

author: Jess
headline: your skin but better vibes
comment:
I was gifted this product via Gloss Angeles Confidential to test pre-launch. and honestly I didn't expect to love this product as much as I do

It's called a balm but it's extremely lightweight and skin-like. It meshes into the skin really well and you can barely tell it's makeup it just makes the overall appearance if your skin look nicer. It's the type of product you can wear with a face full of other makeup or even as the only makeup on your face (like sometimes wearing a base with more coverage and then no othe rmakeup looks weird on me lol)

It's lower coverage and somewhat buildable but don't expect medium/high coverage out of this. I typically only wear lighter coverage base products and concealers layered over it really nicely so I had zero issues with this. also for me it lasted longer than most light coverage base products but thinking maybe because it kind of sets down into the skinlike finish?

this is incredibly random and maybe niche but it sat on my nose well. many times base products look weird on my nose but this one truly just evened out the tone without looking like makeup (which i loved since i'm blowing my nose every 2 seconds this winter)

tldr; super lightweight and skinlike tint with a natural finish

author: Faith Harvey
headline: User Friendly, Incredibly Smooth!
comment:
I was lucky enough to use this product through the Gloss Angeles Confidential program, and am truly so impressed with this product! 

I am not a foundation wearer, I typically use a tinted sunscreen, so the idea of a coverage product had me slightly intimidated. However, from the first application alone, I realized this product was perfect for my light coverage, glowy look. I used a foundation brush to glide the product over my skin and automatically noticed a soft layer of product that enhanced my skins natural color while taking away any redness and discoloration. I first wore this product at night, and even in the dark there was a pretty sheen present on my face all night. Additionally, this product came off super easily upon removal with a cleansing balm. I will definitely be repurchasing for when I want to have a little extra coverage and softer looking skin!

author: Kristen
headline: Found My New Complexion Product
comment:
As a busy mom who only has time for a very minimal face, I'm so happy this product exists! It's like nothing I've ever tried before. Goes on light, blends into your skin seamlessly and feels hydrating without being dewy (sorry not sorry, but I cannot pull off that look). It's definitely light coverage, but for me it's just the right amount. It took me a few tries to figure out application, but what works for me is picking up the product with a flat brush to apply, and then blending it with a sponge or foundation brush. It's just easy, effortless and wears great all day long. I'm obsessed. 

I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential for my honest review.

author: heike
headline: My new favorite
comment:
I absolutely love this product! I'm a huge skin tint lover and have tried so many over the years...I always found myself going back to my tried-and-true Glossier Skin Tint. But let me tell you, this sheer tint face balm is now my holy grail. The texture, the wear, and the way it looks and feels on my skin are pure perfection. I've never used anything quite like it. It's incredibly easy to apply and gives me just enough coverage for a healthy glow while evening out my redness...yet it still looks like my skin. It feels light and airy and lasts all day.
I truly can't say enough good things about this product. I'm obsessed, and this tint will forever be a staple in my makeup collection. Thank you so much, Gloss Angeles Confidential, for this opportunity!

author: Carlee
headline: Love!
comment: This lightweight balm makes my skin glow! It is so light and has really great buildable coverage. It really doesnt feel like you're wearing anything! Its tricky at first to learn how to use, but I learned the fingers are the best to warm up and blend into the skin. I received this to try from Gloss Angeles and will be repurchasing! love!!

author: Christina
headline: Love at first swipe
comment:
I received this product through the Gloss Angeles Confidential program. I have been using this product for about 1 month almost daily and it has become my preferred product for complexion. 
It provides a sheer but even coverage, and it blends in so easily without settling in my enlarged pores and acne scars. 
I even had more complements recently of looking more "glowy"!

author: Kass
headline: Great New Product
comment: Ive used this for a month and really love it. I have forehead acne and even though its light coverage it mostly covers it. It has improved my combo skin texture and has a great feel. The color blends well and didnt need to be a perfect match. I love it for those minimal makeup days!  Definitely will keep using.

author: Skinwithd
headline: My new everyday coverage
comment: I received this as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential. I absolurely adore this skin tint! It looks so natural and slightly dewy, and it lasts all day for me. It provides the perfect amount of sheer coverage for daily use. And, it's so easy to travel with! I will definitely repurchase.

author: Erin
headline: This is what I've been looking for!!!!
comment: I received this skin tint as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential and I absolutely love it!!!! I've been looking for something with medium coverage that just looks like my skin. This is it!!!! I apply it with my fingers and then just blend it out with a brush or my fingers. Both methods work great. It gives my skin a blurred look without being heavy and opaque. It looks like my skin just better!  This skin tint does not settle into my fine lines and it lasts all day. It feels great on my skin and dare I say my skin looks better now than when I starting using it. I am extremely happy with this product and I will happily repurchase it. I have not enthusiastically liked a product as much as I like this skin tint in a very long time. You should try it out!

author: Carolina
headline: Pleasantly surprised!
comment: I tried this product for over 30 days and did not use any other foundation or skin tint to see if the skincare benefits would be noticeable. I was skeptical when I saw the jar packaging because all other balms in jars I've tried in the past have all been disappointing - either too balmy and greasy, or too dry-looking and chalky. I was pleasantly surprised at how amazing this felt on my skin upon first application - very cooling and soothing, like a water cream. The coverage was not too sheer and not heavy. I was able to get a medium coverage using a brush and only needed to build it up with a second layer on my cheeks where I have some redness. For full glam days, I added some concealer and set lighly with powder (for the record, I'm 52 with combo skin). For everyday, I mainly just set my T-zone with powder. This skin tint worked well with both cream products layered on top as well as powder products. I noticed that my skin looked smoother and more radiant over the course of the month and looked forward to putting this product on my skin daily. I also noticed that when I took this makeup off, I saw a lot less clogged pores on my chin and nose, which are problem areas. I'm happy to have found a new favorite complexion product and will definitely re-purchase, though it seems that this jar will last me a very long time. I'm not sure that it would work on a very oily complexion due to the balmy feel and radiant finish. The only con is the glass packaging. I probably wouldn't travel with it.

author: Brooke
headline: Great lightweight coverage
comment: I was give the opportunity through Gloss Angles Confidential to try 2 great shades of this product.  The color matches for both shades given were amazing. I was very pleased with how well it blended and appears to smooth some fine lines. It is a lighter weight coverage that I will use in the summer as an alternative to a full coverage foundation.  My skin has a smooth, healthy look when the product is applied. The coverage lasted all day for me and my skin never felt dry.  I was very impressed with the product and will continue to use it.

author: Olivia
headline: Not for me, but for someone
comment: The idea behind this product got me really excited, but the execution just didn't do anything I needed. It was heavy enough that it made my skin appear really flat and colorless, but not heavy enough to cover spots. It also has a really mousse-y whipped texture on the skin, and I could feel it sitting on top of my skin throughout the day, which I imagine would be so amazing for dry skin, but not for mine. I know this product would be great for someone, but unfortunately it's not me. I received this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for a review.

author: CJK
headline: Very Hydrating!
comment: I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential. The first time I used this I think I did a little bit too much skin prep because this looked very patchy and almost lifted off of itself as I tried to blend. This is cery hydrating which I personally love because I have very dry skin especially in the winter. This doesn't offer much coverage so sometimes I would need to layer with other products to get the coverage I wanted, but for day to day, running errands etc, this is perfect for no makeup makeup looks. It wears very well and looks the same at the end of the day as when I put it on. Overall I would recommend this product!

author: Rachel I.
headline: Like a second skin!
comment: I love how much of a second skin this face balm is. Its super lightweight, and has a fresh and glowy finish. I was able to test it out in the Florida humidity, and I did get a little extra shiny, but it wore all day long! I also wore it while visiting family in California, and still wore all day, but with a little less shine. I love how easily it evens out my skin and how natural it looks. I wish it was a little more buildable though. Would definitely recommend if you want something quick and easy that you can wear everyday, and you arent looking for something with a lot of coverage. Huge thank you to IT cosmetics and Gloss Angeles Confidential for the testing opportunity!

author: Veronika
headline: This product SHOCKED me
comment:
I received this product as part if Gloss Angeles Confidential. 

This product really shocked me! I was expecting it to transfer easily and not last all day because I have oily skin. But this balm went on so beautifully, and stayed put! When I hear the word 'balm' I tend to think of something thick that doesn't stay on the skin easily. But this product was thin (in a good way) and kept my skin hydrated all day without moving around.

As far as coverage, I was also very impressed! I would say this product gives light to medium coverage, dependent  on how much you use. I didn't expect that from something so thin and silky.

Regarding application, I found that the best way to apply to my face, was to use my fingers to pick it up and cover my face, and the news of beauty blender to even it out and give it a blurred look. 

Overall, I really loved this product and I will definitely buy when I run out!

author: Natalie
headline: Great everyday product
comment: Easy to apply and wear for daily use. Light overall coverage but enjoy this for a daytime option. I was gifted this product by the gloss Angeles team for my honorary review.

author: Rachael
headline: Great for Sheer Coverage!
comment: I got to test out the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, thanks to Gloss Angeles, and would recommend this to anyone who likes a sheer to light coverage finish.  This balm blends into the skin seamlessly and leaves a radiant finish that lasts all day.  I was very impressed with the wear!  I do have a lot of hyperpigmentation that I like to cover up, so this was a little too sheer for my everyday wear, which is why I only gave it 4 stars.  Also, because this balm does have a lot of skincare and is hydrating, you want to make sure you don't prep your skin with too many hydrating products beforehand, or it won't wear as well.  Overall, I do like how my complexion looked while wearing this product on days that I wanted a natural finish.  It's too soon to say if this balm has improved my skin with daily wear, but I do like the hydrating feel.  Although this won't be my go-to as I'll stick with my IT Cosmetics CC Cream, I will be recommending this to my friends who do love a sheer to light finish!

author: Karina
headline: This is one of my favorite products I've ever tried!
comment: This product is so beautiful and so easy to use. It covers all imperfections and leaves such a glowy appearance on the face. I would buy this product over again and again. Can't say enough positive things about this product.

author: Lineth
headline: Sheer and buildable !
comment: I received this gift from gloss Angeles and used 120 and125 to match my skin completion. I like the lightweight and sheer feel of this tinted moisturizer. You can also build on top w blush or bronzer and it gives a natural look. Enjoyed the feel.

author: April
headline: Perfect for that no makeup glow!
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles for review. I absolutely love the balm-like texture; it feels just like skincare. It blends beautifully using both a brush and my fingers. While I wish it was slightly less sheer on the first swipe, the coverage is buildable and perfect for someone who doesn't like heavy foundation. It gives a very natural, "no-makeup" glow. Given the reasonable price point and the way it makes my skin feel, I will definitely purchase this when I run out. Highly recommend for that sheer, natural glow!

author: Virginia
headline: I will be using the product forever!!
comment:
I love this product. It goes on so smooth and  light coverage but easily covers all the areas I want evened out. it blends right in and last all day .I love mixing two shades for better coverage. my skin has been looking more glowing since I started using it and I don't feel like I ned to add more half way through the day. 
I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles

author: Kari
headline: Just the coverage i've been looking for
comment:
I'm so happy I had the opportunity to test this tinted face balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential - I LOVE it!! I previously used the CC+ cream for many years, but as I got older, the finish was heavier than I wanted for daily use. This new sheer tinted face balm is the perfect replacement - light coverage that felt fresh throughout the day, and still allowed my skin to shine through. I'm in my early 40s with combo, sensitive, acne-prone skin I found this product to be moisturizing without being too heavy, and it left a dewy finish. You can apply with your fingers or a brush (i preferred the brush), and a little goes a long way.

The flexible shade ranges worked well - both the lighter and darker shades blended in nicely and disappeared into my skin with no noticeable lines, which was surprising based on what the product looks like in the pot. I've tried a lot of tinted moisturizers in my search for lighter, sheer coverage that doesn't irritate my skin, and this is a new winner for me. I will definitely repurchase when I run out!

author: Cristina
headline: Such a versatile product!
comment:
I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. 

This is my first product I've tried from It Cosmetics and it did not disappoint. This honestly feels like I'm putting on a moisturizer that just so happens to have pigment. I got to select 2 shades for my review: 110 Neutral and 125 Cool. I've played around with both in different ways. 110N is pretty close to a perfect shade match for me in the winter and 125C will be great for me in the summer. I've used 110N all over a few times and while a touch too light, it looked great with concealer, blush, bronzer etc. I've mixed the 2 shades to make a closer match to my neck and chest and it looked great that way as well. I've also used the light in the center of my face and the darker shade in the places I would use contour/bronzer and that also looked wonderful. 

While sheer is in the name, I found that it's more light instead of sheer in the coverage department and i could build it up in places I needed a little more coverage on the days my rosacea was flaring up, and it evened my skin out with no issues. I was also able to layer products on top with no pilling or texture issues with my skincare and sunscreen underneath. I have found that I like it best with a primer, setting powder and spray. But when it's set, it's not moving. I've loved the way my makeup has turned out using this as my base product every time I've used it. I didn't experience any skin sensitivities, breakouts, or reactions of any kind. And it really does play well with concealer and cream products. This product does remind me of the Loreal 4-in-1 tinted face balm, but I found that product didn't hold up as well on my combo skin even with primer and setting powder + spray. I did however notice that my skin was less redder than usual over time as I used this product and it didn't sink into fine lines or make them more pronounced. Will definitely be buying once I run out!

Background on my skin: I'm 35 with combo (normal/oily) and sensitive skin. I was diagnosed with rosacea a few years that I treat with maintenance IPL laser every year. I still can experience redness flares when I get overheated or eat overly spicy foods, and sometimes it'll just be that time of the month.

author: Miriam
headline: Great sheer tint
comment: I tested this product through the Gloss Angeles podcast and I did not expect to like it this much! It goes on smoothly and blends in to your skin tone. I love that they have so many different shade options. I would absolutely recommend it. The only negative is that it doesn not have SPF so you would have to use this with another product during the day.

author: Ally
headline: So good!!!
comment: I had the opportunity to try this out through gloss angeles confidential. I was so impressed! I am not loving anything heavy these days for coverage. This is perfect for me! Sheer, lightweight, not greasy. I am also acne prone and had no issues with clogging or breakouts. This sits beautifully under my other products as well. I do set in the tzone with powder, however, I do not get super oily with this. Highly recommend to people of all ages!

author: Michaela
headline: Beautiful sheer coverage product
comment: This product was gifted to me from Gloss Angeles. This product really surprised me! It is both very sheer but also somehow really blurs imperfections in the skin. Unlike most skin tint products, this applies so much easier and isnt patchy at all. I really enjoyed using a brush to apply followed by smoothing with my fingers and/or a beauty blender. I will definitely repurchase!

author: Kim L.
headline: Best no make up looking days, ever!
comment: I don't normally wear make up to work,  but after being given a chance to try this new product I started wearing it every single day. I apply it with my fingers and then tap in with a brush. It melts into my skin. My skin looks soft and healthy. I've worn this alone and it looks great and I've worn it under my all day makeup and it's been amazing. thank you Gloss Angeles for gifting me this opportunity to try this fabulous product.

author: Christina
headline: A natural finish option
comment: I received this product to try from Gloss Angeles but all reviews are my own. The IT Cosemetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the complete opposite of their famous bb and cc products. This product is exactly what the name says. It goes on very sheer and provides a light tint in a balmy formula. I would use this one when you want a very natural finish. It feels very lightweight and the color does a nice job of blending into your skintone without needing to be a perfect match in the jar. I would describe this as a glowy finish. I didn't want to put my brush into the jar so I used a makeup spatula to scoop some out on the lid and then used a brush to apply. I appreciate the 92% skincare ingredients but I wonder how much product you need to apply to receive enough of the skincare ingredients to make a difference . I have dry skin that turns oily as the day progresses. My usual multiple step skincare routine would cause this product to slip off my skin my mid-day even with setting powder or spray. In my opinion it lays best on skin skin with minimal product underneath. Unfortunately I did not notice any changes to my skin using this product. Overall this is a good product and nice option to have in IT Cosemetics foundation line.

author: Anne
headline: Yes!
comment: So it took me a sec to figure this product out but once I got the right way to apply it - it works so great. Really blends into your skin and looks dewy and natural. Very error proof!

author: Danny
headline: Amazing
comment: This tint is amazing, I'm so impressed because the results is so beautiful and radiant on the skin, it blends like a dream and last for many hours, this has been my favorite since I got it. I really like the packaging because it is so easy to use and perfect to travel with, I can't wait to try more products on this line.

author: Steph
headline: Wow!
comment:
I was gifted this product for my honest review from Gloss Angeles confidential. This product is really amazing. It has a very unique texture and I love the skin care benefits that you get with this. It's so easy to apply. I just dip my it cosmetics foundation brush, and then dab it onto my complexion and it literally melts into my skin and gives my skin that flawless and no make up look I do have combination skin and I definitely needed to set my t-
zone with a powder to prevent the product from moving around on my face, but this is definitely helped in the winter months. Keeps my skin super hydrated. I really like this product and I'll definitely keep using it. It's a must try if you have dry skin and want that flawless face look without anything feeling heavy on your skin.

author: Alyssa
headline: Obsessed!!
comment: I absolutely love the texture of this balm—it's light yet buildable, blends effortlessly, and leaves a beautiful, skin-like finish. I was initially worried it might be too sheer or greasy, but it applied seamlessly, gave the coverage I needed, and stayed put all day without emphasizing texture or fine lines. The texture makes it really easy to use and feels so innovative, making my skin look like its best self. As someone who's used IT Cosmetics CC Cream for years because it didn't break me out, I'm thrilled to have found a formula that works even better for my aging, acne-prone skin while keeping the same trusted brand I love. I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles.

author: Rikki
headline: Versatile product that I'll definitely keep using
comment: This is very different than IT's other complexion products, but I love it! Buildable coverage that actually lasts all day. Great for my skin (I'm 42). Very hydrating! For people with oily skin it could probably double as a moisturizer.

author: ES
headline: skin care or makeup?
comment: I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential. I really enjoyed testing the product. I have fair/medium skin depending on the season. I tried fair warm 120 and light neutral 210. I used the fair warm more. I love skin tint products so I loved that this had added skin care benefits but it was hard to apply. you will need a foundation brush and a sponge or buffer brush. but the product goes on and blends into the skin easily. it was a nice base to add additional makeup over. I found that I needed to apply right after moisturizing. if my skin was dry or absorbed the moisturizer quickly, the skin tint would be flaky.

author: Amy
headline: My new go to!
comment: I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles confidential. The texture is creamy and a little goes a long way and it blends out so nicely! On my second attempt I found my perfect shade. Literally an exact match. I have combo skin and this product is the perfect texture to balance it all out. Dry spots aren't moisturized due to the skincare, yet my face isn't left too dewy. The finish is very natural. This is now my daily complexion product. The coverage is medium in my experience as it does build nicely. Overall even when I'm not wearing it my skin looks much smoother due to the skincare ingredients.

author: Christina
headline: A treat for dry skin
comment: Gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential. I really like the balm format for a foundation and found it applied well with a firm brush. It gave me light coverage, not totally covering my redness but doing enough to even it out. It has a dewy finish, and never quite dries down, meaning it rubs off and smears more easily than products I'm used to. I will still get use out of this, it'll just be for no-makeup days or when I'm feeling extra dry.

author: Aida
headline: Enhanced skin
comment: This product was gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential. It's a prefect blend of coverage and skincare that enhanced my skin while feeling comfortable, lightweight and hydrating. Though longevity was a concern, it lasted well with primer and setting spray. It evened out my tone and layers well with concealer for extra coverage. Definitely repurchasing!

author: Princess3
headline: Soft Balm/Skin Tint
comment: At first the texture feels like a less dense and firm version of the Makeup by Mario Skin Enhancer, but once you apply it almost feels cool when it breaks on the skin and then acts more like the thin liquid skin tints on the market. I havent come across anything similar in this format. Much like other skin tints, applying with a brush can leave streaks from the brush strokes and can sit on top of the skin if you look closely, but it blends easily w/ fingers. I do wish this was packaged like a cushion compact so that it could be applied more seamlessly. The coverage is light, so you'll need concealer if you want to cover any darker spots, but would be fine on it's own otherwise. I like how moisturizing it feels, but because I use a lot of skincare for my dry skin, I noticed my makeup didn't always apply as nicely or wear as well. I suspect it would hold up well on it's own or with just a lightweight moisturizer or suncreen. While I won't reach for this on a night out, I will continue to use it for day-to-day as I enjoy the texture and easy application.  Full disclosure: this product was gifted to me from Gloss Angeles

author: Lauren
headline: Obsessed with this product!
comment: I was able to test out this product for the past month thanks to Gloss Angeles. I absolutely fell in love with this balm, and it has now become an everyday go-to that I wear by itself or layer with concealer when wanting more of a full coverage face. I love that it adds a sheer tint to even out my complexion and gives some coverage without feeling heavy. I didn't see a huge difference in any fine lines or wrinkles in terms of long-term skincare benefits, but it does give a smoother look when wearing the product. I have combo skin, and I loved that it was a hydrating formula and it didn't cling to any dry spots on my face, but I did have to add a bit of setting powder to my t-zone area. The only downside of this is the packaging and having to use your fingers to apply the product. I ended up using a beauty spatula to grab some out, and then applied it with a brush, and then blended with a sponge. I highly recommend this if you are looking for something new to try out for everyday wear that is lightweight still with coverage.

author: Eileen
headline: Amazing buildable coverage
comment: I was gifted this product via Gloss Angeles but will continue to buy with my own money. This is a sheer but buildable balm-like product that blends with my skin beautifully. You don't need an exact shade match for it to work - I have both fairest neutral and fair cool and while fair cool is a slightly better fit, both work. It lays on the skin beautifully and doesn't pill or get patchy over time. I wouldn't wear it for full glam, but this is my new go to for everyday coverage.

author: Marina
headline: It's fantabulous
comment: This product was gifted to me by It Cosmetics through Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for an honest review. I must say when I first read the description of this skin tint, I wasn't thrilled. I immediately thought it wouldn't work for me due to my oily skin. Well, the first time I wore it I was pleasantly surprised. I went in first with a thin spatula brush to apply it, which left the lightest of coverage I have ever used. That wasnt my favorite, so I added another thin layer and while still sheer coverage it was absolutely beautiful. Yes, it is very hydrating and did leave me shiny, but powdered down, left the most beautiful finish on my skin. And to my surprise, it held up all day! I thought that due to the texture and the skin care ingredients it might break down at some point, but no, it looked beautiful for 10+ hours. Now this may very well be due to it being winter time and even my very oily skin is a bit drier so I am curious to see how this will perform in the summer time. The only con for me is that I sometimes like to apply my foundation with my fingers and therefore the packaging is not my favorite as I have to dip my fingers in the tub. I did also pick up th product with a denser foundation brush and that gave me excellent medium almost full coverage. Honestly, I really do like this product as a foundation, HOWEVER, personally I didn't see much benefit in regards to the skin care claims. But considering I do not rely on make up/skin care hybrid products for the skin care benefits, even that doesn't knock a star off my review. I try to be very critical of the things I receive for free to review, and I very rarely give the free products five stars, but what can I say? IT Cosmetics really knocked it out of the park with this product. I will absolutely buy this once I run out. Though that may be a while as they so graciously gave us two shades to try and seeing as how the coverage is so sheer, the shades are very flexible and both worked for me.

author: Natalie
headline: Very wearable skin tint
comment: Very user (not a big make up person) friendly. Blends in easily and gave my skin a glowy boost for the day. Hydrating with no flakiness. A very fair price considering how long a pot is likely to last. Tested via Gloss Angeles Confudrntisl.

author: drj5600
headline: Great, Innovative Product
comment: One star removed because you really have to find the right brush or use your fingers (i hate using fingers) so it took some time to make it work but wore beautifully once i found the right tools!!

author: ALI
headline: Light and SO easy to wear
comment: This is a super easy product to wear, but I will say that learning to use it took a little getting used to, since I typically wear liquid foundation.  I have dry/combo but sensitive skin and I was concerned that I might have a problem with the skin care ingredients but I was pleased to learn that my skin did really well with this product.  I applied it with a foundation brush and blended it out; I found it very comfortable and easy to wear.  It provided solid light to medium coverage and felt nice to the touch. *Note: I was gifted this product to try by Gloss Angeles in exchange for an honest review.

author: vanki1bn
headline: Finally a no make up face makeup
comment:
What a delight and suprise this product was. I was gifted  the product by glossangelos. I really had no expectations as I have found a lot of IT cosmetics protects to be too much/too heavy even when considered light coverage. This was a dream and blended/melted into skin
 It gave the lightest coverage and evened everything out while remaining skin like, hydrated, and glowy.

author: nlm8
headline: In My Balm Era
comment: I was in search of a product to even out my skin tone but skeptical of foundations and tints due to dry skin. I think the balm texture combined with color is a winning solution to address both issues. Applies easily with my fingers but I would also recommend tapping the product in with a brush.

author: Alyie
headline: Lightweight, light coverage balm
comment: I liked the gel-like texture of this balm. It was easy to blend & lightweight on my skin. I did mix two colora to achieve desired color match. I would have preferred the product packaging to be something different than a jar but another package might not be optimal due to texture of product. I was gifted this product to test via Gloss Angeles.

author: Dmv6285
headline: Beautiful finish, feels like nothing on face
comment: Was lucky enough to test this product through Gloss Angeles.  I typically only wear skin tints so was happy to try!  Product feels so lightweight on your face, gives a nice radiant glow and provides decent coverage while still looking natural.  I actually loved how it looked as the day went on.  I got two different shades to try within same range and both color matched.  I have tried the other IT CC cream and it got orangey on me but not this.  Would definitely recommend for a natural, radiant glowy makeup.

author: Aly
headline: Nice product, but not great for my skin type
comment:
I was gifted this product as a power of Gloss Angeles and tested it over a few weeks. I liked it, but I didn't totally love it for my skin. My skin is fairly normal but slightly on the oily side but really temperamental. 

It looks really nice when you first apply it and blends easily, but on me it tended to slip around a bit and didn't last as long as I need it to throughout the day. I found myself needing touch-ups sooner than I'd like.

That said, I love the blush and bronzer from this same range and use both regularly, which is why I was excited to try this. Unfortunately, this one just wasn't quite right for me.

I think it could work well for someone with drier skin or if you're looking for something more lightweight for shorter wear days. Just not my favorite from the line, but still a nice formula overall! 

Thanks for the opportunity, Gloss Angeles!

author: Meg
headline: My new go-to face product!
comment: I tested this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential and was so pleasantly surprised to like it as much as I do. I've tried the IT cosmetics CC cream in the past and didn't like how heavy it felt so I was nervous to receive a balm, but this felt so light and comfortable! I dabbed it on with a damp beauty blender for a sheer coverage day to day look but was able to build it up to get more coverage for going out. My only wish is for this to have SPF so it can be a one stop shop in the summer, but it still wore great with my ordinary serum SPF underneath. I will recommend this to anyone looking for a light, sheer skin perfecter!

author: Megan
headline: Looks so beautiful on my skin!
comment: I got to try this (thanks to Gloss Angeles) & I absolutely will buy it again. Applied with my fingers, after my usual skincare & it blends like a dream. It evens skin tone & camouflages my forehead wrinkles. Radiant! Wears great!

author: Melody
headline: Pleasantly Surprised!
comment:
I was gifted the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential and got the chance to try out two shades, Fair Cool which was a perfect match and Light Neutral which was close and totally workable but is better suited to my summer skin tone. 

The balm is creamy and feels very hydrating before drying down nicely to a satiny finish with light/almost medium coverage. I can't say I noticed any obvious improvements in my bare skin, but when I was wearing the balm, my skin definitely looked smoother and plumper which seemed to hide some of my finer wrinkles. When I first started using the balm, I was worried that it wasn't for me because as much as I liked the smooth and even appearance after the immediate application, I found that it was slipping and sliding all over the place within an hour or two. Once I figured out the best application method for me (less is more…one or two swipes of a foundation brush to get it out of the pot, dab it on each area in my t-zone, then buff it out with a beauty blender),it applied beautifully and melted right in. I followed up with some setting powder/spray and it lasted all day with just a light touch up in the afternoon. 

My overall impression ended up being very positive and while I'm not sure that this will replace my "go to" foundation, I can honestly say that I've found myself reaching for it much more often than I expected. That being said, if I could change one thing, it would be the packaging…a pump or tube would be my preference as I really dislike having to dip brushes or my fingers in a pot of product.

author: taylor
headline: truly sheer
comment:
I'm not a huge fan of the tub packaging, but given the balm-like consistency, it makes sense. The texture is actually one of my favorite things about this product - it's whipped, glides beautifully on the skin, and feels very hydrating. It's not drying at all and gives a natural, healthy glow. If you apply too much, though, you might get shiny after a few hours of wear. 

That said, this is not a coverage product. If you're looking to cover blemishes or hyperpigmentation, you'll definitely need to pair it with a concealer. It provides essentially zero coverage, which is why the shades are very forgiving. The color looked like it wouldn't match me at all in the tub, but once blended out, it melted into my skin and looked good.

I do wish it included SPF, but that's not a dealbreaker. Overall, I'd recommend this to those with drier or more mature skin and minimal blemishes or pigmentation. For someone like me with combination, acne-prone skin and some scarring, it gives a nice glow, but it's not enough to be my everyday product.

This product was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Anne
headline: The Jury is still out
comment:
Thank you so much to the ladies at Gloss Angeles and iT Cosmetics for the opportunity to try this new launch. 
After first application I liked the product. It left my skin looking dewy. The coverage was nice and did cover what I wanted it too. I really liked how my skin looked. I did feel like it exasperated the wrinkles on my forehead, however.
 It makes my skin look healthy. I was also very lucky with the shade match. 125 Fair Cool was perfect for my light, pink undertone complexion.
I am really torn here, as much as I like how it looks on my skin, I don't feel like the balm ever dries down. Even with a bit of setting powder. If I touch my face, it wears off. It also moves with other makeup application like cream blush. It definitely transfers. I can see it getting on my clothes if I'm not super careful. Even blowing my nose removes the product. Setting spray did not keep it in place. 

 I like this to film content. It looks good on camera. I do not see me wearing it in other situations unfortunately. It also feels heavy on my skin. Not drying down significantly impacts wear time. Improving transfer resistance would make this product much stronger.

I like a lot about it, but I also dislike some things. I am going to keep using it, trying different setting powders could be an option. I have adjusted the amount I use and am still getting the transfer. It is a work in progress. I do think it is a great product to try. So, I would recommend it for that reason

author: Megan
headline: Definitely would purchase again!
comment: I LOVED this balm! It was so easy to apply, and worked well with other primers and skincare. I thought it lasted a long time and received complaints on my skin when I used it. It lasted a long time and I didn't need to reapply. I was given this product to test from Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Kristin
headline: A little goes a long way!
comment:
This product took me by surprise. Once I figured out the best way, for me, to apply it (with my fingers and buffed out with a foundation brush), I fell in love! I appreciated the flexible shade; I thought the color looked too warm in the jar but it ended up being a perfect match on the skin. The texture of the skin balm is so light and feels almost undetectable. It has a light, buildable coverage that evens out the skin with a natural finish. I have to keep testing longer to see if the skin claims are true, but my overall appearance looked healthy and radiant while wearing it.

I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Meg
headline: Interesting and Innovative Face Balm
comment:
I've been loving this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for easy, low-effort days. The shades are adaptable and blend seamlessly into my skin for a natural, even look without feeling heavy. What really stands out is the cooling, balmy texture as it feels refreshing going on and melts right in, making it perfect when I want to get ready fast, cover redness, and keep my routine simple.

I was given the opportunity to test this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential and tested this during the winter and really liked how comfortable and hydrating it felt. I'm curious to see how it will perform once the hot, humid summer weather hits. That said, the lightweight feel makes me hope it won't look greasy or slick. I just require a light application of setting powder.

For the price, quality, and ingredient list, this feels like a great value, especially if you're into multitasking products that blur the line between skincare and makeup.

author: Kelly
headline: Love this for sheer coverage!
comment: I really enjoy using this product! It provides sheer coverage that evens out my fair skin and helps to balance my pink/flushed tones. But what I was most impressed by was how it felt on my skin. It feels almost cool as I put it on, and really soothing. I could feel the difference between this and another skin tint I previously used -- this one definitely felt more like skin care than makeup. The finish was natural but glowy, and my skin was a bit more radiant after application. Thank you to Gloss Angeles Confidential for the opportunity to try this product. I will definitely purchase again!

author: Dakota
headline: Nice but not for me
comment: I was gifted the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I have normal to dry skin, and while the formula is lightweight, I found that it clings to texture and facial hairs no matter how I applied it—fingers, brushes, or a beauty blender. It dries down more matte at first but becomes more radiant throughout the day, which I liked. I tested two shades, and although they're meant to be flexible, both leaned too warm for me, even the neutral. Unfortunately, I couldn't find a good undertone match.

author: katherine
headline: Lightweight, Glowy, and Effortless
comment: It feels comfortable on the skin and stays hydrated all day with a lovely glow. This makeup genuinely supports your skin and feels weightless. Coverage is light but buildable. Buy a shade lighter than you normally would for a better match.

author: Bayleigh
headline: The perfect work from home makeup
comment:
I really liked this one. It goes on super easily, especially with a dense foundation brush, and gives a smooth, natural-looking finish.
That said—this is makeup, not skincare. Yes, it has skincare ingredients, and that's great, but let's be real: you're wearing this for light coverage, not as your main skincare step. I still want my vitamin C and sunscreen underneath. This is perfect for no-makeup makeup days, work-from-home life, or those "camera on, but keep it chill" moments. It evens things out just enough without looking heavy.
One thing to note, if you have very dry patches, it can cling to them a bit, so prep is key. On well-moisturized skin, though, it looks fresh and effortless.

I was gifted this product via Gloss Angeles and IT Cosmetics for my honest review of the product without any influence or bias.

author: Emma
headline: Pleasantly Surprised!
comment: When I found out I was being gifted this product by GlossAngeles Confidential, I was a little nervous by the packaging. I don't typically gravitate towards balms or jarred base products in fear that they may be too heavy. This product genuinly surprised me! One light application will go on natural but easily build for more coverage, transforming from a tint to an almost BB cream like finish. It wore well throughout the day without any patchiness or seperation, only requiring minor poweder touchups. I lover that it could be applied with your fingers, a brush or even a sponge! My only area for improvement would be the packaging. I don't love products that require dipping into- using fingers feels "dirty" and like I could be contaminating the product while using a spatula dirties another tool. The finish is worth it to overlook this!

author: Lys
headline: Love the glow
comment: This is an innovative complexion product infused with skincare benefits. It's easy to apply and offers buildable coverage. I applied just one layer on my cheeks since I love a natural look. It makes my skin feel hydrated with a naturally glowy finish. It also feels completely weightless and doesn't pill or cake throughout the day.

author: TheChrissy
headline: Everything in one
comment: This product is truly a gem.It Cometics came up with this sheer foundation formula that is also skincare.I have been using this product for a couple weeks and my skin looks great.The formula is non scented and very easy to apply with a brush.It is a buildable formula so I can choose my coverage.I am very happy with this product as i have recently received many compliments on my skin.

author: Catherine
headline: Great product! A true sheer face tint
comment: I really enjoyed this product! It was sheer as promised and provided light coverage. I did find it a bit shiny but a little powder over it helped with this. The texture is really unique. It was easy to apply with a brush or fingers. I think it is a great product especially over the summer or warmer months!

author: Lucy N.
headline: Your skin but better
comment: Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for the opportunity to test this product. I was skeptical because other It cosmetics coverage products are very high coverage and very fragrant, but was so pleasantly surprised by this product. The coverage is so natural and skin-like and application is easy. I've had success with a brush, a sponge and my fingers in spots. It is also very compact which is nice for travel but it also feels like it will last a long time. It wears beautifully throughout the day. I definitely recommend this product, but as a personal preference I prefer sunscreen in my coverage products. I always wear sunscreen under bur like an extra layer, so I may pause in the summer. Shade 110 is my perfect shade match but I can also make 120 work so I think the shades are flexible.

author: JGable
headline: Lightweight and hydrating
comment: I have really enjoyed using this product over the past few weeks as an all over color for my face. It is easy to apply with fingers or a brush. My skin is very glowy after! It has very sheer coverage so I still felt the need to spot touch with concealer.

author: Melissa
headline: it REALLY does it all!
comment:
I received this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for my honest review. 

I must say, this product really does it all! This product comes in a cute little pot that you can apply with either a brush or your fingers. I preferred my fingers because honestly it feels so good! It was very easy to blend and can be buildable depending on where you might want more coverage. I am in my 40's so not having my makeup sink into my lines is a big deal and this product delivers. It is winter where I live right now and I usually have a lot of issue with dry skin about right now but consistent use of this product and I am seeing a difference. I love it! Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for the opportunity.

author: Casey
headline: Love this for mature skin
comment: As a 40ish young lady i have had constant issues with finding a Foyndation or BB/CC Cream tgat can help me with coverage without getting dry and looking worse off then when i started..this has changed all of that for me. It isnt a full coverage but it doesnt leve me looking like cake batter dried up and is moisturizing and feels amazing on

author: Jennifer
headline: Your Skin, But Better!
comment: I really enjoyed this product. I really loved how easy it was to apply this, and the fact that there were several options to do so.  For the sheerest and most natural looking coverage, I opted to apply this with my fingers.  Coverage is buildable, so you can easily apply more in areas that may need a little extra coverage, with just a bit more product.  To start with a bit more coverage, but still a natural look, applying it with a foundation brush (one with loose bristles, not one that is too dense) worked very well.  I have been looking for an every day tint that does not contain sunscreen, and that doesn't require a ton of product.  This may just be the answer - I can easily apply with my fingers or a brush (for no mess) and get a very even application in no time.  This product was very creamy and moisturizing, which is great for my skin, which tends to be a bit more on the dry side.  The price point on this product is also great, especially given that you don't need a lot of product for your entire face.  I can't wait to tell my friends about this one.  Gifted by Gloss Angeles.

author: Nancy
headline: Fantastic Coverage Product
comment: I was a tester thru Gloss Angeles. I received two different colors. From the moment I put this on I loved everything about it. I used the lighter color for my under-eye area as a concealer. It goes on as smooth as a moisturizer. The coverage leaves a nice glow but not too shiny.  I am not 100% it is helping my fine lines but it definitely diminishes them when using. This product lives up to everything it claims to do. The product goes a long way when used with a brush. I found using fingers works well. Just use a little spatula so you don't contaminate product. I give it a 9 out of 10.

author: Kateryna
headline: Love it!
comment: I fell in love with this It cosmetics sheer tint face balm. It has unique balm melting texture with cooling sensation. It is so easy to apply with the brush. It applies and blends flawlessly. It has sheer dewy finish no shade and works great for my combination skin during winter. It looks great all day long with minimal touch ups during the day. It looks like my skin but better and feels so hydrating on the face. It quickly became my favorite everyday foundation. I also like added skincare's ingredients. It's truly skincare and makeup innovation.

author: Rebecca
headline: Gorgeous texture and finish
comment: This is the perfect product for days I don't want a full face of makeup, but also want to look like I didn't just roll out of bed. I'm 50 with combo oily skin and the texture this has is unreal on my skin. It feels light and fluffy like whipped cream. It makes my skin look smooth and even with a really light coverage (it is buildable). I do feel like my skin texture and tone have been looking better since using this.

author: Laura
headline: I've Come Back To IT Cosmetics!
comment:
I used to wear IT Cosmetics all the time, but for some reason as I entered my 50's my skin changed and my trusted CC didn't look right. But this new Balm has brought me back!

I have normal/dry skin, texture, hyperpigmentation, redness…this Balm makes my skin look like my skin but GORGEOUS. Fresh and radiant- like I drank all the water and got all the sleep! 

I love that it has skincare in the formula, frankly for mature skin that is the gold standard.

For me, the best application is to use a compact kabuki brush and stipple into the skin. I don't need to set it, it stays put and doesn't crease.
