I highly recommend this if you love a natural finish to your makeup. I am thrilled to rediscover IT Cosmetics again!

*gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential (opinion entirely my own)

author: Caro
headline: A great light coverage option
comment: I was graciously gifted this product to test through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I loved the formula and how sheer and evenly it applied. I wish it had sunscreen included since it bills itself as skincare. Also, for me, the shades just don't work for my skin tone. I tried 2 shades and both just left me looking too grey. This is unfortunate becuase i did love the product, but i don't see myself wearing unless i can get the shade match right. However, it is a great product otherwise!

author: Liss D
headline: Really enjoyed!
comment: I was apart of Gloss Angeles Confidential and did not pay for this product however I would!! It feels so nice and hydrating on the skin. Perfect for winter months. Works well with other makeup as far as I can tell. I would recommend this for women with mature skin but definitely can work otherwise. I have normal to combo skin so can't vouch for how it holds up with oily skin. Overall, if you are looking for a balm texture with buildable coverage, great skin benefits and feels like skin then this is for you.

author: Jessica
headline: Hydrating, cooling, weightless!
comment:
I was given the opportunity to try this product before its release through Gloss Angeles Confidential - and let me tell you, this was the toughest one to keep secret because I LOVE IT! After testing it for almost a month, I can confidently say that this is my new favorite base product.
After trying a few different ways of application, I found I preferred using a makeup sponge over my fingers or a brush. The formula applies like a dream and sets into the most lovely natural-but-hydrated finish that is the closest thing to "weightless" I've ever felt. I have found that it is fairly buildable by applying a second layer after the first sets in order to get a little more coverage, but if I have an active breakout I still need to go in with a concealer. I can imagine I might need to powder-set it in the summer, but have found that unnecessary in the drier months of winter - it keeps my skin looking and feeling hydrated & comfortable all day.
Lastly, I'm really impressed by the shades I received - 110 and 125 are true neutral & cool toned shades! My past experiences with ItCosmetics were of products that all ran warm on me, so this was a pleasant development. I am light and cool toned and have mainly used 125, but at my palest the 110 would also work.

author: Nikki's
headline: Amazing!
comment: I was given the opportunity to test this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential. All testers were provided 2 shades, and honestly both worked great for me, which really speaks to the shade adaptability! This product has a creamy texture and is buildable, which is great for someone like me who has aging/combination skin and doesn't like the look or feel of heavy foundation. This product sat well all day on my skin and never showed signs of patchiness or dryness. I can't speak to the skincare benefits as I already have a pretty extensive skin care regime, but I had no negative side effects, so I consider that an added benefit. Overall I think this is a great product for all skin types, and for those who prefer lighter coverage. This will definitely be a repurchase for me!

author: Sarah
headline: Very nice complexion product for drier skin types
comment: Loved this product on my winter dry skin. It helped minimize texture and covered my redness and discoloration without feeling heavy. I don't see performance from it as a skincare but as a makeup with skin benefits it's very nice. I'd recommend it for low key makeup days or people who like less makeup looking makeup. Thank you glossangeles for the chance to test this product out.

author: Paige
headline: I Will Buy This Product Again and Again!
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm product has been such a treat to test over the past several weeks, thanks to the opportunity from Gloss Angeles Confidential! I need to preface this review with a disclaimer that I am not a daily foundation wearer. I don't like applying makeup all over my face, so I usually stick to concealer and a light powder and save foundation for special events. This product has made a daily wearer out of me. I love love love the light, skincare-like formula. It provides just enough coverage so imperfections are minimized and my skin still looks like my skin. It gives a wonderful radiance without looking oily (a regular skincare concern of mine,) and I experienced no breakouts or adverse effects from using this. I've been combining two colors and would recommend others try this. The price is extremely fair for what you get!

author: Bethany
headline: Lightweight skin tint with unique formula
comment: I received this product to try through gloss Angeles. This skin tint is packaged in a jar and has a unique texture. It almost melts in your fingers, making it easy to apply on. I loved how it layered on my skin with moisturizer and sunscreen. The compact packaging will make this a must have for future travel!

author: Elena
headline: I would repurchase this balm.
comment: This balm feels like a hidden gem for dry skin. It's rare to find a product that delivers real hydration and visible results, but this one did both. My skin looked smoother, my fine lines were less noticeable, and the glow lasted well into the day. The color is gorgeous, and the finish is effortlessly fresh. Definitely a repurchase.

author: Margaret
headline: Good, Solid Product
comment: I was gifted this product to review for IT cosmetics. Initially, I thought it felt too greasy on my already oily skin, but I have grown to really like the balm. Easy to apply and spread. It feels nourishing and like my skin is benefiting while wearing this balm instead of being suffocated by a thick foundation. I have been trying 2 different shades, and I am very impressed that both shades match my skin well. I do think it helps improve the appearance of my fine lines (which I discover more of every day 😩). Good price point, I would purchase and use this again.

author: Andrea
headline: Whipped texture that moves with your skin
comment: Was gifted through Gloss Angeles Confidential.  I use a brush to take it out of jar, tap all over clean and moisturized face then take a fluffy firm brush and tap to blend it all in. I found I didn't need hardly any concealer under eye because this coverage is so nice, doesn't sit in creases or flake off.  Gives skin a smooth, glowy but not shiny, even coverage.  I had given up on foundation because of trying to color match, there are so many shades and it was easy to find my color.  Jar is heavy and luxe feeling.  The claim is that it helps skin look bouncy and firm and stay moisturized.  I would say it definitely gives that appearance.  I had never tired IT before and now I want to try all the products.

author: Tee
headline: I'm in LOVE with this product, def buying again!!
comment:
I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles confidential and I'm so happy I got to try it!
I loved mixing the two shades I got (medium neutral & medium warm) and it lasts all day! I'm a minimal makeup kinda gal so I would just do my skincare, add blush, mascara and lip gloss and this product was a perfect addition as it helped even out my skin tone and tie it all together 🥰
Even after washing it off, my skin feels so nice and radiant- so the skincare ingredients in it are definitely working for me!! 
Also I find it best to apply using my fingers.

author: Joy Res
headline: A light daily base
comment: I hate wearing foundation on a daily basis, but I do have some redness I'd love to minimize. This is the perfect solution. It's light and easy to blend and does just enough without being cakey or overwhelming. I didn't notice any differences to my skin, but I did enjoy how it felt.  This product was gifted for testing by Gloss Angeles, but my review is completely my own.

author: Mel
headline: Sheer tint with skin benefits
comment:
This sheer skincare tint was a nice addition tobmy skincare and makeup routine! It adds moisture and a light to sheer coverage to blur any blemishes on my face. Over time using this product, I noticed my skin seemed more hydrated and bouncy. 
This product was gifted to me through Gloss Angeles

author: Briana
headline: My New Holy Grail Product
comment: I love using this sheer complexion balm!! I typically gravitate towards tinted moisturizers or BB/CC creams, so this is a product I would find myself using daily. This sheer tint face balm gave my skin a natural glow without making my face look too oily. I also noticed that it evens out my skin tone too! I only applied powder on my T-zone after applying the balm as my skin is dry combination. I notice that this product gives softens lines and texture in my skin. It also provides extra moisture without making my face look too dewy. I will continue to use this product on a daily basis. Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for the opportunity to try out this product!

author: Cindy
headline: Loved this!
comment: [I received this as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential] This has quickly become my new go-to everyday makeup base! I apply it with my fingers, and love how quick and easy it is. I have combo/ oily skin, and this seems to self-set as it even looks good when I wear this alone under skincare. It pairs beautifully with my other skincare and makeup products, as I don't have any issues pilling. I forget I even have makeup on on the days I wear this alone as it doesn't feel heavy and looks so natural! It really does feel like my skin but better. Love it!

author: Cindy
headline: Surprised how much I enjoyed using this
comment: [This review is part of Gloss Angeles Confidential] This has become my new go-to base product! I love how it looks natural and doesn't feel heavy. When I have this on alone, I forget I am wearing makeup, and it seems to set into a natural finish even by itself on my combo/oily skin. Most skin tints feel greasy if I don't set it, but this one looks good throughout the day.

author: Disa
headline: YOU NEED THIS! GLOWING!!!!!!
comment: WOW! What a beautiful product! This is like putting on a cloud that perfects your skin with just enough coverage to give you a glow but you never feel cakey, dry or gross! Thank you gloss Angeles for gifting this product! I'm blown away & will repurchase!

author: Sabrina
headline: Lightweight, natural, and easy to wear
comment: I tested this product through Gloss Angeles. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm feels super comfortable on the skin and gives a healthy, evened-out look without feeling heavy. Coverage is definitely on the lighter side, but that's exactly what I wanted—it's perfect for "your skin but better" days. Great for quick application, no-makeup makeup, and keeping skin looking fresh and hydrated.

author: Andrea
headline: Perfect Product for Dry, Millennial Skin
comment:
I haven't used IT Cosmetics since college, but I got the opportunity to try this new tinted skin balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential and wow — what a cool new product! 

I have dry, neutral/cool skin and could never use any of the brand's CC creams, but I LOVE this tinted balm. It's hydrating, the color is really adaptable, it gives a very sheer bit of color that really looks like skin. I've been applying this all over my face with my fingers and then going in with concealer under my eyes when I need a bit more coverage. It's perfect for running errands, heading to the gym, when you have three seconds before a Zoom call starts, etc. I would compare it to a tinted moisturizer. 

I'm so excited to see what IT Cosmetics does next! It looks like they already have a blush/bronzer in this product line, and I need to try that ASAP. 

One more note — I have super sensitive, dry, acne- and rosacea-prone skin. Everything breaks me out. This did not!! Truly a miracle. 💖💖

author: Jennifer
headline: Perfect coverage
comment: I have been testing the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for the past month through Gloss Angeles. I was gifted two shades and both match pretty well. I have really enjoyed this product because it is easy to apply and has a great amount of coverage. I usually find that tints are too sheer for my skin.  I want some coverage for blemishes, etc. I have been applying it with a brush by stippling it on my face. It is easy to apply and goes on quick. I will definitely be buying the balm after I have used up the two I have, but it seems like a long lasting product.

author: Olivia L
headline: Beautiful, innovative product!
comment:
I received this product from the brand through Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for my honest review. 

Thank you to the brand and Gloss Angeles! 

My current favorite holy grail foundation, for comparison, is Glossier's Stretch Foundation. I also often use Glossier's Stretch Concealer in addition. I have dry skin with minor redness and under eye circles. 

When I received the product and saw the pot it was in - immediate Dream Matte Mousse vibes for this millennial. Honestly I was terrified! But that stopped when I opened it. This formula is creamy and lightweight! I used a medium-sized brush to apply and my Makeup by Mario F4 brush to blend. I cannot believe how easily it blended! It's definitely a light coverage formula, but it is easily buildable. It also played beautifully with my Glossier or Fenty concealer (only used to cover undereye and a little redness around my nose). I always set with a little powder under my eyes. This product looked great on me and lasted all day. I am so so so so thrilled to find this product!!!!

author: AnnaMaria
headline: Gives A Lovely Lasting Glow
comment: I have really been enjoying using this skin balm!   I like to apply it with my fingers.  When I rub the product onto my finger in the jar it has a melting fluid-like consistency.  It is so easy to apply and blend with my fingers.  The shade adapts to match my skin tone nicely.  I love the light coverage that is easily buildable.  I also love the lightweight feel.  It does not have a balmy sticky texture. It gives me such a nice glow without being over the top.  The glow and the finish hold up well throughout the day.  It layers nicely with skincare, sunscreen and other makeup.  It never looks cakey and it does not settle into lines or pores.  I love this product and highly recommend!  I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.

author: coffeenut2015

With minimal prep and sunscreen as my only base, it absorbed beautifully and blended seamlessly into my skin. The finish looked natural and healthy. I do wish it included SPF, as it would be the perfect all in one step

I'm not the biggest fan of the packaging - would prefer it to be a little bigger, but overall a nice product for my dry skin.

author: Lauren

I experienced no piling or  breakouts. I could see this product being an absolute go-to in the Summer. Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential to test this product!

author: Haley

The sheer, buildable coverage lets me add an extra an touch under my eyes and on my t-zone for an effortlessly radiant finish that still feels like skin, not makeup. Hydrating, subtle, and beautifully natural. It's a new everyday favorite!

author: Kimberly
headline: Comfortable Coverage
comment: I really enjoyed this product and it will be a new staple in my routine. It was so versatile and I could just pop it on with a flat brush, my fingers, or a sponge. I often wore a sheer layer on its own on days when I wasn't wearing a full face of makeup but just wanted a little coverage. However I also really loved building it up slightly and using it in place of foundation with a full glam look. My skin is so dry and this left it looking very hydrated and radiant. It never felt cakey and minimized my fine lines instead of settling into them. Even built up it doesnt feel heavy on the face and felt like I was wearing nothing and just had naturally beautiful skin. The shades are really flexible and I was able to make two of them work easily on my very fair skin. This is a great everyday go to! Im so grateful to Gloss Angeles Confidential for giving me the opportunity to test this product.

It's sheer but buildable, goes on hydrating and leaves a nice glow to the skin. For me personally, as someone with combo skin, it breaks apart and becomes oily way too easily, even with a primer and setting powder/spray. But if your skin is dry, it may be perfect to give your skin that extra glow. I will say, it's super sheer, which isn't a problem for me just something to note. It also gave me slight comedomes, but I am someone that frequently reacts to product with dimethicone, which this product has in one of the first few ingredients. I was gifted this by Gloss Angeles for my review.

I plan to continue using it and would recommend it to friends who want an effortless, "no-makeup" glow!

author: Emma
headline: No breakouts?!?
comment:
Ive been using these pore pads for about 2 months now (2-3x per week) and im pmeasantly surprised with results! For reference, my skincare routine is MINIMAL due to my skin being acne-prone and panicky when new ingredients are introduced. I use a fragrance free moisuizing bar soap for cleansing (yes I know thats terrible, but "cleansers" cause breakouts on me), these pore pads, and a ceramide moisturizer before bed (still searching for a good one for long term use itherwise I'd list it here). After 3 uses of these pore pads, me and my husband both noticed a reduction in the prominance of my nose blackheads. After 2 months, I still feel like the blackheads and pores are shrinking, albeit VERY slowly. This was not an overnight success so know that you should try it for a long period befoe making a judgement. 

One thing I wish Id realized before starting use was that it really does need a moisturizer to follow it. The first two times I used it I didnt follow with a moisturizer and it dried my skin WAY out. But after pausing use and moisturizing for the  next few days I was able to restart using the pads (+ a moisturizer) without dryness. 

I am extremely prone to breakouts (one day of foundation and my clear skin is toast) and so my biggest concern was that this would break me out. It didnt. In fact, I've been using it to help clear breakouts caused by occasional makeup use. I do believe I'll be purchasing again.

headline: DO NOT USE DAILY
comment: Be sure to test on a small area if you have sensitive skin. This product works effectively when used correctly, but it's important to do thorough research before trying it. The instructions recommending daily use are misleading; your skin needs a natural barrier to stay healthy, which includes dead skin cells. Although it may sound counterintuitive, maintaining this balance is crucial. Over-exfoliating can cause significant damage to your skin and undo the benefits you're aiming for. Personally, I recommend using it every two to three nights to avoid irritation and support skin health.

author: msturtley
headline: Good product but please do some research
comment:
Hello Everyone! 
I don't write reviews often but love to read them. I felt compelled to write one on this product to add some information to be cautious of before using. 
I have combination dry skin and a bit of texture and hyperpigmentation (PIH). I wanted to start using this Glycolic Acid to help with that. 
The few things to understand, this is a very concentrated high percentage product and should be used in moderation and cautiously. 
Start with once a week for the first 3-4 weeks, then increase to twice a week (IF NECESSARY). Know that this product WILL cause purging (breakouts in certain areas), that can sometimes last from 2-8 weeks. Please do your research on the differences between purging and a skin reaction (purging is Usually localized to the areas you normally get acne and not all over your face/body part). Avoid contact with the eye area at all cause, by rinising your hands after. I like to apply eye cream before so i dont touch my eyes at all after. 
You MUST have a clean and completely dry skin before applying AND wait for it to fully dry down 15-30+ mins after. 
This product takes time to work and its not for everyone so please do some research and consult with a doctor if you are able. I am on week 9 and barely starting to see my skin calm down a bit. But ive seen it work wonders on my friends so i am sticking with it! Over all, i really do think it is workimg for me, hope this helps!

headline: works well, but be cautious

Pretty sure there is a warning on this bottle to patch test before lathering on your entire face. I have used multiple times behind my neck and it cleans out my skin. It is a bit sensitive on my face and neck. So you need to be careful with any products you use. The ingredient literally says ACID! What do people think, it is gentle? it has some type of active ingredients to fight what it is designed to do. a
And compared to what another glycolic acid wash this one is by far gentle. I have used some stuff given by my dermatologist that is very harsh and if not used properly can damage your skin. So read and do your research before applying any products. Just because things are OTC doesn't mean they cannot be just as strong as what a dermatologist can prescribe. Some of these reviews are shocking to see how people use it everyday...yeah maybe they can use it everyday. But each person is different, for me I would only use maybe 1 or 2 times a week and that too only on the back of my neck and under arms. Face and neck skin is super sensitive...so think before dumping the whole product onto your face. It is a solid product but needs to be used cautiously.

author: TyLa
headline: Using on my scalp!
comment:
I decided to do a little research and see if this product would be safe to use on my scalp.. 

I use a lot of medicated shampoos and lotion treatments because I have an overproduction of oil and yeast that will spread across my scalp and cause extreme dandruff. Absolutely giant flakes. 

I hop in the bathtub with dry hair, I massage it into my scalp and leave it for about 10 to 15 minutes. 
I rinse it out with cool water and then add my anti-dandrith over the counter Nizoral shampoo to my scalp and leave it for about another 15 minutes. 
"Really scrub the scalp with the shampoo" 

I condition the ends of my hair and brush the conditioner throughout but never letting the conditioner near my scalp I did this 3 times in two weeks to get control of my scalp and it has been a huge improvement! 

Going forward I may try this remedy once a week and see how it works. 

I would say this product is very versatile!

I haven't applied any lotion on my arms but they're baby smooth now and look moisturized. I cannot recommend this enough to chronic skin pickers like myself (see a bump, feel a bump, squeeze & pick)... there is nothing TO pick anymore. 

I use it once a night before I go to bed on clean skin with no other product.

headline: PLEASE READ!!!

So I LOVE The Ordinary products! I use their puffy serum as well as the hair thickening and hyaluronic acid ones. Because of this I decided to get this glycolic acid and well let's just say…it makes my face very sticky no matter what I do. There is no direction on how to use this besides "use after cleansing" especially for those who use face serum and moisturizer like me!! My face is a neutral skin type. It has its days.. some days are more oily and some days it's just dry so I always use my ordinary face serum and my hydration cream. 
•First I cleaned my face, applied my moisturizer, then my serum, then this glycolic acid and it made my face STICKY. 
•Next day I tried something different. I cleaned my face, applied face serum, then the acid, then the moisturizer and my face was STICKY 
•Next day I tried cleaning my face, adding the acid, then my serums, then moisturizer and well…it was less sticky than before but still sticky. 
Idk if it is just my face type or the skin care products I use…but the ones I use are The Ordinary brands so… 
I'm just saying, before you buy this make sure you know the steps on what to apply first, how to apply it, and if the brands of serum, moisturizer, or whatever you use will mess with the results of this brand. 
*my face does feel super smooth in the morning after I was my face. It's just at night when I apply this on is when it gets very sticky

headline: Favorite Moisturizer
comment:
If you're considering this moisturizer, get it now and let your skin thank me later! This is my essential, go to moisturizer. I've tried tons (I do a lot of product testing) of products, and this one has remained my favorite. My skin loves it. It's softer, smoother, and overall more vibrant when I use this. 

This is non-greasy, doesn't cause shine, and is lightweight. It doesn't clog my pores. I don't have acne prone skin; however, the wrong moisturizer definitely causes my skin to breakout. It's one of the only things that does this to me. Whenever I try a new moisturizer and start to have a break out, I switch back to this one from Clinique, and within days my breakout clears up. 

I have combination skin, with typically more dry skin around my cheeks and chin, and oily in my t-zone. 

There is no heavy fragrance in this. I find it quite pleasant actually. I'm extremely hyper-sensitve to smells, so I'm very picky about it. 

More recently, my husband ran out of his moisturizer so he tried mine. He has acne prone sensitive skin. After a couple days he asked me to buy him some because his skin felt so much better after using this moisturizer. It's worth every cent, and for a quality moisturizer, it's pretty reasonably priced compared to similar options. 

I highly recommend this moisturizer!

author: Bronwyn
headline: Not moisturizing for very dry skin, caused rosacea flare
comment: I love Clinique and have been using them for 20 years, so when my old moisturizer was discontinued, I switched to this one without a second thought. I haven't changed any of my makeup or skincare products at all in the last 2-3 years, so I know it had to be this product. It's nowhere near as moisturizing as the old product, and has a strange jelly texture that doesn't feel nearly as moisturizing as a cream does, and has a cooling sensation similar to products with alcohol. This item might be fine for someone with normal or possibly oily skin but if you are very dry, I wouldn't recommend it. My rosacea flared up after years of calm, my cheeks are tender, my entire face peeled in tiny flakes the next day. and the lines under my eyes are much more crepey. I gave this two stars because I switched to using it on my neck and hands at night and that hasn't caused any issues, and it might just be an ingredient my skin doesn't agree with. For my face I switched to Paula's Choice skin recovery hydrating mask and it's been working better for very dry skin. I still recommend Clinique for their makeup and eye cream, though as that's never caused me any problems!

author: Camila
headline: A Must-Have for Lasting Hydration

As someone with a minimalistic skincare routine, I appreciate products that are both effective and easy to use, and this hydrator fits the bill perfectly.

Since incorporating Moisture Surge into my daily regimen, my skin has never looked better. It feels incredibly hydrated and looks healthy and radiant all day long. The lightweight gel-cream texture absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it perfect for layering under makeup or wearing alone.

This hydrator truly delivers on its promise of long-lasting moisture. I love that it not only provides immediate hydration but also helps my skin retain moisture throughout the day. It's a game-changer, especially for someone like me who prefers a straightforward, no-fuss approach to skincare.

Thank you, Clinique, for creating such a fantastic product. Moisture Surge 100H Auto-replenishing Hydrator has become an essential part of my skincare routine, and I can't recommend it enough!

author: Valerie
headline: Horrible Product and Company
comment:
I had a terrible experience with Maëlys. I requested a refund well within their 21-day money-back guarantee after having an allergic reaction, but their customer service delayed responses until the deadline passed and then denied my refund. They finally issued a return label after 10 PM on Memorial Day, when USPS was closed, making it impossible to meet their requirements. I returned the products in good faith but never received my money back.

I filed a complaint with the BBB and submitted clear evidence showing I contacted Maëlys multiple times within the refund period. Their response completely disregarded the documentation I provided, which seems to be part of a pattern. After looking into it, I saw that hundreds of other customers have reported similar experiences with delayed responses, poor communication, and difficulty obtaining refunds.

I will never purchase from this company again, and I strongly caution others to avoid them. Their return policy appears misleading and unfair, and their customer service is dismissive at best.

headline: Ok. It FR work

Let me start by saying—I never leave reviews. If Ulta could track review stats, I'm sure they'd confirm that. And I'm definitely not one of those TikTok-hype chasers. In fact, I usually avoid anything that goes viral on TikTok or Facebook because it's mostly BS.

But this? This actually works. Like, really works. I'm not about to get up off the couch after submitting 32 assignments for school to show you before-and-afters—but just trust me, it works.

I paid over $100 for it directly from the website, and I'd do it again. Stomach, arms, legs—everything. It works. I don't even know how to make you believe me… but if you're on the fence, I'm telling you: it's worth it.

author: Areid314
headline: This is not it
comment:
I had really hoped to experience some tightening or firming of my skin. I'm petite, on the lower side of the normal weight range for my height, so I don't have an excessive amount of cellulite - just average really. I also exercise 5-6 days a week, nothing crazy / no gym, I just walk approximately 4 miles every day with my dog. 

I have used this product in combination with one other Maelly's product for well over 60 days now and I can tell you with absolute certainty that this product did NOT tighten, firm, or tone my skin at all. While it help to moisturize my skin, it was a total waste of money at these prices - a bottle of Aveeno Colloidal Oatmeal would have yielded the same results. 

I have never had any luck with any Maelly's products and certainly nothing like what they claim in their pictures. I don't recommend this brand. Save your money or try products from someone else because this is not it. I'm disappointed every time. Also this one smells extremely strong like baby powder, but not in a good way, so you won't want to wear it out.

headline: Smooth Skin & Subtle Firming!
comment: I've been using the GET-DREAMY Toning Whip for about six weeks now, and I'm pleasantly surprised by how much I like it. It absorbs quickly, which is a huge plus when you're getting dressed in a hurry. The scent is soft and fresh, not overpowering""think light floral with a hint of citrus. It gives a bit of a spa-like experience during application, which I really enjoy. As for results, my skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and there's a subtle firming effect, especially on the my abdomen. It's not a miracle cream that will erase cellulite or drastically tighten loose skin overnight, but with consistent use, I can see and feel a difference in tone and texture. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is the packaging""it looks cute, but the jar is a bit bulky and not the most hygienic option since you're dipping your fingers in. A pump or tube might be more practical. Overall, I'd recommend the GET-DREAMY Toning Whip if you're looking for a luxurious-feeling body moisturizer with a light toning benefit. Great for anyone wanting to pamper their skin while gradually improving firmness and softness.

author: Linnea W.
headline: Voodoo Magic
comment: OK so for starters, I'm not usually big on writing reviews. But this stuff is straight up voodoo magic y'all. It's pricey, but it WORKS. I think I speak for so many women when I say I've tried countless products in the $15-$30 price range that really don't produce results. That's wasting your money. Spending a little more on something that actually does what it says it does? PRICELESS. Even though it's a whipped texture (side note, feels divine), the product is still dense and lasts for a while. A little really does go a long way! It's helped tighten and smooth my skin, and as an added bonus has even helped with some flakey dry spots I've had for ages that I just assumed would never go away. I didn't expect this to fix all my skin annoyances, but for real it did. I love that I see results literally the next day, though there's also long term results as well. It's nice because the instant gratification keeps me accountable using it long term, where you just continue to see more and more improvement. My only complaint? It works TOO GOOD. Now that I know I'm basically addicted to this stuff (and this brand) for life. Thank goodness they have subscription discounts- it's like they know once you start using their products you just can't stop!

author: taylor
headline: real review. bought myself, no affiliation.
comment:
1. the smell is good. its lavender, very boho insence shop (smells like the store earth bound ) 
2. the product works. i recently lost 70 pounds from 210-140 (24 f) so i have stretch marks, some sagging in my boobs and butt, and a very tiny bit of loose skin on my stomach. ive used it in all of those places the last week. ive noticed the biggest difference in my boobs and butt. they just appear smoother. my butt seems tighter. the loose skin on my stomach and the stretch marks on my stomach apeared more smoothed out. i know it takes a few months to fully work but ive seen results already. it does burn a little after about 10 minutes if you use too much. i usually wash my hands after applying it. 
3. the kicker that i have seen no one talking about? this is a night time cream with added ingredients to help you sleep and it actually does put you to sleep, keeps you asleep. a DEEP sleep. so deep that i have been having night mares and vivid dreams?? and then waking up very groggy after 9 hours of sleep. at first i thought it was just a weird night but it only happens when i use the cream lol and i dont use excessive amounts at all so imagine how strange that has been. 
the product is expensive but worth trying if you are okay with warm sensations and lavender scents.

author: Keeley
headline: Do not waste your money
comment:
They know their target audience and they just steal from the woman that is desperate for help. I have had 2 c sections and this is the second time I have given Maely's products a chance, as most of us want that c section area to tighten up. Keep in mind, I am not hoping for false results. I am a runner, been a runner/athlete for 20 plus years, just need help with some of the extra skin from 3 pregnancies / 2 c sections. I wanted this to work so bad. On top of the product not working, I tried to return (as the no satisfaction return guarantee) and with being a busy full-time working mom of 3, was just unfortunately not able able to get my refund email request in time (3 days short to be exact). Believe you me, no sympathy, no concern, no human, just an automated blanket email response each time asking for help, reconsideration, an exception. 

Never buying another Maely's product again. Ripped off again. To every woman out there hopeful and looking for help with toning/ tightening up extra skin, don't waste your time and money here.

author: Angel F.
headline: I love the scent & how moisturizing the cream is. . .
comment: Maely's has addressed that EVERY BODY TYPE MAY VARY when using this product. I can definitely say in a matter of 2. 5 wks, it has not done any change to my body. I believe the only thing it has done is made my under arms, inner thighs and stomach soft and the cream gives off a lovely scent. Other than that Maely's has addressed that some may experience "the change" in a matter of 6 to 8 wks or even longer to show tone in the body from this cream. So far it hasn't changed my body, I am a breast cancer survivor who has had major surgery in my breast and stomach, while I still have a belly (unfortunately) in the higher torso, I was hoping this cream can assist that. I also placed this cream under my arms and inner thighs, I hate how big they got since my 3 kids, who are all young adults now. I also attend the gym regularly. Still no muscle tone difference from the cream. I will keep using it though just because I love the scent, no stinging sensation and I enjoy how soft it makes my skin feel with a lovely scent it provides. I also love the texture of the cream. Its heavy but doesn't feel heavy or sticky upon applying to the skin. I would definitely say just buy the product when U can at Ulta versus the website. Unless U really need to due to low supply in store. But I wouldn't urgently buy this. Its more of a want than a need. If it did do what its supposed to then I'd definitely recommend ordering it constantly!

This product is absolutely amazing! I did read the other reviews, and I noticed that people said something about the smell. I was nervous at first, so when I opened it, I immediately put it to my nose. For me the smell is completely fine and a nice smell.

I bought both B-tight and get dreamy. I rubbed the B-tight on first let it absorb then used Get Dreamy. This was absolutely amazing!!!!! I woke up and after one application I saw a difference. Only thing is I'm a slender person but have stretch marks and stretched skin because of pregnancy's. This was my last attempt before a tummy tuck but if the results continue this way I will not get the tummy tuck!

These products are so amazing I ordered the booty one (I forgot the name) today after I woke up and looked at my belly in the mirror. Words cannot explain how happy I am with the results!!! What a relief!! I'm going to wear my bikini without feeling self-conscious!!! I'm so happy!! 

Only draw back is it is really warm on the belly, so if it's too much wipe it off after 20 minutes is what the directions say. I left it on though because I want the most bang for my buck.

author: Casey H.
headline: Works for me
comment: I am an athletic person and not overweight, but I have always had some cellulite on my thighs that nothing seems to help. The normal concept of "just reduce fat/ lose weight" wasn't helpful for me as I don't have a lot of weight to lose and even if I did lose 5lbs it didn't make a difference in cellulite. Super frustrating. I did some research and found it might have a lot to do with my skin needing more firmnesses/ tightening. So I first tried a cheap retinol body cream and it worked, but I didn't want to use retinol in high quantities long term due to side effects etc... so I tried this protect, and It took a few months but I noticed a difference, and after continued use I saw more results. I have been using it for about 8 months and use it once a day (at night) and like how it feels and smells/ light odor. And it goes on nice and smooth and is moisturizing. I also use the Re-Lure about 3-4 times a week in the morning. Once I added the whip to my nightly regime, I would say it reduced the appearance of my cellulite / increased skin tightening on the front of my thighs about 95%, and the back about 75%! Obviously that's not 100% but I didn't have that expectation to begin with. I will continue to use. Just wish it wasn't so expensive since it's a product I feel requires daily use for maintaining results. Still giving 5 stars as it has worked for me.

author: Daisy
headline: Bring back the even better refresh foundation now
comment:
Clinique's decision to discontinue the Even Better Refresh foundation is honestly so disappointing. I find it almost ironic that it was replaced with the Even Better foundation and marketed as an improvement, because for me, it absolutely isn't. I have given the new version multiple chances, and I just cannot get into it.

What made the Even Better Refresh so special was how truly refreshing it felt on the skin. It did not feel like makeup at all and wore more like a light tinted serum. My skin looked natural, smooth, and comfortable all day. In contrast, the Even Better foundation with SPF 15 feels heavy and occlusive on my skin and actually accentuates my pores instead of smoothing them.

What is especially frustrating is being told by an associate that the formula was tweaked to be better, when the original Even Better Refresh was already done right the first time. The replacement does not replicate that lightweight, breathable feel at all.

Please bring back the Even Better Refresh foundation. It was truly unique, and the current version simply does not compare.

author: Eleanor
headline: Perfect for aging skin.
comment: This foundation makes your skin feel moisturized and does not accentuate the wrinkles.

author: Maria
headline: Natural Lookiing Finish
comment: I've used the Clinique Even Better foundation for years. It's designed to help even out skin tone and diminish the appearance of dark spots over time, which is something I always look for in a foundation. It provides medium coverage, which I appreciate because it doesn't feel heavy, and it yields a natural-looking finish. I believe the Clinique Even Better foundation is a good choice for those seeking a foundation that offers decent coverage without a heavy feel.

author: Gina
headline: Clinique SPF foundation
comment: This foundation is great to use over the concealer I had also purchased. Skin feels smooth and it is not a heavy makeup, very natural.

author: Sarah
headline: Love this foundation.
comment: I have been wearing this foundation for a few years now, it's not heavy, I love that it has SPF in it. It last all day, no matter the weather.

author: LoveSummer
headline: Even Better Refresh
comment: I am so bummed they discontinued the even better refresh. Its the only full coverage foundation they had with a natural finish. I may have to switch to another brand.

author: Rebecca
headline: Almost perfect color match
comment: I used this years ago and didn't care for it too much.  Decided to try again since my 67 year old skin has changed a lot: drier, more sensitive etc.  I really like it a lot.  Has good coverage, looks radiant over my moisturizer and lasts pretty well throughout the day/evening. Also it seems like there are a few color choices for fair, cool toned skin.

author: Claudia
headline: Definitely loved it!!!
comment: I cannot express how much I love this!! I finally found the perfect foundation that will make my skin look so good. It's not sticky or anything. My wrinkles don't look bad at all. Definitely recommend using it.

author: Laura
headline: Really love this
comment: This foundation feels like a second skin. Not heavy at all and buildable. I also have very dry skin and it does not look cakey.

author: yo
headline: Great Coverage
comment: I was given a sample.  And love the coverage.

author: Cass
headline: Love it
comment: I get more compliments than the last product I bought

author: Mary
headline: This foundation does not have an appealing scent.
comment: Beyond the unpleasant scent, the delivery method is messy. I will not repurchase this item.

author: Angel
headline: Found my new favorite!!!!
comment: I cannot say enough good things about this foundation! It was a blind purchase during a skin event sale and honestly, it has now become my absolute favorite foundation! The application was so easy. It goes on extremely smooth and last all day long. It makes my skin look bright, and the coverage is flawless. I will never go without this again.

author: Connie
headline: I will buy this product again
comment: Advantage of this product over other foundations are ease of application, holding up to humidity in FL, and coverage. I'm 56 with sun spots- this is by far the best foundation I've used.

author: Suzanne
headline: Best foundation for me
comment: I have tried many formulas and colors over the years but this is the best.

author: K
headline: New Formula?
comment: Ive been Even Better Makeup Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Foundation - Nutty since 2009. The last two orders from Ulta I noticed a more orange tint. It doesn't last, very watery and the color is darker which turns my face a orangish brown. After a couple hours I have streaks on my face where the makeup has worn off. Ive never experienced this. When I reached out to customer service about this I was told it was nothing they could do and to contact the global customer care department. Ive been trying to find older batches but no luck.

author: Alicia
headline: Fav foundation
comment: It doesnt cause any acne, in fact, i have fallen asleep with it kn multiple times and did not wake up with destroyed skin. It definitly needs to be washed and reapplied after around 6-8 hours if you dont use a setting spray though. It starts to look separated/patchy on my skin.

author: Alicia
headline: Fav foundation
comment: It doesnt cause any acne, in fact, i have fallen asleep with it kn multiple times and did not wake up with destroyed skin. It definitly needs to be washed and reapplied after around 6-8 hours if you dont use a setting spray though. It starts to look separated/patchy on my skin.

author: Kelly
headline: I would buy this product again
comment: This product goes on smoothly and evenly. It does not dehydrate the skin and it looks very natural.

author: Doe
headline: Dispenser needs help!
comment: I like the color/ feel.  It is very light/not a lot of coverage/but not cakey.  Absolutely do not like the bottle and dispenser tip. You squeeze it hard enough to get some out and too much comes out and there's nothing you can do about it!

author: Victoria

comment:
Don't like the texture and heaviness  
Not water based

author: Cristina
headline: I would buy this product again
comment: I love this brand and products

author: Emilie
headline: I will be using this again.
comment: Very nice coverage. Color match is perfect. It wears well all day. Eager to see how it does in the summer with all the humidity.

author: Sav
headline: Drying, Short Lasting
comment:
This product dries my skin out even after I've moisturized. I have combination skin. The coverage looks a little patchy as well and doesn't last well throughout the day.
Although the color match was good for my cool skin tone, it's just not the product for me.

author: Ashley
headline: Wanted to like this, it's just okay
comment: Found that this foundation didnt build well, and looked as though my face was dry even if it wasnt. Sometimes I thought it made me makeup-free face looking worse than before.

author: Nellie
headline: perfect everyday foundation
comment: it is light enough to wear daily and the spf aspect is a great addition.

author: Jess
headline: Love this foundation!
comment: Exactly what I've been looking for! Makes my skin feel great.

author: Barbara
headline: Great product for a natural look.
comment: Love Cliniques Even Better for the natural coverage.  Was wearing the wrong shade and a counselor told me I should be wearing a warmer shade.  I tried it, and am very happy by hat my face looks warm and not white and cold.  Will definitely stick with this new shade.

author: Jasmine
headline: This is the best foundation and a perfect color match.
comment: OMG, soooo awesome

author: Cindy
headline: Great Foundation
comment: This is my favorite foundation, light but great coverage.

author: Ethel
headline: THIS PRODUCT IS A GAME CHANGER
comment:
I suffered from hyperpigmentation and decolorization after taking an Iron infusion. While I spoke to the consultant at Ulta, she suggested I should use this foundation and guest what? THIS FOUNDATION IS A GAME CHANGER. It also clears fine lines and removes dark spots. My skin is as smooth as silk. 
A big thank you to Ulta and its highly professional staff.

author: Hannah
headline: Go To Foundation for Sunny Days
comment: I feek like this product works the in both sunny and rainy days! It makes my skin look and feel natural. I like how it blends with my blushes too! Love this as my go to foundation.

author: Veronica
headline: Shade range???
comment: This finish is absolutely stunning but we need to talk about the fact that there are 30+ shades for dark skin tones and 3 for light skin tones…..?

author: Ru
headline: Was good only for 2 months or so
comment:
Brought this one in Ulta not so far ago. In store looked great, tried it on, got sample, was perfect. 
In few months I started to notice that I the shade of the same bottle got darker. I was surprised because it was during the winter, I'm staying home most of the time, keep it as it says on a package. Next thing I notice, it became more watery, the product would not get the same glow up effect as it did before. 

I was a good experience, I recored it for people who use a lot of product or use it really fast. So sad it happened, I loved it, it was my first foundation I got 😢

author: Sarah Jane
headline: Beautiful!
comment: This has fast become my favorite foundation. It's beautiful on the skin blends well plus has spf. I have tried others and i keep comibg back to this.

author: Hope
headline: Save your money
comment: Doesnt last 24 hours , separates very patchy

author: Hope
headline: Save your money
comment: Doesnt last 24 hours , separates very patchy

author: Arierusan
headline: Easy, everyday, flexible finish foundation
comment: This is such an easy foundation. Its not picky how its applied and plays well with other products. I have oily, acne prone skin and it left my skin with a matte leaning, satin finish that lasted well all day without touch ups. It is easy to build up and feels like nothing on the skin. The finish is flexible depending on what you put underneath and how you set it. The shade range seems so weird and it was difficult to pick a shade. I ended up with CN02 Breeze which is a pretty good match. I wear Mont Blanc in NARS Light Reflecting, 1.5 in Armani Luminous Silk, and 125 in Fenty Soft n Lit.

author: Kespenc
headline: Works fine
comment: This foundation leaves my skin with a dewy look and greasy feel. It seems to come off fairly easy as well. It looks cakey at times and I get creases. I like that contains SPF and is full coverage. Dispenses easily.

author: d3kinney
headline: Great foundation!
comment: I'm borderline obsessed with this foundation. I've been a powder girl a majority of my adult life. I've tried one other foundation from Too Faced. It was fine, but I didn't love it. This one I loved from first application. It covers the redness on my cheeks, the color match is great, it's light weight, and easy to apply. Highly recommend!

author: Mel
headline: GO BUY THIS
comment: hello this foundation is pretty awesome i have acne and once i out it on and blend it out it disappears. good coverage and is blendable woukd recommend !!!🤌❤️ Like please !

author: Tracy
headline: Would buy again and again!
comment: This product covers my skin evenly and smoothly.  Some days it's all I put on and I look great. I've purchased multiple times! To do the initial color matching I had help from someone in the store.  She tested a few on my face so I got it right.  And it's been great ever since!

author: AuntLo
headline: Natural, Flawless Skin
comment: I struggle with redness, combination skin and fine lines. This foundation manages to blur out all of that, and I finally found my perfect shade! It looks really natural and feels light. It blended out nicely with a brush and you don't need to use a lot. I'm very happy with it.

author: Sonja
headline: I would buy this again
comment: Love this product-match is perfect & light

author: Ct
headline: Orange
comment: The color i originally got (cn 10) was ok for summer time but still did not match the pic when ordering and was super orange. I finally got what i thought woukd be a neutral pale color (CN 08) and it still came super orange. I like tjis foundation as a product i really do hut im nervous to even use it sometimes because of how orange they are and the color unreliability

author: penny
headline: my mom's favorite foundation!
comment: my mom absolutely loves this brand, especially this product. i can confirm that this product lasts sooooo long because she has had it for YEARS!

author: Susan
headline: Perfect for my skin
comment: I have used this Clinique foundation for the past 4 years. I have olive skin color & the CN58 Honey covers up the redness & flaws well. I like that it has SPF 15!

author: CJ
headline: Go to foundation in the Summer
comment: This foundation is one of my favorite simply because it looks natural, radiant/dewy, and sits on the skin very nicely. It makes the skin look healthy. The formula is well made. This foundation is medium coverage towards the lighter side, so the only complaint I have is I wish it was full coverage which of course is not advertised at all with this foundation, just a personal preference.

author: Marly
headline: I have used for years, glad to stilll be able to buy it
comment: This gives good coverage over age spots and still looks moist. Lasts all day, but can still be washed off.

author: Lang803
headline: Love this foundation!
comment: It glides on smooth, and is not too thick! It stays on for all day without reapplying and works well with my powder! I just wish it came in a bigger bottle, but all foundation is in these small bottles so it is very comparable to other brands!

author: JJ
headline: Perfect
comment: I have been buying this for a few years-since they changed the formula (and before). It is the best over a light lotion or moisturizer. I love it on my combination skin. It is worth every penny.

author: khlo
headline: Will not buy again:(
comment: I really wanted to like this foundation but no matter how much I moisturize this foundation does not blend into my skin. I tend to have dry patches here and there and those spots are much more noticable when I use this foundation. If you have dry skin I would not recommend this product even if you keep up with moisturizing because after a short time the foundation WILL start cracking/creasing around your dry areas.  Even my more oily areas like my Tzone become dried out after using this foundation as if the foundation is sucking the moisture from my face.

author: Donna
headline: I would buy again
comment: I gave sensitive skin and this does not irritate my skin.  I usually buy Bare Minerals but could not find a shade that worked.   Clinique cardamom worked well

author: Anne
headline: Works well, love Clinique!
comment: Great coverage, did not irritate my sensitive skin.

author: Becky
headline: I really like this foundation!
comment: After years of using mediocre foundations, I finally bought this one. It was more money, but it is totally worth it.

headline: Not what it claims
comment: The box claims some things that I'm not seeing. Quite expensive to not live up to it's claims.

author: An
headline: Makes my skin soft!
comment: Makes my skin soft and covers redness in a natural way. No one notices that I used foundation but coverage is great.

author: Christine
headline: This was even better than i expected
comment: I was a bit unsure when I purchased this. I wanted moisture and medium coverage - not too cakey but enough to cover for zoom calls. This fits the need exactly - my new favorite. AND it has SPF.

author: DeeDee
headline: So Effective!
comment: I'm 75 years old, and according to some acquaintances, friends, and family, I look at least 10 years younger! I am proud to say that I've been using Clinique skin care and makeup products for nearly 30 plus years. THANK YOU CLINIQUE!

author: auraliyah
headline: absolutely amazing!!
comment:
i typically don't wear foundation but when i do it's for a natural kind of look, and this foundation does just that! i would say overall it's medium coverage, but i always apply a very small amount because a little goes a long way. i assume if you apply more foundation it'll be better coverage. i also love the shades option! shade breeze looks exactly like my skin and im genuinely happy and impressed that i could find a shade exactly like my skin. 
however, beware when buying this, if you don't use a good skincare routine and wait at least a few minutes between each step, your foundation will look at least a little orange. 
overall, if you want a natural / semi natural makeup look, i'd definitely recommend this foundation! it's absolutely wonderful and i have had no issues with it. it lasts forever and leaves a poreless like appearance, i also have rosacea which this foundation does a good job at covering, plus the foundation is overall dewy and lasts all day, even if you're sweating and moving around a lot. i also lightly dot this underneath my eyes and use it in place of a concealer since it doesn't crease. if you want a full glam look i'd recommend buying another foundation.

author: Lisa
headline: First time matched properly
comment: I wish I had gotten the young lady's name who picked out my foundation. She works at the Clinique area and has a funny laugh at the Mall of GA. I'm 60 and she matched my foundation perfectly for the first time ever! I'm going to tell her manager next time I go in there. I'm so happy!!!!

author: Kristy
headline: Love this foundation!
comment: As an aging woman, I have been so pleasantly surprised with this foundation.  I originally purchased it on sale "just to try" and have already ordered a back up.  I was using Lancome and prefer this now - it is light, covers well, doesn't transfer, doesn't settle and the color match was perfect!

author: Christopher
headline: Best ever
comment: I've been using this foundation for almost two months now and it's by far the best I've ever used, It feels light and smooth. Wish I had found it earlier. Highly recommend this product

author: Loretta
headline: I would buy this again
comment: Just the right amount of coverage

author: asmi
headline: nice product
comment: i want to purchase it because the clique is my favorite brand

headline: I really actually love this foundation
comment: Feels light and coverage is there too

author: Olena
headline: Great coverage, non-drying foundation
comment: I like how smooth this foundation goes on. It leaves my skin soft and well-moisturized

author: Nancy
headline: Bring back Even Better Glow
comment: I loved the Even Better Glow foundation. The finish was very natural looking and I appreciated that it had SPF in it. Sadly Clinique doesn't have anything quite like it anymore.

author: Stran818
headline: Glass skin
comment: Im mad i didnt try this earlier!! Coverage is medium but looks like second skin. Found a perfect color match which never happens

author: Mary
headline: I chose this foundation as my Diamond member gift
comment: Out of all the foundation gifts they offered, I chose this one because it had the best color selection for cool-neutral skin tones like mine. I'm a Bright Winter in color theory with light olive skin, brunette hair and blue eyes. Most foundation shades are too yellow, pink, gray, orange, chalky, or deep on me. For reference, I wear Mac NW20, Chanel B20 and Estee Lauer 3N1 shades. The associate matched me to CN 18 Cream Whip in this brand. I must say, it's a perfect match in daylight. I have occasional breakouts, so I'm glad this isn't greasy. It looks good on my mature skin. I took off one star because the SPF is so thick it's hard to blend without a moisture primer first. Even after it sets, the foundation is a bit white which will flashback on camera. This is a great foundation to wear outdoors when exercising because you're protected. Don't take a selfie with it unless you put bronzer on over it.

author: Olivia
headline: I really enjoy this foundation
comment: It has amazing coverage and is super light weight feeling on my skin

author: Vicki
headline: I Just Love Clinique Foundation.
comment:
I've used Clinique Makeup since college, and I'm 67!  It's kept me from aging.  I've never even tried a different
Foundation.  The colors are true, and the texture is great!

author: Bekah
headline: Best foundation for oily skin ever
comment: This is the best foundation for oily skin. I've tried every foundation at least twice and this one is the only thing that lasts!! 12/10 ☆

author: Lou
headline: Like skin!
comment: I have dry, redness prone skin and this foundation is able to be buildable without being patchy or clogging my pores! I feel so beautiful wearing this I'll be using it as my wedding foundation.

author: Dawn
headline: A favorite.
comment: Leo's my skin healthy and looking good.

author: Nancy
headline: Best foundation I have ever used!
comment: In my 67 years, I have tried a lot of makeup.  I found this product recently, and I have to say, it is the best!  It is moist, but light, and a little dab will do.  It covers wrinkles and spots, and makes my skin look consistently beautiful!

author: Tessie
headline: Feels like you have nothing on
comment: Great coverage without feeling heavy.

author: productlover52
headline: Perfect for me foundation
comment: I shopped Ulta for at least two hours last Saturday and tried pretty much every foundation available at my particular store. Key word "available" ...Including.. Nars, it, Tarte, Robane, Charlotte Tillbury, MAC,.BobbieBrown..and  others i can't remember. My primary complaint about most of the products I tried was the SMELL...or, more specifically the Odor of the products.  It's a similar kind of motor oil smell in many of the brands. Not pleasant... and actually kind of nauseating. Sorry. So, last but not least I ended up back at the Clinique area and tried this foundation. After I narrowed down the shade (there are many) and noticed the missing weird smell,..I discovered a nice,natural,buildable medium coverage and a luminous but not  shiny finish. Also, the  smallish squeeze bottle with the little tip dispenser makes for a very controllable delivery of product. Unlike what you get with a wand or worse, those squeezable tubes with the sponge! I hate those! Anyway I made my choice and my purchase and am very pleased. I would reccomend this product.

headline: I've been buying this brand since 1080
comment: I love this foundation

author: Big Al
headline: My new fave foundation
comment: I have loved a designer high end foundation in the past but it stopped being made. When rhis was on the 50% off sale at Ulta I figured 'whats to lose?' The coverage of this Clinique Even Better is lovely and stays looking good all day! Ive found my new favorite!!

author: Alayna
headline: AMAZING!!!!!!!
comment: Bought this for my mom and she absolutely loves it. I wish I could remember the employee who helped us because she was an absolute god send. She shade matched my mom perfectly and was just so helpful.

author: PaulaRenee
headline: Cream Chamois
comment: What has Clinique done with their colors?  I used the Glow Even Better Foundation in Cream Chamois for 20 plus years. Then it was discontinued.  When I bought this version the color was so much darker and looked nothing like it used to.

author: Pam
headline: I will buy this product again.
comment: I've used Clinique products for years.

author: Stacy
headline: Not Matte enough
comment: Not matte enough for a mature woman.

author: Aubrey
headline: Fell in love
comment: I got this as my Diamond free gift and actually fell in love with it. The shade match is perfect, it lasts all day and it has a great natural finish on the skin. It looks good under a full face of heavy makeup too. It doesn't pill under my skincare and at the end of the night it never looks super cakey or separated. I also don't need a primer under this.

author: Carmen W.
headline: Perfect shade match
comment: Alabaster is my perfect match.  I occasionally use a different makeup, but will always have this on hand.  It's my go to.

author: Quin
headline: Moisture and great
comment: Lightweight, instantly smooths and hydrates, it works so great in my skin.

author: Heather
headline: Amazing how well this worked!
comment: I was recently told by my dermatologist that I have rosacea.  So, I was looking for a foundation that would help cover the redness.  The awesome lady in the store recommended this -- and she sure wan't wrong!  Even just a little bit goes a long way!  So, it's easy for a quick morning cover-up, even when I don't want to do a full face.

author: BeachBum
headline: Nice, Affordable High End Dupe
comment: I received this as a Diamond Perk when Diamond first became a thing. I've repurchased it since because its a beautiful foundation at an affordable price. Its a dupe for luxury foundations. Dewy finish. Just a really nice foundation.

author: brigy
headline: not for me
comment: everything I wear this my skin looks so dry. this is definitely not something I will ever buy again.

author: twing
headline: It's OK
comment: To the powers that be at Clinique, perhaps you could change up the models a bit.  It is hard to envision what a shade or color will look like on me because every model on your site has brown eyes and olive skin. Don't forget that white people shop on this site, too.

author: R
headline: Perfect natural dewy finish for acne prone skin
comment:
I have been using this foundation for over a year now and occasionally have tried others like lancome, fenty, covergirl, too faced, and neutrogena, and absolutely nothing compares to this foundation. 

It is the perfect natural finish coverage, with no patchiness. It allows your natural glow to shine through and leaves your skin looking very moisturized and healthy. It is soothing on my acne prone skin. It is buildable, from light to medium coverage, but always does a good job covering my acne without making it look crusty. I almost never use concealer. 

As someone with pale skin, it's hard to find a color match. Usually it either makes me look like a ghost, or it's too orange/peachy. The flax color is such a perfect match for me, and somehow blends with my skin when I'm paler in the winter and when I'm darker in the summer. 

I really hope they never change the formula because nothing else works for my skin the way this does.

author: carrie
headline: amazing
comment: i have extreemly pale skin and this is the only foundation i have ever found in my skin tone that i actually like. a little bit offers a lot of coverage and i rarely ever get oily with it despite having very oily skin. absolutely will never stop buying this

author: Alyssa
headline: Feels like skin
comment: This foundation feels so good, weightless and buildable. Definitely can give a more glam look too! I wear this when I have a tan and it always looks stunning. Kind of feels like you don't have a lot of makeup on even w/ a full face & lasts all day

author: Olivia
headline: Made me breakout after using it for 3 days
comment:
I do not have oily prone skin. I wash my face every morning and night with the same gentle cleanser I've used for years. My forehead is actually the driest part of my face and I broke out with 6 new little zits after a few days. I had switched from Too Faced Born This Way tinted moisturizer because they discontinued it. (I had never broken out from that.) I wish I had tried a tester of this foundation first. 

Really disappointed, as I haven't gotten acne in several years but now I gotta let my 6 new pimples heal because of whatever they put in this. After doing some research I found I'm not the only one dealing with this. And it's sad because a lot of people think their skin is the problem. But in reality it's just something to do with this formula. Clinique is trying to have a comeback and with this formula it just isn't working for me.

author: Christina
headline: Color is perfect match
comment: Jasmine from Lexington was the best. She found my perfect match

author: Carrie
headline: Perfect for mature, oily skin and rosacea
comment: This is the ONLY foundation that doesn't sit in my lines (42 years young) and works with my super oily and rosacea skin. It came dermatologist recommended. Bye MAC and Estee Lauder. I used Benefits pore minimizer under it. Its been 8.5 hours !!!

author: Sarah
headline: I will buy this product again
comment: So smooth! Blends amazingly.

author: Lisa
headline: I would by this again.
comment: First time I bought and tried this was in July. Goes on smooth. Doesn't feel greasy while wearing.  I can't hardly tell I have any on.

author: SHEILA
headline: I would buy this product again.
comment: Love it! Good coverage.

author: B
headline: good product  But>>>>>>>
comment: While I like the product, I much prefer the discontinued Even Better Glow. I used this product and really liked everything about it. Nothing ass constant as change!!!!!

author: Marian

comment: Color #52 neutral is what I bought last year, but unfortunately it looks darker on me for some reason. I don't spend time in the sun at 77 yrs, so I don't know what the deal is. Big mistake for me for paying over $30+ for this

author: Abi
headline: CLEARED MY SKIN?????????!!!
comment: I never write reviews but I came on here and MADE AN ACCOUNT to write this review. This stuff is nuts for acne prone and sensitive skin. My skin hasn't been this clear in FOREVER. I know it's not the other products I'm using because I've used them with a billion other non comedogenic foundations and they all break me out but this one IS AMAZING AND MY SKIN IS SO CLEAR I LOVE IT AND WILL KEEP BUYING IT also it's really pretty and looks phenomenal. I use the shade Sand.

author: Shirley
headline: Good Product
comment: Good coverage without feeling heavy.

author: Elaine
headline: I will continue to purchase this product
comment: This is one of the better foundations I have used, very smooth and not caky

headline: I would buy it again
comment: Very light exactly skin match color love it

author: Addy
headline: Only expensive makeup I can actually justify
comment:
This was reccomended to me by an ulta employee with a clinique badge, so i figured she got commission or worked directly with clinique but im too nice to say no. Plus when she did a color match on my and i tested the formula, i found it was just what i was looking for for casual day to day makeup. 
Ive always had a vendetta against clinique due to animal testing (not sure if they still do it tbh) but i gave it a chance- a very expensive chance when i normally refuse to spend more than $15 on makeup. 
I love it though, its a perfect shade match, its blends nicely under or over cream blush and contour. Its slightly dewy but sits well under pressed and loose powder for more sheen control. It covers redness and isn't patchy over my acne. Its very versatile with the amount of coverage you want. It really is worth the price, the only fancy product i use every day. 
4 stars because it does transfer very easily, and i do need to blot it throughout the day, i have everso slightly oily leaning skin and its pretty hot and humid. But if i get my fave close to ANYTHING it transfers over it it. If i touch my face while reading a book then the pages are covered in finger prints.

author: Val
headline: Best foundation
comment: Applying very easy. Very light wight. Feels like your skin. I love it

author: Danielle
headline: not bad
comment: this foundation is a good foundation however it was hard for me to find my shade and I noticed that it can be a little oily. overall the foundation isn't bad but it is pricy. I would recomend the juvias place I am magic radiance foundation over this because the shade range is better, easy to find match and seems to be somewhat of a dupe for this foundation with many skin care benefits and is a better price with more product. The only downside is that the product has cherries in it which is really good for the skin but you can smell it and may be strong for some people. But otherwise the foundation seems to be amazing and a better price point that this one. Sometimes I noticed with this foundation that it got so greasy that it would melt off my face shades were too orange tinted for me personally, messy, stains clothes, and doesnt dry very well. However if you have dry skin I can see this foundation working for you, I don't think it's bad but I think for the pricing you can do better with the juvias place I am magic radiance foundation.

author: MJ
headline: Amazing brand
comment:
The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 is truly one of the best hyaluronic acids I've ever used. It contains multi-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid for deep hydration and vitamin B5 to enhance surface moisture and support skin repair.

It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling plump and refreshed. I have mature, dry skin that used to look dull and tired. Since I started using this three years ago, my skin has transformed—my texture has improved, it looks fresher, and in my 40s, people never guess I'm older than 32. It's become my go-to product and my number one skincare essential.

On top of all that, it's incredibly affordable. For the results it delivers, The Ordinary is unmatched—proof that high-quality skincare doesn't have to come with a luxury price tag.

author: Heather
headline: Formula change ruined this product
comment: It's rare I leave reviews, but this one felt important. I had been using this product pretty much as long as it had been around, and it was perfect. But about a year ago, my skin started breaking out in painful, cystic acne unlike anything I've ever experienced. I didn't think it could possibly be due to a product I had been using for years, so I continued using this serum. I could not figure out why my skin was the worst it had ever been in my life and tried just about everything to fix it. Recently, I ran out of this product and couldn't restock right away… and my skin cleared up almost over night. I thought it was a fluke, restocked, and my skin broke out almost immediately after starting this serum again. I stopped using it, and again, my skin cleared up almost immediately. What I wish I had known a year ago but found out today was that The Ordinary completely changed the formula. I had no idea, and the timing lines up to exactly when my skin problems started. I was buying a completely different product and had no clue. I'm so sad to say I will never buy this again, as it was a holy grail product for me a long time. If you've noticed the same issues I did, maybe try cutting this one out.

I was definitely afraid I'd break out or have rashes from the new formula like others, but so far....no negative experience. It's been a few months now, and I love how it's lightweight and absorbs quickly. It is ALOT leas sticky, and I love that. I'm just wondering if it's skin differences between customers or if I'm doing something different. It doesn't peel for me. This is the first product I use after cleansing my face and using a toner. I wait a minute or so for it to absorb, and then I follow up with my other serums, then lock it in with my red bean water gel moisturizer (mornings) & my cica gel cream (nights). my face has never felt more hydrated. So, although it's unfortunate for those affected by the formula change, I personally have had a rather positive experience with it. Always do a patch test with new products. A month ago, my skin that I've been meticulous about, suddenly became red and irritated, and burns from any product on it. I blamed everything except for this serum, until I finalky looked it up and found that my moat recent bottle was released with a new formulation. No warnings, no new label, nothing to indicate a formula change. I now have 2 months to try and repair my skin before my wedding. I'm disappointed in The Ordinary, and will no longer use any of their products. It's unfortunate, but I can't trust that it won't happen again.

author: Despondent Consumer
headline: Reformation?!?!

Hoping Deciem is paying attention here. Like MANY MANY other reviews I had been using this product for YEARS and loved it. So I took to the website to look for a way to contact Deciem about this issue figuring it was a fluke, only to check the reviews (to see if anyone else had this issue and how it was handled) and find that it's no fluke.  This is apparently the new 'formula'.  I did not realize it had been changed since the pictures were the same and the name was the same I assumed I was receiving the same product I've purchased previously. 

The number of recent reviews taking issue with this change is highly concerning.  Long term regular users (like myself) are not having breakouts and issues that we haven't faced in years since perfecting our individual regimens. As I am now out of the 'old' formula I will have to hunt down a new product or rethink my facial regimen.  Hoping and praying that Deciem will send out a mass message informing us they have decided to go back to the original and it will be available for purchase again ASAP.

author: tientien0803
headline: Highly recommend !!
comment:
The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a game-changer in my skincare routine. From the moment I incorporated it into my daily regimen, I noticed a remarkable difference in the hydration levels of my skin. The lightweight texture makes it easy to apply, and it absorbs quickly without any greasy residue.

What sets this serum apart is its potent combination of hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5. Hyaluronic acid is a powerhouse ingredient known for its ability to attract and retain moisture, leaving my skin feeling plump and supple. The addition of vitamin B5 enhances hydration and helps to improve the skin's barrier function, leaving it feeling nourished and revitalized.

I've struggled with dry patches and dullness, but this serum has truly transformed my complexion. My skin looks and feels more hydrated, radiant, and youthful. Plus, the affordable price point makes it accessible to everyone.

Overall, The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a skincare essential for anyone looking to achieve hydrated, glowing skin. I highly recommend adding it to your routine—you won't be disappointed!

headline: New Formula Great In Theory But...
comment:
Not great in practice. I used to love the original formula, and used it on and off for years with great results. I never had a problem with stickiness (and it's likely due to user error, anyway).
