One of the standout features of this serum is its ability to lock in moisture throughout the day. Thanks to the hyaluronic acid, which can hold up to 1000 times its weight in water, my skin stays hydrated and dewy from morning until night. Even in harsh weather conditions or during long flights, this serum keeps my skin looking fresh and plumped.

Additionally, the inclusion of vitamin B5 adds an extra layer of nourishment and helps to soothe and repair the skin's barrier. I've noticed a reduction in redness and irritation since incorporating this serum into my routine, making it ideal for those with sensitive or compromised skin.

Overall, the Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum is a skincare essential that delivers on its promises. Whether you're dealing with dryness, dullness, or simply want to give your skin a hydration boost, this serum is a must-have. Highly recommend adding it to your regimen – your skin will thank you!

author: Lucy
headline: Thick and Glossy
comment:
This is such a gorgeous lip balm! I picked it up on a whim and wasn't sure what to expect after feeling how thick it was in the store, but I ended up loving it. Usually, I prefer thinner glosses and balms because I like the smooth feel when I rub my lips together, but this one is still very smooth despite its thickness. It's much longer-lasting than most of my balms and has a beautiful, high-shine gloss finish. I have the shade Strawberry Sorbet, which is a soft, slightly warm pink tint. It smells like sweet strawberries, and I love the scent. As it wears throughout the day, my lips stay pretty moisturized, though the gloss wears off (as expected), and it doesn't feel quite as smooth for rubbing my lips together after a while. author: Luna

If I put it on in the morning, I can feasibly make it last on a single application at least through my workday, as long as I'm not drinking too much coffee (obviously it does rub off on cups). My lips have never felt better! They even feel soft when I don't have it on, which is wild because it's winter where I am right now and my lips usually suffer through this season. I am stoked about this. It literally looks like a gorgeous lip gloss, but it's a beautifully formulated lip treatment. What more could you ask for? GET IT

headline: new holy grail

if you want to invest in a nice glossy balm that really hydrates and lasts hours, nothing beats this imo. however, you can also find clear balms that are slightly thinner but look/feel similar (and smell better) under $10.

comment: I bought this lip gloss for the moisturizer and gloss affect. Had lip injections days  prior and with the weather change needed extra moisture conditioning for my lips.It was exactly what I was looking for with a slight tint!  I Definitely will be buying this again soon!

author: Allison
headline: Crème Brûlée

I purchased the crème brûlée shade and it's a great everyday nude. The formula is on the thicker side but isn't sticky and leaves my lips moisturized.

author: Oli

The only thing i have to state is the obvious. Its more on the pricy side. I say this because the container is quite small, although i find it to be the perfect size. There is more product held than one would think, and a little goes a long way. This product is worth it, try it asap!

author: Jazz
headline: What The Other Brands Aim To Be.
comment: Listen, this what the other brands hope their product does but this actually does it. There is no better lip balm. Miles agead of Summer Fridays and Lineage which to me are just lip glosses and lack in actual moisturization. This though, ACTUALLY MOISTURIZES, the consistancy is thick so it last, evan after eating. The scent is not strong and the subtle color really smoothes out the lips. My new staple.

author: Emily
headline: So pretty and long-lasting!

author: Syd Lanky
headline: Don't justify it, just BUY it!
comment: Literally the best!

author: mattspunkingurl
headline: Love it

I keep this in my purse to add to my lip combo if my lips feel or look dry. This does the trick. I think i got this in a fab fit fun box but now i want to try another color. I dont really notice any detectable fragrance.

author: Angela
headline: Seriously so good
comment: Just bought crème brûlée and I'm shocked how great of a product this is. Seriously so good. Moisture that lasts. Smooths. And pleasant texture. Absolutely live this. This formula has come a long way over most gloss or lip treatments. Buy them all!

author: Greta
headline: Best Lip Treatment EVER

Personally, I love the scent. To me, it smells like burnt marshmallows and hot chocolate. However, I've heard some people saying they don't care for the scent. If you don't like the smell of either of the scents I mentioned, smell and try before you buy. But I would definitely recommend getting at least one.

author: Laura
headline: A must have for me

I did have to put it on pretty frequently at first, but now my lips are in such better shape - a huge part to this product. I love the light colors of the orange and creme brulee colors (flavors?). Anywho, I have stocked up because this is one i dont want to run out of

author: Gigi

Yes and no, its like hydrating sticky if that makes sense, but not like you got honey on your face sticky and you cant wash it  off with water kinda sticky. When i am sleeping it doesnt transfer or go everywhere and when i wash my face in the morning my lips STILL feel hydrated. Im going back to get the strawberry one. author: Logan
headline: Best lip product I've ever purchased
comment: I hope they never discontinue this product! Especially Strawberry Sorbet! I bought this because I needed a good everyday lip color, but lipsticks are too much on me and sooo drying. I also wanted something that would be hydrating. This lip treatment is PERFECT! I wear it everyday instead of using chapstick and lipstick. It's creamy but also light enough that it isn't sticky. There is a glossy feeling to it, but it isn't sticky like most lip products are. The hint of pink in Strawberry Sorbet adds the perfect amount of color for an effortless everyday look and it stays on for a very long time. I wore this to a festival this weekend and never had to reapply. I will be purchasing this for the rest of my life!

author: Dayz
headline: LIFE CHANGING FR
comment: I use to put chapstick on every now and then. I never got into the habit of reapplying lip balms. I never fell for the summer fridays hype. I decided to try this and i cannot leave the house without it. I can apply before the gym (i'm a super sweaty girl btw), workout, drink water 3 hrs later and my boyfriend tells me you have lipgloss on. I had totally forgot! My lips are hydrated. I would definitely buy again it is a little sticky but i love it. I got cocoa

author: salAMANDAr

My lips are screaming for this right now because mine has gone missing after my son got a hold of it. I'm pregnant and everything is shriveling up and i know this will restore my lips! Even the left over laniege mask I have does NOTHING for me. 

I have to buy this again!

author: L

headline: My First Holy Grail Moisturizer
comment:
I was a little hesitant to try this moisturizer because I'd seen a lot of negative reviews, but my skin drinks it up like water in the desert. I have combination to dry, sensitive skin, and this is one of the few moisturizers that actually leaves my skin feeling truly satisfied once it absorbs. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy or heavy and leaves a smooth, glowy finish that lasts throughout the day

One of the biggest challenges for me has been finding a moisturizer that works under my mineral sunscreen. Even with products that should be compatible, like a water-based sunscreen over a water-based moisturizer, my SPF still flakes or pills no matter how long I wait before applying it. With this one, I usually wait just 5-10 minutes and my sunscreen glides on perfectly, stays in place all day, and doesn't disturb the moisturizer underneath. This has made it a staple in my morning routine.

It's fragrance-free, but it also doesn't have that odd "fragrance-free" smell, which I really appreciate. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it doesn't irritate my skin or clog my pores. I've never had breakouts from it. I'm already on my third bottle, which says a lot because I usually rotate through products pretty quickly.

I did the same routine the very next day before work. By the time I had gotten to work, my eyes watering, tears down my face, burning, nose running, and sneezing. Throughout the day, my coworkers kept asking me if I was okay because my eyes were THAT SWOLLEN. I tried eye drops multiple times to wash out my eyes, it did not work. I went to the bathroom and finally decided to wash my face with water. I got some relief but, nothing really made my symptoms go away until I completely washed my face and took a benedryl. I recommend skipping this product entirely and going with Clinique moisture surge or a Pur moisturizer!!!

author: Nikki
headline: Don't Believe the Cons
comment: Listen, the truth of the matter is that most people are using wayyyyy TOO many products in their skincare routine. So here's the story: after 3 years of not wearing any makeup, I went to take family photos with my kids and decided to wear makeup. I also bought the Good Molecules bundle and started using it. Literally a day later my face was broken out bad and I didn't know whether it was from the makeup, the Good Molecules, or both. Soooo I decided to buy the Laroche Posay face wash and this moisturizer, both in the white bottles, and to completely stop using anything else on my face. No oils, no serums, no nothing! Yall, within the next 3 days my face had cleared up. Now, my skin was looking dry when I'd wake up in the morning but I was like I'm going to give the Laroche Posay another week and if ya'll could see my face! It is CLEAR and smooth!! It's giving photo filter for real!! So for the people complaining of pilling and all of that, you are most likely using too many things on your face. You don't need all that extra stuff. It's doing more harm than good!! Also, follow the directions on the bottle friend. They are there for a reason. So for instance, when I wash and rinse my face I don't rub it dry. I just let it air dry a little and then add this moisturizer and yes, it soaks right into my skin. Someone mentioned that as a con lol. Friend you don't want the product to sit on top of your skin. It's meant to repair your barrier, not give the appearance that you slapped Vaseline on your face and if you want that look, then just add a little Vaseline after this product has absorbed into your skin. You can't cake your 8 products on your face and then say this product pilled! Duhhhhh lol. Cake face.

author: Apurva loke
headline: Loved it
comment: Complimentary from tatcha Tatcha Dewy Moisture Cream – My Thoughts Tatcha just launched their Dewy Moisture Cream, and after trying it, I can say it lives up to the name. It's a rich, deeply hydrating formula made for dry or mature skin. The ingredients are impressive—hyaluronic acid, red algae, squalane, Japanese purple rice, and their signature Hadasei‑3 complex—all focused on locking in moisture and strengthening the skin barrier. The texture is creamy and smooth, and it melts into the skin beautifully. It leaves a soft, dewy finish that makes the skin look fresh and well-nourished. If you have oily or acne-prone skin, this might feel a bit heavy—so a patch test is a good idea before fully using it. Overall, it's a luxurious cream for anyone needing intense hydration, especially during colder months or when the skin feels dull and tight. A great addition to any nighttime routine.

author: Salley
headline: Luxurious
comment:
So I have been a loyal DE Protini purchaser for awhile now and always felt satisfied with that specific product UNTIL I decided to give this girl a try and oh...my... goodness! It is indescribably luxurious and long lasting! If DE Protini and Bora Barrier had a baby, THIS would be her!!!! 

So I have loved DE Protini for my morning routine and DE Bora Barrier for night routine because it is MUCH thicker (almost TOO thick). But I would normally feel like my skin was moisturized when I woke up in the morning, but some mornings not so much. But this Tatcha Dewy Skin is perfection in a container- a little goes a long way, especially after the first few steps in my routine, and the moisturizing effect lasts until I wash my face again, but doesn't feel heavy and wet if you know what I mean? Some moisturizers are great, but they do not seem to absorb as intended, and like a layer of damp on my face ready to grab any wisps of hair near my face. This product TRULY absorbs, and continuously works as a true moisturizing mask until washed off. LOVE it! Sorry DE, but definitely retiring my Bora Barrier permanently.

author: L
headline: Lingonberry Glimmer tastes like lip smackers left in the sun
comment:
Lingonberry is NOT a safe blind buy! As a girl with chronic skin conditions and dry lips, I have all sorts of lip balms to get me through whatever stages my skin and lips are in. I've purchased several of the peptide lip treatments and love how they feel on my lips. I had just finished my 3rd tube and saw the glimmers on sale and decided to give the Lingonberry version a try. This has a formula that essentially feels the same as the non-shimmery versions however the flavor or whatever they put in this one tastes disgusting. 

It took me back to the 5th grade and my multi pack of lip smackers lip balms from the drugstore - fruity and reminiscent of melting plastic. Not berry-like at all in my opinion. If I could get a refund on this, I absolutely would. I've been trying to use it as much as I can because even with a sale, we're still coughing up $16-20 for a single lip balm and this one in my opinion, was not worth my hard earned brown girl dollars. Pick up any other flavor or the Topicals lip balm for an alternative that actually doesnt taste like melted plastic.

Love it

headline: I Hope It Never Goes Away

Prior to this I was using Bobbi Brown's foundation- which I also love! But started feeling it was unnecessary to have an opaque skintone. The Bareminerals tinted moisturizer was more up my alley for day-to-day use. Its buildable so you can use as much as you need. Some reviewers have mentioned it being flakey - this is something I've expereinced time to time. I think in that case the product is old, because I'll buy a new one and it wont have flakes. I find it best to use my fingers as I think it blends better. If it looks chaulky I wet a beauty blender and press it on the areas to help it blend in. If youre looking for a day to day lightweight foundation this is the one for you.

I do like the finish, its dewy but not greasy and I don't have to set it. If I wasn't a ride or die for my moisturizer I'd return it an keep this.

author: Dredre
headline: Brilliant product
comment:
I love this moisturizer. I used to use the line's powder foundation but as I hit my late 40s, I needed all of the moisture I could apply to support my skin. My eyes are also sensitive to many sunscreens but not the bare minerals formula so I was very excited to try this. This product is a one stop shop. I'm just writing this review now, but have purchased this so many times. It moisturizes, gives sun protection, and provides light, buildable cover. I have mild rosacea across my nose and it provides enough cover to even that out, even on a hot day. I don't feel like my skin is suffocating, either-I put it on sbd firget it. 
I love that I can buy a big tube for home, and they also offer a smaller tube on a regular basis for travel. It's really thoughtful to have that option all of the time.

Well it just ran out and I went to use the one I purchased in August to discover that it's an entirely different color now and way too dark on me. I went to ulta in person to get help and the woman at the register confirmed that yes bareMinerals changed their shades….. but kept all the old names, which is incredibly misleading. Ulta refuses to help me exchange it for a product that IS my shade because it's been more than 60 days since my purchase. I feel deceived and robbed and ulta refuses to help. Will not be shopping ulta again. They devieve you, take your money, and then disrespect you over email (Maria, I'm talking about you) and blatantly refuse yo help. author: Busy mom
headline: The TRUTH
comment: If youre skepitcal here is a true review on this product— let me help you because i wish i had someone on here telling me this… for starters i have combo skin. Oily in summer and dry— when i go two days without moisturizer because life! Sometimes when i think im moisturuzed im still dry. Anywho— i color matched on chat gpt using my trye foundation color from CT and EL. The match was perfect. I first applied this with my hands and was like ehh because i looked dry. Mind you i do a full skin prep before. I then re applied it with the morphe foundation brush and boom. That was the trick! So if youre going to get this, get an applicator brush. I didnt but the BM one because i love morphe and it was cheaper. I set this with a dewy setting spray. Probably best to stay away from anything that has alcohol. Overall, i like it. I think of you are new to skin tints you have to keep an open mind that these are not foundations. Ill be back after i review kylies ST!

author: Lindsey

author: Jaybird
headline: Liquid Gold with a Kick

I decided to start a search for a really good BB or CC cream. Since I'd used BM's loose highlighter powders in the past, I thought I'd give this Gel makeup a shot. Right away, I noticed three things: It was very light on my skin yet still a bit opaque, it smelled like nothing though it has an SPF30, and it's got subtle optical brighteners to make you look younger and fresher. I now consider this the core of my makeup. I even use it on the backs of my hands to cover imperfections and provide sun protection. It's been 10 years now, and I'll keep buying it as long as it exists. It's not cheap, but it's the real deal. Paired with their Original Concealer, you've got a winning combination for fresher-looking, protected skin.

Fast forward to now, I'm once again trying to stop with actual foundation, and this time I tried applying both with a liquid foundation brush instead and oh my god THAT was the key!!! They go on SO much better, cover more and act like a foundation without the heaviness of a foundation. AND now my pores look more blurred and it doesn't settle into creases. TOTAL GAME CHANGER.

I'm 39 and dislike wearing anything heavy on my face, but like a little bit of coverage. I still apply my normal moisturizer, then apply BM tinted moisturizer. It was originally promoted as a hydrating tinted moisturizer to give moisture to your skin. This is VERY matte, if you have oily skin this might be perfect for you. Drier skin types stay clear of the newer formula. Ugh, so disappointing Bare Minerals, what happened?

author: Heather

headline: disappointed

One of the things I loved about this product was that it was one of the only tinted moisturizers that did not contain silicones.  Bareminerals is also claiming the ingredients are the same, which is not true. I have my old packaging and the ingredients are very clearly different.  Something to be aware of if you like to avoid dimethicone in your skincare and makeup.Wish brands like this would stop ruining fan favorite products.

I figured out I needed to let my moisturizer sit on my face 20-30 minutes before hand before I applied. Once I figured that part out it did wonders looked effortless. author: Maiah
headline: Horrible, why is this product allowed to be sold
comment:
I wanted a good lightweight tinted moisturizer and was very excited to try this one out (I take care of my skin and usually never breakout with any new products). After one single day of wearing this tinted moisturizer (and the last), my face started to develop an itch, I removed the makeup and did my normal skincare routine which usually leaves me so dewy... unfortunately not this time. My skin was stripped of all moisture and not retaining any of the moisturizers I have been using for years.

It's been 3 days and my face still itches so much. I did some research of Bare Mineral products and ingredients that could've caused this, it is called Bismuth Oxychloride. And its a mineral that is ground and clogs your pores. I literally have washed my face everyday and it feels like the product's residue will not leave my skin. It is drying, itchy, and irritated. 

After reading other's experiences I will never purchase this brand or that compound ever again

I have tried setting with a powder, spray, using a primer, mixing with lotion. Nothing works. It either pills, leaves streaks, or dry patches.

I was told to apply using my hands and as I was applying, I started noticing how streaky it was all over my face and how it started piling on my dry parts like my the corners of my lips and nose. author: Lisa M.
headline: Well, I bought 2 at the same time...
comment: You will probably not use this review because I'm going to be really honest. I started using Bare Minerals loose powder foundation in my early 30's till my mid-40's. Maybe I wasn't exfoliating as often as I should. With sensitive skin it is hard to find a balanced routine for exfoliation and/or drenching one's face with moisturizer kindness. Whatever... your loose powder foundation was not working for my older skin any more (caking was a problem). Then, Voila, Complexion Rescue came to the rescue (ha, ha!) for my maturing skin. I'm now 59 years old and I've gotten compliments from younger women, wondering what I'm using to make my skin glow. Now, I'm going to nitpick: 1. Why did you ever retire your Generation Nude lipstick collection? Not every woman wants to look like a tart, but, surely, just wants to look her best. "Tutu" was an absolutely lovely pale and cool (bluish) pink color. As a very pale complected woman without crazy, whitish teeth, this shade kind of color-corrected my otherwise not so whitish teeth. 2. Why did you discontinue your Correcting Concealer Broad Spectrum SPF 20 in the compact? I agree with one of my Mother's favorite idioms that this product "hid a multitude of sins." Please don't discontinue your Complexion Rescue (Opal 01) or your Liquid Concealer (Very Fair 0.5C), either.

headline: LOVE this stuff!
comment:
I have been using this for well over a year now. Nearly $40 for one seemed like a big purchase for me but a bottle lasts at least 6 months even with regular use - you only need a tiny bit. It doesnt feel heavy and instantly helps smooth out your complexion. I struggle with acne and am lucky to have found some help via a dermatologist, but i still get a lot of bumps and blackheads and this helps cover those up quickly. I use it mostly on days where i don't my makeup and still want a little coverage but it also works great as a base under any foundation. The suncreen in it also works great! I would definitely use extra if you're going to be outside for a long time but its perfect for day to day protection. 

The only thing i dont like is that it is hardly tinted. It'll give your skin a little color for sure, but it's very subtle. I recently switched from the bamboo color to ginger because it seemed a bit too light for my skin, but there is hardly any difference at all between how each one looks on me. Don't stress too much about getting the perfect shade because as long as you're in the ballpark of your skin tone it won't matter.

author: Caroline
headline: When You're Ready for a More Natural, Healthy Look
comment: I'm 33 and finally more confident in my natural skin. I've had rounds of acne and rosacea over the years and now have combination skin that sees a few breakouts during the year. I wanted something that would add some coverage but wasn't so thick and wouldn't cake by lunchtime. I love this product. It is my go-to foundation. It takes a few minutes for it to set into the skin (you'll see it on top as you apply it) but after it sets, it's a really nice natural, dewy finish. I've receive a lot of compliments about how fresh my skin looks. It is weightless and I don't find that it melts off or absorbs away during long work days. It is buildable to a degree - some days I wear one layer while others I may do two for a little more coverage, but it's never thick or cakey. I did not like the matte version of this product. That didn't suit my skin well, but the regular tinted moisturizer will be my go to as long as they produce it! I wear Vanilla in the summer and Birch in the fall/winter and can also mix these in the in between seasons for the perfect shade.

author: Adri
headline: My new favorite tinted sunscreen!
comment: Im a lightskin latina, my body gets tan during the summer but my face doesnt so i went with the color wheat and its perfect! I use the color cinnamon as a bronzer. It blends nicely on top. I also use cetaphil 50spf sunscreen for extra spf coverage and I noticed bare minerals tinted sunscreen looks better when i take my time to moisturize and let my other spf sink in my face (about 10 mins) before applying. I have combination skin but lately my skin has been on the dry side so if I dont moisturize enough, the bare minerals doesnt look nice. So I recomend waiting about 10 minutes to let your skin care and/or sunscreen to sink in before applying the tinted sunscreen :) I shake first then apply a dime size to my finger and dots on my face, then use the brush to blend outwards. It eventually sets in. I start off small then add more for coverage as needed so it blends more nicely. Doesnt leave my skin oily, lasts pretty much all day, leaves a nice glow, has not caused me to breakout or itritate my skin and im currently dealing with dermatitis around my nose so its a plus that im able to cover the redness for someone who doesnt wear foundation but wanted some light coverage. Does not feel heavy, very lightweight. Give it a try!

author: L
headline: Lingonberry Glimmer tastes like lip smackers left in the sun
comment:
Lingonberry is NOT a safe blind buy! As a girl with chronic skin conditions and dry lips, I have all sorts of lip balms to get me through whatever stages my skin and lips are in. I've purchased several of the peptide lip treatments and love how they feel on my lips. I had just finished my 3rd tube and saw the glimmers on sale and decided to give the Lingonberry version a try. This has a formula that essentially feels the same as the non-shimmery versions however the flavor or whatever they put in this one tastes disgusting. 

It took me back to the 5th grade and my multi pack of lip smackers lip balms from the drugstore - fruity and reminiscent of melting plastic. Not berry-like at all in my opinion. If I could get a refund on this, I absolutely would. I've been trying to use it as much as I can because even with a sale, we're still coughing up $16-20 for a single lip balm and this one in my opinion, was not worth my hard earned brown girl dollars. Pick up any other flavor or the Topicals lip balm for an alternative that actually doesnt taste like melted plastic.

author: Eliza
headline: It's good stuff, but not worth the price
comment:
My main complaint with this moisturizer is that it can pill up my makeup. It doesn't pill with my MAC foundation, but it pills terribly with my IT Cosmetics CC+ Nude Glow. That was a pretty big let-down for me when this moisturizer is set at luxury pricing. My Bubble Slam Dunk moisturizer has never pilled or let me down, and it's much more affordable.

Because of the unpredictability with makeup, I ended up changing my routine so I only use the Tatcha at night. I do really love it for that.
